formula-notes:formula_2.1:zh.plainMeaning: 这个公式表示：当前群体中等位基因 B 有 i 个拷贝时，下一代中它恰好变成 j 个拷贝的概率。
formula-notes:formula_2.1:zh.inThisChapter: 在 Wright-Fisher 模型的引入部分，它建立了一代之间的转移概率，后面的矩阵公式会用它来追踪等位基因频率变化。

formula-notes:formula_2.1:en.plainMeaning: This formula gives the probability that allele B appears in exactly j copies in the next generation when the current population has i copies.
formula-notes:formula_2.1:en.inThisChapter: In the Wright-Fisher introduction, it defines the one-generation transition probability that later matrix formulas use to track allele-frequency change.

formula-notes:formula_2.2a:zh.plainMeaning: 这个公式用转移矩阵 P 更新整组等位基因拷贝数的概率分布。
formula-notes:formula_2.2a:zh.inThisChapter: 在本章中，它把 Formula 2.1 的单步转移概率整理成一个矩阵更新规则，用来描述一代中性漂变。

formula-notes:formula_2.2a:en.plainMeaning: This formula updates the whole probability distribution of allele counts by multiplying the current distribution by the transition matrix P.
formula-notes:formula_2.2a:en.inThisChapter: In this chapter, it turns the single-step probabilities from Formula 2.1 into a compact matrix rule for one generation of neutral drift.

formula-notes:formula_2.2b:zh.plainMeaning: 这个公式通过反复应用同一个转移矩阵，把等位基因拷贝数分布推进到第 t 代。
formula-notes:formula_2.2b:zh.inThisChapter: 它把一代更新推广到多代预测，用来说明中性漂变如何随时间累积。

formula-notes:formula_2.2b:en.plainMeaning: This formula projects the allele-count distribution t generations forward by applying the same transition matrix repeatedly.
formula-notes:formula_2.2b:en.inThisChapter: It extends the one-generation update into a multi-generation prediction, showing how neutral drift accumulates over time.

formula-notes:formula_10.1a:zh.plainMeaning: 这些关系把物种内多态性和物种间分化分别联系到突变率与演化时间。
formula-notes:formula_10.1a:zh.inThisChapter: 在基于分化的检验概览中，它们给出了中性模型下的期望值，供 HKA 等检验与观察数据比较。

formula-notes:formula_10.1a:en.plainMeaning: These relationships connect within-species polymorphism and between-species divergence to mutation rate and evolutionary time.
formula-notes:formula_10.1a:en.inThisChapter: In the overview of divergence-based tests, they set up the neutral expectations that HKA-style comparisons test against observed data.

formula-notes:formula_10.2a:zh.plainMeaning: 这个公式把每个位点的卡方贡献相加，形成一个总体检验统计量。
formula-notes:formula_10.2a:zh.inThisChapter: 在 HKA 和 McDonald-Kreitman 检验部分，它用来汇总多个位点的偏离程度，从而评估是否符合中性预期。

formula-notes:formula_10.2a:en.plainMeaning: This formula adds locus-by-locus chi-square contributions into one overall test statistic.
formula-notes:formula_10.2a:en.inThisChapter: In the HKA and McDonald-Kreitman section, it summarizes how deviations across multiple loci are pooled to evaluate neutrality.

formula-notes:formula_2.3:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算第t代的近交系数f_t，它等于从大小为2N的基因库中随机抽取两个等位基因是同一亲本基因拷贝的概率1/(2N)，加上它们不是同一亲本拷贝但上一代已近交的概率(1-1/(2N))f_{t-1}。
formula-notes:formula_2.3:zh.inThisChapter: 此公式出现在中性进化章节的引言部分，用于建立近交系数随世代变化的递推关系，为后续推导平衡状态和有效群体大小等概念提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_2.4a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式表示在时间 t 时杂合度（1 - f_t）与上一代杂合度（1 - f_{t-1}）之间的关系，其中 N 为有效群体大小，系数 (1 - 1/(2N)) 反映了每代由于遗传漂变导致的杂合度减少比例。
formula-notes:formula_2.4a:zh.inThisChapter: 该递归公式出现在中性进化章节的引言部分，用于推导杂合度随时间衰减的指数形式（公式 2.4b 和 2.4c），为后续讨论遗传漂变对等位基因频率和群体遗传多样性的影响奠定基础。

formula-notes:formula_2.4b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式表示经过t代后，杂合度（1-f_t）等于初始杂合度（1-f_0）乘以(1 - 1/(2N))的t次幂，其中N为群体大小，f_t为t代的近交系数。
formula-notes:formula_2.4b:zh.inThisChapter: 它由递推公式(2.4a)迭代得到，展示了中性进化中杂合度随时间指数衰减的规律，为后续推导(2.4c)（假设初始无近交）以及说明群体大小对遗传多样性丧失速率的影响奠定基础。

formula-notes:formula_2.4c:zh.plainMeaning: 公式 (2.4c) 计算在初始近交系数 f₀=0 时，经过 t 代随机交配后，群体中非近交个体的比例 (1-f_t)，其中 N 为群体大小，1/(2N) 为每代近交系数的增量。
formula-notes:formula_2.4c:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式由递推式 (2.4a) 和通解 (2.4b) 在假设非近交基础群体 (f₀=0) 下简化得到，用于展示群体大小 N 如何决定遗传变异丧失的速率，并为后续讨论长期进化中杂合度衰减奠定基础。

formula-notes:formula_2.5:zh.plainMeaning: 公式 (2.5) 计算在遗传漂变作用下，经过 t 代后群体期望杂合度 H_t 与初始杂合度 H_0 的关系，其中 N 为有效群体大小，(1 - 1/(2N))^t 是每代杂合度衰减因子的 t 次幂。
formula-notes:formula_2.5:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式由中性进化下的恒等漂变方程 (2.4c) 推导而来，用于定量描述杂合度随时间指数衰减的速率，为后续讨论群体遗传多样性丧失和有效群体大小的影响奠定基础。

formula-notes:formula_2.6a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式用指数衰减近似表示杂合度H_t随时间t的衰减，其中H_0为初始杂合度，N为有效种群大小，衰减速率由1/(2N)决定。
formula-notes:formula_2.6a:zh.inThisChapter: 在介绍中性进化的一座位和两座位系统时，该公式从公式2.5的精确递推关系出发，利用指数近似简化了杂合度衰减的数学表达，为后续推导有效种群大小和遗传漂变效应提供直观的指数衰减模型。

formula-notes:formula_2.6b:zh.plainMeaning: 公式 t = -2N ln(H_t / H_0) 计算杂合度从初始值 H_0 下降到 H_t 所需的期望世代数 t，其中 N 为有效群体大小，ln 为自然对数。
formula-notes:formula_2.6b:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式由前文公式(2.6a)重排得到，用于量化杂合度衰减速度，为后续推导半衰期（约1.4N代）和95%衰减时间（约6N代）提供直接依据。

formula-notes:formula_2.7:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算在随时间变化的种群大小下，经过t代后杂合度H_t的期望值。它等于初始杂合度H_0乘以每一代(1 - 1/(2N_i))的乘积，并近似为指数形式，其中N_i是第i代的种群大小。
formula-notes:formula_2.7:zh.inThisChapter: 此公式出现在介绍中性进化基本概念后，将恒定种群大小的公式2.6a推广到时变种群大小，为后续讨论有效种群大小和进化速率奠定基础。

formula-notes:formula_2.9a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式通过对等位基因频率 p_t 从 1/(2N) 到 1-1/(2N) 积分概率密度 φ(p_t|p_0)，计算在初始频率为 p_0 时，第 t 代群体中两个等位基因仍然共存（即多态）的概率。
formula-notes:formula_2.9a:zh.inThisChapter: 在介绍中性进化的一基因座和两基因座系统时，该公式利用公式 2.8 给出的条件概率密度，定义了多态概率 Ω(p_0,t)，为后续推导固定概率（如公式 2.9b）和描述等位基因丢失过程提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_2.9b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算初始频率为 p0 的等位基因在 t 代时已被固定的概率，它等于 p0 加上一个无穷级数修正项，其中关键符号 F(1-i,i+2,2,p0) 是高斯超几何函数，指数项 e^{-i(i+1)t/4N} 包含有效群体大小 N。
formula-notes:formula_2.9b:zh.inThisChapter: 在推导了等位基因共存概率 Ω(p0,t)（公式 2.9a）后，本节进一步给出固定概率 pf(p0,t) 的显式表达式，为后续讨论固定与丢失概率之和 Ω+pf+pl=1 提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_2.10:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式表示在时间t时，等位基因仍处于多态状态的概率Ω(p₀,t)、固定概率p_f(p₀,t)和丢失概率p_l(p₀,t)三者之和恒等于1，其中p₀为初始频率。
formula-notes:formula_2.10:zh.inThisChapter: 它出现在推导中性等位基因固定和丢失概率之后，用于验证概率的完备性，并为后续讨论长时间极限下Ω→0、p_f→p₀、p_l→1-p₀提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_2.11a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算等位基因从初始频率p0开始，最终被固定或丢失所需的平均时间，其中N为有效种群大小，p0和1-p0的对数项分别代表固定和丢失的贡献。
formula-notes:formula_2.11a:zh.inThisChapter: 本章介绍中性进化的一座位和两座位系统，此公式通过扩散近似推导，为后续比较不同初始频率下的固定时间以及推导条件固定时间（如公式2.11b-d）提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_2.11b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算在初始频率为p0时，一个中性等位基因在有效大小为N的二倍体群体中最终固定所需的平均时间（以世代为单位），其中关键符号p0为初始频率，N为有效群体大小。
formula-notes:formula_2.11b:zh.inThisChapter: 本章介绍中性进化的一、二位点模型，此公式作为扩散方程近似解的一部分，为后续比较不同初始频率下的固定时间提供定量依据。

formula-notes:formula_2.11c:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算等位基因在最终丢失（而非固定）条件下的平均丢失时间，其中p0为初始频率，N为有效群体大小，公式通过交换p0与(1-p0)从固定时间公式得到。
formula-notes:formula_2.11c:zh.inThisChapter: 本节介绍中性进化下等位基因的固定与丢失时间，公式2.11c与2.11a对称，共同刻画了条件平均时间对初始频率的依赖，为后续讨论突变-漂移平衡奠定基础。

formula-notes:formula_2.11d:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算中性等位基因的平均固定时间（从初始频率p0开始），它是固定时间（t_f）和丢失时间（t_l）的加权平均，权重分别为固定概率p0和丢失概率(1-p0)。
formula-notes:formula_2.11d:zh.inThisChapter: 在介绍中性进化的一、二位点系统章节中，该公式将平均固定时间与固定/丢失时间及概率联系起来，为后续推导中性等位基因的固定时间期望提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_2.12:zh.plainMeaning: 公式 (2.12) 计算在恒定有效群体大小 N 下，一个当前频率为 p 的等位基因的期望年龄（以世代为单位），其中关键符号 E(t) 表示期望年龄，N 为有效群体大小，p 为当前频率，ln(p) 为自然对数。
formula-notes:formula_2.12:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在中性进化章节，用于量化等位基因频率与年龄的关系，为后续讨论频率与年龄的正相关（如图2.3）提供数学依据。

formula-notes:formula_2.13:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算在给定样本中某等位基因频率为p时，该等位基因的年龄t不超过τ的累积概率，其中n为样本中等位基因数，N为有效种群大小。
formula-notes:formula_2.13:zh.inThisChapter: 此处用于近似等位基因年龄的累积分布，为后续讨论中性进化下等位基因年龄的统计性质提供解析表达式。

formula-notes:formula_2.14a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算在遗传漂变影响下，t 世代后等位基因频率 p 的方差 σ_p^2(t)，其中 p_0 是初始频率，N 是有效群体大小，方差从 0 逐渐趋近于 p_0(1-p_0)。
formula-notes:formula_2.14a:zh.inThisChapter: 此处推导方差公式是为了量化群体间等位基因频率的离散程度，为后续说明遗传漂变导致固定概率和异合子度衰减提供数学基础。

formula-notes:formula_2.15:zh.plainMeaning: 公式 E(p_t)=p_0 表示在无选择、无突变等定向力时，t 世代后等位基因频率的期望值始终等于初始频率 p_0。
formula-notes:formula_2.15:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在中性进化章节，由 E(δp)=0 直接导出，说明中性等位基因频率的期望值不随时间改变，为后续推导方差和固定概率提供基准。

formula-notes:formula_2.16a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算在遗传漂变下，t 代后等位基因频率平方的期望值 E(p_t^2)，它等于初始频率 p_0 减去初始方差 p_0(1-p_0) 乘以 λ_1^t。
formula-notes:formula_2.16a:zh.inThisChapter: 它出现在中性进化章节，作为从递归方程推导出的显式解，为后续计算杂合度期望（如公式 2.16b）和固定概率等量提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_2.16b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将条件期望 E[p_{t+1}^k | p_t] 展开为二项式求和，其中 p_{t+1} = p_t + δp，求和项包含组合数 C(k,i)、p_t^i 以及 δp 的 (k-i) 次幂的条件期望。
formula-notes:formula_2.16b:zh.inThisChapter: 在本章中性进化背景下，该公式为后续计算等位基因频率 p 的各阶矩提供了统一的展开框架，使得可以利用 δp 的已知期望（如二项抽样理论）来递推求解矩的演化。

formula-notes:formula_2.16c:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算在遗传漂变下，t 代后等位基因频率的三阶矩 E(p_t^3)，它等于初始频率 p_0 减去两个衰减项：第一项涉及 λ_1^t，第二项涉及 (λ_1 λ_2)^t，其中 λ_1 和 λ_2 是特征值，p_0 是初始频率。
formula-notes:formula_2.16c:zh.inThisChapter: 本章引入中性进化的一、两位点模型，公式 (2.16c) 与 (2.16a)、(2.16b) 共同构成高阶矩的递推关系，为后续推导方差、协方差等统计量提供基础，并用于分析等位基因频率的分布演化。

formula-notes:formula_2.16d:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算等位基因频率在t代后的四阶矩E(p_t^4)，表示为初始频率p0、有效种群大小N和特征值λ_i的函数，其中λ_i=1-i/(2N)。关键符号：p0为初始频率，λ_1、λ_1λ_2、λ_1λ_2λ_3为衰减因子。
formula-notes:formula_2.16d:zh.inThisChapter: 作为2.16系列公式的最后一个，它提供了更高阶矩的显式表达式，用于后续推导方差或其他统计量，并展示了中性进化下矩的递推结构。

formula-notes:formula_2.17:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式近似计算了在时间 t 时杂合度 H_t 的方差 σ²(H_t)，其中 H₀ 是初始杂合度，N 是有效群体大小，e 是指数函数。它通过特征值 λ₁、λ₂、λ₃ 的指数近似，将方差表示为三项指数衰减函数的线性组合。
formula-notes:formula_2.17:zh.inThisChapter: 在介绍中性进化的一基因座和两基因座系统章节中，该公式用于量化杂合度随时间波动的程度，为后续讨论遗传漂变对遗传多样性分布的影响提供方差表达式。

formula-notes:formula_2.18:zh.plainMeaning: 公式(2.18)计算实际观测到的AB配子频率p_{AB}与在独立假设下期望的乘积pq之间的差值，即连锁不平衡系数D_{AB}。
formula-notes:formula_2.18:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在介绍中性进化与两基因座系统的章节，为后续讨论连锁不平衡的演化动态和重组对等位基因关联的影响提供基础度量。

formula-notes:formula_2.19:zh.plainMeaning: 公式 (2.19) 计算在重组率 c 和遗传漂变共同作用下，经过 t 代随机交配后连锁不平衡系数 D 的期望值 E(D_t)。前半部分精确表达式为初始值 D_0 乘以 (1-c) 与 λ_1 乘积的 t 次幂，其中 λ_1 = 1 - 1/(2N) 代表无重组时单倍型频率的衰减因子；后半部分近似为 D_0 乘以指数衰减因子 e^{-(2Nc+1)t/(2N)}，将离散世代近似为连续时间。
formula-notes:formula_2.19:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在介绍中性进化与两位点系统的章节，用于量化重组和有限群体大小（遗传漂变）如何共同导致连锁不平衡的衰减。它为后续推导平衡状态下的期望连锁不平衡、以及比较不同重组率下的衰减速率提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_2.20:zh.plainMeaning: 该递推方程将t+1代的三个四阶矩（E[p(1-p)q(1-q)]、E[D(1-2p)(1-2q)]、E(D²)）表示为t代同一组矩的线性组合，矩阵元素包含λ₁、λ₂、N和c。
formula-notes:formula_2.20:zh.inThisChapter: 由于D的期望为零但方差非零，本节引入四阶矩递推以量化漂变导致的D方差演化，为后续讨论连锁不平衡的随机行为提供解析工具。

formula-notes:formula_2.21:zh.plainMeaning: 这个公式定义了连锁不平衡系数 D 的进化方差 σ²(D)，它等于 D² 的期望减去 D 的期望的平方，即 D 的二阶中心矩，用于衡量遗传漂变导致的 D 在重复群体或位点间的变异程度。
formula-notes:formula_2.21:zh.inThisChapter: 在本节介绍中性进化背景下，公式 (2.21) 为后续推导漂变对 D 方差的影响提供了基础，结合前面的 λᵢ 特征值，可用于计算 σ²(D) 随时间的变化，从而理解连锁不平衡在有限群体中的衰减行为。

formula-notes:formula_2.22:zh.plainMeaning: 公式 (2.22) 计算两个位点等位基因频率的配子内相关系数的平方 r²，其中 D 是连锁不平衡系数，p 和 q 分别是两个位点等位基因的频率，分母 p(1-p)q(1-q) 是 D 可能达到的最大绝对值平方。
formula-notes:formula_2.22:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在介绍中性进化中两位点系统的章节，用于标准化连锁不平衡度量，使得 r² 的取值范围为 [0,1]，便于比较不同位点对或不同群体的 LD 强度，并为后续讨论重组、漂变对 LD 的影响提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_2.23:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算下一代杂合度H_{t+1}，由当前杂合度H_t经选择（λ₁）和突变（u）共同决定：第一项是H_t经选择和突变后保留的部分，第二项是纯合子（1-λ₁H_t）因突变（2u）新产生的杂合度。
formula-notes:formula_2.23:zh.inThisChapter: 本章推导中性进化下杂合度的递推关系，此公式整合了选择系数λ₁和突变率u，为后续分析平衡杂合度及突变-选择平衡奠定基础。

formula-notes:formula_2.3:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the expected inbreeding coefficient f_t in generation t, where N is the population size and f_{t-1} is the coefficient in the previous generation. It shows that f_t is a weighted average of 1/(2N) (the probability of coalescence in one generation) and f_{t-1} (the previous inbreeding).
formula-notes:formula_2.3:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to neutral evolution to model the increase of inbreeding over time due to finite population size, supporting later arguments about genetic drift and loss of heterozygosity.

formula-notes:formula_2.4a:en.plainMeaning: This recursion describes how the heterozygosity (1 - f_t) declines each generation by a factor of (1 - 1/(2N)), where N is the population size and f_t is the probability of identity by descent at generation t.
formula-notes:formula_2.4a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to neutral evolution to derive the exponential decay of heterozygosity over time, supporting the later argument that genetic diversity is lost at a rate 1/(2N) per generation under genetic drift.

formula-notes:formula_2.4c:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the probability that a randomly chosen individual is not inbred after t generations, assuming an initial noninbred population (f0=0). The key symbol is f_t (inbreeding coefficient at generation t), and N is the effective population size.
formula-notes:formula_2.4c:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to neutral evolution to show how inbreeding accumulates over time due to finite population size, supporting later arguments about the role of population size in genetic variation dynamics.

formula-notes:formula_2.4b:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the heterozygosity (1 - f_t) after t generations, given initial heterozygosity (1 - f_0) and population size N, showing exponential decay at rate (1 - 1/(2N)) per generation.
formula-notes:formula_2.4b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to neutral evolution to derive the decay of heterozygosity over time, supporting later arguments about the central role of population size in neutral evolution.

formula-notes:formula_2.5:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the expected heterozygosity H_t at generation t, given initial heterozygosity H_0, population size N, and t generations of random genetic drift. H_t is the probability that two randomly chosen alleles are different.
formula-notes:formula_2.5:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to neutral evolution to show how heterozygosity decays exponentially over time due to drift, supporting later arguments about the rate of loss of genetic variation in finite populations.

formula-notes:formula_2.6a:en.plainMeaning: This formula approximates the expected heterozygosity H_t after t generations, starting from initial heterozygosity H_0, under neutral evolution in a diploid population of size N. It shows that heterozygosity decays exponentially at a rate of 1/(2N) per generation.
formula-notes:formula_2.6a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to neutral evolution to provide a simple exponential approximation for the loss of heterozygosity derived from Equation 2.5, supporting later arguments about the timescale of genetic drift and the effective population size.

formula-notes:formula_2.6b:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the expected time (in generations) for heterozygosity to decline from an initial value H0 to a lower value Ht under genetic drift in a diploid population of effective size N. t is time in generations, N is effective population size, H0 is initial heterozygosity, Ht is heterozygosity at time t.
formula-notes:formula_2.6b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to neutral evolution to quantify the rate of loss of genetic diversity due to drift, supporting later arguments about how population size affects the timescale of allele fixation or loss.

formula-notes:formula_2.7:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the expected heterozygosity H_t after t generations, given initial heterozygosity H_0 and time-varying population sizes N_i. It shows that H_t equals H_0 multiplied by the product over generations of (1 - 1/(2N_i)), approximated by an exponential decay with cumulative sum of 1/(2N_i).
formula-notes:formula_2.7:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to neutral evolution to extend the constant-population-size result (Equation 2.6a) to temporally varying population sizes, supporting later arguments about effective population size and the impact of population bottlenecks on genetic diversity.

formula-notes:formula_2.8:en.plainMeaning: This formula gives the probability density of the allele frequency p_t at time t, starting from initial frequency p_0, under neutral evolution. Key symbols: φ(p_t|p_0) is the density, p_0 initial frequency, p_t frequency at time t, N population size, t time in generations, and F denotes hypergeometric functions.
formula-notes:formula_2.8:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to neutral evolution to provide an exact analytical solution for the time-dependent distribution of allele frequency, supporting later discussions on the rate of fixation and the behavior of neutral alleles over time.

formula-notes:formula_2.9a:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the probability that both alleles are still present (polymorphic) at generation t, given an initial frequency p0. The symbol φ(p_t|p0) is the probability density of allele frequency p_t conditional on p0, and the integral over p_t from 1/(2N) to 1-1/(2N) excludes the fixation boundaries.
formula-notes:formula_2.9a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to neutral evolution to quantify the probability of polymorphism over time, supporting later arguments about fixation probabilities and the timescale of loss of variation.

formula-notes:formula_2.9b:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the probability that an allele with initial frequency p0 has been fixed (reached frequency 1) by generation t, using an infinite series involving hypergeometric functions and exponential decay terms.
formula-notes:formula_2.9b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to neutral evolution to quantify the fixation probability over time, supporting later arguments about the dynamics of allele frequency change under genetic drift.

formula-notes:formula_2.11a:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the mean time until an allele with initial frequency p0 is either lost or fixed in a population, where N is the population size and p0 is the initial frequency.
formula-notes:formula_2.11a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to neutral evolution to quantify the expected duration of allele frequency change under drift, supporting later derivations for fixation probabilities and times.

formula-notes:formula_2.10:en.plainMeaning: This formula states that the sum of the probability of the allele being segregating (Ω), the probability of fixation (p_f), and the probability of loss (p_l) at time t, given initial frequency p0, equals 1, reflecting that these three outcomes are exhaustive and mutually exclusive.
formula-notes:formula_2.10:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to neutral evolution to formalize the conservation of probability among the three possible fates of an allele, supporting later arguments about the long-term behavior where Ω decays to zero and fixation/loss probabilities approach p0 and 1-p0, respectively.

formula-notes:formula_2.11b:en.plainMeaning: This formula approximates the expected time to fixation (in generations) of a neutral allele with initial frequency p0 in a haploid population of size N, showing that it is proportional to -4N(1-p0)ln(1-p0)/p0.
formula-notes:formula_2.11b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to neutral evolution to provide a closed-form approximation for the fixation time, supporting later discussions on the timescale of neutral allele dynamics.

formula-notes:formula_2.11c:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the mean time to loss of an allele (starting at frequency p0) given that it is ultimately lost, using the approximation -4N p0 ln(p0)/(1-p0). N is the effective population size, p0 is the initial frequency of the allele.
formula-notes:formula_2.11c:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to neutral evolution to provide the conditional mean loss time, complementing the unconditional mean time (2.11a) and the mean time to fixation (2.11b), and supporting later arguments about the duration of allele segregation under neutrality.

formula-notes:formula_2.11d:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the unconditional mean time to absorption (fixation or loss) of a neutral allele, given its initial frequency p0, as the weighted average of the mean times to fixation and loss, with weights equal to the respective probabilities.
formula-notes:formula_2.11d:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to neutral evolution to derive the overall expected persistence time of a neutral allele, supporting later arguments about the timescale of neutral polymorphism and coalescent theory.

formula-notes:formula_2.12:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the expected age (in generations) of a neutral allele with current frequency p in a population of constant size N. E(t) is the expected time since the allele arose, N is the effective population size, p is the current allele frequency, and ln is the natural logarithm.
formula-notes:formula_2.12:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to neutral evolution to quantify how long an allele is expected to persist given its frequency, supporting the argument that higher-frequency alleles are generally older, which is a key insight for understanding neutral polymorphism patterns.

formula-notes:formula_2.13:en.plainMeaning: This formula gives the cumulative probability that the age t of an allele (in generations) is less than or equal to τ, given its observed frequency p in a sample of n alleles from a population of effective size N.
formula-notes:formula_2.13:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to neutral evolution to provide a method for estimating allele age under neutrality, supporting later arguments about the distribution of allele ages and the interpretation of genetic variation.

formula-notes:formula_2.14a:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the variance in allele frequency across replicate populations at generation t, given initial frequency p0 and effective population size N. Key symbols: σ²_p(t) = variance of p across populations, p0 = initial allele frequency, N = effective population size, t = number of generations.
formula-notes:formula_2.14a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to neutral evolution to quantify how genetic drift increases among-population variance over time, supporting the later argument that variance asymptotically approaches p0(1-p0), the maximum possible under drift.

formula-notes:formula_2.15:en.plainMeaning: This formula states that under neutral evolution, the expected frequency of an allele at time t equals its initial frequency p0, with E denoting expectation and pt the frequency at time t.
formula-notes:formula_2.15:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to neutral evolution to establish that without selection or other forces, allele frequencies do not change on average, supporting the baseline for later models of genetic drift.

formula-notes:formula_2.16a:en.plainMeaning: This formula gives the expected squared allele frequency at generation t, E(p_t^2), as a function of the initial frequency p_0 and the leading eigenvalue λ_1, showing that it decays exponentially from p_0 to p_0 - p_0(1-p_0) as t increases.
formula-notes:formula_2.16a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to neutral evolution to derive the expected heterozygosity (2.16b) and the variance of allele frequency (2.16c), which are key for understanding genetic drift in a one-locus system.

formula-notes:formula_2.16b:en.plainMeaning: This formula expresses the conditional expectation of the k-th power of the allele frequency at time t+1, given its value at time t, by expanding (p_t + δp)^k using the binomial theorem and taking the expectation termwise. The symbols are: p_t (frequency at time t), δp (change in frequency), k (moment order), and E[·|p_t] (conditional expectation).
formula-notes:formula_2.16b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to neutral evolution to provide a general method for computing moments of allele frequency change, which is then used to derive specific results (e.g., mean and variance) for the Wright-Fisher model in subsequent equations (2.16c, 2.16d).

formula-notes:formula_2.16c:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the expected value of the cubed allele frequency at generation t, E(p_t^3), as a function of initial frequency p_0, eigenvalues λ1 and λ2, and time t. Key symbols: p_0 (initial frequency), λ1 (leading eigenvalue), λ2 (second eigenvalue), t (time in generations).
formula-notes:formula_2.16c:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on neutral evolution to derive higher-order moments of allele frequency, supporting later arguments about the dynamics of heterozygosity and the approach to fixation under drift.

formula-notes:formula_2.17:en.plainMeaning: This formula approximates the variance of heterozygosity H_t over time under neutral evolution, where H_0 is initial heterozygosity, N is population size, and t is time in generations.
formula-notes:formula_2.17:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to show how neutral two-locus dynamics reduce to simple exponential decay of heterozygosity variance, supporting later arguments about linkage disequilibrium decay.

formula-notes:formula_2.16d:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the expected fourth power of allele frequency at time t, E(p_t^4), in a neutral Wright-Fisher model. Key symbols: p0 = initial frequency, N = population size, λ_i = 1 - i/(2N), and t = generations.
formula-notes:formula_2.16d:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to neutral evolution to derive higher moments of allele frequency, supporting later arguments about the distribution of allele frequencies and the rate of loss of heterozygosity.

formula-notes:formula_2.18:en.plainMeaning: The formula computes the linkage disequilibrium coefficient D_AB as the difference between the observed frequency of the AB gamete (p_AB) and the expected frequency under independence (pq).
formula-notes:formula_2.18:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to neutral evolution in two-locus systems to define a measure of non-random association between alleles, which is used later to study the dynamics of linkage disequilibrium under neutrality.

formula-notes:formula_2.19:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the expected linkage disequilibrium E(D_t) after t generations, given initial disequilibrium D_0, recombination fraction c, and population size N. The key symbols are D_t (disequilibrium at time t), D_0 (initial disequilibrium), c (recombination rate), N (population size), and λ_1 = 1 - 1/(2N).
formula-notes:formula_2.19:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to neutral evolution in two-locus systems to show how recombination and genetic drift jointly erode linkage disequilibrium over time, supporting later arguments about the timescale of decay and the relative importance of these forces.

formula-notes:formula_2.20:en.plainMeaning: This recursion updates the expected fourth-order moments of allele frequencies at two loci from generation t to t+1, incorporating drift and recombination. Key symbols: p, q are allele frequencies at two loci; D is linkage disequilibrium; N is population size; c is recombination rate; λ_i = 1 - i/(2N).
formula-notes:formula_2.20:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to neutral two-locus evolution to show that even when E[D]=0, the variance of D can be substantial, and this recursion quantifies how drift and recombination affect higher moments, supporting later analysis of the stochastic dynamics of linkage disequilibrium.

formula-notes:formula_2.21:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the variance of linkage disequilibrium D across replicate populations, where E(D²) is the expected squared D and E²(D) is the square of the expected D.
formula-notes:formula_2.21:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to neutral evolution to quantify how drift generates variability in D among populations, supporting later arguments about the expected decay of linkage disequilibrium under neutrality.

formula-notes:formula_2.22:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the squared correlation coefficient r² between alleles at two loci, where D is the linkage disequilibrium, p and q are the frequencies of one allele at each locus, and p(1-p) and q(1-q) are the variances of the allele frequencies.
formula-notes:formula_2.22:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to quantify the strength of linkage disequilibrium in a standardized way, supporting later arguments about the effects of recombination and selection on two-locus systems.

formula-notes:formula_2.23:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the expected heterozygosity at time t+1 (H_{t+1}) as a function of the current heterozygosity H_t, the leading eigenvalue λ₁, the mutation rate u, and the number of alleles k. It accounts for mutation converting homozygotes to heterozygotes and the loss of heterozygosity due to mutation and drift.
formula-notes:formula_2.23:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to neutral evolution in one- and two-locus systems to model the dynamics of heterozygosity under mutation and drift, supporting later analysis of equilibrium heterozygosity and the balance between mutation and genetic drift.

formula-notes:formula_2.24a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算在遗传漂变与突变平衡时，期望杂合度 E(H) 的值，其中 θ = 4Nu 是突变率与有效种群大小的乘积，k 是等位基因的可能状态数。
formula-notes:formula_2.24a:zh.inThisChapter: 它出现在中性进化章节的漂变-突变平衡部分，为后续推导无限等位基因模型下的平衡杂合度（公式 2.24b）和有限等位基因模型下的期望杂合度（公式 2.24c）提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_2.24a:en.plainMeaning: This formula gives the expected equilibrium heterozygosity E(H) under mutation-drift balance, where θ = 4Nu is the population-scaled mutation rate and k is the number of possible allelic states.
formula-notes:formula_2.24a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to neutral evolution to derive the equilibrium heterozygosity for the infinite-alleles model, supporting later arguments about the balance between mutation and genetic drift.

formula-notes:formula_2.24b:en.plainMeaning: This formula approximates the expected heterozygosity E(H) under the infinite-alleles model, where θ = 4Nμ (N is effective population size, μ is mutation rate per locus per generation).
formula-notes:formula_2.24b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to neutral evolution to show how, when the number of possible alleles is large (k ≫ 1), the expected heterozygosity simplifies to a function of θ alone, supporting later comparisons with the infinite-sites model.

formula-notes:formula_2.24c:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the expected homozygosity E(H) under the infinite-sites model for nucleotide sites, where θ = 4Nu (with N effective population size and u mutation rate per site).
formula-notes:formula_2.24c:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to neutral evolution to contrast with the infinite-alleles model (Eq. 2.24b) and to set up the expected homozygosity for nucleotide-level analysis, which is used later for polymorphism predictions.

formula-notes:formula_2.24c:zh.plainMeaning: 公式(2.24c)计算核苷酸位点水平上的期望杂合度E(H)，其中θ=4Nu（N为有效群体大小，u为每位点突变率），分母中的4/3来自核苷酸有4种可能状态（k=4）时的突变模型修正。
formula-notes:formula_2.24c:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在中性进化章节，作为无限等位基因模型（公式2.24b）在核苷酸位点分析时的变体，为后续讨论多位点或不同突变率下的期望杂合度提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_2.25a:zh.plainMeaning: 公式 (2.25a) 给出了等位基因频率 p 在稳态下的概率密度函数 φ(p)，其中 Γ 是伽马函数，θ = 4Nu，β = 4Nu/(k-1)，u 是突变率，N 是有效种群大小，k 是等位基因类型数。
formula-notes:formula_2.25a:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在中性进化章节的引言部分，用于描述在突变-漂变平衡下等位基因频率的稳态分布，为后续讨论多等位基因位点的中性进化提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_2.25a:en.plainMeaning: This formula gives the steady-state probability density of allele frequency p under neutral evolution with mutation, where θ = 4Nu and β = 4Nu/(k-1) are mutation rate parameters, and Γ is the gamma function.
formula-notes:formula_2.25a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to neutral evolution to show that a stationary distribution of allele frequencies exists, supporting later analyses of polymorphism patterns under mutation-drift balance.

formula-notes:formula_2.25b:en.plainMeaning: The gamma function Γ(α) is defined as the integral of x^(α-1) e^{-x} from 0 to ∞, generalizing the factorial to real and complex numbers. It appears in Equation 2.25a to normalize the beta distribution of allele frequencies.
formula-notes:formula_2.25b:en.inThisChapter: This definition is introduced to support Equation 2.25a, which describes the stationary distribution of allele frequencies under mutation-drift equilibrium in neutral evolution. It provides the mathematical tool needed to express the normalization constant of the beta distribution.

formula-notes:formula_2.25b:zh.plainMeaning: 公式(2.25b)定义了伽马函数Γ(α)，它是对变量x从0到无穷积分，被积函数为x^(α-1)乘以e^{-x}，其中α是参数。
formula-notes:formula_2.25b:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在公式(2.25a)之后，为(2.25a)中的Γ(θ+β)、Γ(θ)和Γ(β)提供定义，从而使得(2.25a)中的等位基因频率分布函数得以完整表达，为后续推导突变-漂移平衡下的频率分布奠定基础。

formula-notes:formula_2.26a:zh.plainMeaning: 公式 E(p)=β/(θ+β)=1/k 计算在无限等位基因模型下，等位基因频率 p 的期望值，其中 θ=2Nu，β=θ/(k-1)，k 为等位基因种类数。
formula-notes:formula_2.26a:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式由公式 2.25a 的贝塔分布推导得出，为后续计算等位基因频率方差（公式 2.26b）提供期望值，从而刻画中性进化下等位基因频率的随机波动。

formula-notes:formula_2.26a:en.plainMeaning: This formula gives the expected (mean) allele frequency E(p) under neutral evolution, where β and θ are parameters of a beta distribution from Equation 2.25a, and k is the number of alleles. It shows that the mean frequency equals 1/k.
formula-notes:formula_2.26a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to neutral evolution to characterize the stationary distribution of allele frequencies, supporting later arguments about the behavior of genetic variation under mutation-drift balance.

formula-notes:formula_2.26b:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the variance of allele frequency across replicate populations under neutral evolution, where θ=4Nu, β=4Nv, and k=1/(1+4Nv) is the expected homozygosity.
formula-notes:formula_2.26b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to neutral evolution to quantify the spread of allele frequencies around the mean, supporting later arguments about the distribution of genetic variation under mutation-drift equilibrium.

formula-notes:formula_2.26b:zh.plainMeaning: 公式(2.26b)计算等位基因频率p在多次重复进化实验中的方差σ²(p)，其中θ=4Nu，β=4Nv，k=θ/β+1是等位基因数目。
formula-notes:formula_2.26b:zh.inThisChapter: 在推导出期望频率(2.26a)后，该公式给出频率的波动幅度，为后续讨论遗传漂变和突变平衡下的等位基因频率分布提供方差信息。

formula-notes:formula_2.27a:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the variance of heterozygosity (σ²(H)) at equilibrium under neutral evolution, where θ = 4Nμ (population-scaled mutation rate) and ℓ = k - 1 with k being the number of possible allelic states.
formula-notes:formula_2.27a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to neutral evolution to characterize the stochastic variation of heterozygosity at equilibrium, and it supports the subsequent derivation of the infinite-alleles limit (Equation 2.27b) as k → ∞.

formula-notes:formula_2.27a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算在平衡状态下杂合度H的方差σ²(H)，其中θ=4Nμ，ℓ=k-1，k为等位基因数目。它表达了杂合度围绕其期望值的波动幅度。
formula-notes:formula_2.27a:zh.inThisChapter: 本章介绍中性进化中单座和双座系统的平衡性质，此公式给出有限等位基因模型下杂合度方差的精确表达式，为后续推导无限等位基因模型（k→∞）下的简化形式（2.27b）提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_2.27b:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the variance of heterozygosity (H) under the infinite-alleles model, where θ = 4Nμ (N is effective population size, μ is mutation rate).
formula-notes:formula_2.27b:en.inThisChapter: It appears as the limiting case of the finite-alleles variance (Equation 2.27a) when the number of alleles k → ∞, supporting the derivation of the infinite-alleles model's properties in neutral evolution.

formula-notes:formula_2.27b:zh.plainMeaning: 公式 (2.27b) 计算在无限等位基因模型（k→∞）下，杂合度 H 的方差 σ²(H)，其中 θ=4Nμ 是种群规模与突变率的乘积。
formula-notes:formula_2.27b:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式由 (2.27a) 在等位基因数 k 趋于无穷时取极限得到，用于展示无限等位基因模型下杂合度方差的解析形式，并为后续讨论 θ 很小时的近似 σ²(H)≈θ/3 提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_2.28a:en.plainMeaning: These formulas compute the expected values of heterozygosity products and linkage disequilibrium terms at two sites under drift-mutation equilibrium, where p and q are allele frequencies, D is linkage disequilibrium, ρ = 4Nc, θ = 4Nu, and M is a scaling factor.
formula-notes:formula_2.28a:en.inThisChapter: They appear in the introduction to neutral evolution to provide the equilibrium expectations needed to derive the standardized linkage disequilibrium E[r²], which is the key quantity for assessing linkage disequilibrium in the following sections.

formula-notes:formula_2.28a:zh.plainMeaning: 这三个期望公式分别计算：两个位点杂合度乘积的期望E[p(1-p)q(1-q)]、连锁不平衡与基因频率乘积的期望E[D(1-2p)(1-2q)]、以及连锁不平衡平方的期望E[D²]，它们都是重组率ρ和突变率θ的函数，其中M由(2.28b)定义。
formula-notes:formula_2.28a:zh.inThisChapter: 在随机漂变-突变平衡的章节中，这些公式给出了中性进化下两个位点遗传变异的稳态期望值，为后续推导标准化连锁不平衡E(r²)提供分子部分（如E[D²]和E[p(1-p)q(1-q)]）。

formula-notes:formula_2.28b:zh.plainMeaning: 公式 (2.28b) 定义了归一化因子 M，它由突变率 θ 和重组率 ρ 表示，用于计算 (2.28a) 中三个期望值 E[p(1-p)q(1-q)]、E[D(1-2p)(1-2q)] 和 E[D²]。
formula-notes:formula_2.28b:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在推导中性进化下两位点连锁不平衡期望值的章节中，为后续得到标准化连锁不平衡 E(r²) 的简洁表达式 (2.29a) 提供基础，并将在第4章中进一步应用。

formula-notes:formula_2.28b:en.plainMeaning: This formula defines the scaling factor M used in Equation 2.28a, where θ = 4Nμ (population-scaled mutation rate) and ρ = 4Nr (population-scaled recombination rate).
formula-notes:formula_2.28b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to neutral evolution to provide the necessary normalization for the expected values of linkage disequilibrium moments, which are later used to derive the standardized measure E(r²) in Equation 2.29a.

formula-notes:formula_2.29a:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the expected squared standardized linkage disequilibrium E(r²) between two loci under neutral evolution, where ρ = 4Nc (recombination rate) and θ = 4Nu (mutation rate).
formula-notes:formula_2.29a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to neutral evolution in one- and two-locus systems to provide a key prediction for linkage disequilibrium, which will be used in Chapter 4 to analyze patterns in nucleotide sites.

formula-notes:formula_2.29a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算标准化连锁不平衡系数E(r²)，其中ρ=4Nc（重组参数），θ=4Nμ（突变参数），N为有效群体大小，c为重组率，μ为突变率。
formula-notes:formula_2.29a:zh.inThisChapter: 出现在中性进化一章中，用于量化两个位点间连锁不平衡的期望值，为后续章节讨论θ和ρ对遗传多样性的影响提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_2.29b:en.plainMeaning: This formula approximates the expected squared correlation coefficient E(r²) between two nucleotide sites as a function of the scaled recombination rate ρ, where ρ = 4Nc (N effective population size, c recombination fraction).
formula-notes:formula_2.29b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to neutral evolution in two-locus systems to provide a simple approximation for linkage disequilibrium when ρ is not too small, supporting later discussions on the relationship between recombination and association measures.

formula-notes:formula_2.29b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算在重组率ρ较大时，两个核苷酸位点间连锁不平衡系数r²的期望值，其中ρ是重组参数（4Nc），E(r²)近似为(10+ρ)/(22+13ρ+ρ²)。
formula-notes:formula_2.29b:zh.inThisChapter: 本章介绍中性进化下单位点和双位点系统，此公式在式(2.29a)基础上给出ρ较大时的简化近似，为后续讨论长距离位点间连锁衰减（渐近于1/ρ）提供定量依据。

formula-notes:formula_2.30a:en.plainMeaning: This formula gives the probability of observing exactly k different alleles in a sample of n genes under drift-mutation equilibrium, where θ_L is the population mutation rate and S_n^k is the Stirling number of the first kind (coefficient of θ_L^k in the expansion of S_n(θ_L)).
formula-notes:formula_2.30a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on the detailed structure of neutral variation to quantify the expected number of distinct alleles in a sample, supporting later arguments about the distribution of allele frequencies and the impact of mutation rate on genetic diversity.

formula-notes:formula_2.30a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算在种群突变参数θ_L和样本大小n下，样本中恰好有k个不同等位基因的概率。分子是S_n^k（多项式展开中θ_L^k的系数）乘以θ_L^k，分母是S_n(θ_L)（由公式2.30b定义的上升阶乘）。
formula-notes:formula_2.30a:zh.inThisChapter: 本章分析中性变异的详细结构，该公式直接给出样本中不同等位基因数的概率分布，为后续推导样本多样性统计量（如核苷酸多样性）的期望和方差提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_2.30b:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the rising factorial (Pochhammer symbol) of θ_L with n terms, which is the product of θ_L and the next n-1 consecutive integers. S_n(θ_L) is the normalizing constant in the Ewens sampling formula.
formula-notes:formula_2.30b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in this section to define the denominator of the Ewens sampling formula (Equation 2.30a), which gives the probability of observing k alleles in a sample of n genes under neutral mutation-drift equilibrium, supporting later statistical tests for selection.

formula-notes:formula_2.30b:zh.plainMeaning: 公式 (2.30b) 定义了上升阶乘符号 S_n(θ_L)，它是 θ_L 乘以 (θ_L+1) 一直到 (θ_L+n-1) 的连乘积，用于归一化 (2.30a) 中的概率分布。
formula-notes:formula_2.30b:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在中性变异详细结构章节，为 (2.30a) 中样本基因数 n 下观察到 k 个等位基因的概率提供分母，是后续统计检验的基础。

formula-notes:formula_2.31a:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the probability that a sample of n alleles is monomorphic (k=1) under the infinite-sites model with population-scaled mutation rate θ_L, using the product of (θ_L + i) in the denominator.
formula-notes:formula_2.31a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in this section to quantify the chance of observing no polymorphism in a sample, supporting later arguments about the expected number of segregating sites and the distribution of allele frequencies.

formula-notes:formula_2.31a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算在无限位点模型下，从群体中抽取n个等位基因样本时，所有样本都相同（即只有一种等位基因，k=1）的概率，其中θ_L是群体突变率参数，分母是θ_L加上1到n-1的连乘积。
formula-notes:formula_2.31a:zh.inThisChapter: 它直接由公式2.30a推导而来，用于刻画中性变异样本的等位基因频谱的极端情况（单态样本），为后续讨论样本中等位基因数目的分布和期望奠定基础。

formula-notes:formula_2.31b:en.plainMeaning: This formula gives the expected number of alleles E(k) and the variance σ²(k) in a sample of n genes under the infinite-alleles model, where θ_L = 4N_e u is the population-scaled mutation rate.
formula-notes:formula_2.31b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on the detailed structure of neutral variation to quantify the sampling properties of allele counts, supporting later arguments about the relationship between mutation rate and allelic diversity.

formula-notes:formula_2.31b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式给出了样本中观察到等位基因数目k的期望E(k)和方差σ²(k)，其中θ_L是种群突变率参数，n是样本容量。期望公式求和从j=2到n，方差公式求和从j=1到n-1。
formula-notes:formula_2.31b:zh.inThisChapter: 在推导出样本等位基因数目的概率分布后，本节通过代数运算得到其均值和方差，为后续讨论样本多样性统计量（如核苷酸多样性）的抽样性质提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_2.32:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式表示，将每个等位基因的拷贝数 i 乘以具有该拷贝数的等位基因种类数 n_i，再对所有 i 求和，结果等于样本总染色体数 n。
formula-notes:formula_2.32:zh.inThisChapter: 在描述中性变异的具体结构时，该公式约束了等位基因频率分布（n_i 向量）必须满足的守恒关系，为后续推导 Ewens 抽样公式等概率分布提供基础条件。

formula-notes:formula_2.32:en.plainMeaning: This formula states that the total number of gene copies in a sample (n) equals the sum over all allele frequency classes i of i times the number of alleles n_i that appear i times. Here, i is the count of copies of an allele, n_i is the number of distinct alleles with exactly i copies, and n is the total sample size.
formula-notes:formula_2.32:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on neutral variation to enforce the combinatorial constraint that the allele frequency spectrum must sum to the total sample size, which is essential for deriving properties of the site frequency spectrum under the neutral model.

formula-notes:formula_2.33a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算在样本量为n的群体中，观察到等位基因频谱(n1,...,nn)和等位基因种类数k的联合概率，其中θL是突变参数，Sn(θL)是归一化常数。
formula-notes:formula_2.33a:zh.inThisChapter: 它出现在本章详细描述中性变异结构的部分，作为Ewens抽样公式的核心表达式，为后续推导条件分布（如公式2.33b）和检验中性进化假设提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_2.33a:en.plainMeaning: This formula gives the joint probability of observing a specific configuration of allele counts (n₁, n₂, …, nₙ) and the total number of distinct alleles k in a sample of n genes under the neutral infinite-alleles model. Key symbols: n₁ is the number of alleles represented exactly i times, k is the number of distinct alleles, θ_L = 4N_e u (population-scaled mutation rate), and S_n(θ_L) is a normalizing constant.
formula-notes:formula_2.33a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in this section to describe the detailed structure of neutral variation, specifically the distribution of allele frequencies. This formula supports later arguments about the expected number of alleles and the probability of identity in state, and it is the basis for the conditional distribution given in Equation (2.33b).

formula-notes:formula_2.33b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算在给定样本大小n和等位基因类型数k的条件下，观察到特定等位基因频数向量(n1,n2,...,nn)的概率。分母中S_n^k是第二类斯特林数，表示将n个基因拷贝分配到k个非空等位基因类型的方式数；分子n!除以各ni!和乘积项1^{n1}2^{n2}...n^{nn}，反映了不同频数配置的排列权重。
formula-notes:formula_2.33b:zh.inThisChapter: 本节推导中性变异样本的详细结构，公式2.33b由2.30a和2.33a导出，给出了给定k时频数向量的条件分布，为后续计算样本单态概率（如2.31a）和进一步分析等位基因频谱提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_2.33b:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the probability of observing a specific configuration of allele counts (n1, n2, ..., nn) in a sample of size n, given that there are k distinct alleles. The denominator includes Stirling numbers of the first kind S_n^k and factorial terms for the counts.
formula-notes:formula_2.33b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on the detailed structure of neutral variation to provide the conditional distribution of allele frequencies given the number of alleles, which is used to derive the probability of monomorphism (Equation 2.31a) and to connect with the unconditional distribution in Equation 2.33a.

formula-notes:formula_2.34a:zh.plainMeaning: 公式 φ(x)=θ/x 给出了在频率 x 处（x 在 1/(2N) 到 1-1/(2N) 之间）具有衍生等位基因的位点比例，其中 θ=4Nμ 是突变参数，N 是群体大小。
formula-notes:formula_2.34a:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在“中性变异的详细结构”一节中，用于描述突变-漂变平衡下群体中衍生等位基因的频率分布，为后续推导公式 2.34b（折叠频谱）提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_2.34a:en.plainMeaning: This formula gives the expected density of polymorphic sites where the derived allele is at frequency x in the population, under neutral mutation-drift equilibrium. θ is the population mutation rate (4Nμ), and N is the diploid population size.
formula-notes:formula_2.34a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on the detailed structure of neutral variation to describe the site frequency spectrum, which is used later to derive summary statistics like nucleotide diversity and to understand patterns of polymorphism.

formula-notes:formula_2.34b:en.plainMeaning: This formula gives the folded site frequency spectrum for neutral mutations, where φ(x) is the expected number of segregating sites with minor-allele frequency x, θ is the population mutation rate, and N is the population size.
formula-notes:formula_2.34b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on neutral variation to describe the distribution of allele frequencies when alleles are unpolarized (folded spectrum), supporting later analyses of summary statistics like Tajima's D.

formula-notes:formula_2.35a:en.plainMeaning: This formula gives the expected number of sites with i derived nucleotides in a sample of size n, where θ_L is the population-scaled mutation rate per locus and i ranges from 1 to n-1.
formula-notes:formula_2.35a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on the detailed structure of neutral variation to describe the expected site frequency spectrum, supporting later arguments about the distribution of polymorphisms under neutrality.

formula-notes:formula_2.35b:zh.plainMeaning: 公式(2.35b)计算折叠频谱中每个频率类别i的期望站点数E(s_i)，其中s_i是次要等位基因频率为i/n的位点数量，θ_L是群体突变率参数，n是样本染色体数。
formula-notes:formula_2.35b:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在讨论中性变异详细结构的章节，是公式(2.35a)的折叠版本，用于处理无法区分祖先和衍生等位基因时的频谱期望，为后续中性检验（如Tajima's D）提供理论基础。

formula-notes:formula_2.35b:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the expected number of polymorphic sites with minor-nucleotide frequency i/n in a folded frequency spectrum, where θ_L is the population-scaled mutation rate, n is the sample size, and i ranges from 1 to the floor of n/2.
formula-notes:formula_2.35b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on the detailed structure of neutral variation to describe the expected site frequency spectrum under neutrality, supporting later tests of neutral evolution (Chapter 9) by providing a baseline expectation.

formula-notes:formula_2.36a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算在样本容量为 n、等位基因频率为 x 的条件下，观察到恰好 k 个衍生核苷酸的概率，其中组合数 C(n,k) 表示从 n 个样本中选出 k 个的方式数。
formula-notes:formula_2.36a:zh.inThisChapter: 本章讨论中性变异的详细结构，该公式给出了给定频率 x 时样本中位点模式的完整概率分布，为后续推导样本中位点频谱（如公式 2.36b 和 2.36c）提供了基础。

formula-notes:formula_2.36a:en.plainMeaning: This binomial formula gives the probability of observing exactly k derived nucleotides in a sample of size n, given that the true allele frequency of the derived nucleotide in the population is x. The symbols are: k (count of derived alleles), n (sample size), x (population allele frequency).
formula-notes:formula_2.36a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in this section because the chapter requires the full sampling distribution of allele counts, not just the mean, to later derive the probability of polymorphism and the site frequency spectrum (Equations 2.36b and 2.36c).

formula-notes:formula_2.36b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算在等位基因频率为x的位点上，从群体中抽取n个样本时，样本中同时存在两种等位基因（即多态）的概率，等于1减去样本全部为衍生等位基因（x^n）或全部为祖先等位基因（(1-x)^n）的概率。
formula-notes:formula_2.36b:zh.inThisChapter: 本章讨论中性变异的详细结构，该公式直接由样本单态概率（公式2.36a）推导而来，为后续计算样本中多态位点的期望数目（公式2.36c）提供基础概率表达式。

formula-notes:formula_2.36b:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the probability that a sample of n alleles contains at least one copy of both the derived and ancestral alleles (i.e., is polymorphic) at a site where the derived allele frequency is x. The symbols are: n = sample size, x = population frequency of the derived allele, Pr(1 ≤ k ≤ n-1) = probability that the number of derived alleles in the sample is between 1 and n-1.
formula-notes:formula_2.36b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on the detailed structure of neutral variation to quantify the probability of observing polymorphism in a sample, which is essential for understanding how allele frequency distributions relate to neutral theory predictions and for later derivations of summary statistics like nucleotide diversity.

formula-notes:formula_2.36c:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the probability of observing exactly k derived nucleotides in a sample of n sequences, by averaging the binomial probability over the distribution of allele frequency x, where φ(x) is the equilibrium frequency distribution under drift and mutation.
formula-notes:formula_2.36c:en.inThisChapter: It appears in this section to provide the sampling distribution of nucleotide variation under the neutral infinite-sites model, serving as the null model for likelihood-based tests of selective sweeps discussed in later chapters.

formula-notes:formula_2.36c:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算在样本容量为n的随机位点观察到k个衍生核苷酸的概率，通过对所有可能的衍生等位基因频率x（从1/(2N)到1-1/(2N)）积分，其中φ(x)是x的稳态分布（公式2.34a），二项式系数和x^k(1-x)^{n-k}给出给定x下观察到k个衍生型的条件概率。
formula-notes:formula_2.36c:zh.inThisChapter: 它出现在本章以整合无限位点模型下样本中变异模式的概率分布，为后续章节（如第8、9章）中基于似然的选择性清除检验提供零模型，通过将位点频率谱与理论分布比较来检测自然选择。

formula-notes:formula_2.37:en.plainMeaning: This formula gives the probability that two lineages coalesce exactly t generations in the past, where λ₁ = 1 - 1/(2N) and N is the effective population size.
formula-notes:formula_2.37:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to neutral evolution to derive the geometric distribution of coalescence times, which is fundamental for understanding the coalescent process and later calculations of expected coalescence time and variance.

formula-notes:formula_2.37:zh.plainMeaning: 公式 (2.37) 计算两个谱系在恰好 t 代前发生溯祖的概率，其中 λ₁ 是溯祖概率矩阵的最大特征值（近似为 1 - 1/(2N)），(1/2N) 是两代前溯祖的无条件概率，λ₁^(t-1) 表示前 t-1 代未溯祖的概率。
formula-notes:formula_2.37:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在介绍中性进化中单基因座和双基因座溯祖过程的章节，它通过几何分布形式将溯祖时间与有效种群大小 N 联系起来，为后续推导溯祖时间的期望和方差、以及多基因座联合溯祖概率奠定基础。

formula-notes:formula_2.38:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算两个随机样本基因的平均溯祖时间，即从当前时刻回溯到它们最近共同祖先所需时间的期望值，结果为2N，其中N为有效群体大小。
formula-notes:formula_2.38:zh.inThisChapter: 在介绍中性进化与溯祖理论时，该公式给出了两个等位基因平均溯祖时间的基本结果，为后续推导多个样本的溯祖时间、突变率估计等奠定基础。

formula-notes:formula_2.38:en.plainMeaning: This formula gives the expected coalescence time for two randomly sampled genes, which equals 2N, where N is the population size and P_c(t) is the probability of coalescence at generation t.
formula-notes:formula_2.38:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to neutral evolution to establish the fundamental timescale of coalescence for two lineages, which is used later to derive more complex coalescent results for multiple loci or populations.

formula-notes:formula_2.39:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算在样本量为n的序列中，随机选取的一对序列在t代前首次发生溯祖（即合并为共同祖先）的概率，其中p_n = n(n-1)/2是n条序列中可能的配对总数，N为有效群体大小。
formula-notes:formula_2.39:zh.inThisChapter: 此公式出现在中性进化章节的引言部分，用于推导样本中一对序列的溯祖时间分布，为后续引入更复杂的溯祖过程（如多对序列的联合分布）奠定基础。

formula-notes:formula_2.39:en.plainMeaning: This formula gives the probability that a specific pair of sequences among n sampled sequences coalesces (shares a common ancestor) exactly t generations ago, where p_n = n(n-1)/2 is the number of pairs and N is the diploid population size.
formula-notes:formula_2.39:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to neutral evolution to derive the distribution of coalescence times for a pair of sequences, which is fundamental for later calculations of expected coalescence time and nucleotide diversity under the neutral model.

formula-notes:formula_2.40:zh.plainMeaning: 公式计算从n条谱系合并到n-1条谱系的期望时间，其中p_n = n(n-1)/(4N)是发生一次合并的概率，因此期望时间等于2N除以该概率，即4N/(n(n-1))。
formula-notes:formula_2.40:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在介绍中性进化中谱系合并过程的部分，用于量化样本量减少时合并事件的平均等待时间，为后续推导整个样本的期望合并时间（如TMRCA）提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_2.40:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the expected coalescence time (in generations) for n lineages to coalesce into n-1 lineages, where N is the effective population size and p_n = n(n-1)/(4N) is the coalescence probability per generation.
formula-notes:formula_2.40:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to neutral evolution to quantify the waiting time for coalescent events, supporting the derivation of the total expected coalescence time for a sample of n genes.

formula-notes:formula_2.41:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the expected total time (in generations) for all coalescent events in a sample of n genes under the neutral Wright-Fisher model, where N is the effective population size and i is the number of lineages at each coalescent step.
formula-notes:formula_2.41:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to neutral evolution to quantify the expected genealogical depth, which is later used to derive the expected number of segregating sites and other summary statistics under neutrality.

formula-notes:formula_2.41:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算样本量为 n 时，所有合并事件期望时间的总和（即期望总家系深度）。关键符号：N 为有效群体大小，i 为当前样本数，4N/(i(i-1)) 是第 i 个合并事件的期望时间。
formula-notes:formula_2.41:zh.inThisChapter: 此处通过求和各合并事件的期望时间，得到样本总家系深度的简洁表达式，为后续推导 Tajima's D 等统计量的期望奠定基础。

formula-notes:formula_2.42:en.plainMeaning: F_ST measures the proportion of total genetic variance in allele frequency that is due to variation among subpopulations (demes), where σ²(p) is the variance of allele B frequency across demes and p₀(1-p₀) is the total variance in the metapopulation.
formula-notes:formula_2.42:en.inThisChapter: This formula defines F_ST in the context of mutation-migration-drift equilibrium, allowing quantification of population differentiation and supporting later analysis of how migration and drift balance to maintain genetic variation.

formula-notes:formula_2.42:zh.plainMeaning: 公式(2.42)将FST定义为等位基因B在亚群间频率的方差σ²(p)与整个集合种群中该等位基因频率的方差p₀(1-p₀)之比，用于量化亚群间的遗传分化程度。
formula-notes:formula_2.42:zh.inThisChapter: 在突变-迁移-漂变平衡章节中，该公式用于定义FST，为后续推导平衡状态下FST与迁移率、突变率及有效群体大小的关系提供基础度量。

formula-notes:formula_2.43:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算在无突变和迁移条件下，两个种群从共同祖先分离t代后，由遗传漂变导致的等位基因频率方差（F_ST）的期望值。关键符号：N_e为有效种群大小，t为分离世代数。
formula-notes:formula_2.43:zh.inThisChapter: 本节讨论突变-迁移-漂变平衡，此公式先给出无迁移时的F_ST随时间线性增长关系（t << N_e时），为后续引入迁移和突变后平衡状态的推导提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_2.43:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the fixation index F_ST as a function of time t and effective population size N_e, showing that for small t relative to N_e, F_ST approximates t/(2N_e).
formula-notes:formula_2.43:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the mutation-migration-drift equilibrium section to quantify genetic differentiation due to drift alone, serving as a baseline for comparing with models that include mutation and migration.

formula-notes:formula_2.44:zh.plainMeaning: 公式 (2.44) 将 F_ST 定义为整个集合种群的平均共祖时间 (t̄) 与亚群内平均共祖时间 (t̄₀) 之差除以 t̄，即 F_ST = 1 - t̄₀/t̄，表示亚群间分化程度。
formula-notes:formula_2.44:zh.inThisChapter: 在“突变-迁移-漂变平衡”章节中，该公式建立了 F_ST 与共祖时间的直接关系，为后续利用共祖时间推导平衡状态下的 F_ST 表达式提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_2.44:en.plainMeaning: This formula expresses the fixation index F_ST in terms of average coalescence times: it is the difference between the mean coalescence time for the total population (t̄) and that within subpopulations (t̄₀), divided by t̄, or equivalently 1 minus the ratio t̄₀/t̄.
formula-notes:formula_2.44:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the mutation-migration-drift equilibrium section to connect population structure (F_ST) to coalescent times, which will be used later to derive expected F_ST under various evolutionary forces.

formula-notes:formula_2.45a:zh.plainMeaning: 公式(2.45a)计算的是从同一亚群内随机抽取的两个基因的期望溯祖时间，等于2乘以所有亚群有效大小之和，其中N是每个亚群的个体数，d是亚群个数。
formula-notes:formula_2.45a:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在“突变-迁移-漂变平衡”章节，用于说明在存在迁移的情况下，亚群内基因的溯祖时间仅取决于总群体大小，与迁移率无关，为后续推导亚群间溯祖时间(2.45b)和迁移率的影响提供基准。

formula-notes:formula_2.45a:en.plainMeaning: The formula computes the mean coalescence time for two genes sampled from the same deme, which equals twice the total population size across all demes (2N d), where N is the deme size and d is the number of demes.
formula-notes:formula_2.45a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on mutation-migration-drift equilibrium to show that, under sufficient migration, within-deme coalescence time is independent of migration rate, supporting the concept of a panmictic-like equilibrium at the metapopulation level.

formula-notes:formula_2.45b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算从整个集合种群中随机抽取的两个基因的平均溯祖时间，其中N是亚种群大小，d是亚种群数量，m是迁移率。
formula-notes:formula_2.45b:zh.inThisChapter: 在突变-迁移-漂变平衡章节中，此公式与公式2.45a对比，展示了集合种群水平上的平均溯祖时间如何依赖于亚种群数量和迁移率，为理解种群分化与基因流平衡提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_2.45b:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the mean coalescence time (in generations) for two genes sampled randomly from the entire metapopulation, where N is the subpopulation size, d is the number of subpopulations, and m is the migration rate.
formula-notes:formula_2.45b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the mutation-migration-drift equilibrium section to quantify the effect of population subdivision on coalescence times, supporting later arguments about how migration and drift interact to shape genetic diversity.

formula-notes:formula_2.46:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算在突变-迁移-漂变平衡下，群体分化指数F_ST的值，其中N为群体大小，m为迁移率，d为突变距离（或分化程度）；当d远大于1时，近似为1/(1+4Nm)。
formula-notes:formula_2.46:zh.inThisChapter: 本节推导突变-迁移-漂变平衡下的F_ST，公式2.46由公式2.44代入2.45a和2.45b得到，展示了当分化程度大时F_ST仅依赖于Nm，为后续讨论迁移对分化的影响提供简化形式。

formula-notes:formula_2.46:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the fixation index F_ST as a function of deme size N, migration rate m, and mutation distance d, showing that when d is large, F_ST ≈ 1/(1+4Nm).
formula-notes:formula_2.46:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the mutation-migration-drift equilibrium section to quantify population differentiation under high mutation rates, supporting the later argument that differentiation depends primarily on Nm when mutation is strong.

formula-notes:formula_2.47a:zh.plainMeaning: 这三个公式分别计算群体总变异在不同层级上的划分：F_DG衡量组内亚群间的变异比例（用平均共祖时间t̄₁和t̄₀），F_GT衡量总群体内组间的变异比例（用t̄₂和t̄₁），F_ST衡量总群体内亚群间的变异比例（用t̄₂和t̄₀）。
formula-notes:formula_2.47a:zh.inThisChapter: 在突变-迁移-漂变平衡章节中，这些公式将总群体变异分解为亚群间、组间和组内亚群间三个层次，为后续推导各层次F统计量与迁移率、突变率的关系（如公式2.47b）提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_2.47a:en.plainMeaning: These formulas partition total genetic variation into components: F_DG measures variation among demes within groups, F_GT among groups within the total, and F_ST among demes within the total, using mean coalescence times (t0 within demes, t1 within groups, t2 total).
formula-notes:formula_2.47a:en.inThisChapter: They appear in the mutation-migration-drift equilibrium section to quantify hierarchical population structure, supporting later derivation of equilibrium F-statistics in Equation 2.47b.

formula-notes:formula_2.47b:zh.plainMeaning: 公式(2.47b)给出了在突变-迁移-漂变平衡下，不同层次遗传分化指数F的近似表达式：F_DG（亚群内个体间）近似为1/(1+4Nm1)，其中N为有效群体大小，m1为亚群内迁移率；F_GT（总群内亚群间）和F_ST近似为1/(1+4Ndm2)，其中d为亚群数目，m2为亚群间迁移率。
formula-notes:formula_2.47b:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在“突变-迁移-漂变平衡”章节，是在假设d和g足够大且m2远小于m1的条件下，对之前更一般的公式(2.47a)进行简化得到的结果，为后续讨论不同层次遗传分化与迁移率的关系提供了简洁的近似表达式。

formula-notes:formula_2.47b:en.plainMeaning: These formulas approximate the fixation indices F_DG (between demes and the global pool) and F_GT (between demes and the total population, equal to F_ST) under a continent-island model with many demes and weak migration. F_DG depends on the effective number of migrants per generation into the continent (4Nm1), while F_GT depends on the product of deme number d and migrants per deme (4Ndm2).
formula-notes:formula_2.47b:en.inThisChapter: They appear in the section on mutation-migration-drift equilibrium to provide simplified expressions for population structure when migration is asymmetric and demes are numerous, supporting later arguments about the relationship between F-statistics and coalescence times under hierarchical migration.

formula-notes:formula_3.1:zh.plainMeaning: 该递推公式计算第t代配子结合时产生近交（等位基因同源相同）的概率f_t，它等于三种可能路径的概率之和：两个配子来自同一个亲本且该亲本自交（1/(2N_e)），或来自同一亲本但该亲本先前已近交（(1/(2N_e)) f_{t-1}），或来自不同亲本但亲本间有共同祖先（(1-1/N_e) f_{t-1}）。
formula-notes:formula_3.1:zh.inThisChapter: 本章引入有效群体大小N_e，该公式将f_t表达为N_e和上一代近交系数f_{t-1}的函数，为后续推导理想群体中近交系数的变化率以及定义有效群体大小提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_3.1:en.plainMeaning: This recurrence equation computes the probability of identity-by-descent (f_t) in generation t, given the effective population size N_e and the previous generation's probability f_{t-1}. It combines three sources: new inbreeding from selfing (first term), identity from selfing with previous inbreeding (second term), and identity from outcrossing with previous inbreeding (third term).
formula-notes:formula_3.1:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to genetic effective size to derive the equilibrium inbreeding coefficient and to show how N_e governs the rate of increase in inbreeding, supporting later arguments about the relationship between effective size and inbreeding in populations with spatial structure.

formula-notes:formula_2.24b:zh.plainMeaning: 公式 E(H) ≈ θ/(1+θ) 计算在大量等位基因（k ≫ 1）假设下，群体中期望杂合度 E(H) 与突变率 θ 的关系，其中 θ = 4Nμ（N 为有效群体大小，μ 为突变率）。
formula-notes:formula_2.24b:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式由公式 2.24a 在 k ≫ 1 时简化而来，引出无限等位基因模型，为后续讨论核苷酸位点（k=4）时的公式 2.24c 提供对比基础。

formula-notes:formula_2.8:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算从初始频率p0出发，经过t代后等位基因频率为pt的概率密度φ(pt|p0)。关键符号：p0为初始频率，pt为t代后频率，N为有效群体大小，F(·)为超几何函数，求和项包含i(2i+1)(i+1)权重和指数衰减因子e^{-i(i+1)t/(4N)}。
formula-notes:formula_2.8:zh.inThisChapter: 本章介绍中性进化的一、二位点模型，此公式来自Kimura(1955b)的扩散理论解，为后续讨论等位基因频率的随机波动和固定时间分布提供精确的概率密度表达式。

formula-notes:formula_2.34b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算折叠后的Watterson分布φ(x)，其中x是次要等位基因频率（0 < x ≤ 0.5），θ是种群突变率参数，公式将x和1-x对应的贡献相加，得到φ(x)=θ/[x(1-x)]。
formula-notes:formula_2.34b:zh.inThisChapter: 本章讨论中性变异的详细结构，公式2.34b通过折叠非极化等位基因的频率分布，将x限制在0到0.5之间，为后续分析低频等位基因的频谱提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_2.35a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算在样本大小为n时，L个总位点中恰好有i个衍生核苷酸的位点数目s_i的期望值，等于θ_L除以i。其中θ_L是群体突变率参数，i是衍生核苷酸的计数。
formula-notes:formula_2.35a:zh.inThisChapter: 本节讨论中性变异的详细结构，该公式从Watterson分布推导而来，为后续比较不同i值下s_i的期望分布（如公式2.35b）以及理解频率谱的均匀性提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_3.2:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the probability that two uniting gametes come from the same parent (self-fertilization), which defines the inverse of the effective population size N_e. Key symbols: P_t is the probability, N_e is the effective population size, N_{t-1} is the number of parents, k_i is the number of successful gametes from parent i, and μ_k is the mean number of successful gametes per parent.
formula-notes:formula_3.2:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the GENERAL CONSIDERATIONS section to introduce the concept of effective population size and to show how variance in reproductive success reduces N_e. This supports later arguments about genetic drift and inbreeding in populations with non-ideal reproduction.

formula-notes:formula_3.2:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算有效种群大小Ne的倒数，即自交配子对的比例Pt。分子是每个亲本产生的配子数ki的平方和减去ki之和，分母是上一代总配子数N_{t-1}μk乘以该总数减1，表示所有可能的配子对总数。
formula-notes:formula_3.2:zh.inThisChapter: 本章讨论有效种群大小，公式3.2从配子随机结合的角度推导Ne，为后续简化成更常用的Ne公式（如基于方差）提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_3.3:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the effective population size (Ne) from the actual population size (Nt), mean offspring number (μk), and variance in offspring number (σk²).
formula-notes:formula_3.3:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the General Considerations section to derive a practical expression for effective size that accounts for unequal offspring contributions, supporting later arguments about genetic drift in populations with variable reproductive success.

formula-notes:formula_3.3:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算有效种群大小Ne，其中Nt为当前世代个体数，μk为平均后代数，σk²为后代数方差。它通过将实际种群大小Nt按后代数分布（均值和方差）进行校正，得到理想化种群的有效大小。
formula-notes:formula_3.3:zh.inThisChapter: 在GENERAL CONSIDERATIONS部分，该公式由式3.2推导而来，用于量化非理想繁殖（如后代数方差大）对遗传漂变的影响，为后续讨论不同繁殖模式下的有效种群大小提供基础公式。

formula-notes:formula_3.4:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式在种群大小稳定（平均每个亲本产生两个成功配子，即 μ_k = 2）的条件下，将有效种群大小 N_e 表示为实际种群大小 N 和配子数方差 σ_k^2 的函数。
formula-notes:formula_3.4:zh.inThisChapter: 它出现在“一般考虑”部分，是对方程(3.2)在稳定种群这一重要特例下的简化，为后续讨论不同繁殖策略对有效种群大小的影响提供基础公式。

formula-notes:formula_3.4:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the effective population size (Ne) for a stable population (mean number of successful gametes per parent μk = 2), where N is the census size and σk² is the variance in reproductive success among parents.
formula-notes:formula_3.4:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the GENERAL CONSIDERATIONS section as a simplification of Equation 3.2 under the assumption of stable population size, providing a practical expression for Ne that will be used in later arguments about genetic drift and inbreeding.

formula-notes:formula_3.5:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将t代个体携带来自同一祖父母的两个基因的概率Pt定义为有效群体大小Ne的倒数，并通过t-2代个体的子代数ki计算Ne：分子是ki(ki-1)的总和，分母是N_{t-2}乘以平均子代数μk再乘以(N_{t-2}μk-2)。
formula-notes:formula_3.5:zh.inThisChapter: 在“一般考虑”部分，该公式将有效群体大小Ne与子代数的方差联系起来，为后续推导理想化群体中基因漂变的速率提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_3.5:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the probability that two alleles in a generation-t individual are identical by descent from the same grandparent, which equals the inverse of the effective population size N_e. Key symbols: P_t (probability), N_e (effective population size), N_{t-2} (number of individuals two generations back), k_i (number of offspring of the i-th individual in generation t-2), μ_k (mean number of offspring).
formula-notes:formula_3.5:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the 'General Considerations' section to derive the effective population size N_e from the variance in offspring number, supporting later arguments about how population size affects genetic drift and inbreeding.

formula-notes:formula_3.6:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the effective population size (Ne) from the actual population size in the previous generation (N_{t-1}), the mean (μ_k) and variance (σ_k^2) of offspring number. It adjusts for unequal reproductive success.
formula-notes:formula_3.6:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the 'GENERAL CONSIDERATIONS' section to derive a general expression for effective size under variable offspring numbers, which simplifies to Equation 3.7 for constant population size, supporting later analyses of genetic drift.

formula-notes:formula_3.7:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算在恒定种群大小（即平均后代数 μ_k=2）条件下，有效种群大小 N_e 与总个体数 N 及后代数方差 σ_k^2 的关系：N_e 随方差增大而减小。
formula-notes:formula_3.7:zh.inThisChapter: 本节从一般情况（公式3.6）推导出恒定种群大小下的特例（公式3.7），为后续讨论理想化种群与真实种群遗传漂变强度的差异提供量化工具。

formula-notes:formula_3.7:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the effective population size (Ne) for a population of constant census size N, where the variance in offspring number is σk². It simplifies Equation 3.6 by setting mean offspring number μk = 2.
formula-notes:formula_3.7:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the General Considerations section to provide a practical expression for Ne under constant population size, which is used later to quantify genetic drift and inbreeding in populations with variable reproductive success.

formula-notes:formula_3.8:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算允许自交时的有效群体大小Ne，其中N_{t-1}是上一代个体数，σ_{o,p}是每个亲本成功雄配子（花粉）和雌配子（胚珠）数量的协方差，μ_k是平均配子数。
formula-notes:formula_3.8:zh.inThisChapter: 在讨论自交是否允许对有效群体大小影响的章节中，公式3.8扩展了公式3.6（自交禁止情形），为后续分析自交对遗传漂变的影响提供定量基础。

formula-notes:formula_3.8:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the effective population size (N_e) when selfing is permitted, as a function of the previous generation's census size (N_{t-1}) and the covariance (σ_{o,p}) between the numbers of successful male (pollen) and female (ovule) gametes per parent, scaled by the square of the mean number of gametes (μ_k).
formula-notes:formula_3.8:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on general considerations to extend the effective size formula (Equation 3.6) to the case where selfing is allowed, showing how covariance between male and female gamete success reduces N_e relative to the case without selfing.

formula-notes:formula_3.9:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算个体从同一祖父母继承两个基因的总概率P，它等于有效群体大小Ne的倒数，具体由母本有效群体大小Nem和父本有效群体大小Nef的倒数各乘以1/4后相加得到。
formula-notes:formula_3.9:zh.inThisChapter: 在“一般考虑”章节中，此公式用于推导在雌雄有效群体大小不等时，如何计算总有效群体大小Ne，为后续章节中考虑性别比例对遗传漂变影响的分析提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_3.9:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the probability that an offspring inherits two identical genes from the same grandparent, which equals the inverse of the effective population size (Ne). Ne is partitioned into male (Nem) and female (Nef) effective sizes, with each contributing 1/(4N) to the total probability.
formula-notes:formula_3.9:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the 'General Considerations' section to derive the effective population size from the probability of inheriting two genes from a common ancestor, supporting later arguments about genetic drift and inbreeding in populations with separate sexes.

formula-notes:formula_3.10:zh.plainMeaning: 公式 (3.10) 计算性别 s（雄或雌）的有效种群大小 N_es，它依赖于该性别在 t-2 代的个体数 N_{s,t-2} 以及配子产量的均值 μ_sk 和方差 σ_{sk}^2。
formula-notes:formula_3.10:zh.inThisChapter: 在“一般考虑”部分，该公式扩展了有效种群大小的计算，考虑了性别间配子产量的变异，为后续分析近交或随机遗传漂变提供更精确的模型。

formula-notes:formula_3.10:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the effective number of individuals of a given sex (N_es) based on the mean (μ_sk) and variance (σ²_sk) of gamete production for that sex, and the census number of that sex two generations earlier (N_{s,t-2}).
formula-notes:formula_3.10:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the 'GENERAL CONSIDERATIONS' section to extend the effective population size concept to sex-specific cases, supporting later arguments about how unequal gamete production and overlapping generations affect effective size.

formula-notes:formula_3.11a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算有效雄性亲本数量N_em，它等于4倍的前两代雄性亲本数量N_{m,t-2}除以一个分母，分母包含雄性亲本后代数量的方差σ_{mm}^2、雄性与雌性亲本后代数量的协方差σ_{mm,mf}（乘以系数2(1-φ)/φ）以及雌性亲本后代数量的方差σ_{mf}^2（乘以系数((1-φ)/φ)^2）。
formula-notes:formula_3.11a:zh.inThisChapter: 在“一般考虑”部分，该公式与公式(3.11b)共同给出了考虑后代生产方差和协方差时有效种群大小的更精确表达式，为后续分析性别比例和繁殖变异对遗传漂变的影响提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_3.11a:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the effective number of male parents (N_em) in a population with sex ratio φ, accounting for variance in male progeny production (σ²_mm), covariance between male and female progeny from male parents (σ_mm,mf), and variance in female progeny from male parents (σ²_mf).
formula-notes:formula_3.11a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the GENERAL CONSIDERATIONS section to provide a refined expression for effective population size that incorporates sex-specific variances and covariances, supporting later arguments about how unequal sex ratios and reproductive skew affect genetic drift.

formula-notes:formula_3.11b:zh.plainMeaning: 公式(3.11b)计算雌性有效种群大小N_ef，它基于上一代雌性数量N_{f,t-2}，并除以一个包含雌性后代数方差σ_ff^2、雌性与雄性后代数协方差σ_{fm,ff}以及雄性后代数方差σ_fm^2的项，其中φ为雌性比例。
formula-notes:formula_3.11b:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式与(3.11a)对称，共同给出两性有效种群大小的表达式，为后续推导整体有效种群大小或分析性别比例对遗传漂变的影响提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_3.11b:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the effective female population size (N_ef) from the number of females two generations ago (N_{f,t-2}), adjusted for variance in female offspring number (σ_ff^2), covariance between female and male offspring from female parents (σ_{fm,ff}), variance in male offspring from female parents (σ_{fm}^2), and the sex ratio φ (proportion of females).
formula-notes:formula_3.11b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the GENERAL CONSIDERATIONS section to provide a sex-specific effective size formula, which together with Equation 3.11a for males allows calculation of the overall effective population size under unequal sex ratios and variance in reproductive success.

formula-notes:formula_3.12:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算有效群体大小Ne，它等于4倍雄性个体数Nm与雌性个体数Nf的乘积除以两者之和；代入Nm=(1-φ)N和Nf=φN后，Ne=4φ(1-φ)N，其中φ为雌性比例，N为总个体数。
formula-notes:formula_3.12:zh.inThisChapter: 在“一般考虑”部分，公式3.12由公式3.9推导而来，用于量化性别比例偏离1:1时有效群体大小的缩减，为后续讨论性别比例对遗传漂变和近交速率的影响提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_3.12:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the effective population size (Ne) from the numbers of males (Nm) and females (Nf), expressed as Ne = 4NmNf/(Nm+Nf). It also shows that when Nm = (1-φ)N and Nf = φN, Ne = 4φ(1-φ)N, where φ is the proportion of females and N is the total population size.
formula-notes:formula_3.12:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the GENERAL CONSIDERATIONS section to derive the effective size under unequal sex ratios, supporting later arguments about how sex ratio skew reduces effective population size relative to census size.

formula-notes:formula_3.13:zh.plainMeaning: 公式 (3.13) 计算世代时间 T，即亲本生育时的平均年龄，分子是各年龄 i 乘以该年龄的存活概率 ℓᵢ 和生育数 bᵢ 的加权和，分母是总生育数（净繁殖率 R₀），因此 T 是年龄的加权平均。
formula-notes:formula_3.13:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在介绍遗传有效群体大小的章节，用于定义世代时间 T，因为后续计算有效群体大小时需要将种群统计参数（如寿命、生育率）转化为一个统一的世代尺度，以便与理想群体比较。

formula-notes:formula_3.13:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the generation time (T) as the average age of parents when they give birth, weighted by the product of survival probability (ℓ_i) and fecundity (b_i) at each age i.
formula-notes:formula_3.13:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to genetic effective size to define generation time, which is a key parameter for calculating effective population size from age-structured life tables.

formula-notes:formula_3.14:zh.plainMeaning: 公式(3.14)计算雌雄异体种群的平均世代长度T，它是四种亲本-子代组合（雄父-雄子T_mm、雄父-雌子T_mf、雌父-雄子T_fm、雌父-雌子T_ff）的算术平均值，除以4。
formula-notes:formula_3.14:zh.inThisChapter: 在介绍遗传有效大小的章节中，该公式将世代长度T定义为四个年龄平均值的简单平均，为后续用T作为时间尺度推导年龄结构种群的进化速率（如有效大小）提供基础量度。

formula-notes:formula_3.14:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the average generation length T in a dioecious population by averaging the four possible parent-offspring sex combinations: T_mm (male parents of sons), T_mf (male parents of daughters), T_fm (female parents of sons), and T_ff (female parents of daughters).
formula-notes:formula_3.14:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to genetic effective size to define the natural time scale for evolutionary analysis of age-structured populations, supporting later calculations of effective population size that account for overlapping generations and sex differences.

formula-notes:formula_3.15:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算年龄结构且两性分离群体的遗传有效大小Ne，其中Neb是新生个体数，T是世代长度，ϕb是新生个体中雌性比例，ℓ_i^s和b_i^s分别是性别s在年龄i的存活率和生育率，求和项反映了不同性别年龄组繁殖方差对有效大小的稀释效应。
formula-notes:formula_3.15:zh.inThisChapter: 在引入遗传有效大小概念后，公式3.15将3.14的单一性别模型推广到两性年龄结构，为后续讨论稳定年龄分布下的有效大小提供更现实的表达式。

formula-notes:formula_3.15:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the effective population size (N_e) for an age-structured population with separate sexes, accounting for overlapping generations and variation in reproductive success across age classes. Key symbols: N_eb = number of newborns per time unit, T = generation length, φ_b = proportion of newborns that are male, τ_f and τ_m = maximum reproductive ages for females and males, ℓ_i^s = survivorship to age i for sex s, (∑_s)^2 = squared sum of expected lifetime reproduction from age i+1 onward.
formula-notes:formula_3.15:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to genetic effective size to extend the concept from discrete generations (Formula 3.14) to age-structured populations, which is essential for modeling realistic populations with overlapping generations and separate sexes.

formula-notes:formula_3.16:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算经过t代后群体杂合度H_t，其中H_0为初始杂合度，N_{e,i}为第i代的有效群体大小，乘积表示各代杂合度衰减因子的累积效应。
formula-notes:formula_3.16:zh.inThisChapter: 在介绍有效群体大小的章节中，此公式推广了恒定有效大小下的杂合度衰减公式，为后续讨论世代间有效大小变化对遗传漂变的影响提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_3.16:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the expected heterozygosity after t generations (H_t) given initial heterozygosity H_0, accounting for varying effective population sizes N_{e,i} in each generation. The product term replaces the constant (1 - 1/(2N_e))^t when N_e changes over time.
formula-notes:formula_3.16:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to genetic effective size to show how heterozygosity decay generalizes to populations with fluctuating size, setting up the need for a single effective size that captures the overall loss of genetic diversity.

formula-notes:formula_3.17:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式近似计算了在有效群体大小随时间变化（每代有效大小为N_{e,i}）的情况下，经过t代后杂合度H_t相对于初始杂合度H_0的衰减比例，关键是将各代1/(2N_{e,i})的累加和作为指数衰减的指数。
formula-notes:formula_3.17:zh.inThisChapter: 它由公式3.16简化而来，用于与恒定有效大小下的指数衰减公式对比，从而推导出随时间变化有效大小的调和均值表达式，为后续定义有效大小提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_3.17:en.plainMeaning: This formula approximates the expected heterozygosity H_t after t generations in a population with time-varying effective sizes N_{e,i}, as H_0 multiplied by the exponential of minus the sum over generations of 1/(2N_{e,i}).
formula-notes:formula_3.17:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to genetic effective size to derive an expression for heterozygosity decay under variable population size, which is then equated to the constant-size formula to define the harmonic mean effective size N_e^*.

formula-notes:formula_3.18:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算在t代内，当有效群体大小随时间变化时，调和平均有效群体大小N_e^*，即t除以各代有效大小倒数之和。
formula-notes:formula_3.18:zh.inThisChapter: 它由公式(3.17)与理想恒定有效大小下的H_t表达式指数相等推导而来，用于将变动的有效大小等效为一个恒定值，以便后续分析实际种群的遗传漂变速率。

formula-notes:formula_3.18:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the harmonic mean of effective population sizes over t generations, giving an overall effective size N_e^* that accounts for fluctuating population sizes. N_{e,i} is the effective size in generation i, and t is the number of generations.
formula-notes:formula_3.18:en.inThisChapter: It appears here to show how to calculate a single effective size that summarizes the effect of varying population sizes on heterozygosity loss, supporting the argument that the harmonic mean is the appropriate average for genetic drift over time.

formula-notes:formula_3.19:zh.plainMeaning: 公式 (3.19) 计算在恒定成年个体数 N 且每家族有比例 β 为自交后代时，有效群体大小 Nₑ；关键符号：N 为成年个体数，β 为自交比例，σₖ² 为每个家族后代数的方差。
formula-notes:formula_3.19:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在介绍遗传有效群体大小的章节，用于量化自交对有效群体大小的降低效应，为后续讨论近交和遗传漂变提供定量基础。

formula-notes:formula_3.19:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the effective population size (Ne) for a population with constant adult number, where a proportion β of offspring are from self-fertilization. N is the census size, and σ_k² is the variance in offspring number among individuals.
formula-notes:formula_3.19:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to genetic effective size to show how selfing (β) and variance in reproductive success (σ_k²) jointly reduce Ne relative to N, supporting later discussions on inbreeding and drift in structured populations.

formula-notes:formula_3.20:zh.plainMeaning: 公式 (3.20) 计算有效群体大小 Ne，其中 N 是实际群体大小，β 是配子方差贡献参数（与方差 σ_k^2 相关），Ne = (2-β)N/2 表示有效群体大小随 β 增大而减小。
formula-notes:formula_3.20:zh.inThisChapter: 本节介绍遗传有效群体大小的概念，公式 (3.20) 由方差 σ_k^2 的表达式代入公式 (3.19) 推导得出，为后续讨论不同繁殖模式下的有效群体大小提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_3.20:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the effective population size (Ne) from the census size (N) and a parameter β representing the correlation in reproductive success between mates. It shows that as β increases, Ne decreases.
formula-notes:formula_3.20:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to genetic effective size to illustrate how non-random mating (β) reduces effective size, supporting later arguments about the impact of mating system on genetic drift.

formula-notes:formula_3.21:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式近似计算在雌雄异体、雌雄数量相等且家系大小服从泊松分布时，有效群体大小 Ne 与总群体大小 N 及全同胞交配比例 β 的关系。
formula-notes:formula_3.21:zh.inThisChapter: 本章讨论遗传有效群体大小的概念，此公式展示了当存在一定比例的全同胞交配时，有效群体大小如何随 β 变化，为后续分析近交对有效群体大小的影响提供定量基础。
