formula-notes:formula_6.24a:en.plainMeaning: This formula expresses the response to selection (R_z) as the additive genetic covariance between fitness and the character z, which equals the covariance between the additive genetic values for fitness (A_w) and the character (A_z).
formula-notes:formula_6.24a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in Robertson's Secondary Theorem to formalize the genetic basis of selection response, supporting the argument that selection acts on the additive genetic covariance between fitness and the trait.

formula-notes:formula_6.24b:zh.plainMeaning: 公式(6.24b)计算性状育种值的变化量R_z（即ΔA_z），它等于相对适合度育种值的变化量ΔA_w乘以A_z对A_w的回归系数β_{A_z|A_w}。
formula-notes:formula_6.24b:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在Robertson第二定理的推导中，将性状响应R_z与适合度育种值变化ΔA_w通过回归系数联系起来，为后续用遗传协方差表示响应（公式6.24c）做铺垫。

formula-notes:formula_6.25a:en.plainMeaning: This formula expresses the response to selection R_z as the covariance between relative fitness w and additive genetic value A_z, connecting selection response to genetic variance.
formula-notes:formula_6.25a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to theorems of natural selection to derive the secondary theorem of natural selection, supporting later arguments about the relationship between selection response and additive genetic variance.

formula-notes:formula_6.24a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式表示性状z对选择的总响应Rz等于适应度w与性状z之间的加性协方差σA(w,z)，也等于适应度加性组分Aw与性状加性组分Az之间的协方差σ(Aw, Az)。
formula-notes:formula_6.24a:zh.inThisChapter: 在本节中，该公式是Robertson第二定理的核心表达式，将选择响应直接与加性遗传协方差联系起来，为后续推导选择响应的分解（如公式6.24b和6.24c）提供了基础。

formula-notes:formula_6.24b:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the change in breeding value of a trait (ΔA_z) as the product of the regression coefficient of A_z on A_w (β_{A_z|A_w}) and the change in breeding value of relative fitness (ΔA_w). It connects the response in a trait to the selection response in fitness via the genetic regression.
formula-notes:formula_6.24b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in Robertson's Secondary Theorem to express the change in any trait's breeding value as a linear function of the change in fitness breeding value, supporting the derivation that the genetic change in a trait equals the genetic covariance with relative fitness divided by the variance in fitness breeding value.

formula-notes:formula_6.24c:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the slope of the regression of breeding value for trait z on breeding value for trait w, equal to the covariance between the two breeding values divided by the variance of the breeding value for w. Key symbols: β (regression slope), A_z and A_w (breeding values), σ(A_w, A_z) (covariance), σ²(A_w) (variance).
formula-notes:formula_6.24c:en.inThisChapter: It appears in Robertson's Secondary Theorem to quantify the genetic regression of one trait on another, supporting the derivation of the correlated response R_z = ΔA_z = β_{A_z|A_w} ΔA_w in equation (6.24b).

formula-notes:formula_6.25a:zh.plainMeaning: 公式 R_z = σ(w, A_z) 表示性状对适应度的响应 R_z 等于适应度 w 与加性遗传值 A_z 之间的协方差 σ(w, A_z)。
formula-notes:formula_6.25a:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在 Robertson 次级定理的引入部分，作为 Robertson-Price 恒等式的自然延伸，为后续推导公式 6.25b 和 6.25c 中响应与遗传方差的关系提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_6.24c:zh.plainMeaning: 公式(6.24c)计算的是育种值A_z对A_w的回归斜率，等于A_w与A_z的协方差除以A_w的方差。
formula-notes:formula_6.24c:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在罗伯逊自然选择第二定理的推导中，为公式(6.24b)中R_z = ΔA_z = β_{A_z|A_w} ΔA_w提供了回归系数的具体表达式，从而将选择响应与遗传方差联系起来。

formula-notes:formula_6.25b:en.plainMeaning: This formula expresses the selection response R_z as the sum of heritability h² times the selection differential S and the covariance between fitness w and residual e_A, recovering the breeder's equation when that covariance is zero.
formula-notes:formula_6.25b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to show how the breeder's equation emerges from a regression of breeding value on phenotype, setting up the condition σ(w, e_A)=0 for later discussion of when the equation holds.

formula-notes:formula_6.25b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将选择响应 R_z 分解为两部分：遗传决定的部分 h^2 S（其中 h^2 是遗传力，S 是选择差）和残差 e_A 与适应度 w 的协方差 σ(w, e_A)。
formula-notes:formula_6.25b:zh.inThisChapter: 它从回归方程 A_z = h^2(z - μ) + e_A 出发，代入 Price 方程（6.25a）得到，旨在展示当 σ(w, e_A)=0 时退化为育种者方程，从而揭示 Price 方程与经典选择理论的联系。

formula-notes:formula_6.25c:en.plainMeaning: This formula expresses the selection response R_z as the covariance between breeding value for fitness A_w and breeding value for trait A_z, plus a covariance between the residual e_w and A_z, decomposing the total covariance from Equation 6.25a.
formula-notes:formula_6.25c:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to Price, Fisher, and Robertson theorems to show how the general response equation (6.25a) reduces to the simpler form (6.24a) when the residual covariance σ(e_w, A_z) is zero, linking the two versions.

formula-notes:formula_6.26:en.plainMeaning: This formula expresses the total response to selection (R_z) as the sum of the additive genetic covariance between the trait z and relative fitness w, denoted σ_A(z,w), plus a bias term B.
formula-notes:formula_6.26:en.inThisChapter: It appears in Robertson's Secondary Theorem to decompose the selection response into a component due to additive genetic covariance and a residual bias, supporting the theorem that the response equals the additive genetic covariance when B=0.

formula-notes:formula_6.27:en.plainMeaning: The formula computes the change in mean trait value (R_z) as the additive genetic covariance between the trait and fitness (σ_A(z,w)) plus a second-order error term (O(s^2)), where s is the selection coefficient.
formula-notes:formula_6.27:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on Robertson's secondary theorem to show that after sufficient time, the mean response approximates the additive genetic covariance, supporting the theorem's claim that selection acts on additive genetic variance even under linkage disequilibrium.

formula-notes:formula_6.25c:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将选择响应 R_z 分解为两部分：加性遗传协方差 σ(A_w, A_z) 与残差协方差 σ(e_w, A_z)，其中 w 是适合度，A_w 是其加性遗传值，e_w 是残差，A_z 是性状的加性遗传值。
formula-notes:formula_6.25c:zh.inThisChapter: 此公式出现在比较 Price 方程（6.25a）与 Robertson 方程（6.24a）的等价性讨论中，通过将适合度 w 分解为 A_w + e_w 代入，引出两者相等需满足 σ(e_w, A_z)=0 的条件，为后续分析两种版本适用范围奠定基础。

formula-notes:formula_6.26:zh.plainMeaning: 公式6.26表示对焦点性状z的响应R_z等于相对适应度w与性状z之间的加性遗传协方差σ_A(z,w)加上一个常数B。
formula-notes:formula_6.26:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在Robertson自然选择次级定理的章节中，它从公式5.22的逐位点求和形式出发，将响应分解为加性遗传协方差与常数项，为后续讨论选择响应与遗传协方差的关系提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_6.28:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the change in mean breeding value (ΔĀ_z) for a focal trait across generations, decomposed into the covariance of fitness with breeding value (σ(w, A_z)) and with the average effect of selection (σ(w, δ̄)), plus the expected change due to selection (E(δ̄)). Key symbols: ΔĀ_z (change in mean breeding value), σ (covariance), w (fitness), A_z (breeding value), δ̄ (average effect of selection).
formula-notes:formula_6.28:en.inThisChapter: It appears in Robertson's Secondary Theorem to show that the change in mean breeding value equals the covariance of fitness with breeding value plus additional terms from selection on other traits, supporting the decomposition of evolutionary change into direct and indirect components.

formula-notes:formula_6.27:zh.plainMeaning: 公式 (6.27) 表示平均性状值的变化率 R_z 等于性状 z 与相对适应度 w 的加性遗传协方差 σ_A(z,w) 加上一个 s^2 阶的小量 O(s^2)，其中 s 是选择系数。
formula-notes:formula_6.27:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在 Robertson 次级定理的讨论中，用于说明在连锁平衡附近，平均性状的响应主要由加性遗传协方差决定，而高阶项 O(s^2) 在远离平衡时可能变得重要，为后续分析非平衡状态下的响应偏差做铺垫。

formula-notes:formula_6.28:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算焦点性状平均育种值在世代间的变化ΔĀ_z，将其分解为性状育种值A_z与相对适合度w的协方差σ(w, A_z)、平均显性偏差δ̅与w的协方差σ(w, δ̅)以及δ̅的期望E(δ̅)之和。
formula-notes:formula_6.28:zh.inThisChapter: 在Robertson自然选择次级定理中，该公式将育种值变化拆解为加性效应和显性偏差的贡献，为后续推导育种值变化与加性遗传方差的关系（如公式6.29）提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_6.29:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the change in mean additive genetic value for trait z (ΔĀ_z) as the sum of the covariance between total fitness (w = A_w + e_w) and A_z, plus a covariance involving w and the average excess δ̄, plus an expectation term E(δ̄). It decomposes the first covariance into additive genetic (σ(A_w, A_z)) and environmental (σ(e_w, A_z)) components.
formula-notes:formula_6.29:en.inThisChapter: It appears in Robertson's Secondary Theorem section to show how the general expression (Equation 6.28) reduces to Robertson's 1968 version (Equation 6.25a) when the last three terms are negligible, thereby linking the secondary theorem to the simpler additive genetic covariance form.

formula-notes:formula_6.29:zh.plainMeaning: 公式6.29将选择响应ΔĀz分解为四项：加性遗传协方差σ(Aw, Az)、环境协方差σ(ew, Az)、选择差与平均显性偏差的协方差σ(w, δ̄)以及平均显性偏差的期望E(δ̄)，其中w = Aw + ew。
formula-notes:formula_6.29:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在Robertson二次选择定理章节，通过将w分解为加性效应Aw和环境效应ew，从公式6.28推导而来，旨在说明当δ̄很小但非零时，Robertson定理（公式6.25a）近似成立的条件是后三项为零或远小于第一项。

formula-notes:formula_6.30a:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the response to selection R_z as the sum of the covariance between fitness w_i and offspring mean trait value \overline{z}_i, plus the expected parent-offspring deviation E(\overline{\delta}_i).
formula-notes:formula_6.30a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in this section to decompose the Price equation into a term representing selection (covariance) and a term representing transmission bias (expected deviation), supporting the derivation of the breeder's equation.

formula-notes:formula_6.30b:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the regression coefficient β_{z̄|z} of mean offspring phenotype z̄_i on parental phenotype z_i, defined as the covariance between z̄_i and z_i divided by the variance of z_i.
formula-notes:formula_6.30b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the decomposition of the Price equation into two regressions, supporting the derivation of the breeder's equation by linking offspring mean to parental value through a linear regression.

formula-notes:formula_6.30a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将响应Rz分解为两部分：第一部分是亲本适应度wi与子代均值z̄i之间的协方差σ(wi, z̄i)，表示选择对子代均值的影响；第二部分是亲本-子代偏差δ̄i的期望E(δ̄i)，表示非选择传递（如环境或遗传）造成的平均变化。
formula-notes:formula_6.30a:zh.inThisChapter: 此公式出现在将育种者方程置于Price方程框架的章节中，它从Price方程（式6.7c）直接推导而来，为后续将响应分解为选择与非选择成分（式6.30b、6.30c）提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_6.31a:zh.plainMeaning: 公式 σ(e_w, e_overline{z}) = σ(w, overline{z} || z) 表示将 w_i 和 overline{z}_i 分别对 z_i 回归后得到的残差 e_w 和 e_overline{z} 之间的协方差，等于 w 和 overline{z} 在给定 z 条件下的偏协方差。
formula-notes:formula_6.31a:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在将育种者方程置于 Price 方程框架下的章节中，用于定义偏协方差，为后续推导总协方差 σ(w, overline{z}) 分解为偏协方差和回归项之和（如公式 6.31b）提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_6.30b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将第i个亲本的后代平均表型值z̄_i分解为总体均值μ、亲本表型值z_i的线性回归项β_{z̄|z} z_i和残差e_{z̄,i}之和，其中回归系数β_{z̄|z}等于后代均值与亲本值的协方差σ(z̄_i, z_i)除以亲本表型方差σ_z^2。
formula-notes:formula_6.30b:zh.inThisChapter: 在本节中，该公式是Price方程分解的第一步，通过线性回归将后代均值与亲本值关联，为后续引入遗传力（公式6.30c）和推导育种者方程（公式6.31）提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_6.30c:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将亲本i的相对适合度w_i表示为对其表型值z_i的线性回归，其中回归系数β_{w|z}等于w_i与z_i的协方差除以z_i的方差，即选择差S除以σ_z^2。
formula-notes:formula_6.30c:zh.inThisChapter: 在本节中，该公式将Price方程中的相对适合度w_i与表型值z_i通过线性回归联系起来，为后续推导育种者方程（即选择响应等于遗传力乘以选择差）提供回归系数β_{w|z}的具体表达式。

formula-notes:formula_6.31b:en.plainMeaning: This formula decomposes the covariance between fitness w and the average phenotype of offspring z̄ into a partial covariance given the parent's phenotype z plus the product of the regression coefficient β_{z̄|z} and the selection differential S (which is σ(w,z)).
formula-notes:formula_6.31b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on the Breeder's Equation within the Price Equation to show how the total covariance σ(w, z̄) can be partitioned into a direct effect (via the partial covariance) and an indirect effect mediated by the parent-offspring regression, supporting the derivation of the Breeder's Equation.

formula-notes:formula_6.31a:en.plainMeaning: This formula defines the partial covariance between w and overline{z} given z, denoted sigma(e_w, e_{overline{z}}), as the covariance of the residuals from regressing w and overline{z} on z. Key symbols: w (fitness), overline{z} (mean offspring phenotype), z (parental phenotype).
formula-notes:formula_6.31a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in this section to decompose the total covariance sigma(w, overline{z}) into a partial covariance and a term involving beta_{overline{z}|z}, supporting the derivation of the breeder's equation within the Price equation framework.

formula-notes:formula_6.30c:en.plainMeaning: This formula expresses relative fitness w_i as a linear regression on phenotypic value z_i, where the regression coefficient β_{w|z} equals the covariance between w_i and z_i divided by the variance of z_i, which is also the selection differential S divided by σ_z^2.
formula-notes:formula_6.30c:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section linking the Breeder's Equation to the Price Equation, showing how the selection differential S emerges as the covariance between fitness and phenotype, which is then used to derive the response to selection.

formula-notes:formula_6.33b:en.plainMeaning: The partial covariance between x and y given z equals the covariance between the residuals e_x and e_y from linear regressions of x on z and y on z, respectively.
formula-notes:formula_6.33b:en.inThisChapter: This formula defines the partial covariance used in Heywood’s decomposition, which later supports the derivation of the breeder's equation within the Price equation framework.

formula-notes:formula_6.32:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the total response to selection R_z as the sum of the direct response from the breeder's equation (β_{z̄|z} S), the indirect effect of correlated selection on the mean phenotype (σ(w, z̄||z)), and the average change due to transmission bias (E(δ̄)).
formula-notes:formula_6.32:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section deriving the breeder's equation within the Price equation framework, showing how the Price equation partitions selection and transmission effects into components that match the breeder's equation plus additional terms for correlated selection and bias.

formula-notes:formula_6.33a:en.plainMeaning: This formula defines the conditional covariance between x and y given z, computed as the expected value (over the conditional distribution given z) of the product of the deviations of x and y from their conditional means E(x|z) and E(y|z).
formula-notes:formula_6.33a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on the Breeder's Equation framed within the Price Equation to quantify the covariance between two variables after removing the effect of a third variable, which is essential for deriving the conditional covariance components used in the Price Equation decomposition.

formula-notes:formula_6.33a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式定义了条件协方差 σ(x,y|z)，它计算在给定 z 的条件下，x 和 y 分别减去其条件期望后的乘积的条件期望，度量了剔除 z 的影响后 x 与 y 的线性相关程度。
formula-notes:formula_6.33a:zh.inThisChapter: 本节在 Price 方程框架下推导育种者方程，条件协方差用于刻画在给定某个变量（如适应度）后其他变量之间的依赖关系，为后续公式 6.33b-6.33f 中分解协方差和推导选择响应提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_6.33b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将x和y在给定z条件下的偏协方差σ(x,y||z)定义为x对z回归的残差e_x与y对z回归的残差e_y之间的协方差σ(e_x, e_y)，从而用残差间的协方差来度量控制z后x与y的线性依赖关系。
formula-notes:formula_6.33b:zh.inThisChapter: 在本节中，该公式引入偏协方差作为Price方程框架下Breeder方程的一种替代依赖度量，为后续推导Heywood分解（公式6.33c–6.33f）提供基础，从而将选择响应分解为直接效应和间接效应。

formula-notes:formula_6.32:zh.plainMeaning: 公式(6.32)将性状z对下一代的响应R_z分解为三部分：加性遗传效应β_{z̄|z}S、非加性遗传效应σ(w,z̄||z)以及环境或发育噪声E(δ̄)。其中β_{z̄|z}是后代均值z̄对亲本z的回归系数，S是选择差，σ(w,z̄||z)是条件协方差，E(δ̄)是平均偏差的期望。
formula-notes:formula_6.32:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在将育种者方程嵌入Price方程框架的章节中，它通过引入非加性遗传和环境项，扩展了经典育种者方程，为后续讨论非加性遗传效应和表型可塑性对进化响应的影响提供了基础。

formula-notes:formula_6.31b:zh.plainMeaning: 公式(6.31b)将性状z的群体均值与适合度w的协方差σ(w, z̄)分解为两部分：给定z条件下w与z̄的偏协方差σ(w, z̄||z)，加上回归系数β_{z̄|z}乘以适合度与z的协方差S（即σ(w, z)）。
formula-notes:formula_6.31b:zh.inThisChapter: 在Price方程框架下推导育种者方程时，该公式用于将选择微分（σ(w, z̄)）拆解为直接选择（通过z）和间接选择（通过z̄中与z无关的部分）的贡献，为后续得到响应R = β_{z̄|z} S等关键结果做铺垫。

formula-notes:formula_6.33c:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the residual e_x from the linear regression of x on z, where e_x = x - μ_x - (σ(x,z)/σ_z^2) z. The symbols are: x (trait), μ_x (mean of x), z (covariate), σ(x,z) (covariance), σ_z^2 (variance of z).
formula-notes:formula_6.33c:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the derivation of the partial covariance σ(x,y||z) within the Price equation framework, providing the residual needed to isolate the direct relationship between x and y after controlling for z.

formula-notes:formula_6.33c:zh.plainMeaning: 公式(6.33c)定义了变量x在剔除z的线性影响后的残差e_x，即x减去其对z的线性回归预测值μ_x + (σ(x,z)/σ_z^2)z。
formula-notes:formula_6.33c:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在Price方程框架下推导Breeder's方程的过程中，通过定义残差e_x和e_y，为后续计算条件协方差σ(x,y||z)（公式6.33b）提供基础，从而分离出z对x和y的线性效应。

formula-notes:formula_6.33d:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算在控制变量z后，x与y之间的偏协方差σ(x,y||z)。它等于原始协方差σ(x,y)减去通过z的间接协方差σ(x,z)σ(y,z)/σ_z^2。
formula-notes:formula_6.33d:zh.inThisChapter: 在Price方程框架下推导育种者方程时，需要将性状分解为遗传和环境部分。此公式通过偏协方差消除共同变量z的影响，为后续将σ(x,y||z)表达为遗传协方差σ(e_x,e_y)提供代数基础。

formula-notes:formula_6.33e:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the partial covariance between w and the mean phenotype of offspring (z̄), controlling for z, as the total covariance minus the product of the regression coefficient of z̄ on z and the covariance between w and z.
formula-notes:formula_6.33e:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the derivation of the Breeder's Equation within the Price Equation framework to show how selection on w (e.g., fitness) translates into evolutionary change in the mean phenotype, accounting for transmission bias via the regression β_{z̄|z}.

formula-notes:formula_6.33d:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the partial covariance between x and y given z, denoted σ(x,y||z), as the covariance of the residuals after regressing x and y on z. It simplifies to σ(x,y) minus the product of the covariances of x with z and y with z divided by the variance of z.
formula-notes:formula_6.33d:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the derivation of the partial covariance within the Price equation framework, showing how to remove the effect of a third variable z, which is essential for decomposing selection and transmission in the breeder's equation.

formula-notes:formula_6.33f:en.plainMeaning: This formula decomposes the total selection differential on the offspring mean phenotype σ(w, z̄) into a within-group component σ(w, z̄ || z) and a between-group component β_{z̄|z} S, where S = σ(w, z) is the selection differential on the character z, and β_{z̄|z} is the regression of group mean on individual phenotype.
formula-notes:formula_6.33f:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section linking the Breeder's Equation to the Price Equation, and is used to derive Equation 6.32, which expresses the total response to selection as a sum of within- and between-group components.

formula-notes:formula_6.33f:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将性状均值与适合度的协方差σ(w, z̄)分解为两部分：条件协方差σ(w, z̄||z)（给定z时w与z̄的协方差）加上回归系数β_{z̄|z}乘以选择差S（即σ(w, z)）。
formula-notes:formula_6.33f:zh.inThisChapter: 此式出现在Price方程框架下推导育种者方程的过程中，通过分解协方差为条件期望和回归项，为后续得到方程6.32（即育种者方程）提供关键代数步骤。

formula-notes:formula_6.34:en.plainMeaning: This formula decomposes the covariance between parent mean offspring phenotype (z̄_i) and parent phenotype (z_i) into the sum of two covariances: one involving the offspring mean from unselected parents (z̄_i^∘) and one involving the selection differential effect (δ_i^∘).
formula-notes:formula_6.34:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section linking the Breeder's Equation to the Price Equation, showing how the total covariance can be partitioned into a component due to additive genetic effects (σ(z̄_i^∘, z_i)) and a component due to selection (σ(δ_i^∘, z_i)), which supports later derivation of the Breeder's Equation.

formula-notes:formula_6.33e:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算在控制变量z后，w与平均表型z̄的偏协方差σ(w, z̄ || z)，等于原始协方差σ(w, z̄)减去z̄对z的回归系数β_{z̄|z}乘以w与z的协方差σ(w, z)。
formula-notes:formula_6.33e:zh.inThisChapter: 本节将育种者方程置于Price方程框架下，该公式通过偏协方差分解，为后续推导选择响应与遗传协方差的关系提供关键代数工具。

formula-notes:formula_6.34:zh.plainMeaning: 公式(6.34)将亲本i的育种值(σ(ẑ_i, z_i))分解为两部分：σ(ẑ_i^∘, z_i)是亲本i与随机交配群体中亲本i的后代均值ẑ_i^∘的协方差，σ(δ_i^∘, z_i)是亲本i与选择导致的额外效应δ_i^∘的协方差。
formula-notes:formula_6.34:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在将育种者方程嵌入Price方程的过程中，通过将ẑ_i分解为ẑ_i^∘与δ_i^∘之和，将选择响应拆解为随机交配下的遗传传递部分和选择导致的非随机交配效应，为后续推导育种者方程(6.35)提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_6.35:en.plainMeaning: This formula decomposes the regression coefficient of offspring phenotype on parent phenotype into a component due to the average phenotype of offspring before selection (β_{z̄°|z}) plus a term capturing the effect of selection on the offspring phenotype (σ(δ°, z)/σ_z²).
formula-notes:formula_6.35:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section linking the Breeder's Equation to the Price Equation, showing how the heritability term in the Breeder's Equation can be expressed as the sum of a transmission bias term and a selection effect, thereby unifying quantitative genetics and evolutionary theory.

formula-notes:formula_6.36a:zh.plainMeaning: 公式(6.36a)将性状z的群体平均育种值(overline{z}^circ)与适合度w的协方差分解为两部分：第一部分是给定z后平均育种值的条件协方差σ(w, overline{z}^circ || z)，第二部分是回归系数β_{overline{z}^circ | z}乘以σ(w, z)。
formula-notes:formula_6.36a:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在Price方程框架下推导育种者方程的过程中，通过将协方差分解为条件协方差和回归项，为后续得到育种者方程(如公式6.36b)提供关键代数恒等式。

formula-notes:formula_6.36a:en.plainMeaning: This formula decomposes the covariance between fitness w and the average phenotype of offspring after selection, σ(w, z̄°), into two components: the covariance conditional on the parent's phenotype z, σ(w, z̄°||z), plus the product of the regression coefficient of offspring phenotype on parent phenotype β_{z̄°|z} and the covariance between fitness and parent phenotype σ(w, z).
formula-notes:formula_6.36a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on the Breeder's Equation framed within the Price Equation to show how the total evolutionary response can be partitioned into a direct effect of selection on the parent-offspring transmission and an indirect effect via the parent's phenotype, supporting later derivations of the multivariate breeder's equation.

formula-notes:formula_6.35:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将性状z的育种值对性状z的回归系数β_{z̄|z}分解为两部分：第一部分是“理想化”育种值z̄°对z的回归系数β_{z̄°|z}，第二部分是偏差项δ°与z的协方差除以z的方差，反映了非加性效应或环境效应等对回归的贡献。
formula-notes:formula_6.35:zh.inThisChapter: 在本章中，该公式将育种者方程置于Price方程框架下，通过分解育种值z̄为理想化部分z̄°和偏差δ°，展示Price方程中协方差项如何对应回归系数，为后续推导选择响应和解释遗传增益提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_6.37:en.plainMeaning: This formula decomposes the total change from parent to offspring, \(\overline{\delta}_i\), into two components: the average deviation due to transmission (\(\delta_i^\circ\)) and the change in the average breeding value of selected parents (\(\overline{z}_i^\circ - z_i\)).
formula-notes:formula_6.37:en.inThisChapter: It clarifies that \(\overline{\delta}_i\) is not purely a transmission effect, but includes a selection component, which is essential for correctly interpreting the Price equation and its connection to the breeder's equation.

formula-notes:formula_6.36b:en.plainMeaning: This formula decomposes the covariance between fitness w and the average phenotype of offspring z̄, conditional on parental phenotype z, into three components: the covariance of w with the average breeding value of offspring z̄° conditional on z, the covariance of w with the average environmental deviation δ°, minus a correction term involving the covariance of δ° and z, the covariance of w and z, and the phenotypic variance σ_z².
formula-notes:formula_6.36b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on the Breeder's Equation framed within the Price Equation to show how the covariance between fitness and offspring phenotype can be partitioned into genetic and environmental components, supporting later derivations of evolutionary change in terms of breeding values and environmental effects.

formula-notes:formula_6.38:en.plainMeaning: This formula expresses the expected value of the average change in a character (δ̄_i) as the sum of the expected value of the change due to selection (δ_i^0) and the expected value of the difference between the offspring mean from unselected parents (z̄_i^0) and the parental mean (z_i), which is the constitutive transmission bias.
formula-notes:formula_6.38:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to the theorems of natural selection to decompose the total expected change into a selection component and a transmission bias component, setting up the Price equation and related results.

formula-notes:formula_6.37:zh.plainMeaning: 公式将平均子代表型偏差 \(\overline{\delta}_{i}\) 分解为两部分：亲本到子代的传递偏差 \(\delta_{i}^{\circ}\) 和亲本均值与亲本表型之差 \(\overline{z}_{i}^{\circ}-z_{i}\)，其中 \(\overline{z}_{i}\) 是子代均值，\(z_{i}\) 是亲本表型，\(\overline{z}_{i}^{\circ}\) 是亲本均值。
formula-notes:formula_6.37:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在讨论育种者方程与Price方程关系的章节中，旨在澄清 \(\overline{\delta}_{i}\) 并非纯粹的无选择传递变化，而是包含亲本均值与表型差异的贡献，为后续推导Price方程中协方差项与选择差分的联系提供精确分解。

formula-notes:formula_6.36b:zh.plainMeaning: 公式(6.36b)将条件协方差σ(w, z̄||z)分解为三项：第一项是σ(w, z̄°||z)，第二项是σ(w, δ°)，第三项减去σ(δ°,z)σ(w,z)/σ_z²，其中z̄是子代均值，z̄°是亲代均值，δ°是亲代育种值偏差，z是亲代表型值。
formula-notes:formula_6.36b:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在“育种者方程在Price方程框架下”一节，用于进一步分解条件协方差，为后续推导育种者方程或理解选择响应提供代数工具。

formula-notes:formula_6.38:zh.plainMeaning: 公式(6.38)将子代平均育种值偏差的期望 E(δ̄_i) 分解为两部分：亲本育种值偏差的期望 E(δ_i^∘) 加上亲本到子代育种值变化量的期望 E(z̄_i^∘ - z_i)，其中 z_i 是亲本表型值，z̄_i^∘ 是未选择亲本产生的子代平均表型值。
formula-notes:formula_6.38:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在自然选择定理章节的引言部分，为后续推导Price方程和Fisher基本定理提供基础，通过分解育种值偏差来量化选择与遗传传递对进化变化的影响。

formula-notes:formula_6.39:en.plainMeaning: This formula decomposes the total selection response R into components: the direct effect of selection on breeding value (β S), plus terms capturing covariance between fitness and offspring breeding value conditional on parent breeding value, covariance with environmental deviation, and expected changes in environmental and breeding value offsets.
formula-notes:formula_6.39:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section integrating the Breeder's Equation with the Price Equation, showing how the response to selection can be partitioned into genetic and environmental components, supporting later analysis of evolutionary change under non-ideal conditions.

formula-notes:formula_7.1:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the new frequency of allele a after one generation of viability selection, where p is the current frequency, W_a is the marginal fitness of a, and \(\overline{W}\) is the mean fitness of the population.
formula-notes:formula_7.1:en.inThisChapter: It appears here to model the effect of selection on allele frequency before mutation is applied, serving as the first step in the combined process of selection and mutation under drift.

formula-notes:formula_6.41:en.plainMeaning: This formula expresses the covariance between fitness w and breeding value δ° minus the product of covariances involving z divided by the variance of z, which equals the partial covariance of w and δ° given z, denoted σ(w,δ°||z).
formula-notes:formula_6.41:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the derivation of the Breeder's Equation within the Price Equation framework, showing how the covariance between fitness and breeding value can be adjusted for the effect of a third variable z, supporting the decomposition of selection into components.

formula-notes:formula_6.41:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将育种者方程中的协方差项σ(w,δ°)减去由z介导的间接路径σ(δ°,z)σ(w,z)/σ_z²后，得到偏协方差σ(w,δ°||z)，表示在控制z不变时w与δ°的线性关联。
formula-notes:formula_6.41:zh.inThisChapter: 此处利用该恒等式将公式6.39中的协方差分解为直接路径（偏协方差）与间接路径（通过z的回归项），为后续推导育种者方程中直接选择与间接选择效应的分离提供代数基础。

formula-notes:formula_7.1:zh.plainMeaning: 公式 (7.1) 计算经过生活力选择后等位基因 a 的新频率 p'，它等于选择前频率 p 乘以 a 的边缘适应度 W_a 与群体平均适应度 W̄ 的比值。
formula-notes:formula_7.1:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在本章开头，作为引入选择、突变和漂变相互作用的基础，后续将在此基础上叠加突变（得到 p''）和漂变效应，以分析平衡频率和固定概率。

formula-notes:formula_6.40:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the total response to selection R as the sum of the direct effect from the regression of offspring on parent (βS), plus covariances between fitness and changes in mean breeding value (σ terms), and expected changes due to environmental and transmission effects (E terms). Key symbols: R = response, β = regression coefficient after selection, S = selection differential, w = fitness, z̄° = mean after selection, δ° = environmental deviation, z = trait value.
formula-notes:formula_6.40:en.inThisChapter: It appears in this section to decompose the breeder's equation within the Price equation framework, showing that the simple product βS is only part of the total response, and the additional terms account for non-genetic transmission and environmental effects, supporting a more complete evolutionary analysis.

formula-notes:formula_6.40:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将响应R分解为五个部分：加性遗传效应项β_{z̄,z}S、选择对平均育种值的协方差σ(w,z̄°||z)、选择对偏差的协方差σ(w,δ°||z)、偏差期望E(δ°)以及平均育种值变化期望E(z̄°-z)，其中z̄°是选择后平均育种值，δ°是环境偏差。
formula-notes:formula_6.40:zh.inThisChapter: 在Price方程框架下，公式(6.40)将育种者方程R=βS扩展为包含非加性遗传和环境效应的完整分解，为后续讨论选择响应中遗传与环境贡献的分离提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_6.39:zh.plainMeaning: 公式将选择响应R分解为四项：第一项是育种者方程的核心项，即通过亲本表型z对子代平均表型z̄°的回归系数β乘以选择差S；第二项σ(w, z̄°||z)是给定z条件下w与z̄°的协方差，表示非回归部分；第三项σ(w, δ°)是w与传递偏差δ°的协方差；第四项E(δ°)是传递偏差的期望；第五项E(z̄°-z)是子代均值与亲本均值之差的期望。
formula-notes:formula_6.39:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在将育种者方程置于Price方程框架下的章节，通过将选择响应分解为回归项和剩余项，展示了育种者方程是Price方程在特定假设下的特例，并为后续讨论非加性遗传效应、环境效应等偏离经典假设的情况提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_7.2:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the allele frequency after both mutation and selection, where p' is the frequency after selection, u is the forward mutation rate (from A to a), v is the backward mutation rate (from a to A), and μ = u/(u+v) is the equilibrium frequency under mutation alone.
formula-notes:formula_7.2:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to show how mutation and selection combine to change allele frequency, setting up the baseline for later analysis of drift and mutation-selection balance in finite populations.

formula-notes:formula_7.2:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算经过突变后的等位基因频率p''，它等于上一代经选择后的频率p'乘以未反向突变的概率(1-v)，加上反向突变引入的u乘以非a等位基因频率(1-p')，合并后为(1-μ-v)p'+μ，其中μ=u，v分别为正向和反向突变率。
formula-notes:formula_7.2:zh.inThisChapter: 在引入选择与突变相互作用时，公式(7.2)将选择后的频率p'修正为包含突变效应的频率p''，为后续推导平衡频率和漂变影响提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_7.3:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the frequency of allele a after one generation of selection and mutation, where p is the initial frequency, μ is the mutation rate from A to a, ν is the mutation rate from a to A, Wa is the marginal fitness of a, and W̄ is the mean fitness.
formula-notes:formula_7.3:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to show how selection and mutation jointly change allele frequency, setting the stage for later analysis of their interaction with genetic drift.

formula-notes:formula_7.3:zh.plainMeaning: 公式 (7.3) 计算经过一代选择与突变共同作用后，等位基因 a 的频率 p''。其中 p 是当前 a 的频率，μ 是从 A 到 a 的突变率，v 是从 a 到 A 的突变率，W_a 是 a 型个体的适应度，W̄ 是平均适应度。
formula-notes:formula_7.3:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在“选择、突变与漂变的相互作用”章节的引言部分，用于建立同时包含选择和突变的一代频率变化模型，为后续讨论突变-选择平衡以及漂变的影响提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_7.4:zh.plainMeaning: 该三次方程通过令Δp=0得到，求解平衡频率p̃；方程中s为选择系数，h为显性度，μ为正向突变率，v为回复突变率，p̃为突变-选择平衡时的等位基因频率。
formula-notes:formula_7.4:zh.inThisChapter: 本章引入选择、突变和漂变的相互作用，该方程给出了在突变和选择共同作用下平衡频率p̃的隐式解，为后续讨论漂变对平衡的影响提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_7.5:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the equilibrium frequency of an allele under mutation pressure alone, where μ is the mutation rate to the allele and ν is the mutation rate away from it.
formula-notes:formula_7.5:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to show the simplest case of mutation-selection-drift balance when selection is absent, providing a baseline for later models that include selection and drift.

formula-notes:formula_7.5:zh.plainMeaning: 公式 (7.5) 计算在仅考虑突变（无选择）时，等位基因 A 的平衡频率 p̃，其中 μ 是 A 突变为 a 的速率，v 是 a 突变为 A 的速率。
formula-notes:formula_7.5:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在“选择、突变和漂变的相互作用”章节的引言部分，为后续引入选择效应时提供中性情况下的平衡频率作为参照点。

formula-notes:formula_7.6a:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the equilibrium frequency of a deleterious allele under mutation-selection balance, given the mutation rate μ, selection coefficient s, and dominance coefficient h. The tilde denotes the equilibrium value.
formula-notes:formula_7.6a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to interaction of selection, mutation, and drift to provide a deterministic baseline equilibrium frequency, which later arguments about the effects of genetic drift will modify.

formula-notes:formula_7.4:en.plainMeaning: This cubic equation in (1 - p̃) gives the equilibrium frequency p̃ of allele A under selection (with dominance h and selection coefficient s), forward mutation rate μ from A to a, and backward mutation rate ν from a to A, by setting the change in allele frequency Δp = 0.
formula-notes:formula_7.4:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to show that when mutation and selection act simultaneously, the equilibrium is a root of a cubic, which is then simplified under various assumptions (e.g., weak mutation) to derive approximate formulas used later in the chapter.

formula-notes:formula_7.6a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算在正向突变率v=0、选择系数s大于突变率μ的条件下，突变等位基因的平衡频率p̃。关键符号：h为显性度，s为选择系数，μ为反向突变率（从正常等位基因到有害等位基因）。
formula-notes:formula_7.6a:zh.inThisChapter: 本章讨论选择、突变和漂变的相互作用，此公式从方程7.4简化而来，为后续推导近似解（7.6b）提供精确解基础，并用于分析中间显性情况下的平衡频率。

formula-notes:formula_7.6b:en.plainMeaning: This formula approximates the equilibrium frequency of a deleterious allele under mutation-selection balance when dominance is intermediate and selection is much stronger than mutation, with the condition that the dominance coefficient h is much larger than the square root of the mutation rate over the selection coefficient.
formula-notes:formula_7.6b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to the interaction of selection, mutation, and drift to provide a simplified expression for the equilibrium allele frequency under deterministic forces, which will later be used to assess when drift becomes important relative to selection and mutation.

formula-notes:formula_7.6c:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算在完全显性有害突变（h=1）情况下，突变-选择平衡时突变等位基因A的频率，其中μ是突变率，s是选择系数。
formula-notes:formula_7.6c:zh.inThisChapter: 本节介绍选择、突变和漂变的相互作用，公式7.6c给出了在完全显性条件下平衡频率的显式解，为后续讨论不同显性度下的平衡频率（如公式7.6d）以及漂变的影响提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_7.6d:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the equilibrium frequency (tilde{p}) of a completely recessive deleterious mutation (h=0) under mutation-selection balance, where μ is the mutation rate and s is the selection coefficient against homozygotes.
formula-notes:formula_7.6d:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to interaction of selection, mutation, and drift to show the deterministic equilibrium for recessive mutations, which later serves as a baseline for understanding how genetic drift alters allele frequencies in finite populations.

formula-notes:formula_7.6c:en.plainMeaning: This formula gives the equilibrium frequency (tilde{p}) of a completely dominant deleterious mutation (h=1) under mutation-selection balance, where μ is the mutation rate and s is the selection coefficient against the mutant homozygote.
formula-notes:formula_7.6c:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to interaction of selection, mutation, and drift to show the deterministic equilibrium for dominant mutations, which will later be compared to the recessive case (7.6d) and to stochastic effects of drift.

formula-notes:formula_7.6d:zh.plainMeaning: 公式(7.6d)计算在完全隐性有害突变（h=0）时，突变-选择平衡下的突变等位基因频率，其中μ是突变率，s是选择系数，平衡频率等于μ/s的平方根。
formula-notes:formula_7.6d:zh.inThisChapter: 本节介绍选择、突变和漂变的相互作用，公式(7.6d)作为完全隐性情况下的平衡频率，与显性情况(7.6c)对比，为后续讨论漂变对平衡的影响提供基准。

formula-notes:formula_7.6b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式给出了在中间显性度（0 < h ≤ 1）且选择系数远大于突变率（s >> μ）的条件下，突变-选择平衡时突变等位基因的近似频率 p̃。它近似等于突变率 μ 除以显性系数 h 与选择系数 s 的乘积，前提是 h 远大于 √(μ/s)。
formula-notes:formula_7.6b:zh.inThisChapter: 本章介绍选择、突变和漂变的相互作用，公式(7.6b)从精确解(7.6a)简化而来，为后续讨论弱选择或强突变情况下的平衡频率提供近似表达式，并引出进一步近似(7.6c)和(7.6d)的条件。

formula-notes:formula_7.7:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the frequency of allele A_i after one generation of selection, mutation, and random mating. p_i'' is the new frequency, W_i is the marginal fitness of A_i, μ_i is the total mutation rate away from A_i, μ_ji is the mutation rate from A_j to A_i, and W̄ is the mean fitness.
formula-notes:formula_7.7:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to the interaction of selection, mutation, and drift to model how mutation and selection jointly affect allele frequencies, setting up the analysis of equilibrium behavior under mutation-selection balance.

formula-notes:formula_7.8:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the expected variance in allele frequency change due to genetic drift (gamete sampling) under the Wright-Fisher model, where p is the current allele frequency and N_e is the variance effective population size (the factor 2 accounts for diploidy).
formula-notes:formula_7.8:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to quantify the strength of genetic drift, setting the stage for comparing drift with selection and mutation in subsequent sections.

formula-notes:formula_7.9:en.plainMeaning: This formula states that under neutrality, the probability of fixation of an allele, u_f(p_0), equals its initial frequency p_0.
formula-notes:formula_7.9:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on selection and drift to contrast with cases where selection alters fixation probability, supporting the argument that without selection, fixation probability depends solely on initial frequency.

formula-notes:formula_7.8:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算由配子抽样（遗传漂变）引起的等位基因频率变化Δp_d的方差，其中p是抽样前的等位基因频率，N_e是方差有效群体大小，2表示二倍体（单倍体时改为1）。
formula-notes:formula_7.8:zh.inThisChapter: 本章介绍选择、突变和漂变的相互作用，此公式量化了漂变的强度（即抽样方差），为后续比较漂变与选择、突变的相对重要性提供了基准尺度。

formula-notes:formula_7.7:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算了在经历选择、突变和随机交配后，等位基因 A_i 的新频率 p_i''：它等于 (1-μ_i) 乘以选择后的频率 W_i p_i 加上从其他等位基因 j 突变而来的贡献 μ_{ji} W_j p_j，再除以平均适应度 W̄。
formula-notes:formula_7.7:zh.inThisChapter: 本章引入突变与选择、漂变的相互作用，该公式将突变项（μ_i 和 μ_{ji}）添加到选择后的频率变化中，为后续分析平衡态和突变-选择平衡奠定基础。

formula-notes:formula_7.9:zh.plainMeaning: 公式 u_f(p0)=p0 表示在无选择的中性条件下，一个等位基因最终在群体中固定的概率等于其初始频率 p0。
formula-notes:formula_7.9:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在“单基因座的选择与漂变”章节，用于对比中性模型与选择模型，为后续讨论选择如何改变固定概率提供基线。

formula-notes:formula_7.10a:en.plainMeaning: This formula approximates the fixation probability u_f(p0) of an allele with additive fitness effect s, starting at initial frequency p0, under selection and genetic drift in a population of effective size Ne. Key symbols: u_f = fixation probability, p0 = initial frequency, Ne = effective population size, s = selection coefficient.
formula-notes:formula_7.10a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on selection and drift at single loci to quantify how selection and drift interact to determine the ultimate fate of an allele. It supports later arguments about the conditions under which selection dominates drift (e.g., when 2Ne|s| > 1) and provides the basis for the linear approximation in equation 7.10b when selection is weak.

formula-notes:formula_7.10b:en.plainMeaning: This formula approximates the fixation probability u_f(p0) of an allele with additive fitness effect s, for small population-scaled selection strength (2Ne|s| ≤ 1), as a linear function of initial frequency p0. Key symbols: p0 = initial frequency, Ne = effective population size, s = selection coefficient.
formula-notes:formula_7.10b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on selection and drift at single loci to provide a simple approximation of fixation probability when selection is weak relative to drift, supporting later arguments about the balance between selection and drift in small populations.

formula-notes:formula_7.10a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算在单个位点、加性适应度效应下，等位基因a在初始频率为p0时最终被固定的概率uf(p0)，其中Ne为有效群体大小，s为选择系数。
formula-notes:formula_7.10a:zh.inThisChapter: 本章讨论单一位点的选择与漂变，该公式给出了选择与漂变共同作用下固定概率的精确近似，为后续推导小选择系数下的线性近似（7.10b）提供了基础。

formula-notes:formula_7.11:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the scaled fixation probability of a new mutation (starting frequency p0 = 1/(2N)) relative to the neutral expectation 1/(2N). It shows that this probability depends only on the composite parameter S = 4Ne s, which measures selection strength relative to drift.
formula-notes:formula_7.11:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on selection and drift to derive a simple expression for fixation probability that depends solely on S, supporting later arguments about the relative roles of selection and drift in determining allele fate.

formula-notes:formula_7.10b:zh.plainMeaning: 公式(7.10b)给出了当选择系数s很弱（2Nₑ|s| ≤ 1）时，等位基因a的最终固定概率u_f(p₀)的线性近似：它等于初始频率p₀加上一个由选择引起的修正项2Nₑ s p₀(1-p₀)，其中Nₑ为有效群体大小，s为选择系数。
formula-notes:formula_7.10b:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式紧接在(7.10a)之后，是(7.10a)在弱选择条件下的泰勒展开近似，用于简化计算并直观展示选择与漂移共同作用时固定概率的线性变化趋势。

formula-notes:formula_7.12:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the total expected heterozygosity contributed over time by a single new mutation, where N is the census population size, N_e is the effective population size, and S = 2N_e s (with s being the selection coefficient).
formula-notes:formula_7.12:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on selection and drift to quantify how selection and drift jointly affect the cumulative heterozygosity from a new mutation, supporting later arguments about the relative roles of selection versus neutral processes in maintaining genetic variation.

formula-notes:formula_7.12:zh.plainMeaning: 公式 (7.12) 计算一个新突变在最终被丢失或固定之前，对群体水平杂合度的平均累积贡献 H_T，其中 N_e 是有效群体大小，N 是实际群体大小，S = 4N_e s 是选择参数（s 为选择系数）。
formula-notes:formula_7.12:zh.inThisChapter: 本章讨论单基因座上的选择和漂变，该公式出现在 Kimura 的讨论中，用于量化突变在漂变和选择共同作用下的累积杂合度贡献，为后续比较不同选择强度下的遗传多样性提供定量基础。

formula-notes:formula_7.13a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算在给定选择系数S和有效群体大小Ne下，一个新突变（加性效应）最终固定时，在频率x处停留的期望世代数Φf(x)。关键符号：Ne为有效群体大小，S=2Nes为尺度化选择系数，N为实际群体大小，x为突变等位基因频率。
formula-notes:formula_7.13a:zh.inThisChapter: 本章讨论单基因座上的选择和漂变，该公式用于描述突变在固定过程中频率的期望驻留时间分布，为后续比较不同选择强度下固定时间、以及推导固定概率等提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_7.13a:en.plainMeaning: This formula gives the expected number of generations that a newly arisen mutation with additive effects, destined for fixation, spends at a given frequency x. Key symbols: Φ_f(x) = expected residence time at frequency x, N_e = effective population size, N = census population size, S = 2N_e s (scaled selection coefficient), s = selection coefficient, x = mutant frequency.
formula-notes:formula_7.13a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on selection and drift at single loci to quantify the sojourn time of beneficial mutations conditional on fixation, supporting later arguments about the distribution of allele frequencies and the probability of fixation under weak selection.

formula-notes:formula_7.13b:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the unconditional mean residence time Φ(x) for a mutant allele at frequency x, given effective population size Ne, actual size N, and scaled selection coefficient S = 2Nes. It connects the expected time a mutation spends at each frequency, regardless of eventual fixation or loss.
formula-notes:formula_7.13b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on selection and drift at single loci to provide the unconditional residence time, which is then decomposed via Equation 7.13c into conditional components for fixed and lost mutations, supporting later analysis of mutation dynamics.

formula-notes:formula_7.13c:en.plainMeaning: This formula decomposes the unconditional mean residence time Φ(x) into a weighted average of the mean residence times conditional on fixation (Φ_f(x)) and on loss (Φ_l(x)), with weights given by the fixation probability u_f(1/2N) and its complement.
formula-notes:formula_7.13c:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on selection and drift to derive the conditional mean residence time for loss Φ_l(x) from the unconditional Φ(x) and the known fixation probability, supporting later analysis of allele dynamics under selection.

formula-notes:formula_7.13c:zh.plainMeaning: 公式(7.13c)将任意初始频率x的突变体的平均滞留时间Φ(x)分解为两个条件平均滞留时间的加权和：以概率u_f(1/(2N))最终固定的突变体的Φ_f(x)，和以概率1-u_f(1/(2N))最终丢失的突变体的Φ_l(x)。
formula-notes:formula_7.13c:zh.inThisChapter: 在“单基因座的选择与漂变”章节中，公式(7.13c)利用固定概率u_f(1/(2N))将无条件平均滞留时间Φ(x)（公式7.13b）分解为条件分量，从而为后续推导条件平均滞留时间Φ_l(x)（公式7.13d）提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_7.13d:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the conditional sojourn time density Φ_l(x) for a mutant allele destined to be lost, given its current frequency x, under selection (S=2N_es) and drift in a diploid population of size N with effective size N_e. Key symbols: N (census size), N_e (effective size), S (scaled selection coefficient), x (allele frequency).
formula-notes:formula_7.13d:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on selection and drift at single loci to provide the residual time distribution for alleles that will eventually be lost, which is used together with the fixation component (Φ_f) in Equation 7.13c to obtain the unconditional sojourn time density Φ(x).

formula-notes:formula_7.13b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算突变在种群中的无条件平均驻留时间Φ(x)，即突变等位基因频率为x的平均时间，其中Ne为有效种群大小，N为实际种群大小，S=4Nes为选择系数，x为突变频率。
formula-notes:formula_7.13b:zh.inThisChapter: 本章讨论单个位点上的选择和漂变，公式(7.13b)给出了突变在固定或丢失前的平均驻留时间，为后续推导条件驻留时间Φ_f(x)和Φ_l(x)提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_7.13d:zh.plainMeaning: 公式(7.13d)计算的是在等位基因最终丢失的条件下，突变等位基因在群体中频率为x的驻留时间密度Φ_l(x)，其中S=2N_es为选择系数，N_e为有效群体大小，N为实际群体大小。
formula-notes:formula_7.13d:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在“单基因座上的选择与漂变”章节，由(7.13c)分解得到，用于描述最终丢失的等位基因的频率分布，为后续计算固定概率和驻留时间提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_7.14a:en.plainMeaning: This formula gives the approximate average time (in generations) that an effectively neutral mutation destined to loss spends at frequency x, where Ne is effective population size, N is census size, λ = 1 - 1/(2N), and x is the mutant frequency.
formula-notes:formula_7.14a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to the interaction of selection, mutation, and drift to quantify the residence time for nearly neutral mutations, supporting later arguments about the balance between these forces and the behavior of mutations with small selection coefficients.

formula-notes:formula_7.14a:zh.plainMeaning: 公式 (7.14a) 近似计算了在有效群体大小 Ne、实际群体大小 N 和突变率参数 λ 下，一个注定丢失的有效中性突变在频率 x 附近停留的平均时间 Φ_l(x)，其中 λ = 1 - 1/(2N)。
formula-notes:formula_7.14a:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在讨论选择、突变和漂变相互作用的章节引言中，为后续分析有效中性突变的命运提供时间尺度，并与无条件停留时间公式 (7.14b) 对比，突出条件（丢失）对停留时间分布的影响。

formula-notes:formula_7.14b:en.plainMeaning: This formula gives the unconditional residence time Φ(x) that a neutral or nearly neutral allele spends in frequency class x, showing it is inversely proportional to x. The key symbols are Φ(x) (average time in class x), Nₑ (effective population size), N (census population size), and x (allele frequency).
formula-notes:formula_7.14b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on interaction of selection, mutation, and drift to quantify the expected time an allele spends at different frequencies under neutrality, supporting later arguments about the behavior of effectively neutral mutations when |S| < 1.

formula-notes:formula_7.14b:zh.plainMeaning: 公式 (7.14b) 近似计算一个中性或近中性突变在最终固定或丢失前，在频率区间 x 附近停留的平均时间 Φ(x)，它与当前频率 x 成反比，比例系数为有效群体大小 Ne 与总群体大小 N 的比值。
formula-notes:formula_7.14b:zh.inThisChapter: 在介绍选择、突变和漂变相互作用的章节中，该公式与 (7.14a) 共同给出了突变在频率空间中的驻留时间分布，为后续推导固定概率和分子进化速率提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_7.15:zh.plainMeaning: 公式 (7.15) 计算在有效群体大小为 Ne、实际群体大小为 N、突变率为 λ 的条件下，一个中性突变在固定前被丢失的条件平均时间 t_l，其中关键符号 t_l 表示丢失时间，Ne 是有效群体大小，N 是实际群体大小，λ 是突变率。
formula-notes:formula_7.15:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在讨论选择、突变和漂变相互作用的章节中，用于量化中性突变在漂变作用下丢失的时间尺度，为后续比较有效中性等位基因与有害或有利突变的固定时间提供基准。

formula-notes:formula_7.16:en.plainMeaning: This formula estimates the mean number of generations (t_l) until a new deleterious mutation (with heterozygous effect s<0 and scaled strength |S| = 4N_e|s| >> 1) is completely lost from the population, given effective population size N_e and actual population size N.
formula-notes:formula_7.16:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to quantify how long a deleterious mutation persists under selection and drift, supporting later discussions on the balance between mutation, selection, and drift.

formula-notes:formula_7.15:en.plainMeaning: This formula gives the expected time to loss of a neutral mutation, where t_l is the time in generations, N_e is the effective population size, N is the census population size, and λ is the mutation rate per generation.
formula-notes:formula_7.15:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to show how selection, mutation, and drift interact, specifically contrasting the fixation time of effectively neutral alleles (4N_e) with the loss time of neutral mutations, supporting later discussions on the dynamics of nearly neutral mutations.

formula-notes:formula_7.17b:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the expected total number of neutral mutations segregating in a population at equilibrium, where N_e is the effective population size and λ is the mutation rate per generation.
formula-notes:formula_7.17b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to selection, mutation, and drift to provide a baseline neutral expectation for the number of segregating sites, which later arguments compare to cases with selection.

formula-notes:formula_7.16:zh.plainMeaning: 公式(7.16)计算一个具有有害杂合效应(s<0)的新突变最终被完全丢失的平均世代数t_l，其中N_e为有效种群大小，N为实际种群大小，S=4N_es（s为选择系数），|S|远大于1。
formula-notes:formula_7.16:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在介绍选择、突变和漂变相互作用的章节，用于量化有害突变在种群中存留的时间，为后续讨论突变负荷和分子进化速率提供理论基础。

formula-notes:formula_7.17a:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the expected total number of individuals affected by a mutation (i.e., the sum of its frequency over time until loss or fixation), where Φ(y/2N) is the probability that the mutation reaches frequency y/(2N) and y is the number of copies.
formula-notes:formula_7.17a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to selection, mutation, and drift to define a key quantity for evaluating the impact of mutations, and it supports later arguments by providing the basis for conditional expectations given loss or fixation (Equations 7.17b–7.17d).

formula-notes:formula_7.17c:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the expected number of neutral mutations that ultimately become fixed in a population, where N_e is the effective population size, N is the census population size, and λ is the mutation rate per generation.
formula-notes:formula_7.17c:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to the interaction of selection, mutation, and drift to quantify the long-term contribution of neutral mutations to genetic variation, supporting later arguments about the relative roles of these forces in molecular evolution.

formula-notes:formula_7.17b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算中性突变下群体中突变基因的平均数量，其中N_e为有效群体大小，λ为每代每基因座突变率，乘积4N_eλ即为平均突变基因数。
formula-notes:formula_7.17b:zh.inThisChapter: 在讨论选择、突变和漂变相互作用时，该公式给出了中性突变在平衡状态下的期望数量，为后续比较有选择时突变基因的固定或丢失条件期望（如7.17c和7.17d）提供中性基准。

formula-notes:formula_7.17a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算一个突变等位基因在最终丢失或固定之前，在群体中出现的总个体数的期望值。其中，Φ(y/2N) 是突变等位基因频率为 y/(2N) 时的概率密度函数，y 是携带该等位基因的个体数，求和从 y=1 到 2N-1。
formula-notes:formula_7.17a:zh.inThisChapter: 此公式出现在“选择、突变和漂变的相互作用”章节的引言部分，用于定义突变等位基因在群体中存续的总个体数期望值，为后续分别计算条件于丢失或固定的期望个体数（通过替换 Φ 为 Φ_l 或 Φ_f）以及推导中性突变下的具体表达式（公式7.17b-7.17d）提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_7.17c:zh.plainMeaning: 公式7.17c计算的是最终被固定（fixation）的中性突变位点的期望数量，其中N_e是有效种群大小，N是实际种群大小，λ是每代每个位点的突变率，乘积4N_e N λ给出了在固定状态下期望的中性突变数。
formula-notes:formula_7.17c:zh.inThisChapter: 在讨论选择、突变和漂变相互作用的章节中，该公式用于区分最终固定和最终丢失的突变数量，为后续比较不同选择强度下的固定概率提供基准。

formula-notes:formula_7.17d:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the expected number of neutral mutations that are destined to be lost from the population, where n̄_l is the expected number of such mutations, N_e is the effective population size, and λ is the mutation rate per generation.
formula-notes:formula_7.17d:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to the interaction of selection, mutation, and drift to contrast with the unconditional expectation (7.17b) and the expectation conditional on fixation (7.17c), showing that most neutral mutations are lost.

formula-notes:formula_7.17d:zh.plainMeaning: 公式7.17d计算的是在突变仅通过遗传漂变最终丢失的条件下，一个位点上每代新产生的中性突变体的期望数目，其中N_e是有效种群大小，λ是每代每个位点的突变率。
formula-notes:formula_7.17d:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在介绍选择、突变和漂变相互作用的章节，与7.17b（无条件期望）和7.17c（固定条件下的期望）并列，共同展示不同条件（无条件、固定、丢失）下期望突变数的表达式，为后续推导固定概率和分子进化速率奠定基础。

formula-notes:formula_7.18b:zh.plainMeaning: 公式 G(x) = -4N_e s x (h - x) 定义了指数积分中的核函数，其中 N_e 是有效群体大小，s 是选择系数，h 是显性度，x 是等位基因 A 的频率。
formula-notes:formula_7.18b:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在推导固定概率的积分表达式中，作为指数项的核心部分，用于量化选择对等位基因频率轨迹的影响，为后续通过积分计算固定概率提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_7.18a:en.plainMeaning: This formula gives the fixation probability of a beneficial allele A starting at initial frequency p0, under selection (s) and dominance (h), using diffusion theory. The key symbols are uf (fixation probability), p0 (initial frequency), s (selection coefficient), h (dominance coefficient), Ne (effective population size), and G(x) (a function of allele frequency x).
formula-notes:formula_7.18a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on selection and drift at single loci to quantify how selection and dominance interact with genetic drift to determine the fate of a new mutation. This formula supports later arguments about the probability of fixation under different dominance scenarios and effective population size.

formula-notes:formula_7.18b:en.plainMeaning: G(x) is the exponent in the integrand of the fixation probability formula, where x is the allele frequency, Ne is effective population size, s is selection coefficient, and h is dominance coefficient.
formula-notes:formula_7.18b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on selection and drift to define the integrand for the fixation probability, supporting the derivation of how selection and drift jointly affect allele fixation.

formula-notes:formula_7.18a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算等位基因A在初始频率为p0时的固定概率，近似为从0到p0的积分除以从0到1的积分，其中被积函数包含指数项e^{G(x)}，G(x)由公式(7.18b)定义，依赖于有效群体大小Ne、选择系数s和显性系数h。
formula-notes:formula_7.18a:zh.inThisChapter: 在讨论单个位点选择与漂变的章节中，该公式利用扩散理论给出了考虑显性时固定概率的近似解，为后续理解不同显性程度下选择与漂变的相互作用提供定量基础。

formula-notes:formula_7.19a:en.plainMeaning: This formula gives the approximate fixation probability of a new mutant (initial frequency 1/(2N)) with selective advantage sh and effective population size Ne, accounting for dominance. Key symbols: u_f (fixation probability), N (census size), Ne (effective size), s (selection coefficient), h (dominance coefficient).
formula-notes:formula_7.19a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on selection and drift to quantify how selection and population size interact to determine fixation probability, supporting later arguments about the relative roles of drift and selection in molecular evolution.

formula-notes:formula_7.19a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算一个初始频率为 p0 = 1/(2N) 的新突变（单拷贝）在随机交配和部分显性条件下最终被固定的概率 u_f，其中 N 为种群大小，N_e 为有效种群大小，s 为选择系数，h 为显性度。
formula-notes:formula_7.19a:zh.inThisChapter: 本章讨论单个位点上的选择与漂变，该公式为后续推导（如公式 7.19b）提供基础，用于比较不同显性程度下突变固定概率的差异。

formula-notes:formula_7.19b:en.plainMeaning: This formula approximates the fixation probability u_f of a completely recessive beneficial allele starting from a single copy (initial frequency 1/(2N)) under strong positive selection (4N_e s >> 1). Key symbols: N = census population size, N_e = effective population size, s = selection coefficient.
formula-notes:formula_7.19b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on selection and drift at single loci to provide a simple approximation for fixation probability when selection is strong and the allele is recessive, supporting later arguments about the conditions under which recessive beneficial alleles can become fixed despite being initially rare.

formula-notes:formula_7.20a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算在近交（f>0）条件下，选择对等位基因频率变化的影响函数G(x)，其中x为等位基因频率，s为选择系数，h为显性度，f为偏离哈代-温伯格平衡的度量。
formula-notes:formula_7.20a:zh.inThisChapter: 本章讨论单基因座上的选择和漂变，公式7.20a扩展了公式7.18a，引入近交系数f以处理近亲交配导致的基因型频率偏离，为后续推导固定概率和平衡频率提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_7.20a:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the deterministic change in allele frequency G(x) under selection with direct inbreeding, where N_e is effective population size, s is selection coefficient, f measures deviation from Hardy-Weinberg proportions, h is dominance coefficient, and x is allele frequency.
formula-notes:formula_7.20a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in this section to extend the basic selection-drift model (Equation 7.18a) to account for additional inbreeding from close relatives, supporting later analysis of how inbreeding affects fixation probabilities and effective population size.

formula-notes:formula_7.19b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算在完全隐性等位基因纯合子受强正选择（4N_e s ≫ 1）时，从单个拷贝（初始频率1/(2N)）出发的固定概率u_f，近似等于√(4N_e s/π)除以N。关键符号：N为种群大小，N_e为有效种群大小，s为选择系数。
formula-notes:formula_7.19b:zh.inThisChapter: 本章讨论单个位点上的选择与漂变，公式7.19b是对方程7.18a在强选择条件下的简化近似，为后续分析隐性有利突变的固定概率提供了易于计算的表达式。

formula-notes:formula_7.20b:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the fixation probability of a new mutation (initial frequency 1/(2N)) in a population with inbreeding, where Ne is the effective population size, s is the selection coefficient, f is the inbreeding coefficient, and h is the dominance coefficient.
formula-notes:formula_7.20b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on selection and drift at single loci to extend the fixation probability to populations with inbreeding, supporting later arguments about how inbreeding affects the efficiency of selection.

formula-notes:formula_7.20b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算在近交系数为f的群体中，初始频率为1/(2N)的突变等位基因的固定概率，其中关键符号：N为实际种群大小，Ne为有效种群大小，s为选择系数，h为显性度。
formula-notes:formula_7.20b:zh.inThisChapter: 本章讨论选择和漂移在单个位点上的相互作用，此公式将固定概率从理想群体推广到近交群体，为后续比较不同近交水平下的固定概率提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_7.20c:zh.plainMeaning: 公式7.20c计算在完全隐性突变（h=0）且初始频率为1/(2N)时，突变基因最终被固定的概率u_f，近似等于4N_e f s除以N，其中N_e为有效群体大小，f为近交系数，s为选择系数，N为实际群体大小。
formula-notes:formula_7.20c:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在“单一位点的选择与漂变”章节，是公式7.20a和7.20b在完全隐性情况下的特例，用于简化计算并强调近交对固定概率的影响，为后续讨论近交与选择相互作用提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_7.20c:en.plainMeaning: This formula approximates the fixation probability of a completely recessive beneficial mutation (h=0) in a population of size N, where the effective population size is Ne, the selection coefficient is s, and the mutation frequency is 1/(2N). It shows that the fixation probability is proportional to 4Ne f s / N.
formula-notes:formula_7.20c:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on selection and drift at single loci to provide a simplified expression for the fixation probability of recessive mutations, supporting later arguments about the efficiency of selection in finite populations and the role of effective population size.

formula-notes:formula_7.21:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the fixation probability of a new beneficial mutation (starting at frequency 1/(2N)) in a subdivided population, where u_f is the fixation probability, N_e is effective metapopulation size, N is total metapopulation size, s is selection coefficient, h is dominance coefficient, and F_ST is the index of population subdivision.
formula-notes:formula_7.21:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on selection and drift at single loci to show how population subdivision (F_ST) reduces the effective selection coefficient, supporting the argument that structured populations have lower fixation probabilities than panmictic ones.

formula-notes:formula_7.22:en.plainMeaning: This formula approximates the fixation probability u_f(1/(2N)) of a new mutation with initial frequency 1/(2N) under selection (s) and drift, where N_e is effective population size, N is census size, and erf is the error function.
formula-notes:formula_7.22:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on selection and drift at single loci to quantify how selection and drift interact at a single locus, supporting later arguments about the conditions under which selection dominates over drift.

formula-notes:formula_7.23:en.plainMeaning: The error function erf(x) computes the integral of the Gaussian function from 0 to x, scaled so that erf(∞)=1. It gives the probability that a standard normal variable falls within [-x, x].
formula-notes:formula_7.23:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the expression for the fixation probability u_f(1/2N) to account for the cumulative effect of selection and drift, allowing simplification when N_e s is small.

formula-notes:formula_7.21:zh.plainMeaning: 公式 (7.21) 计算在亚种群结构下，一个初始频率为 1/(2N) 的新有益突变最终在全局固定的概率 u_f，其中 N_e 是有效种群大小，N 是总种群大小，s 是选择系数，h 是显性度，F_ST 是种群分化指数。
formula-notes:formula_7.21:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在“单基因座上的选择与漂变”章节，用于说明种群结构如何通过 F_ST 影响有益突变的固定概率，为后续讨论亚种群间基因流和局部适应提供定量基础。

formula-notes:formula_7.23:zh.plainMeaning: 误差函数 erf(x) 计算从 0 到 x 对高斯核 e^{-y^2} 的积分，再乘以 2/√π 归一化，结果表示标准正态分布在区间 [-x, x] 内的概率。
formula-notes:formula_7.23:zh.inThisChapter: 公式 (7.22) 中 erf(√(N_e s)) 用于修正弱选择下固定概率的近似，因为当 N_e s 较小时 erf 近似线性，从而简化 u_f(1/2N) 的表达式。

formula-notes:formula_7.22:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式近似计算在杂合子适合度降低s、有效群体大小Ne、实际群体大小N时，一个初始频率为1/(2N)的有害突变最终被固定的概率uf。关键符号：s为选择系数，Ne为有效群体大小，N为实际群体大小，erf为误差函数。
formula-notes:formula_7.22:zh.inThisChapter: 本章讨论单基因座上的选择与漂变，该公式出现在推导固定概率的近似表达式部分，为后续比较选择与漂变的相对效率提供定量工具。

formula-notes:formula_7.24:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式给出了一个初始频率为1/(2N)的等位基因在强选择（N_e s > 2）下最终被固定的概率近似值，其中N_e是有效种群大小，s是选择系数，N是实际种群大小。
formula-notes:formula_7.24:zh.inThisChapter: 在7.3节中，公式(7.24)是公式(7.23)在强选择条件下的简化，用于展示当选择效率高时，有害等位基因（s<0）的固定概率随N_e s指数衰减，为后续讨论选择与漂变的平衡提供定量依据。

formula-notes:formula_7.24:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the fixation probability of a new mutation with initial frequency 1/(2N) under strong positive selection (N_e s > 2). The key symbols are: u_f (fixation probability), N (census population size), N_e (effective population size), s (selection coefficient).
formula-notes:formula_7.24:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on selection and drift at single loci to quantify the fixation probability when selection is efficient, contrasting with the neutral case u_f ≈ 1/(2N). It supports later arguments about the limits of selection efficacy and the threshold N_e s > 2 for detectable selection.

formula-notes:formula_7.25:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算在初始频率为1/(2N)时，一个具有杂合子劣势（underdominance）的等位基因最终被固定的概率，其中关键参数θ=Ne s衡量选择强度，ω=1+t/(2s)衡量瓶颈的宽度。
formula-notes:formula_7.25:zh.inThisChapter: 它出现在第7.4节，用于分析经过适应性瓶颈后，underdominant等位基因的固定概率如何影响群体平均适应度的增加，为后续讨论瓶颈在群体分化中的作用提供定量基础。

formula-notes:formula_7.25:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the fixation probability of an underdominant allele starting at initial frequency 1/(2N), given effective population size Ne, selection coefficient s, and a parameter t related to the fitness bottleneck. Key symbols: u_f(1/(2N)) = fixation probability from initial frequency 1/(2N); θ = Ne s; ω = 1 + t/(2s); erf = error function.
formula-notes:formula_7.25:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on selection and drift at single loci to model the effect of a fitness bottleneck on the fixation of underdominant alleles, supporting the argument that such bottlenecks can increase mean population fitness by facilitating the fixation of underdominant alleles.

formula-notes:formula_7.26:en.plainMeaning: This inequality gives a condition on the effective population size (N_e^*) such that a selected allele is unlikely to drift to its equilibrium frequency (p̂). The symbols are: N_e^* = effective population size, t = dominance coefficient, s = selection coefficient.
formula-notes:formula_7.26:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on selection and drift to quantify when deterministic selection dominates over random drift, supporting the argument that drift can be ignored if N_e^* is sufficiently large relative to s and t.

formula-notes:formula_7.26:zh.plainMeaning: 该不等式给出了有效种群大小Ne*的一个下界，其中t和s分别代表选择系数和突变率，当Ne*大于(t+2s)/s^2时，等位基因几乎不可能通过漂变达到平衡频率p̂。
formula-notes:formula_7.26:zh.inThisChapter: 在本节关于单基因座选择和漂变的讨论中，该公式用于界定漂变效应可忽略的条件，从而为后续推导选择主导的等位基因动态提供阈值依据。

formula-notes:formula_7.27:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the expected per-generation change in allele frequency due to additive selection, accounting for drift in a finite population. Key symbols: E(Δp_j) is expected change in generation j, s is selection coefficient, p_j is allele frequency at generation j, p_0 is initial frequency, N_e is effective population size.
formula-notes:formula_7.27:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on selection and drift to quantify how selection's effect diminishes over time due to drift, supporting later arguments about the relative importance of selection versus drift in finite populations.

formula-notes:formula_7.28a:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the expected allele frequency after t generations of selection and drift, starting from p0, where s is the selection coefficient and Ne is the effective population size. The key symbols are E(p_t) (expected frequency at generation t), p0 (initial frequency), s (selection coefficient), Ne (effective population size), and t (number of generations).
formula-notes:formula_7.28a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in this section to show how selection and drift jointly affect allele frequency over time, supporting later arguments about the probability of fixation and the balance between selection and drift in finite populations.

formula-notes:formula_7.27:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算在加性选择下，第j代等位基因频率变化Δp_j的期望值。它近似等于选择系数s乘以期望杂合度E[p_j(1-p_j)]，而后者又等于初始杂合度p_0(1-p_0)乘以(1-1/(2N_e))^j，其中N_e为有效群体大小。
formula-notes:formula_7.27:zh.inThisChapter: 此公式出现在“单一位点的选择与漂变”章节，用于量化在有限群体中，选择与遗传漂变共同作用下等位基因频率变化的期望轨迹。它通过引入漂变对杂合度衰减的影响（来自中性理论），为后续比较选择与漂变的相对强度提供定量基础。

formula-notes:formula_7.28b:en.plainMeaning: This formula approximates the sum of a geometric series (with ratio 1 - 1/(2N_e)) from j=0 to t, yielding 2N_e (1 - e^{-t/(2N_e)}). It connects the effective population size N_e and time t.
formula-notes:formula_7.28b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on selection and drift to simplify the summation in Equation 7.28a, which models the expected allele frequency change under selection and drift over t generations.

formula-notes:formula_7.28b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将求和式 ∑_{j=0}^{t} (1 - 1/(2N_e))^j 近似为 2N_e (1 - e^{-t/(2N_e)})，其中 N_e 是有效群体大小，t 是世代数。
formula-notes:formula_7.28b:zh.inThisChapter: 它出现在公式 7.28a 的推导中，用于简化等位基因频率随时间变化的表达式，为后续讨论选择与漂变的联合效应提供解析近似。

formula-notes:formula_7.29:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the expected frequency of allele A at time t, given initial frequency p0, effective population size Ne, selection coefficient s, and dominance coefficient h. It accounts for both additive and dominance effects on allele frequency change under weak selection and drift.
formula-notes:formula_7.29:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on selection and drift to provide a more general approximation for expected allele frequency when dominance is present, extending the neutral or additive models. It supports later arguments about how dominance influences the probability of fixation and the dynamics of selected alleles in finite populations.

formula-notes:formula_7.28a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算在自然选择和遗传漂变共同作用下，经过t代后等位基因频率的期望值E(p_t)。它从初始频率p_0出发，累加每代频率变化的期望E(Δp_j)，并近似为p_0加上一个与选择系数s、有效群体大小N_e和初始杂合度p_0(1-p_0)有关的项，最后用指数函数表示。
formula-notes:formula_7.28a:zh.inThisChapter: 本章讨论单个位点上的选择和漂变，公式(7.28a)将之前推导的每代期望变化（如公式7.8）累积起来，得到多代后的期望频率，为后续比较确定性选择和随机漂变的效果提供定量基础。

formula-notes:formula_7.29:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算在自然选择（选择系数s、显性度h）和遗传漂变（有效群体大小Ne）共同作用下，经过t代后等位基因A的期望频率E(p_t)，近似等于初始频率p0加上一个修正项，该修正项包含两个指数衰减项，分别对应漂变和选择-漂变相互作用。
formula-notes:formula_7.29:zh.inThisChapter: 本章讨论单个位点上的选择和漂变，公式7.29是在7.23（纯漂变期望）基础上引入选择效应，为后续推导等位基因频率的稳态分布和固定概率提供近似解析表达式。

formula-notes:formula_7.30:en.plainMeaning: This formula approximates the probability of fixation u_f(p0) of an allele with initial frequency p0, under weak selection (s) and arbitrary dominance (h), in a population of effective size Ne. It shows that fixation probability deviates from neutrality (p0) due to selection and dominance.
formula-notes:formula_7.30:en.inThisChapter: It appears in this section to provide a closed-form approximation for fixation probability under weak selection, supporting later arguments about the interplay of selection and drift in finite populations.

formula-notes:formula_7.31a:en.plainMeaning: This formula gives the equilibrium probability density of the frequency x of the advantageous A allele under selection, mutation, and drift, where φ(x) is the density, C is a normalization constant, W̄ is mean fitness, Ne is effective population size, v is mutation rate from A to a, μ is mutation rate from a to A, and x is the allele frequency between 0 and 1.
formula-notes:formula_7.31a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to the interaction of selection, mutation, and drift to present Wright's equilibrium distribution, which supports later arguments about the combined effects of these forces on allele frequency distributions.

formula-notes:formula_7.30:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式近似计算在弱选择（s小）和任意显性度（h）下，等位基因从初始频率p0最终被固定的概率uf(p0)，它等于p0加上一个由有效群体大小Ne、选择系数s、初始频率p0和显性参数h共同决定的修正项。
formula-notes:formula_7.30:zh.inThisChapter: 本章讨论单基因座上的选择和漂变，公式7.30由7.29取t→∞极限得到，为后续比较不同显性模式下固定概率的差异提供解析近似，并铺垫弱选择下固定概率与中性情况（p0）的偏离程度。

formula-notes:formula_7.31a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式给出了在正向突变率v和反向突变率μ下，有利等位基因A在平衡时的概率密度函数φ(x)，其中x是A的频率，C是归一化常数，使得密度积分为1。
formula-notes:formula_7.31a:zh.inThisChapter: 此公式出现在选择、突变和漂变相互作用的章节，为后续推导平衡分布的具体形式（如公式7.31b）提供基础，并用于理解突变-选择平衡下的等位基因频率分布。

formula-notes:formula_7.31b:en.plainMeaning: This formula approximates the expected frequency distribution of a polymorphic allele, φ(x), when mutation rates are very small (< 1/(4Nₑ)). It shows that φ(x) is proportional to C * W̄^(2Nₑ) divided by x(1-x), where C is a normalization constant, W̄ is mean fitness, Nₑ is effective population size, and x is the allele frequency.
formula-notes:formula_7.31b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to the interaction of selection, mutation, and drift to simplify the general formula (7.31a) under weak mutation. This simplification supports later arguments that when mutation is weak, the allele frequency distribution conditioned on polymorphism becomes independent of mutation rates and bias, focusing attention on selection and drift.

formula-notes:formula_7.31b:zh.plainMeaning: 公式 (7.31b) 近似表示，当突变率远小于 1/(4N_e) 时，条件等位基因频率 φ(x) 正比于 C * (平均适合度 W̄)^(2N_e) 除以 x(1-x)，其中 C 是归一化常数，x 是等位基因频率，W̄ 是平均适合度，N_e 是有效群体大小。
formula-notes:formula_7.31b:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在“选择、突变和漂变的相互作用”章节中，用于说明在弱突变压力下，多态位点的期望等位基因频率分布与突变率和突变偏向无关，为后续讨论中性或弱选择下的等位基因频谱提供了简化形式。

formula-notes:formula_7.32:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算在突变-选择-漂变平衡下，群体固定最优等位基因A的时间比例与固定次优等位基因a的时间比例之比，等于反向突变率v与正向突变率μ之比乘以e的S次方，其中S=4N_e s。
formula-notes:formula_7.32:zh.inThisChapter: 本章引入突变、选择和漂变的相互作用，此公式给出了在稳定状态下固定概率的比值，为后续推导等位基因频率的稳态分布和比较不同进化力相对强度提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_7.33:zh.plainMeaning: 公式(7.33)计算多态位点的平衡比例，即群体中位点处于多态状态的时间比例，它等于2N乘以两个固定类别的贡献之和：固定为A的位点通过突变产生a并持续平均时间t̄a的贡献，加上固定为a的位点通过突变产生A并持续平均时间t̄A的贡献。
formula-notes:formula_7.33:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在“选择、突变和漂变的相互作用”章节的引言部分，用于近似处理频率边界x=0和1处的异常行为，通过将多态时间比例与固定类别的平均滞留时间联系起来，为后续推导平衡多态性水平提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_7.35:en.plainMeaning: This formula gives the variance in allele frequency σ²(p) under selection, mutation, and drift, where p̃ is the equilibrium frequency, Nₑ is the effective population size, h is the dominance coefficient, and s is the selection coefficient.
formula-notes:formula_7.35:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to quantify the stochastic fluctuation around the deterministic equilibrium, supporting later arguments about the balance between selection and drift in maintaining genetic variation.

formula-notes:formula_7.34:en.plainMeaning: This formula gives the equilibrium probability density of the frequency x of a beneficial allele under selection, mutation, and drift, where C is a normalizing constant, N_e is effective population size, s is selection coefficient, and μ is mutation rate to the beneficial allele.
formula-notes:formula_7.34:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to the interaction of selection, mutation, and drift to provide a classic result (Wright 1938b) that extends the neutral theory to include selection, supporting later discussions of the balance between these forces.

formula-notes:formula_7.33:en.plainMeaning: This formula approximates the equilibrium proportion of polymorphic sites (\widetilde{P}_{p}) as 2N times the sum of contributions from mutations to allele a (\widetilde{P}_{A} μ \bar{t}_a) and to allele A (\widetilde{P}_{a} ν \bar{t}_A), where N is population size, μ and ν are mutation rates, \bar{t}_a and \bar{t}_A are mean sojourn times of mutations to a and A, and \widetilde{P}_{A} and \widetilde{P}_{a} are equilibrium frequencies of fixed classes.
formula-notes:formula_7.33:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to the interaction of selection, mutation, and drift to provide an approximation for the equilibrium proportion of polymorphic sites, supporting later arguments about the balance between these forces and the behavior at absorbing boundaries.

formula-notes:formula_7.35:zh.plainMeaning: 公式(7.35)计算在突变-选择-漂变平衡下，等位基因频率p的方差σ²(p)，其中p̃是平衡频率，Ne是有效群体大小，h是杂合子优势系数，s是选择系数。
formula-notes:formula_7.35:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在讨论选择、突变和漂变相互作用的章节，用于量化当选择强度足够大（2Nehs >> 1）时，漂变对平衡频率的扰动程度，为后续推导等位基因频率的稳态分布提供方差参数。

formula-notes:formula_7.36:en.plainMeaning: This formula gives the joint stationary distribution of four allele frequencies (x1, x2, x3, x4) under selection, mutation, and drift, where C is a normalizing constant, \overline{W} is mean fitness, Ne is effective population size, and μ is the mutation rate.
formula-notes:formula_7.36:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to show how the trivariate distribution simplifies under symmetric mutation, supporting later analysis of the balance between selection, mutation, and drift.

formula-notes:formula_7.36:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式给出了在突变率μ相同、选择系数s_i弱加性条件下，四个等位基因频率x1,x2,x3,x4的联合平衡分布φ，其中C为归一化常数，W̄为平均群体适应度，Ne为有效群体大小。
formula-notes:formula_7.36:zh.inThisChapter: 本章引入选择、突变和漂变的相互作用，公式7.36是7.31a在对称突变率下的简化结果，为后续推导多等位基因位点的平衡性质提供解析形式。

formula-notes:formula_7.37:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the expected frequency of the optimal nucleotide (P̃_opt) as a function of the ratio of mutation rates (v/μ) and the selection coefficient S, where v is the mutation rate to the optimal state, μ is the total mutation rate away from it, and S is the selection advantage.
formula-notes:formula_7.37:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to show how selection, mutation, and drift interact to determine the equilibrium frequency of the optimal allele, supporting later arguments about the balance between these forces in finite populations.

formula-notes:formula_7.37:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式近似计算在突变-选择平衡下最优核苷酸的期望频率，其中 v 是向最优状态的突变率，μ 是最优状态向其他状态的突变率，S 是选择系数。
formula-notes:formula_7.37:zh.inThisChapter: 本章讨论选择、突变和漂变的相互作用，此公式从式(7.32)推导而来，为后续分析平衡频率对参数变化的敏感性提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_7.38:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the equilibrium probability that allele i is fixed (or nearly so), where S_i = 4N_e s_i is the scaled selection coefficient, T is the sum of exponentials over all n alleles, and the result is independent of mutation rate.
formula-notes:formula_7.38:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to show that under metric mutation (μ = v), the equilibrium allele frequencies follow a Boltzmann-like distribution, supporting the later argument that mutation rate does not affect the relative probabilities of fixation among alleles.

formula-notes:formula_7.39:en.plainMeaning: This formula gives the stationary probability distribution of allele count i under mutation, selection, and drift, where v is mutation rate to beneficial alleles, μ is mutation rate away, S_i = 4N_e e^{-ki} is the scaled selection coefficient, and T normalizes the distribution.
formula-notes:formula_7.39:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to show the stationary distribution for a model with diminishing returns epistasis, supporting later analysis of how selection, mutation, and drift interact to shape genetic variation.

formula-notes:formula_7.38:zh.plainMeaning: 公式 (7.38) 计算在突变-选择-漂变平衡下，等位基因 i 成为固定（或近乎固定）等位基因的概率，其中 S_i = 4N_e s_i 是 scaled 选择系数，T 是所有等位基因的 e^{S_i} 之和，作为归一化常数。
formula-notes:formula_7.38:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在“选择、突变和漂变的相互作用”章节的引言部分，用于说明在特定突变率（μ = v）下，平衡概率与突变率无关，为后续讨论 Sella-Hirsh 模型和 Lynch 模型的不同假设做铺垫。

formula-notes:formula_7.39:zh.plainMeaning: 公式 (7.39) 计算在突变-选择-漂变平衡下，等位基因拷贝数 i 的稳态概率 p̃_i，其中分子是 (v/μ)^i e^{-S_i}，分母 T 是归一化常数（所有可能 i 的分子之和）。
formula-notes:formula_7.39:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在引入选择、突变和漂变相互作用的章节，为后续推导有限等位基因模型下的稳态分布提供具体表达式，并铺垫如何通过 S_i = 4N_e e^{-ki} 将选择强度与 i 关联。

formula-notes:formula_7.40a:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the mean population fitness (W̄) at selection-mutation balance for a deleterious recessive allele, showing that the reduction in mean fitness equals the mutation rate μ, independent of the selection coefficient s. Key symbols: W̄ = mean fitness, s = selection coefficient against homozygotes, freq(aa) = frequency of recessive homozygotes, μ = mutation rate.
formula-notes:formula_7.40a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to interaction of selection, mutation, and drift to illustrate the concept of mutation load, demonstrating that the load depends only on the mutation rate, not on the strength of selection, which is a key result for understanding the impact of deleterious mutations in populations.

formula-notes:formula_7.40b:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the mean population fitness (W̄) under mutation-selection balance with complete dominance, showing that it simplifies to 1 - 2μ, where μ is the mutation rate, h is the dominance coefficient, s is the selection coefficient, and p̃ is the equilibrium allele frequency.
formula-notes:formula_7.40b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to the interaction of selection, mutation, and drift to show that the mean fitness is reduced by twice the mutation rate, setting up the concept that mutation load is independent of the selection coefficient under complete dominance.

formula-notes:formula_7.34:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式给出了在正向选择（系数s）和突变（速率μ）作用下，等位基因频率x的平衡分布φ(x)，其中关键符号C是归一化常数，N_e是有效群体大小，指数项e^{-2N_e s x^2}来自选择效应，x^{4N_e μ-1}来自突变输入，(1-x)^{-1}来自漂变。
formula-notes:formula_7.34:zh.inThisChapter: 本节引入选择、突变和漂变的联合作用，公式(7.34)是Wright平衡分布的具体形式，用于描述突变-选择平衡下等位基因频率的稳态分布，为后续讨论固定概率和杂合度等奠定基础。

formula-notes:formula_7.40a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算在有害隐性等位基因a处于选择-突变平衡时，群体的平均适应度W̄。它等于1减去纯合子aa的频率乘以选择系数s，而纯合子频率由公式7.6d给出为√(μ/s)的平方，即μ/s，因此最终W̄ = 1 - μ。
formula-notes:formula_7.40a:zh.inThisChapter: 此公式出现在讨论选择、突变和漂变相互作用的章节中，用于推导突变负荷（mutation load）的概念。它表明，当有害隐性等位基因在平衡时，群体平均适应度的降低（即负荷）仅取决于突变率μ，而与选择系数s无关，这为后续讨论负荷的独立性提供了关键推导。

formula-notes:formula_7.40b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算在突变-选择平衡下（完全显性，杂合子适合度为1-hs）的平均群体适合度W̄。首先用平衡频率p̃ = μ/(hs)代入，得到W̄ ≈ 1 - 2hs p̃ = 1 - 2μ，即平均适合度仅由突变率μ决定。
formula-notes:formula_7.40b:zh.inThisChapter: 本章讨论选择、突变和漂变的相互作用，公式7.40b通过简化平均适合度，为后续推导固定概率或平衡性质提供简洁表达式，并展示突变负荷（1 - W̄ ≈ 2μ）与显性系数h无关。

formula-notes:formula_7.41:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the frequency of the mutation-free class in the next generation (p0') as its current frequency (p0) multiplied by its relative fitness (W0=1) and the fraction that avoids new mutations (e^{-U}), divided by the mean population fitness (W̄).
formula-notes:formula_7.41:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to show how selection and mutation together change the frequency of the least-mutated class, setting up the balance equations for mutation-selection equilibrium in subsequent sections.

formula-notes:formula_7.41:zh.plainMeaning: 公式(7.41)计算了最优基因型（突变数最少）的克隆在下一代中的频率p'_0，它等于当前频率p_0乘以该克隆的相对适应度W_0（设为1）再乘以不发生突变的比例e^{-U}，然后除以种群平均适应度W̄。
formula-notes:formula_7.41:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在“选择、突变和漂变的相互作用”章节，用于描述在考虑选择（W_0/W̄）和突变（e^{-U}）时，最优基因型频率如何逐代变化，为后续推导突变-选择平衡和种群遗传结构提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_7.42a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算由固定有害突变导致的遗传负荷L，等于纯合效应2s乘以有害等位基因固定的预期时间比例(1-Ṕ_opt)，并近似为2s(μ/v)除以(1+4N_e s+μ/v)。
formula-notes:formula_7.42a:zh.inThisChapter: 本章引入选择、突变和漂变的相互作用，该公式通过近似简化了固定有害突变负荷的表达式，为后续推导平衡负荷公式(7.42b)提供基础。
