formula-notes:formula_7.42a:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the genetic load L due to recurrent deleterious mutations, where L = 2s times the probability that the deleterious allele is fixed (1 - P_opt). Key symbols: s = selection coefficient, μ = mutation rate, v = recombination rate, S = 4N_e s, N_e = effective population size.
formula-notes:formula_7.42a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to quantify the load under the joint effects of selection, mutation, and drift, and it supports the derivation of the more general load formula in Equation 7.42b.

formula-notes:formula_7.42b:en.plainMeaning: This inequality gives an upper bound for the equilibrium frequency L of a deleterious allele under mutation-selection-drift balance, where L is less than 1/(4Ne). Here Ne is the effective population size and s is the selection coefficient against the allele.
formula-notes:formula_7.42b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to interaction of selection, mutation, and drift to show that when selection is weak (S<1), the equilibrium frequency of a deleterious allele is bounded above by the neutral expectation (1/(4Ne)), highlighting the limited impact of selection in small populations.

formula-notes:formula_7.44:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the rate of establishment (r_e) of a beneficial mutation as the product of the mutation rate (2Nμ) and the fixation probability (2s N_e/N), simplifying to 4 N_e μ s, where N_e is effective population size, μ is mutation rate per locus per generation, and s is the selective advantage.
formula-notes:formula_7.44:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on two-locus fixation issues to quantify how quickly a beneficial mutation becomes established in a population, supporting later arguments about the interplay between selection and recombination in multilocus evolution.

formula-notes:formula_7.43:en.plainMeaning: This formula approximates the fixation probability of allele A at one locus, given initial frequency p0, additive selection coefficients s1 (for A) and s2 (for B), effective population size Ne, recombination rate c, and initial linkage disequilibrium D0. The term p0 + 2Ne s1 p0(1-p0) is the single-locus result (Equation 7.10b), and the last term accounts for the effect of the linked selected locus B.
formula-notes:formula_7.43:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on two-locus fixation to show how linkage and selection at a second locus modify the single-locus fixation probability. This supports later arguments about how linkage can either increase or decrease the chance of fixation compared to the single-locus case.

formula-notes:formula_7.42b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式给出了在对称突变率（μ=v）且选择系数较小（S=4Nes<1）时，有害等位基因的平衡频率L的上界，即L小于1/(4Ne)，其中Ne为有效群体大小，s为选择系数。
formula-notes:formula_7.42b:zh.inThisChapter: 本章讨论选择、突变和漂变的相互作用，公式7.42b在7.42a的基础上进一步简化，说明当选择很弱时，有害等位基因的平衡频率主要由突变和漂变决定，且不超过中性条件下的期望值1/(4Ne)，为后续讨论弱选择下的进化动态提供定量界限。

formula-notes:formula_7.44:zh.plainMeaning: 公式 (7.44) 计算的是有利突变在群体中建立（establishment）的速率 r_e，它等于每代新产生的突变数 (2Nμ) 乘以单个突变最终固定的概率 (2s N_e/N)，最终简化为 4 N_e μ s，其中 N_e 是有效群体大小，μ 是每代每个位点的突变率，s 是选择优势。
formula-notes:formula_7.44:zh.inThisChapter: 在本节“涉及两个基因座的固定问题”中，该公式用于量化在考虑连锁和重组之前，单个有利突变在有效群体大小为 N_e 时的建立速率，为后续推导两个基因座同时被选择时的固定概率提供基础速率。

formula-notes:formula_7.43:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式近似计算在两位点模型（A和B）中，等位基因A最终固定的概率u_f(p0)，其中p0是A的初始频率，D0是初始连锁不平衡，s1和s2分别是A和B的选择系数，Ne是有效群体大小，c是重组率。
formula-notes:formula_7.43:zh.inThisChapter: 本章讨论两位点固定问题，公式(7.43)将单一位点固定概率结果（公式7.10b）扩展至两位点，通过引入连锁不平衡项D0和重组率c，展示了选择与连锁对固定概率的联合影响，为后续比较两位点与单一位点近似提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_7.45:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the critical population size N* above which a beneficial double mutant (AB) is more likely to arise via stochastic tunneling than sequential fixation. N is population size, μ is mutation rate per locus per generation, and s is the selective advantage of the double mutant.
formula-notes:formula_7.45:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on two-locus fixation to quantify the threshold where the stochastic tunneling path dominates over sequential fixation, supporting the argument that adaptation can proceed via intermediate single mutants that are neutral or deleterious.

formula-notes:formula_7.45:zh.plainMeaning: 公式 (7.45) 给出了一个临界有效群体大小 N*，它等于 1 除以 2 倍根号下 (2μs)，其中 μ 是突变率，s 是选择系数。当实际群体大小 N 超过 N* 时，适应性进化更可能通过随机隧穿（stochastic tunneling）而非顺序固定（sequential fixation）发生。
formula-notes:formula_7.45:zh.inThisChapter: 在本节讨论两位点固定问题时，该公式用于界定群体大小阈值，区分两种进化路径：顺序固定（需要两个突变依次出现并固定）与随机隧穿（第二个突变在第一个突变固定前出现并共同固定）。它为后续分析不同群体大小下的适应动力学提供了定量判据。

formula-notes:formula_7.47:en.plainMeaning: This formula estimates the rate of establishment (re) as approximately 4Nμufd, where N is the population size, μ is the mutation rate, and ufd is the fixation probability of the first-step allele.
formula-notes:formula_7.47:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on two-locus fixation issues to quantify how quickly a beneficial mutation can become established when the time is dominated by the first-step fixation, supporting later arguments about the speed of adaptation under linkage.

formula-notes:formula_7.46:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the expected time (in generations) for a new beneficial allele to fix via two successive mutations, where the first mutation is deleterious and the second is beneficial. Key symbols: N = population size, μ = mutation rate per locus per generation, u_fd = fixation probability of the deleterious first-step mutant, u_fb = fixation probability of the beneficial second-step mutant.
formula-notes:formula_7.46:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on two-locus fixation issues to quantify the mean waiting time for a double mutant to arise and fix when the intermediate genotype is deleterious, supporting the argument that such a two-step adaptive walk can be much slower than a single beneficial mutation.

formula-notes:formula_7.46:zh.plainMeaning: 公式 (7.46) 计算从单倍型 AB 到 ab（或反向）的平均固定时间，它等于两个突变步骤的等待时间之和：第一项对应有害中间突变（从 AB 到 Ab 或 aB）的等待时间，第二项对应有利第二步突变（从 Ab 或 aB 到 ab）的等待时间，其中 1/(2Nμ) 是突变发生率的倒数，u_fd 和 u_fb 分别是第一步有害突变和第二步有利突变的固定概率。
formula-notes:formula_7.46:zh.inThisChapter: 在本节“涉及两个基因座的固定问题”中，该公式用于量化两步突变路径（从野生型到双突变型）的平均固定时间，为后续讨论基因座间相互作用（如上位性）对适应度景观的影响提供时间尺度。

formula-notes:formula_7.47:zh.plainMeaning: 公式 r_e ≈ 4N μ u_fd 计算的是建立速率（即建立时间的倒数），其中 N 是种群大小，μ 是突变率，u_fd 是第一步等位基因最终固定的概率。
formula-notes:formula_7.47:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在讨论两位点固定问题的章节中，用于量化第一步等位基因固定所需时间对整体建立时间的决定性作用，为后续推导两步适应过程的速率提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_7.48:en.plainMeaning: This formula gives the rate of establishment (r_e) of a double mutant (ab) via stochastic tunneling, approximated as 2μ²/s, where μ is the mutation rate per locus and s is the selective advantage of the intermediate single mutant.
formula-notes:formula_7.48:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on fixation issues involving two loci to quantify how quickly a beneficial double mutant can arise and fix when the intermediate single mutant is deleterious, supporting the argument that tunneling can accelerate adaptation despite negative selection on intermediates.

formula-notes:formula_7.49:en.plainMeaning: This formula gives the stationary probability density of the frequency x0 of the AB gamete under selection, mutation, and drift, where α = 8Nμ²/s and z = 2μ/s, and Γ is the gamma function.
formula-notes:formula_7.49:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to show the equilibrium distribution for a two-locus model with symmetric mutation, supporting later analysis of selection-mutation balance and the effects of drift.

formula-notes:formula_7.48:zh.plainMeaning: 公式计算的是通过“随机隧穿”过程，ab 单倍型在达到与 AB 相同适应度状态时的建立速率，其中 μ 是突变率，s 是选择系数，2μ/s 是突变在群体中存活的概率，再乘以 μ 得到速率。
formula-notes:formula_7.48:zh.inThisChapter: 本章讨论两个位点的固定问题，该公式出现在分析从低适应度状态通过双重突变跳跃到等效适应度状态的速率，为后续比较不同隧穿路径的速率提供定量基础。

formula-notes:formula_7.49:zh.plainMeaning: 公式(7.49)计算在突变-选择平衡下，AB配子频率x0的平稳分布φ(x0)，其中α=8Nμ²/s是群体突变产生ab配子的速率，z=2μ/s是Ab和aB配子的总频率，Γ是伽马函数。
formula-notes:formula_7.49:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在“选择、突变和漂变的相互作用”章节的引言部分，用于描述在对称突变率和选择作用下，双位点平衡的精确分布，为后续讨论有限群体中突变-选择平衡的近似行为提供理论依据。

formula-notes:formula_7.50:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the effective rate of double-mutant production via stochastic tunneling, where r_e is the rate, μ is the mutation rate, s_d is the selective disadvantage of the single mutant, s_b is the selective advantage of the double mutant, N is the census population size, and N_e is the effective population size.
formula-notes:formula_7.50:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to the interaction of selection, mutation, and drift to quantify the rate of double-mutant establishment when the single-mutant intermediate is deleterious but the double mutant is beneficial, supporting the analysis of stochastic tunneling as a key evolutionary scenario.

formula-notes:formula_7.52:en.plainMeaning: This formula gives the rate of establishment via tunneling, where r_e is the rate, N is the population size, μ is the mutation rate, s is the selection coefficient, and N_e is the effective population size.
formula-notes:formula_7.52:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to quantify how quickly a beneficial mutation can become fixed through tunneling when first-step mutations arise at rate 4Nμ per generation, supporting later arguments about the interplay of selection, mutation, and drift.

formula-notes:formula_7.50:zh.plainMeaning: 公式7.50计算在随机隧道效应（stochastic tunneling）下，从单突变体到双突变体的有效速率r_e。它等于单突变体产生速率(2μ/s_d)乘以单突变体数量(2Nμ)再乘以双突变体固定概率2s_b(N_e/N)，最终简化为8N_e μ^2 s_b / s_d。
formula-notes:formula_7.50:zh.inThisChapter: 本章介绍选择、突变和漂变的相互作用，公式7.50修正了7.48在随机隧道效应下的不足，为后续讨论双突变体在有限群体中的固定概率提供关键速率表达式。

formula-notes:formula_7.51:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the expected time (in generations) for a beneficial mutation to become established in a population, given mutation rate μ, effective population size Ne, and selection coefficient s. Key symbols: t̄e = expected establishment time, N = census population size, μ = mutation rate, ufb = fixation probability of the beneficial mutation, Ne = effective population size, s = selection coefficient.
formula-notes:formula_7.51:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on interaction of selection, mutation, and drift to show how the rate of establishment depends on effective population size and selection strength when the intermediate mutation is effectively neutral, supporting the argument that establishment time is dominated by the waiting time for the beneficial mutation when 2Nes ≫ 1.

formula-notes:formula_7.53a:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the effective rate of adaptation (r_e) for a scenario requiring three mutations (d=3), where two neutral mutations must occur before a third adaptive mutation. Key symbols: N = population size, μ = mutation rate, s = selection coefficient, N_e = effective population size.
formula-notes:formula_7.53a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to interaction of selection, mutation, and drift to illustrate how nested tunneling events accelerate adaptation when multiple mutations are needed. It supports later arguments about the probability of complex adaptations evolving via stochastic tunneling.

formula-notes:formula_7.51:zh.plainMeaning: 公式(7.51)计算在突变、选择和漂变共同作用下，一个中性中间突变最终被固定的平均时间（以世代为单位）。左边t̄_e是平均固定时间，右边第一项1/(2μ)是仅由突变率决定的基准时间，第二项1/(2N_e s)反映了选择强度（N_e s）对固定时间的修正。
formula-notes:formula_7.51:zh.inThisChapter: 本章引入选择、突变和漂变的相互作用，公式(7.51)由公式(7.46)代入固定概率推导而来，用于说明当中间突变有效中性时（2N_e s >> 1），固定时间主要由突变率决定，为后续讨论“近乎中性”突变的固定速率提供定量基础。

formula-notes:formula_7.52:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算通过“隧穿”路径（即不经中间突变型固定）建立新适应突变型的速率，其中 r_e 是建立速率，N 是群体大小，μ 是突变率，s 是选择系数，N_e 是有效群体大小。
formula-notes:formula_7.52:zh.inThisChapter: 本章讨论选择、突变和漂变的相互作用，公式(7.52)出现在介绍隧穿效应的部分，用于量化在第一步突变不断产生的情况下，通过两步突变路径建立新基因型的速率，为后续分析突变率与适应度景观的关系提供定量基础。

formula-notes:formula_7.53a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算在d=3（即需要三个突变才能完成适应）时，通过连续隧道事件产生适应性等位基因的速率r_e，其中关键符号N为种群大小，μ为突变率，s为选择系数，N_e为有效种群大小。
formula-notes:formula_7.53a:zh.inThisChapter: 本章介绍选择、突变和漂变的相互作用，该公式作为公式7.52在d=3时的具体展开，展示了隧道事件嵌套结构下的速率表达式，为后续讨论更高维度（d>3）的隧道效应提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_7.53b:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the effective rate of complex adaptation (re) for d mutations, where λ is a product of factors, μ is mutation rate, N is population size, and S = 4Nes is the scaled selection coefficient.
formula-notes:formula_7.53b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to interaction of selection, mutation, and drift to generalize the tunneling rate for an arbitrary number of mutations, supporting later analysis of multi-step adaptive pathways.

formula-notes:formula_7.53c:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes a product of terms (d-i) raised to the power 0.5^i, for i from 1 to d-1, which serves as a correction factor λ in the rate of adaptation for a lineage with d mutations.
formula-notes:formula_7.53c:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the derivation of the rate of adaptation under selection, mutation, and drift, providing the multiplicative factor that accounts for the decreasing probability of fixation as more mutations accumulate.

formula-notes:formula_7.53b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算在d个突变位点的隧道效应中，最终逃逸率r_e。其中d是突变位点数，λ由(7.53c)定义，μ是突变率，N是种群大小，S=4N_e s是选择系数，指数项反映隧道路径的层级结构。
formula-notes:formula_7.53b:zh.inThisChapter: 本章介绍选择、突变和漂变的相互作用，此公式推广了(7.53a)中d=2的情形，为后续推导任意d的隧道效应提供一般表达式。

formula-notes:formula_7.53c:zh.plainMeaning: 公式(7.53c)定义了一个乘积因子λ，它由d-1个因子(d-i)的0.5^i次幂相乘得到，其中d是突变数量，i从1到d-1。
formula-notes:formula_7.53c:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在推导多个突变累积时选择-突变-漂移相互作用的理论中，为公式(7.53b)中λ的具体表达式，用于计算有效重组率r_e，从而量化突变间的相互作用对进化速率的影响。

formula-notes:formula_8.1a:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the overall frequency q(t) of a neutral allele m in a population as a weighted average of its frequencies on chromosomes carrying the selected allele A (q_A(t)) and on those carrying the alternative allele a (q_a(t)), with weights given by the frequency p(t) of A at generation t.
formula-notes:formula_8.1a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in this section to express how the neutral allele's frequency changes during a selective sweep, and it supports later derivations (e.g., Equations 8.1b–8.1e) that model the dynamics of q_A(t) and q_a(t) and ultimately the probability of fixation of m.

formula-notes:formula_7.54:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the rate of establishment via tunneling, $r_e$, for a complex adaptation requiring $d$ intermediate-step mutations. Key symbols: $N_e$ = effective population size, $d!$ = factorial of $d$, $\mu$ = mutation rate, $s_d$ = selection coefficient of the final beneficial mutation, $s_b$ = selection coefficient of the intermediate beneficial mutations.
formula-notes:formula_7.54:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to the interaction of selection, mutation, and drift to quantify how the rate of tunneling scales with the number of required mutations $d$, supporting the argument that the rate is proportional to $\mu^d$ due to limited mutation opportunities during short sojourn times.

formula-notes:formula_8.1b:en.plainMeaning: This formula defines the initial frequency difference between allele A and allele a at a neutral locus, where q_A(0) and q_a(0) are their initial frequencies.
formula-notes:formula_8.1b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on neutral loci linked to a selected site to set the initial condition for the subsequent dynamics of the neutral allele frequency difference over time.

formula-notes:formula_7.54:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算通过“隧道效应”建立新适应型（逃逸型）的速率 r_e，其中关键符号：N_e 为有效种群大小，d 为中间突变步数，μ 为每代每基因组突变率，s_d 为中间型选择系数，s_b 为最终突变的选择优势。
formula-notes:formula_7.54:zh.inThisChapter: 本章介绍选择、突变和漂变的相互作用，该公式出现在讨论多步适应过程中通过隧道效应建立逃逸型的速率，它推广了 d=2 时的公式 7.50，为后续分析突变率幂次依赖关系提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_8.1a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式通过条件概率计算中性等位基因m在群体中的总频率q(t)：它等于在携带选择等位基因A的染色体上的频率q_A(t)乘以A的频率p(t)，加上在携带a的染色体上的频率q_a(t)乘以a的频率1-p(t)。
formula-notes:formula_8.1a:zh.inThisChapter: 本章研究受选择位点附近中性位点的行为，该公式将中性位点频率与选择位点频率p(t)及条件频率q_A、q_a联系起来，为后续推导选择扫荡过程中q(t)的动力学方程（如8.1b-8.1e）提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_8.1c:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the total change in frequency of the neutral allele m from its initial frequency q(0) to its final frequency q(∞) after the beneficial allele A has fixed.
formula-notes:formula_8.1c:en.inThisChapter: It appears in this section to quantify the net effect of genetic hitchhiking on a linked neutral locus, supporting later arguments about the expected reduction in neutral diversity due to a selective sweep.

formula-notes:formula_8.1b:zh.plainMeaning: 公式 δ_q(0) = q_A(0) - q_a(0) 计算在初始时刻（t=0），与选择位点连锁的中性位点上等位基因 A 和 a 的频率之差，其中 q_A(0) 和 q_a(0) 分别是与选择位点等位基因 A 和 a 连锁的中性等位基因的初始频率。
formula-notes:formula_8.1b:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在第8章“与选择位点连锁的中性位点的行为”中，用于定义初始时刻中性位点与选择位点之间的连锁不平衡度量 δ_q(0)，为后续推导 δ_q 随时间的变化（如公式 8.1c-8.1e）提供初始条件。

formula-notes:formula_8.1d:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the fraction of the initial excess association (δ_q(0)) between the neutral allele m and the beneficial allele A that persists after A fixes (Δ_q). Key symbols: f_s (strength of hitchhiking), Δ_q = q(∞)-q(0) (change in neutral allele frequency), δ_q(0) = q_A(0)-q_a(0) (initial excess association), approximated as [q(∞)-q(0)]/[1-q(0)] when p(0)≪q(0).
formula-notes:formula_8.1d:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on hitchhiking to quantify how strongly a neutral locus is affected by a selective sweep. This measure supports later arguments about the probability of fixation of neutral mutations linked to selected sites and the expected reduction in heterozygosity after a sweep.

formula-notes:formula_8.1e:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the final frequency q(∞) of a neutral allele after a selective sweep, given its initial frequency q(0) and the hitchhiking effect f_s. It shows that q(∞) = f_s + q(0)(1 - f_s).
formula-notes:formula_8.1e:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on neutral loci linked to a selected site to quantify the long-term impact of a selective sweep on neutral variation, supporting later arguments about the reduction in heterozygosity and the probability of fixation of neutral alleles.

formula-notes:formula_8.1d:zh.plainMeaning: 这个公式定义了搭车事件强度的关键度量 f_s，它等于 Δ_q（A固定后m频率的最终变化）除以 δ_q(0)（初始时m与A的关联过剩），即 q(∞)-q(0) 除以 q_A(0)-q_a(0)；当 p(0)远小于 q(0)时，分母近似为 1-q(0)。
formula-notes:formula_8.1d:zh.inThisChapter: 在“中性位点与选择位点连锁的行为”这一节中，公式8.1d出现在定义搭车事件强度之后，为后续推导f_s的近似表达式（如公式8.1e）以及分析搭车效应概率提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_8.1c:zh.plainMeaning: 公式 Δ_q = q(∞) - q(0) 计算的是在有利等位基因 A 固定后，连锁的中性等位基因 m 的频率从初始时刻（t=0）到最终时刻（t=∞）的变化量。其中 q(0) 是 m 的初始频率，q(∞) 是 A 固定后 m 的频率。
formula-notes:formula_8.1c:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在第 8.1 节，用于定义中性位点频率在选择性清除过程中的总变化，为后续推导 Δ_q 的期望值（如公式 8.1d）和方差提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_8.2a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算中性位点m在有利背景（A）与不利背景（a）上的频率差δ_q(t)随时间t的变化：δ_q(t) = q_A(t) - q_a(t) = (1-c)^t [q_A(0)-q_a(0)] ≈ δ_q(0) e^{-c t}，其中c为重组率，表明频率差以指数速率衰减。
formula-notes:formula_8.2a:zh.inThisChapter: 本章分析受选择位点附近中性位点的行为，公式(8.2a)给出了无选择时频率差因重组而衰减的精确离散解，为后续推导连续近似(8.2b)和考虑选择效应的更精确结果(8.2c)提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_8.1e:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算在选择性扫荡结束后，与受选择位点连锁的中性位点的最终等位基因频率q(∞)。它等于初始频率q(0)加上由于选择扫荡导致的频率变化Δ_q，其中Δ_q = f_s δ_q(0)，而δ_q(0)=1-q(0)是初始时中性位点与受选择位点之间的连锁不平衡度量。最终表达式为q(∞)=f_s + q(0)(1-f_s)，其中f_s是受选择位点最终固定时中性位点与之关联的概率。
formula-notes:formula_8.1e:zh.inThisChapter: 在本节中，该公式用于量化中性位点频率在选择性扫荡后的最终状态，是推导扫荡对中性变异影响的核心结果。它建立在公式8.1a-8.1d的基础上，为后续讨论扫荡强度、重组率等参数对中性多样性的影响提供了定量基础。

formula-notes:formula_8.2a:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the difference in frequency of a neutral allele between the two genetic backgrounds (A and a) over time, showing that it decays exponentially due to recombination at rate c. δ_q(t) is the frequency difference at time t, δ_q(0) the initial difference, and c the recombination fraction.
formula-notes:formula_8.2a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in this section to quantify how linkage to a selected site causes a neutral locus to behave as if it were under selection, supporting the derivation of the effective selection coefficient in subsequent equations (8.2b, 8.2c).

formula-notes:formula_8.2b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算在受选择位点固定时（时间τ≈2ln(4Nₑs)/s），中性位点初始连锁不平衡δ_q(0)衰减后的剩余量δ_q(∞)。关键符号：c为重组率，s为选择系数，Nₑ为有效群体大小。
formula-notes:formula_8.2b:zh.inThisChapter: 本章讨论受选择位点附近中性位点的行为。公式8.2b通过代入固定时间τ到8.2a，将指数衰减转化为幂律衰减，为后续推导δ_q(∞)/δ_q(0)的表达式（8.2c）提供直接代数结果。

formula-notes:formula_8.2b:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the final linkage disequilibrium δ_q(∞) between a neutral locus and a selected site after a selective sweep, given initial disequilibrium δ_q(0), recombination rate c, selection coefficient s, and effective population size N_e. Key symbols: δ_q(∞) = final disequilibrium, δ_q(0) = initial disequilibrium, c = recombination rate, s = selection coefficient, N_e = effective population size.
formula-notes:formula_8.2b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in this section to quantify how a selective sweep reduces linkage disequilibrium at a neutral locus, supporting the argument that the reduction factor depends on (4N_e s)^{-2c/s} as shown in Equation 8.2c.

formula-notes:formula_8.2c:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the ratio of the final to initial heterozygosity (δq) at a neutral locus linked to a selected site, after a selective sweep. δq(∞) is the final heterozygosity, δq(0) the initial, Ne the effective population size, s the selection coefficient, and c the recombination rate.
formula-notes:formula_8.2c:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on the behavior of a neutral locus linked to a selected site, derived from Equation 8.2b, to quantify the reduction in neutral diversity due to hitchhiking, supporting the argument that the effect depends on the ratio c/s.

formula-notes:formula_8.3a:en.plainMeaning: This formula approximates the total change in neutral allele frequency Δ_q at the end of a selective sweep, given the initial change δ_q(0) and the initial frequency p(0) of the selected allele, with c/s being the ratio of the neutral recombination distance to the selection coefficient.
formula-notes:formula_8.3a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to hitchhiking and selective sweeps to quantify how a neutral allele hitchhikes with a beneficial allele, and it directly leads to the fixation probability f_s in Equation 8.3b.

formula-notes:formula_8.2c:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算在受选择位点附近、重组率为c的中性位点上，最终（固定后）与初始的连锁不平衡比值，等于(1/(4N_e s))的(2c/s)次方。关键符号：δ_q(∞)和δ_q(0)分别表示最终和初始的连锁不平衡，N_e为有效群体大小，s为选择系数，c为重组率。
formula-notes:formula_8.2c:zh.inThisChapter: 本章分析中性位点与受选择位点连锁时的行为，公式(8.2c)由(8.2b)直接整理得到，将指数上的负号移入底数，形式更简洁，为后续讨论不同c/s比值下连锁不平衡的衰减程度提供直接表达式。

formula-notes:formula_8.3b:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the fixation probability of a neutral allele B linked to a beneficial allele A, where f_s is the ratio of the change in frequency of B (Δ_q) to its initial frequency deviation δ_q(0), expressed as p(0)^{c/s}, with p(0) the initial frequency of A, c the recombination rate, and s the selection coefficient.
formula-notes:formula_8.3b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to hitchhiking and selective sweeps to quantify how strongly a neutral allele's frequency is altered by a linked beneficial substitution, supporting later arguments about the genomic signatures of selective sweeps.

formula-notes:formula_8.3b:zh.plainMeaning: 公式8.3b计算的是在A固定时，中性位点等位基因频率变化Δ_q相对于初始频率差δ_q(0)的比例f_s，该比例等于初始频率p(0)的c/s次幂。
formula-notes:formula_8.3b:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在选择性清除的引言部分，由公式8.3a代入公式8.1d直接得到，用于量化选择对中性位点遗传多样性的影响，为后续推导中性位点受选择影响的概率分布（如公式8.3c-8.3g）提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_8.3c:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将幂函数 x^a 表示为指数形式 e^{a ln(x)}，并在 |a ln(x)| 远小于 1 时近似为 1 + a ln(x)，即用线性项近似指数函数。
formula-notes:formula_8.3c:zh.inThisChapter: 此处用于将公式 8.3b 中的幂函数近似为线性形式，从而推导出 Maynard Smith 和 Haigh (1974) 的经典结果 8.3d，修正了之前 8.2c 对选择性清除效应的低估。

formula-notes:formula_8.3c:en.plainMeaning: This formula expresses x^a as e^{a ln(x)} and approximates it as 1 + a ln(x) when |a ln(x)| is much less than 1. Here, x is a variable, a is an exponent, and ln is the natural logarithm.
formula-notes:formula_8.3c:en.inThisChapter: It appears in this section to provide a linear approximation used to simplify Equation 8.3b, recovering the classic result of Maynard Smith and Haigh (1974) in Equation 8.3d, which quantifies the effect of a selective sweep on neutral diversity.

formula-notes:formula_8.3d:en.plainMeaning: This formula approximates the fixation probability f_s of a beneficial allele that is initially linked to a neutral allele, where c is the recombination rate, s is the selection coefficient, and p(0) is the initial frequency of the beneficial allele.
formula-notes:formula_8.3d:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to hitchhiking and selective sweeps to derive the classic Maynard Smith and Haigh result, which quantifies how recombination reduces the hitchhiking effect and sets the stage for later discussions on sweep signatures.

formula-notes:formula_8.3d:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式近似计算在选择性扫荡中，与有利突变连锁的中性位点最终固定概率 f_s，它等于 1 加上 (c/s) 乘以初始频率 p(0) 的自然对数。其中 c 是重组率，s 是选择系数。
formula-notes:formula_8.3d:zh.inThisChapter: 本章介绍 hitchhiking 和选择性扫荡，公式 8.3d 由公式 8.3b 通过近似 8.3c 推导得出，为后续讨论初始频率 p(0)=1/(2N) 时的简化形式 8.3e 做铺垫。

formula-notes:formula_8.3e:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the final frequency of a neutral allele after a selective sweep, given an initial frequency of 1/(2N). Here, f_s is the final frequency, c is the recombination rate, s is the selection coefficient, and N is the population size.
formula-notes:formula_8.3e:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to hitchhiking and selective sweeps to provide a concrete approximation for the reduction in neutral diversity due to a sweep, supporting the argument that strong selection (s >> c) leads to a near-complete sweep (f_s ≈ 1).

formula-notes:formula_8.3e:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算在初始频率p(0)=1/(2N)（即一个拷贝）时，选择性扫荡后中性位点最终固定概率fs的近似值，等于1减去c/s乘以ln(2N)。
formula-notes:formula_8.3e:zh.inThisChapter: 它出现在推导选择性扫荡对中性位点固定概率影响的章节，将一般公式(8.3d)应用于初始频率为单个突变拷贝的常见情形，为后续讨论扫荡概率和基因组多样性影响提供具体表达式。

formula-notes:formula_8.3f:en.plainMeaning: This formula approximates the fixation probability f_s of a completely recessive beneficial allele (h=0) under selection and recombination, where c is recombination rate, s is selection coefficient, and p(0) is initial frequency.
formula-notes:formula_8.3f:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on hitchhiking and selective sweeps to extend the analysis to recessive alleles, showing that the fixation probability depends on the ratio c/(2s) and initial frequency, supporting later discussions on the conditions for a selective sweep.

formula-notes:formula_8.3f:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算完全隐性突变（h=0）时，在选择性清除过程中，最终被固定（频率达到1）的有利等位基因的频率f_s，它近似等于1减去c/(2s)乘以初始频率p(0)的倒数。其中c是重组率，s是选择系数，p(0)是初始频率。
formula-notes:formula_8.3f:zh.inThisChapter: 在介绍选择性清除的章节中，公式8.3f针对完全隐性突变（h=0）这一特殊情况，给出了f_s的近似表达式，补充了公式8.3a-8.3d中h≠0的情况，为后续讨论不同显性度下的清除效应提供完整框架。

formula-notes:formula_8.3g:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算在初始频率p(0)=1/(2N)时，选择性扫荡的固定概率f_s，近似为1减去(c/(2hs))乘以ln(4N_e s)，其中c是重组率，h是显性度，s是选择系数，N_e是有效种群大小。
formula-notes:formula_8.3g:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在讨论搭车效应和选择性扫荡的章节，通过将初始频率从p(0)=1/(4N_e s)替换回p(0)=1/(2N)（如公式8.2c所示），给出了更一般的固定概率近似，为后续分析不同初始条件下的扫荡概率提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_8.4a:en.plainMeaning: This formula expresses the odds of the favored allele A at time t as a function of its initial odds and the selection coefficient s, showing exponential growth over time.
formula-notes:formula_8.4a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to hitchhiking and selective sweeps to describe the deterministic trajectory of a beneficial allele under strong selection, which is essential for modeling the reduction in neutral diversity during a sweep.

formula-notes:formula_8.3g:en.plainMeaning: This formula approximates the fixation probability f_s of a beneficial mutation with selective advantage s and dominance h, given an initial frequency p(0)=1/(2N). It accounts for the reduction in fixation probability due to linked neutral variation by including the recombination rate c and effective population size N_e.
formula-notes:formula_8.3g:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to hitchhiking and selective sweeps to quantify how tightly linked neutral sites are affected by a selective sweep, supporting later arguments about the reduction in neutral diversity around a sweep.

formula-notes:formula_8.4b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算等位基因A从初始频率ε上升到1-ε所需的时间τ，其中s为选择系数，τ与ln(ε)成正比。
formula-notes:formula_8.4b:zh.inThisChapter: 本节介绍选择性清除（selective sweep）中有利等位基因频率上升的时间尺度，此公式为后续推导固定时间（如公式8.4c-8.4e）提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_8.4a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将有利等位基因A的频率p(t)与初始频率p(0)通过指数增长联系起来，其中s为选择系数，t为时间。它表示优势比p(t)/(1-p(t))随时间指数增长。
formula-notes:formula_8.4a:zh.inThisChapter: 本章介绍搭便车效应和选择性清除，该公式来自确定性模型（公式5.3b），用于描述有利等位基因在群体中的频率动态，为后续推导选择性清除的概率和模式提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_8.4b:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the time τ for a beneficial allele A to increase in frequency from a small initial frequency ε to near fixation (1-ε) under selection coefficient s, assuming logistic growth. τ is the time in generations, ε is the threshold frequency, and s is the selection coefficient.
formula-notes:formula_8.4b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to hitchhiking and selective sweeps to quantify the duration of a selective sweep, which is essential for understanding how quickly a beneficial allele rises to fixation and the resulting reduction in linked neutral variation.

formula-notes:formula_8.4c:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the approximate time τ for a beneficial allele to increase from a single copy to near fixation (frequency 1 - 1/(2N)) under selection coefficient s, given a diploid population size N. τ is approximately 2 ln(2N)/s.
formula-notes:formula_8.4c:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to hitchhiking and selective sweeps to quantify the duration of a selective sweep, which is needed to estimate the genomic footprint of a sweep and the reduction in heterozygosity at linked sites.

formula-notes:formula_8.4c:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算从单个拷贝（频率1/(2N)）到接近固定（频率1-1/(2N)）所需的时间τ，其中s为选择系数，N为群体大小。关键符号：τ（时间）、s（选择优势）、N（群体大小）。
formula-notes:formula_8.4c:zh.inThisChapter: 本节介绍选择性清除（selective sweep），该公式用于量化一个有利突变从出现到接近固定所需的时间，为后续讨论清除的持续时间及其对遗传多样性的影响提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_8.4d:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the expected time τ (in generations) for a beneficial allele to go from a single copy to fixation, given selection coefficient s and effective population size Ne. It is derived by substituting the initial frequency ε = 1/(4Nes) into the general fixation time formula.
formula-notes:formula_8.4d:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to hitchhiking and selective sweeps to quantify the duration of a selective sweep, which is essential for understanding how quickly a beneficial allele and linked neutral variants rise to high frequency.

formula-notes:formula_8.4e:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the time t_x for a beneficial allele to reach frequency x, starting from a very low initial frequency ε = 1/(4N_e s), under deterministic selection with selection coefficient s and effective population size N_e.
formula-notes:formula_8.4e:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to hitchhiking and selective sweeps to quantify the duration of a sweep, which is essential for understanding how quickly a beneficial allele fixes and how much linked neutral variation is lost.

formula-notes:formula_8.4e:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算从初始频率ε（设为1/(4Nₑs)）上升到频率x所需的时间tₓ，其中s为选择系数，Nₑ为有效种群大小。
formula-notes:formula_8.4e:zh.inThisChapter: 本章介绍选择性清除（selective sweeps），该公式用于量化有利突变从极低频率（ε≈0）固定所需的时间，为后续讨论清除的基因组印记提供时间尺度。

formula-notes:formula_8.5a:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the change in neutral allele frequency (Δ_q) due to a selective sweep, as a function of initial frequency δ_q(0), initial beneficial allele frequency p(0), and the ratio of recombination rate c to selection coefficient s, using the gamma function Γ.
formula-notes:formula_8.5a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to hitchhiking and selective sweeps to provide a more accurate approximation than Equation 8.3a, and it supports later derivations of approximations for small c/s (Equation 8.5b).

formula-notes:formula_8.4d:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算一个从单个拷贝开始、受正向选择（选择系数 s）的有利突变在有效群体大小为 N_e 的二倍体种群中达到固定所需的平均时间 τ（以世代为单位），其中 ln 内 4N_e s 是初始频率 ε = 1/(4N_e s) 的倒数乘以 2。
formula-notes:formula_8.4d:zh.inThisChapter: 在“搭车与选择性清除”章节中，公式 (8.4d) 由 (8.4c) 代入 ε = 1/(4N_e s) 得到，用于量化选择性清除的时间尺度，为后续讨论清除对周围位点多样性的影响提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_8.5a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算在选择性清除（hitchhiking）过程中，中性位点等位基因频率变化量Δ_q的近似值。它通过初始频率δ_q(0)、选择系数s、重组率c以及初始频率p(0)的c/s次幂，并利用伽马函数Γ修正，给出了比简单幂律更精确的结果。
formula-notes:formula_8.5a:zh.inThisChapter: 本章介绍选择性清除和搭车效应，公式8.5a在8.3a基础上引入伽马函数修正，为后续推导更精确的近似式8.5b以及理解c/s较小时的行为提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_8.6a:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the expected total length (L) of genomic region with reduced variation after a selective sweep, where s is the selection coefficient and c0 is the recombination rate per unit distance.
formula-notes:formula_8.6a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in this section to quantify the extent of a selective sweep's effect on linked neutral variation, supporting later arguments about the expected length of a selective sweep signature.

formula-notes:formula_8.5b:en.plainMeaning: This formula approximates the change in neutral allele frequency (Δ_q) due to a selective sweep, using the initial frequency δ_q(0), the selection coefficient s, the recombination rate c, and the initial frequency of the beneficial allele p(0). It is valid when c/s < 0.1.
formula-notes:formula_8.5b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to hitchhiking and selective sweeps to provide a simplified expression for the reduction in neutral diversity, improving upon earlier approximations (Equation 8.3d) and supporting later discussions on the impact of linked selection.

formula-notes:formula_8.5b:zh.plainMeaning: 公式(8.5b)近似计算了在选择性清除过程中，受选择位点连锁的中性位点等位基因频率的变化量Δ_q，它等于初始频率变化δ_q(0)乘以一个因子，该因子包含重组率与选择系数之比c/s以及初始选择位点频率p(0)的对数。
formula-notes:formula_8.5b:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在选择性清除的引言部分，是对精确公式(8.5a)在c/s < 0.1条件下的简化近似，为后续讨论弱重组或强选择下的清除效应提供更易处理的表达式，并指出其相对于早期公式(8.3d)的改进之处。

formula-notes:formula_8.6a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算与一次近期选择性清除（sweep）相关联的、多样性降低的基因组区域的总期望长度L（以所选单位度量），其中s为选择系数，c0为每单位物理距离的重组率，0.02为常数因子。
formula-notes:formula_8.6a:zh.inThisChapter: 在本节中，该公式用于量化一个中性位点受附近选择位点影响的范围，为后续推导（如公式8.6b）中考虑两侧影响及物理距离与重组率关系提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_8.6b:zh.plainMeaning: 公式 (8.6b) 通过选择系数 s 与减多态性区间总长度 L 及该区间内每代每碱基的重组率 c₀ 的乘积除以常数 0.02 来近似估计 s，其中 L 的单位是碱基对，c₀ 的单位是每代每碱基的重组率。
formula-notes:formula_8.6b:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式由 (8.6a) 重排得到，用于在已知减多态性区间长度和重组率时快速估算选择强度 s，为后续讨论选择扫荡对连锁位点多样性的影响提供定量工具。

formula-notes:formula_8.6b:en.plainMeaning: This formula estimates the selection coefficient s from the length L of reduced variation and the recombination rate c0 per unit length, using the relation s ≈ (c0·L)/0.02.
formula-notes:formula_8.6b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on linked neutral loci to provide a practical method for inferring the strength of selection from observed patterns of genetic diversity, supporting later discussions on detecting selective sweeps.

formula-notes:formula_8.7a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算经过搭车效应后标记位点的杂合度H，它等于最终频率q(∞)的2倍乘以1减q(∞)，并展开为初始杂合度H₀减去与频率变化Δ_q有关的线性项和二次项。
formula-notes:formula_8.7a:zh.inThisChapter: 在本节中，该公式用于量化搭车效应如何改变中性位点的杂合度，为后续推导Δ_q对H的期望影响（如公式8.7b-8.7d）提供代数基础。

formula-notes:formula_8.7b:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the expected change in allele frequency at a neutral locus linked to a selected site, showing it equals zero. Key symbols: E(Δ_q) is the expected change, q(0) is the initial frequency of the neutral allele on the selected background, p(0) is the initial frequency of the selected allele, and c/s is the ratio of recombination to selection.
formula-notes:formula_8.7b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in this section to demonstrate that the expected frequency change of a neutral allele linked to a selected site is zero, supporting the argument that selection does not systematically alter neutral allele frequencies on average, which is crucial for understanding the behavior of linked neutral loci.

formula-notes:formula_8.7c:zh.plainMeaning: 公式(8.7c)计算连锁于选择位点的中性位点的期望杂合度H_h，它等于初始杂合度H_0减去两倍的期望选择位点等位基因频率变化平方E[Δ_q^2]。
formula-notes:formula_8.7c:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在推导中性位点受选择位点牵连效应的章节中，通过对(8.7a)取期望并利用(8.7b)得到，为后续计算期望杂合度随时间的衰减奠定基础。

formula-notes:formula_8.7b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算了中性位点等位基因频率变化的期望值，其中第一项表示初始频率为q(0)的中性等位基因与选择位点有利等位基因（初始频率p(0)）关联时，其频率增加[1-q(0)]p(0)^{c/s}的概率加权贡献；第二项表示初始频率为1-q(0)的中性等位基因与不利背景关联时，其频率减少q(0)p(0)^{c/s}的概率加权贡献，两项之和为零。
formula-notes:formula_8.7b:zh.inThisChapter: 在推导中性位点与选择位点连锁时的等位基因频率变化期望时，公式8.7b表明在初始条件下，中性等位基因频率变化的期望为零，这为后续计算方差（公式8.7c）和最终推导中性位点频率的随机波动（公式8.7d）提供了基础。

formula-notes:formula_8.7c:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the expected heterozygosity at a neutral locus (H_h) as the initial heterozygosity (H_0) minus twice the expected squared change in allele frequency at the linked selected site (E[Δ_q^2]).
formula-notes:formula_8.7c:en.inThisChapter: It appears in this section to quantify how selection at a linked site reduces neutral diversity, supporting the argument that genetic hitchhiking erodes heterozygosity proportionally to the variance in selected allele frequency change.

formula-notes:formula_8.7d:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算了Δ_q（即q(t)与q(0)之差）的期望平方，结果等于q(0)[1-q(0)]乘以p(0)^{2c/s}，其中q(0)是初始频率，p(0)=1-q(0)，c/s是选择与重组强度的比值。
formula-notes:formula_8.7d:zh.inThisChapter: 它出现在推导连锁中性位点杂合度期望衰减的上下文中，通过公式8.7c将H_h表示为初始杂合度H_0减去2倍E[Δ_q^2]，从而量化选择对中性位点多样性的影响。

formula-notes:formula_8.7d:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the expected squared change in allele frequency at a neutral locus due to genetic hitchhiking, where q(0) is the initial frequency of the neutral allele and p(0)^(c/s) is the probability of fixation of the selected allele given the initial frequency p(0) and the ratio of recombination rate c to selection coefficient s.
formula-notes:formula_8.7d:en.inThisChapter: It appears in this section to derive the expected heterozygosity decay (Equation 8.7c) by quantifying the variance of the frequency change, supporting the argument that linked neutral diversity is reduced during a selective sweep.

formula-notes:formula_8.8a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算在受选择位点影响下，中性位点的最终杂合度H_h。H_0是初始杂合度，p(0)是初始时与有利等位基因连锁的染色体频率，c是重组率，s是选择系数。
formula-notes:formula_8.8a:zh.inThisChapter: 本节推导受选择位点连锁的中性位点的行为，公式8.8a由8.7c和8.7d组合得到，为后续分析连锁对中性变异的影响提供关键表达式。

formula-notes:formula_8.8a:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the expected heterozygosity H_h at a neutral locus linked to a selected site, given initial heterozygosity H_0, the initial frequency p(0) of the favored allele, the recombination fraction c, and the selection coefficient s.
formula-notes:formula_8.8a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in this section to quantify how linkage to a selected site reduces neutral diversity via hitchhiking, supporting the argument that the reduction depends on the ratio c/s and the initial frequency of the selected allele.

formula-notes:formula_8.8b:en.plainMeaning: This formula approximates the ratio of heterozygosity at a neutral locus linked to a selected site (H_h) to initial heterozygosity (H_0) when the recombination rate c is much smaller than the selection coefficient s. It shows that the reduction in heterozygosity depends on the initial frequency p(0) of the favored allele and the ratio c/s.
formula-notes:formula_8.8b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on the behavior of a neutral locus linked to a selected site to quantify the hitchhiking effect on neutral diversity. The result supports later arguments about the genomic signatures of selective sweeps, particularly when recombination is weak relative to selection.

formula-notes:formula_8.8c:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the expected relative heterozygosity after a selective sweep, where H_h is heterozygosity at a linked neutral site, H_0 is initial heterozygosity, N_e is effective population size, s is selection coefficient, and c is recombination rate between the neutral and selected sites.
formula-notes:formula_8.8c:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the Hitchhiking and Selective Sweeps section to quantify the reduction in neutral diversity due to a sweep, improving on Equation 8.8b by using a more accurate initial frequency of the beneficial mutation.

formula-notes:formula_8.8b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式近似计算了与受选择位点连锁的中性位点的期望杂合度H_h相对于初始杂合度H_0的比例，其中p(0)是初始时选择位点有利等位基因的频率，c是重组率，s是选择系数。当c/s很小时，该比例近似为1减去p(0)的2c/s次方，进一步近似为-(2c/s)ln[p(0)]。
formula-notes:formula_8.8b:zh.inThisChapter: 在讨论中性位点与选择位点连锁的行为时，公式(8.8b)给出了在强选择（c/s≪1）条件下，中性位点杂合度因遗传搭车而下降的近似表达式，为后续推导搭车效应的强度（如公式8.8c-8.8e）提供了基础。

formula-notes:formula_8.8c:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算选择性清除后，与中性位点连锁的基因座（hitchhiking locus）的相对杂合度（H_h/H_0），其中N_e为有效种群大小，s为选择系数，c为重组率。
formula-notes:formula_8.8c:zh.inThisChapter: 在“搭车与选择性清除”章节中，该公式改进了公式8.8b，通过将初始频率p(0)从1/(2N)替换为1/(4N_e s)，更精确地描述了从单一突变开始的清除过程，为后续讨论清除的强度和时间尺度提供定量基础。

formula-notes:formula_8.8d:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the ratio of heterozygosity after a selective sweep (H_h) to initial heterozygosity (H_0) as 1 minus the square of the coalescent probability f_s, which equals 1 minus p(0) raised to 2c/s, where p(0) is the initial frequency of the beneficial allele, c is the recombination rate, and s is the selection coefficient.
formula-notes:formula_8.8d:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to hitchhiking and selective sweeps to quantify the reduction in genetic diversity caused by a sweep, supporting later arguments about the genomic signatures of positive selection.

formula-notes:formula_8.8e:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the relative heterozygosity (H_h/H_0) after a selective sweep for a completely recessive beneficial mutation (h=0), where η = c√(4N_e/s) captures the effect of recombination and selection.
formula-notes:formula_8.8e:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to hitchhiking and selective sweeps to show that recessive sweeps produce a weaker signal than dominant ones, supporting the argument that the time to fixation (∼√(N_e/s) generations) allows more recombination.

formula-notes:formula_8.9:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the ratio of heterozygosity after a selective sweep (H_h) to initial heterozygosity (H_0), given by (2c/s) ln(2N), where c is the recombination rate, s is the selection coefficient, and N is the population size.
formula-notes:formula_8.9:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to hitchhiking and selective sweeps to quantify the reduction in neutral diversity caused by a sweep, supporting later arguments about detecting sweeps from genomic data.

formula-notes:formula_8.8e:zh.plainMeaning: 公式 (8.8e) 计算完全隐性突变（h=0）经历选择性清除后，在受选择位点附近观察到的相对杂合度 H_h/H_0，它近似等于 η/(1+η)，其中 η = c√(4N_e/s)，c 是重组率，N_e 是有效群体大小，s 是选择系数。
formula-notes:formula_8.8e:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在“搭便车与选择性清除”章节的引言部分，用于说明完全隐性突变（h=0）的选择性清除信号比部分显性突变弱得多，因为隐性突变固定时间更长（约 √(N_e/s) 代），重组机会更多，从而为后续比较不同显性程度下的清除信号强度提供定量依据。

formula-notes:formula_8.8d:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算选择性清除后残留的杂合度比例H_h/H_0，等于1减去两个等位基因在清除中未发生重组而共同溯祖的概率f_s^2，而f_s^2又等于初始频率p(0)的2c/s次方。
formula-notes:formula_8.8d:zh.inThisChapter: 本章介绍搭便车效应与选择性清除，公式8.8d将清除后杂合度与重组率c、选择系数s及初始频率p(0)联系起来，为后续推导清除对连锁位点多样性的影响提供定量基础。

formula-notes:formula_8.10:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式给出了第i大频率单倍型数量n_i与最大频率单倍型数量n_0的比值近似等于μ/(i s)，其中μ是区域总突变率，s是优势等位基因的选择强度。
formula-notes:formula_8.10:zh.inThisChapter: 在本章关于与选择位点连锁的中性位点行为的上下文中，该公式揭示了在选择性清除或背景选择过程中，单倍型频率分布遵循幂律关系，为后续推导单倍型多样性统计量（如Ewens抽样公式的推广）提供了基础。

formula-notes:formula_8.9:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算在选择性清除（selective sweep）发生后，受 hitchhiking 影响的位点（hitchhiking locus）的期望杂合度 H_h 与初始中性杂合度 H_0 之比，其中 c 为重组率，s 为选择系数，N 为有效群体大小。
formula-notes:formula_8.9:zh.inThisChapter: 本章介绍 hitchhiking 与选择性清除，公式 8.9 通过代入 c/s=0.01 和初始频率 p(0)=1/(2N) 到公式 8.8b 得到，用于量化选择性清除对连锁位点遗传多样性的削减程度，为后续讨论清除的检测与参数估计提供理论依据。

formula-notes:formula_8.10:en.plainMeaning: This formula approximates the ratio of the frequency of the i-th most frequent haplotype (n_i) to the most frequent haplotype (n_0) as a power-law function of the mutation rate μ, selection coefficient s, and rank i, simplifying to μ/(i s) when μ/s is small.
formula-notes:formula_8.10:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on neutral loci linked to a selected site to describe the expected haplotype frequency spectrum under genetic hitchhiking, supporting later arguments about the power-law distribution of haplotype classes.

formula-notes:formula_8.11:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the expected heterozygosity E[H(t)] at a neutral locus t generations after a selective sweep, as a function of the initial heterozygosity H0, effective population size Ne, selection coefficient s, and recombination rate c. The key symbols are H0 (equilibrium heterozygosity), Ne (effective population size), s (selection coefficient), c (recombination rate between neutral and selected sites), and t (time in generations).
formula-notes:formula_8.11:en.inThisChapter: It appears in this section to model the recovery of neutral diversity after a selective sweep, supporting the argument that linked neutral sites regain heterozygosity exponentially over time, with the rate determined by Ne and the initial reduction factor (4Ne s)^{-2c/s}.

formula-notes:formula_8.11:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算在选择性清除完成后t代时，与选择位点连锁的中性位点的期望杂合度E[H(t)]，它从清除刚结束时的降低值H0(4Ne s)^{-2c/s}开始，以速率1/(2Ne)指数回升至平衡杂合度H0。
formula-notes:formula_8.11:zh.inThisChapter: 出现在本章讨论选择性清除对连锁中性位点影响的部分，公式(8.11)通过指数衰减项e^{-t/(2Ne)}量化清除后突变恢复杂合度的过程，为后续理解清除后遗传多样性的恢复时间尺度提供定量描述。

formula-notes:formula_8.12a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算选择性清除后重复数方差的期望值V_h与初始方差V_0之比，其中β<1为缩放因子，p(0)为初始时与选择位点连锁的频率，c为重组率，s为选择系数。
formula-notes:formula_8.12a:zh.inThisChapter: 本节讨论中性位点与选择位点连锁时的行为，该公式是式(8.8b)的变体，引入β因子以考虑新突变对变异恢复的贡献，为后续推导完全连锁位点(式8.12b)和一般情况(式8.12c)的公式提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_8.12a:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the expected proportional reduction in variance at a neutral locus after a selective sweep, where V_h is the variance after the sweep, V_0 is the initial variance, β is a scaling factor (<1) accounting for new mutation, p(0) is the initial frequency of the selected allele, and 2c/s is twice the recombination rate divided by the selection coefficient.
formula-notes:formula_8.12a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in this section to quantify how linked neutral variation is reduced by a selective sweep, supporting later arguments about the footprint of selection on neutral diversity and the effect of recombination rate.

formula-notes:formula_8.12b:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the ratio of heterozygosity at a neutral locus (V_h) to its initial heterozygosity (V_0) after a selective sweep, where p(0) is the initial frequency of the neutral allele, μ is the mutation rate, c is the recombination rate, and s is the selection coefficient.
formula-notes:formula_8.12b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on linked neutral loci to quantify how hitchhiking reduces neutral diversity during a sweep, supporting the argument that recombination and mutation can restore variation after the sweep.

formula-notes:formula_8.12b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算在选择性扫荡过程中，与受选择位点连锁的中性位点的相对杂合度（V_h/V_0），其中p(0)是初始时未发生重组的单倍型频率，μ是突变率，c是重组率，s是选择系数。
formula-notes:formula_8.12b:zh.inThisChapter: 本章讨论中性位点与受选择位点连锁时的行为，公式8.12b给出了在扫荡期间突变和重组共同作用下杂合度衰减的定量关系，为后续比较不同参数下的扫荡效应提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_8.12c:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the expected heterozygosity V(t) at a neutral locus linked to a selected site after a selective sweep, as a function of time t. V₀ is the initial heterozygosity, p(0) is the initial frequency of the favored allele, μ is mutation rate, c is recombination rate, s is selection coefficient, and Nₑ is effective population size.
formula-notes:formula_8.12c:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on the behavior of a neutral locus linked to a selected site to model the recovery of genetic variation after a selective sweep, supporting later arguments about the time required to regain variation (e.g., t₀.₅ ≈ 1.4Nₑ generations).

formula-notes:formula_8.12c:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算在选择性清除后，与选择位点连锁的中性位点遗传多样性V(t)随时间t的恢复过程。其中V₀是初始多样性，p(0)是选择开始时衍生等位基因的频率，μ是突变率，c是重组率，s是选择系数，Nₑ是有效种群大小。
formula-notes:formula_8.12c:zh.inThisChapter: 本章讨论与选择位点连锁的中性位点的行为，公式8.12c是公式8.11的修正，引入了p(0)的指数项以考虑初始频率和重组/突变的影响，为后续讨论微卫星恢复变异的速度提供定量基础。

formula-notes:formula_8.13:en.plainMeaning: This formula transforms the presweep site frequency spectrum (SFS) φ(x) into the post-sweep SFS φ*(y) as a piecewise function of derived allele frequency y, depending on the sweep parameter fs (Equation 8.1d). Key symbols: θ (population mutation rate), N (population size), fs (frequency of the selected allele at the end of the sweep).
formula-notes:formula_8.13:en.inThisChapter: It appears in this section to model how a selective sweep at a linked site reshapes the neutral SFS, supporting later arguments about the reduction in genetic diversity and the distortion of the frequency spectrum due to hitchhiking.

formula-notes:formula_8.14:en.plainMeaning: This formula estimates the time τ (in generations) since the most recent common ancestor of a sample, using the observed number of segregating sites S, the mutation rate μ, and the sample size n. It is derived by equating the expected number of segregating sites (μnτ) to the observed S.
formula-notes:formula_8.14:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on linked neutral loci to provide a simple method-of-moments estimator for the coalescent time τ, which is used later to infer the timing of selective sweeps or demographic events from linked neutral variation.

formula-notes:formula_8.13:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将中性位点等位基因频率在选择性清除前的稳态分布φ(x)转换为清除后的位点频谱φ*(y)，其中y是清除后的等位基因频率，fs是选择性清除的关键参数（公式8.1d），θ是突变参数，N是群体大小。公式分三段：当y在[1/(2N), 1-fs]时，φ*(y)=θ(1/y - 1/(1-fs))；当y在(1-fs, fs)时，φ*(y)=0；当y在[fs, 1-1/(2N)]时，φ*(y)=θ/(1-fs)。
formula-notes:formula_8.13:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在本章讨论中性位点与选择位点连锁的章节，用于描述选择性清除后中性位点等位基因频率的预期分布，为后续推导清除后多态性模式（如核苷酸多样性π的减少）提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_8.15:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the relative heterozygosity (H_h/H_0) at a neutral locus linked to a selected site, as a function of recombination rate c, selection coefficient s, effective population size N_e, and the frequency x at which the sweep pauses.
formula-notes:formula_8.15:en.inThisChapter: It appears in this section to quantify how a selective sweep reduces neutral diversity at linked sites, supporting the argument that the reduction depends on the sweep's duration and recombination distance.

formula-notes:formula_8.15:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算在选择性扫荡暂停于频率x时，中性标记位点的杂合度H_h相对于初始杂合度H_0的比例，其中c是重组率，t_x是扫荡到达频率x所需时间，N_e是有效种群大小，s是选择系数。
formula-notes:formula_8.15:zh.inThisChapter: 此公式出现在讨论中性位点与受选择位点连锁时杂合度降低的章节，用于量化扫荡过程中重组对遗传多样性的影响，为后续推导扫荡后多样性恢复模式提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_8.16a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算软性选择性清除后，与完全连锁位点上的期望杂合度（H_h）相对于中性期望杂合度（H_0）的比例，其中θ_b = 4N_e μ_b是有利等位基因的标度突变率，N_e是有效群体大小，s是选择系数，c是重组率。
formula-notes:formula_8.16a:zh.inThisChapter: 本节讨论软性清除（soft sweeps），该公式与硬性清除的公式8.8c形成对比，说明即使位点完全连锁，遗传变异的丧失也不完全，为后续推导完全连锁时的极限形式（公式8.16b）和与硬性清除的比较提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_8.16a:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the expected relative heterozygosity (H_h/H_0) after a multiple-origin soft sweep, where H_h is heterozygosity after the sweep, H_0 is initial heterozygosity, θ_b = 4N_e μ_b is the scaled mutation rate for beneficial alleles, N_e is effective population size, s is selection coefficient, and c is the recombination fraction between the selected site and the neutral marker.
formula-notes:formula_8.16a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the 'Soft Sweeps' section to show that soft sweeps from recurrent mutation preserve more genetic diversity than hard sweeps, contrasting with Equation 8.8c for hard sweeps, and supporting the argument that the loss of variation is incomplete even for completely linked sites.

formula-notes:formula_8.16b:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the expected relative heterozygosity at a neutral site completely linked to a beneficial allele after a soft sweep, showing it approaches θ_b/(1+θ_b) as a function of the population mutation rate θ_b.
formula-notes:formula_8.16b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the 'Soft Sweeps' section to contrast with hard sweeps (Equation 8.8c), demonstrating that soft sweeps preserve more variation even at completely linked sites, supporting the argument that soft sweeps are less severe in reducing diversity.

formula-notes:formula_8.16b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算在软选择扫过（soft sweep）中，与选择位点完全连锁的中性位点（hitchhiking site）在扫过后相对于初始杂合度H0保留的杂合度比例Hh/H0，它等于θb/(1+θb)，其中θb=4Neμb是突变率参数。
formula-notes:formula_8.16b:zh.inThisChapter: 本节（SOFT SWEEPS）讨论软扫过对连锁中性变异的影响，公式(8.16b)与硬扫过的公式(8.8c)对比，说明即使完全连锁，软扫过也不会完全消除变异，为后续推导(8.16c)中θb对保留变异量的影响做铺垫。

formula-notes:formula_8.16c:en.plainMeaning: H12 computes haplotype homozygosity after merging the two most frequent haplotypes into one class, equal to H1 plus twice the product of their frequencies.
formula-notes:formula_8.16c:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the SOFT SWEEPS section to detect incomplete selective sweeps by capturing the excess of the top two haplotypes, supporting the argument that H12 is more sensitive than H1 to soft sweeps.

formula-notes:formula_8.16c:zh.plainMeaning: 公式将前两个单倍型频率合并为一类，计算其频率平方和加上其余单倍型频率平方和，等价于所有单倍型频率平方和加上两倍前两个频率的乘积，即 H1 加上 2p1p2。
formula-notes:formula_8.16c:zh.inThisChapter: 在“软扫描”章节中，该公式用于定义 H12 统计量，通过合并前两个高频单倍型来检测近期正选择信号，为后续比较 H1 与 H12 的差异提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_8.14:zh.plainMeaning: 公式 (8.14) 用观测到的分离位点数目 S 除以突变率 μ 和分支数 n 的乘积，来估计时间 τ（即从祖先到样本的累积分支长度）。
formula-notes:formula_8.14:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在推导中性位点与受选择位点连锁行为的章节中，它基于“期望分离位点数为 μnτ”这一关系，提供了一个简单的矩估计方法，用于从数据中估计 τ，为后续分析连锁效应奠定基础。

formula-notes:formula_8.17a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算从群体中已有的遗传变异（standing variation）出发，等位基因A最终在群体中固定（即发生软扫荡）的概率Pr_sv。它等于等位基因初始频率x的分布φ(x)乘以给定x时该等位基因在新环境下的固定概率u(x)的积分，积分区间从1/(2N)到1-1/(2N)。
formula-notes:formula_8.17a:zh.inThisChapter: 在“软扫荡”一节中，该公式将固定概率表达为对初始频率分布的期望，为后续推导软扫荡概率的具体表达式（如公式8.17b）提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_8.17a:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the probability that a sweep occurs from standing genetic variation (Pr_sv) as the expected value of the fixation probability u(x) under the new environment, integrated over the initial frequency x of the favored allele A, weighted by its stationary distribution φ(x) under mutation-drift balance.
formula-notes:formula_8.17a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the 'Soft Sweeps' section to quantify the probability of a soft sweep from standing variation, and it supports later arguments (e.g., Equation 8.17b) by providing the baseline probability that is then compared to the probability from new mutations.

formula-notes:formula_8.17b:en.plainMeaning: This formula approximates the probability of a soft sweep (Pr_sv) as 1 minus an exponential function of the scaled mutation rate θ_b and a ratio R, where R depends on dominance h, scaled selection coefficients α_b (new environment) and α_d (old environment).
formula-notes:formula_8.17b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the 'Soft Sweeps' section to quantify the probability that a beneficial mutation arises from standing genetic variation, supporting the argument that soft sweeps are more likely when mutation is recurrent or selection is weak.

formula-notes:formula_8.18a:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the expected number of beneficial mutations per generation that are destined to become fixed, where s is the selection coefficient, h is the dominance coefficient, N_e is the effective population size, N is the census population size, μ_b is the beneficial mutation rate per individual per generation, and θ_b = 4N_e μ_b is the beneficial mutation rate scaled by effective population size.
formula-notes:formula_8.18a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the 'Soft Sweeps' section to quantify the rate at which beneficial mutations establish, supporting the derivation of the mean establishment time t_e in Equation 8.18b.

formula-notes:formula_8.17b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式近似计算从新突变（软扫荡）中建立固定概率 Pr_sv，其中关键参数 R 表示新突变相对于背景选择（旧环境）的适应度优势，θ_b 是 scaled 突变率，h 和 h_d 分别是新、旧环境下的显性系数。
formula-notes:formula_8.17b:zh.inThisChapter: 在“软扫荡”章节中，公式 8.17b 基于扩散结果和 8.17a 的固定概率，给出了软扫荡发生的近似概率，为后续讨论软扫荡在适应性进化中的重要性提供定量基础。

formula-notes:formula_8.18a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算每代中注定被固定的有益突变出现的期望个数：第一项[4hs(Ne/N)]是有益突变被固定的概率（近似），第二项[2Nμb]是每代新产生的有益突变总数，两者相乘得到期望个数，并化简为2hsθb，其中θb=4Neμb。
formula-notes:formula_8.18a:zh.inThisChapter: 在“软扫描”章节中，公式(8.18a)用于推导有益突变在群体中建立的平均时间te（公式8.18b的倒数），从而量化软扫描发生的速率。

formula-notes:formula_8.18b:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the mean establishment time (t_e) for a new favorable mutation, where h is dominance, s is selection coefficient, and θ_b is the population-scaled beneficial mutation rate.
formula-notes:formula_8.18b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the 'SOFT SWEEPS' section to quantify how quickly a beneficial mutation becomes established, supporting the analysis of soft sweep dynamics and the expected number of such mutations arising per generation.

formula-notes:formula_8.18c:zh.plainMeaning: 公式计算在T代内至少出现一个注定固定的有利突变（即新突变）的概率，其中h是杂合效应，α_b是选择系数，θ_b是突变率参数，T是世代数。
formula-notes:formula_8.18c:zh.inThisChapter: 本节讨论软清扫（soft sweeps），该公式用于量化新突变（de novo mutation）在给定时间内出现的概率，为后续比较软清扫与硬清扫的等待时间提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_8.18c:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the probability that at least one favorable mutation destined for fixation appears by generation T, where h is the number of loci, α_b is the selection coefficient, and θ_b is the mutation rate parameter.
formula-notes:formula_8.18c:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the Soft Sweeps section to model the waiting time for a de novo mutation that will become fixed, supporting the argument that when α_b θ_b is small, the waiting time is long and soft sweeps from standing variation are more likely.

formula-notes:formula_8.19:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算有利等位基因（加性效应，h=0.5）在群体中固定所需的总等待时间（以世代为单位），其中第一项是成功突变首次出现的平均等待时间（建立时间，依赖于θ_b），第二项是固定时间（依赖于有效群体大小N_e和选择系数s）。
formula-notes:formula_8.19:zh.inThisChapter: 本章推导软清扫模型时，需要将建立时间（公式8.18b）与固定时间（公式8.4d）相加得到总固定时间，公式8.19正是这一整合结果，为后续比较软、硬清扫的时间尺度提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_8.18b:zh.plainMeaning: 公式(8.18b)计算新有利突变建立的平均时间t_e，它是(8.18a)中每代预期固定突变数2hsθ_b的倒数。
formula-notes:formula_8.18b:zh.inThisChapter: 在“SOFT SWEEPS”一节中，该公式由(8.18a)直接导出，用于量化软扫荡下有利突变建立的速率，为后续讨论建立时间与选择系数、突变率的关系提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_8.20:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算在时间T内发生选择性清除时，该清除源自已有等位基因（即standing sweep）的概率。分子是已有等位基因引起清除的先验概率Pr_sv，分母是Pr_sv与新生突变引起清除的概率(1-Pr_sv)Pr_new(T)之和，最终表达式通过θ_b、R、h、α_b等参数给出具体形式。
formula-notes:formula_8.20:zh.inThisChapter: 在“软清除”章节中，该公式用于区分选择性清除的来源是已有变异还是新生突变，为后续讨论软清除的检测和特征提供概率基础。

formula-notes:formula_8.20:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the probability that a sweep by generation T originates from a standing (existing) allele rather than a new mutation. Key symbols: Pr_ex(T) = probability of existing allele given sweep by T, Pr_sv = probability of standing variation, Pr_new(T) = probability of new mutation sweep by T, θ_b = population-scaled mutation rate, R = recombination rate, h = dominance coefficient, α_b = selection coefficient.
formula-notes:formula_8.20:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the Soft Sweeps section to quantify the relative contribution of standing variation versus new mutations to adaptive sweeps, supporting the argument that soft sweeps are more likely when standing variation is abundant.

formula-notes:formula_8.19:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the total expected time (in generations) for a favorable additive allele to fix in a population, combining the waiting time for the first successful mutation (establishment time, involving θ_b) and the subsequent time for that mutation to spread to fixation (involving Ne and s).
formula-notes:formula_8.19:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the Soft Sweeps section to quantify the expected duration of a selective sweep when adaptation uses standing genetic variation or recurrent mutation, supporting later arguments about the probability and timescale of soft sweeps versus hard sweeps.

formula-notes:formula_8.21:en.plainMeaning: This formula gives an upper bound for the probability that a soft sweep (multiple independent beneficial lineages) occurs in a sample of size n, expressed in terms of the population-scaled mutation rate θ_b and the harmonic sum up to n-1, approximated by Euler's constant plus ln(n-1).
formula-notes:formula_8.21:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the 'Soft Sweeps' section to quantify how the probability of detecting multiple origins increases with sample size, supporting the argument that soft sweeps become more likely in large samples even with low mutation rates.

formula-notes:formula_8.21:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式给出了在样本大小为n时发生多起源软清扫（即样本中至少有两个独立谱系）的概率的上界，它等于突变率θ_b乘以调和级数前n-1项的和，近似为θ_b乘以欧拉常数0.577加上ln(n-1)。
formula-notes:formula_8.21:zh.inThisChapter: 本节（SOFT SWEEPS）讨论软清扫的概率，公式8.21利用θ_b和样本大小n给出了一个简洁的上界，为后续比较软清扫与硬清扫的相对概率以及理解选择强度α_b的作用提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_8.22a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算在软扫荡场景下，从近乎零频率到固定过程中，新出现有利突变数量的期望值。关键符号：N为种群大小，μb为有利突变率，τ为突变从出现到固定的平均时间，θb=4Neμb为种群突变率参数，αb=2Nes为选择强度参数。
formula-notes:formula_8.22a:zh.inThisChapter: 本章讨论软扫荡，即多个有利突变同时或先后出现并共同固定。公式8.22a为后续推导软扫荡概率（公式8.22b）提供基础，它量化了在固定时间内出现的新有利突变总数，从而评估多个突变同时存在的可能性。

formula-notes:formula_8.22a:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the expected number of new favorable mutations that arise during a selective sweep, given the population size N, effective size N_e, beneficial mutation rate μ_b, selection coefficient s, and sojourn time τ. Key symbols: N (census size), N_e (effective size), μ_b (mutation rate per site per generation), s (selection coefficient), τ (sojourn time), θ_b = 4N_e μ_b (population-scaled mutation rate), α_b = 2N_e s (population-scaled selection coefficient).
formula-notes:formula_8.22a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the 'Soft Sweeps' section to quantify the contribution of recurrent mutation to soft sweeps, supporting the argument that when the expected number of new mutations is large, soft sweeps become likely. It connects to Equation 8.22b, which gives the probability of a soft sweep.

formula-notes:formula_8.22b:en.plainMeaning: This formula estimates the expected number of new beneficial mutations that arise and increase in frequency during a soft sweep, where θ_b is the population-scaled mutation rate for beneficial mutations, N_e is the effective population size, and s is the selection coefficient.
formula-notes:formula_8.22b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the Soft Sweeps section to quantify the contribution of new mutations to soft sweeps, supporting the argument that soft sweeps can involve multiple beneficial haplotypes when the mutation rate is high.

formula-notes:formula_8.23:en.plainMeaning: This formula defines the characteristic dispersal length χ, which combines the rate of spread ν and the rate of new successful mutations λ, or equivalently the dispersal distance σ, population density ρ, beneficial mutation rate μ_b, and selection coefficient s.
formula-notes:formula_8.23:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the 'Soft Sweeps' section to quantify the spatial scale over which a beneficial mutation spreads, supporting later arguments about the conditions for soft sweeps versus hard sweeps in continuous populations.

formula-notes:formula_8.22b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算在软选择性清除过程中，能够成功增加频率并最终被固定的新有利突变的数量期望值，其中θ_b是群体突变率，N_e是有效群体大小，s是选择系数。
formula-notes:formula_8.22b:zh.inThisChapter: 本章讨论软选择性清除，公式8.22b由公式8.22a乘以2s(N_e/N)得到，用于量化在有利等位基因固定过程中，从突变池中产生的新有利突变数量，为后续分析软清除的遗传信号提供理论预期。

formula-notes:formula_8.23:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式定义了特征扩散长度χ，它等于（ν/(πλ)）^(1/3)，其中ν是传播速率，λ是新成功突变出现的速率；第二个等式将χ表示为σ（扩散率）、ρ（密度）、μ_b（突变率）和s（选择系数）的函数。
formula-notes:formula_8.23:zh.inThisChapter: 在“软扫”章节中，χ作为关键模型参数出现，用于量化等位基因在空间中的扩散尺度，为后续推导等位基因频率的空间分布和扫描时间提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_8.24a:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the rate λ at which beneficial mutations arise and fix in the population per nucleotide per generation, as the product of the mutation rate (2Nμ_b) and the fixation probability (2sN_e/N), simplifying to θ_b s where θ_b = 4N_e μ_b.
formula-notes:formula_8.24a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on genome-wide impact of repeated selection to quantify the rate of selective sweeps, which is then used in subsequent equations (8.24b–d) to model the effects of linked selection on neutral diversity.

formula-notes:formula_8.24a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算每代每个核苷酸位点上新有益突变固定到群体中的速率λ，等于每代新有益突变数(2Nμb)乘以单个突变固定概率(2sNe/N)，简化后为θb·s，其中θb=4Neμb是核苷酸水平的多样性参数。
formula-notes:formula_8.24a:zh.inThisChapter: 在本节“重复选择对连锁位点的全基因组影响”中，公式8.24a用于量化选择扫荡发生的速率，为后续推导背景选择对中性位点多样性的影响（如公式8.24b-d）提供基础参数λ。

formula-notes:formula_8.24b:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the reduction in neutral nucleotide diversity (π) relative to its equilibrium value (π₀) due to recurrent selective sweeps, where λ is the rate of sweeps, γ is the selection coefficient, κ is a factor depending on the sweep model, and c₀ is the per-nucleotide recombination rate.
formula-notes:formula_8.24b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on the genome-wide impact of repeated selection at linked sites to quantify how recurrent sweeps reduce heterozygosity across the genome, supporting the argument that linked selection is a major force shaping patterns of genetic diversity.

formula-notes:formula_8.24b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算在反复选择性清除（recurrent sweeps）下，连锁中性位点的核苷酸多样性π相对于无选择平衡状态π₀的比例，其中c₀是区域平均每核苷酸重组率，λ是选择性清除的发生率，γ是选择强度，κ是清除的效应范围。
formula-notes:formula_8.24b:zh.inThisChapter: 本节讨论反复选择性清除对基因组中性多样性的整体影响，公式8.24b给出了预期杂合度降低的近似表达式，为后续推导8.24c和8.24d中更精确的近似形式奠定基础。

formula-notes:formula_8.24c:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式表示在连锁选择影响下，核苷酸多样性π相对于中性期望π₀的比值近似为1减去λγκ/c₀，并进一步近似为指数形式exp(-λγκ/c₀)，其中λ是选择事件发生率，γ是选择强度，κ是常数约0.075，c₀是重组率。
formula-notes:formula_8.24c:zh.inThisChapter: 在本章关于连锁选择对基因组广泛影响的讨论中，该公式由公式8.24b通过小参数近似推导而来，为后续公式8.24d的指数形式提供基础，用于量化选择性清除对遗传多样性的衰减效应。

formula-notes:formula_8.24c:en.plainMeaning: This formula approximates the reduction in neutral nucleotide diversity (π/π₀) due to linked selection, where λ is the rate of selective sweeps, γ is the selection coefficient, κ ≈ 0.075 is a constant, and c₀ is the recombination rate. It shows that diversity decreases approximately linearly with λγκ/c₀ when this ratio is small, and can be expressed as an exponential decay.
formula-notes:formula_8.24c:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on genome-wide impact of repeated selection to provide a simple analytical approximation for the reduction in diversity caused by linked selection, supporting later arguments about the expected relationship between recombination rate and diversity across the genome.

formula-notes:formula_8.24d:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the average nucleotide diversity π in a genomic region as a linear function of the inverse of the per-base recombination rate c0, where π0 is the baseline diversity in the absence of linked selection, λ is the rate of selective sweeps per base, γ is the selection coefficient, and κ is a constant related to the hitchhiking effect.
formula-notes:formula_8.24d:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on genome-wide impact of repeated selection at linked sites to provide a simple regression model (Stephan regression) that predicts how linked selection reduces diversity as recombination rate decreases, supporting the argument that background selection and hitchhiking shape genomic variation patterns.

formula-notes:formula_8.24d:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将平均核苷酸多样性π表示为每碱基重组率c₀的倒数x=1/c₀的线性函数，其中π₀是当c₀→∞（即无连锁干扰）时的基准多样性，λ是选择性清除率，γ是选择系数，κ是常数。
formula-notes:formula_8.24d:zh.inThisChapter: 本章探讨连锁位点重复选择对基因组范围的影响，该公式（Stephan回归）通过线性近似量化了重组率降低（c₀小）导致多样性π下降的幅度，为后续比较不同区域多样性模式提供了定量预测。

formula-notes:formula_8.25:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将核苷酸多样性π表示为中性期望π₀、重组率c和氨基酸发散率d_a的函数，通过参数β = αγκ/(2t)和x = d_a/c，最终简化为π = π₀/(1+βx)，其中β衡量选择性清除的强度。
formula-notes:formula_8.25:zh.inThisChapter: 在讨论连锁位点重复选择对基因组的影响时，该公式将理论模型（公式8.24b）转化为可检验的回归形式，为后续利用多物种数据估计β和验证选择性清除假说提供定量框架。

formula-notes:formula_8.26:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the expected reduction in nucleotide diversity (π/π₀) due to recurrent partial sweeps, where λ is the rate of sweeps, ζ is a function of sweep duration, and c₀ is the neutral mutation rate.
formula-notes:formula_8.26:en.inThisChapter: It appears in this section to quantify how linked selection from partial sweeps reduces neutral diversity, supporting the argument that recurrent sweeps can mimic background selection effects.

formula-notes:formula_8.25:en.plainMeaning: This formula estimates the expected nucleotide diversity (π) under recurrent hitchhiking, where π₀ is the neutral diversity, c is the recombination rate per codon, λ is the rate of adaptive substitutions per amino acid site, γ is the scaled selection coefficient, κ is a constant, and βx captures the reduction in diversity relative to the neutral expectation.
formula-notes:formula_8.25:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on genome-wide impacts of linked selection to derive a regression model (Andolfatto regression) that relates the reduction in diversity (π/π₀) to the ratio of amino acid divergence to recombination rate (x = dₐ/c), enabling empirical tests of the recurrent hitchhiking hypothesis using polymorphism and divergence data.

formula-notes:formula_8.26:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算中性位点核苷酸多样性π相对于其基线值π₀的比例，近似等于1除以(1+λζ/c₀)，其中λ是选择事件发生率，ζ是部分扫荡达到目标频率所需时间的函数（由公式8.4e定义），c₀是重组率参数。
formula-notes:formula_8.26:zh.inThisChapter: 本章讨论与选择位点连锁的中性位点的行为，此公式出现在“部分扫荡”的背景下，扩展了公式8.24b的完全扫荡结果，用于描述重复部分扫荡对核苷酸多样性的影响，并为后续理解基因组中多样性模式提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_8.27a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式给出了考虑连锁干扰后，基因组尺度上适应性替代速率Λ（或每位点速率λ）的近似表达式，其中Λ₀（或λ₀）为忽略干扰时的预期速率，C（或c₀）为总重组率（或相邻核苷酸间平均重组率）。
formula-notes:formula_8.27a:zh.inThisChapter: 本章讨论重复选择在连锁位点上的全基因组影响，此公式用于量化干扰效应如何降低适应性替代速率，为后续推导更精确的表达式（如公式8.27b）提供基础近似。

formula-notes:formula_8.27b:en.plainMeaning: This formula expresses the scaled rate of adaptation Λ/C as a function of the initial scaled rate Λ₀/C, showing saturation at high Λ₀/C.
formula-notes:formula_8.27b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on genome-wide impact of linked selection to derive the upper limit of adaptation (Λ ≃ C/2) for very large populations, supporting the argument that repeated selection limits adaptation.

formula-notes:formula_8.27b:zh.plainMeaning: 公式(8.27b)将实际适应速率Λ（除以C）表示为初始适应速率Λ₀（除以C）的函数，具体形式为Λ/C ≈ (Λ₀/C) / (1 + 2Λ₀/C)，其中Λ₀是初始适应速率，C是染色体总长度（或c₀是每代每染色体的交换率）。
formula-notes:formula_8.27b:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在讨论连锁位点重复选择对全基因组影响的章节中，用于推导当群体极大（Λ₀/C ≫ 1）时适应速率的上限Λ ≈ C/2，从而说明连锁对适应速率的限制作用。

formula-notes:formula_8.28:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the probability that a gamete carries no deleterious mutations, assuming mutations occur at rate U and are eliminated by selection with coefficient s. The key symbols are f₀ (mutation-free probability), U (genomic deleterious mutation rate per generation), and s (selection coefficient against heterozygotes).
formula-notes:formula_8.28:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on genome-wide impact of linked selection to quantify the fraction of individuals free of deleterious mutations, which is used to model the reduction in neutral diversity due to background selection.

formula-notes:formula_8.28:zh.plainMeaning: 公式 (8.28) 计算的是在突变-选择平衡下，一个配子不携带任何有害突变的概率，其中 U 是基因组有害突变率，s 是选择系数，指数中的 -U/(2s) 是平衡时每个配子中突变数的期望值。
formula-notes:formula_8.28:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在讨论连锁位点重复选择对基因组影响的章节中，用于量化背景选择（background selection）下中性位点有效种群大小的减少程度，为后续推导有效种群大小与重组率的关系提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_8.29a:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the ratio of nucleotide diversity at a neutral locus (π) to its expected value without selection (π₀), approximated as an exponential decay function of the total deleterious mutation rate U, the selection coefficient s, and the recombination rate C.
formula-notes:formula_8.29a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on genome-wide impact of repeated selection at linked sites to quantify how background selection reduces neutral diversity across a genomic region, supporting the argument that recombination can mitigate this effect.

formula-notes:formula_8.29a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算中性位点核苷酸多样性π与无背景选择时的期望值π₀之比，近似等于exp(-U/(2s+C))，其中U是区域总二倍体有害突变率，C是区域总重组率，s是有害突变的选择系数。
formula-notes:formula_8.29a:zh.inThisChapter: 本章讨论连锁位点反复选择对全基因组的影响，公式8.29a引入重组后背景选择对中性多样性的削弱效应，为后续推导更精确的近似公式8.29b和8.29c提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_8.29b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算在连锁位点反复选择下，核苷酸多样性π相对于中性期望π₀的比值，近似等于exp(-2μ/c₀)，其中μ是每个核苷酸的有害突变率，c₀是每个核苷酸的重组率。
formula-notes:formula_8.29b:zh.inThisChapter: 出现在讨论连锁位点反复选择对基因组广泛影响的章节，公式(8.29b)表明当区域内重组总量远大于选择强度s时，杂合度下降近似与选择强度无关，为后续比较背景选择与选择性清除的效应提供关键近似。

formula-notes:formula_8.29b:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the approximate reduction in nucleotide diversity (π/π₀) due to background selection, where μ is the deleterious mutation rate per nucleotide and c₀ is the recombination rate per nucleotide. It shows that the decline in heterozygosity depends only on the ratio 2μ/c₀ and is independent of selection strength when recombination is large relative to selection.
formula-notes:formula_8.29b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on genome-wide impact of repeated selection at linked sites to quantify the effect of background selection on neutral diversity. This expression supports the argument that when recombination is sufficiently high, the reduction in heterozygosity is determined solely by mutation and recombination rates, not by the strength of selection.

formula-notes:formula_8.29c:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式近似表示，在中等至高重组率（2μ/c0远小于1）条件下，中性位点的核苷酸多样性π相对于其基准值π0的比值约等于1减去2μ/c0，其中μ是每代每个位点的突变率，c0是重组率。
formula-notes:formula_8.29c:zh.inThisChapter: 本章讨论反复选择性清除对基因组连锁位点的影响，公式8.29c从指数近似（公式8.24c）出发，利用e^x≈1-x的线性近似，给出了在重组率较高时多样性下降的简单线性表达式，为后续理解重组率如何缓冲选择性清除效应提供了定量基础。

formula-notes:formula_8.29c:en.plainMeaning: This formula approximates the reduction in neutral nucleotide diversity (π/π₀) due to recurrent selective sweeps, where π is the observed diversity, π₀ is the diversity without selection, μ is the rate of adaptive substitutions per site, and c₀ is the recombination rate per site.
formula-notes:formula_8.29c:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on genome-wide impact of repeated selection to provide a simple linear approximation for the diversity reduction under moderate to high recombination, supporting the argument that recurrent sweeps can substantially reduce diversity even when recombination is common.

formula-notes:formula_8.30a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算在背景选择（BGS）和选择性清除共同作用下的相对核苷酸多样性π/π₀，其中f₀是BGS校正后的有效种群大小比例，c₀是重组率相关常数，λₓ是选择性清除速率，γ是选择强度，κ是清除参数。
formula-notes:formula_8.30a:zh.inThisChapter: 本章讨论连锁位点重复选择对全基因组的影响，公式8.30a整合了背景选择和选择性清除两种效应，为后续推导联合模型（如公式8.30b）提供基础，并解释为何实际多样性低于单一机制预测。

formula-notes:formula_8.30a:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the relative nucleotide diversity (π/π₀) under the joint effects of background selection (BGS) and recurrent selective sweeps. Key symbols: π is observed diversity, π₀ is neutral diversity, f₀ is the BGS reduction factor, c₀ is the neutral recombination rate, λc is the rate of sweeps, γ is the scaled selection strength, and κ is a constant related to sweep dynamics.
formula-notes:formula_8.30a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on genome-wide impact of repeated selection to model the combined effect of BGS and sweeps on diversity, supporting the argument that both processes operate simultaneously and can be approximated by modifying Equation 8.24b.

formula-notes:formula_8.30b:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the reduction in neutral diversity (π/π₀) due to repeated partial selective sweeps, where f₀ is the neutral coalescence rate, η is the product of the rate of new favorable mutations and the pairwise coalescence rate due to sweeps, and c₀ is a scaling constant.
formula-notes:formula_8.30b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in this section to generalize Equation 8.30a from hard sweeps to partial sweeps, supporting the argument that repeated selection at linked sites reduces genome-wide diversity even when sweeps are incomplete.

formula-notes:formula_8.30b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算在部分选择性清除（partial sweeps）影响下，核苷酸多样性（π）相对于中性期望值（π₀）的比值，其中η是每代新有利突变数乘以每次清除导致的成对溯祖率，f₀是中性位点频率，c₀是重组率。
formula-notes:formula_8.30b:zh.inThisChapter: 本章讨论连锁位点重复选择的全基因组影响，公式8.30b将公式8.30a从完全清除推广到部分清除情形，为后续分析重复选择如何降低基因组多样性提供定量基础。

formula-notes:formula_8.31a:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the reduction factor B_i for effective population size at site i due to background selection, where μ_i is the mutation rate at site i, s is the selection coefficient, c_{ij} is the recombination distance between sites i and j, and φ_j(s) is the distribution of fitness effects for site class j.
formula-notes:formula_8.31a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to hitchhiking and selective sweeps to quantify how background selection reduces neutral diversity, supporting later arguments that such reductions must be accounted for when inferring selective sweeps from genomic data.

formula-notes:formula_8.31a:zh.plainMeaning: 公式(8.31a)计算背景选择对位点i有效群体大小N_e的缩减因子B_i，其中μ_i是位点i的突变率，c_{ij}是位点i与第j类选择位点的重组距离，s是选择系数，φ_j(s)是第j类位点选择系数的分布。
formula-notes:formula_8.31a:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在“搭车与选择性清除”章节的背景选择部分，用于量化背景选择对中性位点有效群体大小的削减，为后续推导B_i与N_e的关系以及背景选择对遗传多样性的影响提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_8.31b:zh.plainMeaning: 公式 (8.31b) 计算在存在 v 类功能位点（每类有 k_ℓ 个位点，突变率 μ_ℓ，适合度效应分布 φ_ℓ）时，背景选择系数 B_i，即通过指数函数对各类位点中每个位点的选择效应（积分项）求和后取负指数。
formula-notes:formula_8.31b:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式扩展了 (8.31a) 中单一类型位点的背景选择模型，用于处理基因组中不同功能类别（如替换位点和保守区域）的复合效应，为后续利用基因组数据估计背景选择强度提供更现实的框架。

formula-notes:formula_8.31b:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the probability that a neutral site i escapes a selective sweep, accounting for v classes of functional sites, each with mutation rate μℓ and distribution of deleterious fitness effects φℓ(s), and with kℓ sites in class ℓ having recombination distance cij from the sweep. The exponential integrates over all linked sites and selection coefficients s.
formula-notes:formula_8.31b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to hitchhiking and selective sweeps to extend the basic sweep model (Equation 8.31a) to multiple functional classes, enabling the analysis of background selection and selective sweeps in complex genomes with heterogeneous functional elements.

formula-notes:formula_8.32:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the equilibrium frequency of a preferred codon (p̃) as a function of the scaled selection strength (γ = 2Nₑs) and mutation bias (ζ = μP→U / μU→P).
formula-notes:formula_8.32:en.inThisChapter: It appears in this section to model how linked selection (via reduced Nₑ) alters the expected frequency of preferred codons, supporting the argument that repeated selection at linked sites reduces the efficacy of selection on synonymous codon usage.

formula-notes:formula_9.1a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算两个时间点（0 和 t）等位基因频率估计值之差，其中 p̂₀ 是初始时间点的样本频率，p̂ₜ 是 t 时间点的样本频率，差值 δ̂ₜ 表示等位基因频率的估计变化量。
formula-notes:formula_9.1a:zh.inThisChapter: 本节讨论单群体等位基因频率变化，该公式直接定义观测到的频率差异，为后续推导方差和检验遗传漂变提供基础估计量。

formula-notes:formula_8.32:zh.plainMeaning: 公式(8.32)近似计算突变-选择-漂变平衡下最优密码子的期望频率 $\widetilde{p}$，其中 $\gamma = 2N_e s$ 衡量选择强度，$\zeta = \mu_{P\to U} / \mu_{U\to P}$ 衡量突变偏倚。
formula-notes:formula_8.32:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在讨论连锁选择对基因组广泛影响的章节，用于量化选择与突变偏倚如何共同决定密码子使用频率，为后续分析有效种群大小 $N_e$ 的降低提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_9.1a:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the estimated change in allele frequency between time 0 and time t, where \(\widehat{p}_t\) is the estimated frequency at time t and \(\widehat{p}_0\) is the estimated initial frequency.
formula-notes:formula_9.1a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in this section to quantify allele-frequency change over time, serving as the basis for estimating evolutionary parameters such as effective population size or selection coefficients in later analyses.

formula-notes:formula_9.1b:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the variance of the estimated allele-frequency change (δ̂_t = p̂_t − p̂_0) as the sum of the variances of p̂_t and p̂_0 minus twice their covariance, accounting for sampling error in both estimates.
