formula-notes:formula_9.1b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on allele-frequency change to quantify the sampling variance of the estimated divergence, supporting later arguments about the expected neutral divergence and tests for selection.

formula-notes:formula_9.1b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算等位基因频率变化量估计值（真实变化量加上抽样误差）的方差，它等于当前频率估计值的方差加上初始频率估计值的方差，再减去两倍两者的协方差。
formula-notes:formula_9.1b:zh.inThisChapter: 本章讨论单群体等位基因频率变化，公式9.1b将变化量的方差分解为两个时间点估计方差的组合，为后续推导抽样方差随世代累积的表达式（如公式9.2）提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_9.2a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算初始等位基因频率估计值 p̂₀ 的抽样方差，其中 p₀ 是真实频率，n₀ 是初始样本容量（每个等位基因的样本数，因此总样本数为 2n₀）。
formula-notes:formula_9.2a:zh.inThisChapter: 在本节中，该公式用于量化从二项分布抽样得到的初始频率估计的误差，为后续推导包含遗传漂变和抽样误差的最终频率方差（公式 9.2b-9.2d）提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_9.2a:en.plainMeaning: This formula gives the sampling variance of the estimated initial allele frequency (p̂₀) due to binomial sampling from a finite number of individuals (n₀), where p₀ is the true initial frequency.
formula-notes:formula_9.2a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on allele-frequency change to quantify the error introduced when estimating the starting frequency from a sample, which is then combined with drift variance in subsequent equations (9.2b–9.2d) to model the total variance of the final frequency estimate.

formula-notes:formula_9.2b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算最终等位基因频率估计值 p̂_t 的方差，它由初始频率 p₀、最终样本大小 n_t 和有效群体大小 N_e 共同决定。第一行是精确表达式，第二行是近似式，将方差分解为采样方差 p₀(1-p₀)/(2n_t) 和遗传漂变方差 p₀(1-p₀)·t/(2N_e) 的加权和。
formula-notes:formula_9.2b:zh.inThisChapter: 在推导了初始采样方差（9.2a）后，本节需要同时考虑遗传漂变和后续采样对最终频率方差的影响。该公式为后续的假设检验和置信区间估计（如9.2c、9.2d）提供了方差基础。

formula-notes:formula_9.2b:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the variance of the estimated allele frequency after t generations, incorporating both sampling variance (from finite sample size n_t) and genetic drift variance (from effective population size N_e). Key symbols: p_0 (initial allele frequency), n_t (sample size at generation t), N_e (effective population size), t (number of generations).
formula-notes:formula_9.2b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on allele-frequency change in a single population to quantify the total uncertainty in the final estimated frequency, supporting later arguments about detecting selection or demographic events by comparing observed variance to neutral expectations.

formula-notes:formula_9.2c:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the approximate variance of the estimated allele frequency change (δ̂_t) over t generations, where p0 is the initial allele frequency, n0 and nt are sample sizes at times 0 and t, and Ne is the effective population size.
formula-notes:formula_9.2c:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on allele-frequency change in a single population to quantify the sampling variance of the estimated change when sampling is done before reproduction, supporting later inference about genetic drift and effective size.

formula-notes:formula_9.2c:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算等位基因频率变化量δ_t的估计方差，其中p0为初始频率，n0和nt分别为初始和t世代样本量，Ne为有效群体大小，t为世代数。
formula-notes:formula_9.2c:zh.inThisChapter: 在章节中，该公式由式9.1b代入式9.2a和9.2b推导得出，用于量化在繁殖前无放回抽样条件下，频率变化估计的抽样方差，为后续比较不同抽样策略（如式9.2d）提供基准。

formula-notes:formula_9.2d:zh.plainMeaning: 该统计量是观测到的等位基因频率变化量δ̂_t的平方除以其方差σ²(δ̂_t)，用于检验遗传漂变是否显著，近似服从χ²分布。
formula-notes:formula_9.2d:zh.inThisChapter: 在单群体等位基因频率变化章节中，该公式基于零假设（遗传漂变）下δ̂_t的方差由式9.2c给出，构建卡方检验统计量，为后续Waples调整检验提供具体计算方法。

formula-notes:formula_9.2d:en.plainMeaning: This is a test statistic that compares the squared observed allele-frequency change (δ̂_t²) to its variance under the null hypothesis of random genetic drift, yielding an approximate chi-squared distribution with 1 degree of freedom.
formula-notes:formula_9.2d:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on allele-frequency change to provide a formal significance test for detecting selection or other forces beyond drift, supporting the Waples adjusted test for single-population data.

formula-notes:formula_9.3:en.plainMeaning: This is the variance-covariance matrix of the two sample allele frequency estimates at generations 0 and t, with diagonal entries being their variances and off-diagonal being the covariance.
formula-notes:formula_9.3:en.inThisChapter: It appears here to define the sampling error structure needed for the generalized least-squares (GLS) estimator of the initial allele frequency p0, which accounts for correlated errors across time points.

formula-notes:formula_9.4:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the generalized least squares (GLS) estimate of the initial allele frequency p0, where 1 is a vector of ones, V is the covariance matrix of allele frequency estimates, and p is the vector of observed allele frequencies.
formula-notes:formula_9.4:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on allele-frequency change to provide a method for estimating the initial frequency p0 from multiple time points while accounting for correlated errors, supporting later inference of evolutionary parameters.

formula-notes:formula_9.3:zh.plainMeaning: 该矩阵V是样本估计量向量(̂p₀, ̂pₜ)的方差-协方差矩阵，对角元σ²(̂p₀)和σ²(̂pₜ)分别表示两个估计量的方差，非对角元σ(̂p₀, ̂pₜ)表示它们的协方差。
formula-notes:formula_9.3:zh.inThisChapter: 在推导p₀的广义最小二乘（GLS）估计量时，需要知道样本估计量的方差-协方差结构，公式(9.3)提供了这个矩阵，为后续构造GLS权重和计算估计量方差奠定基础。

formula-notes:formula_9.4:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式通过广义最小二乘（GLS）回归，在仅估计截距（即所有时间点的共同初始等位基因频率 p0）时，给出 p0 的加权平均估计：分子是加权和（权重为 V⁻¹），分母是权重之和。
formula-notes:formula_9.4:zh.inThisChapter: 本章讨论单群体等位基因频率变化，公式 (9.4) 来自对时间序列数据的 GLS 回归，为后续估计有效群体大小或检验选择提供基础估计量。

formula-notes:formula_9.5a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式通过反正弦平方根变换将等位基因频率 p_t 转换为 y_t，并说明在 t 相对于 N_e 较小时，y_t 近似服从均值为初始变换值 y_0、方差为 t/(2N_e) 的正态分布。
formula-notes:formula_9.5a:zh.inThisChapter: 本节讨论单个群体等位基因频率的随机变化，该变换用于稳定方差，使得后续可以基于正态分布进行统计推断，为公式 9.5b-9.5d 中似然函数和检验统计量的推导奠定基础。

formula-notes:formula_9.5a:en.plainMeaning: This formula transforms the allele frequency p_t into a variable y_t via an arcsine square-root transformation, and states that y_t is approximately normally distributed with mean y_0 (the transformed initial frequency) and variance t/(2N_e).
formula-notes:formula_9.5a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on allele-frequency change to provide a variance-stabilizing transformation that allows the use of normal theory for inference about allele frequency changes over time, supporting later derivations of likelihood-based tests and confidence intervals.

formula-notes:formula_9.5b:en.plainMeaning: This formula defines the vector y as twice the arcsine-square-root transformation of each sampled allele frequency p_i, and 1 as a vector of ones of the same length. y and 1 are used to compute temporal allele-frequency change.
formula-notes:formula_9.5b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on allele-frequency change to provide a variance-stabilizing transformation for the sampled frequencies, supporting later arguments about estimating effective population size from temporal samples.

formula-notes:formula_9.5b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将k个样本等位基因频率估计值p_i通过反正弦平方根变换（角变换）得到向量y，每个分量乘以2；同时定义了一个全1向量1，长度与y相同。
formula-notes:formula_9.5b:zh.inThisChapter: 在讨论样本间时间间隔的章节中，该变换用于稳定方差，使得后续可以基于正态分布假设构建等位基因频率变化的线性模型（如公式9.5c和9.5d），从而估计有效种群大小或时间间隔。

formula-notes:formula_9.5c:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the variance of the estimated allele frequency at generation t_i, accounting for sampling error (1/(2n_{t_i})) and genetic drift (t_i/(2N_e)), with an approximation that drops the small correction term.
formula-notes:formula_9.5c:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on allele-frequency change to quantify the uncertainty in frequency estimates over time, supporting later arguments about hypothesis testing and confidence intervals for frequency trajectories.

formula-notes:formula_9.5c:zh.plainMeaning: 公式9.5c计算的是第i个样本对应的等位基因频率观测值的方差V_{ii}，它由两部分组成：第一部分1/(2n_{t_i})来自当前样本的抽样方差，第二部分(t_i/(2N_e))来自遗传漂变随时间累积的方差，其中n_{t_i}是第t_i代的样本大小，N_e是有效群体大小。
formula-notes:formula_9.5c:zh.inThisChapter: 在本章中，该公式用于构建等位基因频率观测值的方差-协方差矩阵V，为后续通过广义最小二乘法估计有效群体大小N_e和推断群体历史提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_9.5d:en.plainMeaning: This formula gives the covariance between allele-frequency estimates at two different time points (i and j, with t_j < t_i) as the variance of drift up to the earlier time t_j, specifically t_j/(2N_e).
formula-notes:formula_9.5d:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on allele-frequency change to quantify the shared drift history between two sample points, which is needed for constructing the covariance matrix of estimates and for later arguments about effective size estimation.

formula-notes:formula_9.5d:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算两个不同时间点（t_j < t_i）的等位基因频率估计值之间的协方差，等于较早时间点t_j除以两倍有效群体大小2N_e。关键符号：V_{i,j}和V_{j,i}表示对称协方差，t_j是较早世代数，N_e是有效群体大小。
formula-notes:formula_9.5d:zh.inThisChapter: 在本节中，公式9.5d是公式9.5a-9.5c的延续，用于描述多个时间点样本间等位基因频率的方差-协方差结构，为后续推导似然函数或估计有效群体大小提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_9.6a:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the generalized least-squares (GLS) estimate of the transformed initial allele frequency, where y is the vector of observed transformed frequencies, V is the covariance matrix of the observations, and 1 is a vector of ones.
formula-notes:formula_9.6a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on allele-frequency change to provide a method for estimating the initial frequency under a linear model with correlated errors, supporting later inference on drift or selection parameters.

formula-notes:formula_9.6a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式通过广义最小二乘（GLS）估计初始等位基因频率的变换值 ŷ₀，其中分子是权重矩阵 V⁻¹ 加权的观测向量 y 的总和，分母是所有权重之和。
formula-notes:formula_9.6a:zh.inThisChapter: 本节将等位基因频率变化建模为线性模型，公式 (9.6a) 利用 GLS 给出初始频率的估计，为后续推导频率变化量的方差和检验统计量（如 (9.6b)、(9.6c)）提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_9.6b:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the vector of deviations δ_y by subtracting the estimated common allele frequency ŷ₀ (multiplied by a vector of ones) from the observed allele frequency vector y, representing the differences between observed and expected frequencies under the null hypothesis.
formula-notes:formula_9.6b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on allele-frequency change to define the deviations needed for the test statistic in Equation 9.6c, which tests for significant allele-frequency differences across populations.

formula-notes:formula_9.6b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算每个等位基因频率的观测值向量 y 与所有等位基因频率的公共估计值 ŷ₀ 乘以全1向量 1 后的差值，得到偏差向量 δ_y，其中每个分量表示对应等位基因频率偏离公共估计的程度。
formula-notes:formula_9.6b:zh.inThisChapter: 在单群体等位基因频率变化检验中，公式(9.6b)通过构造偏差向量，为后续公式(9.6c)的卡方检验统计量提供输入，该统计量用于检验群体是否偏离哈代-温伯格平衡或等位基因频率是否相等。

formula-notes:formula_9.6c:zh.plainMeaning: 该表达式计算的是偏差向量 δ_y 的加权平方和，其中 V^{-1} 是协方差矩阵的逆，用于对等位基因频率差异进行标准化。
formula-notes:formula_9.6c:zh.inThisChapter: 在本节中，该统计量用于检验等位基因频率变化是否显著，其近似服从 χ² 分布，为后续的显著性检验提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_9.6c:en.plainMeaning: This is a quadratic form that computes the weighted sum of squared deviations of allele-frequency estimates from their mean, using the inverse of the covariance matrix V as weights. δ_y is the vector of deviations, V is the covariance matrix.
formula-notes:formula_9.6c:en.inThisChapter: It appears in this section to define a test statistic for detecting allele-frequency differences among populations, which under the null hypothesis follows a chi-square distribution with k-1 degrees of freedom.

formula-notes:formula_9.7a:en.plainMeaning: This formula models the transformed allele frequency y_t as a linear function of time t, where μ is the intercept (transformed initial frequency), β is the slope (trend coefficient), and e is the error term. It tests for a significant linear trend in allele frequency over time.
formula-notes:formula_9.7a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on allele-frequency change to provide a simple lack-of-fit test against the drift-only model (β=0). The test supports distinguishing drift from directional forces like selection or migration, which would produce a linear trend.

formula-notes:formula_9.7a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将等位基因频率的某种变换值 y_t 建模为时间 t 的线性函数，其中 μ 是变换后的初始频率，β 是斜率（表示每单位时间的线性变化），e 是随机误差。
formula-notes:formula_9.7a:zh.inThisChapter: 在本节中，该公式用于检验等位基因频率变化是否具有显著的线性趋势，以区分遗传漂变（β=0）与定向选择（β≠0），并为后续的 Fisher-Ford 检验（假设 β=0）提供对比模型。

formula-notes:formula_9.7b:en.plainMeaning: This formula defines the design matrix X and parameter vector β for a linear model of allele frequency change over time, and gives the generalized least squares (GLS) estimator β̂ that accounts for correlated errors via the covariance matrix V.
formula-notes:formula_9.7b:en.inThisChapter: It appears here to formalize the linear trend model for allele frequency change, enabling estimation of the intercept μ and slope β while properly weighting observations by their variances and covariances (from Equations 9.5c and 9.5d).

formula-notes:formula_9.7b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将线性模型 y = Xβ + e 中的设计矩阵 X 和参数向量 β 具体化，其中 X 的第一列为全1（对应截距 μ），第二列为时间点 t_i；β 包含截距 μ 和斜率 β；然后给出广义最小二乘估计量 β̂ = (X^T V^{-1} X)^{-1} X^T V^{-1} y，它通过加权最小化残差来估计参数。
formula-notes:formula_9.7b:zh.inThisChapter: 在本节中，该公式将等位基因频率随时间的变化建模为线性趋势（加上漂移误差），为后续利用实际数据（如例9.2）计算参数估计和检验趋势显著性提供了具体表达式，并依赖于前面给出的协方差矩阵 V（公式9.5c和9.5d）。

formula-notes:formula_9.8:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the squared difference between estimated allele frequencies in two populations at time t, denoted as δ̂_t, where p̂_{t,1} and p̂_{t,2} are the sample frequencies in populations 1 and 2.
formula-notes:formula_9.8:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to detect recent selection by measuring divergence between populations, supporting later arguments that an unusually large δ̂_t may indicate selection rather than drift.

formula-notes:formula_9.8:zh.plainMeaning: 公式 (9.8) 计算在时间 t 时两个群体间等位基因频率的平方差，其中 p̂_{t,1} 和 p̂_{t,2} 分别是两个群体在时间 t 的样本等位基因频率。
formula-notes:formula_9.8:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在介绍利用分子数据检测近期选择信号的章节中，用于量化两个群体从共同祖先分离后的遗传分化程度，为后续讨论选择如何影响群体间分化提供度量基础。

formula-notes:formula_9.9:en.plainMeaning: This formula relates the fixation index F_ST to time t and effective population size N_e, showing that ln(1 - F_ST) is approximately equal to -t/(2N_e) when drift is the only force. Key symbols: F_ST (fixation index), t (time in generations), N_e (effective population size).
formula-notes:formula_9.9:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on divergence between two populations to derive a method for estimating separation time from F_ST, supporting the argument that excessive F_ST values imply longer drift time.

formula-notes:formula_9.9:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式通过对F_ST取对数，将群体分化时间t与有效群体大小N_e联系起来，近似得到ln(1-F_ST) ≈ -t/(2N_e)，从而将F_ST转化为漂变所需的分化时间。
formula-notes:formula_9.9:zh.inThisChapter: 在本节中，该公式用于从F_ST估计两个群体间的分化时间T（以2N_e为单位），为后续利用F_ST值推断群体分离时间提供理论基础。

formula-notes:formula_9.10a:en.plainMeaning: This formula shows that the scaled F_ST value, (n-1)F_ST / mean_F_ST, follows a chi-squared distribution with n-1 degrees of freedom, where n is the number of populations, F_ST is the observed value at a locus, and mean_F_ST is the average across loci.
formula-notes:formula_9.10a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on two-population comparisons to provide a statistical test for neutrality: under the null hypothesis that all loci are neutral, the test statistic follows a known distribution, allowing detection of outlier loci subject to selection.

formula-notes:formula_9.10a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将观测到的F_ST乘以(n-1)后除以所有位点的平均F_ST，得到服从自由度为n-1的卡方分布的统计量，用于检验F_ST是否显著偏离中性期望。
formula-notes:formula_9.10a:zh.inThisChapter: 在本节中，该公式用于构建F_ST的抽样分布，以便后续通过卡方检验判断位点是否受选择，并为公式9.10b和9.10c中计算p值和置信区间提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_9.10b:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the approximate variance of F_ST across markers, where σ²(F_ST) ≈ 2 F̄_ST² / (n-1), with n being the number of populations and F̄_ST the mean F_ST.
formula-notes:formula_9.10b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on two-population comparisons to quantify the sampling variance of F_ST estimates, supporting later inference of confidence intervals or hypothesis tests for population divergence.

formula-notes:formula_9.10c:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式用样本F统计量的中位数除以卡方分布中位数来估计缩放因子λ，其中med(F)是F统计量的样本中位数，med(χ²_{n-1})是自由度为n-1的卡方分布的理论中位数。
formula-notes:formula_9.10c:zh.inThisChapter: 在双总体比较中，当分布非正态时，用中位数替代均值以稳健估计λ，为后续基于中位数的假设检验提供参数估计。

formula-notes:formula_9.10b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算F_ST的方差近似值，其中F_ST近似等于λ乘以自由度为n-1的卡方变量，利用卡方方差为2(n-1)得到方差为2(n-1)λ²，再代入λ的期望表达式，最终用观测均值F̄_ST近似表示为2F̄_ST²/(n-1)。
formula-notes:formula_9.10b:zh.inThisChapter: 在比较两个群体分化程度时，公式9.10b给出了F_ST估计量的抽样方差，为后续公式9.10c构建置信区间和假设检验提供了基础。

formula-notes:formula_9.10c:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes an estimate of the scale parameter λ as the ratio of the median of the observed F-statistic to the median of a chi-squared distribution with n-1 degrees of freedom. Here, med(F) is the sample median of the F-values, and med(χ²_{n-1}) is the median of the reference chi-squared distribution.
formula-notes:formula_9.10c:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on two-population comparisons to provide a robust alternative to moment-based estimation of λ, using medians instead of means to reduce sensitivity to outliers. This estimator supports later arguments for robust divergence measures between populations.

formula-notes:formula_9.11:en.plainMeaning: This formula models the logit-transformed F_ST for locus i in population j as a sum of an intercept (1), a population-specific effect β_j, a locus-specific effect α_i, and an error term ε, enabling detection of loci under selection.
formula-notes:formula_9.11:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on two-population comparisons to provide a statistical framework for identifying outlier loci that deviate from neutral expectations, supporting later arguments about adaptive divergence.

formula-notes:formula_9.12:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算FLK检验统计量，衡量各亚群等位基因频率向量p与祖先频率估计值p̂₀的加权偏差平方和，其中权重由协方差矩阵ℱ⁻¹决定，分母p̂₀(1-p̂₀)用于标准化。
formula-notes:formula_9.12:zh.inThisChapter: 在讨论等位基因频率与环境变量相关性的章节中，该公式用于检测受选择作用的位点，通过比较观测频率与中性期望频率的差异，为后续基于卡方分布的显著性检验提供统计量。

formula-notes:formula_9.12:en.plainMeaning: The FLK statistic tests for correlation between allele frequencies and environmental variables by computing a weighted sum of squared deviations of observed frequencies p from the estimated ancestral frequency p̂₀, scaled by the variance under drift. Key symbols: p (vector of observed allele frequencies), p̂₀ (estimated ancestral frequency), 1 (vector of ones), ℱ (covariance matrix of allele frequencies due to shared ancestry).
formula-notes:formula_9.12:en.inThisChapter: This formula appears in the section on detecting selection by correlating allele frequencies with environmental variables. It extends the Lewontin–Krakauer test to account for population structure and supports the argument that significant deviations from neutral expectations indicate adaptive responses to environmental gradients.

formula-notes:formula_9.11:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将位点i在群体j中的F_ST值经过logit变换后，分解为全局均值1、群体特异性效应β_j、位点特异性效应α_i和随机误差ε之和，用于建模F_ST的变异来源。
formula-notes:formula_9.11:zh.inThisChapter: 在双群体比较章节中，该公式为后续通过贝叶斯层次模型估计α_i和β_j提供线性框架，从而识别受选择位点（α_i异常）和群体分化模式（β_j差异）。

formula-notes:formula_9.13a:en.plainMeaning: This formula maps a normally distributed latent variable θ to the observed allele frequency p, truncating p to the [0,1] interval: p=0 if θ≤0, p=θ if 0<θ<1, and p=1 if θ≥1.
formula-notes:formula_9.13a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on allele-frequency correlations with environmental variables to model bounded allele frequencies via a latent normal variable, supporting later regression analyses (e.g., Equation 9.13b) that relate p to environmental predictors.

formula-notes:formula_9.13a:zh.plainMeaning: 该分段函数将潜在变量θ映射到等位基因频率p，当θ≤0时p=0，当0<θ<1时p=θ，当θ≥1时p=1，从而将θ限制在[0,1]区间内。
formula-notes:formula_9.13a:zh.inThisChapter: 此公式出现在等位基因频率与环境变量相关性章节，用于解决线性回归预测的p值可能超出[0,1]的问题，为后续使用潜在变量θ构建正态分布模型（如公式9.13b）提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_9.13b:en.plainMeaning: This formula states that the vector of allele frequencies Θ across n populations follows a multivariate normal distribution with mean p₀·1 (the ancestral frequency) and covariance matrix p₀(1-p₀)Ω, where Ω is the empirical covariance matrix estimated from neutral markers.
formula-notes:formula_9.13b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on allele-frequency correlations with environmental variables to model the null distribution of allele frequencies under drift alone, which later arguments compare against observed correlations to detect selection.

formula-notes:formula_9.13b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式表示n个群体中某个等位基因的频率向量Θ服从多元正态分布，其均值向量为p₀乘以全1向量，协方差矩阵为p₀(1-p₀)乘以Ω，其中p₀是祖先频率，Ω是等位基因频率的协方差矩阵的经验估计。
formula-notes:formula_9.13b:zh.inThisChapter: 在本节中，该公式用于描述等位基因频率在群体间的联合分布，为后续推导等位基因频率与环境变量之间的相关性检验提供基础，特别是通过Ω捕捉群体间因漂移和共同祖先产生的相关性结构。

formula-notes:formula_9.13c:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes a test statistic for extreme allele frequency divergence, where p is a vector of observed allele frequencies, Ω is a covariance matrix, and p̂₀ is a weighted mean allele frequency that minimizes the quadratic form.
formula-notes:formula_9.13c:en.inThisChapter: It appears in this section to provide a test for correlations between allele frequencies and environmental variables, extending the framework of Equation 9.12 by replacing the kinship matrix ℱ with the covariance matrix Ω.

formula-notes:formula_9.13c:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算一个检验统计量，用于衡量等位基因频率向量 p 与全局平均频率估计值 p̂₀ 的加权偏差，其中权重由协方差矩阵 Ω 的逆决定，分母 p̂₀(1-p̂₀) 是二项方差项。关键符号：p 是等位基因频率向量，p̂₀ 是加权平均频率，Ω 是协方差矩阵。
formula-notes:formula_9.13c:zh.inThisChapter: 本节讨论等位基因频率与环境变量的相关性，此公式出现在将 Θ 替换为 p 后，用于检验单个位点的极端分化，其形式与公式 9.12 相同但协方差矩阵 Ω 替换了 ℱ，为后续推导多基因评分或基因组扫描提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_9.13d:en.plainMeaning: This formula specifies that the vector of transformed allele frequencies Θ follows a multivariate normal distribution across n populations, with mean equal to the baseline frequency p0 (a vector of ones) plus the linear effect of environmental variables Xβ, and covariance matrix p0(1-p0)Ω, where Ω is the covariance structure from the null model.
formula-notes:formula_9.13d:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to using molecular data for detecting recent selection, extending the null model (Equation 9.13c) to include environmental covariates, thereby setting up a framework to test for selection by assessing whether environmental variables explain allele frequency variation beyond the null expectation.

formula-notes:formula_9.13d:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式表示等位基因频率向量Θ服从n维多元正态分布，其均值向量为p0·1n（全局等位基因频率）加上环境协变量X的线性效应Xβ，方差-协方差矩阵为p0(1-p0)Ω，其中Ω是群体间协方差矩阵。
formula-notes:formula_9.13d:zh.inThisChapter: 此公式在9.13c的基础上引入环境变量X的线性效应，构建了检测选择的全模型，为后续通过似然比检验比较有无环境效应的模型（如公式9.13e）提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_9.13e:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes a test statistic for selection, measuring the weighted squared deviation of observed allele frequencies p from the expected frequencies under a neutral model with environmental covariates Xβ, normalized by the binomial variance p̂₀(1-p̂₀). Key symbols: p (observed frequencies), p̂₀ (baseline frequency), X (design matrix), β (covariate effects), Ω (covariance matrix).
formula-notes:formula_9.13e:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to extend the base quadratic form (Equation 9.13c) to include environmental variables, supporting the development of a more general test for selection that accounts for confounding factors.

formula-notes:formula_9.13e:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算在环境变量影响下，观测到的等位基因频率向量p与模型预测均值（p̂₀1 + Xβ̂）之间的加权残差平方和，其中权重矩阵Ω⁻¹考虑了协方差结构，分母p̂₀(1-p̂₀)用于标准化。
formula-notes:formula_9.13e:zh.inThisChapter: 它出现在本章介绍部分，用于构建一个包含环境协变量的检验统计量，为后续检测自然选择信号提供基础，通过比较有环境变量和无环境变量模型的拟合优度来推断选择效应。

formula-notes:formula_9.14:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将第i个位点、第j个群体的对数方差v_ij分解为位点主效应v_i·、群体主效应v_·j、总均值v_··以及残差e_ij之和，类似于双因素方差分析模型。
formula-notes:formula_9.14:zh.inThisChapter: 在讨论中性变异染色体模式变化的章节中，该公式用于在无位点×群体互作和连锁不平衡的假设下，将观测到的对数方差分解为位点和群体效应，为后续检验不同染色体区域的选择信号或中性演化提供统计基础。

formula-notes:formula_9.14:en.plainMeaning: This formula decomposes the observed log-variance v_ij for locus i in population j into a grand mean v_··, locus effect v_i·, population effect v_·j, and residual e_ij, under an additive ANOVA model.
formula-notes:formula_9.14:en.inThisChapter: It appears here to model neutral variation across loci and populations, supporting later arguments about partitioning variance components to detect selection or population structure.

formula-notes:formula_9.15a:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the likelihood of a mixed bottleneck model at locus i, where a fraction (1−q) of the genome experiences a bottleneck of strength b₁ and a fraction q experiences a stronger bottleneck b₂ (< b₁). The key symbols are: q (proportion of genome under stronger bottleneck), b₁, b₂ (bottleneck strengths), Sᵢ (number of segregating sites at locus i), and L(bⱼ|Sᵢ) (likelihood of bⱼ given Sᵢ).
formula-notes:formula_9.15a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in this section to model heterogeneity in bottleneck strength across the genome, supporting the argument that a mixture of bottlenecks (rather than a single one) better explains the observed pattern of neutral variation in maize. This likelihood is then used in Equation 9.15b to compute the full likelihood across independent loci.

formula-notes:formula_9.15b:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the posterior probability that a sampled chromosome carries the derived allele (b2) given the observed SNP pattern Si, using Bayes' theorem. Key symbols: Pr(b2|Si) is the posterior probability of b2 given Si; q is the prior probability of b2; L(bj|Si) is the likelihood of observing Si given allele bj.
formula-notes:formula_9.15b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in this section to show how to infer the allelic state at a focal site from linked neutral variation, supporting later arguments about detecting selective sweeps or demographic events from patterns of polymorphism.

formula-notes:formula_9.15a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将位点i的似然函数表示为两个混合成分的加权平均：以概率(1-q)经历瓶颈强度b1，以概率q经历更强的瓶颈强度b2，其中L(bj|Si)是给定分离位点数Si时瓶颈强度bj的似然函数。
formula-notes:formula_9.15a:zh.inThisChapter: 此公式出现在讨论中性变异染色体模式变化的章节，用于构建混合瓶颈模型，为后续公式(9.15b)中全基因组似然函数（假设位点独立）的乘积形式提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_9.15b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式利用贝叶斯定理，根据观察到的DNA序列模式S_i，计算该模式来自染色体类型b_2（即携带突变）的后验概率，其中q是先验概率，L(b_j|S_i)是似然。
formula-notes:formula_9.15b:zh.inThisChapter: 在讨论中性变异染色体模式变化的章节中，该公式用于从观察到的序列数据推断染色体类型，为后续分析重组和突变对模式分布的影响提供概率基础。

formula-notes:formula_9.16a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算在样本量n和模型参数向量Θ下，某个分离位点i上观察到ki个突变拷贝的概率。它通过二项式系数乘以对等位基因频率x的积分，其中x的分布由位点i的频率谱φ_i(x|Θ)给出。
formula-notes:formula_9.16a:zh.inThisChapter: 本章讨论中性变异的染色体模式变化，该公式基于方程2.36c，将单个位点的等位基因频率谱φ_i(x|Θ)与样本中观察到的突变计数ki的概率联系起来，为后续推导多位点联合概率（如9.16b-d）奠定基础。

formula-notes:formula_9.16a:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the probability that a segregating site i has ki copies of the derived allele in a sample of n sequences, given model parameters Θ. It integrates the binomial sampling probability over the population allele frequency x weighted by the site-specific frequency spectrum φi(x|Θ).
formula-notes:formula_9.16a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on neutral variation to model the expected pattern of allele frequencies under a given evolutionary scenario (e.g., population size changes). The formula supports later derivations of composite likelihood methods for estimating Θ from genomic data.

formula-notes:formula_9.16b:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the reduction in neutral diversity at a linked site due to a selective sweep, where f_{s,i} is the probability of escaping a sweep, c_i is the recombination fraction, s is the selection coefficient, h is the dominance coefficient, N_e is the effective population size, and λ = ln(4N_e s)/(2hs).
formula-notes:formula_9.16b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on changes in neutral variation to quantify the effect of a selective sweep on linked neutral sites, supporting later arguments about the genomic pattern of diversity after a sweep.

formula-notes:formula_9.16b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算选择性清除在基因座i处的强度f_{s,i}，它等于(4N_e s)^{-c_i/(2h s)}或e^{-c_i λ}，其中c_i是重组分数，λ=(1/(2hs))ln(4N_e s)。
formula-notes:formula_9.16b:zh.inThisChapter: 本章讨论中性变异的染色体模式变化，此公式用于量化选择性清除对连锁位点的影响，为后续结合方程8.13计算φ_i提供参数f_{s,i}。

formula-notes:formula_9.16c:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将整个数据向量k（包含m个位点的k_i值）的似然函数表示为每个位点似然函数L(Θ|k_i, n)的乘积，即假设位点间独立。
formula-notes:formula_9.16c:zh.inThisChapter: 本章讨论中性变异染色体模式，该公式用于构建基于多位点数据的联合似然函数，为后续极大似然估计Θ提供基础，但上下文指出相邻位点因共享历史而相关，因此该乘积并非正确似然。

formula-notes:formula_9.16c:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the joint likelihood of the scaled mutation rate Θ given the vector of site-specific allele counts k and sample size n, as the product over m sites of the site-specific likelihoods L(Θ|k_i, n).
formula-notes:formula_9.16c:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on neutral variation to define a composite likelihood for estimating Θ from multiple sites, but the text notes it is not a proper likelihood due to correlations among sites, setting up the need for methods that account for linkage.

formula-notes:formula_9.16d:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算复合似然比Λ_CLR，分子是在给定重组率λ和选择位点位置c_i下最大化复合似然L(θ, f_s(λ,c_i) | k)，分母是在无选择（f_s=0）下最大化复合似然L(θ, f_s=0 | k)，比值衡量选择模型相对于中性模型的拟合优度。
formula-notes:formula_9.16d:zh.inThisChapter: 本节介绍中性变异染色体模式的变化，该公式用于构建复合似然比检验（CLRT），通过比较有选择和无选择下的最大复合似然，检测选择性扫荡并估计选择位点位置。

formula-notes:formula_9.17a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算在给定位点i的衍生等位基因频率为p_i时，从n个样本中观察到k_i个衍生等位基因拷贝的概率，即二项分布的概率质量函数。
formula-notes:formula_9.17a:zh.inThisChapter: 本章讨论中性变异染色体模式的变化，该公式作为L_A模型的基础，用于描述观察数据在未知频率p_i下的似然，为后续推导联合似然函数（如公式9.17b-9.17d）提供概率框架。

formula-notes:formula_9.16d:en.plainMeaning: This is the composite likelihood ratio (CLR) test statistic comparing the maximum composite likelihood under a selective sweep model (with selection coefficient fs and position λ) to that under neutrality (fs=0). Key symbols: Λ_CLR is the test statistic; L is the composite likelihood; θ is the neutral mutation rate; fs is the selection coefficient; λ is the position of the selected site; ci are the data; k is the observed allele frequency spectrum.
formula-notes:formula_9.16d:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on changes in neutral variation patterns during selective sweeps, providing a statistical test to detect selection by comparing the fit of sweep vs. neutral models. This supports later arguments about identifying selected sites from polymorphism data.

formula-notes:formula_9.17a:en.plainMeaning: This formula gives the likelihood of observing k_i copies of the derived allele in a sample of n chromosomes, assuming a binomial sampling distribution with unknown allele frequency p_i at site i.
formula-notes:formula_9.17a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on changes in neutral variation patterns to define the likelihood function for a single site under the L_A model, which is then combined across sites in subsequent equations (9.17b–9.17d) to estimate the distribution of allele frequencies.

formula-notes:formula_9.17b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算在给定观测到的i等位基因拷贝数k_i时，最大似然估计p̂_i = k_i/n下的似然函数值L_A，即二项分布概率质量函数在p̂_i处的取值。
formula-notes:formula_9.17b:zh.inThisChapter: 本节讨论中性变异染色体模式的变化，该公式给出每个位点i的似然函数在MLE处的值，为后续计算似然比统计量（如公式9.17c、9.17d）提供基础，用于比较不同假设下的拟合优度。

formula-notes:formula_9.17b:en.plainMeaning: This formula gives the likelihood of observing k_i derived alleles in a sample of n chromosomes, evaluated at the maximum-likelihood estimate p̂_i = k_i/n. It is the binomial probability mass function with p replaced by the sample proportion.
formula-notes:formula_9.17b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on changes in neutral variation to compute the likelihood ratio test statistic (9.17c) for detecting selection, by comparing the likelihood at the MLE to the likelihood under the null hypothesis (9.17a).

formula-notes:formula_9.17c:zh.plainMeaning: 公式 (9.17c) 计算复合似然函数的最大值，它是将每个多态性水平 i（i=1 到 n-1）对应的公式 (9.17b) 的 n_i 次幂连乘起来，其中 n_i 是样本中具有 i 个衍生等位基因的位点数目。
formula-notes:formula_9.17c:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在讨论中性变异染色体模式变化的章节，用于将单个位点的最大似然（公式 9.17b）扩展到多个位点，从而构建复合似然比检验统计量，为后续推断种群历史（如瓶颈效应）提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_9.17c:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the maximum composite likelihood (max(CL_A)) as the product over all polymorphism levels i (1 to n-1) of the i-th likelihood from Equation 9.17b, each raised to the power n_i (the count of sites with i derived alleles). Key symbols: n = sample size (number of chromosomes), i = number of derived alleles at a site, n_i = number of sites with i derived alleles.
formula-notes:formula_9.17c:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on changes in the chromosomal pattern of neutral variation to provide a likelihood-based method for estimating the ancestral recombination graph or population parameters from polymorphism data, supporting later arguments about detecting selection or demographic events.

formula-notes:formula_9.17d:en.plainMeaning: Λ_GOF is the log-likelihood ratio comparing the maximum composite likelihood under the alternative (sweep) model (max(CL_A)) to that under the null (neutral) model (max(CL_0)).
formula-notes:formula_9.17d:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on changes in neutral variation patterns to provide a statistical test for detecting selective sweeps by comparing the fit of sweep vs. neutral models to the data.

formula-notes:formula_9.17d:zh.plainMeaning: Λ_GOF 是复合似然比检验统计量，取两个复合似然函数最大值之比的自然对数：分子 max(CL_A) 是备择假设（存在选择性清除）下的最大复合似然值，分母 max(CL_0) 是零假设（中性模型）下的最大复合似然值。
formula-notes:formula_9.17d:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在讨论中性变异染色体模式变化的章节，用于构建检验选择性清除的统计量。它基于公式 9.17a-9.17c 定义的复合似然函数，通过比较两种假设下的拟合优度来推断是否发生选择性清除。

formula-notes:formula_9.18b:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the probability of observing i derived alleles in a sample of M lineages after a selective sweep, by averaging over the hypergeometric probability of sampling i derived alleles from a pre-sweep sample of n lineages that contained j derived alleles, weighted by the probability p_j of having j derived alleles before the sweep.
formula-notes:formula_9.18b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on changes in neutral variation after a sweep, providing a key component for calculating the likelihood of observed polymorphism patterns, which is later used to infer sweep parameters or test for selection.

formula-notes:formula_9.18a:en.plainMeaning: This formula gives the probability that exactly ℓ out of n sampled lineages escape a selective sweep, where each lineage has success probability 1−f_s = 1−e^{-cλ}, with c the recombination rate to the sweep site and λ a selection-strength parameter from Equation 9.16b.
formula-notes:formula_9.18a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on changes in neutral variation patterns to model the site-frequency spectrum after a sweep, supporting later arguments (Equations 9.18b, 9.18c) that use this binomial distribution to compute expected allele frequencies and diversity measures.

formula-notes:formula_9.18a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算在经历一次选择性清除后，一个中性位点样本中观察到ℓ个衍等位基因的概率。其中n是样本大小，f_s是未经历清除的谱系比例，1-f_s是经历清除的谱系比例，c是重组率，λ是选择强度参数。
formula-notes:formula_9.18a:zh.inThisChapter: 此公式出现在讨论中性变异染色体模式变化的章节，用于描述选择性清除对等位基因频率谱的影响，为后续推导清除后位点频率分布的期望和方差（如公式9.18b和9.18c）提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_9.18b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算在选择性清除后，从M个谱系中观察到i个衍生等位基因的概率，通过对清除前样本中衍生等位基因拷贝数j（j从i到n-1）求和，并乘以超几何概率项。
formula-notes:formula_9.18b:zh.inThisChapter: 出现在讨论中性变异染色体模式变化的章节，用于描述选择性清除对等位基因频率分布的影响，为后续推导似然函数和检验统计量提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_9.18c:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算在选择性清除后，样本中中性变异拷贝数 i 的概率 p_{S,i}。它由两部分组成：第一部分 P_e(n)p_i 表示有利突变未与样本关联（即样本全部来自非携带者）的概率；第二部分求和项处理有利突变与样本关联的情况，其中 Pr(i+1+ℓ-n|ℓ+1) 和 Pr(i|ℓ+1) 分别对应样本中初始 ℓ+1 个谱系在清除后产生 i 或 i+1+ℓ-n 个拷贝的概率，并乘以相应的系数 (i+1+ℓ-n)/(ℓ+1) 或 (ℓ+1-i)/(ℓ+1)。
formula-notes:formula_9.18c:zh.inThisChapter: 本章讨论中性变异在选择性清除过程中的模式变化。公式 (9.18c) 整合了 (9.18a) 和 (9.18b) 的结果，给出了样本中中性变异拷贝数分布的完整似然，为后续推导清除后样本的期望多样性等统计量奠定基础。

formula-notes:formula_9.19a:en.plainMeaning: This formula gives the approximate normal distribution of an allele's frequency x(t) at generation t, starting from initial frequency p0, with variance proportional to t and the neutral variance p0(1-p0)/(2Ne).
formula-notes:formula_9.19a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to recent selection detection to establish the neutral expectation of allele frequency change under drift, which later arguments (e.g., Equation 9.19b) use to contrast with selection-driven deviations.

formula-notes:formula_9.19a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式表示在遗传漂变下，等位基因频率 x(t) 近似服从正态分布，均值为初始频率 p₀，方差为 t 乘以 p₀(1-p₀)/(2Nₑ)，其中 t 为世代数，Nₑ 为有效群体大小。
formula-notes:formula_9.19a:zh.inThisChapter: 本章利用该公式构建维纳过程，为后续推导选择检测的统计检验（如公式 9.19b）提供中性漂变下的频率分布基础。

formula-notes:formula_8.27a:en.plainMeaning: This formula corrects the expected rate of adaptation (Λ or λ) for interference among linked selected sites, where Λ0 (or λ0) is the rate without interference, C (or c0) is the total (or per-nucleotide) recombination rate, and the denominator accounts for the reduction due to interference.
formula-notes:formula_8.27a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on genome-wide impact of repeated selection to quantify how interference from linked selected sites reduces the effective rate of adaptation, supporting later arguments about the limits of adaptation in genomes with high density of selected sites.

formula-notes:formula_7.32:en.plainMeaning: This formula gives the stationary ratio of the probability that a population is fixed for the optimal allele A versus the suboptimal allele a, as a function of the mutation rate ratio (v/μ) and the scaled selection coefficient S = 4N_e s.
formula-notes:formula_7.32:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to show how selection (via e^S) and mutation (via v/μ) jointly determine the balance between fixation states, setting the stage for later analysis of the interaction of selection, mutation, and drift.

formula-notes:formula_9.21c:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes a t-statistic to test whether two different estimators of the population mutation rate θ (θ̂_i and θ̂_j) are significantly different, normalized by the standard deviation of their difference.
formula-notes:formula_9.21c:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on tests based on the site-frequency spectrum to provide a general form for comparing two θ estimators, which is used to construct neutrality tests such as Tajima's D and others listed in Table 9.1.

formula-notes:formula_8.3a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式近似计算当有利等位基因A固定时，中性等位基因B的频率变化Δ_q，它等于初始时刻B与A的连锁不平衡δ_q(0)乘以A的初始频率p(0)的c/s次幂，其中c是重组率，s是选择系数。
formula-notes:formula_8.3a:zh.inThisChapter: 在介绍搭车效应和选择性清除的章节中，该公式用于量化选择对中性位点频率的影响，为后续推导选择性清除的固定概率f_s（公式8.3b）提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_9.20a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算基于分离位点S的θ估计值与基于折叠单态η1的θ估计值之差，除以标准差√(α*S+β*S²)，得到检验统计量D*。
formula-notes:formula_9.20a:zh.inThisChapter: 此处用于构建Fu和Li的D*检验，通过比较两种θ估计量的差异来检测选择信号，为后续推导方差系数α*和β*提供统计量形式。

formula-notes:formula_8.7a:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the expected heterozygosity H at a neutral marker after a selective sweep, given initial heterozygosity H0, initial marker frequency q(0), and the change Δq due to hitchhiking.
formula-notes:formula_8.7a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on hitchhiking to quantify how a selective sweep reduces neutral diversity, and it supports the derivation of the expected reduction in heterozygosity in subsequent equations (8.7b–d).

formula-notes:formula_9.19b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式表示候选群体中等位基因频率 x 近似服从均值为参考群体频率 p_r、方差为 σ² = β p_r (1-p_r) 的正态分布，其中 β 为与群体大小等相关的参数，且方差远小于1。
formula-notes:formula_9.19b:zh.inThisChapter: 在介绍利用分子数据检测近期单次选择事件的章节中，该公式给出了纯漂变模型下候选群体频率的分布，为后续通过比较观测频率与期望分布来推断选择提供了零分布基础。

formula-notes:formula_9.22a:en.plainMeaning: This formula gives the expected number of segregating sites with exactly i copies of the derived allele (unfolded, ζ_i) or the minor allele (folded, η_i) in a sample of n sequences, where θ = 4N_e μ is the scaled mutation rate.
formula-notes:formula_9.22a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on site-frequency spectrum statistics to provide the neutral expectation under the standard coalescent, which is used to construct test statistics (e.g., Tajima's D) that compare observed spectra to this baseline.

formula-notes:formula_9.20a:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the D* test statistic by comparing two estimators of θ: one based on segregating sites (S) and the other on folded singletons (η1*), normalized by a variance term that depends on S and constants α* and β*.
formula-notes:formula_9.20a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on tests based on the site-frequency spectrum to detect deviations from neutral evolution, supporting the argument that D* can identify selection or demographic effects by contrasting different θ estimators.

formula-notes:formula_9.21b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式说明在计算方差时，用观测到的S/a_n替换θ，用S(S-1)/(a_n^2+b_n)替换θ²，其中S是分离位点数，a_n和b_n是依赖于样本量n的常数。
formula-notes:formula_9.21b:zh.inThisChapter: 本章基于位点频谱统计量进行检验，公式9.21b提供了将理论参数θ和θ²替换为基于观测数据S的估计量的具体方法，为后续计算Tajima's D等检验统计量的方差奠定基础。

formula-notes:formula_9.19b:en.plainMeaning: This formula models the distribution of allele frequency x in a candidate population as a normal distribution centered at the reference frequency p_r, with variance σ² = β p_r (1-p_r) that is much less than 1, where β is a scaling factor related to population size or drift.
formula-notes:formula_9.19b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to detect selection from recent single events, providing a null distribution under pure drift against which selection can be tested, and supports later arguments that deviations from this distribution indicate selection.

formula-notes:formula_9.21a:en.plainMeaning: This formula gives four estimators of the population-scaled mutation rate θ: θ̂_S = S/a_n (Watterson estimator based on segregating sites S), θ̂_Π = Π (Tajima's estimator based on average pairwise differences Π), θ̂_1 = ζ₁ (based on the number of singletons ζ₁), and θ̂_1* = (n/(n-1))η₁ (a bias-corrected version using η₁).
formula-notes:formula_9.21a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on site-frequency spectrum statistics to define the estimators that are used in neutrality tests (e.g., Tajima's D), and it supports later arguments comparing these estimates to detect selection or demographic changes.

formula-notes:formula_7.11:zh.plainMeaning: 公式(7.11)将新突变（初始频率p0=1/(2N)）的固定概率uf(p0)除以中性期望固定概率1/(2N)，得到相对固定概率u'f(p0)，并近似表示为选择强度S=4Nes的函数S/(1-e^{-S})。
formula-notes:formula_7.11:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在“单位点上的选择与漂变”章节，用于量化选择与漂变对突变固定概率的相对贡献，为后续讨论选择强度参数S如何决定固定概率偏离中性期望提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_9.21b:en.plainMeaning: This formula provides plug-in estimates for θ and θ² used to compute the variance of site-frequency spectrum statistics: θ is estimated by S divided by a_n, and θ² by S(S-1) divided by (a_n² + b_n), where S is the number of segregating sites, a_n = Σ_{i=1}^{n-1} 1/i, and b_n = Σ_{i=1}^{n-1} 1/i².
formula-notes:formula_9.21b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on tests based on the site-frequency spectrum to enable computation of variance expressions for statistics like Tajima's D, which require estimates of θ and θ² under neutrality.

formula-notes:formula_9.21c:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算两个θ估计值（如θ̂ᵢ和θ̂ⱼ）之差除以其标准误，得到一个t统计量，用于检验两个估计是否显著不同。
formula-notes:formula_9.21c:zh.inThisChapter: 本章讨论基于位点频谱的检验统计量，该公式统一了表9.1中各种检验统计量的形式，为后续比较不同统计量的性质提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_9.18c:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the probability p_{S,i} that a neutral variant linked to a beneficial mutation is present in i copies in a sample of size n, given the genealogy of the beneficial allele. Key symbols: p_{S,i} (probability of i copies in sample), P_e(ℓ) (probability that ℓ lineages escape recombination), Pr(·|ℓ+1) (transition probabilities under the coalescent with recombination).
formula-notes:formula_9.18c:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on changes in neutral variation patterns during a selective sweep, supporting the calculation of the expected frequency spectrum of linked neutral variants after a sweep, which is used to infer selection from polymorphism data.

formula-notes:formula_9.20:en.plainMeaning: This formula gives the distribution of the frequency x of a neutral allele linked to a selected site, as a mixture of two normal components: one for alleles that were initially on the non-selected background (frequency in [0, fs]) and one for those on the selected background (frequency in [1-fs, 1]). Key symbols: x = allele frequency, fs = final frequency of selected allele, pr = initial frequency of neutral allele, σ² = variance due to drift.
formula-notes:formula_9.20:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to using molecular data to detect selection from recent sweeps, providing the distribution of linked neutral allele frequencies after a selective sweep, which replaces φ(x) in Equation 9.16a to compute the likelihood of observing a sample configuration under a selective sweep model.

formula-notes:formula_9.21a:zh.plainMeaning: 公式 (9.21a) 给出了四种基于不同汇总统计量的θ估计量：Ŝθ = S/aₙ 用分离位点数S除以调和数aₙ；Π̂θ = Π 用平均配对差异数Π；θ̂₁ = ζ₁ 用单态位点数ζ₁；θ̂₁* = n/(n-1)η₁ 用η₁乘以校正因子n/(n-1)。
formula-notes:formula_9.21a:zh.inThisChapter: 本节基于位点频谱统计量构建检验，公式 (9.21a) 列出了四种θ估计量，为后续比较这些估计量在极化与非极化数据下的行为以及构建检验统计量提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_9.20:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式描述了在选择性清除过程中，与有利突变相关联的等位基因频率x的分布，由两个正态分布的混合组成：第一个正态分布对应与突变不关联的谱系（频率被推向0），其均值为f_s p_r，方差为f_s^2 σ^2，权重为(f_s - x)/f_s^2且仅在x∈[0, f_s]时有效；第二个正态分布对应与突变关联的谱系（频率被推向1），其均值为f_s p_r + 1 - f_s，方差相同，权重为(x + f_s - 1)/f_s^2且仅在x∈[1-f_s, 1]时有效。
formula-notes:formula_9.20:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在介绍利用分子数据检测近期单次选择性清除的章节，它替代了公式9.16a中的φ(x)，从而为计算似然函数提供了更精确的等位基因频率分布，使得后续能够基于该分布进行统计推断以检测选择信号。

formula-notes:formula_9.22a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算在n条序列的样本中，具有i个衍生等位基因拷贝的分离位点（ζ_i）的期望个数为θ/i，以及折叠后（η_i）的期望个数为θ/i + θ/(n-i) = (θ/i)*(n/(n-i))，其中θ是整段区域的标度突变率。
formula-notes:formula_9.22a:zh.inThisChapter: 本节基于位点频谱统计量构建检验，公式9.22a给出了中性模型下ζ_i和η_i的期望值，为后续推导9.22b中Tajima's D等统计量的方差和检验统计量提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_9.23b:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the expected value of a linear summary statistic g of the unfolded site-frequency spectrum, showing it equals θ times a constant h(n) that depends on the sample size n and coefficients c_i.
formula-notes:formula_9.23b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on tests based on site-frequency spectrum statistics to derive the expectation of such statistics under the standard neutral model, which is then used to construct test statistics like Tajima's D by comparing observed values to this expectation.

formula-notes:formula_9.22b:en.plainMeaning: This formula gives a method-of-moments estimator of θ from the i-th class of the site-frequency spectrum: for derived alleles, it is i times ζ_i; for minor alleles, it is i(n-i)/n times η_i.
formula-notes:formula_9.22b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in this section to provide per-class estimates of θ, which are then combined into test statistics (e.g., Tajima's D) that compare different frequency classes to detect selection or demography.

formula-notes:formula_9.23c:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes an estimate of the scaled mutation rate θ as the observed value g of a site-frequency spectrum statistic divided by a normalizing function h(n) that depends on sample size n and chosen weights c_i.
formula-notes:formula_9.23c:en.inThisChapter: It appears in this section to define a family of θ estimators based on arbitrary weighted site-frequency spectrum statistics, supporting later arguments about optimal weighting and efficiency comparisons.

formula-notes:formula_9.22b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式给出了基于第i类位点频谱（SFS）计数对θ的矩估计：对于衍生等位基因计数ζ_i，估计量为i·ζ_i；对于次要等位基因计数η_i，估计量为i·(n-i)/n·η_i。
formula-notes:formula_9.22b:zh.inThisChapter: 在9.22a给出期望E[ζ_i]和E[η_i]后，本节直接构造矩估计量，为后续基于SFS的统计检验（如Tajima's D）提供参数估计基础。

formula-notes:formula_9.23d:en.plainMeaning: This formula defines a linear estimator g of the mutation rate parameter θ using the folded site-frequency spectrum η_i, with weights c_i, and its unbiased estimator θ̂_g = g / f(n), where f(n) is a normalization constant that depends on sample size n and the weights.
formula-notes:formula_9.23d:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on tests based on the site-frequency spectrum to provide a general form for estimators of θ from the folded spectrum, supporting later arguments about the power and properties of neutrality tests that use such linear combinations.

formula-notes:formula_9.24b:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the coefficient α_D, which adjusts the variance of Tajima's D statistic. α_D depends on the sample size n and the constants a_n and b_n from Equations 4.3b and 4.4b, and also involves β_D from Equation 9.24c.
formula-notes:formula_9.24b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on site-frequency spectrum statistics to define the denominator of Tajima's D (Equation 9.24a), enabling tests of neutrality by comparing estimates of θ from different summary statistics.

formula-notes:formula_9.24a:en.plainMeaning: Tajima's D computes the normalized difference between two estimators of θ: π (average pairwise differences) and S (number of segregating sites). The denominator scales the difference by its expected variance under neutrality, where α_D and β_D are coefficients depending on sample size n.
formula-notes:formula_9.24a:en.inThisChapter: This formula introduces the classic Tajima's D test, which is the most widely used site-frequency spectrum statistic. It supports later arguments about detecting selection or demographic changes by comparing observed and expected frequency spectra.

formula-notes:formula_9.24a:zh.plainMeaning: Tajima's D 统计量计算基于平均配对差异（π）的θ估计值与基于分离位点数（S）的θ估计值之差，除以标准差估计值，其中分母包含α_D和β_D两个系数。
formula-notes:formula_9.24a:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式是本章核心检验统计量，用于检测群体进化是否偏离中性模型，为后续讨论显著性检验和解释结果提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_9.23a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将任意未折叠位点频谱的汇总统计量 g 定义为每个等位基因频率类别 i 的频谱值 ζ_i 乘以权重 c_i 的线性组合，其中 i 从 1 到 n-1。
formula-notes:formula_9.23a:zh.inThisChapter: 本节基于位点频谱构建检验统计量，此公式给出了统计量的一般线性形式，为后续推导其期望（公式 9.23b）和方差（公式 9.23c、9.23d）提供基础，从而构造中性检验。

formula-notes:formula_9.25a:zh.plainMeaning: 公式 (9.25a) 给出了 Beta 分布的两个形状参数 α 和 β，它们由 D 的取值范围 [D_min, D_max] 计算得到：α 是负的，与 D_max 相关；β 是正的，与 D_min 相关。
formula-notes:formula_9.25a:zh.inThisChapter: 在本节中，该公式用于将 Tajima 的 D 统计量在平衡中性假设下的分布近似为 Beta 分布，从而为后续计算显著性阈值（如公式 9.25b）提供参数基础。

formula-notes:formula_9.24c:zh.plainMeaning: 公式(9.24c)计算β_D，它是Tajima's D检验统计量分母中S²的系数，其中a_n和b_n分别来自公式(4.3b)和(4.4b)，依赖于样本量n。
formula-notes:formula_9.24c:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在基于位点频谱统计量的检验章节，用于构造Tajima's D检验统计量(9.24a)的分母，以检验θ估计量θ̂_Π和θ̂_S之间的差异是否显著。

formula-notes:formula_9.24c:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes β_D, a coefficient used in the variance of Tajima's D test statistic, where n is sample size, a_n = Σ_{i=1}^{n-1} 1/i, and b_n = Σ_{i=1}^{n-1} 1/i^2.
formula-notes:formula_9.24c:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on site-frequency spectrum tests to define the variance normalization for Tajima's D, enabling the test to detect deviations from neutrality without requiring unfolded data.

formula-notes:formula_9.25a:en.plainMeaning: These formulas compute the shape parameters α and β of a Beta distribution that approximates Tajima's D statistic under the equilibrium neutral model, where D_min and D_max are the minimum and maximum possible values of D on a modified (0,1) scale.
formula-notes:formula_9.25a:en.inThisChapter: They appear in this section to provide the distributional form of D needed for significance tests based on the site-frequency spectrum, supporting later arguments that use the Beta approximation to compute p-values or critical values.

formula-notes:formula_9.23c:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将θ的估计量定义为统计量g除以样本大小n和权重c_i的函数h(n)，其中g是观测到的统计量值。
formula-notes:formula_9.23c:zh.inThisChapter: 在本节中，该公式基于任意权重向量(c_1,...,c_{n-1})给出了θ的估计量族，为后续讨论不同权重选择下的估计性质（如无偏性、方差）提供统一表达式。

formula-notes:formula_9.23d:zh.plainMeaning: 公式(9.23d)定义了折叠频谱统计量g为折叠侧谱分量η_i的加权和，权重c_i；然后给出θ_g的估计为g除以归一化因子f(n)，其中f(n)是权重c_i乘以n/(i(n-i))的和。
formula-notes:formula_9.23d:zh.inThisChapter: 本节讨论基于位点频谱的检验，公式(9.23d)将(9.23a)的未折叠统计量推广到折叠情形，用于处理无法区分祖先/衍生等位基因的数据，为后续基于折叠频谱的检验统计量提供估计框架。

formula-notes:formula_9.24b:zh.plainMeaning: 公式(9.24b)定义了Tajima's D检验统计量分母中S的系数α_D，它由样本量n、常数a_n和β_D计算得出，用于将S的方差分解为α_D S + β_D S²的形式。
formula-notes:formula_9.24b:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在基于位点频谱统计量的检验章节，为Tajima's D统计量(9.24a)的分母提供必要的系数，使得D统计量能够标准化为近似标准正态分布，从而检验中性进化假设。

formula-notes:formula_9.23b:zh.plainMeaning: 公式9.23b计算了基于未折叠位点频谱的统计量g的期望值，其中E(ζ_i)=θ/i来自公式9.22a，因此E(g)等于θ乘以系数c_i除以i的求和，即θ h(n)，h(n)=∑_{i=1}^{n-1} c_i / i。
formula-notes:formula_9.23b:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在基于位点频谱统计量的检验章节，它从一般线性统计量g的期望出发，为后续推导g的方差（公式9.23c）和标准化检验统计量（公式9.23d）提供了期望表达式，从而支持构建中性检验。

formula-notes:formula_9.25b:en.plainMeaning: This formula gives the minimum possible value of nucleotide diversity (Π) given the number of segregating sites (S) and sample size (n), assuming all mutations are singletons.
formula-notes:formula_9.25b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on site-frequency spectrum statistics to define the lower bound of Π, which is used to normalize Tajima's D (D' = D/D_min) for fair comparisons across loci.

formula-notes:formula_9.25b:zh.plainMeaning: 公式 (9.25b) 计算在给定分离位点数 S 时，核苷酸多样性 Π 可能达到的最小值，其中 n 是样本容量。
formula-notes:formula_9.25b:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在讨论基于位点频谱的检验统计量章节，为后续定义标准化统计量 D' 提供 Π 的下界，使得不同位点的 D 值可以公平比较。

formula-notes:formula_9.26b:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes α₊, a coefficient in the variance of the test statistic D*, where β₊ is given by (9.26c), aₙ = Σ_{i=1}^{n-1} 1/i, and n is the sample size.
formula-notes:formula_9.26b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on tests based on the site-frequency spectrum to define the denominator of the D* statistic, which is used to test neutrality by comparing two estimators of θ.

formula-notes:formula_9.26b:zh.plainMeaning: 公式 (9.26b) 计算统计量 D* 分母中 S 的系数 α*，其中 a_n 是调和数，β* 由 (9.26c) 给出，n 是样本容量。
formula-notes:formula_9.26b:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在基于位点频谱的检验章节，用于构造 D* 统计量的方差归一化项，使得 D* 在零假设下近似为标准正态分布，从而进行中性检验。

formula-notes:formula_9.26c:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes β₊, a coefficient used in the variance of D*, based on sample size n and harmonic number terms aₙ and bₙ.
formula-notes:formula_9.26c:en.inThisChapter: It appears in this section to provide the necessary variance component for the D* test statistic, which is used to detect selection from site-frequency spectrum data.

formula-notes:formula_9.26d:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the test statistic F* by comparing the difference between two estimators of the population mutation rate θ (θ̂_Π from average pairwise differences and θ̂_1* from folded singletons) normalized by a variance term that depends on the number of segregating sites S and constants α_F and β_F.
formula-notes:formula_9.26d:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on tests based on the site-frequency spectrum to provide a statistical test for detecting deviations from the standard neutral model, supporting later arguments about selective sweeps or population size changes.

formula-notes:formula_9.26f:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes β_F, a coefficient used in the variance of a test statistic based on the site-frequency spectrum, where a_n and b_n are constants depending on sample size n.
formula-notes:formula_9.26f:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on tests based on the site-frequency spectrum to provide the necessary variance correction term for the normalized test statistic in Equation 9.26d.

formula-notes:formula_9.26c:zh.plainMeaning: 公式(9.26c)计算β*，它是D*统计量分母中S²项的系数，由样本量n和调和数an、bn（an=∑_{i=1}^{n-1}1/i，bn=∑_{i=1}^{n-1}1/i²）具体给出。
formula-notes:formula_9.26c:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在构建基于位点频谱的检验统计量D*时，与(9.26b)共同定义分母中的α*和β*，为后续计算D*的方差提供解析表达式。

formula-notes:formula_9.27b:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes a test statistic H as the scaled difference between Fay and Wu's estimator of θ (θ̂_Π) and the estimator based on average pairwise differences (θ̂_H), divided by the standard deviation σ(H).
formula-notes:formula_9.27b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in this section to provide a normalized test statistic for detecting deviations from neutral evolution using site-frequency spectrum statistics, supporting later arguments about model selection and hypothesis testing.

formula-notes:formula_9.26e:zh.plainMeaning: 公式(9.26e)定义了F*统计量分母中S的系数α_F，它由样本量n和常数a_n、a_{n+1}、β_F计算得出，用于调整方差估计。
formula-notes:formula_9.26e:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在构建基于折叠频谱的检验统计量F*时，与(9.26d)和(9.26f)共同给出F*的分母方差表达式，为后续假设检验提供标准化因子。

formula-notes:formula_9.26e:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the coefficient α_F, which together with β_F scales the variance of the test statistic F* in Equation 9.26d. Key symbols: a_n, a_{n+1}, b_n (constants depending on sample size n), and β_F (the other coefficient).
formula-notes:formula_9.26e:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on tests based on the site-frequency spectrum to provide the variance normalization for the folded version of the F* statistic, supporting the construction of a test that compares two estimators of θ.

formula-notes:formula_9.27c:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the sampling variance σ²(H) of the H statistic, which contrasts high- and intermediate-frequency sites. Key symbols: n = sample size, θ = population-scaled mutation rate, b_{n+1} = a constant depending on n.
formula-notes:formula_9.27c:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on tests based on site-frequency spectrum statistics to provide the variance needed for significance testing of H. It supports later arguments by enabling normalization of H to a standard normal deviate for neutrality tests.

formula-notes:formula_9.26d:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算F*检验统计量，分子是平均成对差异估计量θ̂_Π与折叠单态估计量θ̂_1*之差，分母是S的二次函数开方，其中α_F和β_F由(9.26e)和(9.26f)给出。
formula-notes:formula_9.26d:zh.inThisChapter: 本节介绍基于位点频谱的检验，F*检验通过比较两种θ估计量来检测选择信号，为后续推导其零分布和临界值提供统计量形式。

formula-notes:formula_9.27a:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the Fay and Wu's H estimator of the population-scaled mutation rate θ, using weights c_i = i^2 that emphasize high-frequency derived alleles. Here, n is the sample size, and ζ_i is the number of segregating sites where the derived allele appears i times in the sample.
formula-notes:formula_9.27a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on tests based on the site-frequency spectrum, specifically to define a statistic sensitive to an excess of high-frequency derived alleles, which supports detecting recent positive selection or population bottlenecks.

formula-notes:formula_9.28a:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the estimator θ̂_L of the population-scaled mutation rate θ as a weighted sum of the site-frequency spectrum counts ζ_i, with weights i/(n-1). Key symbols: n = sample size, ζ_i = number of segregating sites where the derived allele appears i times in the sample.
formula-notes:formula_9.28a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on tests based on the site-frequency spectrum to define a statistic that emphasizes high-frequency derived alleles, supporting later arguments about the power of different neutrality tests.

formula-notes:formula_9.26f:zh.plainMeaning: 公式 (9.26f) 计算 β_F，它是用于调整方差估计的系数，其中 a_n 和 b_n 是依赖于样本量 n 的常数，公式中的分式项和含 a_n、b_n 的项共同决定了 β_F 的具体数值。
formula-notes:formula_9.26f:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在基于位点频谱统计量的检验章节中，与 α_F 共同构成方差调整项 α_F S + β_F S^2，用于构造统计量 (9.26d) 的分母，从而校正 Tajima's D 等检验的方差，为后续推导检验的零分布提供精确的方差表达式。

formula-notes:formula_9.27c:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算H统计量的抽样方差σ²(H)，其中θ是种群突变率参数，n是样本大小，b_{n+1}是调和数相关项，公式将方差表示为θ的一次项和二次项之和。
formula-notes:formula_9.27c:zh.inThisChapter: 本节基于位点频率谱统计量进行检验，H统计量用于对比高频与中频位点；公式9.27c给出其方差，以便后续构建检验统计量或进行显著性检验。

formula-notes:formula_9.27a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算基于高频衍生等位基因的核苷酸多样性估计量θ̂_H，其中ζ_i是样本中频率为i的衍生等位基因位点数，权重i^2突出高频变异，分母n(n-1)/2来自h(n)的归一化。
formula-notes:formula_9.27a:zh.inThisChapter: 本节介绍基于位点频谱的检验统计量，公式(9.27a)定义Fay和Wu的H统计量中的θ̂_H，用于检测高频衍生等位基因的过量，后续与θ̂_W和θ̂_π比较以推断自然选择。

formula-notes:formula_9.27b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算了Fay和Wu的θ估计量（基于高频变异）与基于平均配对差异的θ估计量（即Tajima的π）之间的差值，再除以该差值的标准差σ(H)，得到标准化统计量H。
formula-notes:formula_9.27b:zh.inThisChapter: 在基于位点频谱统计量的检验章节中，此公式定义了H检验的统计量，用于检测选择或种群历史事件，后续将通过与公式9.27c的临界值比较来判断显著性。

formula-notes:formula_9.28a:zh.plainMeaning: 公式 (9.28a) 计算的是加权线性组合估计量 θ̂_L，它通过对每个频率 i 的位点频谱统计量 ζ_i 乘以权重 i 并求和，再除以 n-1 来得到，其中 n 是样本量。
formula-notes:formula_9.28a:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在基于位点频谱统计量的检验章节中，作为对 θ_S 和 θ_H 的补充估计量，它通过赋予高频位点（i 较大）更多权重来平衡对低频和高频变异的敏感性，为后续比较不同估计量的统计性质提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_9.28b:zh.plainMeaning: 公式 (9.28b) 计算 E 统计量，它是高频区域估计的 θ̂_S 与低频区域估计的 θ̂_L 之差，再除以该差值的标准差 σ(E)，从而标准化为近似标准正态变量。
formula-notes:formula_9.28b:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在基于位点频谱统计量的检验章节，用于构建 Zeng 等人的 E 检验统计量，通过比较频谱高低频区域的 θ 估计值来检测自然选择，后续将利用其正态近似进行假设检验。

formula-notes:formula_9.28b:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes a test statistic E that contrasts estimates of theta from high-frequency (θ̂_L) and low-frequency (θ̂_S) variants, normalized by its standard deviation σ(E).
formula-notes:formula_9.28b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on tests based on the site-frequency spectrum to provide a normalized measure for detecting departures from neutrality, supporting the subsequent interpretation of E as a standard normal deviate under the null hypothesis.

formula-notes:formula_9.28c:en.plainMeaning: This formula gives the variance of the E statistic (σ²(E)) as a quadratic function of θ, where θ is the population-scaled mutation rate, n is the sample size, and aₙ, bₙ are constants from the frequency spectrum.
formula-notes:formula_9.28c:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on site-frequency spectrum tests to provide the denominator for the E test statistic (9.28b), enabling a standardized test that contrasts high- and low-frequency derived alleles.

formula-notes:formula_9.29b:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the Mahalanobis distance D_i^2 for site i, where t_i is the vector of test statistics and Σ_t^{-1} is the inverse of the empirical variance-covariance matrix of the test scores across sites.
formula-notes:formula_9.29b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in this section to transform correlated test statistics into uncorrelated ones with equal variance, enabling valid combined tests based on the site-frequency spectrum.

formula-notes:formula_9.28c:zh.plainMeaning: 公式 (9.28c) 计算了 E 统计量（公式 9.28b）的方差 σ²(E)，其中 θ 是突变率参数，n 是样本量，aₙ 和 bₙ 是依赖于 n 的常数。
formula-notes:formula_9.28c:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在基于位点频率谱统计量的检验章节中，为 Zeng 等人提出的 E 检验提供方差表达式，使得 E 统计量可以标准化为标准正态分布，从而进行假设检验。

formula-notes:formula_9.29b:zh.plainMeaning: 公式计算的是站点 i 的检验统计量向量 t_i 的 Mahalanobis 距离平方，其中 Σ_t 是所有站点检验统计量的经验方差-协方差矩阵，用于将 t_i 变换为方差相等且不相关的量。
formula-notes:formula_9.29b:zh.inThisChapter: 本章讨论基于位点频率谱统计量的检验，当多个检验统计量相关时，需要先进行变换消除相关性；该公式提供了变换后的距离度量，为后续基于该距离的检验（如 outlier 检测）奠定基础。

formula-notes:formula_9.30b:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the sample homozygosity, which is the sum over allele frequencies (i/n) squared, weighted by the number of alleles n_i observed i times in a sample of size n. Key symbols: n = sample size, n_i = count of alleles with frequency i/n.
formula-notes:formula_9.30b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on site-frequency spectrum statistics as an alternative to other statistics for detecting selection, specifically to improve power under weak overdominance, as shown by Watterson.

formula-notes:formula_9.30a:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes a summary statistic I of the frequency spectrum, where n is the total number of sampled haplotypes, i indexes the number of copies of a haplotype, and n_i is the count of haplotypes that appear i times in the sample.
formula-notes:formula_9.30a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the Haplotype-Based Tests section as a measure of the frequency spectrum, and it supports later arguments by being used in Equation 9.30b to define a test statistic for detecting selection.

formula-notes:formula_9.30a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算频率谱的香农熵，其中 n_i 是样本中频率为 i 的等位基因个数，i/n 是等位基因频率，通过对所有频率类别求和得到信息量 I。
formula-notes:formula_9.30a:zh.inThisChapter: 在单倍型检验章节中，Ewens 提出该统计量作为频率谱的摘要，用于衡量等位基因频率分布的均匀性，为后续基于频率谱的检验（如公式 9.30b）提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_9.29a:en.plainMeaning: DCMS_i computes a weighted average of log-odds (ln((1-p)/p)) across t tests for site i, where each test's contribution is weighted by the absolute correlation |r_{kt}| between that test and the last test t, normalized by the sum of absolute correlations W.
formula-notes:formula_9.29a:en.inThisChapter: This formula appears in the section on site-frequency spectrum statistics to define a combined test statistic that aggregates evidence from multiple correlated tests, supporting the later argument that DCMS_i can be used to detect selection by comparing its distribution under neutrality.

formula-notes:formula_9.31b:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the exact p-value (Pe) for a haplotype-based test by summing the probabilities of all allele-frequency spectra n* that are as likely or less likely than the observed spectrum n, given the total number of haplotypes n and number of alleles k.
formula-notes:formula_9.31b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on haplotype-based tests to provide an exact alternative to the test based on the summary statistic h (Equation 9.31a), supporting a more direct assessment of significance without relying on a less informative statistic.

formula-notes:formula_9.31a:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the p-value P_h as the sum of probabilities of all haplotype configurations n* (with n_i counts summing to n) whose test statistic h(η*) is less than or equal to the observed h, under the null hypothesis.
formula-notes:formula_9.31a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the Haplotype-Based Tests section to define the exact p-value for Fisher's exact test on haplotype frequency tables, supporting the assessment of association between haplotypes and phenotypes.

formula-notes:formula_9.31a:zh.plainMeaning: 公式(9.31a)计算单倍型检验的p值P_h，即所有满足h(η*) ≤ h的配置n* = (n1,...,nk)的多项式概率Pr(n1,...,nk | n, k)之和，其中h由公式(9.30a)定义，n*受公式(2.32)约束。
formula-notes:formula_9.31a:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在基于单倍型的检验章节，用于定义Fisher精确检验的p值，通过枚举所有可能配置并累加概率来评估观察到的h值是否极端，为后续比较不同单倍型分布的显著性提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_9.32:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the probability of observing k or fewer distinct alleles in a sample of size n, given the Watterson estimator θ̂_S. Key symbols: K = number of alleles, k = observed count, θ̂_S = Watterson estimator, S_n^i = coefficient of (θ̂_S)^i in the polynomial S_n(θ̂_S).
formula-notes:formula_9.32:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the Haplotype-Based Tests section to provide a null distribution for the number of haplotypes, supporting tests of neutrality or population structure by comparing observed haplotype counts to this expectation.

formula-notes:formula_9.30b:zh.plainMeaning: 公式计算样本纯合度h，其中n_i是样本中频率为i/n的位点个数，n是样本染色体数，求和遍历所有i从1到n，得到每个位点纯合概率(i/n)^2的加权和。
formula-notes:formula_9.30b:zh.inThisChapter: 本章基于位点频率谱统计量进行检验，此公式作为Watterson提出的改进统计量，用于检测弱超显性选择下的偏离，对比公式9.30a以评估检验功效。

formula-notes:formula_9.33b:zh.plainMeaning: 公式将 S' 通过 logit 变换（对数几率）映射到 F_S，其中 S' 是中间等位基因频率下的统计量，F_S 的正负表示稀有等位基因/单倍型是过多还是过少。
formula-notes:formula_9.33b:zh.inThisChapter: 由于 S' 的临界值常过于接近零，不适合直接作为检验统计量，因此本节引入该变换使统计量分布更对称，便于进行单侧检验，为后续检测选择性清除或群体扩张等事件提供有效工具。

formula-notes:formula_9.31b:zh.plainMeaning: 公式 (9.31b) 计算的是精确检验的 p 值，它累加所有与观测到的单倍型频谱 n 相比概率相等或更小的可能频谱 n* 的概率。其中 n 是观测到的等位基因频率向量，Pr(n1,n2,…,nk|n,k) 是在给定样本大小 n 和等位基因数 k 下观察到特定频谱的多项式概率。
formula-notes:formula_9.31b:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在“基于单倍型的检验”章节，是 Slatkin 提出的第二种精确检验方法。它直接对所有可能的配置求和，而不是使用较不信息性的汇总统计量 h，从而为后续比较不同检验统计量的功效提供更精确的 p 值计算方式。

formula-notes:formula_9.32:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算在给定Watterson估计量θ̂_S和样本量n的条件下，样本中观察到k个或更少等位基因的累积概率W。其中S_n(θ̂_S)是多项式展开，S_n^i是θ̂_S^i项的系数。
formula-notes:formula_9.32:zh.inThisChapter: 本章讨论基于单倍型的检验，公式(9.32)将Ewens抽样公式(2.30a)中的θ替换为θ̂_S，从而将理论分布应用于实际数据，为后续检验统计量的构建提供概率基础。

formula-notes:formula_9.33a:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the probability (S') of observing k or more distinct haplotypes (or alleles) in a sample of size n, given the estimated population mutation rate θ̂_Π based on pairwise differences. Key symbols: n = sample size, k = threshold number of haplotypes, S_n^i = Stirling numbers of the first kind, θ̂_Π = estimator of θ from pairwise differences, S_n(θ̂_Π) = sum of S_n^i * (θ̂_Π)^i over i=1..n.
formula-notes:formula_9.33a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on haplotype-based tests to define the test statistic for Fu's F_S test, which detects an excess of rare haplotypes. This probability is then used in Equation 9.33b to compute the actual F_S statistic, supporting the test's ability to identify population expansion or selection.

formula-notes:formula_9.33a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算在样本中观察到至少k个等位基因或单倍型的概率S'，其中关键符号S_n^i表示Ewens抽样公式中样本大小为n时出现i个等位基因的概率，[θ̂_Π]^i是θ估计值的i次幂，S_n(θ̂_Π)是归一化常数。
formula-notes:formula_9.33a:zh.inThisChapter: 本章介绍基于单倍型的检验，该公式用于Fu's F_S检验，通过计算稀有等位基因/单倍型过多的概率，为后续计算F_S统计量（公式9.33b）提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_9.33b:en.plainMeaning: This formula transforms the test statistic S' (a measure of haplotype diversity) into an approximately normally distributed variable F_S using a logit transformation, where S' is the original statistic bounded between 0 and 1.
formula-notes:formula_9.33b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the haplotype-based tests section to address the issue that S' has critical values too close to zero, making it unsuitable for direct testing; the transformed F_S is used for a one-sided test to detect an excess of rare alleles/haplotypes.

formula-notes:formula_9.34a:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes haplotype diversity (H) as one minus the sum of squared haplotype frequencies, where p_i is the frequency of the i-th haplotype. It measures the heterozygosity (or gene diversity) at the haplotype level.
formula-notes:formula_9.34a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the Haplotype-Based Tests section to define the H test statistic, which is compared to its neutral equilibrium expectation given the number of segregating sites S, extending the Ewens-Watterson test (Equation 9.30b) to haplotype data.

formula-notes:formula_9.29a:zh.plainMeaning: DCMS_i 是第 i 个位点的组合统计量，通过对 t 个检验的 ln((1-p_{i,k})/p_{i,k}) 加权求和（权重为 1/W）得到，其中 W 是各检验与第 t 个检验相关系数绝对值之和。
formula-notes:formula_9.29a:zh.inThisChapter: 本节基于位点频谱统计量构建检验，DCMS 用于整合多个相关检验的 p 值，为后续推导其渐近分布（公式 9.29b）提供统计量定义。

formula-notes:formula_9.35a:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes homozygosity (H1) as the complement of haplotype heterozygosity H, summing the squared frequencies p_i of each haplotype i.
formula-notes:formula_9.35a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the haplotype-based tests section to define homozygosity, which is used for neutrality tests and to adjust for sampling effects in later variants.

formula-notes:formula_9.34a:zh.plainMeaning: 公式 H = 1 - Σ p_i^2 计算单倍型杂合度，其中 p_i 是第 i 个单倍型的频率，H 表示随机抽取两个单倍型为不同单倍型的概率。
formula-notes:formula_9.34a:zh.inThisChapter: 本节介绍基于单倍型的检验，H 检验使用该统计量，通过与给定 S 下的中性平衡期望值比较来检测选择信号；公式明确引用 Ewens-Watterson 检验（公式 9.30b），说明 H 检验本质上是该检验的变体。

formula-notes:formula_9.34b:zh.plainMeaning: 该不等式给出了H统计量的取值范围：下限为2(n-1)/n²，对应样本中只有两种单倍型，一种有n-1个拷贝，另一种为单例；上限为1-1/n，对应所有单倍型均不同。
formula-notes:formula_9.34b:zh.inThisChapter: 在本节中，H检验是Ewens-Watterson检验的变体，该不等式明确了H的可能范围，为后续基于H的显著性评估提供了理论边界。

formula-notes:formula_9.34b:en.plainMeaning: This inequality gives the range of the homozygosity statistic H in a sample of n haplotypes: the minimum is 2(n-1)/n^2 when the sample has only two distinct haplotypes (one with n-1 copies, one singleton), and the maximum is 1 - 1/n when all haplotypes are distinct (each with one copy).
formula-notes:formula_9.34b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the Haplotype-Based Tests section to define the possible values of H, which is used as a test statistic analogous to the Ewens-Watterson test but conditioned on the number of segregating sites S rather than the number of alleles k.

formula-notes:formula_9.34c:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the exact p-value (P_E) for a haplotype-based test by summing the probabilities of all sample configurations (n*) whose probability under the null (conditioned on S) is less than or equal to the probability of the observed configuration (η). Key symbols: n* (alternative sample configuration), η* (alternative haplotype configuration), η (observed configuration), n (sample size), k (number of haplotypes), S (observed number of segregating sites).
formula-notes:formula_9.34c:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on haplotype-based tests as a version of Slatkin's exact test (Equation 9.31b) conditioned on S instead of k, supporting the development of the HCT test that uses the haplotype frequency spectrum to detect selection.

formula-notes:formula_9.35c:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the homozygosity after removing the most common haplotype, where p_i is the frequency of the i-th haplotype and the sum starts from the second most common (i>1).
formula-notes:formula_9.35c:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the Haplotype-Based Tests section as a modified HH statistic to detect selective sweeps by reducing the influence of the dominant haplotype, supporting later arguments about sweep signatures.

formula-notes:formula_9.35b:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the H12 statistic, which is the sum of the squared frequency of the two most common haplotypes plus the sum of squared frequencies of all other haplotypes. It equals H1 (the homozygosity) plus twice the product of the two largest haplotype frequencies.
formula-notes:formula_9.35b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the Haplotype-Based Tests section to define a test statistic that can detect both hard and soft sweeps by combining the two largest haplotype classes, supporting the argument that this modification improves sweep detection.

formula-notes:formula_9.35b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将两个最大单倍型类别的频率合并，计算合并后的频率平方与其余所有单倍型频率平方之和，即H12等于H1（最大单倍型频率平方）加上两倍的最大与次大单倍型频率乘积。
formula-notes:formula_9.35b:zh.inThisChapter: 本章基于单倍型频率进行选择检测，H12通过合并前两大单倍型来增强对软性选择（多个单倍型同时上升）的检测能力，为后续比较H12与H1、H2等统计量的表现奠定基础。

formula-notes:formula_9.36a:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the squared correlation coefficient r_{ij}^2 between two genetic sites i and j, where D_{ij} is the linkage disequilibrium, and p_i, q_i are the frequencies of the leading alleles at each site.
formula-notes:formula_9.36a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on haplotype-based tests to define a scaled measure of pairwise disequilibrium, which is then averaged in Equation 9.36b to obtain a general measure of average LD across a region.

formula-notes:formula_9.36b:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the average squared correlation coefficient across all pairs of segregating sites in a genomic region, where S is the number of segregating sites and r_{ij} is the correlation between alleles at sites i and j.
formula-notes:formula_9.36b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on haplotype-based tests to provide a summary statistic for the overall level of linkage disequilibrium (LD) in a region, supporting later analyses of haplotype structure and selection signals.

formula-notes:formula_9.34c:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算单倍型配置的精确检验p值，即所有概率不大于观测配置概率的配置（n*）的条件概率之和，其中条件概率Pr(n1,...,nk|S)是在给定单倍型种类数S下观察到该配置的概率。
formula-notes:formula_9.34c:zh.inThisChapter: 本节介绍基于单倍型频谱配置的精确检验（HCT），公式9.34c是Slatkin精确检验（公式9.31b）的变体，将条件从等位基因数k改为单倍型种类数S，为后续比较不同检验统计量提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_9.36a:zh.plainMeaning: 公式 (9.36a) 将两位点 i 和 j 间的连锁不平衡系数 D_ij 标准化为相关系数的平方 r_ij^2，其中 p_i 和 q_i 分别是两个位点主要等位基因的频率。
formula-notes:formula_9.36a:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在基于单倍型的检验章节，用于定义两位点间 LD 的标准化度量，为后续计算区域平均 LD（如公式 9.36b）提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_9.38b:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the maximum likelihood estimator (MLE) of the time to the most recent common ancestor (T, in units of 2Ne generations) for a haplotype, where p is the frequency of the ancestral haplotype and n is the sample size.
formula-notes:formula_9.38b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the Haplotype-Based Tests section to provide a point estimate of T that is less than the mean, supporting later arguments about the distribution of T and its implications for haplotype-based association tests.

formula-notes:formula_9.36b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算区域中所有成对位点间连锁不平衡（LD）的平方相关系数 r_{ij}^2 的平均值，其中 S 是分离位点数，求和遍历所有 i<j 的位点对。
formula-notes:formula_9.36b:zh.inThisChapter: 在基于单倍型的检验章节中，该公式用于量化整个区域的平均 LD 水平，为后续检验统计量（如 ZnS 检验）提供基础，评估 LD 是否偏离随机期望。

formula-notes:formula_9.35c:zh.plainMeaning: 公式 H₂ = ∑_{i>1} p_i² 计算的是去除频率最高的单倍型类后，剩余所有单倍型类频率的平方和，其中 p_i 是第 i 个单倍型类的频率。
formula-notes:formula_9.35c:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在单倍型检验章节，作为对标准纯合性统计量 H₁（公式 9.35a）的修正，通过移除最大类来更灵敏地检测选择性清除或平衡选择导致的频率分布变化。

formula-notes:formula_9.37:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes a test statistic ω that contrasts the average squared correlation (r²) within two groups of sites (L and R) against the average squared correlation between the groups, scaled by a combinatorial factor C_{S,ℓ} that depends on the total number of sites S and the size ℓ of the left group.
formula-notes:formula_9.37:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the Haplotype-Based Tests section to provide a statistic for detecting recombination or population structure by comparing linkage disequilibrium within and between predefined site groups, supporting later arguments about the significance of observed LD patterns.

formula-notes:formula_9.38a:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the probability that the true age T (in generations) of an allele with sample frequency p is ≤ τ (i.e., no older than 2N_eτ generations). Key symbols: T = true age, τ = scaled time, p = sample frequency, n = sample size.
formula-notes:formula_9.38a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the Haplotype-Based Tests section to provide a null distribution for allele age under neutrality, supporting later tests that compare observed haplotype diversity to this expectation.

formula-notes:formula_9.38a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算在样本量为n、等位基因频率为p的条件下，等位基因的真实年龄T（以2N_e代为单位）不超过τ的概率近似值。关键符号：T为真实年龄，p为样本频率，n为样本量，τ为时间阈值。
formula-notes:formula_9.38a:zh.inThisChapter: 本节（基于单倍型的检验）中，该公式用于估计等位基因年龄的累积分布，为后续推导年龄条件概率（公式9.38b）和联合概率（公式9.38c、9.38d）提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_9.35a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算纯合度 H₁，即随机抽取的两个单倍型完全相同的概率，等于各单倍型频率平方之和 ∑ pᵢ²。
formula-notes:formula_9.35a:zh.inThisChapter: 作为 Depaulis-Veuille H 统计量（杂合度）的补，用于衡量单倍型多样性，并为后续讨论样本校正（如替换 pᵢ² 为 [pᵢ + 1/k]²）提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_9.38c:en.plainMeaning: This formula defines the quantile τ_x of the coalescence time T such that the probability T is less than or equal to τ_x equals x. τ_x is the time corresponding to cumulative probability x.
formula-notes:formula_9.38c:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the haplotype-based tests section to define the confidence interval endpoints for the estimated age of a mutation, using the quantiles of the coalescence time distribution.

formula-notes:formula_9.37:zh.plainMeaning: 公式(9.37)定义了统计量ω，它通过比较左侧(L)和右侧(R)两组位点内部的连锁不平衡（用r²之和衡量）与两组之间的连锁不平衡的比值，并乘以组合常数C_{S,ℓ}来检测重组热点。其中C_{S,ℓ}依赖于总位点数S和左侧位点数ℓ。
formula-notes:formula_9.37:zh.inThisChapter: 在基于单倍型的检验章节中，该公式用于构造一个检验统计量，以区分两组位点间是否存在显著的连锁不平衡差异，从而推断重组热点的存在。它为后续的显著性检验提供了具体的统计量形式。

formula-notes:formula_9.38c:zh.plainMeaning: 公式 Pr(T ≤ τ_x) = x 定义了 τ_x 为随机变量 T 的累积分布函数在概率 x 处的分位数，即 T 小于或等于 τ_x 的概率恰好为 x。
formula-notes:formula_9.38c:zh.inThisChapter: 在本节中，该公式用于构造单倍型年龄的置信区间：通过求解 τ_{α/2} 和 τ_{1-α/2}，得到置信下限和上限，从而为后续的区间估计提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_9.38d:en.plainMeaning: This formula approximates the normalized linkage disequilibrium measure τ_x as a function of the recombination fraction x and the allele frequency p, derived from the relationship between x and τ_x in Equation 9.38c.
formula-notes:formula_9.38d:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the Haplotype-Based Tests section to provide a closed-form approximation for τ_x, which is used to assess the extent of linkage disequilibrium and to support tests of association or recombination in genetic data.

formula-notes:formula_9.38b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算在单倍型检验中，基于观察到的单倍型频率 p 和样本量 n，对共同祖先时间 T（以 2N_e 代为单位）的最大似然估计值 MLE(T)，其中 -ln(1-p) 是主要项，-2/n 是小样本校正项。
formula-notes:formula_9.38b:zh.inThisChapter: 在本章“基于单倍型的检验”中，该公式出现在讨论 MLE 与均值差异的上下文中，为后续比较不同估计量（如公式 9.38c 和 9.38d）的偏差和方差提供基准，并铺垫如何利用单倍型数据推断群体历史。

formula-notes:formula_9.39a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算经过t代重组后，连锁不平衡度量x(t)与平衡值y之间的差值，它等于初始差值(1-y)乘以每代保留比例(1-c)的t次幂。
