formula-notes:formula_11.9c:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式与 (11.9a) 和 (11.9b) 共同描述漂变如何衰减不同阶数的上位方差，为后续推导群体遗传方差随近交的变化提供完整框架。

formula-notes:formula_11.9b:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the additive-by-additive epistatic variance at time t, σ²_AA(t), as a function of the initial variances σ²_AA(0), σ²_AAA(0), etc., and the inbreeding coefficient f_t. The factor (1-f_t)² shows the decay due to drift, while higher-order epistatic terms are scaled by (2f_t).
formula-notes:formula_11.9b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on the response of within-population genetic variance to drift, extending the single-locus result (Equation 11.9a) to two-locus epistatic variance. This supports later arguments about how drift reduces nonadditive variance and alters the contribution of epistasis to the total genetic variance.

formula-notes:formula_11.9c:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the three-locus additive-by-additive-by-additive genetic variance at time t, σ²_AAA(t), as the initial variance σ²_AAA(0) multiplied by (1 - f_t)³, where f_t is the inbreeding coefficient at time t. The dots indicate possible contributions from higher-order epistatic terms.
formula-notes:formula_11.9c:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on the response of within-population genetic variance to drift to show how higher-order epistatic variance components decay under inbreeding. This supports the argument that drift reduces non-additive variance more rapidly than additive variance, with the decay factor (1 - f_t)^k for k-locus interactions.

formula-notes:formula_11.12:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the variance of the additive genetic variance across replicate populations, where σ²[σₐ²(t)] is the variance of additive genetic variance at time t, aᵢ is the additive effect at locus i, and σ²_{Hᵢ}(t) is the variance of heterozygosity at locus i among replicates.
formula-notes:formula_11.12:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on the response of within-population genetic variance to drift to quantify how drift causes variation in additive genetic variance among populations, supporting later arguments about the stochastic dynamics of quantitative genetic variation.

formula-notes:formula_11.9b:zh.plainMeaning: 公式(11.9b)计算在遗传漂变t代后，加性×加性互作方差σ_{AA}^2(t)的期望值，它等于初始值σ_{AA}^2(0)加上高阶互作项（如3(2f_t)σ_{AAA}^2(0)）的贡献，再乘以系数(1-f_t)^2。
formula-notes:formula_11.9b:zh.inThisChapter: 本节推导漂变对遗传方差各分量的响应，公式(11.9b)与(11.9a)、(11.9c)共同展示高阶互作方差衰减更快（因子(1-f_t)^2对比(1-f_t)），为后续讨论近交衰退和长期选择响应提供定量基础。

formula-notes:formula_11.11:en.plainMeaning: This formula partitions the variance of the estimated within-population additive genetic variance at time t into three components: variance due to true additive genetic variance, variance due to Hardy-Weinberg disequilibrium, and variance due to linkage disequilibrium.
formula-notes:formula_11.11:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on response of genetic variance to drift to quantify how sampling error and evolutionary forces (drift, disequilibria) contribute to uncertainty in the estimated variance, supporting later arguments about the stochastic behavior of genetic variance in small populations.

formula-notes:formula_11.10:en.plainMeaning: This formula decomposes the additive genetic variance within a population at time t into three components: variance from true gene effects in an infinite random-mating population (σ_a²(t)), variance from Hardy-Weinberg disequilibrium (σ̂_HW(t)), and variance from linkage disequilibrium (σ̂_L(t)).
formula-notes:formula_11.10:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on response of within-population genetic variance to drift to show how drift alters the components of variance, supporting later arguments about the maintenance of genetic variation under finite population size.

formula-notes:formula_11.14:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the coefficient of coancestry Θ_xy, the probability that a random gene from individual x and a random gene from individual y are identical by descent, as a weighted sum of condensed identity coefficients Δ_i.
formula-notes:formula_11.14:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to genetic drift to define a key measure of relatedness used later to quantify how drift reduces genetic variation within and between populations.

formula-notes:formula_11.12:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算的是加性遗传方差 σ_a^2(t) 的方差，它等于各基因座上等位基因效应 a_i 的四次方乘以该基因座杂合度方差 σ_{H_i}^2(t) 的求和。
formula-notes:formula_11.12:zh.inThisChapter: 在本节中，该公式用于量化遗传漂变导致群体间加性遗传方差在重复群体中的波动幅度，为后续分析漂变对遗传方差长期变化的影响提供方差表达式。

formula-notes:formula_11.11:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将群体内加性遗传方差估计值 $\widehat{\sigma}_{A}^{2}(t)$ 的方差分解为三个独立来源的方差之和：真实加性遗传方差 $\sigma_{a}^{2}(t)$ 的方差、哈代-温伯格不平衡引起的方差 $\sigma^{2}[\widehat{\sigma}_{HW}(t)]$ 以及连锁不平衡引起的方差 $\sigma^{2}[\widehat{\sigma}_{L}(t)]$。
formula-notes:formula_11.11:zh.inThisChapter: 在讨论漂移对群体内遗传方差影响的章节中，该公式承接公式11.10，将估计量的方差分解为遗传漂变（通过 $\sigma^{2}[\sigma_{a}^{2}(t)]$）和抽样误差（后两项）的贡献，为后续分析漂移如何导致群体间方差分化提供定量基础。

formula-notes:formula_11.13:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the genetic covariance between two individuals x and y, incorporating additive, dominance, and additive-by-dominance epistatic variances, as well as terms for inbreeding and identity disequilibrium. Key symbols: Θ_xy (coancestry), Δ_7xy, Δ_1xy, Δ_3xy, Δ_5xy (identity coefficients), σ²_A, σ²_D, σ²_DI, σ_ADI (variance components), f_x, f_y (inbreeding coefficients), ι* and ι² (functions of inbreeding and identity).
formula-notes:formula_11.13:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to changes in genetic variation induced by drift to show how drift alters the covariance between relatives via identity disequilibrium and inbreeding, supporting later arguments about the erosion of genetic variance under finite population size.

formula-notes:formula_11.10:zh.plainMeaning: 公式(11.10)将群体内加性遗传方差估计值分解为三项：σ_a^2(t)是假设群体无限大且随机交配时的真实基因效应方差，σ̂_HW(t)是Hardy-Weinberg不平衡引起的方差，σ̂_L(t)是连锁不平衡引起的方差。
formula-notes:formula_11.10:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在讨论漂移对群体内遗传方差影响的章节，用于量化漂移导致的小群体偏离无限大随机交配理想状态时，加性遗传方差的变化来源，为后续分析漂移如何改变遗传方差提供分解框架。

formula-notes:formula_11.15:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the genetic covariance between two relatives in generations i and j, whose last common ancestor occurred in generation t, as a function of inbreeding coefficients and variance components (additive, dominance, additive-by-dominance, dominance-by-dominance, and additive-by-additive).
formula-notes:formula_11.15:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on drift-induced changes in genetic variation to quantify how inbreeding alters covariances among relatives, supporting later arguments about the decomposition of genetic variance in inbred populations.

formula-notes:formula_11.14:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将共祖系数Θxy（从x和y中各随机抽取一个基因，两基因同源相同的概率）表示为压缩身份系数Δ的加权和：Δ1xy（两基因均同源）权重1，Δ3xy、Δ5xy、Δ7xy（仅一个基因同源）权重1/2，Δ8xy（两基因均不同源但来自同一祖先）权重1/4。
formula-notes:formula_11.14:zh.inThisChapter: 本章引入遗传漂变对遗传变异的影响，公式(11.14)将共祖系数与压缩身份系数联系起来，为后续推导近交系数、方差分量等提供基础工具。

formula-notes:formula_11.16:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the genetic covariance between a parent in generation t and a descendant in generation j, where σ_A², σ_D², σ_ADI, σ_DI², σ_AA² are variance components, f_k = 1 - (1/2)^k, and ι* is a function of allele frequencies.
formula-notes:formula_11.16:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on changes in genetic variation induced by drift to quantify how drift alters the covariance between relatives across generations, supporting later arguments about the decay of genetic variance under drift.

formula-notes:formula_11.13:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算个体x和y之间的遗传协方差σ_G(x,y)，将其分解为加性方差σ_A^2、显性方差σ_D^2、加性×加性上位方差σ_DI^2、加性×显性上位协方差σ_ADI以及由连锁不平衡引起的项ι*和ι^2-ι*的贡献，各分量由共祖系数Θ_xy、双位点联合身份系数Δ_7xy、Δ_1xy等加权。
formula-notes:formula_11.13:zh.inThisChapter: 在漂变引起的遗传变异变化章节中，该公式扩展了无上位和连锁平衡下的经典结果，引入双位点身份系数和连锁不平衡参数，为后续推导漂变如何改变群体遗传协方差结构提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_11.17:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the expected genetic covariance between two relatives (x_i, y_j) within a line after t generations of drift, given equal allele frequencies. Key symbols: σ_A^2 (additive variance), σ_D^2 (dominance variance), σ_AA^2 (additive-by-additive epistatic variance), t (generations of drift), i and j (generations from common ancestor).
formula-notes:formula_11.17:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to show how drift reduces within-line genetic variance components by factors of (1/2)^t, (1/2)^{i+j-t}, and (1/2)^{2t}, supporting later arguments on the decay of genetic variation and the increase of between-line variance.

formula-notes:formula_11.19b:en.plainMeaning: These three equations define the elements of relationship matrices M1, M2, and M3 in terms of condensed identity coefficients Δ and inbreeding coefficients f, capturing different components of genetic covariance between inbred relatives.
formula-notes:formula_11.19b:en.inThisChapter: They appear in the section on covariance between inbred relatives to provide the necessary matrix components for modeling the covariance structure under inbreeding, supporting later arguments on computational demands and the use of alternative approaches.

formula-notes:formula_11.16:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算了来自第t代亲本（x_t）与第j代后代（y_j）之间的遗传协方差σ_G，其中关键符号包括：f_t和f_j为近交系数，σ_A^2为加性方差，σ_D^2为显性方差，ι*为近交衰退参数，σ_ADI、σ_DI^2、σ_AA^2为不同遗传分量间的协方差或方差。
formula-notes:formula_11.16:zh.inThisChapter: 此公式出现在“漂移引起的遗传变异变化”章节中，用于量化漂移下不同世代个体间的遗传协方差，为后续推导群体遗传方差随世代演变的动态方程提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_11.18:en.plainMeaning: This matrix equation updates six genetic identity coefficients (1-Δ₁, 1-Δ₃, 1-Δ₇, 1-Δ₂, 1-f, 1-Θ) from generation t to t+1 under a specific mating system, where the transition matrix encodes the probabilities of allelic state changes due to drift and consanguinity.
formula-notes:formula_11.18:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to drift-induced changes in genetic variation to show how identity coefficients evolve recursively, supporting later arguments about the decay of heterozygosity and the approach to fixation in finite populations.

formula-notes:formula_11.17:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算在漂变t代后，来自同一品系的个体x_i和y_j之间的遗传协方差，其中σ_A^2、σ_D^2、σ_AA^2分别表示加性、显性和加性×加性上位方差，系数(1/2)^t、(1/2)^{i+j-t}和(1/2)^{2t}反映了各分量因漂变而衰减的程度。
formula-notes:formula_11.17:zh.inThisChapter: 在漂变诱导遗传变异变化的引言中，此公式用于量化漂变如何改变家系内个体间的遗传相似性，为后续推导群体内总遗传方差及其分量随时间的衰减奠定基础。

formula-notes:formula_11.20a:en.plainMeaning: This recursion predicts the additive genetic variance σ_A^2 at generation t, given the previous generation's variance, the effective population size N_e, and the mutational input σ_m^2 per generation.
formula-notes:formula_11.20a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to drift-induced changes to show how mutation and drift jointly maintain genetic variance, supporting later derivations of the equilibrium variance (11.20b) and the loss of variation under strong drift (11.20c).

formula-notes:formula_11.19a:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the covariance matrix V of phenotypic values y for inbred relatives as the sum of additive genetic variance σ²_A times the additive relationship matrix A, dominance variance σ²_D times D, digenic interaction variances σ²_DI and σ²_ADI times M₁ and M₂, an inbreeding term ι* times M₃, and environmental variance σ²_e times V_e.
formula-notes:formula_11.19a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on covariance between inbred relatives to extend the basic decomposition from Equation 11.13 by including dominance and epistatic components, supporting later derivations of covariances for inbred populations.

formula-notes:formula_11.18:zh.plainMeaning: 该矩阵方程描述了在连续世代t到t+1中，六个遗传系数（1-Δ₁, 1-Δ₃, 1-Δ₇, 1-Δ₂, 1-f, 1-Θ）的线性递推关系，其中转移矩阵的每一行给出了下一世代对应系数的加权组合。
formula-notes:formula_11.18:zh.inThisChapter: 本节引入漂变导致的遗传变异变化，该递推矩阵用于计算全同胞间协方差的所有系数，为后续推导近交与共祖系数的动态变化提供代数工具。

formula-notes:formula_11.15:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算来自随机交配基础群体的自交系中，两个分别处于自交代数 i 和 j 的个体（其最近共同祖先在 t 代）之间的遗传协方差 σ_G，它分解为加性方差 σ_A^2、显性方差 σ_D^2、加性×显性互作方差 σ_ADI、显性×显性互作方差 σ_DI^2 和加性×加性互作方差 σ_AA^2 的线性组合，系数由自交系数 f_i、f_j、f_t 决定。
formula-notes:formula_11.15:zh.inThisChapter: 本章讨论漂变引起的遗传变异变化，该公式作为自交系间遗传协方差的一般表达式，为后续推导特定亲缘关系（如亲本与后代）的协方差提供基础，并展示自交如何改变方差分量对协方差的贡献。

formula-notes:formula_11.19a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将表型协方差矩阵 V 分解为加性方差 σ_A²、显性方差 σ_D²、显性×显性上位方差 σ_DI²、加性×显性上位协方差 σ_ADI、近交线性项 ι* 以及环境方差 σ_e² 分别乘以对应的关系矩阵 A、D、M₁、M₂、M₃ 和 V_e 之和。
formula-notes:formula_11.19a:zh.inThisChapter: 在近交亲缘协方差章节中，该公式扩展了方程 11.13，通过引入近交相关矩阵 M₁、M₂、M₃ 和 ι*，为后续推导近交群体中亲缘协方差的显性和上位性分量提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_11.20a:zh.plainMeaning: 该递推公式描述了在遗传漂变影响下，第t代加性遗传方差σ_A²(t)等于上一代方差σ_A²(t-1)乘以(1 - 1/(2N_e))，再加上每代由突变新产生的加性方差σ_m²。
formula-notes:formula_11.20a:zh.inThisChapter: 本章引入漂变对遗传变异的影响，此公式作为基础递推关系，用于推导平衡时（t→∞）的加性遗传方差（公式11.20b）以及预测长期变异维持水平。

formula-notes:formula_11.19b:zh.plainMeaning: 公式 (11.19b) 定义了三个关系矩阵 M1、M2、M3 的元素：M1ij 等于 Δ1ij，M2ij 等于 2Δ1ij + Δ3ij + Δ5ij，M3ij 等于 Δ2ij 减去 fi 与 fj 的乘积，其中 Δ 是共祖系数，f 是近交系数。
formula-notes:formula_11.19b:zh.inThisChapter: 在“近交亲属间协方差”一节中，该公式给出了构建多基因遗传协方差矩阵所需的关系矩阵元素，为后续计算近交群体中亲属间的表型协方差提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_11.20c:en.plainMeaning: This formula gives the equilibrium additive genetic variance (σ²_A(∞)) for a neutral quantitative trait under drift, equal to twice the effective population size (N_e) times the mutational variance (σ²_m).
formula-notes:formula_11.20c:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to changes in genetic variation induced by drift to show the long-term balance between mutation and drift, supporting later arguments about the maintenance of genetic variance in finite populations.

formula-notes:formula_11.20b:en.plainMeaning: This formula predicts the additive genetic variance σ_A²(t) after t generations of drift, given initial variance σ_A²(0), effective population size N_e, and mutational input 2N_eσ_m². It shows that variance approaches an equilibrium 2N_eσ_m² over time.
formula-notes:formula_11.20b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to changes in genetic variation induced by drift, illustrating how drift and mutation balance to determine long-term genetic variance, supporting later discussions on the maintenance of quantitative genetic variation.

formula-notes:formula_11.20b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式描述了在遗传漂变影响下，加性遗传方差 σ_A²(t) 随时间 t 的变化：它从初始值 σ_A²(0) 开始，以速率 1/(2N_e) 指数衰减，最终趋近于平衡值 2N_e σ_m²，其中 N_e 是有效群体大小，σ_m² 是每代突变引入的加性方差。
formula-notes:formula_11.20b:zh.inThisChapter: 本章讨论漂变如何改变遗传变异，公式 (11.20b) 是微分方程 (11.20a) 的解，用于量化漂变与突变共同作用下加性方差随时间的变化，为后续推导平衡方差 (11.20c) 提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_11.21b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算在漂变-突变平衡下，每个核苷酸位点的期望杂合度E(H)，其中Ne为有效群体大小，μ0为每核苷酸突变率。
formula-notes:formula_11.21b:zh.inThisChapter: 此处通过对比公式11.21a与漂变-突变平衡下的期望杂合度公式，说明两者形式相似但参数不同，为后续讨论漂变与突变对遗传变异的影响做铺垫。

formula-notes:formula_11.20c:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算中性加性数量性状在平衡状态（t→∞）下的遗传方差，等于有效群体大小Ne乘以每代突变引入的加性方差σm²的两倍。
formula-notes:formula_11.20c:zh.inThisChapter: 本章讨论遗传漂变引起的遗传变异变化，此公式给出漂变与突变平衡时的期望遗传方差，为后续理解中性进化中遗传变异的维持提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_11.21b:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the expected heterozygosity (E(H)) at a nucleotide site under drift-mutation equilibrium, where Ne is the effective population size and μ0 is the per-nucleotide mutation rate.
formula-notes:formula_11.21b:en.inThisChapter: It appears here to contrast with Equation 11.21a, showing that the same form arises from drift-mutation balance, supporting the argument that drift reduces genetic variation analogously to inbreeding.

formula-notes:formula_11.21a:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the expected equilibrium heritability (h̃²) of a neutral trait under mutation-drift balance, expressed as the ratio of additive genetic variance (σ̃²_A) to total phenotypic variance (σ̃²_A + σ²_E), and equivalently in terms of effective population size (N_e), mutational variance (σ_m), and mutational heritability (h²_m).
formula-notes:formula_11.21a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to changes in genetic variation induced by drift to show how drift and mutation together determine the long-term heritability of neutral traits, supporting later arguments about the maintenance of genetic variation and the limits of selection response.

formula-notes:formula_11.22b:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the equilibrium dominance genetic variance (σ̃_D²) under mutation-drift balance, where N_e is effective population size, σ_m² is mutational variance, and k̄ and σ_k² are the mean and variance of dominance coefficients.
formula-notes:formula_11.22b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to show how drift and mutation jointly determine the equilibrium of non-additive genetic variance, supporting later arguments about the maintenance of genetic variation in finite populations.

formula-notes:formula_11.23:en.plainMeaning: This formula expresses the effect of a mutant allele (a_m) as a linear function of the ancestral state (a_0) scaled by τ plus a random deviation (e_a).
formula-notes:formula_11.23:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to changes in genetic variation induced by drift to unify two limiting models (Lynch-Hill when τ=1 and a house-of-cards model when τ=0) under a single framework, supporting later arguments about the dynamics of genetic variance under drift.

formula-notes:formula_11.22a:en.plainMeaning: This formula approximates the equilibrium additive genetic variance (σ̃_A²) under mutation-drift balance, expressed in terms of effective population size (N_e), the mutational variance (σ_m²), and the mean dominance coefficient (k̄).
formula-notes:formula_11.22a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to changes in genetic variation induced by drift to show how drift and mutation interact to maintain additive variance at equilibrium, and it supports the later argument that dominance affects the balance between drift and mutation.

formula-notes:formula_11.23:zh.plainMeaning: 公式 (11.23) 将突变等位基因效应 a_m 表示为祖先状态 a_0 的线性回归 τ a_0 加上随机偏差 e_a，其中 τ 是回归系数，e_a 是期望偏差。
formula-notes:formula_11.23:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在介绍漂变引起的遗传变异变化章节，用于统一描述两种极端突变模型（τ=1 的增量模型和 τ=0 的独立模型），为后续推导突变效应在漂变下的分布变化提供基础框架。

formula-notes:formula_11.22a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算在突变-漂移平衡下，加性遗传方差（σ̃_A²）的近似值，它等于有效群体大小 N_e、突变方差 σ_m² 以及平均显度系数 k̄ 的函数，具体为 2N_e σ_m² (3+2k̄)/3。
formula-notes:formula_11.22a:zh.inThisChapter: 本章讨论遗传漂变引起的遗传变异变化，该公式出现在引入部分，为后续推导显性遗传方差（公式11.22b）以及比较加性与显性方差在平衡时的相对大小提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_11.25:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the coefficient of variation (CV) of the estimated average within-population genetic variance (σ̃²_A) under the infinite-alleles model. Key symbols: L = number of lines, E(a⁴) and E(a²) = fourth and second moments of mutational effects, N_e = effective population size, U = gametic mutation rate, s = sample size per line.
formula-notes:formula_11.25:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to drift-induced changes in genetic variation to quantify the sampling error when estimating the average genetic variance across lines, supporting later arguments about the precision of such estimates.

formula-notes:formula_11.24:en.plainMeaning: This formula gives the equilibrium additive genetic variance (σ̃_A²) as a function of effective population size (N_e), mutational variance (σ_m²), mutation rate (μ), and correlation of mutational effects (τ). It shows two limiting cases: when 4N_eμ ≪ 1, variance is proportional to N_e; when 4N_eμ ≫ 1, variance becomes independent of N_e.
formula-notes:formula_11.24:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to changes in genetic variation induced by drift to illustrate how drift and mutation interact to determine standing genetic variance, and it supports later arguments about the relative roles of drift versus mutation in maintaining variation.

formula-notes:formula_11.21a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算中性性状在突变-漂变平衡下的期望遗传力，将加性遗传方差与总表型方差之比表示为有效群体大小、突变方差和环境方差的函数，最终简化为仅依赖于Ne和突变遗传力hm²的形式。
formula-notes:formula_11.21a:zh.inThisChapter: 本章讨论漂变对遗传变异的影响，此公式基于11.20b的平衡加性方差，推导出平衡遗传力的表达式，为后续比较不同Ne下遗传力变化及理解突变维持遗传变异的能力提供定量基础。

formula-notes:formula_11.22b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算在突变-漂变平衡下，由漂变和突变共同维持的显性遗传方差近似值，其中关键符号：\(\widetilde{\sigma}_{D}^{2}\) 为平衡显性方差，\(N_e\) 为有效群体大小，\(\sigma_m^2\) 为每代突变引起的加性方差增量，\(\bar{k}\) 为显性系数的均值，\(\sigma_k^2\) 为显性系数的方差。
formula-notes:formula_11.22b:zh.inThisChapter: 本章介绍漂变如何改变遗传变异，此公式与(11.22a)共同给出平衡时加性和显性遗传方差的近似表达式，为后续讨论漂变对遗传变异长期维持的影响提供定量基础。

formula-notes:formula_11.27:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算总加性遗传方差 σ_{A,T}^2，它等于有效种群大小 2Nd 和迁移相关项 (d-1)^2/(2dm) 之和乘以突变方差 σ_m^2，其中 d 为亚种群数，N 为每个亚种群的个体数，m 为迁移率。
formula-notes:formula_11.27:zh.inThisChapter: 在漂变-突变平衡章节中，该公式整合了漂变（通过 2Nd）和迁移（通过 (d-1)^2/(2dm)）对遗传方差的影响，为后续分析亚种群分化与基因流对遗传多样性的作用提供定量基础。

formula-notes:formula_11.26:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the average within-deme additive genetic variance (σ_A²) under drift-mutation equilibrium, where N_T is the total population size across demes, μ is mutation rate, n is number of loci, E(a²) is expected squared effect of a mutation, and σ_m² = 4N_T μ n E(a²)/2 is the mutational variance per generation.
formula-notes:formula_11.26:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the Drift-Mutation Equilibrium section to show that the within-deme genetic variance equals 2N_T σ_m², analogous to the single-deme result 2N_e σ_m², supporting the argument that total population size N_T replaces effective size N_e in structured populations.

formula-notes:formula_11.27:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the total additive genetic variance in a metapopulation (σ²_A,T) as a function of the number of demes (d), local effective population size (N), migration rate (m), and the mutational variance per generation (σ²_m).
formula-notes:formula_11.27:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the Drift-Mutation Equilibrium section to show how population subdivision and migration affect the equilibrium genetic variance, supporting the argument that metapopulation structure can increase genetic variance beyond that of a single panmictic population.

formula-notes:formula_11.24:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算在突变-漂移平衡下，加性遗传方差的期望值。关键符号：\(\widetilde{\sigma}_{A}^{2}\) 是平衡加性遗传方差，\(N_e\) 是有效群体大小，\(\sigma_m^2\) 是每代新突变贡献的方差，\(\mu\) 是突变率，\(\tau\) 是突变效应相关性参数。
formula-notes:formula_11.24:zh.inThisChapter: 出现在本章介绍漂移引起的遗传变异变化部分，用于展示在一般突变模型（包含 \(\tau\)）下平衡方差的解析解，并为后续讨论不同突变模型（如 \(\tau=0\) 的 house-of-cards 模型）的极限行为提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_12.2:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the covariance of the between-line component of genetic variance at two different times t and t', showing how shared ancestry (through the inbreeding coefficient f_t and the number of founder lines N_fo) creates a correlation proportional to the initial additive genetic variance σ_A^2(0).
formula-notes:formula_12.2:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to neutral divergence of quantitative traits to establish that among-line variances are not independent across generations, which is essential for understanding the temporal dynamics of population differentiation under drift.

formula-notes:formula_12.2:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算在时间点t和t'（t < t'）之间，由于共同祖先导致的群体间遗传方差协方差σ_B(t,t')，它等于初始加性遗传方差σ_A^2(0)乘以(1/N_fo + 2f_t)，其中N_fo是创始个体数，f_t是t时刻的共祖系数。
formula-notes:formula_12.2:zh.inThisChapter: 本章介绍数量性状的中性分化，公式(12.2)用于量化连续世代间群体间方差的遗传相关性，为后续推导分化程度随时间演化以及中性预期下的F_ST等统计量提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_11.26:zh.plainMeaning: 公式 (11.26) 计算了在漂变-突变平衡下，整个集合种群（共 NT 个个体）内每个亚群的加性遗传方差 σA²。它等于 2NT 乘以每代每基因座的新增突变方差 σm²，其中 σm² = 2μ·E(a²) 是单个单倍体基因座每代新增的遗传方差。
formula-notes:formula_11.26:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在“漂变-突变平衡”一节，用于推导集合种群中遗传方差的平衡值。它表明，在集合种群中，平衡遗传方差与单个隔离亚群的形式相同，只是将有效大小 Ne 替换为总个体数 NT，为后续比较集合种群与单个亚群的遗传多样性提供了基础。

formula-notes:formula_12.3:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算了在世代t时，实验间观测到的群体间方差估计值σ̂_B²(t)的抽样方差，它由初始加性遗传方差σ_A⁴(0)、有效群体大小N_fo、近交系数f_t及其方差σ_f²(t)共同决定。
formula-notes:formula_12.3:zh.inThisChapter: 在“短期分化”章节中，该公式用于量化遗传漂变导致的群体间方差估计的不确定性，为后续评估分化显著性及比较不同实验的可靠性提供理论基础。

formula-notes:formula_12.1a:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the expected among-line variance in a quantitative trait (σ_B²(t)) as a function of initial additive genetic variance (σ_A²(0)), effective founder size (N_fo), and inbreeding coefficient (f_t). Key symbols: σ_B²(t) = among-line variance at generation t, a_i = additive effect of allele i, p_i(0) = initial allele frequency, N_fo = effective number of founders, N_e = effective population size, f_t = inbreeding coefficient at generation t.
formula-notes:formula_12.1a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to neutral divergence of quantitative traits to show how drift and founder effects generate among-line variance, supporting later arguments about the neutral expectation for QST relative to FST.

formula-notes:formula_11.25:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算无限等位基因模型下群体内加性遗传方差估计量（~σ_A^2）的变异系数（CV），它等于括号内三项之和除以L再开平方根，其中L是品系数，N_e是有效群体大小，U是配子突变率，E(a^2)和E(a^4)是突变效应分布的二阶和四阶矩，s是每品系样本量。
formula-notes:formula_11.25:zh.inThisChapter: 本章介绍遗传漂变引起的遗传变异变化，该公式出现在引言部分，用于量化漂变和突变平衡下群体内遗传方差估计的精度，为后续讨论实验设计（如所需品系数L和样本量s）提供理论依据。

formula-notes:formula_12.5a:zh.plainMeaning: 公式 (12.5a) 表明，样本方差 Var 乘以 (n-1) 后服从自由度为 n-1 的卡方分布乘以总体方差 σ²，即 (n-1)Var 与 σ²χ²_{n-1} 同分布。
formula-notes:formula_12.5a:zh.inThisChapter: 在本节“短期发散”中，该公式用于建立样本方差 Var 的抽样分布，为后续推导真实方差 σ² 的置信区间（公式 12.5b）提供理论基础。

formula-notes:formula_12.4:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算两个不同世代t和t'（t < t'）的加性遗传方差估计值σ̂_B²之间的协方差，它由三项组成：第一项与有效群体大小N_fo有关，第二项与近交系数f_t和f_t'的乘积成正比，第三项包含特征值λ₁和世代间隔t'-t以及σ_f²(t)。
formula-notes:formula_12.4:zh.inThisChapter: 在“短期分歧”章节中，该公式用于量化不同时间点估计值之间的相关性，为后续推导回归斜率和截距的标准误（考虑数据内在相关性）提供协方差结构基础。

formula-notes:formula_12.3:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the sampling variance of the realized among-population variance estimate σ̂_B²(t) across replicate experiments. Key symbols: σ̂_B²(t) is the realized among-population variance at generation t; σ_A⁴(0) is the square of the initial additive genetic variance; L is the number of loci; N_fo is the number of founders; f_t is the inbreeding coefficient at generation t; σ_f²(t) is the variance of the inbreeding coefficient across replicates.
formula-notes:formula_12.3:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on short-term divergence to quantify the stochastic variation in estimates of population differentiation due to genetic drift, supporting later arguments about the precision of divergence measures and the design of experiments to detect selection.

formula-notes:formula_12.5a:en.plainMeaning: This formula states that (n-1) times the sample variance Var follows a chi-square distribution with n-1 degrees of freedom, scaled by the true variance σ². Here, n is sample size, Var is the sample variance estimator, σ² is the population variance, and χ²_{n-1} denotes a chi-square random variable with n-1 degrees of freedom.
formula-notes:formula_12.5a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the Short-Term Divergence section to establish the sampling distribution of the variance estimator, which is then used to derive confidence intervals for σ² and to support the construction of formula 12.5b.

formula-notes:formula_12.1a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算了数量性状在t代后各群体间的遗传方差σ_B²(t)，它等于每个位点效应平方a_i²乘以初始杂合度p_i(0)[1-p_i(0)]，再乘以由有效创始群体大小N_fo和近交系数f_t决定的系数，最后对所有位点求和。简化形式表明σ_B²(t)等于初始加性遗传方差σ_A²(0)乘以(1/N_fo + 2f_t)。
formula-notes:formula_12.1a:zh.inThisChapter: 此公式出现在“数量性状的中性分化”章节引言中，用于推导在仅有遗传漂变（无选择）情况下，群体间遗传方差随时间增长的表达式。它为后续比较中性预期与选择下的分化模式提供了基准，并引入了有效创始群体大小N_fo和近交系数f_t等关键参数。

formula-notes:formula_12.4:en.plainMeaning: This formula approximates the covariance between estimates of additive genetic variance (σ̂_B²) at two different generations t and t′ (with t < t′), where f_t and f_t′ are inbreeding coefficients, N_fo is the number of founder individuals, σ_A⁴(0) is the squared additive genetic variance in the base population, L is the number of loci, λ₁ = 1 - 1/(2N) is the eigenvalue from the pedigree, and σ_f²(t) is the variance of inbreeding at generation t.
formula-notes:formula_12.4:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the 'SHORT-TERM DIVERGENCE' section to quantify the non-independence of σ̂_B² estimates across generations, which is essential for correctly weighting data points in regression analysis of short-term evolutionary response, as discussed in the surrounding context.

formula-notes:formula_12.5b:en.plainMeaning: This formula states that the probability that a chi-squared random variable with n degrees of freedom falls between the lower critical value X_{α/2,n} and the upper critical value X_{1-α/2,n} equals 1-α. The symbols are: χ_n^2 (chi-squared with n df), X_{p,n} (p-th quantile), α (significance level).
formula-notes:formula_12.5b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on short-term divergence to establish the confidence interval for the true variance σ². By substituting (n-1)Var/σ² for χ_{n-1}^2, it directly leads to Equation 12.6a, which provides the probability statement for constructing the interval.

formula-notes:formula_12.6a:en.plainMeaning: This formula expresses the probability that the ratio (n-1)Var/σ² lies between two chi-square quantiles, establishing a confidence interval for the population variance σ² based on sample variance Var and sample size n.
formula-notes:formula_12.6a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the Short-Term Divergence section to derive a confidence interval for variance, supporting later arguments about volatility estimation and hypothesis testing in financial time series.

formula-notes:formula_12.6b:en.plainMeaning: This formula expresses the probability that the reciprocal of the sample variance scaled by the population variance lies between the reciprocals of chi-square quantiles, which equals the confidence level 1-α.
formula-notes:formula_12.6b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on short-term divergence to invert the chi-square inequality from Equation 12.6a, leading directly to the confidence interval for σ² in Equation 12.6c.

formula-notes:formula_12.6c:en.plainMeaning: This formula gives a confidence interval for the population variance σ², where Var is the sample variance, n is the sample size, and X_{α/2,n-1} and X_{1-α/2,n-1} are chi-square quantiles with n-1 degrees of freedom. The interval has confidence level 1-α.
formula-notes:formula_12.6c:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the Short-Term Divergence section to provide a statistical method for estimating the variance of short-term returns, supporting later arguments about volatility estimation and hypothesis testing.

formula-notes:formula_12.5b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式表示卡方分布χ_n^2落在下侧α/2分位数X_{α/2,n}与上侧α/2分位数X_{1-α/2,n}之间的概率为1-α，即区间[X_{α/2,n}, X_{1-α/2,n}]覆盖了χ_n^2的1-α概率质量。
formula-notes:formula_12.5b:zh.inThisChapter: 在本节（短期发散）中，该公式为后续推导方差σ^2的置信区间提供基础：通过将χ_n^2替换为(n-1)Var/σ^2（来自公式12.5a），即可得到关于σ^2的概率不等式，进而构造置信区间。

formula-notes:formula_12.6a:zh.plainMeaning: 这个公式表示，随机变量 (n-1)Var/σ² 落在卡方分布下侧 α/2 分位数 X_{α/2,n-1} 和上侧 α/2 分位数 X_{1-α/2,n-1} 之间的概率为 1-α。
formula-notes:formula_12.6a:zh.inThisChapter: 本节（短期发散度）中，该公式通过将 (n-1)Var/σ² 替换 χ²_{n-1} 得到，为后续推导 σ² 的置信区间（公式 12.6c）提供概率陈述基础。

formula-notes:formula_12.6b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将概率语句中的不等式取倒数，从而将卡方分布分位数从分子移到分母，得到关于总体方差σ²的区间概率表达式，关键符号包括卡方分位数X_{α/2,n-1}和X_{1-α/2,n-1}、样本方差Var、样本量n。
formula-notes:formula_12.6b:zh.inThisChapter: 在短期发散章节中，此公式通过代数变换将(12.6a)中的卡方统计量不等式转化为关于σ²的不等式，为下一步直接写出σ²的置信区间(12.6c)做铺垫。

formula-notes:formula_12.7a:en.plainMeaning: This formula gives the lower and upper bounds of a 100(1-α)% confidence interval for the variance (Var) when the true variance is σ₀², using chi-squared critical values X_{α/2,n-1} and X_{1-α/2,n-1} with n-1 degrees of freedom.
formula-notes:formula_12.7a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the Short-Term Divergence section to quantify the uncertainty in variance estimates, supporting later arguments about hypothesis testing or confidence intervals for variance in short-term data.

formula-notes:formula_12.6c:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式给出了总体方差 σ² 的置信区间，下界为 (n-1)Var 除以卡方分布上侧分位数 X_{1-α/2,n-1}，上界为 (n-1)Var 除以卡方分布下侧分位数 X_{α/2,n-1}，置信水平为 1-α。
formula-notes:formula_12.6c:zh.inThisChapter: 在“短期发散”章节中，该公式用于构造方差 σ² 的区间估计，为后续检验短期波动是否显著提供统计推断基础。

formula-notes:formula_12.7b:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the probability β (Type II error) that a sample variance from a normal distribution with true variance σ₁² will not be declared statistically significant when tested against a null variance σ₀², using a chi-squared distribution with n−1 degrees of freedom and critical values X_{α/2,n-1} and X_{1-α/2,n-1}.
formula-notes:formula_12.7b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on short-term divergence to quantify the power of the variance test when the true variance differs from the null, supporting the argument that the test's ability to detect divergence depends on the ratio σ₀²/σ₁².

formula-notes:formula_12.7a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式给出了当总体方差真值为σ₀²时，方差Var的100(1-α)%置信区间：下限为(σ₀²/(n-1))乘以卡方分布下侧α/2分位数X_{α/2,n-1}，上限为(σ₀²/(n-1))乘以卡方分布上侧α/2分位数X_{1-α/2,n-1}。
formula-notes:formula_12.7a:zh.inThisChapter: 在“短期发散”章节中，该公式用于基于样本方差与卡方分布的关系构建方差置信区间，为后续检验方差是否等于σ₀²或比较不同时期方差提供推断基础。

formula-notes:formula_12.7c:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the power (1-β) of a two-tailed chi-square test for variance, where the test statistic under the alternative variance σ₁² follows a chi-square distribution with n-1 degrees of freedom, and the critical values are scaled by σ₀²/σ₁².
formula-notes:formula_12.7c:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on short-term divergence to quantify the probability of correctly rejecting the null hypothesis (σ² = σ₀²) when the true variance is σ₁², supporting the assessment of test sensitivity for detecting volatility changes.

formula-notes:formula_12.8a:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the sample variance among the replicate population means, estimating the between-population variance σ_B²(t). Here, L is the number of replicate populations, z̄_i(t) is the mean of the i-th replicate at time t, and z̄_.(t) is the grand mean across all replicates.
formula-notes:formula_12.8a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the Short-Term Divergence section to provide an empirical estimate of the between-population variance, which is used in subsequent formulas (12.8b–12.8e) to partition total variance and test for population differentiation.

formula-notes:formula_12.8a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算了L个重复种群在时刻t的样本均值之间的样本方差，其中z̄_i(t)是第i个重复种群的样本均值，z̄_·(t)是所有L个样本均值的平均值。
formula-notes:formula_12.8a:zh.inThisChapter: 在“短期发散”章节中，该公式用于估计种群间方差σ_B^2(t)，为后续推导基于两个种群的检验统计量（如公式12.8b-12.8e）提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_12.8b:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the squared difference between the means of two replicate populations at time t, where \(\overline{z}_1(t)\) and \(\overline{z}_2(t)\) are the sample means of the two populations.
formula-notes:formula_12.8b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on short-term divergence to quantify the divergence between two populations, and it supports later tests by relating to the between-population variance \(V_B\) via Equation 12.8a.

formula-notes:formula_12.7c:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算检验功效（1-β），即当真实方差为σ₁²时，检验统计量χ²落在拒绝域（小于下临界值或大于上临界值）的概率。关键符号：χ²_{n-1}是自由度为n-1的卡方变量，σ₀²是原假设下的方差，σ₁²是备择假设下的方差，X_{α/2,n-1}和X_{1-α/2,n-1}是原假设下卡方分布的双侧临界值。
formula-notes:formula_12.7c:zh.inThisChapter: 在“短期发散”章节中，该公式用于量化当实际波动率偏离原假设时检验的敏感度，为后续比较不同样本量或显著性水平下的检验性能提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_12.8c:en.plainMeaning: For L=2 groups, the between-group variance V_B equals half the squared difference d^2 between the two group means, where d = |z̄₁ - z̄₂|.
formula-notes:formula_12.8c:en.inThisChapter: It simplifies the general V_B formula (12.8a) for the two-group case, directly linking to the divergence measure d² in (12.8b) and supporting later derivations in (12.8d) and (12.8e).

formula-notes:formula_12.7b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算当真实方差为σ₁²时，样本方差落入原假设σ₀²下接受域的概率β，即第二类错误概率。关键符号：β为犯第二类错误的概率，σ₀²为原假设方差，σ₁²为真实方差，χ²_{n-1}为自由度为n-1的卡方统计量，X_{α/2,n-1}和X_{1-α/2,n-1}为卡方分布的分位数。
formula-notes:formula_12.7b:zh.inThisChapter: 在短期发散度章节中，该公式用于量化当过程方差实际变为σ₁²时，基于样本方差的检验未能检测出变化（即未拒绝原假设）的概率，为后续计算检验的功效（1-β）或设计控制图样本量提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_12.8e:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式通过组间均方（MS_B）减去组内均方（MS_W）再除以平均样本量（n₀），估计群体间遗传方差V_B(t)。
formula-notes:formula_12.8e:zh.inThisChapter: 在“短期分歧”章节中，此公式提供了一种基于单因素方差分析估计群体间方差的方法，为后续计算遗传分化或进化速率等指标奠定基础。

formula-notes:formula_12.8d:en.plainMeaning: This formula decomposes the variance of the sample mean of line i into the true among-line variance (σ_B^2) plus the sampling error variance (σ_z^2/n), where σ_z^2 is the trait variance and n is the sample size per line.
formula-notes:formula_12.8d:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the Short-Term Divergence section to show that the observed among-line variance overestimates the true genetic variance σ_B^2 due to measurement error, and it supports the condition for when this bias is negligible (2f_t h^2 >> 1/n).

formula-notes:formula_12.8e:en.plainMeaning: This formula estimates the among-group variance component (VB(t)) from a one-way ANOVA by subtracting the within-group mean square (MSW) from the among-group mean square (MSB) and dividing by the average sample size per group (n0).
formula-notes:formula_12.8e:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the SHORT-TERM DIVERGENCE section to provide a simple ANOVA-based method for estimating among-group variance, supporting later arguments about quantifying population differentiation without complex breeding designs.

formula-notes:formula_12.8d:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将样本均值 $\overline{z}_i$ 的方差分解为真实群体均值 $\mu_i$ 的方差（即群体间方差 $\sigma_B^2$）与抽样误差 $e_i$ 的方差（即 $\sigma_z^2/n$）之和。
formula-notes:formula_12.8d:zh.inThisChapter: 在短期分歧（SHORT-TERM DIVERGENCE）章节中，该公式说明样本均值方差高估了真实群体间方差 $\sigma_B^2$，为后续推导校正估计量（如公式12.8e）提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_12.8b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算两个群体在时间t的均值向量（或均值函数）的平方差，即群体1的均值z̄₁(t)与群体2的均值z̄₂(t)之差的平方。
formula-notes:formula_12.8b:zh.inThisChapter: 本节讨论短期分歧，当只考虑两个群体时，该平方差作为衡量群体间差异的简单指标，并为后续与公式(12.8a)中群体间方差V_B建立联系（当L=2时）以及推导相关检验统计量做准备。

formula-notes:formula_12.8c:zh.plainMeaning: 公式 (12.8c) 计算当类别数 L=2 时，组间方差 V_B 等于两个类别均值 \(\overline{z}_1\) 和 \(\overline{z}_2\) 的平方差 \(d^2\) 的一半。
formula-notes:formula_12.8c:zh.inThisChapter: 在本节“短期发散度”中，该公式将组间方差 V_B 与两个均值之差的平方 d^2 直接联系起来，为后续推导 V_B 与 d^2 的线性关系（如公式 12.8d 和 12.8e）提供代数基础。

formula-notes:formula_12.9a:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the F-statistic for neutral divergence, where F_CV equals the observed among-population variance V_B(t) divided by the expected variance under drift (t * V_A(0) / N_e). Key symbols: V_B(t) = among-population variance at generation t, V_A(0) = initial additive genetic variance, N_e = effective population size, t = number of generations.
formula-notes:formula_12.9a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the Short-Term Divergence section to provide a neutrality test using a single divergence estimate, supporting later arguments about detecting selection versus drift in population differentiation.

formula-notes:formula_12.9b:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the between-line variance V_B(t) from L independent sample means, showing it follows a scaled chi-square distribution with L-1 degrees of freedom, where σ_B²(t) is the between-line variance component.
formula-notes:formula_12.9b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the Short-Term Divergence section to quantify the among-line variance under a star phylogeny, supporting later arguments about the distribution of F-statistics for detecting selection.

formula-notes:formula_12.9c:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the between-population genetic variance σ_B²(t) after t generations, given initial additive variance σ_A²(0) and effective population size N_e. For small t relative to N_e, it simplifies to t σ_A²(0)/N_e.
formula-notes:formula_12.9c:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on short-term divergence to quantify how quickly populations diverge due to genetic drift, and it supports the derivation of the chi-squared distribution for V_B(t) in Equation 12.9d.

formula-notes:formula_12.9a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算F统计量F_CV，分子V_B(t)是t代后群体间表型方差，分母t·V_A(0)/N_e是中性进化下预期群体间方差，其中V_A(0)是基础群体加性遗传方差，t是分化代数，N_e是有效群体大小。
formula-notes:formula_12.9a:zh.inThisChapter: 在“短期分化”章节中，该公式用于检验群体间表型分化是否显著偏离中性漂移预期，为后续公式12.9b-12.9e提供基础框架，这些公式进一步考虑不同实验设计或假设下的中性检验统计量。

formula-notes:formula_12.9d:en.plainMeaning: This formula states that the between-population variance V_B(t) is distributed as a chi-square with L-1 degrees of freedom, scaled by (t σ_A^2(0))/(N_e [L-1]), where t is time, σ_A^2(0) is initial additive genetic variance, N_e is effective population size, and L is number of populations.
formula-notes:formula_12.9d:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the SHORT-TERM DIVERGENCE section to provide a distributional result for V_B(t) under the approximation t << N_e, supporting later tests of neutral divergence or estimation of N_e from observed variances.

formula-notes:formula_12.9e:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式表明，在零假设下，F统计量F_CV近似服从自由度为L-1和无穷大的F分布，即F_{L-1,∞}，等价于卡方分布χ²_{L-1}除以自由度L-1。
formula-notes:formula_12.9e:zh.inThisChapter: 在短期发散检验章节中，该公式用于推导F统计量的渐近分布，为后续构造检验临界值或p值提供理论依据。

formula-notes:formula_12.9e:en.plainMeaning: This formula states that the F-statistic for comparing variances (F_CV) follows a chi-squared distribution with L-1 degrees of freedom divided by L-1, which is equivalent to an F-distribution with L-1 numerator degrees of freedom and infinite denominator degrees of freedom. Key symbols: F_CV (test statistic), χ²_{L-1} (chi-squared with L-1 df), F_{L-1,∞} (F-distribution).
formula-notes:formula_12.9e:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the Short-Term Divergence section to show that under the null hypothesis, the test statistic F_CV has a known asymptotic distribution, enabling hypothesis testing for variance equality across groups.

formula-notes:formula_12.9c:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式给出了群体间遗传方差 σ_B²(t) 在时间 t 的近似表达式：它等于 2f_t 乘以初始方差 σ_A²(0)，其中 f_t 是累积近交系数；当 t 远小于有效群体大小 N_e 时，进一步近似为 t σ_A²(0)/N_e。
formula-notes:formula_12.9c:zh.inThisChapter: 在“短期分化”一节中，该公式通过忽略奠基者效应，将群体间方差与近交系数 f_t 直接关联，为后续推导群体间方差服从卡方分布（公式12.9d）提供了线性近似基础。

formula-notes:formula_12.9b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算在L个独立谱系间，t时刻的群体均值（z̄_i）与总均值（z̄_.）的离差平方和除以(L-1)，即组间方差V_B(t)；它服从自由度为L-1的卡方分布乘以σ_B²(t)/(L-1)，其中σ_B²(t)是t时刻的组间方差参数。
formula-notes:formula_12.9b:zh.inThisChapter: 在“短期分歧”章节中，该公式用于量化多个独立谱系在短时间内因遗传漂变产生的均值差异，为后续推导V_B(t)的期望和检验谱系间分化程度提供分布基础。

formula-notes:formula_12.9d:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式表示，在短时间尺度下，群体间等位基因频率的方差V_B(t)近似服从一个自由度为L-1的卡方分布，其尺度参数为tσ_A^2(0) / (N_e [L-1])，其中t为时间（世代数），σ_A^2(0)为初始祖先群体内的方差，N_e为有效群体大小，L为亚群数目。
formula-notes:formula_12.9d:zh.inThisChapter: 在“短期分化”一节中，公式(12.9c)给出了V_B(t)的近似期望值，而(12.9d)进一步给出了其分布形式，为后续推导F_ST的分布或检验统计量（如公式12.9e）提供了基础。

formula-notes:formula_12.14a:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the variance of the phenotypic mean after t generations under neutral evolution, where σ_A^2 is the additive genetic variance and N_e is the effective population size.
formula-notes:formula_12.14a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the rate-based test section to quantify the expected neutral divergence variance, which is then used in Equation 12.14b to test if observed divergence exceeds neutral expectations.

formula-notes:formula_12.11:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the equilibrium among-population variance (σ̃_B²) for a quantitative trait under the house-of-cards mutation model, where it equals twice the product of (1 - expected heterozygosity per locus, E(H)) and the infinite-population additive genetic variance σ_A²(∞).
formula-notes:formula_12.11:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to neutral divergence of quantitative traits to show that under a bounded mutation model (house-of-cards), the among-population variance reaches a finite equilibrium, contrasting with the unbounded growth under the infinite-alleles model and supporting later discussions on the limits of neutral divergence.

formula-notes:formula_12.13:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the expected between-population variance σ_B²(t) after t generations, as a function of the mutation rate u and the equilibrium variance σ̃_B². It shows how divergence approaches equilibrium over time.
formula-notes:formula_12.13:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to neutral divergence of quantitative traits to illustrate that the approach to equilibrium is slow (on the order of 2u per generation), supporting the idea that divergence accumulates gradually under neutrality.

formula-notes:formula_12.10:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the expected between-population genetic variance σ_B²(t) after t generations of isolation, given initial additive variance σ_A²(0), mutational input σ_m², and effective population size N_e. Key symbols: σ_B²(t) = between-population variance at time t, σ_m² = per-generation mutational variance input, σ_A²(0) = initial within-population additive variance, N_e = effective population size.
formula-notes:formula_12.10:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to neutral divergence of quantitative traits to show how mutation and drift jointly determine the expected variance among populations over time, supporting later arguments about the linear long-term accumulation of variance at rate 2σ_m² per generation.

formula-notes:formula_12.12:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the equilibrium among-population variance (σ̃_B²) of a quantitative trait under mutation and drift, where E(a²) is the expected squared mutational effect, τ is a parameter measuring dependency of mutational effect on current allele value, N_e is effective population size, and u is mutation rate.
formula-notes:formula_12.12:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to neutral divergence of quantitative traits to show how mutation and drift interact to produce among-population variance, supporting later arguments about the neutral expectation of quantitative trait divergence.

formula-notes:formula_12.11:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算在“纸牌屋”模型下，有限等位基因突变导致的中性群体间方差平衡值，其中关键符号：E(H)是每个位点的期望杂合度，σ_A^2(∞)是无限大群体中的期望加性遗传方差。
formula-notes:formula_12.11:zh.inThisChapter: 本章引入中性数量性状分化，该公式为后续推导有限等位基因模型下群体间方差平衡提供关键表达式，并连接了杂合度与加性遗传方差。

formula-notes:formula_12.10:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算在无限等位基因模型下，两个隔离t代的群体之间基因型均值的期望方差σ_B²(t)，它由两部分组成：线性项2σ_m²t（突变驱动）和指数衰减项（初始方差与突变-漂移平衡的差异）。
formula-notes:formula_12.10:zh.inThisChapter: 本章引入中性数量性状分化，该公式展示了分化方差随时间的变化：长期趋近于线性增长（突变驱动），短期受初始方差影响，为后续讨论分化速率和中性检验提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_12.13:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算在t代后，群体间数量性状的遗传方差σ_B²(t)如何从0逐渐趋近于平衡方差σ̃_B²，其中(1-u)^(2t)表示每代突变率u导致的方差衰减因子。
formula-notes:formula_12.13:zh.inThisChapter: 此处用于说明当τ<1时，群体分化方差随时间缓慢增加，为后续讨论中性分化速率（约2u每代）提供定量基础。

formula-notes:formula_12.14a:zh.plainMeaning: 公式计算在t代后，群体表型均值的方差σ_t^2，等于每代遗传方差σ_A^2除以有效群体大小N_e再乘以时间t。
formula-notes:formula_12.14a:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在中性表型分化速率检验的章节，用于描述中性漂移下群体均值随时间累积的方差，为后续推导中性预期方差与观测方差的比较（如公式12.14b和12.14c）提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_12.14b:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the cumulative phenotypic variance (σ_t²) at generation t under a Brownian-motion model, summing over generations i=0 to t-1 the ratio of additive genetic variance σ_A²(i) to effective population size N_e(i) at each generation.
formula-notes:formula_12.14b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on rate-based tests for neutral phenotypic divergence, extending the constant-parameter model (12.14a) to allow time-varying σ_A² and N_e, and it supports the derivation of the expected variance under neutrality for testing observed divergence.

formula-notes:formula_12.12:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算中性进化下数量性状的群体间方差（\(\widetilde{\sigma}_{B}^{2}\)），它等于突变效应平方的期望 \(E(a^2)\) 乘以 \(4\)，再除以 \((1-\tau)^2\) 与 \([1+4N_e u(1-\tau)]\) 的乘积，其中 \(\tau\) 是突变效应依赖当前等位基因值的度量，\(N_e\) 是有效群体大小，\(u\) 是突变率。
formula-notes:formula_12.12:zh.inThisChapter: 本章介绍数量性状的中性分化，该公式给出了平衡状态下群体间方差的表达式，为后续比较中性预期与选择下的分化模式提供基准。

formula-notes:formula_12.14b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算在第 t 代时，表型性状的累积方差 σ_t²，它等于从第 0 代到第 t-1 代每一代中加性遗传方差 σ_A²(i) 除以有效种群大小 N_e(i) 的累加和。
formula-notes:formula_12.14b:zh.inThisChapter: 在检验中性表型分歧的速率检验章节中，该公式扩展了恒定参数下的布朗运动模型，允许 σ_A² 和 N_e 逐代变化，为后续推导更一般的分歧方差表达式（如公式 12.14c）提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_12.15a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将求和式 (1/Ne) * Σ_{i=0}^{t-1} e^{-i/(2Ne)} 近似为 2*(1 - e^{-t/(2Ne)})，其中 Ne 为有效种群大小，t 为时间代数。
formula-notes:formula_12.15a:zh.inThisChapter: 此处利用几何级数部分和公式简化漂变-突变平衡下表型方差 σ_B^2 的表达式，为后续推导中性检验统计量提供代数基础。

formula-notes:formula_12.15a:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the sum of a geometric series scaled by 1/Ne, approximating it as 2(1 - e^{-t/(2Ne)}). Key symbols: Ne (effective population size), t (time in generations), i (summation index).
formula-notes:formula_12.15a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on rate-based tests of neutral phenotypic divergence to simplify the expression for σ_B^2 under drift and mutation, recovering Equation 12.10 and supporting the derivation of test statistics.

formula-notes:formula_12.15b:en.plainMeaning: This formula gives the sum of a finite geometric series from i=0 to k-1 with ratio x, equal to (1 - x^k)/(1 - x). Here x is the ratio and k is the number of terms.
formula-notes:formula_12.15b:en.inThisChapter: It is used to simplify the expression for σ_B^2 under drift and mutation, enabling the derivation of Equation 12.15a and subsequent rate-based tests of neutral phenotypic divergence.

formula-notes:formula_12.14c:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the expected between-population variance in mean phenotype at generation t under drift and mutation, given initial additive variance σ_A²(0), mutational variance σ_m², and effective population size N_e. Key symbols: σ_t² (between-population variance), N_e (effective population size), σ_m² (mutational variance), σ_A²(0) (initial additive genetic variance), t (time in generations).
formula-notes:formula_12.14c:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on rate-based tests of neutral phenotypic divergence, derived by substituting the additive genetic variance from Equation 11.20b into Equation 12.14b. This expression supports the null hypothesis that observed divergence can be explained by drift and mutation alone, enabling tests against alternative models.

formula-notes:formula_12.15c:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式利用一阶泰勒展开将指数项 $e^{-1/2N_e}$ 近似为 $1-1/(2N_e)$，从而将 $1-e^{-1/2N_e}$ 简化为 $1/(2N_e)$，其中 $N_e$ 为有效群体大小。
formula-notes:formula_12.15c:zh.inThisChapter: 在本节中，该近似用于将中性表型分歧的零假设检验中的概率表达式（公式12.15a）简化为更易处理的形式，为后续基于速率的检验提供计算基础。

formula-notes:formula_12.16b:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the expected variance of a neutral phenotypic trait after t generations under mutation-drift equilibrium, where σ_m^2 is the mutational variance per generation and t is the number of generations.
formula-notes:formula_12.16b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the rate-based test section to derive the null expectation that the among-population variance increases linearly with time under neutrality, which is then compared to observed divergence to test for selection.

formula-notes:formula_12.15b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算几何级数的部分和，其中x是公比，k是项数，左边求和从i=0到k-1，右边等于(1-x^k)/(1-x)。
formula-notes:formula_12.15b:zh.inThisChapter: 它出现在推导中性表型分化率检验的背景下，用于简化公式(12.15a)中的求和，从而得到漂变-突变平衡下σ_B^2的表达式(12.10)。

formula-notes:formula_12.15c:en.plainMeaning: This formula approximates the probability of coalescence in a diploid population of effective size Ne, showing that 1 - e^{-1/(2Ne)} ≈ 1/(2Ne) for large Ne. The key symbols are Ne (effective population size) and the approximation via first-order Taylor series.
formula-notes:formula_12.15c:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on rate-based tests of neutral phenotypic divergence to derive the neutral expectation for the rate of molecular evolution (Equation 12.15a), supporting the null hypothesis that phenotypic divergence can be explained by neutral processes.

formula-notes:formula_12.16a:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the expected variance of the mean phenotype after t generations under neutral evolution, where σ_t² is the variance among populations, h² is heritability, σ_z² is phenotypic variance, t is time in generations, and N_e is effective population size.
formula-notes:formula_12.16a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the rate-based tests section to provide the null expectation for phenotypic divergence under neutrality, which is then compared to observed divergence in Equation 12.16b to test for selection.

formula-notes:formula_12.14c:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算在遗传漂变和突变作用下，t 世代时群体内加性遗传方差 σ_t² 的期望值。它由两部分组成：第一部分 2σ_m² t 表示突变驱动的线性增长（σ_m² 是每世代每配子的突变方差），第二部分包含初始加性方差 σ_A²(0) 与平衡值 2N_e σ_m² 的偏差，该偏差以指数衰减求和的形式体现漂变的影响。
formula-notes:formula_12.14c:zh.inThisChapter: 本章利用该公式推导中性表型分化速率检验的期望方差，为后续比较观测方差与中性期望方差提供理论依据。公式中 σ_t² 的表达式直接用于计算中性条件下群体间表型分化方差的期望值，从而构建检验统计量。

formula-notes:formula_12.16a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算表型均值在t代后的随机漂变方差σ_t^2，等于遗传力h^2乘以表型方差σ_z^2再乘以时间t除以有效种群大小N_e。
formula-notes:formula_12.16a:zh.inThisChapter: 在速率检验中，该公式将漂变方差与遗传参数（h^2、σ_z^2）和种群大小（N_e）联系起来，为后续公式12.16b中检验中性表型分歧的期望方差提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_12.18a:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the critical effective population size (N_e) such that the probability of observing a phenotypic divergence as large as d is ≤5% under neutrality. Key symbols: d = observed divergence, t = time in generations, h² = heritability, σ_z² = phenotypic variance, N_e = effective population size.
formula-notes:formula_12.18a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the rate-based test section to derive a threshold N_e for rejecting neutral divergence, supporting the argument that if the actual N_e is smaller than this critical value, neutral evolution is unlikely to produce the observed divergence.

formula-notes:formula_12.17:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the probability that the absolute difference between two sample means (taken t generations apart) is ≤ d, under neutral drift. It standardizes the difference by σ_t to obtain a standard normal variable U.
formula-notes:formula_12.17:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the rate-based test section to derive a test statistic for neutral phenotypic divergence, supporting the null hypothesis test by comparing observed divergence to that expected under drift alone.

formula-notes:formula_12.17:zh.plainMeaning: 这个公式将两个时间点（相隔t代）的表型均值差异绝对值不超过某个观测值d的概率，转化为标准化后的均值差异（除以标准差σ_t）不超过d/σ_t的概率，进而等价于标准正态变量U的绝对值不超过d/σ_t的概率。
formula-notes:formula_12.17:zh.inThisChapter: 在本节中，该公式用于构建基于漂移零假设的速率检验：通过将观测到的均值差异标准化为标准正态变量，从而利用标准正态分布计算该差异在遗传漂变下出现的概率，为后续判断表型分化是否显著偏离中性预期提供概率依据。

formula-notes:formula_12.16b:zh.plainMeaning: 公式(12.16b)计算表型均值在t代后的期望方差σ_t²，它等于2t乘以每代突变引入的加性遗传方差σ_m²，其中σ_m²是每代每有效个体由突变产生的加性遗传方差。
formula-notes:formula_12.16b:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在中性表型分歧速率检验的章节，用于推导在中性零假设下，群体间表型均值差异的期望方差仅依赖于时间t和突变方差σ_m²，而不依赖于有效群体大小N_e，从而为后续基于速率的检验提供理论预期。

formula-notes:formula_12.18b:zh.plainMeaning: 公式 (12.18b) 计算在漂变假设下与观测到的表型分化量 d* 相容的最大有效群体大小 Ne,u，其中 t 是世代数，h² 是遗传力，d* 是以表型标准差为单位的分化量，1.96² 来自正态分布 95% 置信区间的临界值。
formula-notes:formula_12.18b:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在检验中性表型分化（漂变）的速率检验部分，由公式 (12.18a) 解出 Ne 的上界得到，用于判断观测到的分化是否可能由漂变产生：若 Ne > Ne,u，则漂变不太可能产生如此大的分化。

formula-notes:formula_12.18b:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the upper bound on effective population size (N_{e,u}) consistent with neutral drift, given time t, heritability h², and phenotypic divergence scaled in standard deviations d_*. The constant 1.96² = 3.84 comes from the 95% confidence level of a chi-square distribution.
formula-notes:formula_12.18b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the rate-based test section to provide a criterion: if the estimated N_e exceeds N_{e,u}, drift alone is unlikely to explain the observed divergence, supporting a test for neutral phenotypic divergence.

formula-notes:formula_12.18a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式通过将标准化偏差1.96等于d除以标准误√(th²σ_z²/N_e)，推导出临界有效种群大小满足(1.96)²th²σ_z² = N_e d²，从而将观测到的表型差异d与遗传方差、遗传力、有效种群大小联系起来。
formula-notes:formula_12.18a:zh.inThisChapter: 在本节中，该公式用于确定在5%显著性水平下，观测到的表型分化d是否可能由遗传漂变单独导致，为后续计算临界有效种群大小N_e（公式12.18b）提供直接代数转换。

formula-notes:formula_12.19a:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the upper bound on effective population size (N_e) such that the observed phenotypic divergence (d_*) is too large to be explained by genetic drift alone, given time (t) and heritability (h^2). The critical value 2.24 corresponds to the 0.025 tail of a standard normal distribution.
formula-notes:formula_12.19a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the rate-based test section to provide a critical threshold for rejecting the null hypothesis of neutral divergence. The formula supports the argument that if N_e is below this bound, drift cannot account for the divergence, implying directional selection.

formula-notes:formula_12.19a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算在检验表型分歧是否快于遗传漂变预期时，种群大小的临界上界N_e,u，其中t为世代数，h^2为遗传力，d_*为标准化分歧量，2.24是标准正态分布0.025分位数。
formula-notes:formula_12.19a:zh.inThisChapter: 此处用于设定零假设（漂变导致分歧）下N_e的最大允许值，若实际N_e大于此值则拒绝零假设，为后续速率检验提供判定阈值。

formula-notes:formula_12.19b:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the minimum effective population size (N_e,l) required to reject the null hypothesis of neutral evolution when the observed divergence is too slow, based on time (t), heritability (h²), and the standardized effect size (d_*).
formula-notes:formula_12.19b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the rate-based tests section to provide a critical lower bound for population size under stabilizing selection, supporting the argument that insufficient phenotypic change can be detected as a departure from neutrality.

formula-notes:formula_12.20b:en.plainMeaning: This formula gives a 1-α confidence interval for 2tσ_m² based on the observed among-line variance V_B(t) and chi-square quantiles, where L is the number of lineages, t is time, and σ_m² is the mutational variance.
formula-notes:formula_12.20b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to neutral divergence of quantitative traits to provide a method for testing the neutral hypothesis using only an estimate of t, without needing an estimate of N_e, as referenced in the surrounding text.

formula-notes:formula_12.20a:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the F-statistic under mutation-drift equilibrium (MDE), where V_B(t) is the among-group variance after t generations, σ_m^2 is the mutational variance per generation, and 2tσ_m^2 is the expected among-group variance under neutrality.
formula-notes:formula_12.20a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on rate-based tests for neutral phenotypic divergence, providing a null distribution for the F-statistic that accounts for mutation and drift, which is used to test whether observed divergence exceeds neutral expectations.

formula-notes:formula_12.20c:en.plainMeaning: This formula gives a 1−α confidence interval for mutational heritability h_m² = σ_m²/σ_e², using the between-line variance V_B(t), the number of lines L, the chi-square quantiles X², and the environmental variance σ_e².
formula-notes:formula_12.20c:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to neutral divergence of quantitative traits to provide a statistical test for h_m², supporting the argument that observed divergence can be compared to neutral expectations derived from mutation-drift equilibrium.

formula-notes:formula_12.19b:zh.plainMeaning: 公式 (12.19b) 计算在检验表型进化过慢（支持稳定选择）时，所需的最小有效种群大小 N_{e,l}，它等于 0.0009 乘以时间 t、遗传力 h² 与表型分化 d*² 的比值。
formula-notes:formula_12.19b:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式与 (12.19a) 对称，用于构建速率检验的双侧临界值，为后续判断表型分化是否显著偏离中性预期提供下界标准。

formula-notes:formula_12.20e:en.plainMeaning: This formula gives the 95% confidence interval for the mutational heritability h_m^2 under drift, with lower bound 0.10·Δ and upper bound 509·Δ, where Δ is the effective population size scaled mutation rate.
formula-notes:formula_12.20e:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to neutral divergence of quantitative traits to illustrate the wide confidence interval for h_m^2, supporting the argument that drift alone can produce large variation in mutational heritability estimates.

formula-notes:formula_12.20a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算突变-漂移平衡（MDE）下的F统计量，其中分子V_B(t)是t时刻的组间表型方差，分母2tσ_m^2是中性进化下组间方差的期望值（来自公式12.16b），因此F_{MDE}是观测方差与中性期望方差的比值。
formula-notes:formula_12.20a:zh.inThisChapter: 在本节中，该公式将Lande的F检验（公式12.9a）调整为突变-漂移平衡版本，用于检验表型分化是否仅由突变和遗传漂变导致，为后续推导F_{MDE}的抽样分布（公式12.20b-12.20e）提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_12.20c:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式给出了突变遗传力 h_m^2 的置信区间，下界为 (L-1)/X_{1-α/2,L-1} 乘以 V_B(t)/(2t σ_e^2)，上界为 (L-1)/X_{α/2,L-1} 乘以 V_B(t)/(2t σ_e^2)，置信水平为 1-α。
formula-notes:formula_12.20c:zh.inThisChapter: 在介绍数量性状中性分化的章节中，此公式由式 12.20b 两边除以 2t σ_e^2 得到，将检验从 V_B(t) 转化为 h_m^2，为后续基于突变遗传力的中性检验提供区间估计。

formula-notes:formula_12.20d:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式给出了在漂变中性模型下，突变遗传力 h_m^2 的 1-α 置信区间，其中 Δ = (V_B/t)/σ_e^2 是观测到的每单位环境方差的分化速率，L 是群体数，X 是卡方分布的分位数。
formula-notes:formula_12.20d:zh.inThisChapter: 此公式由公式 12.20c 代入 Δ 得到，用于将观测到的分化速率转化为 h_m^2 的置信区间，从而检验中性漂变假设，并为后续比较观测值与中性预期提供统计依据。

formula-notes:formula_12.20d:en.plainMeaning: This formula gives a 1−α confidence interval for the mutational heritability h_m^2, based on the estimated divergence rate Δ, the number of lines L, and chi-square quantiles. The key symbols are: h_m^2 (mutational heritability), Δ (estimated scaled divergence rate), L (number of lines), X_{1-α/2, L-1} and X_{α/2, L-1} (chi-square quantiles).
formula-notes:formula_12.20d:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to neutral divergence of quantitative traits to provide a statistical test for whether observed divergence is consistent with drift alone. This interval supports later arguments about detecting selection by comparing observed h_m^2 to drift expectations.

formula-notes:formula_12.21a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式给出了一个判断漂移假说是否被拒绝的临界条件：如果突变遗传力h_m^2小于0.10乘以标准化分化率Δ（约等于0.10乘以d_*^2/t），则拒绝漂移假说。
formula-notes:formula_12.21a:zh.inThisChapter: 在介绍数量性状中性分化的章节中，该公式用于将观测到的分化率与突变遗传力联系起来，为后续通过h_m^2检验漂移假说提供具体判据。

formula-notes:formula_12.21b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式给出了一个判断条件：如果突变遗传力 h_m^2 大于或等于 509 乘以 Δ（其中 Δ ≈ d_*^2 / t），则观察到的性状分化速度太慢，无法用遗传漂变解释。
formula-notes:formula_12.21b:zh.inThisChapter: 在介绍数量性状中性分化的章节中，该公式用于设定一个阈值，以检验漂变假说是否成立，并为后续讨论突变遗传力的估计和检验提供依据。

formula-notes:formula_12.21b:en.plainMeaning: This inequality gives a condition for rejecting neutral divergence: the mutational heritability (h_m^2) must be at least 509 times the standardized divergence rate Δ, where Δ ≈ d_*^2 / t, with d_*^2 being the standardized squared divergence and t the time since divergence.
formula-notes:formula_12.21b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to neutral divergence of quantitative traits to provide a threshold for when observed divergence is too slow to be explained by genetic drift alone, supporting the argument that high mutational heritability would be required to account for the data under neutrality.

formula-notes:formula_12.20b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式给出了中性进化下，群体间表型分化方差V_B(t)与突变输入2tσ_m^2之间关系的置信区间：以1-α的概率，2tσ_m^2落在由V_B(t)乘以卡方分布分位数决定的区间内。关键符号：V_B(t)为t时刻群体间表型方差，σ_m^2为每次突变对表型的方差贡献，t为分化时间，L为谱系数，X_{p,n}为卡方分布的分位数。
formula-notes:formula_12.20b:zh.inThisChapter: 本章介绍数量性状的中性分化，公式12.20b由公式12.5a和12.6c推导而来，用于在已知分化时间t但未知有效群体大小N_e时检验中性假说：若2tσ_m^2的估计值落在该区间外，则拒绝中性。

formula-notes:formula_12.20e:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式给出了在漂变中性模型下，当显著性水平α=0.05且连锁位点数L=2时，突变遗传力h_m^2的95%置信区间为[0.10·Δ, 509·Δ]，其中Δ是每代每性状的突变输入方差。
formula-notes:formula_12.20e:zh.inThisChapter: 本章引入中性漂变下数量性状的突变遗传力，公式(12.20e)通过具体数值展示了如何利用(12.20b)从漂变方差中推断h_m^2的置信区间，为后续检验遗传力是否显著偏离中性预期提供了统计依据。

formula-notes:formula_12.21a:en.plainMeaning: This inequality gives a criterion for rejecting the hypothesis that genetic drift alone explains the observed divergence: if the mutational heritability (h_m^2) is less than 0.10 times the standardized divergence rate Δ (which approximates 0.10 times d_*^2 / t), then drift is rejected at α=0.05. Here, h_m^2 is mutational heritability, Δ is the standardized divergence rate, d_*^2 is the standardized squared divergence, and t is time.
formula-notes:formula_12.21a:en.inThisChapter: This formula appears in the introduction to neutral divergence of quantitative traits to provide a practical test for drift. It supports later arguments by establishing a threshold for when observed divergence exceeds neutral expectations, motivating the need for models incorporating selection or other forces.

formula-notes:formula_12.22a:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the rate of adaptation (a) under Gaussian stabilizing selection, where σ_A² is additive genetic variance, σ_z² is phenotypic variance, and ω² measures selection strength (smaller ω² = stronger selection).
formula-notes:formula_12.22a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the rate-based tests section to define the expected rate of phenotypic evolution under stabilizing selection, which is used to test the null hypothesis of neutral divergence by comparing observed rates to this prediction.

formula-notes:formula_12.22b:en.plainMeaning: This formula gives the expected mean phenotype μ_t at time t under an Ornstein-Uhlenbeck process, where θ is the optimal value, x_o is the starting value, and a is the strength of selection pulling toward θ.
formula-notes:formula_12.22b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the rate-based tests section to model phenotypic evolution under stabilizing selection, providing the expected mean under the null hypothesis of neutral divergence when a=0 or when testing against selection-driven divergence.

formula-notes:formula_12.21c:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将遗传分化度量Δ表示为加性遗传方差V_B与群体规模t和环境方差σ_e^2的比值，通过代入V_B = d^2/2和σ_e^2 = (1 - h^2)σ_z^2，最终近似为d_*^2/t，其中d_*是标准化后的表型差异，h^2是遗传力。
formula-notes:formula_12.21c:zh.inThisChapter: 在介绍数量性状中性分化的章节中，该公式用于推导Δ的近似表达式，为后续讨论中性预期下Δ≈d_*^2/t的简化形式提供依据，并说明当h^2≈1/2时近似成立。

formula-notes:formula_12.22c:en.plainMeaning: This formula gives the variance of the Ornstein-Uhlenbeck process at time t, where σ²_t is the variance, a is the strength of selection pulling toward the optimum, b is the rate of stochastic divergence (b = σ²_A / N_e), and t is time.
formula-notes:formula_12.22c:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on rate-based tests of neutral phenotypic divergence to model trait evolution under stabilizing selection, providing the expected variance under the null hypothesis of neutral divergence when selection is absent (a=0) or present.

formula-notes:formula_12.21c:en.plainMeaning: This formula expresses the standardized divergence Δ of a quantitative trait between populations as the ratio of between-population variance V_B to time t times environmental variance σ_e^2, and simplifies to d_*^2/t when heritability h^2 ≈ 1/2. Key symbols: V_B (between-population variance), t (time since divergence), σ_e^2 (environmental variance), d (trait difference in phenotypic standard deviations), h^2 (heritability), σ_z^2 (phenotypic variance), d_* (trait difference in environmental standard deviations).
formula-notes:formula_12.21c:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to neutral divergence of quantitative traits to show that under neutrality and moderate heritability (h^2 ≈ 1/2), the standardized divergence Δ approximates d_*^2/t, which supports the later argument that neutral divergence scales linearly with time and can be used to test neutrality against selection.

formula-notes:formula_12.22c:zh.plainMeaning: 公式(12.22c)计算Ornstein-Uhlenbeck过程在时间t时的方差σ_t^2，其中b是扩散速率，a是选择强度，方差随时间从0渐近趋于b/(2a)。
formula-notes:formula_12.22c:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在中性表型分歧速率检验章节，为后续推导渐近方差(12.22d)和比较观测分歧与中性期望提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_12.22b:zh.plainMeaning: 公式 (12.22b) 计算在时间 t 时，表型均值 μ_t 如何从初始值 x_o 向最优值 θ 指数衰减，衰减速率由 a 决定。其中 a 来自公式 (12.22a)，表示选择强度。
formula-notes:formula_12.22b:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在中性表型分歧的速率检验章节，用于描述在稳定选择（而非中性漂变）下表型均值的动态，为后续推导方差公式 (12.22c) 和检验统计量提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_12.22a:zh.plainMeaning: 公式 a = σ_A^2 / (σ_z^2 + ω^2) 计算的是表型向选择最优值回归的速率 a，其中 σ_A^2 是加性遗传方差，σ_z^2 是表型方差，ω^2 是稳定选择强度（越小选择越强）。
formula-notes:formula_12.22a:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在中性表型分歧速率检验的章节，用于将高斯稳定选择模型（公式16.17）下的进化过程参数化，为后续推导表型均值和方差随时间变化的公式（12.22b-d）提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_12.23a:en.plainMeaning: This formula estimates the variance per increment (σ²) for a symmetric random walk, using the average of squared differences between consecutive observations (x_i - x_{i-1}) over n increments.
formula-notes:formula_12.23a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the TIME SERIES DIVERGENCE TESTS section to provide an estimate of the standard error (σ√n) needed for testing whether a time series deviates from a random walk, supporting the divergence test statistic in formula 12.23b.

formula-notes:formula_12.23a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式用相邻观测值之差的平方和除以样本量 n 来估计随机游走每步增量的方差 σ²，其中 x_i 是第 i 时刻的观测值。
formula-notes:formula_12.23a:zh.inThisChapter: 在时间序列发散检验中，该估计量用于计算对称随机游走的标准误 σ√n，为后续检验序列是否发散（如单位根检验）提供方差估计基础。

formula-notes:formula_12.22d:en.plainMeaning: This formula gives the asymptotic ratio b/(2a) under the constant-variance model, where b is the rate of increase in additive genetic variance (σ_A^2 / N_e), a is the strength of stabilizing selection, σ_z^2 is the phenotypic variance, ω^2 is the width of the fitness function, and N_e is the effective population size.
formula-notes:formula_12.22d:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on rate-based tests of neutral phenotypic divergence to provide the expected asymptotic divergence variance under neutrality, which is used to test whether observed divergence exceeds neutral expectations.

formula-notes:formula_12.22d:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将稳态下性状相对于最优值的方差（b/(2a)）表示为遗传漂变方差（σ_z²）与选择方差（ω²）之和除以两倍有效群体大小（2N_e）。
formula-notes:formula_12.22d:zh.inThisChapter: 在检验中性表型分化的速率检验部分，该公式给出了中性进化下性状方差的理论期望，为后续比较观测方差与中性期望提供了零假设下的基准值。

formula-notes:formula_12.23b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算的是标准化最大绝对累积和，其中分子是前k步累积和S_k绝对值的最大值，分母是估计标准差σ̂乘以√n，用于衡量时间序列中均值偏移的最大幅度。
formula-notes:formula_12.23b:zh.inThisChapter: 在时间序列发散检验章节中，该公式用于构造检验统计量，通过比较最大累积偏移与随机波动来检测序列是否存在结构性变化，为后续推导渐近分布提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_12.23b:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the maximum absolute cumulative sum of increments (S_k) scaled by the estimated standard deviation (σ̂) and the square root of the sample size (n), giving a test statistic for detecting a change in mean.
formula-notes:formula_12.23b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on time series divergence tests to provide a test statistic for the largest scaled excursion, supporting the detection of a mean shift after an unknown number of steps.

formula-notes:formula_12.24a:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the standardized range R(τ) by dividing the absolute displacement |x_τ - x_0| over a time interval τ by the standard deviation σ, which scales as σ√τ for a symmetric random walk.
formula-notes:formula_12.24a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the TIME SERIES DIVERGENCE TESTS section to define the dependent variable for the log-log regression (Equation 12.24b) that estimates the Hurst exponent H, testing for long-term memory in time series.

formula-notes:formula_12.24b:en.plainMeaning: This formula expresses the log of the rescaled range R(τ) as a linear function of log(τ), where the slope H is the Hurst exponent quantifying long-range dependence. R(τ) is the rescaled range from Equation 12.24a, τ is the time interval, and ε is the error term.
formula-notes:formula_12.24b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the TIME SERIES DIVERGENCE TESTS section to provide a regression-based method for estimating the Hurst exponent, which is then used to test for divergence from a symmetric random walk (where H=0.5).

formula-notes:formula_12.24b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式通过对数变换将重标极差R(τ)与时间间隔τ的幂律关系线性化，其中斜率H即为赫斯特指数，ε为回归残差。
formula-notes:formula_12.24b:zh.inThisChapter: 在时间序列发散检验章节中，该公式用于从(12.24a)定义的重标极差中通过log-log回归估计H，以判断序列是否遵循随机游走（H=0.5）或具有长期记忆（H≠0.5）。

formula-notes:formula_12.25a:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the corrected Akaike Information Criterion (AICc) for model selection, adding an extra penalty term to the standard AIC when the sample size n is small relative to the number of parameters k. Key symbols: L = likelihood, k = number of parameters, n = sample size.
formula-notes:formula_12.25a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the TIME SERIES DIVERGENCE TESTS section to provide a corrected model selection criterion for small samples, supporting later comparisons of candidate models via relative support calculations (e.g., Equations 12.25b–12.25d).

formula-notes:formula_12.25c:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the Akaike weight w_i for model i, where Δ_i is the difference in AIC between model i and the best model, and the denominator normalizes the weights so they sum to 1.
formula-notes:formula_12.25c:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on time series divergence tests to quantify the relative likelihood of each candidate model, supporting model selection and multi-model inference.

formula-notes:formula_12.25a:zh.plainMeaning: AIC_c 在标准 AIC（-2ln(L)+2k）基础上增加了一个修正项 2k(k+1)/(n-k-1)，用于小样本（n<40k）时更准确地惩罚模型复杂度，其中 n 是样本量，k 是参数个数，L 是似然函数最大值。
formula-notes:formula_12.25a:zh.inThisChapter: 本节讨论时间序列发散检验，AIC_c 作为模型选择准则，用于在候选模型中找到最优模型，并为后续公式 (12.25b)-(12.25d) 中计算相对支持度提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_12.24a:zh.plainMeaning: 公式 (12.24a) 计算标准化极差 R(τ)，即时间间隔 τ 内价格绝对变化 |x_τ - x_0| 除以标准差 σ，用于消除波动幅度的影响。
formula-notes:formula_12.24a:zh.inThisChapter: 本节讨论时间序列发散性检验，该公式将随机游走的尺度化绝对位移（由公式 12.23a 估计 σ）标准化，为后续对数回归 (12.24b) 估计赫斯特指数 H 提供因变量。

formula-notes:formula_12.25b:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the difference between the corrected AIC of model i and the minimum corrected AIC among all m candidate models, where Δ_i is the AIC difference, AIC_c,i is the corrected AIC for model i, and min(AIC_c) is the smallest corrected AIC across models.
formula-notes:formula_12.25b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the TIME SERIES DIVERGENCE TESTS section to quantify the relative support for each model compared to the best model, which is used to compute Akaike weights (Equation 12.25c) and evidence ratios (Equation 12.25d) for model selection.

formula-notes:formula_12.26a:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the genetic differentiation measure Q_ST as the proportion of total genetic variance due to between-subpopulation variance, where σ_GB^2 is between-subpopulation variance and σ_GW^2 is within-subpopulation variance.
formula-notes:formula_12.26a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the TIME SERIES DIVERGENCE TESTS section to quantify genetic divergence among subpopulations, supporting later arguments about detecting selection from temporal changes in allele frequencies.

formula-notes:formula_12.25c:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算第 i 个候选模型的 Akaike 权重 w_i，其中 Δ_i 是第 i 个模型与最佳模型之间的 AIC 差值（来自公式 12.25a），分母是所有 m 个模型 e^{-Δ_i/2} 之和，使得所有权重之和为 1。
formula-notes:formula_12.25c:zh.inThisChapter: 在时间序列发散检验章节中，该公式用于将 AIC 差值（Δ_i）转换为概率权重，以便后续进行模型平均或模型选择的不确定性量化。

formula-notes:formula_12.25d:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the posterior weight w_i for model i, combining a prior weight π_i with the exponential of minus half the divergence Δ_i, normalized by the sum over all m models.
formula-notes:formula_12.25d:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on time series divergence tests to extend the equal-prior-weight case of Equation 12.25c to incorporate general prior weights, supporting model averaging or selection based on divergence measures.

formula-notes:formula_12.26a:zh.plainMeaning: 公式 Q_ST = σ_GB^2 / (σ_GB^2 + 2σ_GW^2) 计算的是群体间遗传方差 σ_GB^2 占群体间与两倍群体内遗传方差之和的比例，用于衡量遗传分化程度。
formula-notes:formula_12.26a:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在时间序列分化检验章节，通过将总遗传方差分解为群体间和群体内成分，为后续推导 Q_ST 与 F_ST 的关系以及检验选择信号提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_12.27a:en.plainMeaning: This formula estimates the genetic variance between populations (σ̂²_GB) as a proportion c of the phenotypic variance between populations (σ̂²_PB), and the genetic variance within populations (σ̂²_GW) as heritability h² times the phenotypic variance within populations (σ̂²_PW).
formula-notes:formula_12.27a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the Time Series Divergence Tests section to provide a way to partition observed phenotypic variances into genetic components using simple scaling factors, which are then substituted into Equation 12.27b to test for evolutionary divergence.

formula-notes:formula_12.25b:zh.plainMeaning: Δ_i 计算第 i 个候选模型的 AICc 值与所有 m 个模型中最小 AICc 值之间的差值，用于衡量模型 i 相对于最优模型的相对支持度。
formula-notes:formula_12.25b:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在时间序列发散检验章节，用于定义模型相对支持度，为后续计算 Akaike 权重（公式 12.25c）和证据比（公式 12.25d）提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_12.26b:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes QST, a measure of genetic differentiation among populations, accounting for inbreeding (f). Key symbols: QST (population differentiation), f (inbreeding coefficient), σ²_GB (genetic variance between populations), σ²_GW (genetic variance within populations).
formula-notes:formula_12.26b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the TIME SERIES DIVERGENCE TESTS section to extend QST to populations with inbreeding, supporting tests for neutral vs. selective divergence when populations are not fully outbred.

formula-notes:formula_12.25d:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算在给定先验权重π_i下，模型i的后验权重w_i，其中Δ_i是模型i相对于最佳模型的AIC差异，分母是对所有模型先验权重乘以e^{-Δ/2}的求和。
formula-notes:formula_12.25d:zh.inThisChapter: 本章讨论时间序列发散检验，该公式扩展了等先验权重的公式12.25c，引入任意先验权重π_i，为后续模型平均或模型选择提供更一般的后验权重计算方法。

formula-notes:formula_12.27b:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the estimated P_ST statistic (P_ST,L), which quantifies the proportion of total phenotypic variance among populations that is due to genetic differences, adjusted by the ratio h²/c. Key symbols: σ̂²_PB = estimated phenotypic variance between populations, σ̂²_PW = estimated phenotypic variance within populations, h² = heritability, c = proportion of variance due to additive genetic effects.
formula-notes:formula_12.27b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the Time Series Divergence Tests section to provide a genetic interpretation of phenotypic divergence, supporting the argument that observed differences in means may be genetic rather than solely environmental.

formula-notes:formula_12.26b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算群体间遗传分化指数Q_ST，其中σ_GB²是群体间遗传方差，σ_GW²是群体内遗传方差，f是群体内近交系数，公式将(1+f)σ_GB²作为分子，分母加上2σ_GW²。
formula-notes:formula_12.26b:zh.inThisChapter: 在时间序列分化检验章节中，此公式扩展了12.26a，通过引入近交系数f修正群体内方差权重，为后续处理近交群体间的遗传分化检验提供更准确的统计量。

formula-notes:formula_12.28a:en.plainMeaning: This formula gives the null distribution of Q_ST scaled by average F_ST: (n_d - 1)/F_bar_ST * Q_ST follows a chi-square distribution with n_d - 1 degrees of freedom, implying Q_ST is distributed as (F_bar_ST/(n_d - 1)) times a chi-square variate.
formula-notes:formula_12.28a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the TIME SERIES DIVERGENCE TESTS section to provide a statistical test for whether Q_ST equals F_ST, supporting later derivations of confidence intervals and hypothesis tests for neutral trait divergence.

formula-notes:formula_12.27b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算的是基于表型方差分量的P_ST统计量，其中分子是群体间表型方差分量σ̂²_PB，分母是2乘以(h²/c)再乘以群体内表型方差分量σ̂²_PW加上分子本身。
formula-notes:formula_12.27b:zh.inThisChapter: 在本章时间序列分化检验中，该公式将遗传力h²和比例c引入P_ST，用于从表型方差中推断遗传分化，为后续比较Q_ST与F_ST提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_12.28b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将FST的样本均值与卡方分布联系起来，计算卡方统计量超过临界值(n_d-1)/F̄_ST的概率，并认为该概率近似为0。
formula-notes:formula_12.28b:zh.inThisChapter: 在时间序列分化检验章节中，此公式用于说明当FST较小时，卡方分布的上尾概率可忽略，从而为后续推导QST的近似分布（公式12.28c）提供依据。

formula-notes:formula_12.27a:zh.plainMeaning: 公式 (12.27a) 将表型方差分解为遗传组分：\(\widehat{\sigma}_{G B}^{2}\)（遗传群体间方差）等于系数 \(c\) 乘以表型群体间方差 \(\widehat{\sigma}_{P B}^{2}\)，\(\widehat{\sigma}_{G W}^{2}\)（遗传群体内方差）等于遗传力 \(h^{2}\) 乘以表型群体内方差 \(\widehat{\sigma}_{P W}^{2}\)。
formula-notes:formula_12.27a:zh.inThisChapter: 本节“时间序列分歧检验”中，该公式将纯表型方差分解为遗传分量，为后续代入方程 (12.27b) 计算遗传分化指数 \(Q_{ST}\) 提供遗传方差估计，从而在时间序列数据中检验遗传分化是否超出中性预期。

formula-notes:formula_12.28c:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将检验统计量 Q_ST / F̄_ST 超过阈值 δ 的概率转化为自由度为 n_d-1 的卡方分布超过 δ(n_d-1) 的概率，其中 n_d 是样本量，Q_ST 是组间平方和，F̄_ST 是平均组内方差。
formula-notes:formula_12.28c:zh.inThisChapter: 在时间序列散度检验章节中，该公式用于在原假设下计算检验功效，通过将比值统计量转化为卡方分布，为后续推导拒绝域和检验的势函数提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_12.28c:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the probability that the ratio Q_ST / F̄_ST exceeds a threshold δ, showing it equals the probability that a chi-square random variable with n_d−1 degrees of freedom exceeds δ(n_d−1). Key symbols: Q_ST (test statistic), F̄_ST (average F_ST), n_d (number of demes), δ (threshold).
formula-notes:formula_12.28c:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the TIME SERIES DIVERGENCE TESTS section to derive the power of the test under the null hypothesis, supporting the argument that the test statistic follows a chi-square distribution.
