formula-notes:formula_12.28b:en.plainMeaning: This formula states that the probability that a scaled chi-square random variable exceeds 1 is approximately 0, which is equivalent to the probability that a chi-square with n_d-1 degrees of freedom exceeds (n_d-1)/F̄_ST being negligible. Key symbols: F̄_ST (mean F_ST), n_d (number of demes), χ² (chi-square distribution).
formula-notes:formula_12.28b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the TIME SERIES DIVERGENCE TESTS section to justify that the upper tail of the chi-square distribution is negligible, supporting the approximation in Equation 12.28a that Q_ST is effectively bounded by 1.

formula-notes:formula_12.28a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式表明，在零假设 Q_ST = F_ST 下，统计量 (n_d - 1)/F̄_ST * Q_ST 服从自由度为 n_d - 1 的卡方分布，从而推出 Q_ST 本身按比例缩放后服从卡方分布，其中 F̄_ST 是分子标记位点的平均 F_ST，n_d 是群体数目。
formula-notes:formula_12.28a:zh.inThisChapter: 本节（时间序列分化检验）利用该公式将数量性状分化 Q_ST 与中性分子标记分化 F̄_ST 联系起来，为后续推导 Q_ST 的置信区间（公式 12.28b）和假设检验（公式 12.28c）提供分布基础。

formula-notes:formula_12.29:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the between-population additive genetic variance (σ²_GB) from the within-population additive genetic variance (σ²_GW) and F_ST, assuming a neutral additive trait. It shows how population differentiation (F_ST) inflates the between-population variance relative to within-population variance.
formula-notes:formula_12.29:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on time series divergence tests to derive the expected neutral Q_ST (which equals F_ST) and to provide a baseline for detecting selection: deviations of observed Q_ST from this neutral expectation indicate adaptive divergence.

formula-notes:formula_12.30a:en.plainMeaning: This formula decomposes the total variance σ_x² into a linkage equilibrium component σ_{x,0}² and a disequilibrium contribution d_x, with φ_x = d_x / σ_{x,0}² measuring the relative disequilibrium effect.
formula-notes:formula_12.30a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the TIME SERIES DIVERGENCE TESTS section to show how LD inflates variance components (σ_w² and σ_a²) that enter Q_ST, supporting the argument that LD can bias Q_ST-based tests of selection.

formula-notes:formula_12.29:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将中性加性性状下群体间遗传方差σ²_GB表示为群体间分化系数F_ST和群体内遗传方差σ²_GW的函数，即σ²_GB = 2F_ST σ²_GW / (1 - F_ST)。
formula-notes:formula_12.29:zh.inThisChapter: 在时间序列分化检验章节中，该公式由Q_ST = F_ST（中性加性性状）和公式12.26a推导得出，为后续构建Q_ST的检验统计量或模拟中性分布提供理论依据。

formula-notes:formula_12.30c:en.plainMeaning: This formula relates the quantitative trait divergence measure Q_ST to the underlying locus-based F_STQ, adjusting for linkage disequilibrium (LD) within (φ_w) and among (φ_a) populations. Q_ST equals F_STQ only when φ_a = φ_w.
formula-notes:formula_12.30c:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the TIME SERIES DIVERGENCE TESTS section to show how LD biases Q_ST relative to F_STQ, supporting the argument that Q_ST can be corrected using estimates of LD from time series data.

formula-notes:formula_12.30b:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the additive genetic variance among populations (d_a) as the variance in optimum values (σ_θ^2) minus twice the product of F_STQ and the additive genetic variance within populations (σ_A^2).
formula-notes:formula_12.30b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on time series divergence tests to quantify how stabilizing selection toward different optima reduces the expected neutral divergence (F_STQ) relative to the variance in optima, supporting tests for selection versus neutrality.

formula-notes:formula_12.30c:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将基于方差组分计算的Q_ST与基于底层位点的F_STQ联系起来，其中φ_a和φ_w分别表示群体间和群体内的连锁不平衡（LD）参数。
formula-notes:formula_12.30c:zh.inThisChapter: 在本节时间序列分歧检验中，该公式用于量化LD对Q_ST的影响，并指出只有当φ_a = φ_w时Q_ST才等于F_STQ，为后续讨论LD偏差对Q_ST估计的影响提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_12.31a:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the conditional probability that the number of plus alleles in the high line (n₊) is at least n_high, given that it is already at least [n/2]. It equals the ratio of two binomial tail sums, with the common factor (1/2)ⁿ canceled.
formula-notes:formula_12.31a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on trait-augmented marker-based approaches to derive Orr's QTL sign test for equal effects (QTLST-EE), supporting the test's null distribution for detecting selection when QTLs have equal effects.

formula-notes:formula_12.30a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将总方差 σ_x^2 分解为连锁平衡方差 σ_{x,0}^2 与连锁不平衡贡献 d_x 之和，并定义相对偏差 φ_x = d_x / σ_{x,0}^2，从而将总方差表示为 σ_x^2 = (1+φ_x) σ_{x,0}^2。
formula-notes:formula_12.30a:zh.inThisChapter: 在时间序列分化检验章节中，该公式用于量化群体间或群体内方差中由连锁不平衡引起的额外分量，为后续推导 Q_ST 随时间演化的表达式（如公式 12.30b 和 12.30c）提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_12.30b:zh.plainMeaning: 公式计算了表型分化量d_a，它等于各群体最优值θ的方差σ_θ^2减去2倍F_STQ与加性遗传方差σ_A^2的乘积。
formula-notes:formula_12.30b:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在时间序列分化检验章节，用于在群体均值达到各自最优值后，将表型分化分解为选择（σ_θ^2）和遗传漂变（通过F_STQ和σ_A^2）的贡献，为后续检验选择信号提供基准。

formula-notes:formula_12.31b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算在至少一半标记显著（n₊ ≥ [n/2]）的条件下，显著标记数达到或超过高阈值 n_high 的条件概率，用标准正态分布函数 Φ 近似表示。
formula-notes:formula_12.31b:zh.inThisChapter: 此处用正态近似简化式12.31a中的精确概率计算，为后续在大样本下快速评估QTL检测的显著性提供实用公式。

formula-notes:formula_12.32:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the probability (p) that the number of plus alleles in the high line (n_+) is at least a threshold n_high, given that the observed genetic divergence G is at least D. It sums the conditional probabilities Pr(n_+ = i | G ≥ D) over all i from n_high to n.
formula-notes:formula_12.32:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on trait-augmented marker-based approaches to quantify the significance of observed QTL allele counts under a null model where signs are random, supporting later tests that compare observed n_+ to this null distribution.

formula-notes:formula_12.31b:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the approximate probability that the number of QTL with effects in the same direction (n₊) is at least n_high, given that n₊ is already at least half of the total QTL (n/2), using a normal approximation with mean n/2 and variance n/4. Key symbols: n₊ = number of QTL with positive effect, n_high = threshold, n = total QTL, Φ = standard normal CDF.
formula-notes:formula_12.31b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in this section to provide a large-sample approximation for the conditional probability derived in Equation 12.31a, supporting the argument that the p-value for a sign test becomes very small when n is large and n_high is moderately above n/2.

formula-notes:formula_12.31a:zh.plainMeaning: 这个公式计算在已知高线中至少含有[n/2]个“+”等位基因的条件下，高线中“+”等位基因数n₊至少达到某个阈值n_high的条件概率。分子是n₊≥n_high的无条件概率，分母是n₊≥[n/2]的无条件概率，两者都基于二项分布系数求和，且公共因子(1/2)^n被约掉。
formula-notes:formula_12.31a:zh.inThisChapter: 本节介绍基于QTL信息的特征增强标记方法，该公式用于定义Orr的等效应QTL符号检验（QTLST-EE），通过条件概率评估高线中“+”等位基因富集的显著性，为后续推导公式12.31b（检验的p值或临界值）提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_12.33b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算群体 j 中由 GWAS 预测的性状平均遗传值 a_j，它是所有标记位点 i 上效应值 g_i 乘以该群体中该等位基因频率 p_{ij} 的两倍之和。
formula-notes:formula_12.33b:zh.inThisChapter: 在“性状增强标记方法”章节中，该公式利用 GWAS 信息将标记效应与群体等位基因频率结合，为后续比较不同群体间遗传均值差异（如公式 12.33h）提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_12.33a:en.plainMeaning: This formula specifies that the vector of allele frequencies across m subpopulations for SNP i follows a multivariate normal distribution with mean equal to the ancestral frequency p_{i,0} times a vector of ones, and covariance matrix p_{i,0}(1-p_{i,0})Ω, where Ω is the marker-estimated covariance matrix of allele frequencies among subpopulations.
formula-notes:formula_12.33a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on trait-augmented marker-based approaches to model the neutral null distribution of allele frequencies across subpopulations, which is used to detect selection or to control for population structure in GWAS tests.

formula-notes:formula_12.33a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式表示第i个位点在m个亚群中的等位基因频率向量p_i服从多元正态分布，其均值向量为祖先频率p_{i,0}乘以全1向量，协方差矩阵为p_{i,0}(1-p_{i,0})乘以Ω，其中Ω是亚群间等位基因频率的期望协方差矩阵。
formula-notes:formula_12.33a:zh.inThisChapter: 在本章中，该公式用于描述中性进化下亚群间等位基因频率的联合分布，为后续基于GWAS数据的检验（如公式12.33b和12.33h）提供零分布假设，从而检测与性状关联的位点。

formula-notes:formula_12.33b:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the GWAS-predicted mean genetic value (a_j) for a trait in population j as twice the sum over m markers of the effect size (g_i) times the allele frequency (p_{ij}) in that population.
formula-notes:formula_12.33b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on trait-augmented marker-based approaches to show how GWAS effect estimates and allele frequencies can be combined to predict the mean genetic value of a population, supporting later arguments about cross-population prediction and genetic distance measures.

formula-notes:formula_12.32:zh.plainMeaning: 公式(12.32)计算在给定实际分化G≥D的条件下，高系中“优势等位基因”数量n+至少达到n_high的概率p，通过对所有i≥n_high的Pr(n+=i|G≥D)求和得到。
formula-notes:formula_12.32:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在基于QTL信息的性状增强标记方法章节，用于评估在随机分配等位基因符号（中性假设）下，观测到的优势等位基因数量是否显著偏离随机期望，为后续检验QTL效应是否真实提供概率依据。

formula-notes:formula_12.33h:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the Berg-Coop test statistic Q_x as the sum of squared transformed marker effects (x^T x), which equals a quadratic form in the estimated additive genetic effects (a*) weighted by the inverse of their covariance matrix (Ω^{-1}) and scaled by twice the additive genetic variance (V_A).
formula-notes:formula_12.33h:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on trait-augmented marker-based approaches to provide a test statistic for detecting selection signatures using GWAS data, supporting the subsequent discussion of the Berg-Coop Q_x test and its properties.

formula-notes:formula_12.34c:en.plainMeaning: This formula provides two inequality conditions for the ratio of between-population variance (V_B) to within-population variance (V_A) to test for stabilizing selection (lower bound) or directional selection (upper bound), using F-distribution critical values with degrees of freedom L-1 and k-1, scaled by t/N_e.
formula-notes:formula_12.34c:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on divergence in gene expression to define the critical thresholds for the F-test that distinguishes stabilizing from directional selection, supporting the interpretation of the scaled ratio V_B/V_A.

formula-notes:formula_12.33h:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将检验统计量 Q_x 定义为向量 x 的自身内积，同时通过右侧表达式将其与遗传效应向量 a*、遗传协方差矩阵 Ω 的逆以及加性遗传方差 V_A 联系起来，从而将 Q_x 表示为标准化遗传效应的二次型。
formula-notes:formula_12.33h:zh.inThisChapter: 在本节中，该公式作为 Berg-Coop Q_x 检验的基础，用于检测数量性状位点（QTL）的关联信号；它通过将 GWAS 汇总统计量转化为二次型，为后续推导检验的分布和显著性阈值提供直接依据。

formula-notes:formula_12.34b:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes a modified F-statistic for multivariate stabilizing selection (MDE) as the ratio of between-population variance (VB) to within-population variance (VA), scaled by effective population size (Ne) and divergence time (t), and follows an F-distribution with degrees of freedom L-1 and k-1.
formula-notes:formula_12.34b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on divergence in gene expression to provide a test statistic that accounts for both drift and selection, supporting the inference of stabilizing selection versus neutral divergence.

formula-notes:formula_13.1:en.plainMeaning: The formula computes the response to selection (R) as the product of heritability (h²) and the selection differential (S).
formula-notes:formula_13.1:en.inThisChapter: It appears here to show that under certain conditions (many loci of small effect or linear parent-offspring regression), the simple breeder's equation approximates the response, forming the foundation for quantitative genetics theory.

formula-notes:formula_12.34a:en.plainMeaning: This formula shows that the among-line variance estimator V_B follows a scaled chi-square distribution with L-1 degrees of freedom, and the within-line variance estimator V_A follows a scaled chi-square distribution with k-1 degrees of freedom, where t is divergence time, σ_m^2 is mutational variance, and N_e is effective population size.
formula-notes:formula_12.34a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on divergence in gene expression to provide the sampling distributions of variance components, which are then used to construct a modified F-test statistic (F_MDE*) for detecting stabilizing selection.

formula-notes:formula_12.34a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式表明，组间方差估计量 V_B 近似服从自由度为 L-1 的卡方分布乘以尺度因子 (2t σ_m^2)/(L-1)，其中 t 是分化时间、σ_m^2 是突变方差；组内方差估计量 V_A 近似服从自由度为 k-1 的卡方分布乘以尺度因子 (2N_e σ_m^2)/(k-1)，其中 N_e 是有效群体大小。
formula-notes:formula_12.34a:zh.inThisChapter: 在“基因表达分歧”章节中，该公式基于公式12.5a给出的方差估计分布，为后续构造修正的Lande F_MDE检验统计量（公式12.34b）提供理论基础，通过将V_B和V_A标准化为卡方变量来消除尺度差异。

formula-notes:formula_13.2:en.plainMeaning: This formula predicts the expected offspring phenotype (z_o) given parental phenotypes (z_fa, z_mo), using a linear regression with slopes b_o,fa and b_o,mo, and deviations from parental means μ_fa and μ_mo, centered on offspring mean μ_o.
formula-notes:formula_13.2:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the derivation of the breeder's equation to express the conditional expectation of offspring value under linear biparental regression, which is then averaged over selected parents to obtain the response to selection.

formula-notes:formula_12.34b:zh.plainMeaning: 公式(12.34b)将修正的F统计量F*_{MDE}定义为群体间方差V_B与群体内方差V_A之比，再乘以有效群体大小N_e与分化时间t之比，从而得到一个服从F分布的统计量，其自由度分别为L-1和k-1。
formula-notes:formula_12.34b:zh.inThisChapter: 在“基因表达分歧”这一节中，该公式基于(12.34a)中V_B和V_A的卡方分布，构造了一个可用于检验中性漂移与选择假说的F检验统计量，为后续讨论统计推断和临界值提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_13.1:zh.plainMeaning: 公式 R = h²S 表示响应（R）等于遗传力（h²）乘以选择差（S），即通过选择获得的子代均值变化量。
formula-notes:formula_13.1:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在单代响应章节，作为育种者方程的核心表达式，为后续讨论多代选择、相关响应等扩展奠定基础。

formula-notes:formula_13.4a:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the response to selection in daughters (R_da) as the sum of the product of the daughter-father regression coefficient (b_da,fa) and the selection differential in fathers (S_fa), plus the product of the mother-daughter regression coefficient (b_da,mo) and the selection differential in mothers (S_mo).
formula-notes:formula_13.4a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on single-generation response to derive the breeder's equation for sex-limited traits, supporting the prediction of offspring mean from selection on both parents.

formula-notes:formula_12.34d:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式给出了当比较两个群体（L=2）时，基于平方差异d²与群体内方差V_A的比值，判断是否拒绝中性进化零假设的临界条件：若比值小于等于F分布的α/2分位数或大于等于1-α/2分位数，则差异显著。
formula-notes:formula_12.34d:zh.inThisChapter: 在“基因表达分歧”章节中，该公式将一般情况（公式12.34c）简化为两个群体的情形，利用V_B = d²/2（公式12.8c）将检验统计量转化为d²/V_A，为后续应用F分布进行假设检验提供了具体判据。

formula-notes:formula_12.34d:en.plainMeaning: This formula gives the two-tailed rejection region for testing whether the squared difference d² between two population means is consistent with neutral divergence, using the F-distribution with numerator df=1 and denominator df=k-1, where d² is scaled by the additive genetic variance V_A, and the F quantiles depend on 2t/N_e.
formula-notes:formula_12.34d:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on divergence in gene expression to provide a specific test for two populations, derived from the general L-population test (Equation 12.34c) by substituting V_B = d²/2 from Equation 12.8c, and it supports the argument that neutral expectation can be rejected if d²/V_A falls outside the interval defined by the two F quantiles.

formula-notes:formula_13.4b:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the response to selection in sons (R_so) as the sum of the product of the regression coefficient of sons on fathers (b_so,fa) times the selection differential in fathers (S_fa) and the product of the regression coefficient of sons on mothers (b_so,mo) times the selection differential in mothers (S_mo).
formula-notes:formula_13.4b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on single-generation response to show how the breeder's equation extends to two-sex selection, supporting the calculation of total response from both paternal and maternal contributions.

formula-notes:formula_12.34c:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式给出了两个F分布临界值条件，用于判断群体间基因表达分化（V_B/V_A）是否显著偏离中性预期：若比值小于等于F_{α/2}临界值，则暗示稳定选择；若比值大于等于F_{1-α/2}临界值，则暗示定向选择。其中V_B是群体间方差，V_A是群体内方差，t是分化时间，N_e是有效群体大小，L是群体数，k是每个群体的样本数。
formula-notes:formula_12.34c:zh.inThisChapter: 本章讨论基因表达分化，公式(12.34c)基于中性理论框架（公式12.34a和12.34b）给出了统计检验的临界值，用于区分稳定选择和定向选择，为后续应用F分布进行假设检验提供了具体判据。

formula-notes:formula_13.3:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the expected mean of offspring after selection, given the selection differentials in fathers (S_fa) and mothers (S_mo). Key symbols: μ_o (offspring mean before selection), b_o,fa and b_o,mo (regression coefficients of offspring on father and mother), S_fa and S_mo (selection differentials).
formula-notes:formula_13.3:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on single-generation response to show how the breeder's equation extends to two-sex selection, supporting the derivation of the total response as a weighted sum of parental selection differentials.

formula-notes:formula_13.3:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算经过选择后后代期望均值，等于后代总体均值μ₀加上父亲选择差S_fa乘以父亲对后代的回归系数b_o,fa，再加上母亲选择差S_mo乘以母亲对后代的回归系数b_o,mo。
formula-notes:formula_13.3:zh.inThisChapter: 此处将上一行条件期望表达式中的偏差项替换为选择差S_fa和S_mo，从而将选择响应表示为父母选择差的线性组合，为后续推导单代响应（育种者方程）奠定基础。

formula-notes:formula_13.4b:zh.plainMeaning: 公式(13.4b)计算儿子的响应(R_so)，它是父亲选择差(S_fa)乘以儿子-父亲回归系数(b_so,fa)与母亲选择差(S_mo)乘以儿子-母亲回归系数(b_so,mo)之和。
formula-notes:formula_13.4b:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式与(13.4a)并列，分别给出女儿和儿子的响应，为后续推导两性选择下的育种者方程（如公式13.5）提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_13.6a:en.plainMeaning: The selection intensity (standardized selection differential) is the selection differential S divided by the phenotypic standard deviation σz, expressing the strength of selection in units of phenotypic standard deviations.
formula-notes:formula_13.6a:en.inThisChapter: This formula appears in the section on the breeder's equation to quantify selection intensity, which is then used in Equation 13.6b to relate selection intensity to the response to selection.

formula-notes:formula_13.5:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the response to selection (R) as the product of heritability (h²) and the total selection differential (S), where S is the average of the father's (S_fa) and mother's (S_mo) selection differentials.
formula-notes:formula_13.5:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on single-generation response to show that the breeder's equation holds when selection differentials are averaged over both parents, supporting the derivation of the standard breeder's equation.

formula-notes:formula_13.2:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式表示在双亲回归为线性的条件下，后代性状值对父母性状值的条件期望等于群体均值加上父亲和母亲偏差分别乘以回归系数。其中 μ_o、μ_fa、μ_mo 分别是后代、父亲和母亲的群体均值，b_o,fa 和 b_o,mo 是后代对父亲和母亲的回归系数。
formula-notes:formula_13.2:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在单代响应（育种者方程）章节，用于建立后代期望与父母表型值之间的线性关系，为后续通过对所有选择亲本求平均来得到选择响应（R）提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_13.5:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将子代响应R表示为父本选择差S_fa和母本选择差S_mo分别乘以h^2/2后求和，等价于总选择差S乘以遗传力h^2，其中S=(S_fa+S_mo)/2。
formula-notes:formula_13.5:zh.inThisChapter: 在单代响应（育种者方程）章节中，此式说明当父母本选择差不同时，响应等于父母本贡献之和，从而统一到标准育种者方程形式，为后续多代选择响应推导奠定基础。

formula-notes:formula_13.7a:en.plainMeaning: The selection differential S equals the covariance between relative fitness w and trait value z, quantifying the change in mean trait due to selection.
formula-notes:formula_13.7a:en.inThisChapter: It appears here to derive the Breeder's Equation, linking selection differential to genetic response via heritability in Equation 13.7b.

formula-notes:formula_13.7b:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the expected change in the mean breeding value of a trait after one generation of selection, equal to the covariance between breeding value and relative fitness.
formula-notes:formula_13.7b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on the breeder's equation to express the response to selection in terms of breeding value, linking selection differential to genetic change via the Robertson-Price identity.

formula-notes:formula_13.6a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将选择差 S 除以表型标准差 σ_z，得到标准化选择强度 ī，用于衡量选择强度，单位为表型标准差个数。
formula-notes:formula_13.6a:zh.inThisChapter: 本章通过选择强度 ī 将选择差 S 标准化，为后续推导育种者方程（公式 13.6b）中响应 R 与选择强度、遗传力等的关系做铺垫。

formula-notes:formula_13.6b:en.plainMeaning: This formula expresses the response to selection (R) in terms of heritability (h²), selection intensity (ī), and phenotypic standard deviation (σz), and shows equivalent forms using additive genetic variance (σA²) and the square root of heritability (h).
formula-notes:formula_13.6b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on the breeder's equation to provide a version that uses selection intensity (ī) instead of the selection differential (S), which is a more standardized measure of selection strength, and supports later arguments about predicting evolutionary change under different selection scenarios.

formula-notes:formula_13.4a:zh.plainMeaning: 公式13.4a计算雌性后代（da）对选择的响应R_da，它等于父亲选择差S_fa乘以父-女回归系数b_da,fa，加上母亲选择差S_mo乘以母-女回归系数b_da,mo。
formula-notes:formula_13.4a:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在单世代响应（育种者方程）部分，由公式13.3的期望推导而来，将响应分解为父本和母本选择的线性组合，为后续推导雄性后代响应公式13.4b以及多性状选择响应提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_13.7a:zh.plainMeaning: 公式 S = σ(w, z) 表示选择差 S 等于相对适合度 w 与性状值 z 之间的协方差，即度量了性状与适合度的线性关联强度。
formula-notes:formula_13.7a:zh.inThisChapter: 本章推导育种者方程，此公式将选择差重新表达为协方差形式，为后续将选择差分解为遗传方差和协方差（如公式 13.7b）提供直接代数基础。

formula-notes:formula_13.8a:en.plainMeaning: This formula expresses relative fitness (w) as a linear function of phenotypic value (z), where a is the intercept, β is the regression slope (selection gradient), and e is the residual.
formula-notes:formula_13.8a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the Breeder's Equation section to define the selection gradient β, which is then used in the Robertson-Price identity to derive the response to selection.

formula-notes:formula_13.8a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将相对适应度 w 表示为表型值 z 的线性函数，其中 a 是截距，β 是回归斜率，e 是残差。
formula-notes:formula_13.8a:zh.inThisChapter: 它出现在 Robertson-Price 恒等式之后，为后续推导选择微分和育种者方程（13.8b、13.8c）提供线性回归框架。

formula-notes:formula_13.8b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将选择梯度β定义为性状z与相对适应度w的协方差σ(z,w)除以性状z的方差σ_z^2，即选择差S与方差之比。
formula-notes:formula_13.8b:zh.inThisChapter: 在育种者方程章节中，该公式将选择梯度β与选择差S联系起来，为后续推导育种者方程中响应R = h^2 S提供回归系数的基础。

formula-notes:formula_13.8b:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the selection gradient β as the covariance between trait z and relative fitness w divided by the variance of z, which equals the selection differential S divided by the variance of z.
formula-notes:formula_13.8b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the derivation of the Breeder's Equation to express the slope of the regression of relative fitness on the trait, which is then used to connect selection differential to genetic response.

formula-notes:formula_13.9:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the effective selection differential (Se) by weighting each parent's deviation from the population mean (zi - μz) by its relative number of offspring (ni / n̄), then averaging over the np selected parents.
formula-notes:formula_13.9:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on the breeder's equation to account for unequal fertility among selected parents, providing a corrected selection differential that leads to a more accurate prediction of the response to selection.

formula-notes:formula_13.7b:zh.plainMeaning: 公式 Δμ_{A_z} = R_{A_z} = σ(A_z, w) 表示在单代选择中，育种值 A_z 的平均变化（即响应 R_{A_z}）等于育种值与相对适合度 w 的协方差。
formula-notes:formula_13.7b:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式从 Robertson-Price 恒等式推导而来，将选择响应直接与育种值和适合度的协方差联系起来，为后续推导育种者方程（R = h²S）提供关键桥梁。

formula-notes:formula_13.8c:zh.plainMeaning: 公式 R = σ_A^2 β 计算响应 R，其中 σ_A^2 是加性遗传方差，β 是选择梯度（性状值与适合度之间的关联强度），因此响应等于加性遗传方差乘以选择梯度。
formula-notes:formula_13.8c:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在单世代响应（育种者方程）部分，由选择差 S = σ_z^2 β 代入方程 13.1 得到，将响应 R 直接与加性遗传方差和选择梯度关联，为后续引入多变量 Lande 方程（R = G β）做铺垫。

formula-notes:formula_13.8c:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the response to selection (R) as the product of the additive genetic variance (σ_A^2) and the selection gradient (β), connecting trait heritability with the strength of selection.
formula-notes:formula_13.8c:en.inThisChapter: It appears in this section to derive the univariate version of the breeder's equation from the selection differential and to serve as a foundation for the multivariate Lande equation introduced later.

formula-notes:formula_13.10a:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the expected deviation of offspring trait y from its preselection mean, given the selected parent's trait value z_x, as a linear regression based on the covariance between z_x and y_o and the variance of z.
formula-notes:formula_13.10a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the expansion of the breeder's equation to derive the expected change in the response trait y from selection on z, leading to the multivariate breeder's equation (13.10b).

formula-notes:formula_13.10a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算在给定选择性状z的值为z_x的条件下，响应性状y的后代均值偏离其总体均值μ_y的条件期望，它等于z_x偏离其总体均值μ_z的线性函数，斜率是σ(z_x, y_o) / σ²(z)。
formula-notes:formula_13.10a:zh.inThisChapter: 本节扩展基本育种者方程，该公式通过假设线性回归将选择性状z与响应性状y的后代联系起来，为后续推导响应性状的期望变化（即育种者方程的推广形式）提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_13.10b:zh.plainMeaning: 公式13.10b计算响应变量y的响应Ry，即后代均值μy**与选择前均值μy之差。它等于选择微分Sz乘以σ(zx,yo)/σ²(z)，或等于标准化选择强度īz乘以σ(zx,yo)/σ(z)。
formula-notes:formula_13.10b:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在扩展基本育种者方程章节，从单性状选择响应推广到多性状情形，为后续推导间接选择响应和相关响应奠定基础。

formula-notes:formula_13.11b:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the expected change in the response trait y, measured in phenotypic standard deviations of y, as the product of the standardized selection differential (intensity) on the selected trait z and the genetic correlation between z and the breeding value of y (y_o).
formula-notes:formula_13.11b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on expanding the basic breeder's equation to express the response in relative (standardized) units, supporting later arguments about comparing responses across traits or populations.

formula-notes:formula_13.6b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将响应R表示为选择强度ī、加性遗传标准差σA或表型标准差σz与遗传力h²或h的乘积，即R = h² ī σz = ī h σA = σA² ī / σz，其中h² = σA²/σz²。
formula-notes:formula_13.6b:zh.inThisChapter: 在单世代响应（育种者方程）章节中，该公式通过引入选择强度ī = S/σz替代选择差S，将育种者方程R = h²S转化为以ī表达的形式，便于比较不同性状或群体的选择响应，并为后续多世代响应和选择极限的推导提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_13.11c:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the response to selection in breeding value for trait y (R_{A_y}) as the product of the standardized selection differential (ī_z), the genetic correlation between the selection criterion z_x and the breeding value A_y (ρ(z_x, A_y)), and the genetic standard deviation of A_y (σ(A_y)).
formula-notes:formula_13.11c:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the expansion of the breeder's equation to show how selection on a correlated trait (z_x) causes a response in the breeding value of the trait of interest (A_y), supporting the derivation of the correlated response to selection.

formula-notes:formula_13.11a:en.plainMeaning: This formula expresses the response to selection in trait y (Ry) as the product of the standardized selection intensity (īz), the correlation ρ(zx, yo) between the selection criterion zx and the response trait yo, and the phenotypic standard deviation σ(y) of y.
formula-notes:formula_13.11a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section expanding the basic breeder's equation to show how the response can be rewritten using the correlation (accuracy) between the selection criterion and the response trait, which is a key concept for predicting response from indirect selection or correlated traits.

formula-notes:formula_13.11a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将响应变量y的遗传进展R_y表示为选择强度i_z、响应变量标准差σ(y)以及预测准确性ρ(z_x, y_o)的乘积，其中ρ(z_x, y_o)是选择指标z_x与响应变量y_o之间的相关系数。
formula-notes:formula_13.11a:zh.inThisChapter: 在扩展基本育种者方程这一节中，公式13.11a通过引入相关系数ρ将选择强度版本的响应方程转化为准确性形式，为后续推导不同情境下的预测准确性（如公式13.11b-13.11e）奠定基础。

formula-notes:formula_13.11e:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the correlation between an individual's phenotype (z) and breeding value (A), which simplifies to the square root of heritability (h), indicating the accuracy of individual selection.
formula-notes:formula_13.11e:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section expanding the basic breeder's equation to show that the correlation ρ(z,A) equals heritability, linking phenotypic selection to genetic gain.

formula-notes:formula_13.11d:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将选择响应分解为三个因子的乘积：选择强度（Intensity）、利用表型值zx预测育种值的准确性（Accuracy in predicting breeding value using zx）以及可利用的遗传变异（Usable variation）。
formula-notes:formula_13.11d:zh.inThisChapter: 本节将基本育种者方程扩展为更一般的形式，公式(13.11d)通过引入准确性和可利用变异，为后续推导多性状或复杂选择方案下的响应公式提供框架。

formula-notes:formula_13.11c:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算对目标性状育种值A_y进行选择时的响应R_{A_y}，等于选择强度ī_z乘以性状z_x与A_y之间的遗传相关系数ρ(z_x, A_y)再乘以A_y的标准差σ(A_y)。
formula-notes:formula_13.11c:zh.inThisChapter: 在扩展基本育种者方程一节中，该公式将响应变量从表型值替换为育种值A_y，为后续推导多性状选择响应（如公式13.11d和13.11e）奠定基础。

formula-notes:formula_13.11e:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算个体表型值(z)与育种值(A)之间的相关系数ρ(z,A)，通过协方差σ(z_x,A_x)除以标准差乘积σ_zσ_A，最终等于σ_A/σ_z，即遗传力h的平方根。
formula-notes:formula_13.11e:zh.inThisChapter: 在扩展基本育种者方程章节中，此公式将选择准确性（表型与育种值的相关性）直接表达为遗传力h，为后续推导选择响应和预测遗传进展提供关键连接。

formula-notes:formula_13.12a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将第i个区组中第j个个体的表型值z_ij分解为总体均值μ、基因型值G_ij、区组效应B_i和残差环境效应e_ij之和。
formula-notes:formula_13.12a:zh.inThisChapter: 在扩展基本育种者方程这一节中，该公式将表型方差分解为遗传方差、区组方差和残差方差，为后续推导遗传力估计和选择响应公式（如公式13.12b）提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_13.11d:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the response to selection as the product of selection intensity, accuracy of predicting breeding value using a predictor z_x, and usable genetic variation. Key symbols: Response (genetic gain), Intensity (standardized selection differential), Accuracy (correlation between predictor and true breeding value), Usable variation (genetic standard deviation).
formula-notes:formula_13.11d:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section expanding the basic breeder's equation to show that the classic equation R = h²S is a special case when accuracy equals the square root of heritability. This general form supports later derivations of response using different predictors (e.g., own phenotype, progeny, or molecular markers).

formula-notes:formula_13.12b:en.plainMeaning: This formula partitions the total phenotypic variance (σ_z²) into genetic variance (σ_G²) and environmental variance (σ_E²), where environmental variance is further decomposed into block variance (σ_B²) and residual within-block variance (σ_e²).
formula-notes:formula_13.12b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section expanding the basic breeder's equation to account for block effects in field trials, supporting the calculation of heritability and prediction of response to selection when environmental variation is structured by blocks.

formula-notes:formula_13.11b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算响应性状y的响应量（以y的表型标准差为单位）等于选择差（以z的表型标准差为单位）乘以选择性状z_x与响应性状y_o之间的遗传相关系数ρ(z_x, y_o)。
formula-notes:formula_13.11b:zh.inThisChapter: 在扩展基本育种者方程这一节中，公式13.11b将相对响应（即响应性状以表型标准差为单位的变化）表示为选择强度与遗传相关性的乘积，为后续推导多性状选择下的响应预测（如公式13.11c-13.11e）提供了基础。

formula-notes:formula_13.12a:en.plainMeaning: This formula decomposes the observed phenotypic value z_{ij} of individual j in block i into the population mean μ, its genotypic value G_{ij}, a block effect B_i, and a residual environmental deviation e_{ij}.
formula-notes:formula_13.12a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section expanding the basic breeder's equation to partition phenotypic variance into genetic and environmental components, supporting the derivation of heritability and response to selection in later arguments.

formula-notes:formula_13.12b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将表型方差 σ_z² 分解为遗传方差 σ_G² 与环境方差 σ_E² 之和，其中环境方差进一步拆分为区组间方差 σ_B² 和残差方差 σ_e²。
formula-notes:formula_13.12b:zh.inThisChapter: 在扩展基本育种者方程这一节中，该公式承接公式13.12a对表型方差的分解，通过明确环境方差的两个组分（区组间和区组内），为后续推导更精确的遗传力估计和育种值预测提供方差结构基础。

formula-notes:formula_13.14a:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the accuracy (correlation) between the phenotypic deviation of an individual from its block mean and its additive genetic value, where σ_A is additive genetic standard deviation, σ_G^2 is genotypic variance, σ_e^2 is environmental variance, and n is block size.
formula-notes:formula_13.14a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section expanding the breeder's equation to account for block designs, supporting the derivation of accuracy when selection is based on deviations from block means.

formula-notes:formula_13.13:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算个体育种值A_ij与块内偏差(z_ij - z̄_i)之间的协方差，其中z_ij是第i块第j个体的表型值，z̄_i是第i块均值，A_ij是育种值。推导显示该协方差等于σ_A^2乘以(1 - 1/n)，n为块内个体数。
formula-notes:formula_13.13:zh.inThisChapter: 本节扩展基础育种者方程，该公式用于推导块内选择时育种值与表型偏差的相关性（精度），为后续计算选择响应提供关键协方差项。

formula-notes:formula_13.14c:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the response to selection (R) when blocks are ignored, using the selection intensity (ī), additive genetic variance (σ_A²), and the square root of total phenotypic variance (σ_G² + σ_B² + σ_e²) as the denominator.
formula-notes:formula_13.14c:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section expanding the basic breeder's equation to account for block effects, showing how ignoring blocks inflates the phenotypic variance and reduces the expected response compared to designs that account for blocks.

formula-notes:formula_13.13:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the covariance between an individual's breeding value (A_ij) and its phenotypic deviation from the block mean (z_ij - z̄_i). It shows that under the assumption of no relatedness within blocks, this covariance equals the additive genetic variance σ_A^2 multiplied by (1 - 1/n), where n is the block size.
formula-notes:formula_13.13:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section expanding the basic breeder's equation to account for block (environmental) effects. The result is used to derive the accuracy of selection based on within-block deviations, which is a key component of the breeder's equation when blocks are present.

formula-notes:formula_13.15:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the relative efficiency of stratified (blocked) experimental designs compared to completely randomized designs, where σ²_G is genetic variance, σ²_B is block variance, and σ²_e is error variance.
formula-notes:formula_13.15:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on expanding the breeder's equation to show how blocking reduces error variance, thereby increasing heritability and response to selection.

formula-notes:formula_13.14a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算基于个体间偏差（z_{ij} - \overline{z}_{i}）与育种值A_{ij}之间的相关系数（精度），分子是σ_A^2乘以(1-1/n)，分母是σ_A乘以√(σ_G^2+σ_e^2)，化简后分子为σ_A(1-1/n)，分母为√(σ_G^2+σ_e^2)。
formula-notes:formula_13.14a:zh.inThisChapter: 在扩展基本育种者方程章节中，该公式用于推导当个体在区块内不相关时，基于区块内偏差的育种值预测精度，为后续公式(13.14b)和(13.14c)中不同设计下的精度表达式提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_13.14b:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the response to selection (R) when selection is applied within blocks, as the product of the selection intensity (ī), the covariance between the deviation from block mean and the breeding value divided by σ_A, and σ_A. It simplifies to ī times the additive genetic variance (σ_A^2) divided by the square root of the total phenotypic variance (σ_G^2 + σ_e^2), assuming large n.
formula-notes:formula_13.14b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section expanding the basic breeder's equation to account for block designs, showing how the response can be expressed in terms of variance components, which supports later derivations for more complex experimental designs.

formula-notes:formula_13.16a:en.plainMeaning: This formula decomposes the j-th measurement of individual i (z_ij) into a genotypic component (G_i), a permanent environmental component (E_i), and a special environmental component (e_ij) unique to that measurement.
formula-notes:formula_13.16a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the expansion of the breeder's equation to introduce repeatability, supporting later derivation of the correlation between repeated measures and the estimation of genetic parameters.

formula-notes:formula_13.15:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算分层（区组）设计相对于完全随机设计的效率增益，即区组方差σ_B²越大，比值越大，说明分层越有效。
formula-notes:formula_13.15:zh.inThisChapter: 在扩展基本育种者方程中，此公式量化了区组设计（分层）对遗传方差估计精度的提升，为后续比较不同试验设计效率提供依据。

formula-notes:formula_13.16b:en.plainMeaning: This formula defines repeatability (r) as the proportion of total phenotypic variance (σ_z²) due to genetic (σ_G²) and permanent environmental (σ_E²) effects, equivalently 1 minus the proportion due to special environmental variance (σ_e²).
formula-notes:formula_13.16b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the expansion of the breeder's equation to partition phenotypic variance into repeatable and non-repeatable components, supporting later arguments about predicting response to selection when multiple measurements per individual are available.

formula-notes:formula_13.14b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算在分组选择中，基于组内选择强度 ī、加性遗传方差 σA² 以及表型方差（由遗传方差 σG² 和环境方差 σe² 组成）的平方根，得到响应 R。当每组个体数 n 较大时，近似忽略 (1-1/n) 因子。
formula-notes:formula_13.14b:zh.inThisChapter: 本节扩展基础育种者方程，公式 13.14b 将响应 R 表达为组内选择强度 ī 与加性遗传方差 σA² 的乘积除以表型标准差，为后续推导组间选择响应（如公式 13.14c）提供直接表达式。

formula-notes:formula_13.14c:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算在忽略区组、从整个群体直接选择个体时的响应R，其中分子是选择强度乘以加性遗传方差，分母是表型标准差（包含遗传方差、区组方差和环境方差之和的平方根）。
formula-notes:formula_13.14c:zh.inThisChapter: 出现在扩展基本育种者方程的章节，承接公式13.6b，说明当区组效应被纳入表型方差时，响应公式的形式变化，为后续讨论不同选择方案的效果提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_13.16a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将个体i的第j次测量值z_ij分解为基因型值G_i、永久环境效应E_i和特殊环境效应e_ij之和，其中G_i和E_i对所有测量相同，e_ij仅影响第j次测量。
formula-notes:formula_13.16a:zh.inThisChapter: 本章扩展基础育种者方程，此分解用于引入重复率概念，为后续推导基于重复测量的育种值预测（如公式13.16b和13.16c）奠定基础。

formula-notes:formula_13.16c:en.plainMeaning: This formula partitions the total phenotypic variance (σ_z²) into two components: rσ_z² equals the sum of genotypic variance (σ_G²) and permanent environmental variance (σ_E²), while (1−r)σ_z² equals the temporary environmental variance (σ_e²).
formula-notes:formula_13.16c:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section expanding the breeder's equation to show how repeatability (r) decomposes variance into permanent (σ_G²+σ_E²) and temporary (σ_e²) components, supporting later arguments about predicting breeding values from repeated measures.

formula-notes:formula_13.16c:zh.plainMeaning: 公式将总表型方差σ_z^2乘以重复率r分解为遗传方差σ_G^2与一般环境方差σ_E^2之和，而(1-r)σ_z^2则等于特殊环境方差σ_e^2。
formula-notes:formula_13.16c:zh.inThisChapter: 在扩展基本育种者方程章节中，该公式通过重复率r将总方差拆解为可重复部分（σ_G^2+σ_E^2）和临时部分（σ_e^2），为后续推导个体多次测量均值方差及育种值预测提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_13.16b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将重复力 r 定义为遗传方差 σ_G^2 与一般环境方差 σ_E^2 之和占总表型方差 σ_z^2 的比例，也等于 1 减去特殊环境方差 σ_e^2 占总表型方差的比例。
formula-notes:formula_13.16b:zh.inThisChapter: 在扩展基本育种者方程这一节中，该公式用于量化个体多次测量值之间的相关性，为后续推导重复力与方差组分的关系（如公式13.16c）以及利用重复力估计育种值提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_13.9:zh.plainMeaning: 公式13.9计算有效选择差S_e，它通过每个亲本的表型值z_i与群体均值μ_z的偏差，并用该亲本的后代数n_i与平均后代数n̄的比值加权，再除以亲本总数n_p，从而考虑不同亲本繁殖成功率的差异。
formula-notes:formula_13.9:zh.inThisChapter: 在单世代响应（育种者方程）章节中，该公式用于修正简单选择差，使其能反映实际繁殖贡献不均的情况，为后续准确预测选择响应ΔR = h²S_e提供更精确的输入量。

formula-notes:formula_13.17a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算个体加性遗传值 A_i 与表型均值 z̄_i 的协方差，通过将协方差运算拆解为对每个表型值 z_ij 的协方差平均，最终得到该协方差等于加性遗传方差 σ_A²。
formula-notes:formula_13.17a:zh.inThisChapter: 此处推导该协方差是为了后续计算用 z̄_i 预测 A_i 的准确度（公式 13.17b 和 13.17c），因为准确度需要协方差与 z̄_i 的方差之比。

formula-notes:formula_13.17b:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the mean phenotype of the i-th genotype across n replicates, decomposing it into the genotypic value G_i, the permanent environmental effect E_i, and the average of temporary environmental deviations e_ij.
formula-notes:formula_13.17b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the expansion of the breeder's equation to derive the variance of the mean phenotype, which is then used to express the repeatability r and the variance of the mean in terms of σ_z^2 and n.

formula-notes:formula_13.17a:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the covariance between the breeding value A_i of individual i and the mean phenotype of its n progeny (z̄_i). It shows that this covariance equals the additive genetic variance σ²_A, because the covariance between A_i and each progeny phenotype z_ij is σ(A_i, A_i) = σ²_A, and averaging over n progeny preserves this value.
formula-notes:formula_13.17a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section expanding the basic breeder's equation to derive the accuracy of predicting breeding values from progeny means. The result σ(A_i, z̄_i) = σ²_A is used in equation (13.17b) to compute the variance of z̄_i and in (13.17c) to obtain the regression coefficient, ultimately supporting the expression for accuracy.

formula-notes:formula_13.17c:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the variance of the mean phenotype of a group (e.g., family or line) as a function of the total phenotypic variance σ_z², the intraclass correlation r (repeatability), and the number of individuals n per group. It shows that the variance equals σ_z² times (1+(n-1)r)/n.
formula-notes:formula_13.17c:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section expanding the basic breeder's equation to derive the variance among group means, which is needed to predict response to selection when selection is based on group means rather than individual phenotypes.

formula-notes:formula_13.18a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算用表型均值 $\overline{z}_i$ 预测育种值 $A_i$ 的准确度 $\rho$，等于遗传力 $h$ 乘以一个关于个体数 $n$ 和重复力 $r$ 的因子。
formula-notes:formula_13.18a:zh.inThisChapter: 它出现在扩展基本育种者方程中，为后续推导基于重复记录的选择响应公式（13.18b）提供准确度表达式。

formula-notes:formula_13.17c:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算表型均值 $\overline{z}_{i}$ 的方差，将其分解为遗传方差 $\sigma_G^2$、永久环境方差 $\sigma_E^2$ 和临时环境方差 $\sigma_e^2/n$，并进一步用表型方差 $\sigma_z^2$ 和重复力 $r$ 表示为 $\sigma_z^2(1+(n-1)r)/n$。
formula-notes:formula_13.17c:zh.inThisChapter: 在扩展基本育种者方程章节中，该公式用于量化个体多次测量均值的变异，为后续推导育种值预测的精度或选择响应提供方差结构。

formula-notes:formula_13.19a:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the ratio of the accuracy of selection based on the mean of n repeated measures (ρ(ẑ_i, A_i)) to the accuracy of selection based on a single measure (ρ(z_i, A_i)), expressed as √(n / (1 + (n-1)r)), where n is the number of repeated measures and r is the repeatability (intraclass correlation).
formula-notes:formula_13.19a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on expanding the breeder's equation to show how repeated measures improve selection accuracy, supporting the argument that when repeatability is low, repeated-measures selection can substantially increase accuracy, especially as n grows large.

formula-notes:formula_13.18a:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the accuracy (correlation) between the mean phenotype of a group (e.g., family mean) and the individual's breeding value, showing how it depends on heritability (h), number of individuals (n), and intraclass correlation (r). Key symbols: ρ(ẑᵢ, Aᵢ) = accuracy, h = square root of heritability, n = group size, r = correlation among group members.
formula-notes:formula_13.18a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the expansion of the breeder's equation to account for selection based on family means rather than individual phenotypes, and it directly feeds into formula 13.18b to compute the response to selection R.

formula-notes:formula_13.17b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将第i个基因型（如家系）的n个观测值的平均值分解为：群体均值G_i（基因型效应）、环境效应E_i以及残差项的平均值(1/n)∑e_ij。
formula-notes:formula_13.17b:zh.inThisChapter: 在扩展基本育种者方程章节中，该公式用于建立表型均值与遗传、环境及残差成分的关系，为后续推导均值方差σ²(z̄_i)提供基础，进而引出重复率r的概念。

formula-notes:formula_13.19b:en.plainMeaning: This formula compares the response to selection using family mean selection (R_{z̄_i}) versus individual selection (R_{z_i}), incorporating the ratio of selection intensities (ī_{z̄_i}/ī_{z_i}) and a factor √(n/(1+(n-1)r)) that accounts for family size n and intraclass correlation r.
formula-notes:formula_13.19b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section expanding the basic breeder's equation to compare the efficiency of different selection strategies, supporting the argument that family selection can outperform individual selection when heritability is low or family structure is favorable.

formula-notes:formula_13.20:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the yearly genetic gain (r_y) in a breeding program, connecting selection intensities (ī_s, ī_d), generation intervals (L_s, L_d), heritability (h²), and phenotypic standard deviation (σ_z) or additive genetic standard deviation (σ_A).
formula-notes:formula_13.20:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section expanding the basic breeder's equation to account for separate selection in males and females, supporting later arguments about optimizing selection across sexes and generations.

formula-notes:formula_13.18b:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the response to selection (R) as the product of selection intensity (ī), the correlation between group mean and individual breeding value (ρ(z̄_i, A_i)), and the phenotypic standard deviation (σ_A). The second expression substitutes ρ(z̄_i, A_i) = h √(n / (1 + (n-1)r)), where h is the square root of heritability, n is group size, and r is relatedness among group members.
formula-notes:formula_13.18b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section 'Expanding the Basic Breeder's Equation' to extend the breeder's equation to group selection contexts, showing how relatedness and group size affect the response. This formula supports later arguments about the evolution of social traits by quantifying how indirect genetic effects and group structure alter selection response.

formula-notes:formula_13.19b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算基于家系均值选择（对家系均值进行选择）的响应 R_{z̄_i} 与基于个体表型值选择（对个体值进行选择）的响应 R_{z_i} 之比，等于两者选择强度之比（ī_{z̄_i} / ī_{z_i}）乘以 √[n / (1 + (n-1)r)]，其中 n 为家系大小，r 为家系内个体间的遗传相关系数。
formula-notes:formula_13.19b:zh.inThisChapter: 在扩展基础育种者方程（EXPANDING THE BASIC BREEDER'S EQUATION）一节中，该公式用于量化不同选择策略（家系选择 vs. 个体选择）的相对效率，为后续比较其他选择方案（如家系内选择、组合选择）提供基准公式。

formula-notes:formula_13.18b:zh.plainMeaning: 公式(13.18b)计算选择响应R，它是选择强度\bar{\imath}、育种值A_i与表型均值\overline{z}_i的相关系数ρ(\overline{z}_i,A_i)以及加性遗传标准差σ_A的乘积；代入(13.18a)后，R = \bar{\imath} h √[n/(1+(n-1)r)] σ_A，其中h是平方根遗传力，n是同胞数，r是同胞间表型相关系数。
formula-notes:formula_13.18b:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在扩展基本育种者方程章节，将响应R表达为选择强度、遗传力、家系大小和同胞相关性的函数，为后续讨论不同选择方案（如家系选择、同胞选择）的效率比较提供具体表达式。

formula-notes:formula_13.22a:en.plainMeaning: This formula expresses the response to selection (R) in units of phenotypic standard deviations (σ_z) as the product of heritability (h²) and standardized selection intensity (ī).
formula-notes:formula_13.22a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in this section to standardize the breeder's equation, allowing comparison of selection strength across traits with different variances, and supports later arguments about the required selection intensity for a given response.

formula-notes:formula_13.19a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算重复测量选择（基于个体均值）与单次测量选择（基于单次表型）的准确度之比，其中ρ(ẑᵢ, Aᵢ)是均值与育种值的相关系数，ρ(zᵢ, Aᵢ)是单次表型与育种值的相关系数，n是测量次数，r是重复力。
formula-notes:formula_13.19a:zh.inThisChapter: 本节扩展基础育种者方程，引入重复测量以提高选择准确度。该公式量化了重复测量相对于单次测量的优势，为后续讨论重复测量在低重复力下的效率提升（如当n很大时比值趋近1/√r）提供数学基础。

formula-notes:formula_13.21a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算每单位时间的预期遗传响应率 r_y，等于选择强度（父本和母本的平均值）除以世代间隔（父本和母本之和），再乘以选择精度 ρ(A,x) 和加性遗传标准差 σ_A。
formula-notes:formula_13.21a:zh.inThisChapter: 本章扩展基本育种者方程，公式 (13.21a) 将选择精度（式 13.11c）和世代间隔（式 13.20）整合为一个通用表达式，为后续考虑性别间精度差异的公式 (13.21b) 提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_13.21b:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the annual genetic gain (r_y) when selection accuracy differs between sexes, using sex-specific selection intensities (ī_s, ī_d), accuracies (ρ_s, ρ_d), generation intervals (L_s, L_d), and additive genetic standard deviation (σ_A).
formula-notes:formula_13.21b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the Expanding the Basic Breeder's Equation section to generalize the breeder's equation for scenarios where males and females have different selection accuracies, supporting later arguments on optimizing breeding programs with sex-specific selection.

formula-notes:formula_13.20:zh.plainMeaning: 公式(13.20)计算年遗传进展率 r_y，它等于亲本平均选择强度 (ī_s+ī_d)/(L_s+L_d) 乘以遗传力 h² 再乘以表型标准差 σ_z，或者等价地乘以 h 和加性遗传标准差 σ_A。
formula-notes:formula_13.20:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在扩展基础育种者方程章节，将原本以世代为单位的响应转化为以年为单位的响应，通过引入世代间隔 (L_s+L_d) 和双亲选择强度，为后续讨论不同繁殖策略下的年进展率提供定量基础。

formula-notes:formula_13.21a:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the expected rate of response per year (r_y) as the product of the selection intensity averaged over sexes (mean of male and female standardized selection differentials, ī_s and ī_d, divided by the sum of male and female generation intervals, L_s and L_d), the accuracy of selection ρ(A,x) (the correlation between the selection criterion x and the additive genetic value A), and the additive genetic standard deviation σ_A.
formula-notes:formula_13.21a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in this section to combine the selection accuracy (Equation 13.11c) and generation-interval (Equation 13.20) versions of the breeder's equation into a unified expression for the expected rate of response per year, supporting later generalizations where accuracies vary by sex (Equation 13.21b).

formula-notes:formula_13.21b:zh.plainMeaning: 公式(13.21b)计算育种值对年度遗传进展的贡献，其中r_y是年遗传进展，σ_A是加性遗传标准差，ī_s和ī_d分别为公母畜选择强度，ρ_s(A,x)和ρ_d(A,x)分别为公母畜基于度量x的育种值准确度，L_s和L_d为公母畜世代间隔。
formula-notes:formula_13.21b:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在扩展基本育种者方程章节，在公式(13.21a)基础上引入性别间准确度差异，为后续推导更精确的遗传进展预测公式提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_13.23a:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the response to selection (R) as the product of the additive genetic variance (σ_A^2), the inverse of the phenotypic variance (σ_z^{-2}), and the selection differential (S).
formula-notes:formula_13.23a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to the breeder's equation to express heritability in terms of variances, supporting later derivations of alternative forms like h^2 = σ_A^2 / σ_z^2.

formula-notes:formula_13.22b:en.plainMeaning: This formula expresses the proportional response to selection (R/μz) as the product of standardized selection intensity (ī), the square root of heritability (h), and the coefficient of additive genetic variation (CVA = σA/μz), which measures evolvability.
formula-notes:formula_13.22b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on expanding the breeder's equation to justify using mean-standardized response and CVA as a better measure of evolutionary potential than heritability alone, supporting arguments for comparing evolvability across traits.

formula-notes:formula_13.22a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将响应变量R（选择响应）除以表型标准差σz，得到标准化响应，等于遗传力h²乘以标准化选择强度ī。
formula-notes:formula_13.22a:zh.inThisChapter: 在扩展基本育种者方程这一节中，该公式通过方差标准化将响应与选择强度联系起来，为后续推导所需选择强度（如ī=1/h²）提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_13.22b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将标准化响应 R/μz 表示为选择强度 ī、遗传力 h 和加性遗传变异系数 CVA 的乘积，其中 CVA = σA/μz 是加性遗传标准差与表型均值的比值。
formula-notes:formula_13.22b:zh.inThisChapter: 在扩展基本育种者方程的章节中，该公式引入均值标准化响应，为后续讨论进化潜力度量（如CVA优于h²）提供数学基础。

formula-notes:formula_13.23b:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the multivariate response to selection (R) as the product of the additive-genetic covariance matrix (G), the inverse of the phenotypic covariance matrix (P⁻¹), and the selection differential vector (S).
formula-notes:formula_13.23b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to the breeder's equation to extend the univariate breeder's equation (R = h²S) to multiple traits, supporting later arguments about correlated responses and multivariate evolution.

formula-notes:formula_13.23c:en.plainMeaning: This formula defines the elements of the phenotypic covariance matrix P and the additive-genetic covariance matrix G: P_ij is the phenotypic covariance between traits i and j, and G_ij is the additive-genetic covariance between traits i and j.
formula-notes:formula_13.23c:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to the breeder's equation to specify the components of the matrices P and G used in the multivariate breeder's equation (13.23b), which predicts the response to selection for multiple traits.

formula-notes:formula_13.23c:zh.plainMeaning: 公式定义矩阵 P 和 G 的元素：P_{ij} 是性状 i 和 j 的表型协方差（由表型值 z_i 和 z_j 的协方差给出），G_{ij} 是加性遗传协方差（由育种值 A_i 和 A_j 的协方差给出）。
formula-notes:formula_13.23c:zh.inThisChapter: 此处出现在多变量育种者方程 (13.23b) 之后，明确 P 和 G 矩阵的具体含义，为后续用这些矩阵计算响应向量 R 和选择差向量 S 提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_13.23a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将育种者方程中的响应R表示为加性遗传方差σ_A^2与表型方差σ_z^{-2}的比值乘以选择差S，即R = h^2 S，其中h^2 = σ_A^2 / σ_z^2。
formula-notes:formula_13.23a:zh.inThisChapter: 此处通过将遗传力h^2分解为σ_A^2/σ_z^2，将育种者方程从概念形式转化为可计算的方差形式，为后续推导响应预测和方差组分估计（如公式13.23b和13.23c）提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_13.24a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算两个性状的响应向量R（R₁和R₂），通过遗传协方差矩阵G、表型协方差矩阵P的逆矩阵与选择差向量S（S₁和S₂）相乘得到，其中G和P均为2×2对称矩阵。
formula-notes:formula_13.24a:zh.inThisChapter: 本节推导多变量育种者方程，此公式是方程13.23b在双性状情形下的具体展开，为后续讨论遗传相关对响应的影响以及计算间接响应（公式13.24b、13.24c）提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_13.25a:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the vector of selection gradients β (each β_i is the partial regression coefficient of relative fitness on trait i) as the product of the inverse of the phenotypic variance-covariance matrix P and the vector of selection differentials S.
formula-notes:formula_13.25a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the multivariate breeder's equation section to extend the univariate selection gradient (Equation 13.8a) to multiple traits, providing the key input for predicting the response to selection via Equation 13.25b.

formula-notes:formula_13.23b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将多性状响应向量 R 表示为加性遗传协方差矩阵 G 乘以表型协方差矩阵 P 的逆再乘以选择差向量 S，即 R = G P^{-1} S，其中 R 和 S 分别是各性状的响应和选择差向量，G 和 P 分别是加性遗传和表型协方差矩阵。
formula-notes:formula_13.23b:zh.inThisChapter: 本节介绍短时均值变化，公式(13.23b)是单性状选择响应公式(13.23a)向多性状的推广，为后续推导多性状响应与选择梯度关系(13.23c)提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_13.24b:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the vector P⁻¹S, which is the product of the inverse of the phenotypic covariance matrix P and the selection differential vector S. The key symbols are P₁₁, P₂₂ (variances), P₁₂ (covariance), ρ_z (phenotypic correlation), and S₁, S₂ (selection differentials).
formula-notes:formula_13.24b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the Multivariate Breeder's Equation section to express the selection gradient β = P⁻¹S in terms of individual variances and correlation, which is then used to derive the response to selection for multiple traits.

formula-notes:formula_13.24a:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the vector of expected responses to selection for two traits, R = (R1, R2), as the product of the genetic covariance matrix G, the inverse of the phenotypic covariance matrix P, and the selection differential vector S. Key symbols: Gij = genetic covariance between traits i and j, Pij = phenotypic covariance, Si = selection differential for trait i.
formula-notes:formula_13.24a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the Multivariate Breeder's Equation section to extend the univariate breeder's equation to multiple traits, showing how genetic correlations (via G) and phenotypic correlations (via P) affect correlated responses to selection. This supports later arguments about the evolutionary consequences of selection on correlated traits.

formula-notes:formula_13.25a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将选择梯度向量 β（多元回归系数）与选择差向量 S 通过表型方差-协方差矩阵 P 的逆矩阵联系起来，即 β = P^{-1} S。
formula-notes:formula_13.25a:zh.inThisChapter: 在多元育种者方程章节中，此公式将单变量选择梯度（公式13.8a）推广到多变量情形，为后续推导多性状响应公式（如13.25b、13.25c）提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_13.24b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算了选择微分向量S左乘表型协方差矩阵逆P^{-1}的结果，将S通过P的逆变换为响应向量，其中P_{11}、P_{22}为两性状的方差，P_{12}为协方差，ρ_z为表型相关系数。
formula-notes:formula_13.24b:zh.inThisChapter: 在多元育种者方程章节中，该公式将选择微分S转换为P^{-1}S，为后续推导响应向量R = G P^{-1} S提供中间步骤，体现选择在多性状上的直接与间接效应。

formula-notes:formula_13.25b:en.plainMeaning: This formula expresses relative fitness (w) as a linear function of multiple traits (z_i) plus an intercept (a) and residual (e), where β_i are partial regression coefficients (selection gradients) quantifying the direct effect of each trait on fitness.
formula-notes:formula_13.25b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the multivariate breeder's equation section to define the selection gradient vector β, which is then used in Equation 13.25a to relate the selection differential S to the phenotypic variance-covariance matrix P, enabling prediction of evolutionary change across multiple traits.

formula-notes:formula_13.24c:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the response to selection in trait 1 (R₁) as a function of the selection differentials S₁ and S₂, the genetic and phenotypic variances/covariances (G₁₁, G₁₂, P₁₁, P₂₂, P₁₂), and the phenotypic correlation ρz. It expands the multivariate breeder's equation to show how correlated selection on trait 2 affects the response in trait 1.
formula-notes:formula_13.24c:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on the multivariate breeder's equation to illustrate that when traits are phenotypically and genetically correlated, the response in one trait depends on both selection differentials. This expression supports later arguments about the conditions under which the univariate breeder's equation is recovered (when P₁₂ = ρz = 0 and G₁₂ = 0).

formula-notes:formula_13.25c:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the observed selection differential S_i for trait i as the sum of the direct effect of selection on trait i (P_{ii} β_i) and the indirect effects from selection on other traits j (∑_{j≠i} P_{ij} β_j), where P_{ij} are genetic covariances and β_j are selection gradients.
formula-notes:formula_13.25c:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the multivariate breeder's equation section to decompose the selection differential into direct and correlated components, supporting the argument that selection on one trait can cause evolutionary change in correlated traits.

formula-notes:formula_13.25b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将相对适合度 w 表示为性状值向量 z 的线性函数，其中 β 是多元回归系数向量，a 是截距，e 是残差。
formula-notes:formula_13.25b:zh.inThisChapter: 此公式出现在多元育种者方程推导中，用于定义选择梯度 β，从而将自然选择与性状协方差矩阵 P 和选择差向量 S 联系起来（式 13.25a）。

formula-notes:formula_13.24c:zh.plainMeaning: 公式13.24c将性状1的响应R1分解为两部分：第一项是h1^2乘以校正后的选择差(S1 - S2 * P12/P22)再除以(1-ρz^2)，第二项包含G12（性状1和2的加性遗传协方差）与选择差和表型方差协方差的组合。
formula-notes:formula_13.24c:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在多元育种者方程推导中，从13.24a和13.24b代入得到，展示了当性状间存在表型和遗传相关时，单变量育种者方程不再成立，为后续讨论相关响应和间接选择奠定基础。

formula-notes:formula_13.26a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算多性状响应向量 R 等于遗传方差-协方差矩阵 G 乘以选择梯度向量 β，其中 R 的分量是各性状的响应，β 的分量是各性状的直接选择强度。
formula-notes:formula_13.26a:zh.inThisChapter: 在单世代响应（育种者方程）一节中，该公式将单性状的 R = σ_A^2 β 推广到多性状情形，为后续讨论遗传相关对响应的影响以及计算间接响应（如公式 13.26b-d）提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_13.26a:en.plainMeaning: The Lande equation computes the multivariate response to selection (vector R) as the product of the genetic variance-covariance matrix G and the selection gradient vector β. R contains the per-generation changes in trait means, G summarizes additive genetic variances and covariances, and β quantifies direct selection on each trait.
formula-notes:formula_13.26a:en.inThisChapter: This equation appears in the section on single-generation response to extend the univariate breeder's equation to multiple traits, showing how genetic correlations (via G) and selection (β) jointly determine evolutionary change. It supports later arguments about correlated responses and the role of G in constraining or facilitating adaptation.

formula-notes:formula_13.26c:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the response to selection in trait 1 (R1) as the sum of the direct genetic effect (G11β1) and the indirect genetic contribution from trait 2 (G12β2), where G11 and G12 are additive genetic variances/covariances and β1, β2 are selection gradients.
formula-notes:formula_13.26c:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the multivariate breeder's equation section to show how selection on multiple traits simultaneously affects each trait's response, supporting the decomposition of the multivariate response into direct and correlated components.

formula-notes:formula_13.25c:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将第 i 个性状的选择差 S_i 分解为两部分：直接选择效应 P_{ii} β_i（由该性状自身的加性遗传方差 P_{ii} 和选择梯度 β_i 贡献）和间接选择效应 ∑_{j≠i} P_{ij} β_j（由其他性状 j 与该性状的遗传协方差 P_{ij} 和对应选择梯度 β_j 贡献）。
formula-notes:formula_13.25c:zh.inThisChapter: 在多元育种者方程章节中，该公式由 S = Pβ 展开得到，明确展示了选择差 S_i 如何受所有性状选择梯度的联合影响，为后续理解相关选择响应和间接选择提供了基础。

formula-notes:formula_13.27a:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the response to selection (R) as the product of the additive genetic variance (σ_A^2) and the selection gradient (∂ln W̄/∂μ), which measures the sensitivity of mean fitness to changes in the mean phenotype μ.
formula-notes:formula_13.27a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the multivariate breeder's equation section to express the univariate response to selection in terms of the selection gradient, linking quantitative genetics to fitness landscapes and supporting the multivariate extension in Equations 13.27b and 13.27c.

formula-notes:formula_13.26b:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the response vector R (R1, R2) for two traits as the product of the genetic variance-covariance matrix G and the selection gradient vector β. G contains additive genetic variances (G11, G22) and covariance (G12), while β contains selection gradients (β1, β2).
formula-notes:formula_13.26b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the multivariate breeder's equation section to extend the univariate breeder's equation (13.8c) to multiple traits, showing how genetic correlations (G12) cause indirect selection responses. It simplifies the general expression (13.24c) by explicitly writing out the matrix multiplication, supporting later analysis of correlated trait evolution.

formula-notes:formula_13.26c:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算第一个性状（性状1）对选择的响应R₁，它等于加性遗传方差G₁₁乘以选择梯度β₁加上加性遗传协方差G₁₂乘以第二个性状的选择梯度β₂。
formula-notes:formula_13.26c:zh.inThisChapter: 此公式是多元育种者方程（13.26b）展开后的第一个分量表达式，将矩阵乘法结果显式写出，为后续理解性状间遗传协方差如何影响相关响应奠定基础。

formula-notes:formula_13.27c:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the response to selection vector R as the product of the genetic covariance matrix G and the selection gradient vector ∂lnW̄/∂μ, where μ is the vector of trait means and W̄ is mean fitness.
formula-notes:formula_13.27c:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the multivariate breeder's equation section to show how the Lande equation (13.27a) can be expressed in gradient form, linking G to the directional selection gradient for multiple traits.

formula-notes:formula_13.26d:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算第i个性状对多性状选择的响应R_i，等于其自身加性遗传方差G_ii乘以选择梯度β_i，再加上与其他性状j的加性遗传协方差G_ij乘以对应选择梯度β_j的总和。
formula-notes:formula_13.26d:zh.inThisChapter: 在多元育种者方程章节中，该公式将单性状响应推广到多性状，说明即使性状间表型相关，若遗传不相关（G_ij=0），选择其他性状不会影响第i个性状的响应，为后续讨论遗传相关对间接选择的影响奠定基础。

formula-notes:formula_13.27b:zh.plainMeaning: 公式 (13.27b) 定义选择梯度向量 β，其每个分量 β_i 是平均适应度自然对数 ln(¯W) 对第 i 个性状均值 μ_i 的偏导数，衡量了改变该性状均值对对数平均适应度的影响。
formula-notes:formula_13.27b:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在多元育种者方程章节，将选择梯度 β 与平均适应度 ¯W 的梯度联系起来，为后续推导 Lande 方程 Δμ = Gβ 提供核心定义，其中 β 作为选择的方向和强度。

formula-notes:formula_13.26b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将两个性状的响应向量 R 表示为遗传协方差矩阵 G 与选择梯度向量 β 的矩阵乘积，其中 R₁ 和 R₂ 分别是性状 1 和 2 的响应，G₁₁、G₂₂ 是加性遗传方差，G₁₂ 是遗传协方差，β₁、β₂ 是选择梯度。
formula-notes:formula_13.26b:zh.inThisChapter: 在多元育种者方程（13.26a）的基础上，公式（13.26b）显式写出两性状情形下的矩阵乘法，为后续推导出简化的响应表达式（13.26c 和 13.26d）提供直接代数形式，避免了（13.24c）的复杂展开。

formula-notes:formula_13.27b:en.plainMeaning: This formula defines the selection gradient vector β, where each element β_i = ∂ ln W̄ / ∂ μ_i measures the change in log mean fitness resulting from a change in the mean of trait i. It connects the vector of selection gradients to the partial derivatives of log mean fitness with respect to trait means.
formula-notes:formula_13.27b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the multivariate breeder's equation section to formalize the selection gradient as the driving force for evolutionary change in multiple traits, supporting the Lande equation (13.27c) that describes the response to selection.

formula-notes:formula_13.26d:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the response to selection for trait i (R_i) as the sum of the direct effect of selection on that trait (G_{ii}β_i) and the indirect effects from selection on other correlated traits (sum of G_{ij}β_j for j≠i). Key symbols: R_i = response in trait i, G_{ii} = additive genetic variance of trait i, β_i = selection gradient on trait i, G_{ij} = additive genetic covariance between traits i and j, β_j = selection gradient on trait j.
formula-notes:formula_13.26d:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on the multivariate breeder's equation to show how genetic correlations (G_{ij}) cause selection on one trait to affect the response of others, supporting the argument that even if traits are phenotypically correlated, genetic uncorrelatedness (G_{ij}=0) makes responses independent.

formula-notes:formula_13.27a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算响应R，等于加性遗传方差σ_A^2乘以平均适应度ln W对平均性状μ的偏导数（即选择梯度β），将选择差转化为遗传响应。
formula-notes:formula_13.27a:zh.inThisChapter: 本节推导多元育种者方程，此式是单变量版本，为后续引入选择梯度β和遗传方差矩阵G铺垫，最终得到多元形式R=Gβ。

formula-notes:formula_13.28a:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the additive genetic variance in relative fitness w that is accounted for by selection on a vector of traits z. σ_A(z^T, w) is the covariance between the breeding values of z and w, G is the additive genetic covariance matrix of z, and σ_A(z, w) is the covariance between the breeding values of z and w (as a column vector).
formula-notes:formula_13.28a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on the multivariate breeder's equation to quantify the amount of selection β on z, and it supports later arguments by linking selection response to additive genetic variance in fitness, as per Robertson's secondary theorem (Equation 6.24a).

formula-notes:formula_13.28b:en.plainMeaning: This identity shows that the quadratic form (Gβ)ᵀG⁻¹(Gβ) simplifies to βᵀGβ, where G is the genetic covariance matrix and β is the selection gradient vector.
formula-notes:formula_13.28b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the derivation of the multivariate breeder's equation to relate the response to selection (R = Gβ) to the selection gradient, supporting the calculation of the selection differential or the genetic variance of fitness.

formula-notes:formula_13.27c:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算响应向量 R 等于遗传协方差矩阵 G 乘以对数平均适应度对均值向量 μ 的梯度（∂lnW̄/∂μ），即每个性状的响应是其遗传方差-协方差与选择梯度的加权和。
formula-notes:formula_13.27c:zh.inThisChapter: 在本节中，公式 (13.27c) 将 Lande 方程从单性状推广到多性状，用矩阵形式统一描述多个性状对选择的联合响应，为后续分析多性状进化动态提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_13.28a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算由性状向量z上的选择所解释的相对适应度w的加性方差，其中σ_A(z^T,w)是z的育种值与w的育种值之间的协方差向量，G是z的加性遗传方差-协方差矩阵，σ_A(z,w)是协方差向量的转置。
formula-notes:formula_13.28a:zh.inThisChapter: 本章推导多元育种者方程，该公式将选择梯度β与加性遗传方差联系起来，为后续通过G^{-1}σ_A(z,w)得到β（公式13.28b）提供直接铺垫。

formula-notes:formula_13.28b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式表明，将选择梯度β乘以遗传协方差矩阵G得到响应向量Gβ后，再计算其以G^{-1}为权重的二次型，结果等于β^T G β，即选择梯度β在G度量下的二次型。
formula-notes:formula_13.28b:zh.inThisChapter: 在多元育种者方程章节中，该公式用于简化选择响应与选择梯度之间的关系，为后续推导选择梯度与响应之间的等价形式（如公式13.28c）提供代数基础。

formula-notes:formula_13.10b:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the expected change in the mean of a response trait y after one generation of selection on an index z, expressed as the product of the selection differential S_z (or selection intensity ı_z) and the regression coefficient of y on z. Key symbols: R_y = response in y, μ_y = initial mean, μ_y** = offspring mean, σ(z_x, y_o) = covariance between index z and offspring y, σ²(z) = variance of z, μ_z* = mean of z after selection, μ_z = initial mean of z, S_z = selection differential, ı_z = standardized selection intensity.
formula-notes:formula_13.10b:en.inThisChapter: This formula appears in the section expanding the basic breeder's equation to multivariate selection, showing how the response in a correlated trait depends on the selection intensity and the covariance structure. It supports later arguments about indirect selection and the use of selection indices.

formula-notes:formula_13.28c:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算的是在剔除性状向量z的加性遗传效应后，剩余的那部分适应度加性遗传方差，其中σ_A^2(w)是适应度的总加性遗传方差，β^T G β是通过性状z解释的加性遗传方差部分。
formula-notes:formula_13.28c:zh.inThisChapter: 本节推导多元选择响应时，需要量化性状z对适应度加性方差的贡献，该公式作为中间结果，用于后续计算选择梯度β和遗传协方差矩阵G对适应度方差分解的作用。

formula-notes:formula_13.29:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the expected change in mean fitness (Δw̄) due to selection on multiple traits, where β is the vector of selection gradients, Δz is the response vector, R is the response vector from the multivariate breeder's equation, and G is the genetic covariance matrix. The expression βᵀGβ equals the additive genetic variance in fitness.
formula-notes:formula_13.29:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the multivariate breeder's equation section to show that the change in mean fitness equals the additive variance in fitness associated with the traits, thereby recovering Fisher's fundamental theorem of natural selection in a multivariate context.

formula-notes:formula_14.2b:zh.plainMeaning: 公式 (14.2b) 表示标准正态随机变量 U 大于分位数 x_{[1-p]} 的概率等于 p，其中 x_{[1-p]} 是上侧概率为 p 的分位数。
formula-notes:formula_14.2b:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式与 (14.2a) 共同定义 probit 变换，为后续截断选择（truncation selection）中计算截断点提供概率基础。

formula-notes:formula_14.2a:en.plainMeaning: This formula defines the probit transformation x_{[p]} as the quantile of a standard normal distribution U such that the cumulative probability up to that quantile equals p.
formula-notes:formula_14.2a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the truncation selection section to provide the threshold value needed to compute the selection intensity and the mean of the selected population, supporting the derivation of the selection differential.

formula-notes:formula_14.2a:zh.plainMeaning: 公式 (14.2a) 定义 x_{[p]} 为标准正态随机变量 U 的 p 分位数，即 U 小于等于 x_{[p]} 的概率恰好为 p。
formula-notes:formula_14.2a:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在截断选择（TRUNCATION SELECTION）部分，用于将选择比例 p 转换为标准正态分位数 x_{[p]}，为后续推导截断点与选择强度之间的关系提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_13.28c:en.plainMeaning: This expression gives the residual additive genetic variance in fitness after accounting for the additive genetic variance explained by the traits z, where σ_A^2(w) is the total additive genetic variance in fitness, β is the vector of selection gradients, and G is the additive genetic covariance matrix of z.
formula-notes:formula_13.28c:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the multivariate breeder's equation section to quantify how much additive variance in fitness remains unexplained by the traits, supporting the interpretation of the selection gradient β as the partial regression of fitness on traits after removing genetic correlations.

formula-notes:formula_14.2b:en.plainMeaning: This formula expresses that the probability a standard normal variable U exceeds the probit of (1-p) equals p, connecting the upper tail probability to the probit transformation.
formula-notes:formula_14.2b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the truncation selection section to define the threshold for truncation from above, supporting the derivation of selection intensity and expected genetic gain.

formula-notes:formula_14.1:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the expected selection differential S, which is the mean of the selected individuals minus the population mean, under truncation selection. Here, φ is the standard normal density, T is the truncation threshold, μ and σ are the population mean and standard deviation, and p is the proportion selected.
formula-notes:formula_14.1:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the Truncation Selection section to quantify the genetic gain from selecting individuals above a threshold, supporting later arguments on response to selection and breeding value prediction.

formula-notes:formula_14.3a:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the standardized selection intensity (i-bar) as the ratio of the selection differential S to the phenotypic standard deviation σ, which equals the ordinate of the standard normal distribution at the truncation point x_{[1-p]} divided by the selected proportion p.
formula-notes:formula_14.3a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the Truncation Selection section to quantify the expected selection intensity under truncation selection, supporting later derivations of the response to selection and the breeder's equation.

formula-notes:formula_14.3b:en.plainMeaning: This formula approximates the standardized selection differential (mean of the selected proportion) as a function of the proportion p selected, using a logarithmic transformation. The symbols are: ī (standardized selection differential) and p (proportion selected).
formula-notes:formula_14.3b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the TRUNCATION SELECTION section to provide a practical approximation for ī based on p, supporting later calculations of selection response or genetic gain without needing numerical integration.

formula-notes:formula_13.29:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算了由性状选择响应引起的平均适应度变化Δw̄，它等于选择梯度βᵀ与响应向量Δz的乘积，而Δz又等于遗传协方差矩阵G与选择梯度β的乘积，因此Δw̄ = βᵀGβ。
formula-notes:formula_13.29:zh.inThisChapter: 在本节中，该公式将多元育种者方程Δz̄ = Gβ与适应度变化联系起来，为后续推导Fisher基本定理（即平均适应度变化等于适应度的加性方差）提供了直接代数依据。

formula-notes:formula_14.1:zh.plainMeaning: 公式计算截断选择下的期望选择差S，其中φ是标准正态密度函数在截断点(T-μ)/σ处的值，σ是标准差，p是保留比例（即性状值≥T的概率）。
formula-notes:formula_14.1:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在截断选择章节，用于量化对群体进行截断选择后，被选择个体的平均表型值相对于原群体均值的预期增量，为后续推导选择响应和遗传进展提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_14.3b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式近似计算截断选择下选择强度 ī 与保留比例 p 的关系，其中 ī 是标准化选择强度，p 是保留比例，ln(1/p - 1) 是 logit 变换。
formula-notes:formula_14.3b:zh.inThisChapter: 本节讨论截断选择，公式 14.3b 作为公式 14.3a 的近似，简化了 ī 与 p 的计算，为后续在 p 值范围内应用提供便捷表达式。

formula-notes:formula_14.3a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算标准化选择强度（选择差除以标准差），它等于截断点处标准正态概率密度函数值 φ(x_{[1-p]}) 除以被选中的比例 p。
formula-notes:formula_14.3a:zh.inThisChapter: 在截断选择章节中，该公式将选择强度 ī 直接表示为截断点 x_{[1-p]} 的函数，为后续推导不同选择比例下的预期选择强度（如公式 14.3b）提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_14.4a:en.plainMeaning: This formula approximates the expected selection intensity (standardized selection differential) for truncation selection when only N individuals are selected from a sample of M, using the truncation point y_p (upper p fraction) and the phenotypic density φ(y).
formula-notes:formula_14.4a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the Truncation Selection section to correct the infinite-population selection intensity for finite sample size, supporting later derivations of expected genetic gain under realistic breeding scenarios.

formula-notes:formula_14.4a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式近似计算从N个个体中选出前M个（截断选择）后，这M个个体标准化表型均值的期望E[ī_{(N,M)}]；它等于截断点y_p以上的条件均值μ_{y_p}减去一个修正项，修正项依赖于选择比例p、样本量N和M以及截断点处的概率密度φ(y_p)。
formula-notes:formula_14.4a:zh.inThisChapter: 本章讨论截断选择（Truncation Selection），公式(14.4a)给出了有限样本下选择强度的Burrows近似，为后续推导(14.4b)和(14.4c)中更精确的修正项或方差公式提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_14.4b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算截断选择下期望标准选择差E[ī_{(N,M)}]的近似值，它等于完整选择下的期望标准选择差ī减去一个修正项，修正项由截断比例p=N/M和样本量M决定。
formula-notes:formula_14.4b:zh.inThisChapter: 本节讨论有限M导致的截断选择偏差，公式(14.4b)给出了该偏差的近似表达式，为后续比较不同选择方法的效果提供定量基础。

formula-notes:formula_14.4c:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes an adjusted selection proportion p̃ used in Equation 14.3a, where N is the number selected and M is the population size, to improve accuracy for small samples.
formula-notes:formula_14.4c:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the Truncation Selection section to provide a more accurate approximation for the selection intensity when N is small, supporting the derivation of expected selection response under normality.

formula-notes:formula_14.4c:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算一个修正后的选择比例p̃，其中N是选择个体数，M是候选个体数，p̃用于替代式(14.3a)中的p，以改进截断选择下响应预测的准确性。
formula-notes:formula_14.4c:zh.inThisChapter: 本章讨论截断选择（Truncation Selection），式(14.4c)作为Bulmer (1980)提出的近似公式，用于修正选择比例，从而更精确地预测选择响应，为后续推导选择响应公式提供更准确的p值。

formula-notes:formula_14.4b:en.plainMeaning: This formula gives the expected value of the truncated selection differential (mean of the top N out of M selected individuals) as approximately the infinite-population selection differential minus a bias correction term that depends on N, M, and the selection intensity. Key symbols: E[ī_{(N,M)}] = expected truncated mean, ī = infinite-population selection differential, N = number selected, M = number sampled, p = N/M = proportion selected.
formula-notes:formula_14.4b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the Truncation Selection section to quantify the bias when selection is based on a finite sample, correcting the infinite-population approximation. This supports later arguments about the accuracy of selection response predictions and the need for adjustments in small breeding populations.

formula-notes:formula_14.8a:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the mean phenotype after selection (μ_t^*) as a weighted average of the mean liability among individuals not displaying the trait (z<0) and those displaying it (z≥0), with weights (1-p_t) and p_t respectively.
formula-notes:formula_14.8a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the binary character section to decompose the selected mean into contributions from the two discrete groups, setting up the derivation of the selection differential in Equation 14.8b.

formula-notes:formula_14.5:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the expected selection intensity for truncation selection when sampling M individuals from families of size n, adjusting for the intraclass correlation τ among family members. Key symbols: E[ī_(N,M)] is the expected intensity, ī is the intensity for infinite population, p is the proportion selected, τ is intraclass correlation, n is family size, M is total sampled individuals.
formula-notes:formula_14.5:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the Truncation Selection section to extend Burrows's correction (Equation 14.4b) to family-structured samples, supporting later discussion of family selection in Chapter 21.

formula-notes:formula_14.6:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the mean liability μ_t of the threshold trait as the negative of the probit transformation of the complement of the trait frequency q_t, where x_{[1-q_t]} is the probit (inverse normal CDF) of 1 - q_t.
formula-notes:formula_14.6:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on binary characters to relate the population mean liability to the observed trait frequency, supporting the derivation of response to selection in threshold traits.

formula-notes:formula_14.5:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算在截断选择中，当从M个家系（每个家系n个个体）抽样时，期望选择强度的近似值E[ī_(N,M)]，它等于总体选择强度ī减去一个修正项，修正项依赖于截断点p、家系内相关系数τ、家系数M和家系大小n。
formula-notes:formula_14.5:zh.inThisChapter: 此公式出现在截断选择章节，是对Burrows校正（公式14.4b）的推广，考虑了家系内相关τ，为第21章中更详细的家族选择分析提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_14.8a:zh.plainMeaning: 公式 (14.8a) 计算下一代群体中个体潜在性状z的均值μ_t^*，它等于未表现性状的个体（z<0）的条件期望乘以未表现个体比例(1-p_t)，加上表现性状的个体（z≥0）的条件期望乘以表现个体比例p_t。
formula-notes:formula_14.8a:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在离散性状（二元性状）响应部分，将连续潜在变量z的均值更新与表现型比例p_t联系起来，为后续推导μ_t^*与p_t之间的递推关系（如公式14.8b）提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_14.9:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the selection differential S_t as the difference between the mean after selection (μ_t^*) and before selection (μ_t), expressed in terms of the unit normal density φ, the proportion selected q_t, and the proportion of individuals displaying the trait p_t.
formula-notes:formula_14.9:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on binary character response to show how selection on a discrete trait changes the mean of the underlying liability, supporting later arguments about the relationship between selection intensity and trait frequency.

formula-notes:formula_14.7:zh.plainMeaning: 公式(14.7)将下一世代性状频率q_{t+1}表示为标准正态变量U超过阈值x_{[1-q_t]}减去遗传力h²与选择差S_t乘积的概率，其中x_{[1-q_t]}是当前频率q_t对应的正态分位数。
formula-notes:formula_14.7:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在离散性状响应选择的小节中，它利用前一公式(14.6)中μ_t与x_{[1-q_t]}的关系，将响应表达为可直接计算的概率形式，为后续推导选择响应与遗传力、选择强度的关系奠定基础。

formula-notes:formula_14.8b:zh.plainMeaning: 公式 (14.8b) 给出了在给定当前均值 μ_t 下，截断正态分布的条件期望：当 z ≥ 0 时，期望为 μ_t 加上 φ(μ_t)/q_t；当 z < 0 时，期望为 μ_t 减去 φ(μ_t)/(1-q_t)。其中 φ(μ_t) 是标准正态密度函数在 μ_t 处的值，q_t 是 z ≥ 0 的概率。
formula-notes:formula_14.8b:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在离散性状（二元性状）响应选择的章节中，用于计算选择后的均值变化。它由 LW 方程 2.14 推导而来，并直接代入公式 (14.8a) 以得到选择响应 S_t 的表达式，从而将响应与选择强度联系起来。

formula-notes:formula_14.6:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将阈值 μ_t 定义为标准正态分布中右侧尾部概率为 q_t 时的分位数的负值，即 μ_t = -x_{[1-q_t]}，其中 x_{[1-q_t]} 是概率 1-q_t 对应的 probit 变换值。
formula-notes:formula_14.6:zh.inThisChapter: 在本节关于离散性状（二元性状）的响应中，该公式用于将群体中表现该性状的比例 q_t 与潜在连续变量（如 liability）的阈值 μ_t 联系起来，为后续推导选择响应和遗传力估计提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_14.8b:en.plainMeaning: These formulas compute the conditional expectation of a standard normal variable z given that it is non-negative (first) or negative (second), when the mean is μ_t. q_t is the probability that z ≥ 0, and φ is the standard normal density.
formula-notes:formula_14.8b:en.inThisChapter: They appear in the binary character response model to derive the selection differential S_t (Equation 14.8a) by providing the necessary conditional expectations of the liability z.
