formula-notes:formula_14.10a:en.plainMeaning: The logistic function ℓ(z) maps any real number z to a probability between 0 and 1, with ℓ(z) ≈ 0 for z ≪ -1, ℓ(z) ≈ 1 for z ≫ 1, and ℓ(0) = 0.5.
formula-notes:formula_14.10a:en.inThisChapter: It appears here to model the probability of a binary trait (e.g., presence/absence) as a smooth function of an underlying continuous variable z, and it supports the later introduction of a more general version with parameters α and m in Equation 14.10b.

formula-notes:formula_14.7:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the frequency of a binary trait in the next generation, q_{t+1}, as the probability that a standard normal variable U exceeds a threshold determined by the current frequency q_t, heritability h^2, and selection differential S_t.
formula-notes:formula_14.7:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on response in discrete traits to show how the threshold model translates selection on a continuous liability into change in trait frequency, supporting the derivation of the response to selection for binary characters.

formula-notes:formula_14.10a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式定义逻辑函数 ℓ(z)，将任意实数 z 映射到 (0,1) 区间，具体计算为 exp(z) 除以 1+exp(z)，或等价为 1 除以 1+exp(-z)。
formula-notes:formula_14.10a:zh.inThisChapter: 在离散性状（二元字符）的响应模型中，需要将连续潜变量 z 转换为概率 p(z)，逻辑函数因其单调递增、S 形且值域在 0 到 1 之间的特性被引入，为后续引入更一般的带参数 α 和 m 的逻辑函数（公式 14.10b）以及建立概率模型奠定基础。

formula-notes:formula_14.11a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算了逻辑分布的概率密度函数 φ(x, α, m) 从负无穷到 z 的积分，结果等于逻辑分布的累积分布函数，其中 α 控制陡峭度，m 是中位数。
formula-notes:formula_14.11a:zh.inThisChapter: 在本章关于离散性状（二元性状）的响应分析中，该公式将阈值 T 的分布假设为逻辑分布，为后续推导二元性状的响应概率（如公式 14.11b 和 14.11c）提供了基础。

formula-notes:formula_14.9:zh.plainMeaning: 公式(14.9)计算选择响应S_t，即选择后均值μ_t^*与选择前均值μ_t之差，它等于标准正态密度函数φ(μ_t)除以选择比例q_t，再乘以(p_t - q_t)/(1 - q_t)；其中p_t是选择后具有该性状的个体比例，q_t是选择前具有该性状的个体比例。
formula-notes:formula_14.9:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式由公式(14.8a)和(14.8b)代入推导而来，用于量化离散性状（二元性状）的选择响应，为后续讨论最大选择（p_t=1）时S_t的简化形式以及选择方向（p_t>q_t时S_t>0）提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_14.10b:zh.plainMeaning: 公式 (14.10b) 将逻辑函数 ℓ(z) 推广为 ℓ[α(z−m)]，其中参数 m 使函数在 z=m 处取值为 0.5，参数 α 控制从低概率到高概率过渡的陡峭程度。
formula-notes:formula_14.10b:zh.inThisChapter: 在本节“离散性状的响应”中，该公式用于建模二元性状（如存活/死亡）的概率随潜在连续变量 z 变化的平滑阈值模型，为后续推导遗传力或选择响应提供灵活的链接函数形式。

formula-notes:formula_14.11b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算逻辑斯蒂回归模型中响应变量为1的概率密度函数φ(x,α,m)，其中α控制曲线陡峭度，m是拐点位置，z是线性预测值。
formula-notes:formula_14.11b:zh.inThisChapter: 它出现在对累积分布函数（14.11a）求导之后，为后续推导似然函数和参数估计提供概率密度表达式。

formula-notes:formula_14.10b:en.plainMeaning: This logistic function computes the probability of a binary outcome (e.g., trait presence) as a function of a continuous variable z, with a midpoint m and steepness α. ℓ is the probability, z is the underlying variable, m shifts the curve horizontally, and α controls the abruptness of the transition.
formula-notes:formula_14.10b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on binary character response to generalize the standard logistic function (14.10a) by adding a midpoint parameter m and a scaling factor α, allowing the model to fit data with different thresholds and transition steepness.

formula-notes:formula_14.11a:en.plainMeaning: This formula gives the cumulative distribution function (CDF) of the logistic distribution, where φ(x, α, m) is the logistic density, α controls the scale, m is the location (mean), and the integral from -∞ to z yields the logistic function, which is the probability that a random variable T is less than or equal to z.
formula-notes:formula_14.11a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on binary characters to define the probability that a random threshold T is less than or equal to a given value z, which is used to model the probability of observing a particular discrete trait (e.g., character state) as a function of an underlying continuous liability.

formula-notes:formula_14.12:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式用逻辑斯蒂分布近似标准正态分布U的累积分布函数，其中α=π/√3使得逻辑斯蒂分布的方差为1（与标准正态一致）。
formula-notes:formula_14.12:zh.inThisChapter: 在离散性状（二元性状）章节中，此公式说明逻辑斯蒂分布可近似正态分布，为后续使用逻辑斯蒂回归（如阈值模型）提供理论依据。

formula-notes:formula_14.11c:en.plainMeaning: This formula gives the mean μ = m, variance σ² = (1/3)(π/α)², and third central moment μ₃ = 0 for a distribution (likely logistic) with location m and scale α.
formula-notes:formula_14.11c:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on binary characters to provide moments of the underlying latent distribution, supporting the later argument that the logistic and normal distributions are similar (as shown in Figure 14.7).

formula-notes:formula_14.11b:en.plainMeaning: This formula gives the probability density function φ(x, α, m) of a logistic distribution, where α is a scale parameter and m is the location parameter (the inflection point).
formula-notes:formula_14.11b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on binary characters to derive the probability of a response as a smooth function of an underlying continuous trait, supporting the logistic regression model for discrete traits.

formula-notes:formula_14.12:en.plainMeaning: This formula approximates the cumulative distribution function of a standard normal variable U by a logistic function with scale parameter α = π/√3, matching the variance to 1.
formula-notes:formula_14.12:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on binary character response to show that the normal and logistic distributions are nearly identical, justifying the use of the logistic distribution (with simpler mathematics) in threshold models for discrete traits.

formula-notes:formula_14.13c:en.plainMeaning: This formula expresses the observed phenotype y_i of individual i as the sum of the population mean μ, fixed effects from covariates (∑β_k x_{k,i}), a random additive genetic effect A_i, and a normally distributed residual e_i.
formula-notes:formula_14.13c:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on binary characters to set up the linear model underlying the threshold model, where the observed binary response is assumed to arise from a latent continuous liability y_i, and this equation supports later estimation of genetic parameters via mixed model methodology.

formula-notes:formula_14.13a:en.plainMeaning: This formula expresses the expected phenotype (y_i) of individual i as the sum of an overall mean (μ), fixed effects of covariates (Σβ_k x_{k,i}), and the individual's additive genetic value (A_i).
formula-notes:formula_14.13a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the binary character section to set up the linear mixed model framework, which will be extended to threshold models (Equation 14.13b) and liability models (Equation 14.13c) for discrete traits.

formula-notes:formula_14.13b:zh.plainMeaning: 公式 y_i = μ_i + e_i 将个体 i 的观测表型值 y_i 分解为两部分：其期望值 μ_i（由固定效应和协变量决定）和随机残差 e_i（均值为零的正态分布）。
formula-notes:formula_14.13b:zh.inThisChapter: 在离散性状（二元性状）的响应分析中，该公式为后续建立阈值模型（如公式 14.13c）提供基础，通过将连续潜变量 y_i 与离散表型关联，从而推导性状的遗传力等参数。

formula-notes:formula_14.14b:en.plainMeaning: This formula defines the conditional expectation of the observed trait y given the latent variable z as a monotonic function g(z). Here, y is the discrete binary trait, z is the underlying continuous liability, and g is the link function (e.g., probit or logit).
formula-notes:formula_14.14b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on binary characters to specify how the latent liability (from Equation 14.14a) is mapped to the expected binary outcome, supporting the generalized linear model framework used for discrete traits.

formula-notes:formula_14.13b:en.plainMeaning: This formula expresses the observed phenotype y_i of individual i as the sum of its expected value μ_i (the liability based on covariates) and a normally distributed residual e_i with mean zero, implying y_i is also normally distributed.
formula-notes:formula_14.13b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on binary characters to model the underlying continuous liability, which is then thresholded to produce discrete binary observations, supporting the threshold model analysis.

formula-notes:formula_14.15a:en.plainMeaning: The logit function computes the natural logarithm of the odds ratio, where p is the probability of a binary trait being present. It maps a probability p (0 to 1) to a real number z.
formula-notes:formula_14.15a:en.inThisChapter: This formula appears in the section on binary characters to provide the link function that linearizes the logistic regression model, enabling the use of linear predictors for discrete trait evolution.

formula-notes:formula_14.14a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将个体i的潜在连续变量（易感性）z_i分解为总体均值μ、固定效应（∑β_k x_{k,i}）、加性遗传效应A_i和环境效应E_i之和，是阈值模型中潜在变量的线性结构。
formula-notes:formula_14.14a:zh.inThisChapter: 本章讨论离散性状（如二分类性状）的遗传分析，该公式为后续通过阈值模型将潜在连续变量映射到离散表型（公式14.14b）提供了线性基础，并引出遗传方差组分估计。

formula-notes:formula_14.11c:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式给出了逻辑分布的前三阶矩：均值μ等于位置参数m，方差σ²等于(π/α)²/3，三阶中心矩μ₃等于0（分布对称）。
formula-notes:formula_14.11c:zh.inThisChapter: 在离散性状（二元性状）响应分析的章节中，此公式为后续将逻辑分布与正态分布进行对比（如累积分布函数相似性）提供了矩的数值依据，并支撑了用逻辑分布近似正态分布的计算。

formula-notes:formula_14.14a:en.plainMeaning: This formula defines the liability z_i for individual i as a linear combination of an overall mean μ, fixed effects from covariates β_k x_{k,i}, a random additive genetic (breeding) value A_i, and a random environmental deviation E_i.
formula-notes:formula_14.14a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on binary characters to set up the threshold model, where liability is assumed to be normally distributed and then mapped to a discrete trait via a link function g, supporting later estimation of heritability on the liability scale.

formula-notes:formula_14.14c:en.plainMeaning: This formula expresses the linear predictor z (the underlying liability) as the inverse link function g^{-1} of the conditional expectation of the observed binary trait y given z. The symbols are: g^{-1} inverse link function, E[y|z] expected value of y given z, z linear predictor, μ intercept, β_k fixed effects, x_{k,i} covariates, A_i additive genetic effect, E_i residual.
formula-notes:formula_14.14c:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on binary characters to show how the observed binary response is linked to the underlying linear model via a link function, supporting the use of generalized linear models for discrete traits.

formula-notes:formula_14.13c:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将个体i的表型值yi分解为群体均值μ、固定效应（∑βk xk,i）、加性遗传效应Ai和残差ei之和，其中Ai和ei均假设服从正态分布。
formula-notes:formula_14.13c:zh.inThisChapter: 在本节关于离散性状（二元性状）的响应分析中，该公式将连续性状的线性模型扩展至二元性状的潜在尺度，为后续通过阈值模型（如probit模型）估计遗传参数和预测育种值奠定基础。

formula-notes:formula_14.14b:zh.plainMeaning: 公式(14.14b)定义了给定潜在变量z时表型y的条件期望等于g(z)，其中g是将潜在变量z映射到表型y的单调函数。
formula-notes:formula_14.14b:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在离散性状（二元性状）的响应部分，用于连接潜在变量z与观测表型y，为后续通过逆函数g^{-1}建立线性模型(14.14c)提供桥梁。

formula-notes:formula_14.13a:zh.plainMeaning: 公式 (14.13a) 将个体 i 的表型期望值 μ_i 分解为总体均值 μ、固定效应 ∑β_k x_{k,i} 和加性遗传效应 A_i 之和，其中 β_k 是第 k 个固定效应的回归系数，x_{k,i} 是相应的协变量。
formula-notes:formula_14.13a:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式在“离散性状响应：二元性状”章节中引入，为后续将线性混合模型推广到非正态分布性状（如二元性状）奠定基础，并直接引出公式 (14.13b) 和 (14.13c) 中连接函数和方差结构的定义。

formula-notes:formula_14.14c:zh.plainMeaning: 公式(14.14c)表示连接函数g的逆函数将条件期望E[y|z]映射回线性预测值z，而z等于总体均值μ加上固定效应∑β_k x_{k,i}、加性遗传效应A_i和残差E_i之和。
formula-notes:formula_14.14c:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在离散性状（二元性状）的响应部分，用于建立线性预测值z与观测性状y之间的非线性链接，为后续使用广义线性模型（如logit或probit）分析二元性状提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_14.15a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将概率 p 转换为对数几率（log-odds），即 ln(p/(1-p))，其中 p 是性状存在的概率，1-p 是性状不存在的概率。
formula-notes:formula_14.15a:zh.inThisChapter: 本章讨论离散性状（二元性状）的响应，该公式作为逻辑函数的逆（链接函数），将概率 p 映射到线性预测值 z，为后续建立广义线性模型（如 logistic 回归）提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_14.16:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the probability that a Poisson-distributed random variable y equals a nonnegative integer k, given the mean λ (λ > 0).
formula-notes:formula_14.16:en.inThisChapter: It appears here to model discrete trait values (e.g., counts) in the context of truncation and threshold selection, where the Poisson distribution provides a natural extension from binary traits.

formula-notes:formula_14.15b:en.plainMeaning: This formula expresses the logit of the probability of a binary trait (p) as equal to the liability (z_i), which is decomposed into a population mean (μ), fixed effects of covariates (Σβ_k x_{k,i}), and random additive genetic (A_i) and environmental (E_i) components.
formula-notes:formula_14.15b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on binary characters to link the observed binary trait probability to the underlying liability scale via the logit link, enabling the application of linear mixed model methods for heritability estimation and prediction in discrete traits.

formula-notes:formula_14.16:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算在给定均值 λ 时，计数性状 y 恰好等于 k 的概率，其中 λ 是期望值，k 是非负整数。
formula-notes:formula_14.16:zh.inThisChapter: 本节讨论截断和阈值选择，该泊松分布公式为后续将计数性状与潜在阈值模型关联提供基础，类似于二元性状的处理方式。

formula-notes:formula_14.17a:en.plainMeaning: This formula maps an underlying liability value z (with additive effects from Equation 14.14a) to a positive mean λ via the exponential function, ensuring λ > 0 for all z, which is required for a Poisson expectation.
formula-notes:formula_14.17a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on truncation and threshold selection to provide a link function that transforms the unbounded liability z into a positive mean λ, supporting the generalized linear model framework for count data.

formula-notes:formula_14.19a:en.plainMeaning: This formula gives the moment-generating function (MGF) of a normally distributed random variable x with mean μ and variance σ², evaluated at t. The MGF is exp(μ t + (σ²/2) t²).
formula-notes:formula_14.19a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on truncation and threshold selection to provide the MGF needed for computing expectations of truncated normal variables, which are used later to derive the mean and variance of the truncated distribution.

formula-notes:formula_14.19b:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the expected value of e^x when x is normally distributed with mean 0 and variance σ², showing it equals exp(σ²/2).
formula-notes:formula_14.19b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on truncation and threshold selection to quantify the effect of a Gaussian distribution's variance on the mean of exponentiated values, supporting later arguments about moment behavior under truncation.

formula-notes:formula_14.18:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the expected value of the trait y under a log-linear model, showing that it factors into the product of exp(μ) and the expectations of exp(A) and exp(e), where μ is a constant, A is an additive genetic effect, and e is an environmental deviation.
formula-notes:formula_14.18:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on truncation and threshold selection to derive the mean trait after selection, supporting later calculations of the selection response by expressing the mean in terms of independent components.

formula-notes:formula_14.15b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将二元性状的患病概率p通过logit变换转换为潜在变量z_i，并将其分解为总体均值μ、固定效应∑β_k x_{k,i}、加性遗传效应A_i和环境效应E_i之和。
formula-notes:formula_14.15b:zh.inThisChapter: 在离散性状（二元性状）响应章节中，该公式将logit尺度上的概率与第14.15a式的阈值模型连接起来，为后续使用广义线性混合模型（GLMM）分析二元性状的遗传参数提供线性预测方程。

formula-notes:formula_14.17b:en.plainMeaning: This formula specifies the log-link function for a Poisson generalized linear model, where the log of the mean λ equals a linear predictor z composed of an intercept μ, covariates β_k x_{k,i}, a random effect A_i, and an error e_i.
formula-notes:formula_14.17b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on truncation and threshold selection to model the mean of a Poisson process after truncation, supporting later arguments about how covariates and random effects influence the rate of exceedances.

formula-notes:formula_14.19b:zh.plainMeaning: 公式计算当随机变量 x 服从均值为 0、方差为 σ² 的正态分布时，e^x 的期望值等于 exp(σ²/2)。
formula-notes:formula_14.19b:zh.inThisChapter: 本节讨论均值短期变化中的截断与阈值选择，该公式用于计算对数正态变量的期望，为后续推导阈值对极值分布的影响提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_14.17b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将泊松分布的均值参数λ取对数后，表示为线性预测项z，其中z由总体均值μ、协变量线性组合∑β_k x_{k,i}、随机效应A_i和误差项e_i相加构成。
formula-notes:formula_14.17b:zh.inThisChapter: 在讨论短期均值变化及截断阈值选择的章节中，此公式通过连接函数ln(λ)=z将泊松GLM的线性预测器与均值参数关联，为后续基于对数线性模型的阈值建模和参数估计提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_14.20a:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the expected mean trait value E[y] as the product of exp(μ) and exp((σ_A^2 + σ_e^2)/2), where μ is the mean of the underlying liability, σ_A^2 is additive genetic variance, σ_e^2 is environmental variance, and σ_z^2 = σ_A^2 + σ_e^2 is the total phenotypic variance of the liability.
formula-notes:formula_14.20a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on truncation and threshold selection to show that the expected mean of the observed trait depends on both the mean and variance of the liability, supporting the argument that selection on a threshold trait can change the mean via changes in liability variance.

formula-notes:formula_14.19a:zh.plainMeaning: 这个公式计算正态随机变量 x 的矩母函数，其中 μ 是均值，σ² 是方差，t 是参数，结果是指数函数 exp(μ t + (σ²/2) t)。
formula-notes:formula_14.19a:zh.inThisChapter: 在本节关于截断和阈值选择的短期均值变化中，该公式用于推导截断正态分布的矩，为后续计算条件期望（如公式 14.19b）提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_14.20b:zh.plainMeaning: 公式计算在给定育种值A的条件下，表型y的条件期望。它等于exp(μ+A)乘以exp(σ_e²/2)，其中μ是总体均值，A是育种值，σ_e²是环境方差。
formula-notes:formula_14.20b:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在讨论短期均值变化中关于截断和阈值选择的章节，它从公式14.20a出发，推导出条件期望的具体表达式，为后续计算选择响应和预测遗传进展提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_14.20a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算在截断选择下，表型值y的期望E[y]等于底层易感性的均值μ的指数乘以底层易感性总方差σ_z²一半的指数，其中σ_z²=σ_A²+σ_e²。
formula-notes:formula_14.20a:zh.inThisChapter: 本章讨论短期均值变化，该公式由公式14.18代入得到，说明截断选择后表型期望不仅依赖于μ，还依赖于方差σ_z²，为后续推导选择响应和阈值移动提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_14.20b:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the conditional expected value of y given breeding value A, showing it equals exp(μ+A) multiplied by exp(σ_e²/2), where μ is the population mean, A is the breeding value, and σ_e² is the environmental variance.
formula-notes:formula_14.20b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on truncation and threshold selection to derive the conditional mean after conditioning on breeding value, supporting later arguments about response to selection when only individuals with certain breeding values are selected.

formula-notes:formula_14.21:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the response to selection R on the phenotypic scale for a log-normal trait, where R is the difference between the mean of offspring (E[y_{t+1}]) and the mean of parents (E[y_t]), expressed as a function of the selection differential on the liability scale S and heritability h².
formula-notes:formula_14.21:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on truncation and threshold selection to show how selection on an underlying normal liability translates into a change in the mean of a log-normal trait, supporting the derivation of the response when the trait distribution is log-normal.

formula-notes:formula_14.21:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算选择响应R，即下一代均值E[y_{t+1}]与当代均值E[y_t]之差，通过将隐变量尺度上的选择差S乘以遗传力h²后指数化，再乘以当代均值E(y_t)得到。
formula-notes:formula_14.21:zh.inThisChapter: 在本节关于短时均值变化中，该公式将选择响应R与隐变量尺度上的选择差S和遗传力h²直接关联，为后续讨论截断选择和阈值选择对表型均值的影响提供了定量表达式。

formula-notes:formula_14.18:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算在log-linear模型下，表型值y（等于λ，即exp(z)）的期望。它将期望分解为常数项exp(μ)乘以遗传效应A的指数期望和环境效应e的指数期望的乘积，利用了μ是常数且A与e不相关（若二元正态则独立）的性质。
formula-notes:formula_14.18:zh.inThisChapter: 本章讨论短期均值变化（截断与阈值选择），此公式用于推导选择后群体均值，为后续计算选择响应（如R = h²S）提供基础，通过分解期望明确各成分贡献。

formula-notes:formula_15.1b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算选择响应R，它等于加性遗传方差贡献的h²S加上非加性遗传方差（σ²_AA/2, σ²_AAA/4等）和母体/父体环境协方差（σ(E_fa,E_o), σ(E_mo,E_o)）除以表型方差σ_z²再乘以选择差S的总和。
formula-notes:formula_15.1b:zh.inThisChapter: 此公式出现在讨论短期均值变化中永久与暂时响应的章节，通过展示R可能显著偏离h²S，引出为何仍重点关注h²的问题，为后续解释h²在预测响应中的核心作用做铺垫。

formula-notes:formula_15.1a:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the parent-offspring regression slope (b_op) as the covariance between parental and offspring phenotypic values divided by the phenotypic variance, expressed as a sum of additive and epistatic variance components (σ²_A, σ²_AA, etc.) plus the covariance of environmental values between generations.
formula-notes:formula_15.1a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to permanent versus transient response to show that the parent-offspring regression includes epistatic contributions, which affect the accuracy of predicting long-term response from the breeder's equation.

formula-notes:formula_15.2:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the response to one generation of selection (R) as the selection differential (S) multiplied by the sum of narrow-sense heritability (h²) and half the ratio of additive-by-additive epistatic variance (σ²_AA) to total phenotypic variance (σ²_z).
formula-notes:formula_15.2:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on genetic sources of transient response to show that additive-by-additive epistatic variance contributes to the short-term selection response, supporting the argument that non-additive genetic variance can transiently affect response beyond additive effects.

formula-notes:formula_15.1a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算单个亲本-子代回归斜率b_op，等于亲本与子代表型值协方差σ(z_p,z_o)除以表型方差σ_z^2，其中协方差分解为加性方差σ_A^2的一半、加性×加性上位方差σ_AA^2的四分之一等遗传分量，以及亲本与子代环境偏差协方差σ(E_p,E_o)。
formula-notes:formula_15.1a:zh.inThisChapter: 本章讨论均值短期变化，区分永久与瞬时响应；此公式引入上位性和环境相关后亲本-子代回归的精确表达式，为后续推导响应分解（如公式15.1b）提供基础，说明表型协方差中遗传与环境成分的贡献比例。

formula-notes:formula_15.3:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the total response to selection after τ generations of random mating following a single generation of selection, where S is the selection differential, h² is the narrow-sense heritability, c is the recombination fraction between two loci, σ²_AA is the additive-by-additive epistatic variance, and σ²_z is the phenotypic variance.
formula-notes:formula_15.3:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on genetic sources of transient response to show how epistatic variance contributes to additional response beyond the additive component, and how this extra response decays with random mating, converging to the additive response h²S as τ → ∞.

formula-notes:formula_15.2:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算选择响应 R，它等于选择差 S 乘以括号内的两项之和：第一项是狭义遗传力 h²，第二项是加性×加性上位方差 σ_AA² 除以两倍表型方差 σ_z²。
formula-notes:formula_15.2:zh.inThisChapter: 本章讨论遗传变异对短期选择响应的影响，该公式在经典 breeders' equation（R = Sh²）基础上增加了上位方差项，说明即使没有加性遗传方差，上位方差也能贡献短期响应，为后续讨论长期响应和方差变化做铺垫。

formula-notes:formula_15.4b:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the cumulative additive-by-additive epistatic contribution to the response after t generations of constant selection differential S. Key symbols: R_AA(t) = cumulative epistatic response, S = selection differential, σ²_AA = additive-by-additive variance, σ²_z = phenotypic variance, c = recombination rate, t = generation number.
formula-notes:formula_15.4b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on genetic sources of transient response to show how non-additive (epistatic) variance contributes to the long-term selection response beyond the additive component, supporting the decomposition of total response in Equation 15.4a.

formula-notes:formula_15.4a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将经过 t 代选择后的累积响应 R(t) 分解为两部分：线性项 t h² S（由加性遗传方差贡献的恒定响应）和 R_AA(t)（由显性×显性上位方差 σ_AA² 贡献的瞬态响应）。
formula-notes:formula_15.4a:zh.inThisChapter: 本章讨论遗传方差对选择响应的瞬态贡献，公式 (15.4a) 通过引入 R_AA(t) 显式量化了非加性遗传方差（σ_AA²）在累积响应中的衰减作用，为后续推导长期选择极限和平衡响应提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_15.3:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算经过τ代随机交配后，对两个连锁位点进行一代选择所获得的响应；其中S为选择差，h²为狭义遗传力，c为重组率，σ²_AA为加性×加性方差，σ²_z为表型方差。
formula-notes:formula_15.3:zh.inThisChapter: 出现在“瞬态响应的遗传来源”一节，用于说明当选择后允许随机交配时，响应如何从包含上位性分量逐渐衰减至仅剩加性分量（h²S），为后续讨论长期响应与连锁平衡提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_15.4b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算了在恒定选择差S下，经过t代后由加性×加性上位效应贡献的累积响应R_AA(t)。关键符号：σ_AA^2是加性×加性上位方差，σ_z^2是表型方差，c是重组率，t是世代数。
formula-notes:formula_15.4b:zh.inThisChapter: 它出现在本章中，用于分解总响应R(t)中的上位性部分，说明即使加性方差耗尽，上位效应也能在短期产生额外响应，为后续讨论长期选择极限和遗传变异耗散提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_15.4a:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the cumulative response to selection after t generations as the sum of a linear term (t h^2 S) due to additive genetic variance and a nonlinear term R_AA(t) due to additive-by-additive epistatic variance. Key symbols: R(t) = cumulative response, t = number of generations, h^2 = heritability, S = selection differential, R_AA(t) = cumulative response from epistasis.
formula-notes:formula_15.4a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on genetic sources of transient response to show how epistatic variance (σ_AA^2) contributes to a nonlinear, transient component of the cumulative response, supporting later arguments about the dynamics of selection response beyond the additive model.

formula-notes:formula_15.1b:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the response to selection (R) as the sum of the additive genetic component (h²S) and contributions from dominance and epistatic variance components (σ²_AA, σ²_AAA, etc.) scaled by S/σ²_z, plus covariances between offspring and each parent's permanent environment (σ(E_fa,E_o) and σ(E_mo,E_o)). Key symbols: R = response, S = selection differential, h² = narrow-sense heritability, σ²_z = phenotypic variance, σ²_AA = additive-by-additive variance, etc.
formula-notes:formula_15.1b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to permanent vs. transient response to show that the simple breeder's equation (R = h²S) can be inaccurate when non-additive genetic effects and parent-offspring environmental covariances are present, motivating the need to consider these factors in predicting long-term response.

formula-notes:formula_15.5b:zh.plainMeaning: 这个公式计算从 x^1 到 x^n 的等比数列求和，其中 x 是公比，n 是项数，结果等于 (x(1-x^n))/(1-x)。
formula-notes:formula_15.5b:zh.inThisChapter: 在“瞬态响应的遗传来源”一节中，该公式用于简化后续推导中出现的有限等比级数，例如在分析种群遗传学中的瞬态动力学时，需要计算类似形式的和。

formula-notes:formula_15.5a:en.plainMeaning: This formula gives the sum of the first n terms of a geometric series with ratio x, expressed in two equivalent index forms and as a closed-form rational expression. Key symbols: i (index), n (number of terms), x (common ratio).
formula-notes:formula_15.5a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the derivation of the cumulative additive × additive epistatic contribution (Equation 15.4b) by summing a geometric series, and it supports the derivation of Equation 15.5b, which extends the transient response analysis to include epistatic variance components.

formula-notes:formula_15.5a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式是等比数列前n项和公式，将求和式∑_{i=1}^n x^{i-1}（即1 + x + x^2 + ... + x^{n-1}）化简为封闭形式(1 - x^n)/(1 - x)，其中x是公比，n是项数。
formula-notes:formula_15.5a:zh.inThisChapter: 在本节中，该公式用于将(15.4b)中涉及累加性×累加性上位性贡献的无穷级数求和转化为封闭形式，从而推导出(15.5b)中瞬态响应的遗传方差表达式。

formula-notes:formula_15.5b:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the sum of a finite geometric series from i=1 to n, where x is the common ratio. The two equivalent forms show the sum as (1-x^{n+1})/(1-x) minus 1, or as x(1-x^n)/(1-x).
formula-notes:formula_15.5b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on genetic sources of transient response to provide a closed-form expression for summing geometric series, which is used later to model transient dynamics in population genetics or similar systems.

formula-notes:formula_15.7:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the cumulative response after t generations of selection followed by τ generations of random mating, where h²S is the additive response per generation and (1-c)^τ R_AA(t) is the decaying epistatic contribution.
formula-notes:formula_15.7:en.inThisChapter: It appears in this section to show that after random mating, the epistatic component decays to zero, leaving only the additive response predicted by the breeder's equation, supporting the argument that transient epistatic effects do not persist.

formula-notes:formula_15.6a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算当位点间存在重组（c>0）时，加性×加性上位性方差对长期响应极限的贡献，其中S为选择强度，σ_AA^2为上位性方差，σ_z^2为表型方差，c为重组率。
formula-notes:formula_15.6a:zh.inThisChapter: 在讨论遗传瞬态响应的来源时，该公式表明完全连锁（c=0）时响应随时间线性增长，而重组（c>0）使上位性贡献趋于有限值，为后续推导公式15.6b中总长期响应奠定基础。

formula-notes:formula_15.6b:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the half-life (t_{1/2}) of the transient epistatic response, i.e., the time (in generations) required for the cumulative response R_{AA}(t) to reach half of its asymptotic value. The key symbols are t_{1/2} (half-life), c (recombination rate between the two loci).
formula-notes:formula_15.6b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on genetic sources of transient response to derive the time scale over which epistatic variance is converted to additive variance and the response decays. This half-life supports later arguments about the duration of transient response and its dependence on recombination rate.

formula-notes:formula_15.8:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the response to selection (R) after one generation of random mating, where S is the selection differential, h² is the narrow-sense heritability, and σ²_{AA}, σ²_{AAA}, etc. are additive-by-additive epistatic variance components divided by the phenotypic variance σ²_z.
formula-notes:formula_15.8:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on transient response to show how epistatic variance contributes to the initial response but decays rapidly with random mating, supporting the argument that after several generations the response converges to h²S.

formula-notes:formula_15.6a:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the limiting value of the epistatic contribution to the response as time goes to infinity, where R_AA(t) is the cumulative response due to additive-by-additive epistasis, c is the recombination fraction, S is the selection intensity, σ_AA^2 is the additive-by-additive genetic variance, and σ_z^2 is the phenotypic variance.
formula-notes:formula_15.6a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on genetic sources of transient response to show that with recombination (c>0), the epistatic contribution does not increase indefinitely but approaches a finite limit, contrasting with the linear increase under complete linkage (c=0). This supports the later argument (Equation 15.6b) that the total response eventually becomes linear in time due to additive variance alone.

formula-notes:formula_15.6b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算达到总上位响应一半所需的时间 t_{1/2}，其中 c 是每代重组率，ln(2) 和 ln(1-c) 分别来自半衰期条件 1-(1-c)^t = 1/2。
formula-notes:formula_15.6b:zh.inThisChapter: 本章讨论瞬态响应的遗传来源，该公式由方程 15.4b 和 15.6a 推导而来，用于量化上位响应累积到一半时的代数，为后续分析响应速度与重组率的关系提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_15.9:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the response to selection (R) as the product of the selection differential (S) and a term that combines narrow-sense heritability (h²) with a contribution from dominance variance (σ_D²) scaled by three times the phenotypic variance (σ_z²).
formula-notes:formula_15.9:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on genetic sources of transient response to account for the additional response from dominance variance in polyploids, supporting the argument that non-additive genetic variance can contribute to short-term selection response.

formula-notes:formula_15.10c:en.plainMeaning: This formula gives the limiting value of the transient response component R_D(t) as t → ∞, where S is the selection coefficient, σ_D^2 is the dominance variance, and σ_z^2 is the phenotypic variance.
formula-notes:formula_15.10c:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on genetic sources of transient response to show that the transient component due to dominance converges to a constant fraction of the selection coefficient, supporting the decomposition of total response into additive and transient parts.

formula-notes:formula_15.10a:zh.plainMeaning: 公式(15.10a)将t代选择后的总响应R(t)分解为加性遗传响应t h² S与显性遗传响应R_D(t)之和，其中h²是狭义遗传力，S是选择差，t是世代数。
formula-notes:formula_15.10a:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在讨论瞬态响应的遗传来源章节，用于说明在有限群体中，由于显性效应衰减，总响应会偏离无限位点模型的线性预测，为后续推导R_D(t)的显性衰减公式(15.10b)及其极限值(15.10c)提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_15.7:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算经过t代选择和τ代随机交配后的累积响应，其中t h^2 S表示加性遗传响应（h^2为遗传力，S为选择差），(1-c)^τ R_{AA}(t)表示上位性响应衰减后的剩余部分（c为重组率，R_{AA}(t)为t代选择后的上位性响应）。
formula-notes:formula_15.7:zh.inThisChapter: 出现在“瞬态响应的遗传来源”一节，用于说明在随机交配下上位性响应如何随时间衰减，最终收敛至育种者方程预测的加性响应值，为后续讨论响应持久性提供定量依据。

formula-notes:formula_15.9:zh.plainMeaning: 公式 (15.9) 计算多倍体后代对选择的响应 R，其中 S 是选择差，h² 是狭义遗传力，σ_D² 是显性方差，σ_z² 是表型方差；括号内第二项表示显性方差对响应贡献的修正。
formula-notes:formula_15.9:zh.inThisChapter: 本章讨论遗传变异对短期响应的影响，此公式在多倍体背景下引入显性方差项，为后续分析非加性遗传效应在响应中的作用提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_15.10a:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the total response to selection after t generations, R(t), as the sum of an additive component (t h² S) and a dominance component R_D(t). Key symbols: R(t) = total response, t = generations, h² = narrow-sense heritability, S = selection differential, R_D(t) = dominance response.
formula-notes:formula_15.10a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on genetic sources of transient response to separate the additive and non-additive (dominance) contributions to selection response, supporting the argument that dominance generates a transient component that decays over generations.

formula-notes:formula_15.10b:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the transient (temporary) response R_D(t) after t generations of selection with constant selection differential S, where σ_D² is the dominance variance, σ_z² is the phenotypic variance, and the term (1/3)^t reflects the decay of dominance contributions due to recombination.
formula-notes:formula_15.10b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on genetic sources of transient response to decompose the total response R(t) into a permanent part (t h² S) and a transient part R_D(t) that decays to a limit, supporting the argument that dominance variance contributes only temporarily to selection response.

formula-notes:formula_15.10d:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the total response after t generations of selection followed by τ generations of random mating, where t h² S is the additive response and (1/3)^τ R_D(t) is the decaying dominance component.
formula-notes:formula_15.10d:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on genetic sources of transient response to show how dominance deviations decay rapidly under random mating, supporting the argument that the response converges to t h² S.

formula-notes:formula_15.8:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算经过一代随机交配后，选择响应R等于选择差S乘以一个加权和，其中h²是加性遗传方差占比，σ²_AA、σ²_AAA等分别是加性×加性、加性×加性×加性等上位方差占比，权重依次为1/4、1/16、1/64等。
formula-notes:formula_15.8:zh.inThisChapter: 本节讨论瞬态响应的遗传来源，公式15.8表明在无限小模型下，一代选择后的响应会因上位方差的存在而偏离h²S，但经过多代随机交配后迅速收敛到h²S，为后续解释长期响应衰减提供数学基础。

formula-notes:formula_15.10c:zh.plainMeaning: 公式(15.10c)计算的是当世代数t趋于无穷时，由遗传方差σ_D^2贡献的响应分量R_D(t)的极限值，即长期响应R̃_D等于选择强度S乘以遗传方差σ_D^2与表型方差2σ_z^2的比值。
formula-notes:formula_15.10c:zh.inThisChapter: 在“瞬态响应的遗传来源”一节中，公式(15.10b)给出了随时间衰减的响应分量R_D(t)，而(15.10c)取其极限，表明长期响应仅由初始加性遗传方差的一半贡献，为后续讨论平衡选择或突变维持的遗传方差提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_15.10b:zh.plainMeaning: 公式(15.10b)计算在恒定选择差S下，经过t代选择后，由于显性效应导致的响应增量R_D(t)。它等于S乘以3/2乘以[1-(1/3)^t]再乘以显性方差σ_D^2与表型方差σ_z^2之比的三分之一。
formula-notes:formula_15.10b:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在“瞬态响应的遗传来源”一节，用于分解总响应R(t)（公式15.10a）中由显性效应贡献的部分，并说明该部分随世代增加而衰减并收敛到极限值（公式15.10c）。

formula-notes:formula_15.11a:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the total response R(T) by generation T as a weighted sum of selection differentials S_t from earlier generations t, where each S_t is multiplied by the number of ancestors (2^{T-t}) and the partial regression coefficient β_{T,t} linking ancestor phenotype to descendant phenotype.
formula-notes:formula_15.11a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on permanent versus transient response to decompose the cumulative evolutionary response into contributions from selection at different time depths, supporting the argument that transient changes decay while permanent changes accumulate.

formula-notes:formula_15.10d:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算经过t代选择后，再随机交配τ代时的总响应：第一项t h^2 S是选择响应（与世代数t、遗传力h^2和选择差S成正比），第二项(1/3)^τ R_D(t)是来自双亲后裔的剩余响应，以每代1/3的速率衰减。
formula-notes:formula_15.10d:zh.inThisChapter: 本节讨论四倍体遗传下瞬态响应的遗传来源，公式15.10d展示了随机交配后响应如何快速收敛到t h^2 S，为后续引入双减数频率c并推广衰减速率做铺垫。

formula-notes:formula_15.11b:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the cumulative response R(T) as a weighted sum of selection differentials S_t across generations t=0 to T-1, where each weight is 2^(T-t) times the ratio of cross-generation covariance σ_G(T,t) to the phenotypic variance σ^2(z_t) in generation t.
formula-notes:formula_15.11b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on permanent versus transient response to decompose the long-term response into contributions from each generation, supporting the argument that transient changes decay over time while permanent changes accumulate.

formula-notes:formula_15.11c:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the ancestral regression coefficient R(T) as the sum over generations t=0 to T-1 of the product of the partial regression coefficient β_{T,t} and the selection differential S_t, where β_{T,t} measures the effect of selection at generation t on the mean at generation T.
formula-notes:formula_15.11c:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to permanent versus transient response to show how ancestral regression simplifies under pure selfing (due to the absence of the 2^{T-t} term from Equation 15.11a), setting up its use in Chapter 23 for analyzing selection under inbreeding.

formula-notes:formula_15.11a:zh.plainMeaning: 公式 R(T) = Σ_{t=0}^{T-1} 2^{T-t} β_{T,t} S_t 计算的是经过T代选择后的总响应，其中β_{T,t}是第T代个体表型对其第t代祖先（共2^{T-t}个之一）的偏回归系数，S_t是第t代的选择微分。
formula-notes:formula_15.11a:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在讨论均值短期变化的章节中，用于量化永久性响应与瞬时响应的叠加，为后续推导响应分解（如公式15.11b和15.11c）提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_15.12a:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the total response to selection R(T) at generation T as the sum over generations t of the product of a regression coefficient β_{T,t} and the sum of selection differentials S_{t,i} across all n(t,T) relatives in generation t that contribute to the response.
formula-notes:formula_15.12a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to permanent vs. transient response to show how selection in multiple generations can cumulatively affect the mean, and it supports the derivation of Equation 15.12b for the special case of pure selfing.

formula-notes:formula_15.12b:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the total response R(T) as the sum over generations t of the sum over n(t,T) relatives of the regression coefficient β_{T,t,i} times the selection differential S_{t,i}. It generalizes the response to include multiple relatives per generation.
formula-notes:formula_15.12b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on permanent versus transient response to show how the response can be decomposed into contributions from relatives in different generations, supporting the distinction between transient and permanent components of selection response.

formula-notes:formula_15.11b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算长期响应R(T)为各世代t的选择微分S_t乘以权重2^{T-t}再乘以跨世代协方差σ_G(T,t)与表型方差σ^2(z_t)之比的总和，其中σ_G(T,t)=σ(z_T,z_t)是世代t与后代世代T之间的表型协方差。
formula-notes:formula_15.11b:zh.inThisChapter: 在讨论均值短期变化的章节中，此公式将长期响应分解为各世代独立贡献的加权和，为后续比较永久性与瞬时性响应以及推导公式15.11c（响应与选择微分的关系）提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_15.13b:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the finite sum of a geometric series where the ratio is (1/2)^{i-1}, with x representing that ratio. It connects the sum over τ from 1 to t of x^τ to the closed-form expression x(1-x^t)/(1-x).
formula-notes:formula_15.13b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on permanent versus transient response to derive the cumulative effect of a shock over time, supporting the analysis of how quickly the mean reverts after a perturbation.

formula-notes:formula_15.11c:zh.plainMeaning: 公式 R(T) = Σ_{t=0}^{T-1} β_{T,t} S_t 计算的是在世代 T 时的响应 R(T)，它是过去各世代 t 的选择微分 S_t 乘以回归系数 β_{T,t} 的加权和，其中 β_{T,t} 表示祖先世代 t 的选择微分对后代世代 T 的响应的回归系数。
formula-notes:formula_15.11c:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在讨论均值短期变化中永久与暂时响应的章节，用于描述在纯自交情况下（缺少公式15.11a中的 2^{T-t} 项）的祖先回归，为第23章分析近交下选择提供基础，因为此时跨世代协方差同时依赖于 T 和 t。

formula-notes:formula_15.13a:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the cumulative contribution to the total response from ith-order additive epistasis after t generations, given constant selection S. Key symbols: R_{A^i}(t) = response from ith-order epistasis at time t, S = selection coefficient, σ²(A^i) = additive genetic variance due to ith-order epistasis, σ_z² = phenotypic variance, i = order of epistasis, t = number of generations.
formula-notes:formula_15.13a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on permanent versus transient response to show how higher-order epistatic contributions decay geometrically over time, supporting the argument that only additive effects (i=1) produce a permanent response, while epistatic effects (i>1) are transient.

formula-notes:formula_15.12a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算在世代T的总响应R(T)，它是对过去每个世代t（从0到T-1）的贡献求和：每个世代t的贡献等于该世代所有相关个体（共n(t,T)个）的选择差S_{t,i}之和乘以从世代t到T的回归系数β_{T,t}。
formula-notes:formula_15.12a:zh.inThisChapter: 本章讨论均值短期变化中永久与暂时响应的区分，此公式将总响应分解为不同世代选择效应的加权和，为后续推导纯自交情形（n(t,T)=1）下简化为更简单形式（方程15.12b）提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_15.13c:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the limit of a geometric series sum as t→∞, where x = (1/2)^{i-1}. It simplifies to 1/(2^{i-1}-1), representing the total scaled response relative to the initial contribution.
formula-notes:formula_15.13c:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to permanent vs. transient response to show the asymptotic total response from a single perturbation, supporting the argument that the long-term response is a multiple of the initial effect.

formula-notes:formula_15.12b:zh.plainMeaning: 公式(15.12b)计算第T代个体的表型值R(T)，它是所有过去世代t（从0到T-1）中，每个世代t内所有第i个亲属的性状值S_{t,i}乘以对应回归系数β_{T,t,i}的累加和。
formula-notes:formula_15.12b:zh.inThisChapter: 在讨论均值短期变化的永久与暂时响应时，该公式通过引入不同回归系数β_{T,t,i}，将公式(15.12a)推广到更一般的情况，为后续分析不同亲属关系对表型的影响提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_15.14a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算子代期望表型值，等于群体均值μ加上父母双方各自偏离μ的一半乘以遗传率ρ。
formula-notes:formula_15.14a:zh.inThisChapter: 出现在讨论短期均值变化中永久与瞬时应答的章节，为后续推导选择响应公式(15.14b)提供基础，说明子代均值如何由父母均值加权得到。

formula-notes:formula_15.13b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将几何级数求和公式应用于底数为(1/2)^{i-1}的等比数列，其中x=(1/2)^{i-1}，计算从τ=1到t的有限项和，结果为x(1-x^t)/(1-x)。
formula-notes:formula_15.13b:zh.inThisChapter: 本章讨论均值短期变化中永久性与暂时性冲击的区分，该公式用于计算冲击衰减过程中有限时间窗口内的累积效应，为后续推导冲击响应的持久性度量提供代数工具。

formula-notes:formula_15.13a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算在常数选择强度S下，由i阶加性上位性效应贡献的累积总响应R_{A^i}(t)，其中σ²(A^i)是i阶上位性方差，σ_z²是表型方差，求和项表示每代遗传贡献的衰减累积。
formula-notes:formula_15.13a:zh.inThisChapter: 本章讨论均值短期变化，公式15.13a将15.11b的通用响应公式具体化为i阶上位性贡献，为后续比较不同阶上位性响应速度（如15.13b和15.13c）提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_15.14a:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the expected phenotypic value of an offspring given the phenotypic values of its mother (z_mo) and father (z_fa), assuming the parents are uncorrelated. Key symbols: μ = population mean, ρ = heritability (or correlation between parent and offspring), z_fa and z_mo = parental values.
formula-notes:formula_15.14a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on permanent vs. transient response to show how the mean of offspring depends equally on both parents, which is then used to derive the response to selection equation (15.14b) for the mean in the next generation.

formula-notes:formula_15.13c:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将几何级数求和极限 x/(1-x) 具体化为 x = (1/2)^{i-1} 的情形，得到极限值为 1/(2^{i-1}-1)，表示第 i 个特征根对应的瞬态响应在 t→∞ 时的总增量与初始贡献的比值。
formula-notes:formula_15.13c:zh.inThisChapter: 在讨论永久响应与瞬态响应的章节中，该公式用于计算瞬态响应随时间的累积效应，为后续比较不同特征根对长期响应的影响提供定量基础。

formula-notes:formula_15.14b:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the mean phenotype at generation t+1 (μ_{t+1}) as the population baseline mean μ plus a fraction ρ of the deviation of the selected parents' mean (μ_t^*) from μ. Key symbols: μ = baseline mean, ρ = fraction of environmental deviation transmitted, μ_t^* = mean of selected adults in generation t.
formula-notes:formula_15.14b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on permanent vs. transient response to illustrate how a transient environmental effect (μ_t^* - μ) can persist across generations via the parameter ρ, supporting the argument that shared environmental effects can cause sustained changes in the mean.

formula-notes:formula_15.16a:en.plainMeaning: This formula expresses the change in mean phenotype from generation t to t+1 (Δμ_t) as a function of the previous change (Δμ_{t-1}) and the change in selection differential (S_t - S_{t-1}), scaled by the heritability ρ.
formula-notes:formula_15.16a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to permanent versus transient response to show how the mean change depends on both past evolution and current selection changes, setting up the decomposition into permanent and transient components in equations 15.16b and 15.16c.

formula-notes:formula_15.15:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算下一代均值 μ_{t+1}，它是长期均值 μ 加上 ρ 乘以当前代选择后均值 (μ_t + S_t) 与 μ 的偏差，其中 ρ 是亲代-子代回归斜率。
formula-notes:formula_15.15:zh.inThisChapter: 本节区分永久与瞬时响应，此公式将选择响应分解为直接传递（通过 ρ）和向长期均值回归的部分，为后续推导均值变化 Δμ_t 提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_15.15:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the mean phenotype in the next generation (μ_{t+1}) as the population mean μ plus a fraction ρ of the deviation of the selected parents' mean (μ_t + S_t) from μ, where ρ is the parent–offspring regression slope (heritability).
formula-notes:formula_15.15:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on permanent versus transient response to show how selection shifts the mean when only part of the selection differential is transmitted to offspring, supporting later analysis of long-term evolutionary dynamics.

formula-notes:formula_15.16a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算了均值变化量 Δμ_t，它等于 ρ 乘以上一期均值变化量 Δμ_{t-1} 与选择响应变化量 (S_t - S_{t-1}) 之和，刻画了均值变化的递归关系。
formula-notes:formula_15.16a:zh.inThisChapter: 在讨论均值短期变化的章节中，该公式从方程(15.15)推导而来，为后续分析永久与瞬态响应（方程15.16b和15.16c）提供递归基础，从而分离选择效应与回归效应。

formula-notes:formula_15.14b:zh.plainMeaning: 公式(15.14b)计算第t+1代群体的均值μ_{t+1}，它等于基线均值μ加上一个修正项ρ(μ_t^* - μ)，其中μ_t^*是第t代被选择亲本的均值，ρ是环境偏差传递给后代的比例。
formula-notes:formula_15.14b:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在讨论均值短期变化的章节，用于量化选择响应中环境效应的持久性（永久vs瞬时响应），为后续推导选择响应方程或分析环境协方差提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_15.17b:zh.plainMeaning: 公式计算长期累积响应R(t)的极限值，等于选择差S乘以ρ/(1-ρ)，其中ρ是遗传相关系数。
formula-notes:formula_15.17b:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在讨论上位性对长期响应影响的章节，用于量化选择与繁殖平衡时的最终响应，为后续比较瞬态与永久响应提供基准。

formula-notes:formula_15.16b:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the increment in mean phenotype Δμ_t after t generations of selection, given initial selection differential S and a heritability-like parameter ρ that decays the response geometrically. Key symbols: Δμ_t (response in generation t), ρ (proportion of selection transmitted), S (selection differential).
formula-notes:formula_15.16b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on transient vs. permanent response to show that under continued selection the response decays geometrically, supporting the argument that total response reaches a limit even with sustained selection.

formula-notes:formula_15.17a:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the cumulative response R(t) after t time steps to a permanent step change S in forcing, where ρ is the lag-1 autocorrelation. It shows that R(t) approaches the equilibrium response Sρ/(1-ρ) as t increases.
formula-notes:formula_15.17a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to permanent versus transient response to derive the time-dependent approach to equilibrium for a persistent forcing, supporting later discussion of how the mean adjusts over time.

formula-notes:formula_15.16c:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the total cumulative response to selection after t generations, R(t) = μ_t - μ_0, as the sum of per-generation responses Δμ_i, which equals S times the sum of ρ^i from i=1 to t. Here, S is the selection differential, ρ is the correlation between parent and offspring phenotype (or a measure of persistence), and t is the number of generations.
formula-notes:formula_15.16c:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on permanent versus transient response to show how the total response accumulates over time when each generation's response decays geometrically with rate ρ, supporting the argument that the long-term response approaches a finite limit as t increases.

formula-notes:formula_15.16c:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算经过t代选择后的总响应R(t)，即第t代均值μ_t与初始均值μ_0之差，等于各代选择响应Δμ_i的累加，也等于选择差S乘以几何级数ρ^i的求和。
formula-notes:formula_15.16c:zh.inThisChapter: 本节讨论均值短期变化的永久与瞬态响应，该公式通过累加每代响应（来自公式15.16b）给出总响应，为后续分析响应随世代衰减或持续提供定量基础。

formula-notes:formula_15.18:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the expected change in mean phenotype at generation t+τ (Δμ_{t+τ}) as a function of the initial deviation S, the rate ρ, and time indices t and τ, showing that the transient response decays geometrically.
formula-notes:formula_15.18:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on permanent versus transient response to illustrate how a one‑time environmental shift (S) produces a transient effect that decays over time, supporting the argument that only sustained changes have lasting evolutionary impact.

formula-notes:formula_15.17b:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the asymptotic (long-term) cumulative response to selection, showing that it equals the selection differential S multiplied by ρ/(1-ρ), where ρ is the correlation between breeding value and phenotype.
formula-notes:formula_15.17b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on permanent vs. transient response to illustrate that under epistasis, the cumulative response reaches a finite equilibrium due to the balance between selection-generated correlations and their removal by reproduction, supporting the argument that long-term response can be limited even with constant selection.

formula-notes:formula_15.16b:zh.plainMeaning: 公式 Δμ_t = ρ^t S 计算第 t 代选择响应增量，其中 ρ 是世代间遗传相关系数，S 是选择差，Δμ_t 表示第 t 代相对于前一代表型均值的增量。
formula-notes:formula_15.16b:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在讨论短期均值变化的永久与瞬时应答部分，通过迭代公式 15.16a 得到，说明即使持续选择，响应增量也会逐代衰减并趋于零，为后续推导总响应极限（公式 15.16c）提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_15.19a:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the cumulative response R at generation t+τ as the product of ρ^τ and the response at generation t, showing exponential decay of the initial response over τ generations. Key symbols: R(t) = response at generation t, ρ = decay factor (0<ρ<1), τ = number of generations elapsed.
formula-notes:formula_15.19a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on permanent versus transient response to derive the transient component's decay, supporting the argument that the response to a permanent change eventually reaches a new equilibrium, while the transient component decays geometrically.

formula-notes:formula_15.19c:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the half-life t_{1/2} of the decay process described by ρ^t, where ρ is the decay factor (0<ρ<1). It gives the time required for the quantity to reduce to half its initial value.
formula-notes:formula_15.19c:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the discussion of transient response to quantify how quickly the effect of a perturbation decays, supporting the distinction between permanent and transient changes in the mean.

formula-notes:formula_15.17a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算在时间 t 内，由于一个永久性冲击 S 导致均值发生改变后，响应变量 R(t) 从初始状态向新均衡调整的累积路径，其中 ρ 是自回归系数，控制调整速度。
formula-notes:formula_15.17a:zh.inThisChapter: 本节区分永久与暂时冲击的响应，此公式为永久冲击的累积响应函数，为后续推导暂时冲击的响应（公式15.17b）提供对比基准。

formula-notes:formula_15.19a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算了从第t代到第t+τ代的累积响应R(t+τ)，它等于初始响应R(t)乘以ρ的τ次幂，其中ρ是遗传力相关的衰减因子，τ是世代间隔。
formula-notes:formula_15.19a:zh.inThisChapter: 在本节中，该公式用于推导永久性响应与暂时性响应的区分，通过展示当τ足够大时R(t+τ)趋于0，从而说明响应是暂时性的，为后续引入永久性响应公式15.19b和15.19c做铺垫。

formula-notes:formula_15.19b:en.plainMeaning: This formula simplifies the product of a transient term and a geometric sum into a single expression involving the response R(t) and a factor (1-ρ^τ), showing how the cumulative effect over τ periods depends on the persistence parameter ρ.
formula-notes:formula_15.19b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the derivation of the transient response to a permanent change, supporting the argument that the cumulative impact over a finite horizon τ can be expressed compactly in terms of the initial response R(t) and the persistence parameter ρ.

formula-notes:formula_15.19b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将前一步的表达式化简为仅含R(t)和ρ^τ的乘积，其中R(t)是t时刻的响应，ρ是衰减因子，τ是求和上限。
formula-notes:formula_15.19b:zh.inThisChapter: 它出现在推导永久性与暂时性冲击响应的过程中，通过代数化简将中间表达式转化为简洁形式，为后续讨论冲击的持久性效应提供直接表达式。

formula-notes:formula_15.20a:en.plainMeaning: This formula decomposes an individual's phenotypic value (z) into additive genetic effects (G) and environmental effects (E), where E is further split into a maternal performance component (M) and an environmental deviation (e).
formula-notes:formula_15.20a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on selection with heritable maternal effects to partition the phenotype into components that can be inherited (G and M) versus non-inherited (e), setting up the derivation of the response to selection in Equation 15.20b.

formula-notes:formula_15.18:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算在永久性环境变化（S_t=S，之后S_{t+τ}=0）下，第t+τ代均值变化Δμ_{t+τ}，它等于ρ^τ乘以Δμ_t与S的差，最终表示为-Sρ^τ(1-ρ^t)。关键符号：ρ为响应系数，τ为时间滞后，t为初始世代，S为永久性冲击大小。
formula-notes:formula_15.18:zh.inThisChapter: 本节区分永久性与瞬时响应，公式15.18通过代入S_t=S和S_{t+τ}=0到15.16a，推导出永久冲击后均值变化的显式表达式，为后续比较不同冲击类型下的长期动态提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_15.20b:en.plainMeaning: This formula decomposes an individual's phenotypic value (z) into direct genetic (G_d), maternal genetic (G_m), maternal environmental (E_m), and residual environmental (e) components.
formula-notes:formula_15.20b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on selection with heritable maternal effects to partition the phenotype into direct and maternal contributions, enabling the derivation of response to selection formulas that account for both pathways.

formula-notes:formula_15.19c:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算响应衰减的半衰期 t_{1/2}，即响应值衰减到初始一半所需的时间步数，其中 ρ 是衰减因子（0<ρ<1）。
formula-notes:formula_15.19c:zh.inThisChapter: 本节讨论短期变化中永久与瞬态响应的区别，该公式由 ρ^{t_{1/2}}=1/2 解出，用于量化瞬态响应衰减的速度，为后续比较不同 ρ 下的响应持久性提供定量工具。

formula-notes:formula_15.22a:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the expected phenotypic value of an offspring (z_o) given the maternal breeding value (A_mo), paternal breeding value (A_fa), and the mother's phenotypic value (z_mo). It combines half of each parent's breeding value plus a maternal effect term (m z_mo).
formula-notes:formula_15.22a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on selection with heritable maternal effects to model how maternal phenotype influences offspring phenotype beyond additive genetic contributions, and it supports the derivation of the mean phenotype in the next generation (Equation 15.22b).

formula-notes:formula_15.20a:zh.plainMeaning: 公式将个体表型值z分解为直接遗传效应G、母体效应M和剩余环境偏差e之和，其中M由母亲贡献，e为独立环境偏差。
formula-notes:formula_15.20a:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式在母体效应遗传背景下引入，将表型方差拆解为直接遗传方差、母体效应方差及协方差等组分，为后续推导选择响应公式（15.20b）提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_15.21:en.plainMeaning: This formula decomposes an individual's phenotype z into a direct genetic component G, a maternal effect M that is proportional to the mother's phenotype z_mo (with proportionality constant m), and an environmental component e.
formula-notes:formula_15.21:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on selection with heritable maternal effects to express the maternal contribution as a linear function of the mother's phenotype, enabling the derivation of response to selection formulas that account for this indirect genetic effect.

formula-notes:formula_15.22b:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the mean phenotypic value in generation t+1 (μ_z(t+1)) as the average of the mean breeding values of selected fathers (A_fa^*(t)) and selected mothers (A_mo^*(t)), plus the maternal effect m times the mean phenotypic value of selected mothers (μ_mo^*(t)).
formula-notes:formula_15.22b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on selection with heritable maternal effects to show how the maternal effect m influences the response to selection, and it supports the derivation of the selection response equation (15.22c) by linking parental breeding values and maternal phenotype to offspring mean.

formula-notes:formula_15.21:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将个体表型值z分解为加性遗传效应G、母体效应M（等于母体表型z_mo乘以系数m）以及环境残差e，即z = G + m z_mo + e。
formula-notes:formula_15.21:zh.inThisChapter: 在讨论存在可遗传母体效应的选择时，该公式将母体效应M具体化为母体表型的线性函数，为后续推导母体效应下的选择响应和遗传参数估计提供了基础分解形式。

formula-notes:formula_15.22b:zh.plainMeaning: 公式(15.22b)计算下一代t+1的平均表型值μ_z(t+1)，它等于选留父本平均育种值A_fa*(t)与选留母本平均育种值A_mo*(t)的均值，再加上母本遗传效应m乘以选留母本的平均表型值μ_mo*(t)。
formula-notes:formula_15.22b:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在讨论可遗传母体效应下选择响应的章节，由个体模型(15.22a)对选留亲本求平均得到，为后续推导选择响应公式(15.22c)提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_15.23a:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the equilibrium regression slope of breeding value A on phenotype z, given heritability h² and the maternal effect parameter m. It shows how the slope is amplified by the factor 2/(2-m) due to heritable maternal effects.
formula-notes:formula_15.23a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on selection with heritable maternal effects to quantify the bias in the parent-offspring regression caused by maternal transmission, supporting the derivation of the response to selection (Equation 15.23b).

formula-notes:formula_15.22c:zh.plainMeaning: 公式(15.22c)计算经过选择后母本平均育种值A_mo*(t)，它等于群体平均育种值μ_A(t)加上育种值对表型的回归系数b_{A|z}乘以母本选择差S_mo(t)。
formula-notes:formula_15.22c:zh.inThisChapter: 本节讨论可遗传母本效应下的选择响应，该公式将选择差S_mo(t)与母本育种值变化直接关联，为后续推导母本选择导致的遗传进展奠定基础。

formula-notes:formula_15.22a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算子代表型值z_o的条件期望，给定母本育种值A_mo、父本育种值A_fa和母本表型值z_mo，等于父母育种值的一半之和加上母本表型值乘以母体效应系数m。
formula-notes:formula_15.22a:zh.inThisChapter: 出现在“存在可遗传母体效应下的选择”章节，为后续推导选择后世代均值μ_z(t+1)提供基础，通过平均得到公式(15.22b)。

formula-notes:formula_15.24:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the mean phenotype in the next generation (μ_z(t+1)) as a function of the mean additive genetic value (μ_A(t)), selection differentials on mothers (S_mo) and fathers (S_fa), heritability (h²), maternal effect coefficient (m), and current mean phenotype (μ_z(t)).
formula-notes:formula_15.24:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on selection with heritable maternal effects to derive the response to selection, showing how maternal inheritance (m) modifies the standard breeder's equation and supporting later analysis of evolutionary dynamics under maternal effects.

formula-notes:formula_15.22c:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the expected breeding value of selected mothers, A_mo*(t), as the population mean μ_A(t) plus the product of the regression coefficient b_{A|z} and the selection differential S_mo(t). Key symbols: A_mo*(t) = expected breeding value in selected mothers, μ_A(t) = population mean breeding value, b_{A|z} = regression coefficient of breeding value on phenotype, S_mo(t) = selection differential in mothers.
formula-notes:formula_15.22c:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on selection with heritable maternal effects to show how selection on the maternal trait changes the mean breeding value of mothers, which is needed to predict the response to selection in the offspring generation.

formula-notes:formula_15.20b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将个体表型值z分解为直接遗传效应G_d、母体遗传效应G_m、母体环境效应E_m和残差e之和，其中M=G_m+E_m代表母体贡献。
formula-notes:formula_15.20b:zh.inThisChapter: 在讨论可遗传母体效应下的选择时，此公式将表型方差拆解为直接和母体组分，为后续推导母体效应导致的遗传协方差和选择响应奠定基础。

formula-notes:formula_15.24:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算下一代平均表型值 μ_z(t+1) 由当前平均育种值 μ_A(t)、母体效应选择差 S_mo(t) 和父体效应选择差 S_fa(t) 的加权组合，以及当前平均表型值 μ_z(t) 与母体效应选择差之和乘以母体效应传递系数 m 构成。
formula-notes:formula_15.24:zh.inThisChapter: 在讨论可遗传母体效应下的选择响应时，该公式将母体效应（通过 m 和 S_mo）与父体效应（S_fa）纳入下一代平均表型值的预测，为后续推导长期响应或平衡状态提供递推关系。

formula-notes:formula_15.26:zh.plainMeaning: 公式(15.26)计算第一代选择响应Δμ_z(1)，它等于遗传力h^2除以(2-m)乘以母本选择差S_mo(1)与父本选择差S_fa(1)之和，再加上母本选择差乘以母体效应系数m。
formula-notes:formula_15.26:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在讨论永久与瞬时响应的章节，在假设母体效应达到平衡（公式15.23a成立）后，推导单代选择响应的表达式，为后续区分永久和瞬时成分提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_15.23b:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the mean breeding value in the next generation (μ_A(t+1)) as the average of the breeding values of selected mothers (A_mo^*) and fathers (A_fa^*). It shows that the response to selection equals the current mean plus a term involving heritability (h^2), the maternal effect parameter (m), and the selection differentials in males (S_mo) and females (S_fa).
formula-notes:formula_15.23b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on selection with heritable maternal effects to derive the evolutionary response when maternal effects influence the phenotype. This formula supports the argument that the response to selection depends on both direct and maternal genetic effects, modifying the standard breeder's equation.

formula-notes:formula_15.23a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算在母体效应存在且达到平衡时，个体表型值z对加性遗传值A的回归斜率b_{A|z}，等于遗传力h²乘以2/(2-m)，其中m是母体效应系数。
formula-notes:formula_15.23a:zh.inThisChapter: 它出现在讨论可遗传母体效应下选择响应的章节，用于量化表型与育种值的关系，为后续推导选择响应或预测遗传变化提供关键回归系数。

formula-notes:formula_15.23b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算下一代t+1时的平均育种值μ_A(t+1)，它等于选留母本和父本育种值的平均值，并表示为当前平均育种值μ_A(t)加上选择响应项，其中h²是狭义遗传力，m是母体效应遗传力，S_mo(t)和S_fa(t)分别是母本和父本的选择差。
formula-notes:formula_15.23b:zh.inThisChapter: 在讨论存在可遗传母体效应下的选择响应时，该公式整合了母体效应（通过分母2-m）对选择响应的影响，为后续推导总响应或预测长期选择进展提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_15.25:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the change in mean phenotype Δμ_z(t) as a sum of direct selection effects (first two terms) and a maternal carry-over from the previous generation (last term). Key symbols: h² (heritability), m (maternal effect coefficient), S_mo(t) and S_fa(t) (selection differentials in mothers and fathers), Δμ_z(t-1) (previous change), S_mo(t-1) (previous maternal selection).
formula-notes:formula_15.25:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on selection with heritable maternal effects to quantify how both genetic and maternal components contribute to evolutionary change across generations, supporting the interpretation that maternal effects alter the response to selection beyond the standard breeder's equation.

formula-notes:formula_15.26:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the total change in mean phenotype after one generation of selection (Δμ_z(1)), combining the direct response from both maternal (S_mo(1)) and paternal (S_fa(1)) selection differentials, weighted by heritability h² and the maternal effect coefficient m, plus an additional contribution from the maternal selection differential alone.
formula-notes:formula_15.26:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction of permanent versus transient response to show how maternal effects alter the short-term selection response, building on the equilibrium condition (Equation 15.23a) to derive the initial response before subsequent generations.

formula-notes:formula_15.27b:en.plainMeaning: This inequality specifies the condition on the male mutation rate m (relative to female rate) for a stable polymorphism under sex-limited selection, where h is the dominance coefficient.
formula-notes:formula_15.27b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the discussion of transient vs. permanent responses to show when a mutation can be maintained in the population rather than being lost or fixed, supporting the analysis of long-term evolutionary dynamics.

formula-notes:formula_15.27a:en.plainMeaning: This inequality defines the condition on m (the ratio of transient to permanent response magnitudes) for a reversed response (Δμ_z opposite in sign to S) when S_fa = S_mo = S, where h is a parameter related to heritability or variance components.
formula-notes:formula_15.27a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to permanent versus transient response to specify when a transient response can reverse sign relative to the permanent response, supporting the discussion of counterintuitive evolutionary dynamics under short-term changes.

formula-notes:formula_15.27a:zh.plainMeaning: 该不等式给出了当S_fa = S_mo = S时，出现反向响应（Δμ_z与S符号相反）的条件：m必须小于1 - √(1 + 2h²)。其中m是遗传力（或相关参数），h²是狭义遗传力。
formula-notes:formula_15.27a:zh.inThisChapter: 本节讨论均值短期变化中的永久与瞬态响应，该公式从方程15.26推导而来，明确了反向响应发生的参数边界，为后续区分响应类型和预测响应方向提供定量判据。

formula-notes:formula_15.27b:zh.plainMeaning: 该不等式给出了当选择仅作用于雌性时，雄性突变率 m 必须满足的上界条件，其中 h 是雌性中突变杂合子的选择系数。
formula-notes:formula_15.27b:zh.inThisChapter: 在讨论永久性与暂时性响应的章节中，该公式用于界定雄性突变率的上限，以判断突变负荷的响应是永久性的还是暂时性的。

formula-notes:formula_15.28a:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the change in mean phenotype Δμ_z(t) after t generations of constant directional selection S on both sexes, given heritability h² and migration rate m. Key symbols: Δμ_z(t) = change in mean at generation t, S = selection differential, h² = heritability, m = migration rate.
formula-notes:formula_15.28a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on permanent vs. transient response to show how the transient dynamics (depending on m^t) decay to the asymptotic response (Equation 15.28b), illustrating the effect of migration on the rate of approach to equilibrium.

formula-notes:formula_15.29a:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the cumulative response R(t) after t generations of selection, summing the per-generation changes Δμ_z(i). Key symbols: R(t) = cumulative response, S = selection differential, m = migration rate, h² = heritability, t = generation number.
formula-notes:formula_15.29a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on permanent vs. transient response to show how the cumulative response evolves over time, supporting the later argument that the response converges to a linear function (Equation 15.29b) when |m|<1.

formula-notes:formula_15.25:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算了在存在可遗传母体效应时，性状均值从第t-1代到第t代的变化量Δμ_z(t)。它由三部分构成：前两项是第t代选择导致的遗传贡献(h²/(2-m))乘以母体与父体选择差之和，以及母体效应贡献(m乘以母体选择差)；第三项是第t-1代均值变化量减去母体选择差后乘以母体效应系数m，体现了母体效应的跨代传递。
formula-notes:formula_15.25:zh.inThisChapter: 本章讨论存在可遗传母体效应时的选择响应，该公式由上下文中的均值表达式经代数简化得到，并引用了公式15.23b。它直接给出了选择响应Δμ_z(t)的递推形式，为后续分析母体效应如何影响长期进化动态提供了基础。

formula-notes:formula_15.30:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the change in mean phenotype Δμ_z at generation t+τ after selection stops, as the product of the decay factor m^τ and the deviation of the initial response Δμ_z(t) from the constant selection differential S.
formula-notes:formula_15.30:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on permanent versus transient response to show that selection response persists after selection ceases, supporting the concept of a transient response that decays geometrically over time.

formula-notes:formula_15.28a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算在恒定方向选择强度S下，经过t代后，数量性状均值每代的变化量Δμ_z(t)。其中h²是性状的遗传力，m是迁移率，t是世代数。
formula-notes:formula_15.28a:zh.inThisChapter: 此公式出现在讨论永久与瞬态响应的章节，通过迭代方程15.25得到，用于展示均值变化如何随时间t从初始瞬态（依赖m^t项）过渡到稳态值（公式15.28b），为后续分析长期进化响应奠定基础。

formula-notes:formula_15.28b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算当输入S恒定时，长期（稳态）平均表型变化量Δμz，其中h²是遗传力，m是自回归系数，S是选择差分。
formula-notes:formula_15.28b:zh.inThisChapter: 它由公式15.28a取t→∞得到，用于区分永久响应（稳态值）与瞬态响应（随时间衰减的部分），为后续讨论长期进化响应提供定量基准。

formula-notes:formula_15.28b:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the long-term (asymptotic) change in the mean phenotype (Δμz) after a sustained selection differential S, given heritability h² and a parameter m (|m|<1) that governs the rate of decay of transient effects. The symbols are: Δμz = asymptotic change in mean, S = selection differential, h² = heritability, m = transient decay parameter.
formula-notes:formula_15.28b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on permanent versus transient response to show the steady-state outcome when selection is sustained indefinitely, supporting the argument that the transient component decays to zero and only the permanent component remains.

formula-notes:formula_15.29b:en.plainMeaning: This formula gives the long-term (asymptotic) cumulative response R(t) of the mean to a sustained perturbation, where S is the selection coefficient, m the migration rate, h the dominance coefficient, and t the time in generations.
formula-notes:formula_15.29b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on permanent versus transient response to show the limiting behavior of the cumulative response as t becomes large, supporting the distinction between short-term and long-term evolutionary dynamics.

formula-notes:formula_15.29a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算经过t代选择后的累积响应R(t)，它是每代均值变化Δμ_z(i)从第1代到第t代的加和。公式中S为选择差，m为表型方差中不可遗传部分的比例，h^2为狭义遗传力，t为世代数。
formula-notes:formula_15.29a:zh.inThisChapter: 本节讨论均值变化的短期动态，区分永久与瞬时响应。公式15.29a通过累加单代变化（15.28a）并代入15.5b得到，为后续推导收敛形式（15.29b）提供基础，展示响应如何随时间趋于线性增长。

formula-notes:formula_15.30:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算在停止选择后第τ代，性状均值响应Δμ_z(t+τ)与初始响应Δμ_z(t)和选择差分S的关系，其中m是遗传传递系数，τ是停止选择后的代数。
formula-notes:formula_15.30:zh.inThisChapter: 出现在讨论选择停止后响应持续性的章节，通过迭代公式15.25推导得出，为后续说明即使选择停止，响应仍会衰减但持续（图15.3）提供数学基础。

formula-notes:formula_15.32:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the asymptotic cumulative response to selection after many generations, where S is the selection differential, m is the migration rate, t is the number of generations of selection, and h² is the heritability.
formula-notes:formula_15.32:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on permanent versus transient response to show how migration and heritability interact to determine the long-term evolutionary change after selection ceases.

formula-notes:formula_15.29b:zh.plainMeaning: 公式 (15.29b) 是 (15.29a) 在 |m|<1 时的稳态近似，它去掉了含 m^t 的瞬态项，用 t 的线性函数加上常数项来近似累积均值偏移 R(t)，其中 S 是冲击幅度，h 是学习率，m 是记忆参数。
formula-notes:formula_15.29b:zh.inThisChapter: 本节讨论永久性 vs 瞬时性响应，公式 (15.29b) 给出了长期（t 大）时 R(t) 的渐近行为，为后续区分永久性冲击（m=1）和瞬时性冲击（|m|<1）的响应特征提供解析基础。

formula-notes:formula_15.31:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the cumulative evolutionary response R*(τ) after τ generations of no selection, given the initial selection differential Δμz(t) and the genetic constraint S. Key symbols: R*(τ) = cumulative response, m = proportion of new immigrants each generation, τ = number of generations after selection stops, Δμz(t) = selection differential in the last selected generation, S = constraint term.
formula-notes:formula_15.31:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on permanent versus transient response to show how evolutionary momentum (carryover from past selection) decays over time when selection ceases. This supports the argument that the transient response can be substantial and depends on the immigration rate m and the constraint S.

formula-notes:formula_15.33:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将经过t代选择后的总响应R(t)与松弛选择后的剩余响应R*之和表示为t乘以渐近响应（公式15.28b），其中h²是狭义遗传力，S是选择差，m是迁移率。
formula-notes:formula_15.33:zh.inThisChapter: 本节引入永久响应与瞬时响应的概念，公式15.33通过累加公式15.29a和15.32，直接给出了t代选择后的永久响应，为后续讨论选择松弛后响应的衰减（当R*与S符号相反时）提供了定量基础。

formula-notes:formula_15.32:zh.plainMeaning: 公式 (15.32) 计算在无限时间后（τ→∞）的累积响应 R*，其中 S 是选择差，m 是表型值向均值回归的系数，t 是选择代数，h² 是狭义遗传力。该式将 R* 表示为 S 乘以一个包含 m、t 和 h² 的因子。
formula-notes:formula_15.32:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在讨论选择响应的永久性与瞬时性部分，由 (15.31) 取极限得到，用于量化长期选择后表型均值的总变化，为后续比较不同 m 和 h² 下的响应模式提供解析表达式。

formula-notes:formula_15.34a:en.plainMeaning: This inequality defines the range of the absolute value of the standardized selection differential m (0 < m < (3 - sqrt(1+8h^2))/2) for which erosion of the cumulative response occurs when selection is relaxed, given |m| < 1 and heritability h^2.
formula-notes:formula_15.34a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on permanent versus transient response to quantify when the cumulative response is not fully permanent, supporting the discussion of erosion and reversed response upon relaxation of selection.

formula-notes:formula_15.34b:en.plainMeaning: This inequality defines the condition on maternal effect magnitude m (relative to heritability h²) under which the response to selection persists transiently after selection ceases. Specifically, m must exceed the threshold (3 - √(1+8h²))/2.
formula-notes:formula_15.34b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the discussion of transient vs. permanent response to distinguish when maternal effects cause a delayed decay of response, supporting the argument that sufficiently large positive maternal effects produce a transient component that masks the permanent response.

formula-notes:formula_15.31:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算在最后一代选择之后，经过τ代累积的响应R*(τ)，它等于一个几何级数因子乘以选择差[Δμz(t)-S]，其中m是遗传力相关的参数，τ是世代数。
formula-notes:formula_15.31:zh.inThisChapter: 本节介绍短期均值变化中的永久与暂时响应，公式15.31通过求和15.30式得到累积响应，为后续推导当τ→∞时的极限响应（公式15.32）做铺垫。

formula-notes:formula_15.33:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the total cumulative response to t generations of selection as the sum of the permanent response R(t) and the transient response R*, which equals t times the asymptotic response per generation (h² S times a factor involving m). Key symbols: R(t) = permanent response after t generations, R* = transient response, t = number of generations, h² = heritability, S = selection differential, m = migration rate.
formula-notes:formula_15.33:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on permanent versus transient response to show that the total response after t generations is simply t times the asymptotic response, implying that the transient component R* does not accumulate over time. This supports the argument that any erosion of cumulative response upon relaxation of selection is due to the transient component being opposite in sign to S.

formula-notes:formula_15.35a:en.plainMeaning: This formula expresses the offspring's direct trait value (z) as the sum of the direct genetic effect (G_d), a maternal effect proportional to the mother's maternal trait value (m * z_{m,mo}), and an environmental residual (e).
formula-notes:formula_15.35a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on selection with heritable maternal effects to extend Equation 15.21 by explicitly separating direct and maternal traits, supporting later analysis of how maternal effects influence evolutionary response to selection.

formula-notes:formula_15.35a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将子代表型值z分解为直接遗传效应G_d、母体遗传效应m乘以母体母性表型值z_{m,mo}，以及环境残差e。
formula-notes:formula_15.35a:zh.inThisChapter: 在存在可遗传母性效应的选择背景下，此公式扩展了基础模型(15.21)，为后续推导母性效应下的遗传参数和选择响应提供表达式。

formula-notes:formula_15.35b:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the total response to selection in the direct trait z as the sum of the direct response R_d(t) and the maternal contribution m R_m(t-1), where m is the maternal effect coefficient and R_m(t-1) is the response in the maternal trait in the previous generation.
formula-notes:formula_15.35b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on selection with heritable maternal effects to decompose the evolutionary change in z into direct and indirect maternal components, supporting later arguments about how maternal inheritance alters the dynamics of response to selection.

formula-notes:formula_15.34b:zh.plainMeaning: 该不等式给出了母体效应参数 m 的一个上界条件：当 m 大于 (3 - sqrt(1+8h^2))/2 时，选择松弛后响应会持续若干代。其中 h^2 是狭义遗传力。
formula-notes:formula_15.34b:zh.inThisChapter: 本节区分永久响应与瞬态响应，该不等式与 m<0 并列，用于界定母体效应足够大（正方向）时瞬态分量衰减缓慢，从而在松弛选择后仍能观察到持续几代的响应。

formula-notes:formula_15.36a:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the direct response to selection (R_d(t)) as a function of selection gradients on the direct trait (β_z(t)) and maternal effect (β_m(t)), weighted by additive genetic variances and covariances (G_dd, G_md) and the maternal inheritance coefficient (m).
formula-notes:formula_15.36a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on selection with heritable maternal effects to decompose the evolutionary response into direct and maternal components, and it supports the derivation of the total response R_z(t) in Equation 15.36c.

formula-notes:formula_15.35b:zh.plainMeaning: 公式 (15.35b) 将子代性状 z 的总响应 R_z(t) 分解为两部分：直接遗传响应 R_d(t) 和母体遗传响应 m R_m(t-1)，其中 m 是母体效应系数，R_m(t-1) 是上一代母体性状的响应。
formula-notes:formula_15.35b:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在讨论存在可遗传母体效应时的选择响应章节，它扩展了经典选择响应公式，将母体对子代性状的间接影响纳入总响应中，为后续推导多性状联合响应或预测长期进化动态奠定基础。

formula-notes:formula_15.34a:zh.plainMeaning: 该不等式给出了在短期选择响应中，当均值回归系数 m 为正且小于 1 时，出现响应侵蚀（即累积响应在放松选择后部分丧失）的条件：m 必须小于 (3 - √(1+8h²))/2，其中 h² 是遗传力。
formula-notes:formula_15.34a:zh.inThisChapter: 本节讨论永久性与瞬时性响应，公式(15.34a)为后续公式(15.34b)中定义侵蚀程度提供了阈值条件，帮助区分哪些参数组合会导致响应部分可逆。

formula-notes:formula_15.36c:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the total evolutionary response in the offspring trait (R_z(t)) as the sum of the direct response (R_d(t)), a maternal contribution from the previous generation (m R_m(t-1)), and a term accounting for changes in selection gradients (Δβ) weighted by phenotypic covariances (P_mm and P_mz).
formula-notes:formula_15.36c:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on selection with heritable maternal effects to show how the response in the offspring trait depends on both direct and maternal responses, as well as temporal changes in selection, supporting the analysis of evolutionary dynamics under maternal inheritance.

formula-notes:formula_15.36a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算直接遗传响应 R_d(t)，它等于直接加性遗传方差 G_dd 与一半母体效应 m 乘以直接-母体遗传协方差 G_md 之和乘以直接选择梯度 β_z(t)，再加上 G_md 乘以母体选择梯度 β_m(t)。
formula-notes:formula_15.36a:zh.inThisChapter: 本章讨论存在可遗传母体效应时的选择响应，该公式与(15.36b)共同给出直接和母体性状的响应方程，为后续推导总响应 R_z(t) 的(15.36c)提供直接组分。

formula-notes:formula_15.36b:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the response to selection in the maternal component (Rm) as a linear combination of selection gradients on the offspring trait (βz) and on the maternal effect (βm), weighted by genetic variances and covariances (Gmd, Gmm) and the degree of maternal inheritance (m).
formula-notes:formula_15.36b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on selection with heritable maternal effects to describe how maternal genetic variation contributes to evolutionary change, supporting the joint dynamics of direct and maternal components in equations 15.36a–c.

formula-notes:formula_15.36b:zh.plainMeaning: 公式(15.36b)计算母体性状响应R_m(t)，它等于母体加性遗传方差G_mm与直接加性遗传方差G_md的线性组合乘以选择梯度β_z(t)，再加上母体加性遗传方差G_mm乘以母体选择梯度β_m(t)。
formula-notes:formula_15.36b:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式与(15.36a)共同描述直接和母体性状对选择响应的联合动态，为后续推导总响应R_z(t)的(15.36c)提供母体响应分量。

formula-notes:formula_15.36c:zh.plainMeaning: 公式(15.36c)计算总选择响应R_z(t)，它等于直接响应R_d(t)加上母体效应延迟项m R_m(t-1)，再加上母体表型方差P_mm和协方差P_mz加权的选择梯度变化量Δβ_m(t-1)和Δβ_z(t-1)的线性组合。
formula-notes:formula_15.36c:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在讨论可遗传母体效应下选择响应的章节，它整合了直接响应和母体效应的滞后影响，为后续分析母体效应如何改变进化轨迹提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_15.38b:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the response to selection in the offspring trait (R_z) as a function of the selection gradient on that trait (β_z) and the additive genetic variances and covariances (G_dd, G_md, G_mm) under the assumption of no direct selection on the maternal performance trait (β_m = 0).
formula-notes:formula_15.38b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on selection with heritable maternal effects to show how the offspring trait evolves when maternal performance is not directly selected, supporting the analysis of indirect selection responses through genetic correlations.

formula-notes:formula_15.38a:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the response to selection in the maternal performance trait (R_m) as a function of the additive genetic covariance between direct and maternal effects (G_md), half the maternal additive genetic variance (G_mm), and the selection gradient on the offspring trait (β_z).
formula-notes:formula_15.38a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in this section to show how, when there is no direct selection on the maternal trait (β_m=0), the response in the maternal trait depends only on the selection gradient on the offspring trait and the genetic covariance structure, supporting the derivation of the joint response equations (15.38b–e).

formula-notes:formula_15.37b:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the response to selection in the maternal effect (Rm) and the direct trait (Rz) after the first generation, assuming selection gradients are constant. Key symbols: Rm(t) = response in maternal effect at generation t, Rz(t) = response in direct trait, G's = genetic (co)variances (dd=direct, mm=maternal, md=cross), m = maternal effect coefficient, βz and βm = selection gradients on direct and maternal components.
formula-notes:formula_15.37b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on selection with heritable maternal effects to show how the response equations simplify when selection gradients are constant (Δβ=0). This supports later arguments about the asymptotic rate of response and the role of maternal inheritance in evolutionary dynamics.
