formula-notes:formula_19.5e:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算预测育种值误差（估计值减真实值）的方差-协方差矩阵，其中关键符号：σ_e^2为残差方差，Z为设计矩阵，M为吸收固定效应的投影矩阵，λ=σ_e^2/σ_a^2为方差比，A为加性遗传相关矩阵。
formula-notes:formula_19.5e:zh.inThisChapter: 在短期选择实验的混合模型分析中，此式从式19.5c推导而来，为后续计算预测误差方差（如式19.5f）和评估预测准确性提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_19.5d:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将育种值估计值â的方差分解为预测误差方差Var(â−a)和真实育种值方差Var(a)之和，其中预测误差方差等于σ_e²C₂₂，真实育种值方差等于σ_A²A。
formula-notes:formula_19.5d:zh.inThisChapter: 在短时选择实验的混合模型分析中，此公式用于量化估计育种值的不确定性，为后续推导预测误差方差和计算选择响应提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_19.5f:en.plainMeaning: This formula gives the covariance between the estimated fixed effects (β̂) and the prediction errors (â - a) as σ_e² times C₁₂, where σ_e² is the residual variance and C₁₂ is a submatrix from the inverse of the mixed model coefficient matrix.
formula-notes:formula_19.5f:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the mixed-model analysis of selection experiments to characterize the joint distribution of estimators and predictors, supporting later inference on selection response and hypothesis testing.

formula-notes:formula_19.6a:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the restricted likelihood L(σ) as a quadratic function of the variance component vector σ, where b0 is a scalar intercept, b1 is a v×1 vector of linear coefficients, and Q is a v×v symmetric matrix of quadratic coefficients.
formula-notes:formula_19.6a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the basics of mixed-model analysis to approximate the restricted likelihood surface near the REML solution, enabling efficient estimation of variance components via a quadratic fit, which is later used for inference or optimization.

formula-notes:formula_19.5e:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the variance-covariance matrix of the prediction error (estimated minus true breeding values) in a mixed model, where σ²_e is residual variance, Z is the design matrix for individuals, M is a projection matrix, λ = σ²_e/σ²_a is the variance ratio, and A is the additive genetic relationship matrix.
formula-notes:formula_19.5e:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the mixed-model analysis of selection experiments to provide an expression for the prediction error variance, which is used to assess the accuracy of estimated breeding values and to support later derivations of confidence intervals or hypothesis tests.

formula-notes:formula_19.5c:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算预测误差向量 (â - a) 的方差-协方差矩阵，等于残差方差 σ_e² 乘以矩阵 C₂₂，其中 C₂₂ 来自混合模型方程组的系数矩阵的逆矩阵的对应分块。
formula-notes:formula_19.5c:zh.inThisChapter: 在本节中，该公式用于量化育种值预测的精度（PEV），为后续推导预测误差方差以及评估选择响应估计的可靠性提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_19.6b:en.plainMeaning: This formula approximates the variance-covariance matrix of the REML estimates (vector σ̂) as the negative inverse of twice the matrix Q, where Q is the second derivative matrix of the restricted log-likelihood.
formula-notes:formula_19.6b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on basics of mixed-model analysis to provide a computationally tractable approximation for the uncertainty of variance component estimates, supporting later inference and hypothesis testing in mixed models.

formula-notes:formula_19.6b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算REML估计向量 $\widehat{\boldsymbol{\sigma}}$ 的近似协方差矩阵，等于负二倍黑塞矩阵 $\mathbf{Q}$ 的逆矩阵。
formula-notes:formula_19.6b:zh.inThisChapter: 在混合模型分析基础章节中，该公式用于量化方差组分估计的不确定性，为后续假设检验和标准误计算提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_19.6a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式用二次回归曲面来近似受限似然函数 L(σ)，其中 b₀ 是标量截距，b₁ 是 v×1 线性系数向量，Q 是 v×v 对称矩阵，包含方差分量 σ 的二次项系数。
formula-notes:formula_19.6a:zh.inThisChapter: 出现在 REML 求解的数值优化部分，通过拟合二次曲面来逼近真实似然函数，为后续利用该二次型求导得到 REML 估计的迭代公式（如 19.6b）做铺垫。

formula-notes:formula_19.5f:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算估计的固定效应向量 $\widehat{\boldsymbol{\beta}}$ 与预测误差 $\widehat{\mathbf{a}}-\mathbf{a}$ 之间的协方差矩阵，等于残差方差 $\sigma_e^2$ 乘以混合模型方程系数矩阵逆的对应子块 $\mathbf{C}_{12}$。
formula-notes:formula_19.5f:zh.inThisChapter: 在短期选择实验的混合模型分析中，该公式用于量化固定效应估计与随机效应预测误差之间的相关性，为后续推导预测误差方差和置信区间提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_19.5a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将混合模型方程组系数矩阵的逆矩阵分块为四个子矩阵，其中C11、C12和C22分别对应固定效应β和随机效应a的方差-协方差子矩阵。
formula-notes:formula_19.5a:zh.inThisChapter: 本章通过分块逆矩阵（19.5a）从混合模型方程组（19.4）导出BLUE和BLUP的抽样方差-协方差矩阵（19.5b-19.5f），为后续进行假设检验和置信区间估计提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_19.7a:en.plainMeaning: This formula expresses the observed phenotypic value y_{ij} as the sum of an overall mean μ, the breeding value a_{ij} of the jth individual in generation i, and a residual e_{ij} representing the deviation between breeding and phenotypic values.
formula-notes:formula_19.7a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the animal-model analysis of selection experiments to partition phenotypic variation into additive genetic and environmental components, supporting the estimation of genetic parameters and response to selection in later equations (19.7b–d).

formula-notes:formula_19.7a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将第i代第j个个体的表型值y_{ij}分解为总体均值μ、育种值a_{ij}和残差e_{ij}之和，其中e_{ij}是表型值与育种值之差。
formula-notes:formula_19.7a:zh.inThisChapter: 在本节中，该公式作为最简单的动物模型，为后续引入更复杂的模型（如包含固定效应的模型19.7b-19.7d）奠定基础，并用于分析选择实验中的遗传响应。

formula-notes:formula_19.7b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将观测值向量 y 分解为总体均值 μ 乘以全1向量 1、育种值向量 a 和残差向量 e 之和，其中 a 的方差为 σ_A^2 A。
formula-notes:formula_19.7b:zh.inThisChapter: 在动物模型分析选择实验的章节中，该公式简化了混合模型方程（式19.1），将固定效应仅保留均值，为后续估计育种值和方差组分提供基础模型。

formula-notes:formula_19.8a:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the estimated mean breeding value in generation k by averaging the individual breeding-value estimates (â_{kj}) of all n_k individuals in that generation.
formula-notes:formula_19.8a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the animal-model analysis section to provide a simple estimator of the population mean breeding value per generation, which is then used to calculate cumulative selection response (e.g., in Equation 19.8b).

formula-notes:formula_19.7b:en.plainMeaning: This formula expresses the observed phenotype vector y as the sum of the overall mean μ (multiplied by a vector of ones 1), the vector of breeding values a, and the residual vector e. It is a simplified animal model with only the mean as a fixed effect.
formula-notes:formula_19.7b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the context of animal-model analysis of selection experiments to show the simplest case where the only fixed effect is the mean, reducing the general mixed model (Equation 19.1) to a form that directly estimates breeding values and variance components.

formula-notes:formula_19.8b:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the vector of estimated mean breeding values for generations 0 to t-1 by multiplying the transpose of the K matrix with the vector of estimated individual breeding values. The K matrix has rows that average the breeding values of individuals within each generation.
formula-notes:formula_19.8b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the animal-model analysis of selection experiments to show how generation means are derived from individual estimates, supporting the estimation of cumulative selection response across generations.

formula-notes:formula_19.8b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式通过矩阵乘法 K^T 乘以个体育种值估计向量 â，得到各世代平均育种值的估计向量 â̄，其中 â̄ 的第 k 个元素是第 k 世代个体的平均育种值估计。
formula-notes:formula_19.8b:zh.inThisChapter: 在动物模型分析选择实验的章节中，该公式将个体水平的育种值估计转换为世代平均育种值估计，为后续计算累积选择响应（如公式 19.8c）提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_19.7c:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the best linear unbiased estimates (BLUE) of the overall mean μ and best linear unbiased predictions (BLUP) of breeding values a, given the total number of individuals n, the vector of phenotypes y, the average phenotype ȳ, the additive genetic relationship matrix A, and the variance ratio λ = σ_e²/σ_A².
formula-notes:formula_19.7c:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on animal-model analysis of selection experiments to provide a simplified mixed-model equation when residual variance is homogeneous (Var(e)=σ_e²I), enabling estimation of genetic parameters and prediction of breeding values in selection experiments.

formula-notes:formula_19.8a:zh.plainMeaning: 公式(19.8a)计算第k代平均育种值的估计值，它是该代所有个体育种值估计值的算术平均，其中n_k是第k代个体数，â_kj是第j个个体的育种值估计。
formula-notes:formula_19.8a:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在动物模型分析选择实验的章节中，用于从个体育种值估计得到世代平均育种值，为后续计算累积选择响应（公式19.8b）和绘制响应曲线提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_19.9:en.plainMeaning: This formula models the phenotype of the k-th individual in population j at generation t as the sum of an overall mean μ, an environmental trend b_{j,t}, an additive genetic effect a_{j,tk}, and a residual error e_{j,tk}.
formula-notes:formula_19.9:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the animal-model analysis of selection experiments to decompose phenotypic variation into genetic and environmental components, supporting later arguments that differences between selected and control populations can be attributed to genetic change if environmental trends are equal.

formula-notes:formula_19.7d:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the prediction error (co)variance matrix for the mixed model equations, where C11 is the variance of fixed effect estimates, C22 is the prediction error variance of BLUPs, and C12 is their covariance; n is the number of records, 1 is a vector of ones, I is the identity matrix, λ is the variance ratio, and A⁻¹ is the inverse numerator relationship matrix.
formula-notes:formula_19.7d:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the animal-model analysis of selection experiments to provide the sampling variances and covariances needed for hypothesis testing and for constructing confidence intervals for genetic parameters and breeding values.

formula-notes:formula_19.10:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将选择群体与对照群体在t代的表型均值之差分解为两部分：育种值均值之差（$\overline{a}_{s,t}-\overline{a}_{c,t}$）加上残差均值之差（$e_{s,t}-e_{c,t}$）。
formula-notes:formula_19.10:zh.inThisChapter: 在共同环境效应相等的假设下，该公式用于分离遗传响应与环境噪声，为后续利用对照群体无偏估计选择群体的育种值均值变化提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_19.8c:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the sampling covariance matrix of the estimated genotypic means vector (â), where σ²ₑ is the residual variance, K is a design matrix relating genotypes to observations, and C₂₂ is a matrix from the mixed model equations (Equation 19.7d or 19.5a).
formula-notes:formula_19.8c:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the animal-model analysis of selection experiments to quantify the precision of estimated genotypic means, supporting later inference on selection responses and hypothesis tests.

formula-notes:formula_19.7d:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式给出了固定效应估计的预测误差方差矩阵 C11、育种值BLUP的预测误差方差矩阵 C22 以及两者之间的协方差矩阵 C12，它们等于左侧分块矩阵的逆矩阵，其中 n 是观测数，1 是全1向量，I 是单位阵，λ 是方差比，A⁻¹ 是分子关系矩阵的逆。
formula-notes:formula_19.7d:zh.inThisChapter: 在本节中，该公式用于量化选择实验中固定效应和随机效应（育种值）估计的不确定性，为后续推断遗传进展和检验选择响应提供误差协方差结构。

formula-notes:formula_19.7c:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式给出了在残差方差为σ_e² I且无遗传协方差时，混合模型方程组（19.4）的简化形式，其中左侧向量包含总体均值μ的估计和n维育种值向量a的估计，右侧向量由总观测数n、均值ȳ和观测向量y构成，系数矩阵包含单位矩阵I、λA⁻¹以及全1向量1。
formula-notes:formula_19.7c:zh.inThisChapter: 本节推导选择实验中动物模型的分析方法，该公式是混合模型方程（19.4）在残差独立同分布假设下的特例，为后续计算育种值预测值（如公式19.7d）提供了可直接求解的线性系统。

formula-notes:formula_19.8c:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算估计的基因型均值向量â的抽样协方差矩阵，等于残差方差σ_e²乘以Kᵀ、C₂₂和K的乘积，其中K是设计矩阵，C₂₂是混合模型方程中与随机效应相关的子矩阵的逆。
formula-notes:formula_19.8c:zh.inThisChapter: 本章推导选择实验中动物模型的分析方法，该公式基于方差传播规则（公式8.21b）从â的表达式（19.8a）导出，为后续检验选择响应或计算标准误提供协方差结构。

formula-notes:formula_19.10:en.plainMeaning: This formula expresses the difference in phenotypic means between selected and control populations as the sum of the difference in mean breeding values and the difference in residuals. Key symbols: \(\overline{y}_{s,t}\) and \(\overline{y}_{c,t}\) are phenotypic means; \(\overline{a}_{s,t}\) and \(\overline{a}_{c,t}\) are mean breeding values; \(e_{s,t}\) and \(e_{c,t}\) are residuals.
formula-notes:formula_19.10:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on animal-model analysis of selection experiments to show that, under the assumption of equal common environmental values, the phenotypic contrast isolates the genetic response to selection, supporting later arguments about unbiased estimation of \(\overline{a}_{s,t}\).

formula-notes:formula_19.11:zh.plainMeaning: 公式(19.11)将第t代第k个体的表型值y_{tk}分解为总体均值μ、第t代共同环境效应b_t、个体加性遗传效应a_{tk}和残差e_{tk}。
formula-notes:formula_19.11:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式在基本动物模型基础上引入固定效应b_t以刻画世代间的共同环境差异，为后续估计遗传参数和检验选择响应提供模型基础。

formula-notes:formula_19.9:zh.plainMeaning: 公式将个体观测值 y_{j,t k} 分解为总体均值 μ、群体-世代环境效应 b_{j,t}、个体加性遗传效应 a_{j,t k} 和残差 e_{j,t k}，其中下标 j 表示群体（如选择群或对照群），t 表示世代，k 表示个体编号。
formula-notes:formula_19.9:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在选择实验的动物模型分析中，为后续推导选择群与对照群之间的差异（如 d_t = y_{s,t} - y_{c,t}）提供基础，通过假设 b_{s,t} = b_{c,t} 来分离遗传响应与环境趋势。

formula-notes:formula_19.11:en.plainMeaning: This formula models the phenotype y_{tk} as the sum of the overall mean μ, a fixed common-environment effect b_t for generation t, the additive genetic value a_{tk} of individual k, and a residual error e_{tk}.
formula-notes:formula_19.11:en.inThisChapter: It extends the basic animal model to account for shared environmental influences within generations, which is essential for unbiased estimation of genetic parameters in selection experiments where generations are reared in separate environments.

formula-notes:formula_19.13:en.plainMeaning: This formula gives the covariance matrix of breeding values across generations t to T, with σ²_A(t) as the additive genetic variance in generation t and A_{j,k} as the relationship matrix between generations j and k.
formula-notes:formula_19.13:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on animal-model analysis of selection experiments to model the genetic covariance structure when generation t is treated as the base population, supporting later estimation of genetic parameters and selection responses.

formula-notes:formula_19.12a:en.plainMeaning: This formula models the observed phenotype y for individual i in generation t of line k as the sum of an overall mean μ, a generation-specific environmental effect b_t, an additive genetic value a, and a residual e.
formula-notes:formula_19.12a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the animal-model analysis of selection experiments to partition phenotypic variance into genetic and environmental components, supporting the estimation of breeding values and genetic trends across generations.

formula-notes:formula_19.15a:en.plainMeaning: This formula expresses an individual's breeding value (A_i) as the average of its parents' breeding values (A_f_i and A_m_i) plus a segregation residual (s_i) due to Mendelian sampling.
formula-notes:formula_19.15a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to mixed-model and Bayesian approaches for analyzing short-term selection experiments, providing the genetic model that underlies the variance component estimation and prediction of breeding values in later sections.

formula-notes:formula_19.12a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将第k个品系第t世代第i个个体的观测值y分解为总体均值μ、世代环境效应b_t、加性遗传效应a_{k,ti}和残差e_{k,ti}之和。
formula-notes:formula_19.12a:zh.inThisChapter: 本节通过此线性模型将表型方差分解为遗传和环境组分，为后续推导品系间响应差异（如公式19.12b）提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_19.14:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the estimated additive genetic variance within generation t as the sample variance of predicted breeding values (â_ti) around their mean (â̄_t), divided by n_t - 1.
formula-notes:formula_19.14:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on animal-model analysis of selection experiments to provide a direct estimate of additive variance from predicted breeding values, supporting later arguments about genetic change and response to selection.

formula-notes:formula_19.12b:en.plainMeaning: This formula models the phenotype y for individual i in line k at time t as the sum of an overall mean μ, a line-by-time fixed effect b_{k,t}, an additive genetic value a_{k,ti}, and a residual e_{k,ti}.
formula-notes:formula_19.12b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on animal-model analysis of selection experiments to allow line-specific environmental effects over time, supporting the comparison of genetic responses across lines when environmental trends differ.

formula-notes:formula_19.15b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算个体i的孟德尔抽样方差σ_{s_i}^2，它等于(1 - 父母平均近交系数f̄_i)乘以加性遗传方差σ_a^2的一半。
formula-notes:formula_19.15b:zh.inThisChapter: 在短期选择实验分析中，该公式用于量化个体i因亲本配子抽样产生的遗传变异，为后续构建混合模型或贝叶斯模型中的随机效应方差提供依据。

formula-notes:formula_19.15b:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the variance of the Mendelian sampling term for individual i, denoted σ²_{s_i}, as half the additive genetic variance σ²_a scaled by (1 - the average inbreeding coefficient of its parents, f̄_i).
formula-notes:formula_19.15b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to mixed-model and Bayesian approaches for short-term selection experiments to quantify how inbreeding reduces the genetic variance contributed by Mendelian sampling, which is essential for modeling genetic drift and selection response in structured populations.

formula-notes:formula_19.13:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算从世代 t 到 T 的育种值向量的协方差矩阵，等于基础世代 t 的加性遗传方差 σ_A^2(t) 乘以一个分块矩阵，其中对角块是单位阵 I（世代 t 内）或世代内亲缘关系矩阵（如 A_{t+1,t+1}），非对角块是世代间亲缘关系矩阵（如 A_{t,t+1}）。
formula-notes:formula_19.13:zh.inThisChapter: 在动物模型分析选择实验的章节中，该公式用于将世代 t 设为参考群体，从而构建从 t 到 T 各世代育种值的联合分布，为后续基于该协方差结构进行方差组分估计或预测奠定基础。

formula-notes:formula_19.12b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将第k个品系在第t代第i个个体的表型值y_{k,ti}分解为总体均值μ、品系-世代固定效应b_{k,t}、加性遗传效应a_{k,ti}和残差e_{k,ti}，其中b_{k,t}替代了原模型中的世代效应t和品系效应l，允许不同品系有各自的环境效应。
formula-notes:formula_19.12b:zh.inThisChapter: 在19.12a基础上，本节通过引入品系-世代交互效应b_{k,t}来放宽环境效应在品系间相同的假设，为后续比较不同品系选择响应及估计遗传参数提供更灵活的模型框架。

formula-notes:formula_19.14:zh.plainMeaning: 公式(19.14)计算第t代内预测育种值(â_ti)的样本方差，其中â_ti是个体i的预测育种值，â̄_t是该代所有个体预测育种值的均值，n_t是样本量，分母n_t-1用于无偏估计。
formula-notes:formula_19.14:zh.inThisChapter: 本节讨论选择实验中加性遗传方差的估计方法，该公式提供了一种基于预测育种值（来自动物模型BLUP）的方差估计，为后续比较不同估计方法（如基于选择响应或亲缘关系）的优劣奠定基础。

formula-notes:formula_19.15a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将个体i的育种值A_i表示为父本育种值A_f_i的一半、母本育种值A_m_i的一半，再加上一个分离残差s_i，其中s_i代表亲本杂合位点等位基因分离导致的孟德尔抽样变异。
formula-notes:formula_19.15a:zh.inThisChapter: 本章引入混合模型和贝叶斯方法分析短期选择实验，该公式作为基础回归方程，将个体育种值分解为亲本均值与孟德尔抽样项，为后续构建随机效应模型（如将s_i视为随机效应）和估计方差组分提供理论依据。

formula-notes:formula_19.16:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the diagonal element F_{ii} of the inverse relationship matrix, representing one minus the average inbreeding coefficient of the parents of individual i. Key symbols: F_{ii} (diagonal of A^{-1}), f_i (inbreeding coefficient of i), f_k, f_j (inbreeding of parents), A_{kk}, A_{jj} (diagonals of relationship matrix A).
formula-notes:formula_19.16:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction of mixed-model and Bayesian approaches to show how the inverse relationship matrix is constructed from parent inbreeding, supporting later arguments on modeling Mendelian sampling terms in selection experiments.

formula-notes:formula_19.16:zh.plainMeaning: 公式(19.16)计算个体i的对角元素F_{ii}，它等于1减去其父母k和j的平均近交系数，也等于2减去父母k和j的A矩阵对角元素A_{kk}和A_{jj}的平均值，其中A_{kk}=1+f_k。
formula-notes:formula_19.16:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在介绍混合模型和贝叶斯方法分析短期选择实验的章节中，用于定义对角矩阵F，该矩阵用于调整孟德尔抽样项s的分布，使其不受亲本育种值的影响，为后续构建混合模型方程提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_19.17a:en.plainMeaning: This formula expresses the vector of breeding values a as a linear transformation of the vector w, which concatenates base population breeding values a_b and Mendelian segregation values s, via the lower-triangular matrix T that describes gene flow from ancestors to relatives.
formula-notes:formula_19.17a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to mixed-model and Bayesian approaches for short-term selection experiments to formally decompose breeding values into ancestral and segregation components, setting up the structure for the mixed model equations (e.g., Equation 19.17b) that relate observed data to these components.

formula-notes:formula_19.17b:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the element T_{i,j} of the T matrix for descendant i and ancestor j (j < i) as the average of the corresponding elements for i's father (f) and mother (m).
formula-notes:formula_19.17b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the mixed-model/Bayesian approach to short-term selection experiments to recursively build the T matrix, which decomposes breeding values into base population contributions, supporting inference of additive genetic variance.

formula-notes:formula_19.17b:zh.plainMeaning: 公式 (19.17b) 计算个体 i 的 T 矩阵中第 i 行第 j 列元素（j < i），等于其父亲 f 和母亲 m 的 T 矩阵中对应第 j 列元素的平均值。
formula-notes:formula_19.17b:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式与 (19.17a) 共同将育种值分解为祖先贡献的线性组合，为后续基于混合模型或贝叶斯方法估计方差组分和预测育种值提供递归计算基础。

formula-notes:formula_19.18a:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the variance of breeding values (a) as the variance of transformed base-generation contributions (Tw), which equals T times the variance of w times T transpose. Key symbols: a = vector of breeding values, T = matrix of transmission coefficients, w = vector of base-generation contributions.
formula-notes:formula_19.18a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to mixed-model and Bayesian approaches for short-term selection experiments to show how the variance of breeding values can be expressed in terms of base population variance and the T matrix, supporting later derivations of variance components and prediction of breeding values.

formula-notes:formula_19.17a:zh.plainMeaning: 公式 (19.17a) 将 n×1 的加性遗传值向量 a 分解为矩阵 T 与向量 w 的乘积，其中 w 由 (n-m)×1 的基向量 a_b（基础群体的加性遗传值）和 m×1 的 s（孟德尔分离值）组成。
formula-notes:formula_19.17a:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在介绍混合模型和贝叶斯方法的章节，通过将 a 表示为 T 与 w 的乘积，为后续推导 a 的协方差结构（如公式 19.17b）提供基础，从而将选择实验中的遗传变异分解为祖先贡献和新分离变异。

formula-notes:formula_19.18b:en.plainMeaning: This formula expresses the variance-covariance matrix of the vector w (combining base population additive genetic values a_b and selection responses s) as σ_a^2 times a block-diagonal matrix with identity I for a_b and F/2 for s, which equals σ_a^2 A, where A is the numerator relationship matrix.
formula-notes:formula_19.18b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the mixed-model analysis of selection experiments to specify the joint variance structure of base and selection effects, supporting the derivation of BLUP and REML estimators for genetic parameters.

formula-notes:formula_19.18c:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将加性遗传相关矩阵A分解为下三角矩阵T、对角矩阵Λ（特征值）和T的转置的乘积，其中T的列是A的特征向量，Λ的对角元是特征值。
formula-notes:formula_19.18c:zh.inThisChapter: 在章节中，此分解用于利用T的简单形式快速计算A的逆矩阵A⁻¹，为后续基于混合模型和贝叶斯方法的短期选择实验分析提供计算效率。

formula-notes:formula_19.18c:en.plainMeaning: This formula expresses the additive genetic relationship matrix A as a product of a lower triangular matrix T, a diagonal matrix Λ of eigenvalues, and the transpose of T, under the assumption of no disequilibrium in the base population.
formula-notes:formula_19.18c:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to mixed-model and Bayesian approaches for short-term selection experiments, providing a decomposition that enables rapid computation of A⁻¹, which is essential for efficient mixed-model analysis.

formula-notes:formula_19.19:en.plainMeaning: This formula expresses the variance-covariance matrix of breeding values a (partitioned into a1 and a2) as a sum of two components, each involving a transformation matrix T, block-specific additive genetic relationship matrices A1 and A2, and variance components σ²_a(1) and σ²_a(2).
formula-notes:formula_19.19:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to mixed-model and Bayesian approaches for short-term selection experiments to model heterogeneous genetic variances across blocks, supporting later estimation of variance components and prediction of breeding values.

formula-notes:formula_19.18a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将育种值向量a的方差-协方差矩阵表示为转换矩阵T乘以加性遗传效应向量w的方差-协方差矩阵再乘以T的转置，即Var(a)=T Var(w) T^T。
formula-notes:formula_19.18a:zh.inThisChapter: 在19.18a中，通过将育种值a表示为T与w的乘积（来自19.17a），利用方差运算性质导出Var(a)与Var(w)的关系，为后续假设Var(w)=Iσ²_A并推导Var(a)=T T^T σ²_A（即Aσ²_A）奠定基础。

formula-notes:formula_19.20a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将观测向量 y 表示为固定效应 Xβ、加性遗传效应 Za、共同家庭效应 Wu 和残差 e 的线性组合，其中 W 是 n×m 的关联矩阵，u 是 m 个随机共同家庭效应。
formula-notes:formula_19.20a:zh.inThisChapter: 在基本动物模型（公式 19.1）基础上引入第二个随机效应向量 u（共同家庭效应），为后续推导包含共同环境效应的混合模型方程组（如公式 19.20b、19.20c）奠定基础。

formula-notes:formula_19.20a:en.plainMeaning: This formula extends the basic animal model by adding a term for common-family effects (e.g., shared environment or genetic group effects). It expresses the phenotype vector y as the sum of fixed effects (Xβ), additive genetic effects (Za), common-family effects (Wu), and residuals (e).
formula-notes:formula_19.20a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on modifications of the basic animal model to account for additional random effects beyond breeding values, such as common-family effects. This model is used to partition phenotypic variance more accurately and to support subsequent derivations of variance components and prediction equations.

formula-notes:formula_19.18b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将向量 w（包含基础群体加性遗传效应 a_b 和后代育种值 s）的方差-协方差矩阵表示为 σ_a^2 乘以矩阵 A，其中 A 是分块对角矩阵，左上角为单位阵 I（对应 a_b 的方差），右下角为 F/2（对应 s 的方差，F 为亲本间亲缘关系矩阵）。
formula-notes:formula_19.18b:zh.inThisChapter: 在短期选择实验的混合模型分析中，该公式整合了基础群体和后代遗传效应的方差结构，为后续构建 w 的多元正态分布以及推导似然函数或贝叶斯后验提供了关键的协方差矩阵表达式。

formula-notes:formula_19.19:zh.plainMeaning: 公式(19.19)计算育种值向量a的方差-协方差矩阵，其中a被分为两个区块a1和a2，分别对应不同的遗传方差组分σ_a²(1)和σ_a²(2)，并通过变换矩阵T将分块对角矩阵A1和A2映射到原始空间。
formula-notes:formula_19.19:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在混合模型与贝叶斯方法介绍中，用于构建短期选择试验中育种值的协方差结构，为后续推导方差组分估计和预测奠定基础。

formula-notes:formula_19.20c:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the total phenotypic variance-covariance matrix V of the observed vector y as the sum of additive genetic variance (σ²_A) via the relationship matrix A, a second random effect variance (σ²_u) via its design matrix W, and residual variance (σ²_e) times identity I.
formula-notes:formula_19.20c:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the modifications section to extend the basic animal model by including an additional random effect (e.g., maternal or permanent environment), supporting later estimation of variance components and prediction of breeding values under this extended model.

formula-notes:formula_19.20b:en.plainMeaning: This formula expresses the variance-covariance matrix of the three random vectors (additive genetic effects a, permanent environmental effects u, and residuals e) as a block-diagonal matrix, where a has variance σ_A² A, u has variance σ_u² I, e has variance σ_e² I, and all covariances between different vectors are zero.
formula-notes:formula_19.20b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on modifications of the basic animal model to compactly state the assumed uncorrelated structure among random effects, which is then used to derive the variance of the observation vector y in equation (19.20c).

formula-notes:formula_19.20c:zh.plainMeaning: 公式(19.20c)将动物模型中的表型协方差矩阵V分解为加性遗传效应方差σ_A²乘以亲缘关系矩阵A经Z变换后的项、永久环境效应方差σ_u²乘以W及其转置的项、以及残差方差σ_e²乘以单位阵I的项。
formula-notes:formula_19.20c:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在基本动物模型扩展部分，基于(19.20a)和(19.20b)的方差结构推导而来，为后续利用V进行BLUP求解或REML估计提供协方差矩阵的具体表达式。

formula-notes:formula_19.21b:en.plainMeaning: This formula defines two variance ratios: λ_A = σ_e² / σ_A² and λ_u = σ_e² / σ_u², where σ_e² is the residual variance, σ_A² is the additive genetic variance, and σ_u² is the permanent environmental variance.
formula-notes:formula_19.21b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on modifications of the basic animal model to provide the scaling factors needed in the mixed model equations (19.21a) for models with both additive genetic and permanent environmental random effects.

formula-notes:formula_19.20b:zh.plainMeaning: 该矩阵表示三个随机向量（加性遗传效应a、永久环境效应u、残差e）的方差-协方差矩阵，其中a的方差为σ_A²乘以亲缘关系矩阵A，u和e的方差分别为σ_u²和σ_e²乘以单位矩阵I，且三者互不相关（非对角线为零）。
formula-notes:formula_19.20b:zh.inThisChapter: 在基本动物模型扩展中，此公式将a、u、e的方差结构紧凑表达为分块对角矩阵，为后续推导y的方差-协方差矩阵V（公式19.20c）提供基础，即通过Z和W矩阵将各随机效应方差映射到观测值y上。

formula-notes:formula_19.22:en.plainMeaning: This formula expresses the vector of breeding values for all individuals (base and remaining) as a linear function of itself plus a vector of segregational residuals, where the matrix contains identity and zero blocks for base individuals and parent-average matrices P1 and P2 for remaining individuals.
formula-notes:formula_19.22:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on modifications of the basic animal model to show how remaining individuals' breeding values depend on base population values and segregational residuals, supporting the derivation of mixed model equations for populations with base and non-base individuals.

formula-notes:formula_19.22:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将育种值向量分解为基群育种值 a_b 和后代育种值 a_r，其中 a_r 通过亲本贡献矩阵 P1、P2 与 a_b 及自身线性相关，再加上分离残差向量 s。
formula-notes:formula_19.22:zh.inThisChapter: 本节修改基本动物模型，该公式用于表达后代育种值对基群育种值的依赖关系，为后续构建混合模型方程（MME）中处理基群与后代随机效应提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_19.23:en.plainMeaning: This formula defines a mixed model where the phenotype vector y is modeled as a linear combination of fixed effects (Xβ), two random genetic effects: a_b (breeding values) with incidence matrix Z1, and a_r (residual genetic effects) with incidence matrix Z2, plus residual error e.
formula-notes:formula_19.23:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on modifications of the basic animal model to incorporate a second random genetic effect (a_r) that accounts for additional genetic variation not captured by a_b, supporting later arguments about partitioning genetic variance and improving model fit.

formula-notes:formula_19.21a:en.plainMeaning: This is the mixed-model equations (MME) for an animal model with two random effects: additive genetic (a) and permanent environmental (u). The left-hand side is a block matrix relating fixed effects (β), additive genetic effects (a), and permanent environmental effects (u) to the right-hand side vector of crossproducts with the response y. λ_A and λ_u are variance ratios (residual variance over respective variance components).
formula-notes:formula_19.21a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on modifications of the basic animal model to incorporate an additional random effect (permanent environment). The equations extend the standard MME (Equation 19.4) by adding a block for W and the corresponding penalty λ_u I, enabling estimation of both additive genetic and permanent environmental effects in repeated records models.

formula-notes:formula_19.21b:zh.plainMeaning: 公式定义了加性遗传效应的方差比 λ_A = σ_e² / σ_A² 和母体效应的方差比 λ_u = σ_e² / σ_u²，其中 σ_e² 是残差方差，σ_A² 是加性遗传方差，σ_u² 是母体效应方差。
formula-notes:formula_19.21b:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在基本动物模型修改章节，用于构建混合模型方程组（19.21a）中的系数矩阵，通过引入方差比将方差分量信息融入方程组，为后续求解固定效应 β、加性遗传效应 a 和母体效应 u 的估计值提供必要的参数。

formula-notes:formula_19.21a:zh.plainMeaning: 该矩阵方程是Henderson混合模型方程组，用于同时求解固定效应β、加性遗传效应a和母体效应u的估计值。左侧系数矩阵包含X、Z、W的设计矩阵乘积及惩罚项λ_A A^{-1}和λ_u I，右侧为各效应与响应变量y的叉积。
formula-notes:formula_19.21a:zh.inThisChapter: 本节对基础动物模型进行修改，引入母体效应u（见公式19.20a和19.20b），此公式将标准混合模型方程（公式19.4）扩展至包含u及其方差比λ_u，为后续估计遗传参数和预测育种值提供计算框架。

formula-notes:formula_19.24a:zh.plainMeaning: 该矩阵方程将固定效应向量 β̂、加性遗传效应向量 â_b 和剩余遗传效应向量 â_r 的求解与观测值 y 通过设计矩阵 X、Z₁、Z₂ 以及方差比 λ 和遗传关系矩阵 G 联系起来，其中 λ = 2σ_e²/σ_A²。
formula-notes:formula_19.24a:zh.inThisChapter: 在本章“基本动物模型的修改”中，公式 (19.24a) 给出了包含加性和剩余遗传效应的混合模型方程组，为后续推导简化形式 (19.24b) 提供了基础，其中通过引入矩阵 Q 来吸收剩余效应。

formula-notes:formula_19.25a:en.plainMeaning: This formula extends the basic animal model by adding a dominance genetic effect term (Z d) to the fixed effects (X β) and additive genetic effects (Z a), with residual e. y is the phenotype vector, X and Z are design matrices, β is fixed effects, a is additive genetic effects, d is dominance effects, e is residuals.
formula-notes:formula_19.25a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on modifications to include dominance, supporting the subsequent derivation of the dominance relationship matrix and variance components in formulas 19.25b–d.

formula-notes:formula_19.24a:en.plainMeaning: This matrix equation defines the mixed model equations for a modified animal model with two random effects (breeding values for base and residual groups), where the coefficient matrix includes penalty terms λQᵀG⁻¹Q and λG⁻¹ to account for grouping and genetic covariance structure.
formula-notes:formula_19.24a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on modifications of the basic animal model to incorporate grouping strategies, and it supports the derivation of equivalent models and computational simplifications for genetic evaluation.

formula-notes:formula_19.23:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将观测值向量 y 分解为固定效应 Xβ、基础加性遗传效应 Z₁a_b、剩余加性遗传效应 Z₂a_r 和残差 e 四个部分，其中 a_b 是固定效应，a_r 是随机效应。
formula-notes:formula_19.23:zh.inThisChapter: 在基本动物模型基础上，本节将加性遗传效应拆分为基础效应 a_b（固定）和剩余效应 a_r（随机），以处理亲本信息不完整或分组结构，公式(19.23)是后续推导方差分量和估计固定效应的起点。

formula-notes:formula_19.24b:en.plainMeaning: This formula defines matrices Q and G used in the mixed model equations for an animal model with two random effects. Q transforms the P1 matrix, and G is a covariance matrix for the second random effect, where F is a diagonal matrix from Equation 19.16 and I is the identity matrix.
formula-notes:formula_19.24b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on modifications of the basic animal model to incorporate additional random effects (e.g., maternal or permanent environmental effects). The matrices Q and G are used to set up the mixed model equations (19.24a) for estimating variance components and predicting breeding values.

formula-notes:formula_19.25b:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the phenotypic variance-covariance matrix V of the response vector y as the sum of additive genetic variance (σ²_A) times the additive relationship matrix A projected by Z, dominance genetic variance (σ²_D) times the dominance relationship matrix D projected by Z, and residual variance (σ²_e) times the identity matrix I.
formula-notes:formula_19.25b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on modifications of the basic animal model to incorporate dominance genetic effects, supporting the extension of the mixed model equations to include a dominance random effect and enabling estimation of dominance variance components.

formula-notes:formula_19.25a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将观测值向量 y 分解为固定效应 Xβ、加性遗传效应 Za、显性遗传效应 Zd 和残差 e 之和，其中 Z 是关联矩阵。
formula-notes:formula_19.25a:zh.inThisChapter: 本节在基本动物模型基础上引入显性效应 d，公式 (19.25a) 作为扩展模型的起点，为后续推导显性方差组分和协方差矩阵 (19.25b–d) 提供结构基础。

formula-notes:formula_19.24b:zh.plainMeaning: 公式(19.24b)定义了矩阵Q和G：Q = (I - P2)^{-1} P1，G = (I - P2)^{-1} F [(I - P2)^{-1}]^T，其中P1和P2是来自(19.24a)的系数矩阵，F是对角矩阵（其元素由(19.16)给出），I是单位矩阵。Q和G分别用于连接固定效应和随机效应的估计与方差分量估计。
formula-notes:formula_19.24b:zh.inThisChapter: 在“基本动物模型修正”一节中，公式(19.24b)紧接在混合模型方程组(19.24a)之后出现，目的是将(19.24a)中的系数矩阵P1和P2转化为Q和G，以便后续利用分离向量s（来自上下文）估计加性遗传方差。Q和G的构造为方差分量估计提供了所需的线性变换。

formula-notes:formula_19.25b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算表型向量 y 的方差-协方差矩阵 V，将其分解为加性遗传方差 σ_A^2 乘以 Z A Z^T、显性遗传方差 σ_D^2 乘以 Z D Z^T 以及残差方差 σ_e^2 乘以单位矩阵 I 之和。
formula-notes:formula_19.25b:zh.inThisChapter: 在扩展基本动物模型以包含显性遗传效应时，该公式显式给出了总表型方差的组成，为后续通过 REML 估计方差组分以及计算显性遗传关系矩阵 D 提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_19.25c:en.plainMeaning: This formula defines a linear mixed model where the phenotype vector y is modeled as a combination of fixed effects (Xβ), additive genetic effects (Za), and a residual term e* that now includes dominance genetic effects and environmental noise.
formula-notes:formula_19.25c:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on modifications to the basic animal model to introduce a new residual term e* that captures dominance variance, setting up the covariance structure in Equation 19.25d that includes the dominance relationship matrix D.

formula-notes:formula_19.25d:en.plainMeaning: This formula gives the variance-covariance matrix of the residual vector e* in the modified animal model, where σ_D² scales the dominance genetic relationship matrix Z D Zᵀ and σ_e² scales the identity matrix I.
formula-notes:formula_19.25d:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on modifications to the basic animal model to incorporate dominance genetic effects, supporting the derivation of the covariance structure for the model in Equation 19.25c.

formula-notes:formula_19.26a:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the coefficient of fraternity Δ_{ij} between two noninbred individuals i and j, where Θ_{gk} is the coancestry between parent g of i and parent k of j, and similarly for other pairs.
formula-notes:formula_19.26a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on modifications of the basic animal model to incorporate dominance genetic variance, providing the necessary genetic relationship measure Δ_{ij} for the dominance covariance term σ_D² Δ_{ij}.

formula-notes:formula_19.25c:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将观测向量 y 分解为固定效应 Xβ、加性遗传效应 Za 和残差 e*，其中 e* 包含了显性遗传效应和随机误差。
formula-notes:formula_19.25c:zh.inThisChapter: 本节修改基本动物模型以包含显性遗传效应，公式(19.25c)通过将显性效应吸收进残差项 e* 中，使得协方差结构(19.25d)可以表达为显性遗传方差和误差方差之和，为后续推导显性遗传关系矩阵 D 提供模型基础。

formula-notes:formula_19.25d:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算残差向量 e* 的方差-协方差矩阵，等于加性遗传方差 σ_D^2 乘以 Z D Z^T 加上残差方差 σ_e^2 乘以单位矩阵 I。
formula-notes:formula_19.25d:zh.inThisChapter: 在修改基本动物模型时，该公式给出了新模型（19.25c）中残差的协方差结构，为后续推导混合模型方程或进行方差组分估计提供必要的方差-协方差矩阵。

formula-notes:formula_19.26a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算个体i和j之间的亲缘系数Δ_{ij}，它等于i的父母(g,h)与j的父母(k,l)之间四个共祖系数乘积之和：Θ_{gk}Θ_{hl} + Θ_{gl}Θ_{hk}。
formula-notes:formula_19.26a:zh.inThisChapter: 本章在基本动物模型基础上引入显性遗传效应，公式(19.26a)将个体间显性遗传协方差σ_D^2 Δ_{ij}中的Δ_{ij}用亲本共祖系数表示，为后续构建包含显性效应的方差协方差矩阵提供具体表达式。

formula-notes:formula_19.26b:zh.plainMeaning: 公式 (19.26b) 利用分子亲缘关系矩阵 A 中的元素计算 D 矩阵的非对角元 D_{ij}，其中 A_{gk}、A_{hl}、A_{gl}、A_{hk} 分别是个体 g 与 k、h 与 l、g 与 l、h 与 k 的亲缘系数乘以 2 后的值。
formula-notes:formula_19.26b:zh.inThisChapter: 本章在基本动物模型基础上引入 D 矩阵以处理显性遗传效应，该公式给出了从 A 矩阵元素计算 D 矩阵非对角元的具体方法，为后续利用 D 矩阵的稀疏性进行高效计算奠定基础。

formula-notes:formula_19.27:en.plainMeaning: This formula sets up the mixed model equations for an animal model that includes both additive (a) and dominance (d) genetic effects, where λA and λD are variance ratios. The block matrix on the left combines fixed effects (β) and random genetic effects, and the right-hand side is the product of design matrices with the phenotype vector y.
formula-notes:formula_19.27:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on modifications of the basic animal model to incorporate dominance genetic effects, supporting the estimation of both additive and dominance breeding values while accounting for their covariances via A⁻¹ and D⁻¹ matrices.

formula-notes:formula_19.28:en.plainMeaning: This formula models a phenotypic trait y for individual i in generation t as the sum of an overall mean μ, a fixed effect of inbreeding depression (B times the inbreeding coefficient f), plus random additive genetic (a), non-additive genetic (b), and residual (e) effects.
formula-notes:formula_19.28:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on modifications to the basic animal model to account for inbreeding depression by including inbreeding level as a covariate, supporting the estimation of the inbreeding depression parameter B while controlling for genetic and environmental sources of variation.

formula-notes:formula_19.26b:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the off-diagonal element D_ij of the dominance relationship matrix D using elements of the numerator relationship matrix A for the four grandparents (g, h, k, l) of individuals i and j, where i and j are not inbred. The symbols A_gk, A_hl, A_gl, A_hk are the additive relationships between the respective grandparents.
formula-notes:formula_19.26b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on modifications of the basic animal model to incorporate dominance effects, providing a method to compute the dominance relationship matrix D from the additive relationship matrix A, which is more sparse and computationally efficient for later genetic evaluation.

formula-notes:formula_19.29b:en.plainMeaning: This formula states that the posterior distribution of parameters Θ given data y is proportional to the product of the likelihood p(y|Θ) and the prior p(Θ), ignoring the normalizing constant p(y).
formula-notes:formula_19.29b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the Bayesian mixed-model analysis section to simplify posterior computation by omitting the constant p(y), enabling direct use of the unnormalized posterior for inference.

formula-notes:formula_19.29a:en.plainMeaning: Bayes' theorem for continuous vector parameters: the posterior density of Θ given data y equals the likelihood times the prior divided by the marginal likelihood (the integral of the joint density over Θ).
formula-notes:formula_19.29a:en.inThisChapter: It provides the foundational update rule for Bayesian mixed-model analysis, enabling inference on random effects by combining prior beliefs with observed data.

formula-notes:formula_19.27:zh.plainMeaning: 该混合模型方程组（MME）用于同时求解固定效应β、加性遗传效应a和显性遗传效应d的估计值，其中左侧系数矩阵由X和Z的设计矩阵以及加性（λA A⁻¹）和显性（λD D⁻¹）罚函数构成，右侧为Xᵀy和Zᵀy。
formula-notes:formula_19.27:zh.inThisChapter: 本节对基本动物模型进行修改以纳入显性效应，公式(19.27)是模型(19.25a)对应的MME，为后续估计方差组分和预测育种值提供了可直接求解的线性系统。

formula-notes:formula_19.28:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将表型值 y_{ti} 分解为总体均值 μ、近交衰退效应 (B·f_{ti})、加性遗传效应 a_{ti}、显性效应 b_{ti} 和环境残差 e_{ti}，其中 f_{ti} 是个体近交系数，B 是完全近交下的近交衰退量（固定效应）。
formula-notes:formula_19.28:zh.inThisChapter: 本章在基本动物模型基础上引入近交衰退修正，该公式通过将 f_{ti} 作为协变量纳入模型，为后续估计 B 和校正近交对遗传参数的影响提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_19.29a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式是贝叶斯定理的连续向量形式，将给定数据 y 后参数向量 Θ 的后验分布 p(Θ|y) 表达为似然 p(y|Θ) 与先验 p(Θ) 的乘积除以边际似然 p(y)（即联合分布 p(y,Θ) 对 Θ 的积分）。
formula-notes:formula_19.29a:zh.inThisChapter: 在贝叶斯混合模型分析章节中，此公式为后续推导后验分布（如公式 19.29b）提供基础，通过将先验与似然结合，实现从数据到参数的推断。

formula-notes:formula_19.29b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式表示在给定数据 y 的条件下，参数 Θ 的后验分布 p(Θ|y) 正比于似然函数 p(y|Θ) 与先验分布 p(Θ) 的乘积，其中比例常数是边际似然 p(y) 的倒数。
formula-notes:formula_19.29b:zh.inThisChapter: 在贝叶斯混合模型分析中，该公式用于简化后验分布的计算，通过忽略常数 p(y) 将后验表示为似然与先验的乘积，为后续的 MCMC 采样或变分推断提供基础形式。

formula-notes:formula_19.31a:en.plainMeaning: This formula describes drawing a new sample x_i from the conditional distribution of x given the previous y value y_{i-1}, which is a step in the Gibbs sampler for Bayesian mixed models.
formula-notes:formula_19.31a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the Bayesian mixed-model analysis section to illustrate the iterative sampling scheme of the Gibbs sampler, supporting the derivation of posterior distributions for model parameters.

formula-notes:formula_19.30:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式通过积分消去干扰参数向量Θ_nu，得到感兴趣参数Θ_1的边缘后验分布；第一行是直接积分联合后验，第二行利用条件概率分解，第三行将积分表示为关于Θ_nu后验分布的期望。
formula-notes:formula_19.30:zh.inThisChapter: 在贝叶斯混合模型分析中，通常存在干扰参数（如方差分量），该公式提供了通过边缘化得到感兴趣参数后验分布的标准方法，为后续进行参数推断或MCMC采样奠定基础。

formula-notes:formula_19.30:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the marginal posterior distribution of parameters of interest Θ₁ by integrating out nuisance parameters Θ_ν, showing it equals the expectation of the conditional posterior p(Θ₁|Θ_ν, y) over the posterior of Θ_ν.
formula-notes:formula_19.30:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the Bayesian mixed-model analysis section to justify obtaining inference on fixed effects and variance components of interest while accounting for uncertainty in nuisance parameters, supporting later MCMC or numerical integration methods.

formula-notes:formula_19.31b:en.plainMeaning: This formula describes the second step of a Gibbs sampler: drawing a new value y_i from the conditional distribution of y given the most recent sample x_i of x.
formula-notes:formula_19.31b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the Bayesian mixed-model analysis section to illustrate how the Gibbs sampler iteratively updates parameters by sampling from full conditional distributions, supporting the implementation of MCMC for posterior inference.

formula-notes:formula_19.31a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式表示从给定 y_{i-1} 的条件下 x 的条件分布中抽取新的 x_i 样本，即 Gibbs 采样中更新 x 的步骤。
formula-notes:formula_19.31a:zh.inThisChapter: 在贝叶斯混合模型分析的 Gibbs 采样器中，该公式与后续的公式 (19.31b) 交替执行，共同构成一个马尔可夫链，用于从联合后验分布中采样。

formula-notes:formula_19.31b:zh.plainMeaning: 公式 (19.31b) 表示从给定 x = x_i 的条件分布 p(y | x = x_i) 中抽取一个新的 y_i 值，其中 x_i 是上一步 (19.31a) 生成的样本。
formula-notes:formula_19.31b:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式与 (19.31a) 共同构成吉布斯采样器的两个交替步骤，用于从联合分布 p(x, y) 中生成样本，为后续贝叶斯混合模型分析中的参数推断提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_19.32a:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the Monte Carlo estimate of the expectation of a function f(x) by averaging f evaluated at m samples x_i from the Gibbs sequence. E[f(x)]_m is the sample mean, x_i are the sampled values, and m is the number of samples.
formula-notes:formula_19.32a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the Bayesian mixed-model analysis section to show how posterior expectations of functions of parameters are approximated from Gibbs sampling output, supporting inference via Monte Carlo integration.

formula-notes:formula_19.32a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式用来自吉布斯采样得到的 m 个样本 x_i 的算术平均，近似计算任意函数 f(x) 的期望 E[f(x)]，其中 f(x_i) 是每个样本的函数值。
formula-notes:formula_19.32a:zh.inThisChapter: 在贝叶斯混合模型分析的章节中，此公式提供了从吉布斯采样序列计算边际后验特征（如期望）的蒙特卡洛估计方法，为后续推导方差估计（公式19.32b）和收敛性讨论奠定基础。

formula-notes:formula_19.33a:zh.plainMeaning: 公式(19.33a)表示在给定固定效应β、育种值a和环境方差σ_e^2的条件下，观测数据向量y服从多元正态分布，其均值向量为Xβ+Za，协方差矩阵为σ_e^2 I，其中I是单位矩阵。
formula-notes:formula_19.33a:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在贝叶斯混合模型分析章节，作为似然函数的基础，为后续推导后验分布（如公式19.33b）提供条件分布假设。

formula-notes:formula_19.33b:en.plainMeaning: This formula specifies that the vector of breeding values a, conditional on the relationship matrix A and additive genetic variance σ²_A, follows a multivariate normal distribution with mean zero and covariance matrix σ²_A A.
formula-notes:formula_19.33b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the Bayesian mixed-model analysis section to define the prior distribution for breeding values under the infinitesimal model, which is essential for subsequent Bayesian inference and prediction of genetic values.

formula-notes:formula_19.32b:en.plainMeaning: This formula gives the Monte Carlo estimate of the expected value of a function f of n variables (θ^(1),...,θ^(n)), computed as the average of f evaluated at m independent samples (θ^(1)_i,...,θ^(n)_i).
formula-notes:formula_19.32b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the Bayesian mixed-model analysis section to show how to approximate posterior expectations of functions of multiple parameters using MCMC samples, supporting inference when analytical integration is intractable.

formula-notes:formula_19.33a:en.plainMeaning: This formula specifies that the observed data vector y, conditional on fixed effects β, random breeding values a, and environmental variance σ_e^2, follows a multivariate normal distribution with mean Xβ + Za and covariance matrix σ_e^2 I, where I is the identity matrix.
formula-notes:formula_19.33a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the Bayesian mixed-model analysis section to define the likelihood of the data given the parameters, which is essential for deriving posterior distributions and for subsequent equations like (19.33b) that specify the joint posterior.

formula-notes:formula_20.2:en.plainMeaning: This formula expresses a female's breeding date (z) as the sum of an additive genetic component (A), a negative environmental effect (-n), and a residual error (e).
formula-notes:formula_20.2:en.inThisChapter: It introduces Fisher's model to decompose phenotypic variation into genetic and environmental components, setting up the basis for analyzing selection response in natural populations.

formula-notes:formula_20.1a:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the selection differential S₁ for trait 1 as the sum of direct selection (variance σ²(z₁) times gradient β₁) and indirect selection via covariance σ(z₁,z₂) with trait 2 times its gradient β₂.
formula-notes:formula_20.1a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on the target of selection to show that selection on a focal trait includes contributions from correlated unmeasured traits, supporting the need to consider multivariate selection (Equation 20.1b).

formula-notes:formula_19.33b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式表示在给定亲缘关系矩阵A和加性遗传方差σ_A^2的条件下，育种值向量a服从均值为0、协方差矩阵为σ_A^2 A的多元正态分布，即a的变异由遗传方差和亲缘关系共同决定。
formula-notes:formula_19.33b:zh.inThisChapter: 本章在贝叶斯混合模型分析中引入该公式，为后续基于先验分布进行遗传参数估计和育种值预测提供概率模型基础，是连接遗传方差组分与观测数据似然函数的关键环节。

formula-notes:formula_20.1a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算性状1的选择微分S₁，它等于性状1的遗传方差σ²(z₁)乘以性状1的梯度β₁，加上性状1与性状2的协方差σ(z₁,z₂)乘以性状2的梯度β₂。
formula-notes:formula_20.1a:zh.inThisChapter: 此公式出现在讨论自然选择目标时，说明即使只关注性状1，其选择响应也会受到相关性状2的间接影响，为后续引出多变量选择响应公式（20.1b）做铺垫。

formula-notes:formula_19.32b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式用 m 个样本的平均值来近似计算 n 个随机变量函数 f 的期望，其中每个样本点由 (θ_i^(1), …, θ_i^(n)) 组成。
formula-notes:formula_19.32b:zh.inThisChapter: 在贝叶斯混合模型分析中，后验期望通常无法解析计算，因此需要蒙特卡洛估计；此公式将单变量 MC 估计（公式 19.32a）推广到多变量函数，为后续基于 MCMC 样本计算后验量提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_20.1b:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the expected response to selection in trait 1 (R₁) as the sum of direct selection on trait 1 (G₁₁β₁) and indirect selection via genetic covariance with trait 2 (G₁₂β₂). Key symbols: R₁ = response in trait 1, G₁₁ = additive genetic variance of trait 1, β₁ = selection gradient on trait 1, G₁₂ = additive genetic covariance between traits 1 and 2, β₂ = selection gradient on trait 2.
formula-notes:formula_20.1b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in this section to show that even when direct selection on a trait is present (β₁ ≠ 0), the net response can be reduced or reversed due to genetic correlations with other traits under selection. This supports the argument that selection acts on the whole organism, not on individual traits in isolation.

formula-notes:formula_20.1b:zh.plainMeaning: 公式(20.1b)计算性状1的预期响应R₁，它等于性状1的加性遗传方差σ²(A₁)乘以直接选择梯度β₁，加上性状1与性状2的加性遗传协方差σ(A₁,A₂)乘以性状2的选择梯度β₂。
formula-notes:formula_20.1b:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在讨论自然选择目标时，说明即使性状1受到直接选择（β₁≠0），其净选择差也可能因遗传相关（G₁₂）而接近零或反号，为后续理解相关响应和间接选择提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_20.2:zh.plainMeaning: 公式将雌性个体的繁殖日期 z 分解为三个部分：A 表示潜在繁殖日期（或基础值），n 表示由于选择压力导致的偏移量（如捕食风险），e 表示随机环境误差。
formula-notes:formula_20.2:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在自然种群选择响应的引言部分，用于建立 Fisher 模型的基本框架，为后续推导选择如何影响繁殖日期分布以及进化响应提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_20.3a:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the fitness W(z) of an individual with phenotype z under stabilizing selection, where θ is the optimal phenotype and ω² determines the strength of selection (smaller ω² gives stronger selection).
formula-notes:formula_20.3a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to selection response to model how natural selection reduces phenotypic variance around an optimum, supporting later derivations of evolutionary change under stabilizing selection.

formula-notes:formula_20.3a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式定义了稳定化选择下个体表型值 z 的适应度 W(z)，其中 θ 为最优表型（适应度最大），ω 控制选择强度（ω 越小选择越强），适应度随 z 偏离 θ 呈高斯衰减。
formula-notes:formula_20.3a:zh.inThisChapter: 本章引入自然种群中的稳定化选择模型，公式 (20.3a) 作为标准正态最优模型，为后续推导选择梯度、平衡多态性等数量遗传学结果提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_20.3b:en.plainMeaning: This formula expresses fitness W as an exponential function of nutritional status n, where α is a positive constant determining the steepness of the increase.
formula-notes:formula_20.3b:en.inThisChapter: It appears here to model a plausible positive relationship between nutrition and fitness, supporting later arguments about how selection might act on traits affecting nutritional status.

formula-notes:formula_20.4a:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes fitness as a product of selection on nutritional value n and breeding date z, where α scales the benefit of n, θ is the optimal breeding date, and ω² measures the strength of stabilizing selection on z.
formula-notes:formula_20.4a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to selection response to decompose fitness into independent components, setting up the derivation of the selection gradient in Equation 20.4b.

formula-notes:formula_20.4b:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes fitness W as a function of phenotype n, environment e, and additive genetic value A, combining an exponential growth term (αn) with a Gaussian stabilizing selection term centered at θ with width ω.
formula-notes:formula_20.4b:en.inThisChapter: It appears here to model how fitness depends on both the direct effect of phenotype (αn) and deviation from an optimum (A - n + e - θ), supporting later analysis of selection response in natural populations.

formula-notes:formula_20.4a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将个体适应度表示为繁殖日期z和营养值n的乘积形式，其中W(z)是高斯型选择函数（中心在θ，宽度ω），W(n)是指数增长函数（α为营养对适应度的增益系数），最终适应度是两者乘积的指数形式。
formula-notes:formula_20.4a:zh.inThisChapter: 本章引入自然种群中的选择响应，此公式用于构建同时受两个性状（繁殖日期和营养值）影响的适应度函数，为后续推导联合选择梯度（如公式20.4b）提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_20.4b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将适应度W表示为个体表型值n、环境效应e和群体平均表型A的函数，其中指数项包含αn（方向选择）和二次项（稳定选择偏离最优值θ的惩罚）。
formula-notes:formula_20.4b:zh.inThisChapter: 本章引入该公式以量化自然选择中表型分布对适应度的影响，为后续推导选择梯度、进化动态及平衡条件提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_20.5:zh.plainMeaning: 公式(20.5)计算选择响应R，即性状均值的变化，它等于加性遗传方差σ_A^2乘以一个分数，该分数的分子是选择差(θ-μ)加上营养方差σ_n^2乘以α，分母是总表型方差ω^2+σ_z^2。
formula-notes:formula_20.5:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在介绍自然种群中选择响应的章节，用于推导平衡时的均值(20.6)，说明营养方差σ_n^2会使平衡均值偏离最优值θ。

formula-notes:formula_20.3b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式用指数函数 exp(αn) 表示适应度 W(n) 随营养状态 n 的增加而增长，其中 α>0 控制增长速率。
formula-notes:formula_20.3b:zh.inThisChapter: 在介绍自然群体选择响应的章节中，此公式为 Price 等人假设的适应度-营养关系提供一种具体数学形式，为后续推导选择响应公式奠定基础。

formula-notes:formula_20.6:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the equilibrium mean breeding date (μ̂) as the optimal date (θ) plus a shift (ασₙ²) due to nutritional variance, where α is a coefficient and σₙ² is the variance in nutritional value.
formula-notes:formula_20.6:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to show that natural selection on breeding date does not return the population to the optimal date θ when nutritional variance exists, supporting the argument that environmental variation can cause evolutionary lag.

formula-notes:formula_20.5:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the expected change in mean phenotype (R) per generation under natural selection, where σ_A² is additive genetic variance, θ is the optimal phenotype, μ is the current mean, α is the effect of nutritional value on phenotype, σ_n² is variance in nutritional value, ω² is the width of the fitness function, and σ_z² is phenotypic variance.
formula-notes:formula_20.5:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to selection response in natural populations to show how environmental variance (nutritional value) shifts the equilibrium mean, leading to Equation 20.6 for the equilibrium mean phenotype.

formula-notes:formula_20.7a:en.plainMeaning: This formula expresses relative fitness (w) as a linear function of the phenotype (z), additive genetic value (A), and environmental deviation (E), with regression coefficients βz, βA, βE, and an intercept α plus error ε.
formula-notes:formula_20.7a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in this section to decompose fitness into components from different paths (phenotype, genetics, environment), supporting the derivation of the multivariate breeder's equation for natural populations by linking selection gradients to genetic variances.

formula-notes:formula_20.7a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将相对适应度 w 表示为表型值 z、加性遗传值 A 和环境值 E 的线性回归，其中 β_z、β_A、β_E 分别是各变量的偏回归系数，ε 是残差。
formula-notes:formula_20.7a:zh.inThisChapter: 本章旨在将育种者方程推广到自然种群，该公式通过多元回归分解影响适应度的不同路径（表型、遗传、环境），为后续推导选择梯度（如公式 20.7b）提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_20.6:zh.plainMeaning: 公式(20.6)计算平衡时的平均繁殖日期μ̂，它等于最优繁殖日期θ加上α乘以营养值方差σₙ²，表明平衡均值比θ更晚。
formula-notes:formula_20.6:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式由上一公式(20.5)在平衡条件R=0下推导得出，用于说明自然选择下平均繁殖日期会因营养状况变异而偏离最优值，为后续讨论表型可塑性的进化后果铺垫。

formula-notes:formula_20.7b:en.plainMeaning: This formula states that the partial covariances of breeding value (A) with fitness (w), and of environmental value (E) with fitness (w), both conditioned on the trait value (z), are zero. It specifies the condition for the breeder's equation to hold in natural populations.
formula-notes:formula_20.7b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on modifying the breeder's equation to show that when these partial covariances vanish, the simple breeder's equation (20.7a) is valid, supporting the argument that selection on a trait can be predicted from the covariance of breeding value and fitness without confounding by environmental effects.

formula-notes:formula_20.7b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式表示在给定表型z的条件下，育种值A与适合度w的偏协方差，以及环境值E与适合度w的偏协方差，都等于0。
formula-notes:formula_20.7b:zh.inThisChapter: 在本节中，该公式用于定义自然种群中适合度与遗传和环境成分之间无偏相关（条件独立）的条件，为后续推导修正的育种者方程（如考虑非随机交配或环境协方差）提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_20.8a:en.plainMeaning: This matrix equation expresses the covariances of fitness with phenotype (S), breeding value (R), and environment (E) as the product of the covariance matrix of z, A, and E with the vector of partial regression coefficients βz, βA, βE.
formula-notes:formula_20.8a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section modifying the breeder's equation for natural populations to account for unmeasured variables, and it supports the derivation of the multivariate response to selection by linking selection differentials to genetic and environmental components.

formula-notes:formula_20.8b:en.plainMeaning: This formula expresses the covariance between the phenotypic value (z) and the breeding value (A) as the sum of the additive genetic variance (σ²_A) and the covariance between the environmental deviation (E) and the breeding value (A).
formula-notes:formula_20.8b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on modifying the breeder's equation for natural populations to show that the covariance between phenotype and breeding value is not simply σ²_A when E and A are correlated, which is a key point for extending the breeder's equation to natural populations with non-random environments.

formula-notes:formula_20.8b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算表型值z（由育种值A、环境偏差E和抽样误差e_s组成）与育种值A之间的协方差，结果等于育种值方差σ²_A加上环境偏差与育种值的协方差σ(E,A)。
formula-notes:formula_20.8b:zh.inThisChapter: 在本节中，该公式用于构建预测变量的方差-协方差矩阵（公式20.8a右侧的3×3矩阵），为后续推导自然群体中育种者方程的修正形式提供协方差项。

formula-notes:formula_20.9b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将响应R分解为加性遗传方差σ_A^2、遗传-环境协方差σ(E,A)以及选择梯度β_z、β_A、β_E的线性组合，展示了遗传和环境协方差如何通过不同路径贡献于总响应。
formula-notes:formula_20.9b:zh.inThisChapter: 在修改自然种群育种者方程这一节中，公式(20.9b)从(20.9a)推导而来，通过代数重组将R表达为更简洁的形式，为后续讨论遗传-环境协方差对进化响应的影响奠定基础。

formula-notes:formula_20.8a:zh.plainMeaning: 该矩阵方程将选择梯度向量（包含对表型z、加性遗传值A、环境值E的协方差）表示为（表型、加性遗传、环境）方差-协方差矩阵与偏回归系数向量β的乘积，其中S是选择差，R是育种者方程中的响应。
formula-notes:formula_20.8a:zh.inThisChapter: 本节利用多元回归理论将育种者方程扩展到自然种群，该公式通过矩阵形式统一了选择差S、响应R与偏回归系数的关系，为后续推导考虑未测量变量影响的选择响应公式（如20.8b）提供代数基础。

formula-notes:formula_20.10a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将选择差S分解为表型方差σ_z²乘以表型选择梯度β_z、加性遗传方差σ_A²乘以加性遗传选择梯度β_A、环境方差σ_E²乘以环境选择梯度β_E三部分之和，前提是基因型-环境协方差σ(E,A)=0。
formula-notes:formula_20.10a:zh.inThisChapter: 本章引入自然种群中的选择响应，公式(20.10a)在假设无基因型-环境相关时，将选择差S拆解为表型、遗传和环境三个方差-梯度乘积项，为后续推导响应R的表达式(20.10b)提供基础，其中R仅包含加性遗传方差项。

formula-notes:formula_20.10b:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the response to selection R as the additive genetic variance σ_A² multiplied by the sum of the selection gradients on the phenotype (β_z) and on the additive genetic value (β_A).
formula-notes:formula_20.10b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to selection response in natural populations to show how R simplifies when genotype-environment correlations are absent, supporting the derivation of the multivariate breeder's equation.

formula-notes:formula_20.10a:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the selection differential S as the sum of three components: the phenotypic variance σ_z² times the phenotypic selection gradient β_z, the additive genetic variance σ_A² times the additive genetic selection gradient β_A, and the environmental variance σ_E² times the environmental selection gradient β_E.
formula-notes:formula_20.10a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to selection response in natural populations to decompose S into genetic and environmental contributions under the assumption of no genotype-environment correlation, setting the stage for deriving the response R in Equation 20.10b.

formula-notes:formula_20.9a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将选择差S分解为表型方差σ_z^2乘以表型选择梯度β_z、表型-加性遗传协方差σ(z,A)乘以加性遗传梯度β_A、以及表型-环境协方差σ(z,E)乘以环境梯度β_E之和；第二行利用σ(z,A)=σ_A^2+σ(E,A)和σ(z,E)=σ_E^2+σ(E,A)展开，第三行合并同类项，得到S=σ_z^2β_z+σ_A^2β_A+σ_E^2β_E+σ(E,A)(β_A+β_E)。
formula-notes:formula_20.9a:zh.inThisChapter: 本节旨在修改育种者方程以适应自然种群，该公式通过将选择差S分解为遗传和环境组分，为后续推导响应R（公式20.9b）提供基础，并揭示协方差σ(E,A)对选择差和响应的贡献。

formula-notes:formula_20.10b:zh.plainMeaning: 公式 R = σ_A^2 (β_z + β_A) 计算的是对性状 z 的响应 R，其中 σ_A^2 是加性遗传方差，β_z 是性状 z 的选择梯度，β_A 是加性遗传值的直接选择梯度，两者之和乘以加性遗传方差得到响应。
formula-notes:formula_20.10b:zh.inThisChapter: 在推导出总选择差 S 的分解式 (20.10a) 后，此公式进一步给出在无基因型-环境相关时，响应 R 仅由加性遗传方差和选择梯度决定，为后续理解自然选择如何驱动性状进化提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_20.9b:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the total evolutionary response R as the sum of three selection components: direct selection on the trait (σ_A^2 β_z), selection on additive genetic variance (σ_A^2 β_A), and selection on environmental covariance (σ(E,A)(β_z+β_E)). Key symbols: R (response), σ_A^2 (additive genetic variance), σ(E,A) (covariance between environment and additive genetic effects), β_z, β_A, β_E (selection gradients on phenotype, additive genetic value, and environment).
formula-notes:formula_20.9b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section modifying the breeder's equation for natural populations to account for environmental-genetic covariance and multiple selection gradients, supporting the argument that the response to selection depends not only on heritability but also on covariances between genetic and environmental effects.

formula-notes:formula_20.9a:en.plainMeaning: This formula expresses the within-generation change S as a sum of selection differentials on the phenotype (z), additive genetic value (A), and environmental deviation (E), each weighted by their respective selection gradients (βz, βA, βE). The second and third lines expand the covariances σ(z,A) and σ(z,E) in terms of variances and covariances of A and E.
formula-notes:formula_20.9a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section modifying the breeder's equation for natural populations to account for environmental effects and genetic-environmental correlations. This expression for S is used together with the response R (Equation 20.9b) to derive the multivariate breeder's equation that partitions evolutionary change into components due to direct selection on the phenotype and indirect selection on correlated traits.

formula-notes:formula_20.11b:en.plainMeaning: This equation expresses the covariance between the focal trait (z1) and an unmeasured correlated trait (z2) weighted by the selection gradient on z2 (β2) as the sum of additive genetic variance (σA²) times the additive genetic selection gradient (βA) and environmental variance (σE²) times the environmental selection gradient (βE).
formula-notes:formula_20.11b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to selection response in natural populations to decompose the indirect selection effect from a correlated trait into genetic and environmental components, supporting the argument that selection on a correlated trait can contribute to the response of the focal trait via both genetic and environmental pathways.

formula-notes:formula_20.12a:en.plainMeaning: This formula decomposes the covariance between phenotype z1 and fitness-related trait z2, weighted by selection gradient β2, into contributions from additive genetic component A and environmental component E, assuming z1 = A + E.
formula-notes:formula_20.12a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to selection response in natural populations to show how the total selection differential can be partitioned into genetic and environmental components, supporting the derivation of the breeders' equation in formula 20.12b.

formula-notes:formula_20.12a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将性状z1与z2的协方差乘以选择梯度β2，分解为遗传部分（A）与环境部分（E）分别与z2的协方差乘以β2之和，即总选择响应可拆分为遗传和环境贡献。
formula-notes:formula_20.12a:zh.inThisChapter: 此处引入加性遗传效应A和环境效应E的分解，为后续推导遗传响应（如公式20.12b）和阐明选择响应的遗传基础做铺垫。

formula-notes:formula_20.11b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将未观测性状（z₂）与焦点性状（z₁=z）之间的协方差σ(z₁,z₂)乘以z₂的选择梯度β₂，分解为加性遗传方差σ_A²乘以加性遗传选择梯度β_A与环境方差σ_E²乘以环境选择梯度β_E之和。
formula-notes:formula_20.11b:zh.inThisChapter: 在自然种群选择响应的介绍中，公式(20.11b)通过将协方差选择响应分解为遗传和环境组分，为后续推导多性状选择响应方程（如式20.12）提供关键分解步骤。

formula-notes:formula_20.11a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将选择差S分解为两种形式：左边是直接对性状1的选择（σ²(z₁)β₁）加上通过相关性状2的间接选择（σ(z₁,z₂)β₂）；右边则进一步将选择差拆分为表型方差分量（σ_z²β_z）、加性遗传方差分量（σ_A²β_A）和环境方差分量（σ_E²β_E）的贡献。
formula-notes:formula_20.11a:zh.inThisChapter: 此公式出现在介绍自然群体选择响应的章节，通过等式连接直接与间接选择效应以及方差分量，为后续推导选择响应（如公式20.11b）和区分遗传与环境影响奠定基础。

formula-notes:formula_20.12b:zh.plainMeaning: 公式(20.12b)将选择梯度β₂与加性遗传方差σₐ²和遗传协方差σ(A,z₂)联系起来，左边σ(A,z₂)β₂等于右边σₐ²βₐ；同样，环境协方差σ(E,z₂)β₂等于环境方差σₑ²βₑ。
formula-notes:formula_20.12b:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在推导选择响应时，通过匹配方程(20.11b)和(20.12a)的项，建立了选择梯度与遗传和环境方差-协方差之间的关系，为后续计算总选择响应奠定基础。

formula-notes:formula_20.12b:en.plainMeaning: This formula equates the covariance between breeding value (A) or environmental deviation (E) and the offspring phenotype (z2) times the selection gradient on offspring (β2) to the additive genetic variance (σA²) times the selection gradient on breeding value (βA) or environmental variance (σE²) times the selection gradient on environmental deviation (βE).
formula-notes:formula_20.12b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to selection response in natural populations to connect the multivariate selection response equations (20.11b and 20.12a) to the univariate breeder's equation components, showing how selection on offspring phenotype translates to selection on genetic and environmental components.

formula-notes:formula_20.11a:en.plainMeaning: This formula expresses the selection differential S for a focal trait as the sum of direct selection on that trait (σ²(z₁)β₁) and indirect selection from a correlated trait (σ(z₁,z₂)β₂), and equivalently as the sum of components due to genetic (σ²_A β_A) and environmental (σ²_E β_E) variances plus total phenotypic variance (σ²_z β_z). Key symbols: S (selection differential), σ²(z₁) (variance of trait 1), β₁ (direct selection gradient on trait 1), σ(z₁,z₂) (covariance between traits), β₂ (selection gradient on trait 2), σ²_z (phenotypic variance), β_z (total selection gradient on phenotype), σ²_A (additive genetic variance), β_A (genetic selection gradient), σ²_E (environmental variance), β_E (environmental selection gradient).
formula-notes:formula_20.11a:en.inThisChapter: This formula appears in the introduction to selection response in natural populations to show how the selection differential on a focal trait can be partitioned into direct and indirect components, and how it relates to genetic and environmental sources of variation. It supports later arguments about the breeder's equation and the interpretation of selection in natural populations, particularly when unmeasured correlated traits exist.

formula-notes:formula_20.15a:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the response to selection R as the product of the selection gradient β_z and the sum of phenotypic variance σ_z^2 and genotype-environment covariance σ(E,A), or equivalently as the selection differential S multiplied by the sum of heritability h^2 and the ratio σ(E,A)/σ_z^2.
formula-notes:formula_20.15a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to selection response in natural populations to show how genotype-environment correlation modifies the breeder's equation, supporting later arguments about the conditions under which the simple breeder's equation holds.

formula-notes:formula_20.13a:en.plainMeaning: This formula expresses the additive genetic variance times the selection gradient on the phenotype (σ_A^2 β_z) as heritability times the difference between the total selection differential S and the sum of the selection contributions from additive genetic and environmental components (σ_A^2 β_A + σ_E^2 β_E). Key symbols: h^2 = heritability, σ_z^2 = phenotypic variance, β_z = selection gradient on phenotype, σ_A^2 = additive genetic variance, S = selection differential, β_A = selection gradient on additive genetic value, σ_E^2 = environmental variance, β_E = selection gradient on environmental deviation.
formula-notes:formula_20.13a:en.inThisChapter: This formula appears in the introduction to selection response in natural populations to show how the breeder's equation is modified when genotype-environment correlations exist, and it supports the derivation of the response to selection accounting for such correlations.

formula-notes:formula_20.13b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算总选择响应R，将其分解为三个部分：直接选择S乘以遗传力h²，加上遗传方差σ_A²乘以(1-h²)再乘以遗传选择梯度β_A，减去遗传力h²乘以环境方差σ_E²再乘以环境选择梯度β_E。
formula-notes:formula_20.13b:zh.inThisChapter: 此公式由公式20.10b代入σ_A²β_z的表达式推导而来，用于量化自然选择中遗传与环境因素对表型演化的贡献，为后续讨论遗传力与选择梯度的相互作用提供数学基础。

formula-notes:formula_20.14:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the selection response R when the environment and additive genetic value are correlated (σ(E,A)≠0). Key symbols: R (response), h² (heritability), S (selection differential), σ_A² (additive genetic variance), β_A (additive genetic selection gradient), σ_E² (environmental variance), β_E (environmental selection gradient), σ(E,A) (covariance between environment and additive genetic value), β_z (phenotypic selection gradient).
formula-notes:formula_20.14:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to selection response in natural populations to extend the basic breeder's equation to cases with environmental-genetic covariance, supporting later arguments about realistic evolutionary predictions when such correlations exist.

formula-notes:formula_20.13b:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the total selection response R as the sum of the direct response from phenotypic selection (h²S) plus contributions from genetic (σ²_A(1-h²)β_A) and environmental (h²σ²_Eβ_E) indirect selection, where h² is heritability, S is selection differential, σ²_A is additive genetic variance, σ²_E is environmental variance, and β_A and β_E are selection gradients on breeding value and environment.
formula-notes:formula_20.13b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to selection response in natural populations to decompose R into components due to direct and indirect selection, supporting later arguments about how environmental correlations can bias estimates of evolutionary response.

formula-notes:formula_20.13a:zh.plainMeaning: 公式(20.13a)将遗传力h²乘以表型选择微分σ_z²β_z（即选择差S）分解为遗传方差σ_A²乘以β_z，并等于h²乘以S减去遗传和环境协方差项(σ_A²β_A + σ_E²β_E)的差。
formula-notes:formula_20.13a:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在讨论自然种群中存在基因型-环境相关时的选择响应章节，通过重组(20.10a)得到，为后续推导(20.13b)中遗传响应R与选择差S的关系提供中间步骤。

formula-notes:formula_20.15b:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the selection response R as the product of the additive genetic variance σ²_A and the additive genetic selection gradient β_A, expressed in terms of the selection differential S and the ratio of σ²_A to the sum of σ²_A and the genotype–environment covariance σ(E,A).
formula-notes:formula_20.15b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to selection response in natural populations to show how a genotype–environment correlation (σ(E,A)≠0) can inflate the response relative to the selection differential, supporting the argument that ignoring such correlations can bias predictions.

formula-notes:formula_20.14:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算在环境与遗传协方差σ(E,A)不为零时，自然选择对表型均值造成的响应R，其中h²是遗传力，S是选择差，β_A和β_E分别是遗传值和环境值的选择梯度，σ²_A和σ²_E是遗传和环境方差，β_z是表型选择梯度。
formula-notes:formula_20.14:zh.inThisChapter: 本节引入更一般的响应公式，以处理环境与遗传相关的情况，为后续讨论非独立环境下的选择响应奠定基础。

formula-notes:formula_20.15a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将选择响应R表示为选择差S乘以遗传力h²与基因型-环境协方差σ(E,A)除以表型方差σ_z²之和，即R = (h² + σ(E,A)/σ_z²) S。
formula-notes:formula_20.15a:zh.inThisChapter: 在推导出β_z = S/σ_z²后，代入响应公式(20.9b)得到此式，它展示了当存在基因型-环境相关时，响应R如何偏离经典育种者方程，并为后续讨论相关对响应的影响（如公式20.15b,c）提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_20.15c:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算选择响应R，等于选择差S乘以一个分数，该分数的分子是基因型与环境协方差σ(E,A)，分母是环境方差σ_E²加上该协方差σ(E,A)。
formula-notes:formula_20.15c:zh.inThisChapter: 本章讨论自然群体中的选择响应，此公式展示当只有环境效应影响适合度（β_E≠0）且无直接遗传效应时，响应完全依赖于基因型-环境协方差，为后续讨论瞬态响应（第15章）提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_20.15b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算选择响应R，等于加性遗传方差σ_A^2乘以选择梯度β_A，其中β_A用选择差S表示为S乘以σ_A^2除以σ_A^2与基因型-环境协方差σ(E,A)之和。
formula-notes:formula_20.15b:zh.inThisChapter: 在本节中，该公式用于展示当基因型-环境协方差σ(E,A)存在时，选择响应R与选择差S的关系，为后续讨论无协方差时R=S的特例做铺垫。

formula-notes:formula_20.15c:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the response to selection R as the product of the environmental effect on fitness β_E and the covariance between environment and additive genetic value σ(E,A), which can also be expressed as the selection differential S times the ratio of σ(E,A) to the sum of environmental variance σ_E^2 and σ(E,A). Key symbols: R (response), β_E (environmental effect on fitness), σ(E,A) (covariance between environment E and additive genetic value A), S (selection differential), σ_E^2 (environmental variance).
formula-notes:formula_20.15c:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to selection response in natural populations to illustrate that when only environmental effects influence fitness (β_E ≠ 0, β_A = β_z = 0), response can still occur via genotype-environment correlation σ(E,A). This supports the later argument that such response is transient unless the correlation is perfect.

formula-notes:formula_20.16b:en.plainMeaning: This equation shows that the regression of relative fitness w on phenotype z equals the regression of w on breeding value A_z, scaled by the respective variances. Key symbols: σ(z,w) = covariance of phenotype and fitness, σ²(z) = phenotypic variance, σ(A_z,w) = covariance of breeding value and fitness, σ²(A_z) = additive genetic variance.
formula-notes:formula_20.16b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section questioning whether a focal trait is the direct target of selection, supporting the argument that the phenotypic selection gradient equals the genetic selection gradient when the trait is the direct target, as derived from Queller (1992a).

formula-notes:formula_20.16c:en.plainMeaning: This formula states that the heritability (h²) times the covariance between the trait (z) and relative fitness (w) equals the covariance between the additive genetic component of the trait (A_z) and relative fitness (w).
formula-notes:formula_20.16c:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section discussing whether a focal trait is the direct target of selection, supporting the argument that the selection differential on a trait can be decomposed into genetic and environmental components, and that the genetic covariance with fitness can be estimated from the phenotypic covariance and heritability.

formula-notes:formula_20.16a:en.plainMeaning: This equation states that the response to selection R equals heritability h² times the selection differential S, and also equals the covariance between additive genetic value for the trait A_z and relative fitness w, showing equivalence of the breeder's equation and Robertson's theorem under certain conditions. Key symbols: R (response), h² (heritability), S (selection differential), σ²(A_z) (additive genetic variance), σ²(z) (phenotypic variance), σ(z,w) (covariance between trait and fitness), σ(A_z,w) (covariance between additive genetic value and fitness).
formula-notes:formula_20.16a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in this section to demonstrate the condition under which the breeder's equation and Robertson's theorem yield identical predicted responses, supporting the argument that a focal trait can be the direct target of selection when the covariance between additive genetic value and fitness equals the product of heritability and selection differential.

formula-notes:formula_20.16a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式表明，当使用1966年版Robertson定理时，育种者方程预测的响应R等于h²S，也等于加性遗传方差与表型方差之比乘以选择差，最终等于加性遗传协方差σ(A_z, w)。
formula-notes:formula_20.16a:zh.inThisChapter: 本节探讨焦点性状是否直接受选择作用，该公式通过等价关系连接育种者方程和Robertson定理，为后续推导两者一致的条件（如公式20.16b和20.16c）提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_20.17a:en.plainMeaning: This formula equates the multivariate response to selection vector R (with components equal to the covariance between breeding value of each trait and relative fitness) to the product of the genetic covariance matrix G, the inverse of the phenotypic covariance matrix P⁻¹, and the selection differential vector S.
formula-notes:formula_20.17a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section examining whether a focal trait is the direct target of selection, deriving a multivariate version of Robertson's theorem (Equation 20.16b) by equating the response from Robertson's theorem with that from the multivariate breeder's equation (Equation 13.23b).

formula-notes:formula_20.19a:en.plainMeaning: This formula states that the slope of the univariate regression of relative fitness on breeding value (b_A) equals the slope of the univariate regression of relative fitness on phenotype (b_z).
formula-notes:formula_20.19a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section examining whether a focal trait is the direct target of selection, serving as the univariate version of the condition in Equation 20.17b, which is used to test if selection acts directly on the trait rather than on a correlated character.

formula-notes:formula_20.18:en.plainMeaning: This formula states that the selection differential on breeding value (S_A) equals heritability (h^2) times the phenotypic selection differential (S_z), connecting the response to selection at the genetic level to the observed phenotypic selection.
formula-notes:formula_20.18:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section discussing whether a focal trait is the direct target of selection, showing that the genetic response (S_A) is a fraction (h^2) of the phenotypic differential, which helps distinguish direct selection from indirect selection via correlated traits.

formula-notes:formula_20.17b:en.plainMeaning: This equation states that the selection gradient on breeding values (G⁻¹σ(A_z, w)) equals the selection gradient on phenotypes (P⁻¹σ(z, w)), linking genetic and phenotypic selection. Key symbols: G (genetic covariance matrix), P (phenotypic covariance matrix), σ(A_z, w) (genetic covariance with fitness), σ(z, w) (phenotypic covariance with fitness).
formula-notes:formula_20.17b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on whether a focal trait is the direct target of selection, serving as Rausher's consistency condition that must hold if the trait is under direct selection, and it generalizes Equation 20.16b to the multivariate case.

formula-notes:formula_20.16b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式表明，性状z对适应度w的回归斜率（σ(z,w)/σ²(z)）等于育种值A_z对适应度w的回归斜率（σ(A_z,w)/σ²(A_z)），即通过性状z的加性遗传成分A_z可以等价地估计选择梯度。
formula-notes:formula_20.16b:zh.inThisChapter: 在讨论“焦点性状是否为选择的直接目标”时，该公式将表型选择梯度转化为育种值选择梯度，为后续区分直接选择与间接选择（如通过遗传相关）提供了可操作的计算桥梁。

formula-notes:formula_20.16c:zh.plainMeaning: 公式20.16c表明，当条件满足时，加性遗传方差h²与性状z和适应度w的协方差σ(z,w)的乘积等于加性遗传值A_z与适应度w的协方差σ(A_z,w)。
formula-notes:formula_20.16c:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在讨论焦点性状是否直接受选择的章节，它通过将遗传力h²与协方差联系起来，为后续推导无偏估计σ(A_z,w)提供了代数基础。

formula-notes:formula_20.18:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式表明，基于育种值的选择差S_A等于表型选择差S_z乘以遗传力h²，即S_A = h² S_z。其中S_A = σ(A, w)是育种值与相对适合度的协方差，S_z = σ(z, w)是表型值与相对适合度的协方差。
formula-notes:formula_20.18:zh.inThisChapter: 在本节中，该公式由单变量情况下的式(20.17b)和式(20.16b)推导而来，用于说明当性状是选择直接目标时，育种值选择差与表型选择差之间的线性关系，为后续讨论遗传响应与选择强度的关系提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_20.19a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式表明，当条件成立时，相对适应度对表型值z的回归斜率b_z等于相对适应度对育种值A的回归斜率b_A，即两者在数值上相等。
formula-notes:formula_20.19a:zh.inThisChapter: 本节探讨焦点性状是否直接受选择作用，公式(20.19a)通过展示b_A = b_z，将育种值与表型值的回归斜率联系起来，为后续区分直接选择与间接选择提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_20.17a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将多变量响应向量 R 表示为遗传协方差矩阵 G、表型方差-协方差矩阵的逆 P⁻¹ 与选择差向量 S 的乘积，即 R = G P⁻¹ S，其中 R 的每个分量是性状育种值与相对适应度的协方差 σ(A_i, w)。
formula-notes:formula_20.17a:zh.inThisChapter: 本章通过将 Robertson 定理（R = σ(A_z, w)）与多变量育种者方程（式 13.23b）相等，推导出式 20.17a，从而建立选择响应与遗传、表型参数间的桥梁，为后续讨论焦点性状是否直接受选择提供代数基础。

formula-notes:formula_20.19b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将表型z对适应度w的单变量回归斜率b_z分解为加性遗传分量A的回归斜率b_A与残差分量E的回归斜率b_E的加权平均，权重分别为遗传力h²和1-h²。
formula-notes:formula_20.19b:zh.inThisChapter: 本节探讨焦点性状是否直接受选择作用，公式(20.19b)通过分解b_z为b_A和b_E的加权和，为后续检验b_A是否为零（即A是否直接受选择）提供了统计基础。

formula-notes:formula_20.17b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式通过将选择微分向量从表型空间（P⁻¹σ(z,w)）映射到加性遗传空间（G⁻¹σ(A_z,w)），建立了Rausher一致性条件，其中G是加性遗传协方差矩阵，P是表型协方差矩阵，σ(z,w)是表型与相对适应度的协方差向量，σ(A_z,w)是加性遗传值与相对适应度的协方差向量。
formula-notes:formula_20.17b:zh.inThisChapter: 本节探讨焦点性状是否直接受选择作用，公式(20.17b)作为多变量版本的Rausher一致性条件，将选择响应从表型层面转换到遗传层面，为后续检验性状是否直接受选择提供了可检验的约束条件。

formula-notes:formula_20.20:en.plainMeaning: This formula models fitness (w) as a linear function of the additive genetic component (A) and the residual environmental deviation (E) of a trait, where βA and βE are partial regression coefficients, and e is the error term.
