formula-notes:formula_20.20:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section testing whether a focal trait is the direct target of selection, supporting the Rausher-Simms equality test to distinguish direct selection on A from indirect selection via correlated traits.

formula-notes:formula_20.20:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将相对适合度 w 分解为三个部分：由育种值 A 贡献的部分 β_A A、由残差偏差 E 贡献的部分 β_E E，以及随机误差 e。其中 β_A 和 β_E 分别是 A 和 E 的偏回归系数。
formula-notes:formula_20.20:zh.inThisChapter: 本节通过该回归方程检验焦点性状是否直接受选择：若 β_E 显著非零，则表明残差偏差（即环境或非加性遗传成分）影响适合度，从而否定该性状是选择的直接目标。

formula-notes:formula_20.21c:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式表明，环境协方差σ(E_z, e_w)除以环境方差σ²(E_z)等于加性遗传协方差σ(A_z, A_w)除以加性遗传方差σ²(A_z)，即环境回归系数等于遗传回归系数。
formula-notes:formula_20.21c:zh.inThisChapter: 在讨论焦点性状是否直接受选择时，该公式作为Morrissey一致性条件出现，用于检验环境与遗传对性状协方差的贡献是否一致，从而判断选择是否直接作用于焦点性状。

formula-notes:formula_20.19b:en.plainMeaning: This formula expresses the univariate regression slope of fitness on the phenotype z (b_z) as a weighted average of the slopes on the additive genetic component A (b_A) and the environmental component E (b_E), with weights equal to heritability h² and its complement (1-h²).
formula-notes:formula_20.19b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section examining whether a focal trait is the direct target of selection, showing that b_z conflates direct genetic and environmental effects, which is used to argue that selection on z does not necessarily imply selection on the underlying genes.

formula-notes:formula_20.21a:en.plainMeaning: This equation expresses a consistency condition for selection on a focal trait, equating the total regression coefficient of fitness on the phenotype (left side) to the regression of fitness on the breeding value (right side), using covariances between genetic (A) and environmental (E) components of the trait z and fitness w.
formula-notes:formula_20.21a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section testing whether a focal trait is the direct target of selection, serving to derive conditions under which the phenotypic selection gradient equals the genetic gradient, which is necessary to infer direct selection.

formula-notes:formula_20.21c:en.plainMeaning: This equation states that the regression coefficient of the environmental component of a focal trait (E_z) on the environmental component of a correlated trait (e_w) equals the regression coefficient of the additive genetic component of the focal trait (A_z) on the additive genetic component of the correlated trait (A_w).
formula-notes:formula_20.21c:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section testing whether a focal trait is the direct target of selection, providing a consistency condition (Morrissey et al.) that must hold if the environmental and genetic regressions are proportional, which is used to infer the causal structure of selection.

formula-notes:formula_20.21b:en.plainMeaning: This equation states that the ratio of the sum of covariances of the environmental component (E_z) with the environmental (e_w) and additive genetic (A_w) components of the other trait, to the variance of E_z, equals the analogous ratio for the additive genetic component (A_z). It connects the environmental and genetic contributions to the covariance between traits.
formula-notes:formula_20.21b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section testing whether a focal trait is the direct target of selection, providing a consistency condition that must hold if selection acts directly on the focal trait, supporting the argument that deviations from this equality indicate indirect selection.

formula-notes:formula_20.22b:en.plainMeaning: This formula specifies the joint distribution of the vector of breeding values (a) and the vector of residuals (e), which are both zero-mean and uncorrelated, with covariance matrices σ²(A)A and σ²_e I respectively.
formula-notes:formula_20.22b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to set up the mixed model assumptions for selection response in natural populations, supporting later derivations of prediction equations and variance components.

formula-notes:formula_20.22a:en.plainMeaning: This formula specifies a mixed linear model (the animal model) that partitions the phenotypic vector y into fixed effects (Xβ), additive genetic effects (Z_a a), additional random effects (sum of Z_i u_i), and residual error (e). Key symbols: y = phenotype vector, X = design matrix for fixed effects β, Z_a = incidence matrix for breeding values a, Z_i = incidence matrices for other random effects u_i, e = residual vector.
formula-notes:formula_20.22a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to selection response in natural populations to present the standard animal model used for estimating breeding values and variance components, which later supports the prediction of evolutionary change via the breeder's equation and related selection response formulas.

formula-notes:formula_20.22a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将观测向量 y 分解为固定效应 Xβ、加性遗传效应 Z_a a、k 个其他随机效应 Z_i u_i 以及残差 e 的线性组合，其中 X 是固定效应设计矩阵，Z_a 和 Z_i 是相应的随机效应设计矩阵。
formula-notes:formula_20.22a:zh.inThisChapter: 本章介绍自然种群中的选择响应，该动物模型作为核心工具出现，用于估计育种值 a 并分解表型方差，为后续推导选择响应预测（如公式 20.22b）提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_20.23a:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the molecular similarity at locus ℓ between two individuals x and y, averaging the indicator functions for allelic identity (AIS) across all four possible allele pairs (a with c, a with d, b with c, b with d).
formula-notes:formula_20.23a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to selection response to define a measure of genetic similarity between individuals, which is later used to derive relatedness coefficients and predict response to selection.

formula-notes:formula_20.22b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式表示育种值向量a和残差向量e的联合分布服从均值为零向量、协方差矩阵为分块对角矩阵的多元正态分布，其中a的协方差矩阵为加性遗传方差σ²(A)乘以亲缘关系矩阵A，e的协方差矩阵为残差方差σ_e²乘以单位矩阵I，且a与e不相关（协方差为零矩阵）。
formula-notes:formula_20.22b:zh.inThisChapter: 在本章介绍自然群体选择响应时，该公式为混合模型方程（如20.22a）提供了随机效应的分布假设，即育种值和残差独立且服从指定协方差结构，从而为后续推导育种值BLUP和选择响应公式奠定基础。

formula-notes:formula_20.21b:zh.plainMeaning: 该等式表明，在一致性条件下，性状z对适应度w的总遗传协方差（分子左侧）除以E_z的遗传方差，等于性状z对适应度w的总遗传协方差（分子右侧）除以A_z的遗传方差。其中σ(E_z, e_w)是环境偏差与残差适应度的协方差，σ(E_z, A_w)是环境偏差与加性遗传适应度的协方差，σ(A_z, A_w)是加性遗传性状与加性遗传适应度的协方差，σ(A_z, e_w)是加性遗传性状与残差适应度的协方差。
formula-notes:formula_20.21b:zh.inThisChapter: 本节讨论焦点性状是否直接受选择作用。该公式由公式(20.21a)重排得到，用于推导后续的一致性条件(20.21c)，以检验选择是否直接作用于性状z的加性遗传成分A_z。

formula-notes:formula_20.21a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式表示，在一致性条件（式20.16b）下，表型协方差（分子左侧）与表型方差（分母左侧）之比等于加性遗传协方差（分子右侧）与加性遗传方差（分母右侧）之比。关键符号：A_z和A_w分别为性状z和w的育种值，E_z为环境偏差，e_w为w的剩余偏差。
formula-notes:formula_20.21a:zh.inThisChapter: 此式出现在探讨“焦点性状是否为选择的直接目标”的章节，用于推导一致性条件，为后续判断选择是否直接作用于性状z提供数学依据。它通过比较表型回归系数与遗传回归系数，引出式20.21b和20.21c，从而建立选择响应与遗传协方差的关系。

formula-notes:formula_20.23b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式通过平均L个标记位点的分子共祖系数S_{xy,ℓ}来估计个体x和y之间的加性遗传关系矩阵元素Â_{xy}，其中Â_{xy}=2θ̂_{xy}，θ̂_{xy}是共祖系数θ_{xy}的估计值。
formula-notes:formula_20.23b:zh.inThisChapter: 在自然群体选择响应章节中，该公式将分子标记数据与理论关系矩阵联系起来，为后续利用标记估计遗传参数和预测选择响应提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_20.23b:en.plainMeaning: This formula estimates the additive genetic relationship coefficient between individuals x and y (A_xy) as twice the estimated coancestry (θ_xy), computed as the average over L loci of the indicator S_{xy,ℓ} for allele sharing at locus ℓ.
formula-notes:formula_20.23b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to selection response in natural populations to show how molecular marker data can be used to estimate the relationship matrix needed for predicting evolutionary change.

formula-notes:formula_20.23a:zh.plainMeaning: 公式 (20.23a) 计算两个个体 x 和 y 在基因座 ℓ 上的分子相似度 S_{xy,ℓ}，它等于 x 的两个等位基因（a、b）与 y 的两个等位基因（c、d）之间所有四种配对（ac、ad、bc、bd）的指示函数 I 的平均值，其中 I 在等位基因状态相同（AIS）时取1，否则取0。
formula-notes:formula_20.23a:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在“自然群体中的选择响应：引言”部分，用于定义个体间在单个基因座上的分子相似度，为后续推导群体平均相似度（如公式 20.23b）和选择响应方程（如公式 20.23c 等）提供基础度量。

formula-notes:formula_20.23e:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the total number of shared AIS alleles between two individuals across L loci, where S_{xy,ℓ} is the number of shared alleles at locus ℓ and S_{xy} is the sum over all loci.
formula-notes:formula_20.23e:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to selection response in natural populations to define a simple kinship estimator based on total shared AIS alleles, which will be used in subsequent equations (e.g., 20.23f–20.23k) to derive relatedness measures.

formula-notes:formula_20.23c:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算在标记位点ℓ上，个体x和y的基因型共享指标S_{xy,ℓ}的期望值，它等于基础群体共祖系数θ_{xy}加上(1-θ_{xy})乘以标记位点ℓ的杂合度s_ℓ。
formula-notes:formula_20.23c:zh.inThisChapter: 本节介绍自然群体中选择响应的基础概念，该公式将个体间亲缘关系（θ_{xy}）与标记位点信息（s_ℓ）联系起来，为后续推导选择响应和遗传方差提供期望框架。

formula-notes:formula_20.23e:zh.plainMeaning: 公式(20.23e)将个体间在L个位点上共享的等位基因总数Sxy定义为每个位点共享数Sxy,ℓ的累加和，其中ℓ从1到L。
formula-notes:formula_20.23e:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在介绍基于共享等位基因总数构建亲缘关系估计量的部分，为后续定义基于Sxy的估计量（如公式20.23f）提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_20.23c:en.plainMeaning: This formula gives the expected value of the observed similarity S_{xy,ℓ} at locus ℓ between two individuals x and y as a weighted average of the coancestry θ_{xy} and the population baseline s_ℓ, where s_ℓ is the probability that two random alleles at ℓ are identical in state (AIS).
formula-notes:formula_20.23c:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to selection response in natural populations to show how relatedness and population allele frequencies jointly determine expected genotypic similarity, which is foundational for estimating relatedness and predicting selection response in structured populations.

formula-notes:formula_20.23d:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the estimated coancestry coefficient θ̂_xy between individuals x and y as the average over L SNPs of (S_{xy,ℓ} - s_ℓ)/(1 - s_ℓ), where S_{xy,ℓ} is the observed IBS sharing at SNP ℓ and s_ℓ is the expected IBS sharing under Hardy-Weinberg equilibrium.
formula-notes:formula_20.23d:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to selection response in natural populations as a more general estimator derived from Equation 20.23c, allowing estimation of relatedness from SNP data and setting up discussion of negative estimates when observed IBS is less than expected.

formula-notes:formula_20.23f:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the expected total selection response across all L loci, where E[S_xy] is the sum over loci of per-locus expected responses E[S_xy,ℓ], each decomposed into a baseline component θ_xy and a locus-specific contribution (1-θ_xy)s_ℓ. The result is Lθ_xy + (1-θ_xy)∑s_ℓ.
formula-notes:formula_20.23f:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to selection response in natural populations to aggregate per-locus expectations into a genome-wide expected response, setting the stage for later derivations of response under various genetic architectures.

formula-notes:formula_20.23h:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算两个个体 x 和 y 在基因座 ℓ 上同时携带等位基因 1 的概率，其中 θ_{xy} 是共祖系数，p_ℓ 是等位基因 1 的频率。
formula-notes:formula_20.23h:zh.inThisChapter: 此公式出现在介绍自然群体选择响应的章节，用于将联合概率分解为共祖系数和等位基因频率的函数，为后续推导协方差和选择响应公式提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_20.23g:en.plainMeaning: The Day-Williams estimator computes the selection coefficient for a compound group by adjusting the observed covariance S_xy for the sum of within-group covariances s_ℓ, normalized by the number of groups L minus that sum.
formula-notes:formula_20.23g:en.inThisChapter: This estimator is introduced in the context of selection response in natural populations to provide a corrected measure of selection that accounts for group structure, supporting later analyses of multilevel selection.

formula-notes:formula_20.23d:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式通过平均L个SNP位点的( S_{xy,ℓ} - s_ℓ ) / (1 - s_ℓ )来估计个体x和y之间的共祖系数θ̂_{xy}，其中S_{xy,ℓ}是位点ℓ上x和y的等位基因状态共享指标，s_ℓ是群体中该位点的期望共享概率。
formula-notes:formula_20.23d:zh.inThisChapter: 本章介绍自然种群中的选择响应，此公式由方程20.23c重排得到，提供了一个更通用的θ估计量，并引出后续关于负估计值含义的讨论（当S_{xy,ℓ} < s_ℓ时）。

formula-notes:formula_20.23h:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the probability that a randomly drawn allele from individuals x and y are both 1, given the allele frequency p_ℓ and the coancestry coefficient θ_xy between x and y.
formula-notes:formula_20.23h:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to selection response in natural populations to express the joint probability of identity in state in terms of θ_xy, which is then rearranged to define θ_xy as a correlation coefficient, supporting later derivations of genetic covariance.

formula-notes:formula_20.23j:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the correlation between the trait values T of individuals x and y at SNP ℓ, using the covariance and variances derived from the genotype coding (0,1,2) and allele frequency pℓ.
formula-notes:formula_20.23j:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to selection response to quantify the genetic similarity between individuals at a locus, which is later used to derive the covariance between relatives and the response to selection.

formula-notes:formula_20.23i:en.plainMeaning: This formula defines θ_xy as the correlation between indicator variables b_{x,ℓ} and b_{y,ℓ} for a random allele at locus ℓ in individuals x and y, showing it equals the standardized covariance (correlation coefficient).
formula-notes:formula_20.23i:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to selection response to express the probability of joint allele identity in terms of relatedness, supporting later derivations of covariance between relatives and the Breeder's Equation.

formula-notes:formula_20.23j:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算两个个体x和y在SNP ℓ处的基因型计数T_x,ℓ和T_y,ℓ之间的相关系数，分子是协方差σ(T_x,ℓ,T_y,ℓ)，分母是各自标准差的乘积，最终简化为(T_x,ℓ-2p_ℓ)(T_y,ℓ-2p_ℓ)除以2p_ℓ(1-p_ℓ)，其中p_ℓ是等位基因频率。
formula-notes:formula_20.23j:zh.inThisChapter: 在自然群体选择响应章节中，该公式用于量化不同个体间同一SNP的基因型相关性，为后续推导群体遗传参数（如加性遗传方差）和选择响应公式提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_20.23f:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将个体间性状协方差期望 E[S_xy] 分解为所有 L 个位点的贡献之和，其中每个位点的贡献由亲缘系数 θ_xy 和该位点对性状方差的贡献 s_ℓ 决定，最终表达为 Lθ_xy 加上 (1-θ_xy) 乘以各位点 s_ℓ 的和。
formula-notes:formula_20.23f:zh.inThisChapter: 在自然种群选择响应章节中，该公式通过累加各位点的期望协方差（来自公式20.23c），为后续推导总选择响应（如公式20.23g）提供基础，将多位点遗传结构整合为可计算的总体协方差表达式。

formula-notes:formula_20.23i:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将θ_{xy}定义为两个个体x和y在基因座ℓ上等位基因指示变量b_{x,ℓ}和b_{y,ℓ}之间的相关系数，即corr(b_{x,ℓ}, b_{y,ℓ})，其中pℓ是等位基因频率。
formula-notes:formula_20.23i:zh.inThisChapter: 在推导选择响应时，需要量化个体间等位基因的共变程度，θ_{xy}作为相关系数直接出现在公式20.23h中，用于表达联合概率Pr(b_{x,ℓ}=b_{y,ℓ}=1)，并后续用于计算群体遗传方差和协方差。

formula-notes:formula_20.23k:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the correlation between the total selection differentials for two traits (T_{x,ℓ} and T_{y,ℓ}) as twice the correlation between the breeding values (b_{x,ℓ} and b_{y,ℓ}), which equals 2θ_{xy}.
formula-notes:formula_20.23k:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to selection response in natural populations to show how the correlation of total selection differentials simplifies to a function of the genetic correlation θ_{xy}, supporting later derivations of multivariate response to selection.

formula-notes:formula_20.23g:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算Day-Williams估计量，其中S_xy是样本协方差，s_ℓ是第ℓ个选择位点的选择系数，L是位点总数，估计量通过调整S_xy减去选择效应总和再除以剩余非选择位点比例得到。
formula-notes:formula_20.23g:zh.inThisChapter: 在自然种群选择响应章节中，该公式从之前的协方差分解推导而来，用于在存在多个选择位点时估计遗传协方差，为后续讨论选择响应和遗传参数估计提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_20.24a:en.plainMeaning: This formula expresses the prediction error variance (PEV) σ²(ε) as the difference between the true additive genetic variance σ²(A) and the variance of the predicted breeding value σ²(â), given that â and A are uncorrelated.
formula-notes:formula_20.24a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on applying mixed models to natural populations to derive the PEV, which is then used in subsequent equations (20.24b–h) to quantify prediction accuracy and heritability in natural population settings.

formula-notes:formula_20.23m:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the self-coancestry coefficient (including inbreeding) for individual x, where Â_xx = 1 + f̂_x, with f̂_x being the estimated inbreeding coefficient. T_{x,ℓ} is the genotype indicator (0,1,2) at locus ℓ, p_ℓ is the allele frequency, and L is the number of loci.
formula-notes:formula_20.23m:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to selection response in natural populations to provide a method for estimating individual inbreeding from marker data, which is later used to quantify relatedness and inbreeding depression in selection response analyses.

formula-notes:formula_20.24b:en.plainMeaning: This formula defines the accuracy ρ as the correlation between the estimated breeding value (â) and the true breeding value (A), and simplifies to the square root of the ratio of the variance of â to the variance of A.
formula-notes:formula_20.24b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on applying mixed models to natural populations to quantify the reliability of estimated breeding values, supporting later arguments about selection response and prediction accuracy.

formula-notes:formula_20.23m:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算个体x与自身的亲缘系数估计值Â_xx，其中1代表基线，求和项为近交系数估计，T_{x,ℓ}是x在位点ℓ的基因型编码（0,1,2），p_ℓ是等位基因频率。
formula-notes:formula_20.23m:zh.inThisChapter: 本章介绍自然群体中的选择响应，公式20.23m修正了之前公式中个体与自身共祖系数的估计，为后续讨论近交和遗传多样性提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_20.23k:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将两个个体在基因座ℓ上的传递性等位基因计数Tx,ℓ和Ty,ℓ之间的相关系数corr(Tx,ℓ,Ty,ℓ)表示为该基因座上的等位基因指示变量bx,ℓ和by,ℓ之间的相关系数corr(bx,ℓ,by,ℓ)的两倍，即2θxy，其中θxy是共祖系数。
formula-notes:formula_20.23k:zh.inThisChapter: 在本章关于自然群体中选择响应的介绍中，该公式将传递性等位基因的相关系数与共祖系数θxy直接联系起来，为后续推导个体间遗传协方差以及选择响应公式提供了关键桥梁。

formula-notes:formula_20.24b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将预测育种值(\widehat{a})与真实育种值(A)之间的相关系数ρ定义为协方差除以标准差乘积，并进一步简化为预测值方差与真实值方差之比的平方根，从而直接建立了ρ与方差比的关系。
formula-notes:formula_20.24b:zh.inThisChapter: 在本节中，该公式用于量化混合模型预测的准确性，为后续推导预测方差与准确性的关系（如公式20.24c）以及评估不同预测方法的相对效率提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_20.24c:zh.plainMeaning: 公式 (20.24c) 将预测育种值方差 σ²(â) 表示为真实育种值方差 σ²(A) 乘以相关系数 ρ 的平方，即预测方差等于真实方差乘以准确度的平方。
formula-notes:formula_20.24c:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式由 (20.24b) 直接推导而来，将准确度 ρ 与预测方差联系起来，为后续计算预测误差方差或评估预测可靠性提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_20.24a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算预测误差方差（PEV），即预测值 $\widehat{a}$ 与真实育种值 $A$ 之差的方差 $\sigma^2(\epsilon)$。利用 $\widehat{a}$ 与 $A$ 不相关（$\sigma(\widehat{a},A)=\sigma^2(\widehat{a})$）的假设，将方差分解化简为 $\sigma^2(A)-\sigma^2(\widehat{a})$，表明PEV等于真实育种值方差减去预测值方差。
formula-notes:formula_20.24a:zh.inThisChapter: 本节将混合模型应用于自然群体，需要评估预测的准确性。该公式从方差分解出发，推导出PEV的简洁表达式，为后续公式（20.24b–h）中进一步计算PEV的具体形式（如用亲缘关系矩阵表示）奠定基础。

formula-notes:formula_20.24d:en.plainMeaning: This formula shows that the absolute correlation between the predicted breeding value (PBV, â) and the phenotypic value (z) equals the absolute correlation between the true breeding value (A) and z divided by ρ (the accuracy, correlation between â and A), and is therefore greater than or equal to |corr(A,z)|.
formula-notes:formula_20.24d:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on applying mixed models to natural populations to demonstrate that using PBVs (â) yields a stronger correlation with phenotype than using true breeding values (A), supporting the use of PBVs in selection or prediction.

formula-notes:formula_20.24e:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the variance of the prediction error ε (the difference between estimated breeding value â and true breeding value A) as the product of the additive genetic variance σ²(A) and (1 - ρ²), where ρ is the correlation between â and A (accuracy).
formula-notes:formula_20.24e:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on applying mixed models to natural populations to express the prediction error variance (PEV) in terms of accuracy ρ, linking the concepts of reliability and genetic variance for evaluating breeding value predictions.

formula-notes:formula_20.24f:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the variance of the prediction error ε (or equivalently the covariance between predicted breeding value â and environmental deviation E) as (1 - ρ²) times the additive genetic variance σ²(A). Here ρ² = h² is the heritability, σ²(ε) is the error variance, and σ²(A) is the additive genetic variance.
formula-notes:formula_20.24f:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to selection response to quantify the uncertainty in predicting breeding values from phenotypes, supporting later arguments about the accuracy of selection and the expected response to selection.

formula-notes:formula_20.24d:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算预测育种值(hat{a})与表型值(z)之间的相关系数的绝对值，并证明它等于真实育种值(A)与表型值(z)的相关系数绝对值除以精度ρ，因此大于或等于|corr(A,z)|。关键符号：hat{a}为预测育种值，A为真实育种值，z为表型值，ρ为精度（即corr(hat{a}, A)）。
formula-notes:formula_20.24d:zh.inThisChapter: 在本节中，该公式用于展示PBV(hat{a})比真实育种值A与表型值z的相关性更强，从而说明使用PBV进行选择比直接基于表型值更有效，为后续讨论选择响应和育种计划设计提供理论基础。

formula-notes:formula_20.24e:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将预测误差方差 σ²(ε)（即估计育种值 â 与真实育种值 A 之差的方差）表示为真实育种值方差 σ²(A) 乘以 (1 - ρ²)，其中 ρ 是 â 与 A 之间的相关系数（即准确性）。
formula-notes:formula_20.24e:zh.inThisChapter: 在本节中，该公式直接连接了准确性 ρ 与预测误差方差（PEV），为后续通过 ρ 评估育种值估计的精度提供了基础，并统一了 20.24a 和 20.24c 中关于 PEV 的表达式。

formula-notes:formula_20.24h:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the prediction reliability ρ_i² for individual i as 1 minus the ratio of prediction-error variance (PEV_ii) to additive genetic variance σ²(A).
formula-notes:formula_20.24h:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on selection response in natural populations to quantify the accuracy of predicting an individual's breeding value, supporting later arguments on how prediction reliability affects selection response and genetic gain.

formula-notes:formula_20.24h:zh.plainMeaning: 公式(20.24h)将个体i的预测可靠性ρ_i^2定义为1减去预测误差方差PEV_{ii}与加性遗传方差σ^2(A)的比值，即PEV_{ii}占σ^2(A)的比例越小，可靠性越高。
formula-notes:formula_20.24h:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式由(20.24g)直接变形得到，用于量化个体遗传育种值预测的可靠性，为后续讨论选择响应和预测精度提供基础度量。

formula-notes:formula_20.24g:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the prediction-error variance for individual i (PEV_{ii}) as the product of (1 - ρ_i^2) and the additive genetic variance σ^2(A), where ρ_i^2 is the prediction reliability.
formula-notes:formula_20.24g:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to selection response in natural populations to quantify the uncertainty of estimated breeding values, supporting later arguments about the accuracy of selection predictions.

formula-notes:formula_20.24g:zh.plainMeaning: 公式(20.24g)计算个体i的预测误差方差PEV_{ii}，它等于(1-ρ_i^2)乘以加性遗传方差σ^2(A)，其中ρ_i^2是预测可靠性。
formula-notes:formula_20.24g:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在介绍自然群体选择响应章节，用于从预测误差方差定义预测可靠性，为后续通过可靠性评估育种值估计精度提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_20.24f:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算预测育种值误差ε的方差σ²(ε)，它等于预测育种值â与真实育种值E（即A）的协方差σ(â, E)，也等于(1 - ρ²)乘以育种值A的方差σ²(A)，其中ρ²是预测育种值与真实育种值之间的相关系数平方（即遗传力h²）。
formula-notes:formula_20.24f:zh.inThisChapter: 在介绍自然群体选择响应的章节中，该公式将预测误差方差与遗传力联系起来，为后续推导选择响应（如育种者方程）中预测精度对响应的影响提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_20.26a:en.plainMeaning: This formula specifies the linear mixed model for trait j, where y_j is the vector of phenotypic values, X_j is the design matrix for fixed effects b_j, Z_j is the incidence matrix for random additive genetic effects a_j (breeding values), and e_j is the residual vector.
formula-notes:formula_20.26a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on applying mixed models to natural populations to define the univariate animal model for each trait, which is then combined across traits in Equation 20.26b to form the multivariate animal model that accounts for genetic correlations among traits.

formula-notes:formula_20.25b:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the regression coefficient of relative fitness on predicted breeding value (â), showing it equals the regression on phenotypic value (b_z) divided by the squared accuracy (ρ²) of the prediction. Key symbols: b_â (regression on â), σ(w,â) (covariance of fitness and â), σ²(â) (variance of â), h² (heritability), σ(w,z) (covariance of fitness and phenotype), σ²(z) (phenotypic variance), b_z (regression on z), ρ (accuracy of prediction).
formula-notes:formula_20.25b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to selection response in natural populations to show how using predicted breeding values instead of true breeding values inflates the regression coefficient by 1/ρ², which is important for understanding bias in selection gradient estimates when predictors are imperfect.

formula-notes:formula_20.25b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算将相对适合度w对预测育种值â回归的斜率b_â，它等于b_z（w对表型值z的回归斜率）除以ρ²（â与z的相关系数平方），从而将选择响应从表型尺度转换到预测育种值尺度。
formula-notes:formula_20.25b:zh.inThisChapter: 本节介绍自然群体中的选择响应，公式20.25b通过连接b_â与b_z，为后续使用预测育种值而非真实育种值A来估计选择响应提供关键转换关系，并依赖公式20.24c中σ(w,â)=h²σ(w,z)和σ²(â)=ρ²h²σ²(z)的推导。

formula-notes:formula_20.25a:en.plainMeaning: This formula shows that when selection acts solely on phenotypic values (Equation 20.16b holds), the regression slope of relative fitness on breeding value (b_A) equals the regression slope of relative fitness on phenotypic value (b_z). Key symbols: b_A (slope on breeding value A), σ(w,A) (covariance of fitness with A), σ²(A) (variance of A), h² (heritability), σ(w,z) (covariance of fitness with phenotype z), σ²(z) (phenotypic variance), b_z (slope on phenotype).
formula-notes:formula_20.25a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to selection response in natural populations to establish that under the condition of selection on phenotype only, the regression on breeding value is equivalent to the regression on phenotype. This supports later arguments that when using predicted breeding values (Equation 20.25b), the equivalence may break down, highlighting the importance of accurate estimation.

formula-notes:formula_20.26b:en.plainMeaning: This formula specifies the joint distribution of the random effects (breeding values a_j and residuals e_j) for trait j, assuming they are independent with zero means and covariance matrices σ²(A_j)A and σ²(e_j)I, respectively.
formula-notes:formula_20.26b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on applying mixed models to natural populations to define the covariance structure for a single trait, which is then extended to multiple traits in subsequent arguments (e.g., Equation 20.26a).

formula-notes:formula_20.26a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将第 j 个性状的观测向量 y_j 分解为固定效应部分 X_j b_j、加性遗传效应部分 Z_j a_j 和残差 e_j，其中 X_j 是固定效应设计矩阵，b_j 是固定效应参数向量，Z_j 是关联矩阵，a_j 是育种值向量。
formula-notes:formula_20.26a:zh.inThisChapter: 本节将单性状动物模型扩展到多性状情形，公式 (20.26a) 为每个性状分别建立模型，为后续 (20.26b) 中通过协方差矩阵关联不同性状的育种值和残差、构建多性状混合模型奠定基础。

formula-notes:formula_20.25a:zh.plainMeaning: 公式 (20.25a) 表明，当选择完全基于表型值（即满足方程 20.16b 的条件）时，将相对适合度 w 对育种值 A 回归的斜率 b_A 等于将 w 对表型值 z 回归的斜率 b_z。关键符号：b_A 是 w 对 A 的回归斜率，σ(w,A) 是 w 与 A 的协方差，σ²(A) 是 A 的方差，h² 是遗传力，b_z 是 w 对 z 的回归斜率。
formula-notes:formula_20.25a:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在“自然群体中的选择响应：引言”部分，用于说明在特定条件下（选择完全基于表型），育种值与表型值对适合度的回归斜率相等，从而为后续讨论使用预测育种值（ˆa）时该等式不再成立（如公式 20.25b 所示）做铺垫。

formula-notes:formula_20.27a:en.plainMeaning: This formula sets up a bivariate mixed model where the joint vector of a focal trait (z) and relative fitness (w) is modeled as a linear combination of fixed effects (b_z, b_w), additive genetic effects (a_z, a_w), and residuals (e_z, e_w), with block-diagonal design matrices for fixed and random effects.
formula-notes:formula_20.27a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on applying mixed models to natural populations to formally express the joint analysis of a trait and fitness, which is necessary for estimating genetic covariance and selection gradients in subsequent equations (20.27b–e).

formula-notes:formula_20.26b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式表示性状j的育种值向量a_j和残差向量e_j的联合分布服从均值为零向量、协方差矩阵为分块对角矩阵的多元正态分布，其中a_j的协方差矩阵为σ²(A_j)A（A为亲缘关系矩阵），e_j的协方差矩阵为σ²(e_j)I（I为单位矩阵），且a_j与e_j不相关（协方差为零矩阵）。
formula-notes:formula_20.26b:zh.inThisChapter: 在本节中，该公式将单性状混合模型（公式20.26a）中的随机效应协方差结构具体化，为后续在多性状分析中引入遗传和环境协方差矩阵（如G和E）奠定基础。

formula-notes:formula_20.27b:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the covariance matrix of the stacked vector of breeding values (a_z for trait z, a_w for trait w) as the Kronecker product of the genetic covariance matrix G (containing additive genetic variances σ²(A_z), σ²(A_w) and covariance σ(A_z,A_w)) and the relatedness matrix A.
formula-notes:formula_20.27b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on applying mixed models to natural populations to extend the univariate animal model to multivariate cases (e.g., maternal effects, repeated measures), and it supports later arguments for partitioning genetic covariances and estimating multivariate heritabilities.

formula-notes:formula_20.27a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将焦点性状（z）和相对适应度（w）的观测向量堆叠成一个联合响应向量，并用块对角固定效应矩阵（X_z, X_w）和随机效应矩阵（Z_z, Z_w）分别建模两个性状的固定效应（b_z, b_w）和加性遗传效应（a_z, a_w），加上残差（e_z, e_w）。
formula-notes:formula_20.27a:zh.inThisChapter: 在此节中，该公式将单变量混合模型扩展为双变量混合模型，为后续推导性状-适应度遗传协方差（公式20.27b-20.27e）提供基础，从而估计选择梯度。

formula-notes:formula_20.27c:en.plainMeaning: This 2x2 matrix G contains the genetic variances (σ²(A_z), σ²(A_w)) and covariance (σ(A_z, A_w)) between additive genetic values for two traits z and w.
formula-notes:formula_20.27c:en.inThisChapter: It appears as the core genetic covariance matrix used in the Kronecker product G⊗A to construct the full genetic covariance matrix for multivariate mixed models in natural populations.

formula-notes:formula_20.27b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将两个性状（z和w）的育种值向量（a_z和a_w）的协方差矩阵表示为加性遗传方差-协方差矩阵G与亲缘关系矩阵A的Kronecker积，即G⊗A。其中σ²(A_z)和σ²(A_w)是性状z和w的加性遗传方差，σ(A_z,A_w)是它们之间的加性遗传协方差。
formula-notes:formula_20.27b:zh.inThisChapter: 在本节中，该公式将单性状的混合模型（公式20.27a）扩展为多性状情形，为后续推导多性状BLUP（公式20.27c）和预测误差方差（公式20.27d-e）提供了核心协方差结构。

formula-notes:formula_20.27c:zh.plainMeaning: 该矩阵 G 是 2×2 遗传方差-协方差矩阵，其对角线元素 σ²(A_z) 和 σ²(A_w) 分别表示性状 z 和 w 的加性遗传方差，非对角线元素 σ(A_z, A_w) 表示两性状间的加性遗传协方差。
formula-notes:formula_20.27c:zh.inThisChapter: 在 20.27b 式中，G 与亲缘关系矩阵 A 做 Kronecker 积，构成多性状混合模型中加性遗传效应的协方差结构；后续 20.27d 式将类似地定义残差协方差矩阵，从而完整刻画两性状的随机效应协方差。

formula-notes:formula_20.27d:en.plainMeaning: This formula specifies the covariance structure for the stacked residual vectors e_z and e_w, where the covariance matrix is the Kronecker product of E (the 2×2 residual covariance matrix) with the identity matrix I, indicating independent and identically distributed residuals within each trait.
formula-notes:formula_20.27d:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on applying mixed models to natural populations to define the residual covariance structure, complementing the genetic covariance matrix in (20.27c) and enabling the full specification of the multivariate mixed model for two traits.

formula-notes:formula_20.28a:en.plainMeaning: This formula partitions the selection differential S_z (covariance between phenotypic value z and fitness w) into a genetic component σ(A_z, A_w) (expected selection response under Robertson's theorem) and an environmental component σ(e_z, e_w), assuming no covariance between additive genetic values and environmental deviations.
formula-notes:formula_20.28a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on applying mixed models to natural populations to show how the total selection differential can be decomposed, supporting later arguments that the genetic component (Equation 20.28b) directly estimates the expected response to selection.

formula-notes:formula_20.27e:en.plainMeaning: This formula specifies the assumed covariance matrix of the vector of additive genetic values (a_z, a_w) and environmental deviations (e_z, e_w) for two traits z and w, where G is the genetic covariance matrix, A is the additive genetic relationship matrix, E is the environmental covariance matrix, and I is an identity matrix.
formula-notes:formula_20.27e:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on applying mixed models to natural populations to define the covariance structure under standard assumptions, supporting the estimation of genetic parameters and hypothesis testing about genetic correlations in wild populations.

formula-notes:formula_20.27d:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式用克罗内克积（⊗）表示残差向量 e_z 和 e_w 的协方差矩阵：整体协方差矩阵等于残差协方差矩阵 E（包含 e_z 和 e_w 的方差及协方差）与单位矩阵 I 的克罗内克积。
formula-notes:formula_20.27d:zh.inThisChapter: 在混合模型应用于自然种群中，公式(20.27d)与(20.27c)的遗传协方差矩阵对应，共同构建了表型协方差矩阵的分解，为后续估计遗传参数和假设检验提供残差结构。

formula-notes:formula_20.28b:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the selection differential on the breeding value (A_z) of the focal trait, defined as the covariance between A_z and fitness w. It shows that this equals the covariance between A_z and the breeding value for fitness (A_w), because the environmental component e_w is uncorrelated with A_z.
formula-notes:formula_20.28b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in this section to contrast with Equation 20.28a, which estimates selection on phenotypic value, highlighting that using variance components avoids pitfalls of individual-level analysis in natural populations.

formula-notes:formula_20.28b:zh.plainMeaning: 公式 (20.28b) 计算焦点性状育种值 A_z 与适合度 w 的协方差 S_A，其中 w 被分解为 A_w + e_w，最终简化为 A_z 与 A_w 的协方差 σ(A_z, A_w)。
formula-notes:formula_20.28b:zh.inThisChapter: 在应用混合模型于自然种群时，该公式与 (20.28a) 并列，分别给出表型值和育种值上的选择差估计，为后续利用方差组分避免个体水平分析的陷阱做铺垫。

formula-notes:formula_20.27e:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式给出了所有加性遗传效应（a_z, a_w）和残差（e_z, e_w）的协方差矩阵，其中加性效应的协方差为G⊗A，残差的协方差为E⊗I，且两者之间协方差为零。
formula-notes:formula_20.27e:zh.inThisChapter: 在本节中，该公式将前面对性状z和w的遗传协方差结构假设（如G和A）与残差结构（E和I）整合为一个完整的块对角协方差矩阵，为后续进行多变量混合模型分析（如估计遗传参数）提供了基础。

formula-notes:formula_20.28a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将选择差 S_z（即表型值 z 与适应度 w 的协方差）分解为加性遗传协方差 σ(A_z, A_w) 与环境协方差 σ(e_z, e_w) 之和，其中 A_z 和 A_w 分别为焦点性状和适应度的加性遗传值，e_z 和 e_w 为对应的环境偏差。
formula-notes:formula_20.28a:zh.inThisChapter: 在本节中，该公式用于在假设加性遗传值与环境偏差不相关（σ(A_z, e_w)=σ(A_w, e_z)=0）的条件下，将表型选择差拆分为遗传和环境成分，从而为后续推导加性遗传选择差 S_A（公式20.28b）提供基础，并联系 Robertson 定理（公式6.24a）中的期望选择响应。

formula-notes:formula_20.29a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式给出了四个随机向量（a_z, a_w, e_z, e_w）的协方差矩阵，其中对角块为G⊗A和E⊗I，非对角块C及其转置表示加性遗传效应与残差之间的协方差。
formula-notes:formula_20.29a:zh.inThisChapter: 在放宽加性遗传效应与残差独立的假设后，公式(20.29a)替代了(20.27e)，为后续推导更一般的混合模型（如公式20.29b-20.29d）提供了协方差结构基础。

formula-notes:formula_20.29a:en.plainMeaning: This formula gives the covariance matrix of the vectors of breeding values (a_z, a_w) and environmental deviations (e_z, e_w) for two traits z and w, allowing cross-covariances between breeding values and environmental deviations. Key symbols: G (genetic covariance matrix), A (additive genetic relationship matrix), E (environmental covariance matrix), I (identity matrix), C (matrix of covariances between a and e).
formula-notes:formula_20.29a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in this section to relax the assumption of zero covariance between breeding values and environmental deviations, supporting a more general mixed model analysis of natural populations where such covariances may exist due to non-random mating or environmental correlations.

formula-notes:formula_20.29c:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the phenotypic selection differential (S_z) as the sum of four covariances: between breeding values of the trait (A_z) and fitness (A_w), between environmental deviations (e_z, e_w), and the cross-covariances between breeding value of one and environmental deviation of the other.
formula-notes:formula_20.29c:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on applying mixed models to natural populations to express the phenotypic selection differential in terms of genetic and environmental components, supporting the use of Postma's test (Equation 20.18) under the general consistency condition (Equation 20.21b).

formula-notes:formula_20.29d:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the breeding-value selection differential (S_A) as the sum of the covariance between breeding value for the trait (A_z) and breeding value for fitness (A_w) plus the covariance between breeding value for the trait (A_z) and the environmental deviation for fitness (e_w).
formula-notes:formula_20.29d:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section applying mixed models to natural populations to decompose the selection differential into genetic and environmental components, supporting the argument that selection on breeding value depends only on covariances involving A_z.

formula-notes:formula_20.29b:en.plainMeaning: This matrix C contains covariances between additive genetic effects (a_z, a_w) and residuals (e_z, e_w) for two traits z and w. The off-diagonal blocks are proportional to the additive genetic relationship matrix A, with coefficients σ(A_z, e_w) and σ(A_w, e_z); the diagonal blocks are zero, indicating no direct covariance between a trait's genetic effect and its own residual.
formula-notes:formula_20.29b:en.inThisChapter: In this section on applying mixed models to natural populations, C appears in the joint covariance matrix (20.29a) to allow for covariances between genetic and residual effects across traits, which is necessary when modeling multiple traits with potentially correlated residuals and genetic effects.

formula-notes:formula_20.29b:zh.plainMeaning: 该矩阵C表示加性遗传效应向量a与残差向量e之间的协方差矩阵，其中非对角块σ(A_z, e_w)A和σ(A_w, e_z)A分别刻画了不同性状（z和w）的加性遗传效应与残差之间的协方差，而对角块为零矩阵，表明同一性状的加性效应与残差不相关。
formula-notes:formula_20.29b:zh.inThisChapter: 在20.29a的方差-协方差矩阵中，C作为非对角块出现，用于连接加性遗传效应和残差，为后续推导多性状混合模型中的协方差结构（如20.29c和20.29d）提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_20.29d:zh.plainMeaning: 公式 (20.29d) 计算育种值选择差 S_A，它等于加性遗传协方差 σ(A_z, A_w) 加上加性遗传值与环境偏差的协方差 σ(A_z, e_w)。
formula-notes:formula_20.29d:zh.inThisChapter: 在将混合模型应用于自然种群的章节中，该公式从表型选择差 (20.29c) 中分离出育种值部分，为后续推导遗传响应和预测进化变化提供关键组件。

formula-notes:formula_20.231:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the genetic relationship coefficient \(\widehat{A}_{xy}\) (twice the coancestry \(\widehat{\theta}_{xy}\)) between individuals x and y, using allele frequencies \(p_\ell\) and genotype indicators \(T_{x,\ell}\) (0,1,2) across L SNPs.
formula-notes:formula_20.231:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to quantify realized relatedness from genome-wide SNP data, supporting later arguments on how selection response depends on additive genetic covariance among relatives.

formula-notes:formula_20.29c:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将表型选择差 S_z 分解为四个协方差项：加性遗传效应 A 与配偶加性遗传效应 A_w 的协方差、残差 e 与配偶残差 e_w 的协方差、加性效应与配偶残差的协方差、以及残差与配偶加性效应的协方差，从而量化了非随机交配和表型相关对选择差的影响。
formula-notes:formula_20.29c:zh.inThisChapter: 在本节中，该公式用于将 Postma 检验（公式 20.18）扩展到自然种群，其中表型选择差 S_z 需考虑遗传和残差分量之间的交叉协方差，为后续推导育种值选择差 S_A（公式 20.29d）以及检验遗传协方差与残差协方差是否相等提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_21.1b:zh.plainMeaning: 公式(21.1b)计算全同胞选择下的响应Ry，等于选择单元与后代性状的协方差σ(x,y)除以选择单元方差σx²，再乘以平均选择差Sx。
formula-notes:formula_21.1b:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在全同胞选择路径分析中，是公式(21.1a)在父母协方差相等时的简化形式，为后续推导复合选择单元（如公式21.1c）提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_21.1a:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the expected single-cycle response (Ry) as the sum of separate contributions from male and female selection, where each contribution is the product of the selection differential (S) and the regression coefficient of the trait y on the selected trait x (σ(x,y)/σ²_x).
formula-notes:formula_21.1a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on expected single-cycle response to show how the breeder's equation generalizes to separate selection in males and females, supporting later derivations of response under the infinitesimal model.

formula-notes:formula_21.1a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将雌雄两性的选择响应（S_{x_m}和S_{x_f}）分别乘以各自的遗传回归系数（性状x对y的协方差除以x的方差），然后相加，得到总响应R_y。
formula-notes:formula_21.1a:zh.inThisChapter: 本章推导单周期预期响应，该公式是育种者方程（13.4a/b）在雌雄选择强度不同时的直接推广，为后续讨论非对称选择（如性别特异性选择）提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_21.1c:en.plainMeaning: This formula expresses the total covariance between the selection unit x and offspring y as the sum of covariances through the female parent (R_f) and male parent (R_m), which equals twice the covariance through a single parent (R) when the two are equal.
formula-notes:formula_21.1c:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the derivation of the expected single-cycle response to show how the parent-offspring covariance in the response equation (21.1b) can be decomposed into contributions from both parents, supporting the simplification that leads to the final response formula.

formula-notes:formula_21.1b:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the single-cycle response to selection (Ry) as the product of the regression coefficient of offspring on selection unit (σ(x,y)/σx²) and the average selection differential (Sx). Key symbols: Ry = response, σ(x,y) = covariance between selection unit and offspring, σx² = variance of selection unit, Sx = average selection differential.
formula-notes:formula_21.1b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on expected single-cycle response to simplify the expression for full-sib selection when selection unit-offspring covariances are equal for both parents, supporting later derivations of response under more complex pedigrees.

formula-notes:formula_21.2a:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the response in trait y (R_y) as the product of the generalized heritability of y given x (h_{x,y}^2) and the selection differential on x (S_x). It is analogous to the breeder's equation.
formula-notes:formula_21.2a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in this section to express the expected single-cycle response in a correlated trait using a heritability-like coefficient, supporting later arguments about indirect selection and correlated responses.

formula-notes:formula_20.231:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算个体x和y之间的基因组关系系数估计值（\(\widehat{A}_{xy}\)），等于两倍共祖系数估计值（\(2\widehat{\theta}_{xy}\)），通过对L个SNP位点求和平均得到，其中\(T_{x,\ell}\)和\(T_{y,\ell}\)分别是个体x和y在位点ℓ的基因型编码（0,1,2），\(p_\ell\)是位点ℓ的等位基因频率。
formula-notes:formula_20.231:zh.inThisChapter: 本章引入选择反应时，需要量化个体间的遗传相似性，该公式提供了基于SNP数据估计亲缘关系的方法，为后续推导选择反应和遗传方差组分奠定基础。

formula-notes:formula_21.2b:en.plainMeaning: This formula defines the generalized heritability of y given x, denoted h_{x,y}^2, as the ratio of the covariance σ(x,y) to the variance σ_x^2, which equals twice the slope of the regression of y on x conditional on the response R.
formula-notes:formula_21.2b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in this section to extend the breeder's equation (21.1b) to a generalized form (21.2a), where h_{x,y}^2 replaces individual heritability h^2, allowing prediction of response R_y from selection differential S_x in a multivariate context.

formula-notes:formula_21.3a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算单周期响应R_y，即后代性状y的均值变化，等于父本选择强度乘以父本性状x_m与y的协方差除以x_m标准差，加上母本选择强度乘以母本性状x_f与y的协方差除以x_f标准差。
formula-notes:formula_21.3a:zh.inThisChapter: 在“期望单周期响应理论”章节中，该公式将选择强度版本（21.1a）推广到两性选择强度不同的情况，为后续推导联合选择响应（如21.3b）奠定基础。

formula-notes:formula_21.1c:zh.plainMeaning: 公式(21.1c)将选择单位x与后代y之间的总协方差σ(x,y)分解为通过父亲路径的协方差σ(x,y|R_f)和通过母亲路径的协方差σ(x,y|R_m)之和；当两条路径的协方差相等时，总协方差等于单条路径协方差σ(x,y|R)的两倍。
formula-notes:formula_21.1c:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在推导单周期响应R_y的过程中，用于将总协方差拆分为父本和母本贡献，从而将(21.1b)中的σ(x,y)与后续的遗传力等概念联系起来，为理解双亲对选择响应的共同作用提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_21.2a:zh.plainMeaning: 公式(21.2a)将响应变量y的单周期响应R_y表示为广义遗传力h_{x,y}^2与选择差S_x的乘积，其中h_{x,y}^2度量了x对y的遗传传递能力，S_x是x上的选择差。
formula-notes:formula_21.2a:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在“期望单周期响应理论”一节，通过类比育种者方程(21.1b)将响应分解为遗传力与选择差的乘积，为后续定义广义遗传力(21.2b)并推导多变量响应奠定基础。

formula-notes:formula_21.2b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式定义了广义遗传力 h_{x,y}^2，它等于性状 x 和 y 的协方差 σ(x,y) 除以 x 的方差 σ_x^2，也等于 2 倍给定选择响应 R 条件下 x 和 y 的条件协方差 σ(x,y|R) 除以 σ_x^2。
formula-notes:formula_21.2b:zh.inThisChapter: 在本节“期望单周期响应理论”中，公式 (21.2b) 将广义遗传力与育种者方程 (21.1b) 中的响应 R_y 和选择差 S_x 联系起来，为后续推导相关性状的响应公式提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_21.3a:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the expected single-cycle response (Ry) as the sum of contributions from male and female selection, where each contribution is the product of the selection intensity (ī) and the genetic covariance (σ) between the selected trait (x) and the response trait (y), divided by the standard deviation of the selected trait (σ_x).
formula-notes:formula_21.3a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on expected single-cycle response to express the response in terms of selection intensities, enabling standardized comparisons across different selection schemes, and it supports later derivations such as Equation 21.3b.

formula-notes:formula_21.4a:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the expected single-cycle response to selection (Ry) as the product of the phenotypic standard deviation (σz), the average selection intensity (īx), and the correlation between selection units and offspring (ρ(x,y)).
formula-notes:formula_21.4a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the theory of expected single-cycle response to derive the response from the selection intensity and correlation, supporting later calculations of response under different selection scenarios.

formula-notes:formula_21.3b:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the expected response to selection in the offspring (Ry) as the product of the covariance between parent and offspring (σ(x,y)) divided by the phenotypic standard deviation of the parent (σ_x) and the average selection intensity (ī_x).
formula-notes:formula_21.3b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the theory of expected single-cycle response to show how the response depends on the average selection intensity when regressions are equal for both sexes, supporting the derivation of the response in terms of selection unit-offspring correlation.

formula-notes:formula_21.3b:zh.plainMeaning: 公式 (21.3b) 计算在双亲回归相同的情况下，子代响应 R_y 等于性状 x 与 y 的协方差 σ(x,y) 除以 x 的标准差 σ_x，再乘以平均选择强度 ī_x。
formula-notes:formula_21.3b:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在“期望单周期响应”理论部分，由 (21.3a) 在双亲回归相同的假设下推导而来，为后续用选择单位-子代相关表达响应提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_21.5:en.plainMeaning: This formula expresses the phenotypic correlation ρ(x,y) between a trait x in one generation and the same trait y in the next generation as the product of the square root of heritability h and the genetic correlation ρ(x,A_R) between the trait and the breeding value for the selected character.
formula-notes:formula_21.5:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on expected single-cycle response to show how the parent-offspring correlation can be decomposed into heritability and genetic correlation, which is used to derive the response to selection.

formula-notes:formula_21.4b:zh.plainMeaning: 公式(21.4b)计算对y（后代性状）的单周期响应Ry，它等于加性遗传标准差σA乘以选择强度īx再乘以选择单元x与后代y的亲本育种值A_R之间的相关系数ρ(x, A_R)，即选择准确度。
formula-notes:formula_21.4b:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式是(21.4a)的变体，通过引入选择准确度ρ(x, A_R)将响应表达为选择单元与育种值相关性的函数，为后续讨论不同选择方法（如个体选择、家系选择）的准确度比较提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_21.4b:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the expected single-cycle response to selection (Ry) as the product of the additive genetic standard deviation (σA), the standardized selection differential (īx), and the accuracy of selection ρ(x, Aℛ), which is the correlation between the selection criterion (x) and the breeding value of the parent (Aℛ).
formula-notes:formula_21.4b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in this section to express the response to selection in terms of accuracy, linking the selection differential and heritability concepts from earlier chapters to the prediction of response in a single cycle, and it supports later arguments about the impact of selection accuracy on genetic gain.

formula-notes:formula_21.5:zh.plainMeaning: 公式(21.5)将表型相关系数ρ(x,y)表示为遗传力h与个体x与育种值A_R的相关系数ρ(x,A_R)的乘积，其中σ_A是育种值标准差，σ_z是表型标准差。
formula-notes:formula_21.5:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在“期望单周期响应”理论章节，用于将选择响应中的相关系数分解为遗传力与育种值相关性的乘积，为后续推导选择响应公式（如R = h^2 S）提供关键连接。

formula-notes:formula_21.7b:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the covariance between the deviation of an individual's phenotype from its family mean and the phenotype of a relative y, equating it to (1 - r_n) times the additive genetic variance σ_A^2, where r_n is the coefficient of relationship between the individual and y.
formula-notes:formula_21.7b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on expected single-cycle response to derive the total parent-offspring covariance by doubling the single-parent contribution, supporting the calculation of response to selection.

formula-notes:formula_21.6a:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the covariance between the mean of family i (over n individuals) and the phenotypic value y, given that the family mean for trait 1 equals x_ij. It decomposes the covariance into a within-family component (1/n σ(z_ij, y)) and a between-family component ((1-1/n) σ(z_ik, y)), then expresses it in terms of additive genetic variance σ_A^2 and coancestry coefficients Θ.
formula-notes:formula_21.6a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on expected single-cycle response to illustrate how coefficients of coancestry (from Table 21.2) are used to compute covariances in family selection, supporting the derivation of selection response formulas (21.6b, 21.6c).

formula-notes:formula_21.6a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算在给定一个亲本为自交系（R1=xij）的条件下，家系均值（z̄_i）与群体均值（y）的协方差。它分解为：第一项是同一家系内个体（zij）与y的协方差乘以1/n，第二项是不同家系个体（zik）与y的协方差乘以(1-1/n)，最终用加性遗传方差σA²和共祖系数Θ表达。
formula-notes:formula_21.6a:zh.inThisChapter: 本节推导家系选择下响应预测的协方差公式，此式（21.6a）是基础，后续（21.6b、21.6c）将针对不同亲本类型（如一般配合力）给出具体Θ值，从而得到可计算的协方差表达式。

formula-notes:formula_21.6c:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the covariance between the average effect of an allele substitution in parent i (z̄_i) and the phenotypic value y of an offspring, showing it equals twice the conditional covariance given parent R1, and also equals the product of the coefficient of relationship r_n and the additive genetic variance σ_A^2.
formula-notes:formula_21.6c:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on expected single-cycle response to derive the covariance between parent average effects and offspring phenotype, which is essential for predicting response to selection using the breeder's equation.

formula-notes:formula_21.7a:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the covariance between an individual's family deviation (z_ij - mean_z_i) and its offspring's phenotypic value y, given that the individual's own phenotypic value equals x_ij. It equals the parent-offspring covariance (sigma_A^2/2) multiplied by (1 - r_n), where r_n is the correlation between family means.
formula-notes:formula_21.7a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on expected single-cycle response to derive the contribution of family deviation to the selection response, and it supports the subsequent formula (21.7b) that doubles this covariance to account for both parents.

formula-notes:formula_21.6b:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the covariance between the mean phenotype of a family (with n individuals) and the breeding value of a parent, given that the parent's phenotype equals a specific value. σ(ẑ_i, y | ℛ₁ = x_ij) is the conditional covariance, r_n is the effective additive genetic relationship within the family, and σ_A² is the additive genetic variance.
formula-notes:formula_21.6b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on expected single-cycle response to derive the covariance structure needed for predicting response to selection. This result supports later arguments (e.g., Equation 21.6c) about the expected response when selection is based on family means.

formula-notes:formula_21.6b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算在给定一个共同亲本（ℛ₁ = xᵢⱼ）条件下，半同胞组均值（z̄ᵢ）与个体表型值（y）的协方差，等于 rₙ 乘以加性遗传方差的一半（σ²A/2），其中 rₙ = r + (1-r)/n 是调整后的亲缘系数。
formula-notes:formula_21.6b:zh.inThisChapter: 本章推导单周期响应理论，公式21.6b通过Wright系数简化了21.6a，为后续计算选择响应（如公式21.6c）提供关键协方差表达式。

formula-notes:formula_21.6c:zh.plainMeaning: 公式(21.6c)表明，个体i的育种值估计量z̄_i与个体y的表型值之间的协方差σ(z̄_i, y)等于2倍的条件协方差σ(z̄_i, y | R₁)，也等于亲缘系数r_n乘以加性遗传方差σ_A²。
formula-notes:formula_21.6c:zh.inThisChapter: 在“理论：期望单周期响应”一节中，该公式用于将育种值估计量与表型值的协方差表示为亲缘系数和加性遗传方差的函数，为后续推导选择响应和预测遗传进展提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_21.8a:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the among-family variance (σ_b²) as the sum of the among-family genetic variance (σ_GF²) and the among-family environmental variance (σ_Ec²), where σ_b² is the variance of expected family means μ_i.
formula-notes:formula_21.8a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the theory of expected single-cycle response to decompose the total among-family variance into genetic and environmental components, supporting later derivations of genetic variance (Equations 21.11a and 21.26a) and the overall response model.

formula-notes:formula_21.7b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算了第i个家系中个体j的育种值偏离家系均值（z_{ij}-\overline{z}_i）与后代个体y的育种值之间的协方差，等于(1-r_n)倍的加性遗传方差σ_A^2，其中r_n是亲缘系数。
formula-notes:formula_21.7b:zh.inThisChapter: 本节推导单周期响应理论，公式(21.7b)通过将亲本-后代协方差加倍（考虑双亲）并引入亲缘系数r_n，得到家系内偏差与后代协方差的表达式，为后续计算选择响应和方差分量提供关键协方差项。

formula-notes:formula_21.7a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算在给定个体i的育种值x_{ij}条件下，个体i的家族偏差(z_{ij}-\overline{z}_i)与其后代表型值y的协方差。它等于个体i的表型值z_{ij}与y的协方差减去家族均值\overline{z}_i与y的协方差，结果为(1-r_n)\sigma_A^2/2，其中r_n是家族内个体间的相关系数，\sigma_A^2是加性遗传方差。
formula-notes:formula_21.7a:zh.inThisChapter: 本章推导预期单周期响应，该公式用于量化家族内偏差与后代表型的关系，为后续将单亲贡献加倍得到总贡献（公式21.7b）提供中间步骤。

formula-notes:formula_21.8a:zh.plainMeaning: 公式(21.8a)将家系间方差 σ_b² 分解为家系间遗传方差 σ_GF² 和家系间环境方差 σ_Ec² 之和，即家系期望均值 μ_i 的方差等于这两部分方差相加。
formula-notes:formula_21.8a:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在“期望单周期响应理论”部分，用于定义家系间方差的结构，为后续推导家系间遗传方差 σ_GF² 的具体表达式（如公式21.11a和21.26a）以及进一步分析选择响应提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_21.8b:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the within-family variance of individual phenotypic values (z_ij) around their family mean (μ_i), partitioning it into within-family genetic variance (σ²_Gw) and within-family environmental variance (σ²_Es).
formula-notes:formula_21.8b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on expected single-cycle response to quantify the within-family component of phenotypic variance, which is needed to predict response to selection and to derive the total variance decomposition (Equations 21.11b and 21.26b).

formula-notes:formula_21.8d:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the variance of the deviation of an individual observation from its family mean, showing it equals the within-family variance multiplied by (1 - 1/n), where n is the family size and σ_w² is the within-family variance.
formula-notes:formula_21.8d:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on expected single-cycle response to quantify how using the observed family mean (instead of the expected mean) reduces the within-family variance, which is needed for deriving the response to selection formulas.

formula-notes:formula_21.8d:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算个体观测值减去其家族均值后的方差，等于(1-1/n)乘以家族内方差σ_w²，其中n是每个家族的个体数。
formula-notes:formula_21.8d:zh.inThisChapter: 在推导总方差分解为家族间和家族内方差后，此公式说明当使用观测均值而非期望均值时，家族内方差会因均值估计而减少(1-1/n)倍，为后续理解方差分量估计提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_21.8c:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算基于n个同胞均值的家系间方差：它等于家系间真实均值μ_i的方差σ_b^2加上估计误差ē_i的方差σ_w^2/n。
formula-notes:formula_21.8c:zh.inThisChapter: 在讨论单周期响应期望理论时，公式(21.8c)展示了用家系均值估计家系效应时，家系间观测方差由遗传方差σ_b^2和抽样误差方差σ_w^2/n组成，为后续推导选择响应和方差分解提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_21.9b:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the variance of the mean phenotype among n sibs, where σ²(z̄_i) = t_n σ_z², with t_n being the intraclass correlation among sib means and σ_z² the total phenotypic variance.
formula-notes:formula_21.9b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on expected single-cycle response to quantify the sampling variance of family means, which is needed to derive the accuracy of selection based on family information.

formula-notes:formula_21.9a:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the variance of the mean single-cycle response, decomposing it into between-group variance components (σ²_GF + σ²_Ec) and within-group variance components (σ²_Gw + σ²_Es) divided by sample size n.
formula-notes:formula_21.9a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the theory of expected single-cycle response to quantify total variability in mean response, supporting later arguments about precision and sample size requirements in repeated measures designs.

formula-notes:formula_21.8c:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the variance of observed family means (z̄_i) as the sum of among-family variance (σ_b²) and within-family variance divided by family size (σ_w²/n), where μ_i is the true family mean and ē_i is the average error.
formula-notes:formula_21.8c:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on expected single-cycle response to show how using family means reduces within-family variance in the among-family variance component, supporting later derivations of selection response and heritability estimates.

formula-notes:formula_21.9c:en.plainMeaning: This formula defines t_n as a weighted average of the intraclass correlation t and 1, where n is the number of observations per group. It adjusts the correlation for group size.
formula-notes:formula_21.9c:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the context of deriving the variance of group means (Equation 21.9b), showing how the intraclass correlation t is modified by sample size n to account for within-group dependence.

formula-notes:formula_21.9b:zh.plainMeaning: 公式(21.9b)计算的是基于n个同胞的组均值(\overline{z}_i)的方差，它等于组内表型方差(σ_z^2)乘以系数t_n。其中t_n由公式(21.9c)定义，t是同胞间的表型相关系数。
formula-notes:formula_21.9b:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在“期望单周期响应”理论部分，用于量化基于同胞组均值进行选择时，组均值作为选择变量的方差。它后续将用于推导选择响应和预测遗传进展，类似于公式(21.6b)中r_n的作用。

formula-notes:formula_21.9a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将单个被试在i条件下的平均观测值z̄_i的方差分解为四项：组间遗传方差σ²_GF、组间环境方差σ²_Ec、以及除以n后的组内遗传方差σ²_Gw和组内环境方差σ²_Es，其中n是每个被试的观测次数。
formula-notes:formula_21.9a:zh.inThisChapter: 在“单周期反应期望理论”章节中，此公式由式21.8c推导而来，用于量化个体平均值的方差组成，为后续讨论组内与组间方差成分的估计（如式21.9b和21.9c）提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_21.4a:zh.plainMeaning: 公式 R_y = σ_z ī_x ρ(x,y) 计算的是对选择单元（如亲本）施加选择后，响应变量（如子代）的预期单周期响应 R_y，其中 σ_z 是响应变量的标准差，ī_x 是选择单元的平均选择强度，ρ(x,y) 是选择单元与响应变量之间的相关系数。
formula-notes:formula_21.4a:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在“预期单周期响应理论”一节中，它从公式 21.3b 直接推导而来，通过将协方差 σ(x,y) 替换为 ρ(x,y)σ_xσ_y 并利用 σ_z = σ_y 的关系，将响应表达为更直观的相关性形式，为后续讨论选择强度与相关性的作用奠定基础。

formula-notes:formula_21.10a:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the variance of the deviation of an individual observation from its family mean, expressed as the product of a correction factor (1 - 1/n) and the sum of within-family genetic variance (σ²_Gw) and special environmental variance (σ²_Es).
formula-notes:formula_21.10a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on expected single-cycle response to quantify within-family variation, which is then used to derive the intraclass correlation and the simplified form (21.10b) for predicting response to selection.

formula-notes:formula_21.10a:zh.plainMeaning: 公式(21.10a)计算的是个体观测值z_{ij}与其家系均值\overline{z}_i的偏差的方差，它等于(1-1/n)乘以家系内遗传方差σ_{Gw}^2与特殊环境方差σ_{Es}^2之和。
formula-notes:formula_21.10a:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在“期望单周期响应理论”章节中，用于推导家系内方差与总方差及组内相关系数t_n的关系，为后续公式(21.10b)的简化形式提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_21.9c:zh.plainMeaning: 公式 t_n = t + (1-t)/n 定义了单周期响应方差中的衰减因子 t_n，其中 t 是单次测量的相关系数，n 是周期数，该因子用于将总体方差 σ_z^2 缩放为样本均值方差 σ^2(ẑ_i)。
formula-notes:formula_21.9c:zh.inThisChapter: 本章推导单周期响应的期望理论，此公式出现在例21.3之后，用于将式(21.9b)中的方差缩放因子具体化，类似于式(21.6b)中 r_n 的作用，为后续计算单周期响应方差提供关键参数。

formula-notes:formula_21.10b:en.plainMeaning: This formula expresses the variance of the deviation of an individual observation from its group mean as (1 - t_n) times the total phenotypic variance σ_z², where t_n is the intraclass correlation for groups of size n.
formula-notes:formula_21.10b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on expected single-cycle response to simplify the expression for the variance of within-group deviations, which is used later to derive the expected response to selection based on within-family deviations.

formula-notes:formula_21.11a:en.plainMeaning: This formula gives the among-family genetic variance (σ²_GF) for half-sibs and full-sibs in terms of additive (σ²_A) and dominance (σ²_D) genetic variances. For half-sibs, it equals 1/4 σ²_A; for full-sibs, it equals 1/2 σ²_A + 1/4 σ²_D.
formula-notes:formula_21.11a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the theory of expected single-cycle response to quantify the genetic variance among families, which is needed to partition total genetic variance into among- and within-family components for predicting response to selection.

formula-notes:formula_21.10b:zh.plainMeaning: 公式(21.10b)将单个观测值z_ij相对于组均值z̄_i的方差σ²(z_ij - z̄_i)表示为(1 - t_n)乘以总方差σ_z²，其中t_n是组内相关系数，σ_z²是观测值的总方差。
formula-notes:formula_21.10b:zh.inThisChapter: 在“期望单周期响应”理论中，该公式将(21.10a)中的方差分量表达式压缩为更简洁的形式，以便后续推导遗传力或响应预测时直接使用总方差和相关系数。

formula-notes:formula_21.11b:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the within-family genetic variance (σ²Gw) as total genetic variance (σ²G) minus among-family genetic variance (σ²GF), expressed in terms of additive (σ²A) and dominance (σ²D) variance components for half-sibs and full-sibs.
formula-notes:formula_21.11b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the theory of expected single-cycle response to derive the within-family variance, which is needed to predict response to within-family selection or to partition total genetic variance in breeding programs.

formula-notes:formula_21.11b:zh.plainMeaning: 公式(21.11b)计算家系内遗传方差σ_{Gw}^2，即总遗传方差σ_G^2减去家系间遗传方差σ_{GF}^2；对于半同胞家系，σ_{Gw}^2 = (3/4)σ_A^2 + σ_D^2；对于全同胞家系，σ_{Gw}^2 = (1/2)σ_A^2 + (3/4)σ_D^2。
formula-notes:formula_21.11b:zh.inThisChapter: 在“理论单周期响应”章节中，该公式由总遗传方差与家系间方差之差得到，用于分解遗传方差组分，为后续计算选择响应中家系内选择部分提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_21.12b:zh.plainMeaning: 公式(21.12b)定义了嵌套在雄性内的雌性遗传方差σ²_{G(f|m)}，它等于全同胞组遗传方差σ²_{GF(FS)}减去半同胞组遗传方差σ²_{GF(HS)}，即加性方差σ²_A与显性方差σ²_D之和的四分之一。
formula-notes:formula_21.12b:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在单周期期望响应理论中，用于分解遗传方差组分，为后续推导单周期选择响应公式提供遗传方差的结构基础。

formula-notes:formula_21.12b:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the genetic variance among females nested within males (σ²_G(f|m)) as the difference between full-sib (σ²_GF(FS)) and half-sib (σ²_GF(HS)) genetic covariances, which equals one-quarter of the sum of additive (σ²_A) and dominance (σ²_D) genetic variances.
formula-notes:formula_21.12b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on expected single-cycle response to partition total genetic variance into components due to additive and dominance effects, supporting the derivation of response to selection formulas that rely on these variance components.

formula-notes:formula_21.13a:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the response to among-family selection (R_b) as the product of the square root of additive genetic variance (σ_A), the square root of heritability (h), the square root of the number of relatives (r_n) divided by the square root of the number of individuals per family (t_n), and the standardized selection differential (i̅).
formula-notes:formula_21.13a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on response for particular designs to quantify the expected genetic gain from among-family selection, supporting later comparisons with other selection methods (e.g., within-family or combined selection) in Equation 21.13b.

formula-notes:formula_21.11a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式给出了半同胞和全同胞家系间遗传方差（σ²_GF）的组成：半同胞家系间方差等于1/4加性遗传方差（σ²_A），全同胞家系间方差等于1/2加性遗传方差加上1/4显性遗传方差（σ²_D）。
formula-notes:formula_21.11a:zh.inThisChapter: 在本章中，该公式用于将家系间遗传方差分解为加性和显性组分，从而为后续推导家系内遗传方差（σ²_Gw = σ²_G - σ²_GF）以及计算选择响应提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_21.12a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算全同胞家系均值（嵌套在半同胞家系内）的方差，它分解为六个方差组分：半同胞家系间的遗传方差σ²_GF(HS)、雌性嵌套于雄性内的遗传方差除以雌性数n_f、全同胞家系内的遗传方差除以n_s n_f、特殊环境方差除以总个体数n、共同环境方差（全同胞）除以n_f、以及共同环境方差（半同胞）σ²_Ec(HS)。
formula-notes:formula_21.12a:zh.inThisChapter: 在“理论：期望单周期响应”章节中，该公式用于量化嵌套全同胞-半同胞设计下家系均值的抽样方差，为后续推导选择响应（如公式21.12b）提供方差组分分解基础。

formula-notes:formula_21.13b:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the response to within-family selection (R_FD) as a function of the selection differential (S) or the standardized selection differential (τ̄), incorporating additive genetic variance (σ_A²), phenotypic variance (σ_z²), heritability (h²), and the within-family correlations for full-sibs (r_n) and for the trait (t_n).
formula-notes:formula_21.13b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on response for particular designs to quantify the expected genetic change from selecting among full-sib families, supporting later arguments about the efficiency of within-family selection relative to other family-based selection methods.

formula-notes:formula_21.13a:zh.plainMeaning: 公式 (21.13a) 计算家系间选择响应 R_b，它等于选择差 S 乘以家系间加性遗传方差与表型方差的比值，最终表达为 σ_A（加性遗传标准差）、h（单性状遗传力）、r_n（家系内个体间遗传相关）、t_n（家系内个体间表型相关）和标准化选择强度 ī 的乘积。
formula-notes:formula_21.13a:zh.inThisChapter: 在“特定设计响应”一节中，该公式针对家系间选择给出响应表达式，为后续推导家系内选择响应（公式 21.13b）以及比较不同选择方法的效果提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_21.14b:en.plainMeaning: This formula defines the coefficient γ used in the selection unit-offspring covariance γσ_A^2/2, where γ takes different values depending on the selection design: for family selection γ = r_n = r + (1-r)/n, for sib selection γ = r, and for parental or S1 seed selection γ = 1/2.
formula-notes:formula_21.14b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section 'RESPONSE FOR PARTICULAR DESIGNS' to provide the specific γ values needed to compute the covariance and thus the expected response to selection under each design, supporting the derivation of selection response formulas for different breeding schemes.

formula-notes:formula_21.13b:zh.plainMeaning: 公式21.13b计算全同胞家系内选择（within-family selection）的响应R_FD，它等于选择差S乘以一个系数，该系数由家系内加性遗传方差(1-r_n)σ_A^2与家系内表型方差(1-t_n)σ_z^2的比值决定；等价形式为σ_A h乘以(1-r_n)/√(1-t_n)再乘以标准化选择差τ̄。
formula-notes:formula_21.13b:zh.inThisChapter: 本节讨论特定设计（如全同胞家系）下的选择响应，公式21.13b将响应分解为遗传参数（σ_A、h、r_n、t_n）和选择强度（τ̄）的函数，为后续比较不同选择方法（如家系间选择）的效率提供定量基础。

formula-notes:formula_21.14a:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the selection response (R_b) for among-family selection, connecting the additive genetic variance (σ_A^2), selection intensities (ī_xm and ī_xf), and a factor γ/σ(ẑ) that scales the response based on the family structure and phenotypic variance.
formula-notes:formula_21.14a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on response for particular designs to quantify the expected genetic gain from among-family selection, supporting later comparisons of different selection strategies (e.g., within-family, combined selection) in Tables 21.3 and 21.4.

formula-notes:formula_21.12a:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the variance of the half-sib family mean (over full-sib subfamilies) in a nested-sib design, decomposing it into genetic components (among half-sib families, among females within males, within full-sib families) and environmental components (among sires, common environment within full-sib families, common environment within half-sib families). Key symbols: σ²(ẑ_HS(FS)) = variance of half-sib mean (averaged over full-sibs), σ²_GF(HS) = genetic variance among half-sib families, σ²_G(f|m) = genetic variance of females nested within males, σ²_Gw(FS) = within full-sib family genetic variance, σ²_Es = sire environmental variance, σ²_Ec(FS) = common environmental variance within full-sib families, σ²_Ec(HS) = common environmental variance within half-sib families, n_f = number of females per male, n_s = number of sibs per female, n = n_f n_s = total sibs per male.
formula-notes:formula_21.12a:en.inThisChapter: This formula appears in the section on expected single-cycle response to derive the variance components needed for predicting response to selection in a nested half-sib/full-sib design. It supports later arguments (e.g., Equation 21.12b) that relate these variances to additive and dominance genetic variances, enabling the calculation of heritability and selection response.

formula-notes:formula_21.14b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式给出了不同选择设计下，选择单元与后代之间的加性遗传协方差比例因子γ的具体取值：家系选择时γ = rₙ = r + (1-r)/n（r为个体间遗传相关，n为家系大小），同胞选择时γ = r，亲本或S₁种子选择时γ = 1/2。
formula-notes:formula_21.14b:zh.inThisChapter: 在“特定设计响应”章节中，该公式将21.14a中的通用协方差表达式γσ_A²/2具体化为三种常见选择设计的数值，为后续推导各设计下的响应预测提供直接代入参数。

formula-notes:formula_21.14a:zh.plainMeaning: 公式21.14a计算家系间选择（among-family selection）一个周期的选择响应Rb，它等于选择强度γ除以√tn，乘以加性遗传标准差σA/2，再乘以遗传力h和父母选择强度平均值(ī_xm+ī_xf)/2；或者等价地，等于γ除以表型标准差σ(z̄)，乘以加性方差σA²/2，再乘以父母选择强度平均值。
formula-notes:formula_21.14a:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在“特定设计响应”部分，由公式21.13a推导而来，用于量化家系间选择（设计n）的响应，为后续表格21.3和21.4中的数值计算提供基础，并引出公式21.14b中关于家系内选择的类似表达式。

formula-notes:formula_21.15a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算基底剪力响应Rb，等于系数γ除以√tn，再乘以层间位移标准差σz、层高h的平方以及平均影响系数ī的乘积。
formula-notes:formula_21.15a:zh.inThisChapter: 本节给出特定设计响应公式，此式是式(21.14a)的变体，利用σA h = σz h²将响应表达为与层间位移标准差σz和平均影响系数ī相关的形式，为后续讨论不同表达方式（如式21.15b、21.15c）提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_21.15b:zh.plainMeaning: 公式(21.15b)定义了基于家系选择的响应R_b，其中h_{b,γ}^2是家系内遗传力的修正版本，等于γ除以t_n再乘以个体遗传力h^2，S是父母平均选择差。
formula-notes:formula_21.15b:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在“特定设计响应”部分，用于计算家系选择下的遗传进展，为后续比较不同选择方法（如家系内选择、家系间选择）的效率提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_21.15a:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the response R_b as a function of the gamma factor γ, the square root of the number of trials t_n, the standard deviation σ_z, the square of the step size h, and the average of two i-bar terms (i̅_xf and i̅_xm).
formula-notes:formula_21.15a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on particular designs as a variant of Equation 21.14a, expressing the response in terms of σ_z h^2 and the average i̅, likely to simplify or adapt the general formula for specific experimental designs.

formula-notes:formula_21.15b:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the response to selection in a family-based breeding program (R_b) as the product of the family heritability (h_{b,γ}^2) and the average selection differential (S). The family heritability is defined as h_{b,γ}^2 = (γ / t_n) h^2, where γ is a coefficient related to family structure, t_n is the intraclass correlation among family members, and h^2 is the individual heritability.
formula-notes:formula_21.15b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section 'RESPONSE FOR PARTICULAR DESIGNS' to provide a specific expression for family selection response, supporting later arguments about how family structure (via γ and t_n) modifies the expected genetic gain compared to individual selection.

formula-notes:formula_21.15c:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the response to family selection (Rb) for half-sibs and full-sibs, using the intraclass correlation t_n, additive genetic variance σ_A^2, narrow-sense heritability h^2, and selection intensities ī_xm and ī_xf.
formula-notes:formula_21.15c:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on response for particular designs to quantify the expected genetic gain from selecting among families, supporting later comparisons of half-sib vs. full-sib family selection efficiency.

formula-notes:formula_21.16a:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the difference in variance of the mean phenotype between full-sib (FS) and half-sib (HS) families, expressed as a quarter of the sum of additive and dominance genetic variances plus the difference in common environmental variance between the two family types.
formula-notes:formula_21.16a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on response for particular designs to derive the inequality that the variance of FS means is greater than that of HS means, which supports the later argument (Equation 21.16b) that the difference in variance components can be used to estimate genetic parameters.

formula-notes:formula_21.16a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算全同胞家系均值方差与半同胞家系均值方差之差，等于加性方差σ_A²和显性方差σ_D²之和的四分之一，加上全同胞与半同胞共同环境方差之差σ_Ec(FS)² - σ_Ec(HS)²。
formula-notes:formula_21.16a:zh.inThisChapter: 此公式出现在特定设计响应部分，用于推导全同胞与半同胞设计在估计遗传方差时的效率差异，为后续公式21.16b中比较两种设计的标准误提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_21.16b:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the ratio of response to selection using full-sib families (R_b(FS)) to that using half-sib families (R_b(HS)), showing it is less than 2√(t_n(HS)/t_n(FS)) and ultimately less than 2. Key symbols: R_b(FS), R_b(HS), n (family size), t_n(HS) and t_n(FS) (t-values for half-sib and full-sib selection).
formula-notes:formula_21.16b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on particular designs to compare the efficiency of full-sib versus half-sib family selection, supporting the conclusion that full-sib selection yields greater response variance but a smaller response ratio bounded by 2.

formula-notes:formula_21.17:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the response to sib selection (R_sib) as the product of the average selection intensity (ī), the additive genetic standard deviation (σ_A), the square root of heritability (h), and a factor involving the number of sibs per family (n), the intraclass correlation among sibs (r), and the phenotypic correlation among sibs (t).
formula-notes:formula_21.17:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on response for particular designs to provide a specific expression for sib selection, derived from the general response equation (21.15a) by substituting γ = r and using σ_A, and it supports later arguments about the efficiency of sib selection relative to other selection methods.

formula-notes:formula_21.18a:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the expected response to selection (R_pt) when selecting on only one sex using half-sib families. Key symbols: σ_A = additive genetic variance, t_n(HS) = intraclass correlation among half-sibs, h = square root of heritability, ī = selection intensity on the selected sex.
formula-notes:formula_21.18a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on response for particular designs to quantify genetic gain when selection is limited to one sex, as in dairy bull selection. It supports later arguments about doubling response in monoecious species (Equation 21.18b).

formula-notes:formula_21.18a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算对单个性状进行半同胞家系选择时，在选定性别上的预期响应R_pt，其中σ_A/4是半同胞家系间加性遗传方差，t_n(HS)是半同胞家系内表型相关系数，h是单个性状遗传力的平方根，ī是选择强度。
formula-notes:formula_21.18a:zh.inThisChapter: 本节讨论特定设计（如半同胞家系）下的选择响应，公式(21.18a)为后续推导雌雄同株物种的响应（加倍）以及公式(21.18b)提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_21.15c:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算基于家系选择（family selection）的响应Rb：对于半同胞家系，Rb = (1+3/n)/√[tn(HS)] × (σA/8) × h × (īxm + īxf)；对于全同胞家系，Rb = (1+1/n)/√[tn(FS)] × (σA/4) × h × (īxm + īxf)。其中n为家系内个体数，tn(HS)和tn(FS)分别为半同胞和全同胞家系内表型相关系数，σA为加性遗传方差，h为单个性状遗传力的平方根，īxm和īxf分别为雄性和雌性选择强度。
formula-notes:formula_21.15c:zh.inThisChapter: 本节（RESPONSE FOR PARTICULAR DESIGNS）在推导了通用家系选择响应公式（21.14a）后，将其具体应用于半同胞和全同胞家系设计，得到21.15c。该公式量化了两种家系设计中可利用的加性方差差异（全同胞为σA²/2，半同胞为σA²/4）以及家系内相关对响应的影响，为后续比较不同设计效率（如全同胞优势因近交而减弱）提供定量基础。

formula-notes:formula_21.19:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the expected response to family-deviation selection (R_FD) as a weighted average of selection intensities in males and females, simplified to an expression involving the intraclass correlation t_n, the correlation r_n between full sibs, the additive genetic standard deviation σ_A, heritability h, and the average selection intensity.
formula-notes:formula_21.19:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on response for particular designs to provide a closed-form expression for response when selection is based on within-family deviations, supporting the derivation of expected genetic gain under family-based selection schemes.

formula-notes:formula_21.16b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算全同胞家系选择响应 R_b(FS) 与半同胞家系选择响应 R_b(HS) 的比值，它等于两个因子的乘积：第一个因子 (1+1/n)/(1+3/n) 反映家系内个体数 n 对响应的影响，第二个因子 8√t_n(HS) / (4√t_n(FS)) 反映家系内相关 t_n 的影响。整个比值小于 2√[t_n(HS)/t_n(FS)]，且进一步小于 2。
formula-notes:formula_21.16b:zh.inThisChapter: 在“特定设计响应”一节中，该公式用于比较全同胞与半同胞家系选择的相对效率，承接公式 21.15c 给出的响应表达式，并利用公式 21.16a 的不等式关系，最终证明全同胞家系选择的响应小于半同胞家系选择响应的两倍，为选择方案设计提供理论依据。

formula-notes:formula_21.17:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算家系选择（sib selection）的响应 R_sib，其中平均选择强度 ī 乘以加性遗传标准差 σ_A 和平方根遗传力 h，再乘以家系内相关系数 r 与家系大小 n 的调整因子，分母 √[n(1+(n-1)t)] 校正家系内表型相关 t 对选择响应的影响。
formula-notes:formula_21.17:zh.inThisChapter: 本节推导特定设计（家系选择）的响应公式，从通用公式 (21.15a) 出发，代入 γ = r 并利用 σ_A 与 h 的关系，得到 (21.17) 以量化家系选择下的遗传进展，为后续比较不同选择方法提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_21.18b:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the response to selection (R_pt) in a half-sib/full-sib nested design, where the numerator is the additive genetic gain (h * i * σ²_A / 4) and the denominator is the square root of the phenotypic variance among family means, decomposed into additive, dominance, and environmental components.
formula-notes:formula_21.18b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on particular designs to provide the exact response equation for a nested mating design with multiple females per male and multiple sibs per female, supporting later calculations of expected genetic gain and optimal resource allocation.

formula-notes:formula_21.21:zh.plainMeaning: 公式(21.21)将全分集接收时的误码率R_FD与无分集时的误码率R_WF联系起来，通过平均电流比(ī_FD/ī_WF)和因子√(1-1/n)进行缩放，其中n为分集支路数。
formula-notes:formula_21.21:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在“特定设计响应”章节，用于推导分集接收系统的误码率性能，为后续比较不同分集方案（如等增益合并、最大比合并）提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_21.20:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算的是当使用家系内偏差（z_{ij}-μ_i）作为选择指标时的总响应R_WF，它等于雄性选择强度ῑ_{x_m}和雌性选择强度ῑ_{x_f}分别乘以各自条件协方差与偏差方差的比值后求和，最终简化为(1-r)/√(1-t) σ_A h乘以平均选择强度。
formula-notes:formula_21.20:zh.inThisChapter: 本节推导特定设计下的响应公式，此式展示了当用家系内偏差替代观测均值时，响应如何依赖于家系内相关系数t、性状间遗传相关r、加性遗传标准差σ_A和平方根遗传力h，为后续比较不同选择方法的效果提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_21.20:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the response to within-family selection (R_WF) as a function of the selection intensities in males and females, adjusted for the correlation between family and individual deviations. Key symbols: R_WF = response to within-family selection, σ(z_ij - μ_i, y | R) = covariance between within-family deviation and phenotype given selection, σ(z_ij - μ_i) = standard deviation of within-family deviation, ῑ_xm and ῑ_xf = selection intensities in males and females, r = intraclass correlation, t = proportion of variance due to common family effects, σ_A = additive genetic standard deviation, h = square root of heritability.
formula-notes:formula_21.20:en.inThisChapter: This formula appears in the section on response for particular designs to show how within-family selection response can be expressed in terms of selection intensities and genetic parameters, supporting the argument that within-family selection can be effective even when family effects are present.

formula-notes:formula_21.21:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the response coefficient for a fixed-dose design (R_FD) by scaling the response coefficient for a weight-based fixed-ratio design (R_WF) with the ratio of average doses (ī_FD / ī_WF) and multiplying by sqrt(1 - 1/n), where n is the number of dose levels.
formula-notes:formula_21.21:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on response for particular designs to provide a direct conversion from the weight-based fixed-ratio design to the fixed-dose design, supporting later comparisons of design efficiency and dose-response estimation.

formula-notes:formula_21.18b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算在巢式交配设计（每个雄性配nf个雌性，每个雌性有ns个后代）中，基于家系选择的响应Rpt。分子是加性遗传方差σA²乘以选择强度h和平均超额i的1/4，分母是家系均值表型方差平方根，其中分母第一行展开为各方差分量除以相应样本量。
formula-notes:formula_21.18b:zh.inThisChapter: 本节讨论特定交配设计下的选择响应，公式21.18b将21.18a中的一般方差分量替换为巢式设计下具体的遗传和环境方差表达式，为后续比较不同设计效率提供量化依据。

formula-notes:formula_21.22a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算严格家系内选择（WF）的响应R_WF，对于半同胞家系，响应为(3/8)σ_A除以√(1-t(HS))再乘以h和两个选择强度之和；对于全同胞家系，系数为1/4。
formula-notes:formula_21.22a:zh.inThisChapter: 此公式出现在“特定设计响应”小节，由公式21.20推导而来，用于比较WF与FD选择的响应差异，并为后续公式21.22b中FD响应的对比提供基准。

formula-notes:formula_21.22b:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the response to within-family selection (R_WF) for half-sibs and full-sibs, using additive (σ²_A), dominance (σ²_D), and common environmental (σ²_E_s) variance components, along with selection intensities (ī_xm, ī_xf).
formula-notes:formula_21.22b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on response for particular designs to show how within-family selection response differs between half-sib and full-sib families, supporting the argument that half-sibs have more usable within-family additive variance.

formula-notes:formula_21.24a:en.plainMeaning: This formula estimates the realized heritability for a specific selection scheme (x) as the ratio of the observed response (R_x) to the selection differential (S_x).
formula-notes:formula_21.24a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on response for particular designs to provide a practical estimator of realized heritability from family-based selection experiments, supporting later comparisons or adjustments in formula 21.24b.

formula-notes:formula_21.22a:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the expected response to within-family selection (R_WF) using half-sib or full-sib families. Key symbols: σ_A = additive genetic standard deviation, t(HS) and t(FS) = intraclass correlations for half-sibs and full-sibs, h = square root of heritability, and ī_xm + ī_xf = sum of selection intensities in males and females.
formula-notes:formula_21.22a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on particular designs to provide explicit response equations for within-family selection, supporting the comparison with family and individual selection in the chapter's discussion of family-based breeding schemes.
