formula-notes:formula_21.19:zh.plainMeaning: 公式(21.19)计算家族内选择（FD）的响应R_FD，它等于对雄性（R_m）和雌性（R_f）分别用协方差除以标准差得到的两个选择差加权平均，最终简化为用遗传标准差σ_A、窄遗传力h、以及平均选择强度(ī_{x_m}+ī_{x_f})/2表达的简洁形式。
formula-notes:formula_21.19:zh.inThisChapter: 本节“特定设计的响应”中，公式(21.19)将一般响应公式(21.1a)应用于家族内偏差作为选择单元的情形，利用表21.3和21.4的结果推导出显式表达式，为后续比较不同选择方案（如家族内与家族间选择）的效率提供定量基础。

formula-notes:formula_21.23:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the within-family heritability (h_w^2) as the ratio of additive genetic variance to phenotypic variance after removing between-family effects, expressed in terms of the population heritability (h^2), intraclass correlation (r), and phenotypic correlation among sibs (t).
formula-notes:formula_21.23:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on response for particular designs to show that within-family heritability is identical under full-sib and within-family selection, supporting the argument that the ratio (1-r)/(1-t) simplifies to the same value regardless of family size.

formula-notes:formula_21.24a:zh.plainMeaning: 公式 (21.24a) 通过将观察到的选择响应 R_x 除以选择差 S_x，来估计基于家系的方案中性状 x 的实现遗传力 ĥ²_{r,x}。
formula-notes:formula_21.24a:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在“特定设计响应”小节，为后续推导公式 (21.24b) 中基于家系内选择差和响应的实现遗传力估计提供基础，并铺垫如何利用不同选择方案计算遗传力。

formula-notes:formula_21.25a:en.plainMeaning: This formula converts a realized heritability estimate from among-family selection ($\widehat{h}_{r,b}^2$) into a realized individual heritability ($\widehat{h}_r^2$) by scaling with the ratio of the intraclass correlation of full-sibs ($t_n$) to the selection coefficient ($\gamma$).
formula-notes:formula_21.25a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on translating realized heritability estimates from family-based designs to individual-based estimates, supporting the argument that different selection designs yield comparable heritability measures when properly adjusted.

formula-notes:formula_21.25b:en.plainMeaning: This formula converts the realized heritability estimated from within-family selection (ĥ²_{r,wf}) to the realized heritability for individual selection (ĥ²_r) using the intraclass correlation t and the correlation between full sibs r.
formula-notes:formula_21.25b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on response for particular designs to show how heritability estimates from different selection methods (within-family vs. individual) are related, supporting later comparisons of expected responses across breeding designs.

formula-notes:formula_21.22b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算了半同胞或全同胞家系内选择（WF）的预期响应R_WF，它等于家系内加性遗传方差（半同胞为(3/8)σ_A^2，全同胞为(1/4)σ_A^2）除以表型标准差（分母中的平方根项），再乘以父本和母本的选择强度之和(ī_xm+ī_xf)。
formula-notes:formula_21.22b:zh.inThisChapter: 在“特定设计响应”一节中，公式(21.22b)将家系内选择响应表达为方差组分的形式，为后续比较不同家系设计（半同胞与全同胞）的选择效率提供定量依据，并铺垫了半同胞家系内加性方差更大（3/4 σ_A^2）这一关键结论。

formula-notes:formula_21.24b:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the variance of the realized within-family heritability estimate (ĥ²_{r,wf}) as the variance of the ratio R_wf / S_wf, which simplifies to the variance of the response (R_wf) divided by the squared selection differential (S_wf²). Key symbols: σ²(·) = variance, ĥ²_{r,wf} = estimated realized within-family heritability, R_wf = within-family response, S_wf = within-family selection differential.
formula-notes:formula_21.24b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on response for particular designs to provide a method for calculating the standard error of the realized within-family heritability estimate, supporting later arguments that translate this heritability into individual heritability using Equations 21.15b and 21.23.

formula-notes:formula_21.25b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将基于家系内选择估计的遗传力 \(\widehat{h}_{r,wf}^{2}\) 转换为基于个体选择的遗传力 \(\widehat{h}_{r}^{2}\)，转换因子为 \((1-t)/(1-r)\)，其中 \(t\) 是家系内表型相关系数，\(r\) 是家系内遗传相关系数。
formula-notes:formula_21.25b:zh.inThisChapter: 在讨论特定设计（如家系内选择）时，该公式连接了两种不同选择方案下的遗传力估计，为后续比较不同选择方法的效率或统一估计提供了转换桥梁。

formula-notes:formula_21.26a:en.plainMeaning: This formula gives the among-family genetic variance (σ²_GF) for half-sibs and full sibs as a sum of additive, dominance, and epistatic variance components, each weighted by coefficients derived from the genetic covariance between sibs.
formula-notes:formula_21.26a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on expected single-cycle response to show how the genetic variance among families is partitioned, which is then used in Equation 21.26b to compute the expected response to selection.

formula-notes:formula_21.25a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将基于家系间选择得到的实现遗传力估计值 $\widehat{h}_{r,b}^{2}$ 转换为个体实现遗传力估计值 $\widehat{h}_{r}^{2}$，转换系数为 $t_n / \gamma$，其中 $t_n$ 是家系内表型相关系数（由公式21.9c定义），$\gamma$ 是家系间选择下的遗传方差比例（由公式21.14b给出）。
formula-notes:formula_21.25a:zh.inThisChapter: 在讨论特定设计（家系间选择）时，该公式用于将实验观测到的家系水平实现遗传力校正为个体水平，以便与标准遗传力定义一致，并为后续比较不同设计（如家系内选择，公式21.25b）提供转换基础。

formula-notes:formula_21.26b:en.plainMeaning: This formula gives the within-family genetic variance (σ²Gw) for half-sib and full-sib families, expressed as a weighted sum of additive (σ²A), dominance (σ²D), and epistatic variance components (σ²AA, σ²AD, σ²DD, σ²AAA, …).
formula-notes:formula_21.26b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on expected single-cycle response to quantify the genetic variation within families, which is used to predict the response to within-family selection or to partition total genetic variance into between- and within-family components.

formula-notes:formula_21.27a:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the covariance between a parent (R1) and its offspring (y) as a sum of additive genetic variance components (σ²_A, σ²_AA, σ²_AAA, ...), each weighted by (1/2)^u, where u is the order of interaction. It assumes no dominance effects (Δ_xy = 0).
formula-notes:formula_21.27a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on particular designs to provide the expected parent-offspring covariance under a model with only additive and additive-by-additive epistatic components, supporting later calculations of genetic parameters from family data.

formula-notes:formula_21.23:zh.plainMeaning: 公式(21.23)给出了家系内遗传力 h_w^2 的三种等价表达式：它等于 2 倍协方差 σ(z_{ij} - ȳ_i, y|R₁) 除以方差 σ²(z_{ij} - ȳ_i)，也等于 (1 - r_n)σ_A² 除以 (1 - t_n)σ_z²，最终简化为 (1 - r)/(1 - t) 乘以总遗传力 h²。其中 r 是同胞间表型相关系数，t 是同胞间遗传相关系数，r_n 和 t_n 是考虑有限家系大小的修正值。
formula-notes:formula_21.23:zh.inThisChapter: 本节讨论特定设计（如全同胞家系）下的家系内选择，公式(21.23)表明家系内遗传力在有限家系（FD）和无限家系（WF）下形式相同，从而为后续推导家系内选择响应（如公式21.24）提供了基础，并展示了如何从总体参数 r、t 和 h² 直接计算 h_w²。

formula-notes:formula_21.26b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算半同胞或全同胞家系内遗传方差 σ_{Gw}^2，它等于总遗传方差 σ_G^2 减去家系间遗传方差 σ_{GF}^2，并展开为加性、显性及各阶上位方差组分的线性组合，系数取决于亲缘关系（半同胞 vs 全同胞）。
formula-notes:formula_21.26b:zh.inThisChapter: 在本章“单周期期望响应理论”中，公式(21.26b)与(21.26a)共同将总遗传方差分解为家系间和家系内两部分，为后续推导基于家系内选择（如家系内选择响应）或联合选择的响应公式提供方差分量基础。

formula-notes:formula_21.26a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式给出了半同胞组（half-sibs）和全同胞组（full sibs）的组间遗传方差 σ_GF²，它等于相应亲缘关系下同胞间遗传协方差（来自LW表7.2），其中σ_A²为加性方差、σ_D²为显性方差、σ_AA²等为上位性方差分量。
formula-notes:formula_21.26a:zh.inThisChapter: 在本章“期望单周期响应”理论中，该公式用于量化不同家族结构（半同胞/全同胞）中家族间遗传方差，为后续推导选择响应（如公式21.26b）提供组间变异基础。

formula-notes:formula_21.27a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算亲本与一个后代（关系R1）之间的协方差，等于加性方差σ_A^2的一半加上各阶加性×加性上位方差σ_{A^u}^2乘以衰减因子(1/2^u)的累加和。
formula-notes:formula_21.27a:zh.inThisChapter: 在“特定亲缘关系响应”一节中，该公式用于推导亲本-后代协方差的具体表达式，为后续计算亲本-后代回归和选择响应提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_21.28:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the covariance between family mean (z̄) and individual phenotype (y) under family selection, given relatedness ℛ₁. Key symbols: n = family size, r = relatedness between family members, σ²_{A^u} = additive genetic variance for u-fold epistasis, r_n^u = r^u + (1 - r^u)/n.
formula-notes:formula_21.28:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on response for particular designs to derive the covariance for family selection, supporting later arguments about how family size and relatedness affect selection response, especially the limiting case of large family size approaching sib selection.

formula-notes:formula_21.29a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算半同胞家系选择（r=1/4）时，家系均值与个体表型值之间的单亲协方差，其中σ_A^2、σ_AA^2、σ_AAA^2分别表示加性、加性×加性、加性×加性×加性遗传方差，n为家系内个体数。
formula-notes:formula_21.29a:zh.inThisChapter: 本节针对特定设计推导协方差公式，此式由公式21.28代入r=1/4得到，为后续比较不同选择方案（如亲本选择、S1种子选择）的响应提供半同胞家系选择的协方差表达式。

formula-notes:formula_21.29a:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the covariance between half-sib family means (z̄_HS) and individual genotypic values (y) after one cycle of selection (R1), as a function of additive (σ²_A), additive-by-additive (σ²_AA), and higher-order epistatic variance components, with sample size n affecting the coefficients.
formula-notes:formula_21.29a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on response for particular designs to quantify the selection response for half-sib family selection (r=1/4), derived from the general covariance formula (Equation 21.28) and supporting later calculations of expected genetic gain.

formula-notes:formula_21.29b:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the covariance between the full-sib family mean (z̄_FS) and an individual's phenotypic value (y), conditional on the reference population ℛ₁, as a sum of additive (σ²_A), additive-by-additive (σ²_AA), and higher-order epistatic variance components weighted by coefficients that depend on family size n.
formula-notes:formula_21.29b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on response for particular designs to quantify the selection differential for full-sib family selection (r = 1/2), supporting the prediction of response to selection when families are the unit of selection.

formula-notes:formula_21.29b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算在基于全同胞家系选择（亲缘系数r=1/2）时，家系均值（z̄_FS）与个体表型值（y）的条件协方差，其中σ_A²、σ_AA²、σ_AAA²分别代表加性、加性×加性、加性×加性×加性遗传方差，n为家系内个体数。
formula-notes:formula_21.29b:zh.inThisChapter: 本节针对特定设计（全同胞家系选择）推导协方差表达式，为后续计算选择响应或遗传进展提供基础；公式(21.29b)与(21.29a)同属一组，分别对应半同胞和全同胞家系，便于比较不同亲缘关系下的协方差结构。

formula-notes:formula_21.28:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算在家族选择（基于亲属R1）下，表型均值与育种值之间的协方差σ(z̄, y|R1)，它分解为两项之和：第一项是家系内个体间协方差（系数1/n乘以(1/2^u)σ²_{A^u}），第二项是家系间协方差（系数(1-1/n)乘以(r/2)^u σ²_{A^u}），最终合并为∑_u (1/2^u) r_n^u σ²_{A^u}，其中r_n^u = r^u + (1-r^u)/n。
formula-notes:formula_21.28:zh.inThisChapter: 本章讨论特定设计下的响应预测，公式(21.28)由(21.6a)代入(21.27a,b)得到，将家族选择协方差表达为加性遗传方差分量σ²_{A^u}的加权和，为后续推导选择响应（如公式(21.29)）提供基础，并展示当家族大小n很大时系数趋近于同胞选择下的值。

formula-notes:formula_21.24b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算了家系内实现遗传力估计值（ĥ²_{r,wf} = R_{wf}/S_{wf}）的方差，等于响应R_{wf}的方差除以选择差S_{wf}的平方。
formula-notes:formula_21.24b:zh.inThisChapter: 此处将R_{wf}视为随机变量、S_{wf}视为常数，从而将估计量方差的推导简化为仅需R_{wf}的方差，为后续将ĥ²_{r,wf}的方差转化为h²的函数（通过公式21.15b和21.23）提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_21.30:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the covariance between within-family deviations of offspring phenotype (z_{ij} - mean of family i) and the parental phenotype y, conditional on the first parent's genotype R1. It expresses this covariance as a sum over loci u of (1/2)^u times (1 - r_n^u) times the additive genetic variance σ_{A^u}^2, where r_n^u is the recombination rate with n offspring, and simplifies to (1 - 1/n) times the sum over u of (1/2)^u (1 - r^u) σ_{A^u}^2 using the identity (1 - r_n) = (1 - 1/n)(1 - r).
formula-notes:formula_21.30:en.inThisChapter: This formula appears in the section on particular designs to derive the covariance for within-family deviations in half-sib families, supporting later arguments about the contribution of recombination and family size to genetic covariance components.

formula-notes:formula_21.32a:en.plainMeaning: This formula gives the genetic covariance σ_G(x,y) between relatives of different types (parent-offspring, half-sibs, full-sibs) as a linear combination of additive (σ_A^2), dominance (σ_D^2), and higher-order interaction variances (σ_T^2, σ_Q^2).
formula-notes:formula_21.32a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on response for particular designs to provide the covariances needed to compute the response to selection (e.g., via equation 21.32b) for different family structures.

formula-notes:formula_21.30:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算在给定亲本R1条件下，家系内偏差(z_{ij}-z̄_i)与性状y的条件协方差，等于R1与y的条件协方差减去z̄_i与y的条件协方差，并展开为各加性效应方差分量σ²_{A^u}的加权和，权重为(1/2)^u乘以(1-r_n^u)，最后利用(1-r_n)=(1-1/n)(1-r)化为(1-1/n)倍的形式。
formula-notes:formula_21.30:zh.inThisChapter: 在“特定设计响应”章节中，该公式用于推导半同胞家系内偏差与性状的协方差，为后续计算半同胞家系选择响应提供基础，其中(1-1/n)因子将出现在所有项中，可被忽略以简化表达式。

formula-notes:formula_21.31a:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the covariance between the deviation of half-sib family mean from the overall half-sib mean and the offspring phenotype, conditional on the first round of selection (R1). It is expressed as a series of additive (σ²_A), additive-by-additive (σ²_AA), and higher-order epistatic variance components, each weighted by coefficients that decrease with interaction order.
formula-notes:formula_21.31a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on response for particular designs to provide the specific covariance expression needed to predict response to selection in half-sib family selection. This formula supports the derivation of the expected selection response by linking the selection differential to the genetic variance components.

formula-notes:formula_21.31b:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the covariance between the deviation of a full-sib family mean from the population mean (z_{ij} - z̄_{FS}) and the phenotypic value y, conditional on relatedness ℛ₁, as a weighted sum of additive (σ²_A), additive-by-additive (σ²_AA), and higher-order epistatic variance components.
formula-notes:formula_21.31b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on response for particular designs to quantify the genetic covariance among full-sibs under a polygenic model with epistasis, supporting later calculations of selection response and variance components in structured populations.

formula-notes:formula_21.32b:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the among-family genetic variance (σ²_GF) for half-sibs and full-sibs, expressed as a linear combination of additive (σ²_A), dominance (σ²_D), and for full-sibs also trigenic (σ²_T) and quadrigenic (σ²_Q) variance components.
formula-notes:formula_21.32b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on response for particular designs to provide the genetic variance among families needed to predict selection response, supporting the derivation of response equations for half-sib and full-sib family selection.

formula-notes:formula_21.32a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式给出了不同亲属对（亲-子、半同胞、全同胞）之间的遗传协方差σ_G(x,y)，表示为加性方差σ_A^2、显性方差σ_D^2以及高阶互作方差σ_T^2和σ_Q^2的线性组合，系数由亲缘系数和上位性系数决定。
formula-notes:formula_21.32a:zh.inThisChapter: 在“特定设计响应”部分，该公式用于计算不同亲属对间的遗传协方差，为后续推导方差组分估计的期望均方（如公式21.32b和21.32c）提供基础，从而支持遗传力等参数的估计。

formula-notes:formula_21.32b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式给出了半同胞和全同胞家系间遗传方差σ_GF²的分解：半同胞家系由加性方差σ_A²的1/4和显性方差σ_D²的1/36构成；全同胞家系则包含σ_A²的1/2、σ_D²的2/9、上位性方差σ_T²的1/12和σ_Q²的1/36。
formula-notes:formula_21.32b:zh.inThisChapter: 在“特定设计响应”章节中，此公式基于协方差推导（如公式21.26a和21.26b的逻辑），将家系间遗传方差分解为加性、显性和上位性组分，为后续比较不同亲缘关系设计的遗传方差组成提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_21.32c:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the within-family genetic variance (σ²Gw) for half-sibs and full-sibs, expressed as a linear combination of additive (σ²A), dominance (σ²D), two-locus epistatic (σ²T), and higher-order epistatic (σ²Q) variance components.
formula-notes:formula_21.32c:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on response for particular designs to provide the necessary within-family variance for calculating heritability and predicting response to selection in half-sib and full-sib family designs.

formula-notes:formula_21.31b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算全同胞家系内个体间（减去全同胞家系均值后）的协方差，等于加性方差σ_A^2乘以1/4、加性×加性方差σ_AA^2乘以3/16、加性×加性×加性方差σ_AAA^2乘以7/64等项的无穷级数。
formula-notes:formula_21.31b:zh.inThisChapter: 在比较不同亲属关系（半同胞、全同胞）的协方差结构时，此式与(21.31a)并列，展示全同胞共享更多遗传方差分量（系数更大），为后续推导亲属间遗传协方差及选择响应公式提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_21.32c:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算半同胞或全同胞家系内的遗传方差，由总遗传方差减去家系间遗传方差得到，其中关键符号σ_A^2、σ_D^2、σ_T^2、σ_Q^2分别表示加性、显性、双位点互作和四位点互作方差分量。
formula-notes:formula_21.32c:zh.inThisChapter: 在本节“特定设计响应”中，该公式用于量化不同亲缘关系家系内的遗传变异，为后续推导家系内个体间遗传协方差或设计育种方案提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_21.31a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算在半同胞设计（HS）中，以参考群体ℛ₁为基准时，个体表型值偏离半同胞家系均值的偏差（zij - z̄_HS）与育种值y的协方差，表示为加性方差σ²_A、加性×加性方差σ²_AA、加性×加性×加性方差σ²_AAA等的加权和，权重分别为3/8、15/64、63/512等。
formula-notes:formula_21.31a:zh.inThisChapter: 此公式出现在讨论特定交配设计（半同胞、全同胞）的章节，从一般公式(21.30)推导而来，用于量化半同胞家系内偏差与育种值的协方差结构，为后续比较不同亲缘关系下的遗传协方差（如全同胞公式21.31b）提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_21.33b:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the covariance between the mean phenotype of a half-sib family (with n individuals) and the phenotype of a relative in the same family, expressed as a weighted sum of additive (σ²_A) and dominance (σ²_D) genetic variances, with coefficients depending on family size n.
formula-notes:formula_21.33b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on response for particular designs to quantify the genetic covariance in half-sib families, which is essential for predicting response to selection under this common breeding design.

formula-notes:formula_21.33b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算在给定半同胞关系（R1）条件下，群体均值（z̄）与个体表型值（y）的协方差，其中n为半同胞家系大小，σA²为加性遗传方差，σD²为显性遗传方差。
formula-notes:formula_21.33b:zh.inThisChapter: 本节针对特定亲缘关系设计（如半同胞），推导协方差表达式，为后续计算亲缘关系矩阵或方差组分估计提供具体公式。

formula-notes:formula_21.33c:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the covariance between the mean phenotype of a full-sib family (z̄) and the phenotype of an individual (y) within that family, given that the family is selected based on the first record (ℛ₁). The key symbols are: σ²_A (additive genetic variance), σ²_D (dominance variance), and n (family size).
formula-notes:formula_21.33c:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on response for particular designs to provide the covariance expression needed to predict response to selection using full-sib family information, supporting later derivations of selection response and variance components.

formula-notes:formula_21.33c:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算全同胞家系内个体间表型协方差σ(z̄,y|ℛ₁)，其中z̄是家系均值，y是个体表型，ℛ₁表示全同胞关系。公式将协方差分解为加性方差σ_A²和显性方差σ_D²的线性组合，系数依赖于家系大小n。
formula-notes:formula_21.33c:zh.inThisChapter: 在“特定设计响应”章节中，此公式用于推导全同胞家系设计的遗传力估计精度，为后续比较不同亲属关系（如半同胞、全同胞）的统计效力提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_21.33a:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the covariance between the mean phenotype of a sibship (excluding the measured sib) and the phenotype of a measured sib, given that the measured sib is the reference individual R1. It decomposes into a weighted average of the variance of y (when the measured sib is a parent) and the covariance between x and y (when the measured sib is an unmeasured sib). The second line substitutes the expression for σ(y|R1) in terms of additive (σ²_A) and dominance (σ²_D) variance components.
formula-notes:formula_21.33a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on response for particular designs to derive the covariance structure needed for predicting response to selection when using sib-based selection indices. This formula supports the subsequent derivation of formula 21.33b and 21.33c, which provide the full covariance expressions for the selection response.

formula-notes:formula_21.34a:en.plainMeaning: This formula decomposes the genotypic value G_{1234} for a tetraploid individual into additive effects (a_i), dominance effects (d_{ij}), three-way interactions (t_{ijk}), and a four-way interaction (q_{1234}) of the four alleles.
formula-notes:formula_21.34a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on particular designs to provide the full decomposition of genotypic value for tetraploids, which is then used in subsequent equations (21.34b–e) to define variance components and partition genetic variance.

formula-notes:formula_21.33a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算在给定一个全同胞家系（R₁）条件下，家系均值（z̄）与个体y的协方差。第一项表示当y是x的父本（概率1/n）时，σ(y|R₁)的贡献；第二项表示当y是x的未测量同胞（概率1-1/n）时，σ(x,y|R₁)的贡献。第二行将σ(y|R₁)替换为(1/2)σ_A² + (1/6)σ_D²，这是全同胞家系内个体与其自身协方差的表达式。
formula-notes:formula_21.33a:zh.inThisChapter: 本节（RESPONSE FOR PARTICULAR DESIGNS）针对特定家系设计推导协方差结构。公式21.33a将家系均值与个体y的协方差分解为两种可能关系（父本或同胞）的加权平均，为后续公式21.33b和21.33c中进一步展开σ(x,y|R₁)项、得到完整协方差表达式提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_21.34b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将总遗传方差 σ_G² 分解为加性方差 σ_A²、显性方差 σ_D²、上位方差 σ_T² 和四基因互作方差 σ_Q² 之和，其中 σ_A²=4σ_a², σ_D²=6σ_d², σ_T²=4σ_t², σ_Q²=σ_q²。
formula-notes:formula_21.34b:zh.inThisChapter: 在“特定设计响应”章节中，此公式给出了四倍体群体总遗传方差的组分分解，为后续推导各组分方差分量（如公式21.34c-e）提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_21.34b:en.plainMeaning: This formula partitions the total genetic variance (σ_G²) into components due to additive (σ_A²), dominance (σ_D²), trigenic (σ_T²), and quadrigenic (σ_Q²) effects, with coefficients 4, 6, 4, and 1 for the underlying variance components σ_a², σ_d², σ_t², and σ_q², respectively.
formula-notes:formula_21.34b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on response for particular designs to show how total genetic variance is decomposed into higher-order epistatic components, supporting later arguments about predicting response to selection under non-additive gene action.

formula-notes:formula_21.34c:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the genetic covariance between two relatives as a weighted sum of additive (σ²_A), dominance (σ²_D), two-locus epistatic (σ²_T), and quadrigenic (σ²_Q) variance components, with weights determined by the probabilities π₁–π₄ of sharing 1–4 alleles identical by descent (IBD).
formula-notes:formula_21.34c:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on response for particular designs to provide a general expression for genetic covariance in terms of IBD probabilities, which is then specialized to specific relationships (e.g., parent-offspring, half-sibs) by substituting their π values.

formula-notes:formula_21.34e:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the genetic covariance between an uncle (x, full-sib of parent R) and his nephew (y, offspring of R) as a weighted sum of additive (σ²_A) and dominance (σ²_D) variances, with coefficients 1/4 and 1/27 respectively.
formula-notes:formula_21.34e:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on response for particular designs to provide the covariance for an uncle-nephew relationship, which is used to predict genetic resemblance and design breeding programs.

formula-notes:formula_21.34e:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算叔侄关系（叔叔x与侄子y）的遗传协方差σ_G(x,y)，其中叔叔x与共同亲本R是全同胞，侄子y是R的后代。结果表示为加性方差σ_A^2的1/4与显性方差σ_D^2的1/27之和。
formula-notes:formula_21.34e:zh.inThisChapter: 在“特定设计响应”章节中，该公式通过π系数（共祖概率）推导出特定亲缘关系下的遗传协方差，为后续计算亲缘间表型协方差或方差组分估计提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_21.34a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将四倍体基因型值G1234分解为四个单等位基因加性效应（a1至a4）、六个两两显性效应（d12至d34）、四个三向互作效应（t123至t234）和一个四向互作效应（q1234），共15个分量。
formula-notes:formula_21.34a:zh.inThisChapter: 在“特定设计的响应”章节中，此公式为四倍体遗传模型提供了完整的基因型值分解框架，后续公式21.34b–e将基于此分解分别计算各效应分量的方差分量，从而分析四倍体群体的遗传变异组成。

formula-notes:formula_21.34d:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the genetic covariance between half-uncle and nephew as a weighted sum of additive (σ²_A) and dominance (σ²_D) variances, with coefficients 1/8 and 1/216 respectively.
formula-notes:formula_21.34d:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on response for particular designs to provide the explicit covariance expression for this specific relationship, which is used later to predict resemblance or response in selection designs involving half-uncle–nephew pairs.

formula-notes:formula_21.34c:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将任意两个亲属间的遗传协方差表示为四个IBD概率π₁, π₂, π₃, π₄与加性方差σₐ²、显性方差σᴅ²、双基因上位方差σᴛ²、四基因上位方差σǫ²的加权和，其中每个权重由πᵢ的线性组合给出。
formula-notes:formula_21.34c:zh.inThisChapter: 在“特定设计响应”章节中，此公式作为通用协方差表达式，用于后续代入特定亲属关系（如亲-子、半同胞）的πᵢ值，从而推导出这些关系下的遗传协方差具体形式。

formula-notes:formula_21.34d:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算半叔侄关系（x与R为半同胞，y为R的子代）的遗传协方差σ_G(x,y)，结果为加性方差σ_A^2的1/8加上显性方差σ_D^2的1/216。
formula-notes:formula_21.34d:zh.inThisChapter: 在“特定设计响应”章节中，该公式由方程21.34c代入系数得到，用于量化特定亲缘关系下的遗传协方差，为后续推导其他亲属关系（如全叔侄）的协方差提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_21.35a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算家系选择响应(R_b)与个体选择响应(R_m)的比值，等于选择强度比(ī_b/ī_m)乘以系数γ除以√(t_n)，其中t_n是家系内同胞表型相关。
formula-notes:formula_21.35a:zh.inThisChapter: 本章比较家系选择与个体选择的效率，此公式通过比值直接量化两种方法的相对响应，为后续讨论不同家系选择类型(如全同胞、半同胞)的γ取值及效率比较提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_21.35b:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the ratio of response to family-deviations selection (R_FD) relative to mass selection (R_m), as the product of the intensity ratio and a factor involving the correlation among sibs (r_n) and the intraclass correlation (t_n).
formula-notes:formula_21.35b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section comparing efficiency of family-based vs. individual selection to quantify how family-deviations selection performs relative to mass selection, supporting the conclusion that its efficiency depends on the balance between selection intensity and the reduction in genetic variance due to family structure.

formula-notes:formula_21.35a:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the ratio of response to selection from among-family selection (R_b) to that from individual (mass) selection (R_m). It connects the ratio of selection intensities (ī_b/ī_m), a factor γ depending on selection type, and the square root of the intraclass correlation among sibs (t_n).
formula-notes:formula_21.35a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section comparing efficiency of family-based vs. individual selection to quantify the relative advantage of using family information. The ratio supports later arguments about when among-family selection outperforms mass selection, depending on heritability and family structure.

formula-notes:formula_21.35c:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the ratio of response to within-family selection (R_WF) to response to mass selection (R_m) as the product of the intensity ratio (ī_WF/ī_m) and a factor (1-r)/√(1-t), where r is the intraclass correlation of half-sib families and t is the intraclass correlation of full-sib families.
formula-notes:formula_21.35c:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on efficiency of family-based vs. individual selection to quantify the relative advantage of within-family selection over mass selection, supporting the argument that within-family selection can be more efficient when family correlations are low.

formula-notes:formula_21.35b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算家族偏差选择（FD）相对于个体选择（mass selection, m）的响应比 R_FD/R_m，等于两个选择强度之比乘以 (1 - r_n)/√(1 - t_n)，其中 r_n 是同胞间表型相关（由公式21.6b计算），t_n 是家族内表型相关（由公式21.9c计算）。
formula-notes:formula_21.35b:zh.inThisChapter: 本章比较不同选择方法（个体、家族、家系内）的效率，此公式由公式21.19推导而来，用于量化家族偏差选择相对于个体选择的优势，为后续与家系内选择（公式21.35c）的对比提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_21.35c:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算严格家系内选择（WF）相对于个体选择（质量选择，m）的响应比，等于两个选择强度之比乘以(1-r)/√(1-t)，其中r是家系内个体间的遗传相关，t是家系内表型相关。
formula-notes:formula_21.35c:zh.inThisChapter: 在比较家系选择与个体选择效率的章节中，此公式由响应比公式(21.20)推导而来，用于量化当利用家系内变异时，选择响应相对于质量选择的相对效率，为后续讨论不同选择策略的优劣提供定量依据。

formula-notes:formula_21.36a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将家系均值方差与个体表型方差之比 t 分解为两部分：第一部分 r h^2 表示由加性遗传方差（通过亲缘系数 r 和狭义遗传力 h^2）贡献的部分，第二部分 (σ_GF^2 - r σ_A^2) + σ_Ec^2 除以 σ_z^2 表示由非加性遗传方差（σ_GF^2 中超出 r σ_A^2 的部分）和共同环境方差 σ_Ec^2 贡献的部分。
formula-notes:formula_21.36a:zh.inThisChapter: 本章比较家系选择与个体选择的效率，t 是家系内表型相关，此处通过分解 t 来量化家系均值中可遗传（加性）与不可遗传（非加性+共同环境）成分的比例，为后续推导家系选择响应公式（如公式 21.36b）提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_21.36a:en.plainMeaning: This formula expresses the intraclass correlation t of family means as the sum of two components: the first term r h^2 represents the additive genetic contribution scaled by relatedness, and the second term captures non-additive genetic variance (σ_GF^2 - r σ_A^2) plus common environmental variance (σ_Ec^2), all divided by total phenotypic variance σ_z^2.
formula-notes:formula_21.36a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section comparing family-based vs. individual selection to decompose the variance of family means into genetic and environmental parts, supporting the derivation of the efficiency ratio in Equation 21.36b.

formula-notes:formula_21.37b:en.plainMeaning: This inequality gives the condition on the squared coefficient of environmental variation (c²) for family-based selection to be more accurate than individual selection, depending on heritability (h²) and relationship coefficient (γ).
formula-notes:formula_21.37b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in this section to quantify when family selection outperforms individual selection, supporting the comparison of selection methods under different family structures.

formula-notes:formula_21.37a:en.plainMeaning: This formula defines the threshold t_n, which is the intraclass correlation for family means, as a function of the intraclass correlation t among individuals and the family size n. It is expressed in terms of heritability h², genetic correlation r, and common environmental effect c². The inequality t_n < γ² indicates that among-family selection is more accurate than individual selection.
formula-notes:formula_21.37a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in this section to provide a concrete condition (t_n < γ²) for when family-based selection outperforms individual selection, building on Equation 21.35a. This condition is used to compare the accuracy of different selection strategies.

formula-notes:formula_21.38a:en.plainMeaning: This inequality gives the condition under which family-based selection yields a larger response than individual selection when families are large. The symbols are: t (intraclass correlation of phenotypic values), r (coefficient of relationship), h² (heritability), and c² (common environmental correlation).
formula-notes:formula_21.38a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section comparing efficiency of family-based vs. individual selection to derive the threshold where family selection outperforms individual selection. It supports the subsequent derivation of specific conditions for half-sibs and full-sibs in Equation 21.38b.

formula-notes:formula_21.39a:en.plainMeaning: This inequality states that the within-family heritability (h_w^2) exceeds the individual heritability (h^2) when the intraclass correlation among family members (t) is greater than the correlation between breeding values and phenotypes within families (r).
formula-notes:formula_21.39a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section comparing family-based vs. individual selection to show that when t > r, family-based selection (using within-family heritability) yields a greater response than individual selection, supporting the argument for the efficiency of family-based methods under certain conditions.

formula-notes:formula_21.36b:en.plainMeaning: This formula expresses the phenotypic correlation among relatives (t) as the sum of the product of relatedness (r) and heritability (h²) plus a term c² that captures residual among-family variance not due to additive genetic effects. For half-sibs, c²σz² equals the environmental variance common to half-sib families (σ²_Ec(HS)); for full-sibs, it equals one-quarter of the dominance variance (¼σ²_D) plus the common environmental variance for full-sib families (σ²_Ec(FS)).
formula-notes:formula_21.36b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on efficiency of family-based vs. individual selection to decompose the family mean correlation into additive genetic and non-additive components, enabling comparison of selection response accuracy between family and individual selection strategies as illustrated in Figures 21.4 and 21.5.

formula-notes:formula_21.37a:zh.plainMeaning: 公式 (21.37a) 计算了家系内个体间表型相关系数 t 经 n 个同胞校正后的阈值 t_n，具体为 t_n = t + (1-t)/n，并展开为 (r h^2 + c^2)(1 - 1/n) + 1/n，用于与遗传决定系数 γ^2 比较。
formula-notes:formula_21.37a:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在比较家系选择与个体选择效率的章节，由条件 γ^2 > t_n 导出，为后续推导家系选择更准确的条件提供具体不等式，并铺垫公式 (21.37b) 的进一步分析。

formula-notes:formula_21.37b:zh.plainMeaning: 该不等式给出了共同环境效应方差占比c²的上限，当c²小于右边表达式时，基于家系的选择比个体选择更准确。右边三个表达式分别对应半同胞（家系和同胞选择，γ=1/4）、半同胞（亲本和S₁种子选择，γ=1/2）和全同胞（γ=1/2）三种情况，其中h²为狭义遗传力。
formula-notes:formula_21.37b:zh.inThisChapter: 本节比较家系选择与个体选择的效率，公式(21.37b)由公式(21.37a)代入公式(21.14b)推导得出，为后续判断不同家系结构下何时采用家系选择更优提供了定量判据。

formula-notes:formula_21.38b:en.plainMeaning: This formula gives the minimum value of the common environmental variance component c² (as a fraction of total phenotypic variance) required for family-based selection to be more efficient than individual selection, expressed for half-sibs (r=1/4) and full-sibs (r=1/2) in terms of heritability h².
formula-notes:formula_21.38b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on efficiency of family-based vs. individual selection to derive the condition under which family selection outperforms individual selection, supporting the argument that when families are large, the criterion reduces to a simple inequality involving h² and c².

formula-notes:formula_21.38b:zh.plainMeaning: 公式(21.38b)给出了在家族选择优于个体选择的条件中，共同环境效应方差占比c²必须超过的下界，该下界依赖于亲缘系数r和遗传力h²；对于半同胞(r=1/4)下界为7/16 - h²/4，对于全同胞(r=1/2)下界为3/4 - h²/2。
formula-notes:formula_21.38b:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式由条件(21.38a)直接推导而来，将不等式右侧的t替换为rh²+c²并化简，得到c²的显式阈值，从而在后续分析中结合h²+c²≤1的约束，判断不同h²下家族选择是否可行。

formula-notes:formula_21.39a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式表明，当个体间表型相关 t 大于家系内个体间遗传相关 r 时，家系内遗传力 h_w^2 大于个体遗传力 h^2。
formula-notes:formula_21.39a:zh.inThisChapter: 本节比较家系选择与个体选择的效率，公式(21.39a)通过比较 h_w^2 与 h^2 的大小，为后续推导家系选择相对于个体选择的响应优势（公式21.39b和21.39c）提供条件判断依据。

formula-notes:formula_21.38a:zh.plainMeaning: 该不等式比较了家系选择相对于个体选择的响应大小：当家系内表型相关t（由遗传相关rh²和共同环境效应c²组成）大于1减去(1-r)²时，家系选择更优。
formula-notes:formula_21.38a:zh.inThisChapter: 本节推导家系选择与个体选择的效率比较，该公式给出了大n时家系选择更优的临界条件，为后续代入半同胞(r=1/4)和全同胞(r=1/2)的具体表达式做铺垫。

formula-notes:formula_21.36b:zh.plainMeaning: 公式 t = r h² + c² 将全同胞或半同胞家系内表型相关系数 t 分解为两部分：由加性遗传效应贡献的 r h²（其中 r 是亲缘系数，h² 是狭义遗传力）和由共同环境效应（及全同胞情形下的显性效应）贡献的 c²。c² 的具体表达式取决于家系类型：半同胞时 c²σz² = σ²_{Ec(HS)}，全同胞时 c²σz² = (1/4)σ²_D + σ²_{Ec(FS)}。
formula-notes:formula_21.36b:zh.inThisChapter: 本节比较家系选择与个体选择的效率，该公式通过将表型相关分解为遗传和环境组分，为后续推导家系选择响应（如公式 21.36a 中的 R_F）提供基础，并用于计算家系均值遗传力等关键参数。

formula-notes:formula_21.39b:en.plainMeaning: This inequality states that the among-family heritability (h_b^2) exceeds the individual heritability (h^2) when the intraclass correlation (γ) is greater than the standardized selection threshold (t_n).
formula-notes:formula_21.39b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section comparing family-based vs. individual selection to show the condition under which family selection is more effective, supporting the argument that family-based selection outperforms individual selection when family resemblance is sufficiently high.

formula-notes:formula_21.39b:zh.plainMeaning: 该不等式表明，当γ（家系内表型相关系数）大于t_n（家系内个体间遗传相关系数）时，家系间遗传力h_b^2大于个体遗传力h^2。
formula-notes:formula_21.39b:zh.inThisChapter: 本节比较家系选择与个体选择的效率，此公式通过比较h_b^2和h^2的大小关系，为后续推导家系选择相对于个体选择的效率优势提供条件判断依据。

formula-notes:formula_21.40:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the selection intensity for within-family deviations (ī_FD) as the mass selection intensity (ī_m) multiplied by a factor that depends on the total number of measured sibs (M). It shows that ī_FD is slightly larger than ī_m.
formula-notes:formula_21.40:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section comparing efficiency of family-based vs. individual selection to quantify the increased selection intensity achievable by using within-family deviations, supporting the argument that family-based selection can be more efficient than mass selection.

formula-notes:formula_21.39c:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the ratio of selection differential from among-family selection (S_b) or within-family selection (S_w) to that from individual selection (S_m), expressed as the product of intensity ratio and the square root of the intraclass correlation t_n (for among-family) or 1-t_n (for within-family). Key symbols: S_b, S_w, S_m = selection differentials; i_b, i_w, i_m = selection intensities; σ_b, σ_w, σ_z = standard deviations; t_n = intraclass correlation.
formula-notes:formula_21.39c:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on efficiency of family-based vs. individual selection to quantify the relative selection differentials achievable by different selection methods, supporting the comparison of their genetic gains in later arguments.

formula-notes:formula_21.39c:zh.plainMeaning: 公式将家系选择（下标b）和家系内选择（下标w）的选择差分别与个体选择（下标m）的选择差之比，表示为选择强度之比乘以家系间标准差（σ_b = σ_z√t_n）或家系内标准差（σ_w = σ_z√(1-t_n)）与个体标准差σ_z之比，从而用家系内相关系数t_n量化相对效率。
formula-notes:formula_21.39c:zh.inThisChapter: 在比较家系选择与个体选择效率的章节中，该公式直接利用前文给出的家系间方差t_nσ_z²和家系内方差(1-t_n)σ_z²，将选择差之比转化为选择强度与t_n的函数，为后续推导相对效率的数值比较提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_21.40:zh.plainMeaning: 公式(21.40)计算的是基于家系内偏差选择时的标准化选择强度 \(\bar{\imath}_{FD}\)，它等于群体选择强度 \(\bar{\imath}_{m}\) 乘以 \(\sqrt{1+1/(M-1)}\)，其中 M 是测量的同胞总数。
formula-notes:formula_21.40:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在比较家系选择与个体选择效率的章节中，用于量化家系内偏差选择相对于群体选择在强度上的提升，为后续推导家系选择相对于个体选择的相对效率提供关键比较基准。

formula-notes:formula_21.41b:en.plainMeaning: This formula expresses the variance of family means (σ²(ẑ)) as the sum of three components: genetic variance among families (σ²_GF), variance due to common environment (σ²_Ec), and residual variance (σ²(ε)).
formula-notes:formula_21.41b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on replicated families over environments to decompose the observed variance into genetic, common environmental, and residual components, supporting later estimation of heritability or genetic correlations.

formula-notes:formula_21.41a:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the total variance of the family mean phenotype, combining among-family genetic and common environmental variance (σ_F²), plot-to-plot variance divided by number of plots (σ_{E_p}²/n_p), and individual-specific variance divided by total individuals (σ_w²/N).
formula-notes:formula_21.41a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on families replicated over environments to quantify how plot replication reduces environmental noise, supporting later derivations of heritability and response to selection in structured breeding designs.

formula-notes:formula_21.41b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将家系均值方差分解为三个分量：遗传家系方差（σ²_GF）、共同环境方差（σ²_Ec）和残差方差（σ²(ε)），其中残差方差进一步包含家系内遗传方差、特殊环境方差和地块误差。
formula-notes:formula_21.41b:zh.inThisChapter: 在“家系在环境中重复”的章节中，该公式用于量化家系均值估计的精度，为后续比较不同设计（如公式21.41a）的残差方差提供基础，并引出公式21.41c中残差方差的具体分解。

formula-notes:formula_21.41a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算的是家系均值（z̄）的方差，它分解为三个部分：家系间方差σ_F²、每个宏环境中重复小区数n_p引起的环境方差σ_{E_p}²/n_p，以及总个体数N导致的个体间方差σ_w²/N。
formula-notes:formula_21.41a:zh.inThisChapter: 在“家系在环境中重复”的章节中，该公式用于量化当存在共同家庭效应、小区效应和个体效应时家系均值的总方差，为后续推导更复杂设计（如公式21.41b和21.41c）下的方差表达式奠定基础。

formula-notes:formula_21.41c:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the residual variance σ²(ε) in the variance of family means, where σ²(ε) is the sum of three components: within-family genetic variance (σ²_Gw) divided by total individuals per family N, among-sibship environmental variance (σ²_Es) divided by N, and among-plot environmental variance (σ²_Ep) divided by number of plots per family n_p. The alternative form shows σ²(ε) = (1/N)(σ²_Gw + σ²_Es + n_s σ²_Ep) where n_s is the number of sibs per plot.
formula-notes:formula_21.41c:en.inThisChapter: This formula appears in the section on replicated families over environments to decompose the residual variance term in Equation 21.41b, which is needed to estimate the variance of family means and ultimately to test for genotype-by-environment interaction or to compute heritability.

formula-notes:formula_21.42a:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the variance of the residual error (σ²(ε)) when families are replicated over environments, decomposing it into components: σ²_Gw (within-family genetic variance), σ²_GF×E (family-by-environment interaction), σ²_Ep (plot error), and σ²_Es (sib error), scaled by sample sizes N, n_e, n_p, n_s.
formula-notes:formula_21.42a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on replicated families across environments to extend Equation 21.41b by incorporating additional error sources from macroenvironments and plots, supporting the calculation of family mean heritability and genetic gain in multi-environment trials.

formula-notes:formula_21.41c:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算残差方差 σ²(ε)，它由三个方差分量组成：家系内遗传方差 σ²_{Gw} 除以总个体数 N、环境内小区误差 σ²_{Es} 除以 N、以及环境间误差 σ²_{Ep} 除以环境数 n_p；最后一项通过 n_s（每个环境内的家系数）改写为 (1/N) n_s σ²_{Ep}，其中 N = n_s n_p。
formula-notes:formula_21.41c:zh.inThisChapter: 在“家系在环境中重复”的章节中，公式 (21.41c) 将残差方差分解为三个来源，为公式 (21.41b) 中家系均值方差 σ²(ẑ) 提供最后一个分量，从而支持后续对家系均值方差结构的完整表达。

formula-notes:formula_21.42b:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the variance of the residual error ε for a family mean when families are replicated across year-location combinations, with n_p plots per combination and n_s sigs per plot. Key symbols: σ²(ε) is the residual variance; σ²_GF×L, σ²_GF×Y, σ²_GF×L×Y are genotype-by-environment interaction variances; σ²_Ep is plot error variance; σ²_Gw and σ²_Es are within-plot genetic and sampling error variances; n_ℓ, n_y, n_p, n_s are numbers of locations, years, plots, and sigs; N = n_ℓ n_y n_p n_s is total sigs per family.
formula-notes:formula_21.42b:en.inThisChapter: This formula appears in the section on replicated families across environments to show how the residual variance of a family mean is partitioned into components from various sources of error and interaction. It supports later arguments about estimating heritability and comparing family means across environments.

formula-notes:formula_21.42a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算在多个环境中重复家系时，残差方差σ²(ε)的组成：它等于遗传方差σ_{Gw}^2除以总个体数N，加上家系-环境互作方差σ_{GF×E}^2除以环境数n_e，加上环境内小区误差σ_{E_p}^2除以n_e n_p，加上个体内误差σ_{E_s}^2除以N；第二行将其合并为(1/N)乘以括号内各项，其中n_s为每小区同胞数，n_p为每环境小区数。
formula-notes:formula_21.42a:zh.inThisChapter: 本节讨论家系在多个环境中重复时的方差结构，公式(21.42a)将残差方差分解为遗传、互作和误差分量，为后续推导家系均值方差(公式21.42b)和遗传力估计提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_21.43b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算当家系在环境中重复时，家系间方差分量的组成，包括加性方差σ_A²、显性方差σ_D²、加性×环境互作方差σ_{A×E}²、显性×环境互作方差σ_{D×E}²以及环境方差σ_{E_s}²，各项分别除以不同的系数（4, 4n_f, 4n_e, 4n_f n_e, N）。
formula-notes:formula_21.43b:zh.inThisChapter: 在本节中，公式21.43b扩展了公式21.43a，加入了环境重复和基因型×环境互作项，为后续推导家系选择响应或遗传力估计提供了更完整的方差结构。

formula-notes:formula_21.43b:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the variance among half-sib families when families are replicated across environments, partitioning contributions from additive (σ²_A), dominance (σ²_D), additive-by-environment (σ²_{A×E}), dominance-by-environment (σ²_{D×E}), and plot error (σ²_{E_s}) variances, with sample sizes n_f (families per environment), n_e (environments), and N (total plots).
formula-notes:formula_21.43b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on family replication over environments to extend the basic among-family variance formula (21.43a) by including genotype-by-environment interaction components, supporting later arguments on optimal allocation of resources in multi-environment trials.

formula-notes:formula_21.42b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算了当每个家系在多个年份-地点组合中重复种植时，家系均值表型方差中残差分量σ²(ε)的组成。它通过将各随机效应方差（如GF×L、GF×Y、GF×L×Y、Eₚ、Gw和Eₛ）除以相应的样本量（nℓ, ny, np, ns）来量化这些方差对残差的贡献，并最终用总样本数N统一表达。
formula-notes:formula_21.42b:zh.inThisChapter: 在本节“家系在环境中重复”的背景下，该公式用于推导家系均值表型方差中残差项的具体结构，为后续计算家系遗传力或进行显著性检验提供必要的方差分量表达式。它承接了公式21.41b的框架，并细化了残差方差在多层嵌套设计下的分解形式。

formula-notes:formula_21.44:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the expected response to ear-to-row selection (R_ER) when families are replicated over environments. It connects the selection intensity (ī_{(pM,M)}) with the additive genetic variance (σ²_A/8) divided by the phenotypic standard deviation among half-sib family means (σ(ẑ_HS)), with a correction factor (1+3/n) that approximates 1 for large n.
formula-notes:formula_21.44:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on replicated families to show how replication across environments reduces the correction factor (1+3/n) to 1, simplifying the response formula. This supports the argument that with sufficient replication, the response depends only on additive variance and selection intensity, ignoring dominance and epistasis.

formula-notes:formula_21.43a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算半同胞家系均值（\overline{z}）的方差，它分解为五个方差分量：父本半同胞遗传方差（\sigma_{G F(H S)}^{2}）、母本内遗传方差除以雌亲数（\sigma_{G(f|m)}^{2}/n_f）、父本半同胞与环境互作方差除以环境数（\sigma_{G F(H S)\times E}^{2}/n_e）、母本内与环境互作方差除以雌亲数与环境数乘积（\sigma_{G(f|m)\times E}^{2}/(n_f n_e)），以及全同胞内遗传方差与环境抽样方差之和除以总个体数N（(\sigma_{G w(F S)}^{2}+\sigma_{E_s}^{2})/N）。
formula-notes:formula_21.43a:zh.inThisChapter: 本节讨论家系在环境中重复时的响应，该公式为后续推导遗传力（公式21.43b）提供方差组分表达式，通过将各分量代入H定义（公式21.16b）来估计选择响应。

formula-notes:formula_21.43a:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the variance of the mean phenotype (σ²(ẑ)) for a half-sib family design where full-sib families are replicated across environments. Key symbols: σ²_GF(HS) = variance among half-sib families (genetic), σ²_G(f|m) = variance among females within males (full-sib families), σ²_GF(HS)×E = genotype-by-environment interaction for half-sib families, σ²_G(f|m)×E = genotype-by-environment interaction for full-sib families, σ²_Gw(FS) = within full-sib family genetic variance, σ²_Es = environmental variance among sibs, n_f = females per male, n_e = environments, n_s = sibs per family per environment, N = total half-sibs per male.
formula-notes:formula_21.43a:en.inThisChapter: This formula appears in the section on replicated families over environments to extend the basic half-sib design to include environmental replication. It supports later arguments (e.g., Equation 21.43b) by providing the variance components needed to estimate heritability and genetic correlations across environments.

formula-notes:formula_21.44:zh.plainMeaning: 公式(21.44)计算在穗行选择中，从M个半同胞家系中选取前K个（p=K/M）时的预期响应R_ER，它等于选择强度乘以半同胞家系均值方差中的加性遗传方差分量（σ_A^2/8）再除以半同胞家系均值表型标准差σ(ẑ_HS)。当n很大时，近似忽略(1+3/n)因子。
formula-notes:formula_21.44:zh.inThisChapter: 本节讨论家系在多个环境中重复时的响应，公式(21.44)将响应表达为选择强度与遗传变异（σ_A^2/8）相对于表型变异（σ(ẑ_HS)）的比值，为后续推导大n下的简化形式（如公式21.45）以及比较不同选择方法提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_21.46:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the expected response to within-row selection (R_ER(w)) when selecting the best k = q n_s plants from n_s within each selected row (family). It uses the standardized selection differential (i-bar) and the ratio of (3/8) of the additive genetic variance (σ_A^2) to the within-row phenotypic standard deviation (σ_w(HS)).
formula-notes:formula_21.46:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on response when families are replicated over environments, specifically addressing within-family selection when families are not replicated in the crossing block. It supports the argument that the response depends on the within-row phenotypic variance, which includes genetic and environmental components.

formula-notes:formula_21.46:zh.plainMeaning: 公式(21.46)计算在环境重复（ER）设计下，对半同胞家系内个体进行截断选择（保留比例q）时的预期响应R_{ER(w)}，它等于选择强度\overline{\imath}_{(qn_s,n_s)}乘以加性遗传方差(3/8)σ_A^2与半同胞家系内表型标准差σ_w(HS)的比值。
formula-notes:formula_21.46:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在“家系在环境中重复”一节，用于推导当半同胞家系在杂交圃中不重复时，家系内选择响应的表达式，为后续比较不同选择策略（如家系间选择）的效率提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_21.47:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算在无上位效应且家系重复于环境时，行内选择对响应分量R_ER(w)的贡献，其中分子(3/8)σ_A^2是加性遗传方差的一部分，分母平方根内包含(3/4)σ_A^2、σ_D^2和σ_E_s^2，分别代表加性、显性和环境方差，而\bar{\imath}_{(qn_s,n_s)}是选择强度。
formula-notes:formula_21.47:zh.inThisChapter: 此公式出现在讨论家系重复于环境下的响应时，由公式21.22b推导而来，用于量化行内选择在特定设计下的遗传进展，为后续比较不同选择策略的效果提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_21.45:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the response to selection (R_ER) when families are replicated across environments, as the product of the standardized selection intensity (i̅_(pM,M)) and the ratio of one-eighth of the additive genetic variance (σ_A²/8) to the square root of the total phenotypic variance among half-sib family means, which includes components of σ_A², genotype-by-environment interaction variance (σ_GF×E²), plot error variance (σ_Ep²), and subplot error variance (σ_Es²), each divided by appropriate replication numbers (n_e, n_p, n).
formula-notes:formula_21.45:en.inThisChapter: This formula appears in the section on response when families are replicated over environments to provide a practical expression for the expected selection response under such experimental designs, supporting later arguments about optimizing replication numbers and evaluating the impact of environmental interactions on genetic gain.

formula-notes:formula_21.47:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the response to within-row selection (R_ER(w)) when families are replicated over environments, using the selection intensity (i̅) and the ratio of (3/8) of additive genetic variance (σ²_A) to the square root of (3/4)σ²_A plus dominance variance (σ²_D) and specific environmental variance (σ²_E_s).
formula-notes:formula_21.47:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on response when families are replicated over environments to quantify the expected genetic gain from within-row selection under that design, supporting later arguments about the efficiency of replication across environments.

formula-notes:formula_21.45:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算在存在基因型-环境互作时，对半同胞家系进行选择（选择强度为 ī_{(pM,M)}）的响应 R_ER，分子是加性方差 σ_A^2 的 1/8，分母是半同胞家系均值表型方差的开方，其中分母包含加性方差的一半、基因型-环境互作方差除以环境数 n_e、永久环境方差除以 n_e n_p、以及暂时环境方差除以总个体数 n。
formula-notes:formula_21.45:zh.inThisChapter: 本节讨论家系在环境中重复时的响应，公式(21.45)从(21.44)推导而来，将分母中的 σ(ẑ_HS) 用(21.42a)的具体方差分量展开，以便在存在环境互作时量化选择响应，并为后续考虑上位性等复杂情况提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_21.50a:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes an index value I_ij for individual j in family i, combining the deviation of its phenotype from the family mean (weighted by b1) and the family mean itself (weighted by b2).
formula-notes:formula_21.50a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on selection using a family index, providing a general method to weight within- and among-family information for individual selection, and it leads to optimal weights derived in Equations 21.50b and 21.50c.

formula-notes:formula_21.50a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式通过加权组合个体偏差（个体值减去家系均值）和家系均值，计算个体j在家族i中的选择指数值I_{ij}，其中b1和b2分别为偏差和均值的权重。
formula-notes:formula_21.50a:zh.inThisChapter: 本节讨论基于家族指数的个体选择，该公式为后续推导最优权重b1、b2（公式21.50b、21.50c）提供基础，从而最大化选择响应。

formula-notes:formula_21.50c:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the relative weight B on family mean as the ratio of the index coefficient for family mean (b₂) to the coefficient for individual phenotype (b₁), minus 1.
formula-notes:formula_21.50c:en.inThisChapter: It appears in this section to simplify the index from Equation 21.50a into a form that directly expresses the weight on family mean relative to individual phenotype, supporting the discussion of selection on a family index.

formula-notes:formula_21.48a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将总预期响应 R_{ER(m)} 分解为两部分：第一项 R_{ER} 表示基于家系间选择（从 M 个家系中选 pM 个）的响应，使用半同胞家系均值标准差 σ(¯z_HS) 和加性方差 σ_A^2/8；第二项 R_{ER(w)} 表示基于家系内选择（从每个选中家系的 n_s 个个体中选 qn_s 个）的响应，使用家系内标准差 σ_w(HS) 和加性方差 (3/8)σ_A^2。
formula-notes:formula_21.48a:zh.inThisChapter: 本节讨论“家系在环境中重复”时的响应，该公式将家系间和家系内选择响应相加，为后续推导总响应 R_{ER(m)} 的简化形式（如公式 21.48b）以及考虑选择强度与方差分量关系（如公式 21.57b）提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_21.48a:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the total expected response to selection when families are replicated over environments, as the sum of the response from among-family selection (first term) and within-family selection (second term). Key symbols: R_ER(m) = total response, R_ER = among-family response, R_ER(w) = within-family response, ī = selection intensity, σ_A^2 = additive genetic variance, σ(ẑ_HS) = phenotypic standard deviation of half-sib family means, σ_w(HS) = within-family phenotypic standard deviation, pM = number of selected families out of M, qn_s = number of selected sibs within each selected family.
formula-notes:formula_21.48a:en.inThisChapter: This formula appears in the section on response when families are replicated over environments, extending the basic ear-to-row response (Equation 21.47) by adding within-family selection. It supports later arguments (e.g., Equation 21.48b) that optimize the allocation of resources between among- and within-family selection to maximize total response.

formula-notes:formula_21.48b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算改良穗行选择（modified ear-to-row selection）的预期响应 R_{ER(m)}，它由两项组成：第一项利用半同胞家系间选择（分子为 σ_A^2/8），分母包含加性方差、家系×环境互作、环境主效和重复误差；第二项利用家系内个体选择（分子为 3σ_A^2/8），分母包含加性方差、显性方差和重复误差。
formula-notes:formula_21.48b:zh.inThisChapter: 在章节“家系在环境中重复时的响应”中，公式21.48b将21.48a的响应分解为两项，分别对应家系间和家系内选择，为后续比较不同选择方案（如全同胞或半同胞）的效率提供量化基础。

formula-notes:formula_21.49:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算在环境间重复家系时，对ER（环境间重复）选择方案的响应R_ER(m)，它由两项组成：第一项来自半同胞家系间选择，贡献为选择强度乘以(1/4)加性遗传方差除以半同胞家系均值表型标准差；第二项来自半同胞家系内选择，贡献为选择强度乘以(3/8)加性遗传方差除以家系内表型标准差。
formula-notes:formula_21.49:zh.inThisChapter: 此公式出现在“当家系在环境间重复”一节，用于推导当两个亲本均经历半同胞选择时，从家系间和家系内分量获得的加倍响应，为后续公式(21.57b)中M的定义提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_21.50b:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes a family index I_{ij} as the sum of an individual's phenotype deviation z_{ij} and a weighted family mean deviation B * z̄_i, where B is the relative weight on the family mean.
formula-notes:formula_21.50b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on selection on a family index to provide a simplified form of the index that highlights the role of the relative weight B, supporting later arguments about how varying B affects selection outcomes.

formula-notes:formula_21.49:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the expected response to selection (R_ER(m)) when both parents in a crossing block are selected via half-sib family performance, combining an among-family component (first term) and a within-family component (second term). Key symbols: i̅_(pM,M) = selection intensity for among-family selection, i̅_(qn_s,n_s) = selection intensity for within-family selection, σ²_A = additive genetic variance, σ(z̅_HS) = phenotypic standard deviation of half-sib family means, σ_W(HS) = within-family phenotypic standard deviation.
formula-notes:formula_21.49:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on response when families are replicated over environments to quantify the total selection response from using both among- and within-family selection in a half-sib design. This formula supports later derivations (e.g., formula 21.57b) by providing the response expression needed to optimize selection intensity allocation.

formula-notes:formula_21.50b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将个体表型值z_ij与加权的家族均值B乘以z_i上划线相加，得到家族指数I_ij，其中B是家族均值相对于个体表型的相对权重。
formula-notes:formula_21.50b:zh.inThisChapter: 在本节关于家族指数选择的上下文中，此公式通过引入相对权重B，将个体选择与家族均值选择统一到一个指数中，为后续推导等价形式（如公式21.50a）和讨论权重缩放不变性提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_21.51:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算基于家庭指数I进行选择时的单代响应R_I，它等于选择强度ī_I乘以表型标准差σ_z再乘以指数I与后代性状y之间的遗传相关ρ(I,y)。
formula-notes:formula_21.51:zh.inThisChapter: 本章讨论基于家庭指数的选择，公式21.51将一般选择响应公式（21.1a或21.4a）具体化为指数I的形式，为后续计算指数选择下的响应提供直接表达式。

formula-notes:formula_21.48b:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the expected response to modified ear-to-row selection (R_ER(m)) as the sum of two components: the first uses between-family selection (with additive variance σ_A^2 scaled by 1/8) divided by the square root of the phenotypic variance among family means, and the second uses within-family selection (with additive variance scaled by 3/8) divided by the square root of the phenotypic variance among individuals within families. Key symbols: σ_A^2 = additive genetic variance, σ_D^2 = dominance variance, σ_F×E^2 = family-by-environment interaction variance, σ_E_p^2 = plot error variance, σ_E_s^2 = subplot error variance, n_e = number of environments, n_p = number of plots per environment, N = total number of subplots, and ī = selection intensity.
formula-notes:formula_21.48b:en.inThisChapter: This formula appears in the section on response when families are replicated over environments, extending the single-environment ear-to-row selection formula (21.48a) to account for genotype-by-environment interactions and multiple error terms. It supports the argument that modified ear-to-row selection can be partitioned into between- and within-family components, and that the overall response is the sum of these two independent selection steps.

formula-notes:formula_21.52a:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the covariance between a selection index I and offspring phenotype y, conditional on the family index R1, as a weighted sum of additive genetic variance components, where b1 and b2 are index weights, rn is the relationship coefficient, and σA² is the additive genetic variance.
formula-notes:formula_21.52a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on selection based on a family index to derive the covariance needed for the selection response equation (21.51), and it supports the subsequent derivation of the index weights in equation (21.52b).

formula-notes:formula_21.51:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the response to selection (R_I) when selection is on a family index I, as the product of the standardized selection intensity (ȋ_I), phenotypic standard deviation (σ_z), and the correlation ρ(I,y) between the index and offspring phenotype. Key symbols: R_I = response, σ(I,y|R₁) = parent-offspring covariance for index and phenotype, σ_I² = variance of index, S_{I_m}+S_{I_f} = sum of selection differentials in males and females, ȋ_I = standardized intensity, σ_z = phenotypic SD, ρ(I,y) = correlation.
formula-notes:formula_21.51:en.inThisChapter: This formula appears in the section on selection on a family index to show how the general response equation (21.1a or 21.4a) simplifies when the selection criterion is an index I. It supports later arguments by linking the response to the correlation between index and offspring phenotype, enabling prediction of selection outcomes.

formula-notes:formula_21.50c:zh.plainMeaning: 公式 B = b₂/b₁ - 1 计算了相对权重 B，其中 b₂ 是家系均值的权重，b₁ 是个体表型的权重，B 表示家系均值相对于个体表型的额外权重。
formula-notes:formula_21.50c:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在“家系指数选择”章节中，用于将式(21.50a)的指数形式转换为式(21.50b)的等价形式，为后续推导基于家系均值的选择指数提供代数关系。

formula-notes:formula_21.53b:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the correlation ρ(I,A) between an individual's index score I and breeding value A, expressed in terms of selection parameters b1, b2, heritability h, relationship r_n, and family size t_n.
formula-notes:formula_21.53b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on selection using a family index to quantify the accuracy of the index as a predictor of breeding value, supporting later derivations of selection response and optimal index weights.

formula-notes:formula_21.52a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算在给定家系索引R1的条件下，综合选择指数I与后代表型y之间的协方差σ(I,y|R1)。它通过权重b1和b2分别对家系内偏差(zij - z̄i)和家系均值(z̄i)与y的协方差进行加权，并利用遗传方差σA²/2以及家系内相关系数rn简化得到最终表达式。
formula-notes:formula_21.52a:zh.inThisChapter: 本章讨论基于家系索引的选择，公式21.52a是推导最优索引权重（公式21.51）所需的关键协方差计算，它结合表21.3中的协方差结构，为后续得到索引的预测精度和选择响应提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_21.52b:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the variance of a selection index I as a weighted combination of within-family and between-family variances, where b1 and b2 are weights, σz² is the total phenotypic variance, and tn is the intraclass correlation.
formula-notes:formula_21.52b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on selection using a family index to derive the variance of the index, which is then used to compute the selection response or heritability in later arguments.

formula-notes:formula_21.52b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算选择指数 I 的方差 σ²(I)，将其表示为两个回归系数 b₁、b₂ 和组内相关系数 tₙ 的函数，最终简化为 [b₁² + tₙ(b₂² - b₁²)]σ_z²。
formula-notes:formula_21.52b:zh.inThisChapter: 在“家系指数选择”章节中，该公式用于推导选择指数 I 的方差，为后续计算选择响应或遗传进展提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_21.54:en.plainMeaning: This formula gives the optimal index weights b1 (for individual phenotype) and b2 (for family mean) that maximize the correlation ρ(I, A) between the index and breeding value, where r is the intraclass correlation of breeding values, t is the phenotypic intraclass correlation, and n is family size.
formula-notes:formula_21.54:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on selection using a family index to show how to combine individual and family information optimally, supporting the argument that the index maximizes the correlation with breeding value.

formula-notes:formula_21.53c:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the expected response to selection on a family index, where R_I is the response, ī_I is the average selection intensity across sexes, h is the square root of heritability, σ_A is the additive genetic standard deviation, b1 and b2 are index weights for individual and family information, r_n is the relationship among family members, and t_n is the intraclass correlation among family members.
formula-notes:formula_21.53c:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on selection using a family index to quantify the expected genetic gain when combining individual and family information, supporting the comparison of index selection efficiency relative to mass selection.

formula-notes:formula_21.53a:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the heritability of a family index (h_I^2) as a function of the trait heritability (h^2), within-family regression coefficient (b1), between-family regression coefficient (b2), relationship coefficient (r_n), and a weighting factor (t_n) that accounts for family size and correlation.
formula-notes:formula_21.53a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on selection using a family index to quantify how effectively the index captures genetic variation, supporting later derivations of selection response and optimal index weights in equations 21.53b and 21.53c.

formula-notes:formula_21.53b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算个体指数得分 I 与育种值 A 之间的相关系数 ρ(I,A)，等于协方差 σ(I,A) 除以标准差乘积 σ(I)σ(A)。通过代入 σ(I,A)=2σ(I,y|R₁) 并化简，最终表示为遗传力 h 与权重系数 b₁、b₂、半同胞相关系数 r_n、以及 t_n 的函数。
formula-notes:formula_21.53b:zh.inThisChapter: 在本章“家系指数选择”中，该公式用于量化指数 I 对育种值 A 的预测精度，为后续比较不同指数（如家系内选择、家系间选择）的效率提供基础。它直接由 21.52a 和 21.52b 推导而来，并引出 21.53c 中更简洁的形式。

formula-notes:formula_21.56a:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the response to selection (R_LI) under Lush's family index, where ī is selection intensity, σ_A is additive genetic standard deviation, h is square root of heritability, r is relationship among family members, t is intraclass correlation, and n is family size.
formula-notes:formula_21.56a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on selection using a family index to quantify the expected genetic gain when using optimal weights derived from Equation 21.53c, supporting the comparison of different selection strategies.

formula-notes:formula_21.55:zh.plainMeaning: 公式 (21.55) 计算Lush指数中家系均值权重系数B_L，其中r是组内个体间遗传相关，t是组内表型相关，n是家系大小。
formula-notes:formula_21.55:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式由将公式(21.54)代入(21.50c)得到，用于构建Lush指数I_L = z_{ij} + B_L \overline{z}_i，为后续基于家系信息的选择指数提供具体权重。

formula-notes:formula_21.53a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算基于家系指数I的选择响应所对应的遗传力h_I^2，它等于2倍指数I与条件育种值(y|R1)的协方差除以指数方差σ^2(I)，并进一步表示为群体遗传力h^2乘以一个关于b1、b2、rn和tn的分数。
formula-notes:formula_21.53a:zh.inThisChapter: 在本章“家系指数选择”中，该公式用于量化指数选择效率，为后续推导最优指数权重（如公式21.53b和21.53c）提供基础，并比较不同选择策略的遗传进展。

formula-notes:formula_21.55:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the weight B_L for the family mean in the Lush index, where r is the intraclass correlation of family means, t is the intraclass correlation of individual records, and n is the number of individuals per family.
formula-notes:formula_21.55:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on selection on a family index to define the optimal weighting of family information, supporting the derivation of the combined selection index that maximizes response to selection.

formula-notes:formula_21.54:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式给出了最优选择指数中个体表型值权重b1和家系均值权重b2的具体表达式，其中r是性状遗传力（即公式21.37b中的h²），t是家系内表型相关系数，n是家系大小。
formula-notes:formula_21.54:zh.inThisChapter: 在“家系指数选择”一节中，该公式直接来自Lush（1947）对最大化指数与育种值间相关系数ρ(I,A)的推导结果，为后续比较不同选择方法（如个体选择、家系选择）的效率提供了具体的权重计算依据。

formula-notes:formula_21.53c:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算基于家系指数选择的预期响应 R_I，其中 ī_I 是两性平均选择强度，hσ_A 是加性遗传标准差乘以选择强度的平方根，分子中的 b1 + r_n(b2 - b1) 表示家系内和家系间信息的加权和，分母 sqrt(b1^2 + t_n(b2^2 - b1^2)) 是表型标准差，整体反映了指数选择响应与质量选择响应的比值关系。
formula-notes:formula_21.53c:zh.inThisChapter: 在“家系指数选择”章节中，该公式由方程21.53a代入21.51推导而来，用于量化指数选择相对于个体质量选择的预期遗传进展，为后续比较不同指数权重（b1, b2）和家系结构（r_n, t_n）对选择效率的影响提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_21.56a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算Lush指数下的选择响应R_LI，其中ī是选择强度，σ_A是加性遗传标准差，h是平方根遗传力，r是遗传相关系数，t是表型相关系数，n是家系内个体数。
formula-notes:formula_21.56a:zh.inThisChapter: 在家族指数选择章节中，此公式由最优权重下的响应公式21.53c简化而来，用于量化基于家系信息的指数选择带来的遗传进展，为后续比较不同指数（如公式21.56b和21.56c）的效率提供基准。

formula-notes:formula_21.57a:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the effective number of independent variables (M_e) as a linear combination of the total number of markers (M) and the number of families (m), weighted by the intraclass correlation (t) between sibs.
formula-notes:formula_21.57a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on selection on a family index to approximate the effective number of independent markers when sibs are correlated, supporting the derivation of a more accurate effective number in equation (21.57b).

formula-notes:formula_21.56b:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the ratio of response to family index selection (R_LI) over response to individual selection (R_m), showing it is always at least 1. Key symbols: r = intraclass correlation of family members, t = phenotypic correlation among family members, n = family size.
formula-notes:formula_21.56b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on selection on a family index to quantify the advantage of using family information over individual selection alone, supporting the argument that family index selection yields greater response when r > t.

formula-notes:formula_21.56c:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the ratio of response to linear index selection (R_LI) over response to individual selection (R_m) for large family size n, as a function of the intraclass correlation t and relatedness r. Key symbols: R_LI = response to linear index selection, R_m = response to individual selection, r = relatedness among family members, t = intraclass correlation.
formula-notes:formula_21.56c:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on selection on a family index to show that when family size is large, the relative efficiency of index selection can become very high when t is near 0 or 1, supporting the argument that index selection is especially advantageous under extreme intraclass correlations.

formula-notes:formula_21.56c:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算当个体选择（n很大）时，基于家系指数的选择响应R_LI与基于个体表型的选择响应R_m之比，其中r是亲缘系数，t是家系内表型相关。
formula-notes:formula_21.56c:zh.inThisChapter: 本节讨论家系指数选择，该公式表明当t接近0或1时比值可很大，解释图21.8的U形曲线，并为后续比较不同选择方法提供理论依据。

formula-notes:formula_21.57b:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the expected selection intensity for family-based selection, adjusted for correlations, as a function of the proportion selected (p), the mean selection intensity (ī_p), and the numbers of males (M) and females (m) per family, with t representing the correlation among sibs.
formula-notes:formula_21.57b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section comparing family-based vs. individual selection to quantify the reduction in selection intensity due to correlated family members, supporting the argument that family selection loses efficiency when family size is large or correlations are high.

formula-notes:formula_21.58a:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the intraclass correlation τ among sibs for the selection index I = z_ij + B * z̄_i, where n is sibship size, t is the intraclass correlation of individual phenotypes, and B is the weight on family mean.
formula-notes:formula_21.58a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on selection using a family index to show how τ depends on B, n, and t, supporting later arguments that large B makes τ approach 1, justifying selection on family means.

formula-notes:formula_21.57a:zh.plainMeaning: 公式计算有效独立变量数 M_e，其中 M 是总变量数，m 是家族数，t 是同胞间相关系数；它通过加权平均 M 和 m 来调整变量间的相关性。
formula-notes:formula_21.57a:zh.inThisChapter: 本节讨论基于家族索引的选择，该公式为后续推导有效独立变量数（公式21.57b）提供线性近似基础，用于量化选择响应中的自由度损失。

formula-notes:formula_21.58b:en.plainMeaning: This formula gives the approximate selection differential (τ) for family-based selection under Lush index weights, expressed in terms of the intraclass correlation t. For full-sibs, τ ≈ 1 - t; for half-sibs, τ ≈ (1 - t)/(1 + 8t) ≈ 1/(1 + 2h²), where h² is heritability.
formula-notes:formula_21.58b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on selection on a family index to quantify the reduction in selection differential due to family structure, supporting later arguments about the efficiency of family versus individual selection.

formula-notes:formula_21.56b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算了在家族指数选择下响应（R_LI）与个体选择下响应（R_m，由公式13.6b给出）的比值，其中r为家族内个体间遗传相关系数，t为表型相关系数，n为家族大小。比值≥1表明家族指数选择至少与个体选择一样有效。
formula-notes:formula_21.56b:zh.inThisChapter: 本章讨论基于家族指数的选择，公式21.56b量化了相对于个体选择的增益，为后续比较不同选择方法（如公式21.56c）提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_21.57b:zh.plainMeaning: 公式计算在考虑家系内相关时，对群体选择强度 \(\bar{\imath}_p\) 的校正值 \(\bar{\imath}_{(K,M)}(t)\)，其中 \(p\) 为选择比例，\(M\) 和 \(m\) 分别为家系内个体数及家系数，\(t\) 为家系内相关。
formula-notes:formula_21.57b:zh.inThisChapter: 此公式出现在比较家系选择与个体选择效率的章节，通过引入相关校正，为后续推导家系选择相对于个体选择的相对效率提供定量基础。

formula-notes:formula_22.1a:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the phenotype z_i of individual i as the sum of its direct effect P_{d_i} and the indirect (associative) effects P_{s_j} from all other n-1 individuals in the group.
formula-notes:formula_22.1a:en.inThisChapter: It introduces the basic decomposition of phenotype into direct and associative components, which is then used to partition genetic effects (breeding values) in subsequent equations (22.1b–22.1e).

formula-notes:formula_21.58b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式给出了在Lush指数权重下，选择响应τ的近似表达式：对于全同胞（full-sibs）家系，τ≈1-t；对于半同胞（half-sibs）家系，τ≈(1-t)/(1+8t)≈1/(1+2h²)，其中t是家系内性状相关，h²是遗传力。
formula-notes:formula_21.58b:zh.inThisChapter: 本章讨论基于家系指数的选择，公式21.58b利用公式21.55中B的值，推导出不同亲缘关系下选择响应的简化形式，为后续比较不同选择方案的效果提供定量依据。

formula-notes:formula_22.1a:zh.plainMeaning: 公式 (22.1a) 将个体 i 的表型值 z_i 分解为两部分：个体自身的直接效应 P_{d_i}，以及群体中其他 n-1 个个体的社会效应 P_{s_j} 之和。
formula-notes:formula_22.1a:zh.inThisChapter: 本节讨论直接效应与关联效应，该公式为后续将 P_{d_i} 和 P_{s_j} 进一步分解为育种值 A 和残差 E（公式 22.1b-22.1e）提供了基础，从而建立包含社会互动的遗传模型。

formula-notes:formula_21.58a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算家系指数I = z_{ij} + B \bar{z}_i（公式21.50b）在同窝个体间的组内相关系数τ，其中t是个体表型值的组内相关系数，n是家系大小，B是家系均值权重。
formula-notes:formula_21.58a:zh.inThisChapter: 在本节“基于家系指数的选择”中，该公式用于量化指数I在亲属间的相似程度，为后续推导选择响应（如公式21.58b）提供关键参数τ。

formula-notes:formula_22.1b:en.plainMeaning: This formula expresses the phenotype z_i of individual i as the population mean μ plus the direct genetic and environmental effects (A_{d_i}+E_{d_i}) of i, plus the sum over all other individuals j of their associative (social) genetic and environmental effects (A_{s_j}+E_{s_j}).
formula-notes:formula_22.1b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on direct versus associative effects to decompose the total phenotype into direct and indirect components, setting up the later derivation of the total heritable effect and response to selection in socially interacting groups.

formula-notes:formula_22.1c:en.plainMeaning: This formula expresses an individual's phenotypic value (z_i) as the sum of the population mean (μ), its own direct additive genetic effect (A_{d_i}), the sum of associative additive genetic effects of all other group members (∑ A_{s_j}), and a residual (e_i) that combines direct and associative environmental effects (E_{d_i} and ∑ E_{s_j}).
formula-notes:formula_22.1c:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on direct versus associative effects to provide a compact decomposition of the phenotype into direct and indirect genetic components, supporting later derivations of group mean phenotype and variance components.

formula-notes:formula_22.1d:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the mean phenotypic value of a group (μ_z) as the sum of the population mean (μ), the mean direct genetic effect (μ_{A_d}), and (n-1) times the mean associative genetic effect (μ_{A_s}), where n is the group size.
formula-notes:formula_22.1d:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on direct versus associative effects to express the expected group phenotype when environmental deviations average to zero, supporting later analysis of how indirect genetic effects contribute to group-level heritable variance.

formula-notes:formula_22.1c:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将个体i的表型值z_i分解为群体均值μ、个体自身的直接加性遗传效应A_{d_i}、所有其他n-1个个体的社会加性遗传效应A_{s_j}之和，以及残差e_i（其中e_i又分解为直接环境效应E_{d_i}和其他个体的社会环境效应E_{s_j}之和）。
formula-notes:formula_22.1c:zh.inThisChapter: 在“直接效应与社会效应”一节中，此公式将22.1a和22.1b的分解合并为更紧凑的形式，为后续推导群体平均表型值（22.1d）和方差分量奠定基础。

formula-notes:formula_22.1d:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算群体平均表型值 μ_z，它等于总体均值 μ 加上直接遗传效应均值 μ_{A_d}，再加上 (n-1) 倍的社会遗传效应均值 μ_{A_s}。
formula-notes:formula_22.1d:zh.inThisChapter: 在“直接效应与关联效应”一节中，公式 (22.1d) 由 (22.1c) 取期望得到，为后续推导群体均值与方差组分（如公式 22.1e）提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_22.1b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将个体i的表型值z_i分解为群体均值μ、个体自身的直接遗传效应（育种值A_{d_i}加残差E_{d_i}）以及所有其他个体j≠i的间接遗传效应（育种值A_{s_j}加残差E_{s_j}）之和，其中下标d表示直接效应，s表示间接（社会）效应。
formula-notes:formula_22.1b:zh.inThisChapter: 在“直接效应与间接效应”一节中，该公式将式(22.1a)中的群体效应进一步拆分为遗传和环境组分，为后续推导总遗传方差（式22.1c）以及直接-间接遗传协方差（式22.1d, 22.1e）提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_22.1e:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the total change in mean trait value within a group after selection, Δμ_z, as the sum of the response in direct genetic value (R_d) and (n-1) times the response in social genetic value (R_s).
formula-notes:formula_22.1e:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on direct versus associative effects to decompose the total evolutionary response into contributions from direct and social genetic effects, supporting the argument that both components must be considered in multilevel selection.

formula-notes:formula_22.1e:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将群体均值性状的变化 Δμ_z 分解为直接遗传响应 R_d 和 (n-1) 倍社会遗传响应 R_s 之和，其中 n 是群体大小。
formula-notes:formula_22.1e:zh.inThisChapter: 在“直接效应与关联效应”章节中，此公式用于量化选择后群体均值的变化，并明确区分直接遗传效应和社会遗传效应各自的贡献，为后续分析间接遗传效应的重要性奠定基础。

formula-notes:formula_22.4a:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the covariance between an individual's phenotype (z_i) and its total breeding value (A_T_i), expressed as the sum of covariances of direct (A_d_i) and associative (A_s_j) genetic effects with the total breeding value.
formula-notes:formula_22.4a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on direct versus associative effects to decompose the covariance into components involving direct and associative genetic effects, supporting the derivation of selection response equations (22.4b, 22.4c).

formula-notes:formula_22.2:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将个体 i 的性状值 z_i 分解为自身加性遗传效应 A_i、自身环境效应 e_i，以及来自互作个体 j 的性状值 z'_j 的贡献 Ψ_{ij} z'_j，其中 z'_j 进一步分解为 A'_j 和 E'_j，从而将互作个体的遗传和环境效应纳入模型。
formula-notes:formula_22.2:zh.inThisChapter: 在本节“直接与关联效应”中，该公式扩展了经典直接遗传效应模型，引入 Ψ_{ij} 作为多元版本的 Falconer m 系数，为后续讨论互作个体间性状反馈循环和间接遗传效应提供数学基础。

formula-notes:formula_22.3:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the total breeding value (TBV) of an individual i for a trait expressed in a group of size n, as the sum of its direct genetic effect (A_di) and the total associative effects from all other group members, where each of the n-1 group members contributes an associative effect A_si.
formula-notes:formula_22.3:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on direct versus associative effects to decompose the total genetic contribution of an individual into its own direct effect and its influence on others, supporting later arguments about how selection on group performance can be partitioned into direct and indirect genetic components.

formula-notes:formula_22.2:en.plainMeaning: This formula expresses the phenotype of trait i in a focal individual as the sum of its own additive genetic (A_i) and environmental (e_i) components, plus the effect of the interacting partner's phenotype for trait j (z'_j), scaled by the interaction coefficient Ψ_ij. The partner's phenotype is further decomposed into its additive genetic (A'_j) and environmental (E'_j) components.
formula-notes:formula_22.2:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on direct versus associative effects to formalize how an individual's trait value can be influenced by the phenotype of another individual, extending the concept of indirect genetic effects to multivariate traits. This model supports later arguments about feedback loops and evolutionary dynamics in social interactions.

formula-notes:formula_22.4b:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the total genetic variance of group phenotype (σ(z, A_T)) as the sum of direct genetic variance (σ²(A_d)) and (n-1) times the covariance between direct and associative genetic effects (σ(A_d, A_s)), assuming unrelated group members.
formula-notes:formula_22.4b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on direct versus associative effects to decompose total genetic variance into components from direct and indirect genetic effects, supporting later arguments about how relatedness affects the covariance terms in the full model (e.g., Equation 22.4c).

formula-notes:formula_22.4b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算群体中个体总育种值（A_T）与个体自身表型（z）之间的协方差，等于个体直接育种值方差σ²(A_d)加上(n-1)倍个体直接与间接育种值之间的协方差σ(A_d, A_s)。
formula-notes:formula_22.4b:zh.inThisChapter: 在“直接与关联效应”章节中，该公式用于推导当群体成员无亲缘关系时，总育种值方差与直接、间接育种值方差及协方差的关系，为后续计算群体遗传方差（如公式22.4c）提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_22.4c:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the variance of total breeding value A_T, which is a linear combination of direct (A_d) and associative (A_s) genetic effects, as the sum of their variances plus twice the covariance, weighted by group size n.
formula-notes:formula_22.4c:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on direct versus associative effects to quantify the total genetic variance in a group setting, supporting later arguments about the decomposition of phenotypic variance and response to selection in social interactions.

formula-notes:formula_22.3:zh.plainMeaning: 公式(22.3)将个体i的总育种值A_Ti定义为它的直接育种值A_di加上(n-1)倍它的社会育种值A_si，其中n是群体大小，n-1是除自身外的同伴数。
formula-notes:formula_22.3:zh.inThisChapter: 本节区分直接效应和社会效应，此公式为后续推导总育种值方差、协方差以及选择响应提供基础，说明个体对群体总性能的贡献由自身直接效应和影响同伴的社会效应共同构成。

formula-notes:formula_22.4a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算个体表型值 $z_i$ 与其总育种值 $A_{T_i}$ 之间的协方差，其中 $z_i = \mu + A_{d_i} + \sum_{j\neq i} A_{s_j} + e_i$，$A_{T_i} = A_{d_i} + (n-1)A_{s_i}$。通过协方差的线性性质，将协方差拆分为直接育种值 $A_{d_i}$ 与社会育种值 $A_{s_j}$ 分别与总育种值的协方差之和。
formula-notes:formula_22.4a:zh.inThisChapter: 本章区分直接效应与关联效应，该公式为推导个体总育种值方差（公式22.4b）和协方差（公式22.4c）提供基础，通过展开协方差项，后续可代入协方差定义得到简化表达式。

formula-notes:formula_22.5a:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the phenotypic variance (σ_z²) as the product of the total variance (σ²) and the sum of the probability of direct effect (P_{d_i}) plus the sum over all other individuals j of the probabilities of social/associative effects (P_{s_j}).
formula-notes:formula_22.5a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on direct versus associative effects to decompose phenotypic variance into contributions from direct and social effects, supporting later derivations (e.g., Equations 22.5b–22.5d) that partition variance components in group-structured populations.

formula-notes:formula_22.4c:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将总育种值A_T的方差σ²(A_T)展开为直接育种值A_d的方差、直接与间接育种值协方差以及间接育种值方差的加权和，其中n为群体大小。
formula-notes:formula_22.4c:zh.inThisChapter: 在直接与间接效应章节中，此公式用于量化个体总育种值的遗传方差组成，为后续比较直接与间接遗传方差分量、理解社会互作对遗传进展的影响提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_22.5b:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the total phenotypic variance in a group trait (σ_z²) as the sum of the variance of direct genetic effects (σ²(P_d)) and (n-1) times the variance of social partner effects (σ²(P_s)), assuming group members are unrelated.
formula-notes:formula_22.5b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to associative effects to decompose group-level variance into direct and social components, supporting later arguments about how social interactions contribute to heritable variation and response to selection.

formula-notes:formula_22.5b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将群体表型方差 σ_z² 分解为直接遗传效应方差 σ²(P_d) 与 (n-1) 倍的社会遗传效应方差 σ²(P_s) 之和，其中 n 为群体大小。
formula-notes:formula_22.5b:zh.inThisChapter: 在假设群体成员无亲缘关系（协方差为零）时，由式 22.5a 简化而来，为后续引入遗传和环境方差分解（式 22.5c、22.5d）以及分析群体选择效应奠定基础。

formula-notes:formula_22.5a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将表型方差 σ_z² 分解为直接遗传方差 σ² P_{d_i} 与所有其他个体间接遗传方差之和 σ² ∑_{j≠i} P_{s_j}，其中 σ² 为遗传方差，P_{d_i} 为个体 i 的直接遗传效应系数，P_{s_j} 为个体 j 对 i 的间接遗传效应系数。
formula-notes:formula_22.5a:zh.inThisChapter: 本节区分直接效应与关联效应，该公式为后续推导总遗传方差（公式 22.5b）、直接-间接协方差（公式 22.5c）及表型方差分解（公式 22.5d）提供基础框架。

formula-notes:formula_22.5c:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the total phenotypic variance σ²_z as the sum of direct additive genetic variance σ²(A_d), indirect (social) additive genetic variance multiplied by (n-1), direct environmental variance σ²(E_d), and indirect environmental variance multiplied by (n-1), assuming unrelated group members.
