formula-notes:formula_22.39b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the BLUP estimation section to define the genetic covariance structure for direct and associative effects, which is then combined with the relationship matrix A via the Kronecker product to model the full covariance of random effects.

formula-notes:formula_22.38b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将个体i的表型值z_i分解为总体均值μ、个体i的直接育种值A_{d_i}、所有其他同伴j≠i的间接（社会）育种值A_{s_j}之和，以及残差e_i。
formula-notes:formula_22.38b:zh.inThisChapter: 在本节中，该公式作为最简单的残差结构模型，为后续推导直接和间接育种值的BLUP估计方程（如公式22.38c）提供了基础，并假设残差独立同方差以便于协方差矩阵的构建。

formula-notes:formula_22.39a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式表示直接遗传效应向量 a_d 和社会遗传效应向量 a_s 的方差-协方差矩阵，其中对角块为各自方差分量乘以亲缘关系矩阵 A，非对角块为协方差分量乘以 A。
formula-notes:formula_22.39a:zh.inThisChapter: 在本章 BLUP 估计直接和社会效应的上下文中，该公式定义了随机效应的协方差结构，为后续推导混合模型方程（如公式 22.39b 和 22.39c）提供必要的矩阵表达式。

formula-notes:formula_22.39a:en.plainMeaning: This formula specifies the variance-covariance matrix of the vectors of direct genetic effects (a_d) and associative (social) genetic effects (a_s), where the covariance structure is proportional to the additive genetic relationship matrix A, with variances σ²(A_d) and σ²(A_s) and covariance σ(A_d, A_s).
formula-notes:formula_22.39a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on BLUP estimation of direct and associative effects to define the covariance structure needed for mixed model equations, supporting the subsequent derivation of prediction error variances and covariances in Equations 22.39b and 22.39c.

formula-notes:formula_22.40a:en.plainMeaning: This matrix equation extends the standard mixed model to include two correlated random effects (direct and social breeding values). The left-hand side block matrix combines fixed effects (X, β) and random effects (Z_d, a_d; Z_s, a_s) with penalty terms λ1, λ2, λ3 and the inverse additive relationship matrix A⁻¹ to account for genetic correlations.
formula-notes:formula_22.40a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to associative effects to set up the mixed-model equations needed when direct and social genetic effects are correlated, supporting later estimation of variance components and prediction of breeding values in social interaction models.

formula-notes:formula_22.39b:zh.plainMeaning: 该矩阵 G 是直接遗传效应方差 σ²(A_d)、社会遗传效应方差 σ²(A_s) 以及两者协方差 σ(A_d, A_s) 组成的 2×2 协方差矩阵，用于描述个体加性遗传效应向量 (a_d, a_s) 的方差-协方差结构。
formula-notes:formula_22.39b:zh.inThisChapter: 在本节 BLUP 估计直接与社会效应中，公式 (22.39b) 将个体遗传效应的协方差矩阵定义为 G，以便后续通过 Kronecker 积 G ⊗ A 构建所有个体的完整遗传协方差矩阵，为 BLUP 求解混合模型方程提供必要的方差组分。

formula-notes:formula_22.39c:en.plainMeaning: This matrix specifies the variance-covariance structure for the random effects in the model: direct genetic effects (a_d), associative genetic effects (a_s), and residuals (e). The diagonal blocks contain variances (σ²(A_d) and σ²(A_s)) scaled by the additive genetic relationship matrix A, and the off-diagonal block shows the covariance σ(A_d,A_s) between direct and associative effects, also scaled by A. Residuals have variance σ²(e) times an identity matrix I and are uncorrelated with the genetic effects.
formula-notes:formula_22.39c:en.inThisChapter: This formula appears in the section on BLUP estimation of direct and associative effects to define the full covariance structure required for solving the mixed model equations. It supports the subsequent derivation of BLUP predictions for a_d and a_s by providing the necessary variance components and relationships.

formula-notes:formula_22.39c:zh.plainMeaning: 该矩阵给出了模型（22.39a）中三个随机效应向量（直接加性遗传效应 a_d、社会加性遗传效应 a_s 和残差 e）的方差-协方差结构：对角块为各自的方差矩阵（a_d 和 a_s 的方差为 σ²(A_d)A 和 σ²(A_s)A，e 的方差为 σ²(e)I），非对角块中 a_d 与 a_s 的协方差为 σ(A_d,A_s)A，而 e 与两者均不相关（0 矩阵）。
formula-notes:formula_22.39c:zh.inThisChapter: 在定义了直接和社会加性遗传效应的方差-协方差矩阵（22.39b）后，此公式将残差纳入，形成完整的随机效应协方差结构，为后续推导 BLUP 估计方程（如混合模型方程组）提供必要的方差分量信息。

formula-notes:formula_22.40b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将权重矩阵（λ1, λ2, λ3）表示为残差方差σ²(e)乘以加性遗传方差-协方差矩阵G的逆，其中G包含直接遗传效应方差σ²(Ad)、社会遗传效应方差σ²(As)及其协方差σ(Ad, As)。
formula-notes:formula_22.40b:zh.inThisChapter: 在介绍关联效应（竞争、社会互作、群体与亲缘选择）的章节中，公式(22.40b)用于将混合模型方程中的权重λ与遗传参数联系起来，为后续通过REML估计遗传方差组分提供理论基础。

formula-notes:formula_22.41:en.plainMeaning: This formula defines the covariance matrix of residuals σ(e) as σ²(e) times a correlation matrix R, where R has 1 on the diagonal, ρ for pairs in the same group, and 0 for pairs in different groups. Key symbols: σ²(e) is residual variance, ρ is the within-group residual correlation, and R is the correlation matrix.
formula-notes:formula_22.41:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the BLUP estimation section to specify the correct residual covariance structure for models with direct and associative effects, supporting the derivation of BLUP equations that account for group-structured data.

formula-notes:formula_22.40b:en.plainMeaning: This formula expresses the 2×2 matrix of weights (λ1, λ2, λ3) as the residual variance σ²(e) times the inverse of the genetic (co)variance matrix G, where G contains the additive genetic variances of direct (A_d) and social (A_s) effects and their covariance.
formula-notes:formula_22.40b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to associative effects to show how the weights in the mixed model equations (22.40a) are derived from the genetic parameters, supporting the estimation of direct and social genetic effects under competition or social interactions.

formula-notes:formula_22.40a:zh.plainMeaning: 该矩阵方程将固定效应（β）和两个随机效应（直接遗传效应ad、社会遗传效应as）的BLUP求解方程组合成一个分块线性系统，其中左上角块对应固定效应，对角块引入λ1、λ2、λ3调整随机效应方差-协方差结构。
formula-notes:formula_22.40a:zh.inThisChapter: 本章引入社会遗传效应（as）后，标准混合模型方程需扩展以处理ad与as间的遗传相关，此公式为后续推导BLUP解（公式22.40b）提供直接求解框架。

formula-notes:formula_22.43:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the phenotypic covariance between two group members, σ(z₁,z₂), as the sum of direct-associative genetic covariance (2σ(A_d,A_s)), associative genetic variance scaled by group size ((n-2)σ²(A_s)), group variance (σ²(g_p)), and residual covariance (σ(e₁,e₂)).
formula-notes:formula_22.43:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the BLUP estimation section to decompose the within-group covariance into genetic components, enabling the estimation of direct and associative effects via mixed models.

formula-notes:formula_22.42:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将观测值向量 z 分解为固定效应 Xβ、直接加性遗传效应 Za、随机群组效应 Zg gp 和残差 e 的线性组合，其中 a 是直接育种值向量，gp 是群组效应向量。
formula-notes:formula_22.42:zh.inThisChapter: 此公式出现在第22章 BLUP 估计直接与关联效应的部分，通过引入随机群组效应 Zg gp 扩展标准动物模型，为后续推导群组效应的方差协方差结构及关联效应的 BLUP 估计奠定基础。

formula-notes:formula_22.42:en.plainMeaning: This formula specifies a mixed linear model where the phenotype vector z is decomposed into fixed effects (Xβ), random direct genetic effects (Za), random group (associative) effects (Z_g g_p), and residuals (e). Key symbols: z = phenotype vector, X = design matrix for fixed effects β, Z = incidence matrix for direct genetic effects a, Z_g = incidence matrix for group effects g_p, e = residuals.
formula-notes:formula_22.42:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on BLUP estimation of direct and associative effects to extend the standard animal model by including random group effects, supporting the later derivation of BLUP for both direct breeding values and associative effects in group-structured populations.

formula-notes:formula_22.41:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式定义了残差向量 e 的协方差矩阵为 σ²(e) 乘以矩阵 R，其中 R 的对角线元素为 1（个体自身残差方差），同一组内不同个体的协方差为 ρ，不同组的个体间协方差为 0。
formula-notes:formula_22.41:zh.inThisChapter: 在 BLUP 估计直接效应和关联效应的章节中，该公式用于构建残差的协方差结构，以便在混合模型方程中正确加权观测值，为后续求解育种值 BLUP 提供必要的方差-协方差矩阵。

formula-notes:formula_22.44a:en.plainMeaning: This formula defines the projection matrix P that transforms the data vector z into residuals orthogonal to the fixed effects, where V is the covariance matrix of z and X is the design matrix for fixed effects.
formula-notes:formula_22.44a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the BLUP estimation section because P is essential for REML estimation of variance components, which are needed to compute BLUPs of direct and associative effects.

formula-notes:formula_22.43:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算同一组内两个无关个体（1和2）表型值z1和z2的协方差，将其分解为直接遗传效应协方差（2σ(Ad,As)）、关联遗传效应方差（(n-2)σ²(As)）、永久环境效应方差（σ²(gp)）以及残差协方差（σ(e1,e2)）。
formula-notes:formula_22.43:zh.inThisChapter: 在本节中，该公式用于推导组内协方差等于组间方差（即σ²(gp)）的估计量，为后续通过组内协方差估计永久环境效应方差提供基础，并引出直接与关联遗传效应协方差的表达式。

formula-notes:formula_22.45a:en.plainMeaning: This formula expresses the covariance matrix V as a linear combination of known constant matrices V_i with unknown variance-covariance parameters θ_i to be estimated.
formula-notes:formula_22.45a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the BLUP estimation section to define the general covariance structure used for all V matrices in the chapter, supporting the subsequent estimation of variance components and prediction of random effects.

formula-notes:formula_22.44b:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the vector Pz as the inverse of the covariance matrix V^{-1} times the residuals (z - Xβ̂), where z is the data vector, X is the fixed-effects design matrix, β̂ is the GLS estimate of fixed effects, and V is the covariance matrix of z.
formula-notes:formula_22.44b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the BLUP estimation section to show that Pz represents the data adjusted for fixed effects, which is then used to derive the covariance structure for predicting direct and associative genetic effects.

formula-notes:formula_22.44b:zh.plainMeaning: 公式(22.44b)将向量Pz定义为广义逆方差矩阵V⁻¹乘以数据z减去固定效应估计Xβ̂后的残差，即对数据z进行固定效应校正后的加权残差。
formula-notes:formula_22.44b:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在BLUP估计直接与关联效应的章节中，用于构建校正固定效应后的数据向量Pz，为后续推导BLUP的协方差结构提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_22.45a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将方差-协方差矩阵 V 表示为已知常数矩阵 V_i 与未知方差-协方差参数 θ_i 的线性组合，其中求和从 i=1 到 n。
formula-notes:formula_22.45a:zh.inThisChapter: 在本章中，所有 V 矩阵（如直接效应、关联效应等随机效应的方差-协方差结构）均采用此线性形式，为后续通过 REML 或 ML 估计 θ_i 提供基础结构。

formula-notes:formula_22.45b:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the (i,j)-th element of the Fisher information matrix for REML estimates, where P is the projection matrix and V_i, V_j are derivative matrices of the variance-covariance structure with respect to parameters θ_i and θ_j.
formula-notes:formula_22.45b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the BLUP estimation section to provide large-sample standard errors for the estimated direct and associative effects, supporting inference on the variance components estimated via REML.

formula-notes:formula_22.44a:zh.plainMeaning: 公式(22.44a)定义了一个矩阵P，它等于V的逆减去一个修正项，其中V是z的协方差矩阵，X是固定效应的设计矩阵，因此P可以看作是将数据投影到残差空间（即去除固定效应影响）的投影矩阵。
formula-notes:formula_22.44a:zh.inThisChapter: 在本节中，该公式用于构建REML估计的关键变换矩阵，为后续推导REML对数似然函数及其一阶导数（如公式22.44b）提供基础，从而实现对直接效应和关联效应的方差组分进行无偏估计。

formula-notes:formula_22.46a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将总方差-协方差矩阵 V 分解为四个分量：直接加性遗传方差 σ²(A_d) 乘 V₁、直接与关联加性遗传协方差 σ(A_d, A_s) 乘 V₂、关联加性遗传方差 σ²(A_s) 乘 V₃、以及残差方差 σ²(e) 乘 V₄。
formula-notes:formula_22.46a:zh.inThisChapter: 在本章中，该公式用于将 BLUP 混合模型方程中的方差结构具体化，以便后续通过 REML 或类似方法估计方差组分，并最终预测直接和关联加性遗传效应。

formula-notes:formula_22.46a:en.plainMeaning: This formula expresses the phenotypic variance-covariance matrix V as a linear combination of four known matrices (V1, V2, V3, V4) weighted by the genetic variance components: direct genetic variance σ²(A_d), direct-associative covariance σ(A_d, A_s), associative genetic variance σ²(A_s), and residual variance σ²(e).
formula-notes:formula_22.46a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the BLUP estimation section to specify the covariance structure of the mixed model (Equation 22.38c), enabling the derivation of BLUP solutions and variance component estimation via REML.

formula-notes:formula_22.46b:en.plainMeaning: This formula defines four matrices V1, V2, V3, V4 that decompose the phenotypic covariance matrix V into components due to direct genetic variance, covariance between direct and associative effects, associative genetic variance, and residual variance, where Zd and Zs are incidence matrices for direct and associative effects, A is the additive genetic relationship matrix, and I is the identity matrix.
formula-notes:formula_22.46b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on BLUP estimation of direct and associative effects to specify the covariance structure (Equation 22.46a) needed for mixed model equations, enabling prediction of breeding values for both direct and associative genetic effects.

formula-notes:formula_22.47a:en.plainMeaning: This formula expresses an individual's fitness (Wi) as the sum of the population mean fitness (μ), the additive genetic effect of the individual's own fitness (Ad_i), the sum of additive social effects from all other individuals (∑A_s_j), and a residual (e_i).
formula-notes:formula_22.47a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on associative effects and inclusive fitness to decompose fitness into direct and indirect genetic components, supporting the derivation of the change in mean fitness via Fisher's theorem.

formula-notes:formula_22.47a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将个体i的适合度Wi分解为总体均值μ、个体自身的直接加性效应Ad_i、所有其他个体j≠i对i的间接加性效应As_j之和，以及残差e_i。
formula-notes:formula_22.47a:zh.inThisChapter: 本章将性状视为个体适合度（z=W），利用此前结果（式22.1c）将适合度分解为直接和间接遗传效应，为后续推导适合度均值变化（如式22.47b、22.47c）提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_22.45b:zh.plainMeaning: 公式计算Fisher信息矩阵中第i行第j列的元素F_ij，其中P是投影矩阵，V_i和V_j分别是方差协方差矩阵对第i个和第j个方差分量的偏导数，迹运算将矩阵乘积缩为一个标量。
formula-notes:formula_22.45b:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在REML估计的章节中，用于构造未知方差分量θ_i的渐近方差-协方差矩阵，为后续计算标准误提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_22.47c:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the variance of total breeding value for fitness (A_T) as the sum of the variance of direct breeding value (A_d), the variance of social breeding value (A_s) weighted by (n-1)^2, and twice the covariance between them weighted by (n-1).
formula-notes:formula_22.47c:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on associative effects and inclusive fitness to quantify the genetic variance in fitness that arises from both direct and social effects, supporting the decomposition of selection into direct and indirect components in Fisher's theorem.

formula-notes:formula_22.47b:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the total breeding value for fitness of individual i (A_Ti) as the sum of its direct breeding value (A_di) and (n-1) times its social breeding value (A_si), where n is group size.
formula-notes:formula_22.47b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on associative effects and inclusive fitness to quantify how an individual's total genetic contribution to fitness includes both direct and indirect (social) effects, supporting the derivation of the variance components in equation (22.47c) and the connection to Fisher's theorem.

formula-notes:formula_22.47b:zh.plainMeaning: 公式(22.47b)将个体i的总育种值A_{T_i}定义为直接育种值A_{d_i}与(n-1)倍的社会育种值A_{s_i}之和，其中n是群体大小。
formula-notes:formula_22.47b:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在讨论关联效应和广义适合度的章节，用于量化个体对自身及其(n-1)个同伴适合度的遗传贡献，为后续推导总育种值方差(22.47c)和费希尔定理的扩展奠定基础。

formula-notes:formula_22.48a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将选择微分 S_W 定义为绝对适应度 W 与相对适应度 w 之间的协方差 σ(W,w)，并进一步简化为 W 的方差 σ²(W) 除以平均适应度 W̄，即 S_W = σ²(W)/W̄。
formula-notes:formula_22.48a:zh.inThisChapter: 在本节中，该公式通过 Robertson-Price 恒等式（式 6.10）将选择微分与适应度方差联系起来，为后续推导 Fisher 基本定理中适应度方差与平均适应度变化率的关系提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_22.47c:zh.plainMeaning: 公式 (22.47c) 计算总育种值 A_T 的方差，它等于直接育种值方差 σ²(A_d) 加上 (n-1) 倍直接与间接育种值协方差的两倍，再加上 (n-1)² 倍的间接育种值方差。
formula-notes:formula_22.47c:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式由个体总育种值表达式 (22.47b) 直接推导得出，为后续分析群体中总遗传方差如何影响适应度变化（如费希尔定理）提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_22.48a:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the selection differential for absolute fitness (S_W) as the covariance between absolute fitness W and relative fitness w, which simplifies to the variance of absolute fitness divided by mean fitness. Key symbols: S_W (selection differential for absolute fitness), σ(W,w) (covariance of absolute and relative fitness), σ²(W) (variance of absolute fitness), W̄ (mean absolute fitness).
formula-notes:formula_22.48a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on associative effects and inclusive fitness to connect the Robertson-Price identity to Fisher's fundamental theorem, showing that the selection differential for fitness equals the variance in fitness scaled by mean fitness, which is a key step in deriving the theorem's expression for the rate of change of mean fitness.

formula-notes:formula_22.46b:zh.plainMeaning: 公式(22.46b)定义了四个矩阵V1、V2、V3、V4，它们分别由直接遗传效应设计矩阵Zd、社会遗传效应设计矩阵Zs和分子亲缘关系矩阵A的乘积构成，用于分解(22.46a)中方差-协方差矩阵V的四个方差组分（直接遗传方差σ²(Ad)、直接-社会协方差σ(Ad,As)、社会遗传方差σ²(As)和残差方差σ²(e)）的系数。
formula-notes:formula_22.46b:zh.inThisChapter: 在BLUP估计直接和社会效应的章节中，公式(22.46b)将(22.45a)中的V分解为四个已知矩阵的线性组合，从而将方差组分估计问题转化为对这四个矩阵的运算，为后续通过REML等方法估计方差组分以及求解混合模型方程提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_22.48b:en.plainMeaning: This formula shows that when the trait is fitness itself, the standardized response (mean change in fitness divided by standard deviation of fitness) simplifies to the reciprocal of mean fitness, 1/\overline{W}. Key symbols: \bar{\imath}_{W} is the mean change in fitness, \sigma(W) is the standard deviation of fitness, S_W is the selection differential, \sigma^2(W) is the variance in fitness, and \overline{W} is mean fitness.
formula-notes:formula_22.48b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on associative effects and inclusive fitness to demonstrate a special case of Fisher's fundamental theorem, where the response to selection on fitness reduces to a simple function of mean fitness, supporting later derivations of the theorem's exact form.

formula-notes:formula_22.48b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将性状为适应度时的标准化响应（平均超量除以标准差）简化为平均适应度的倒数，其中关键符号：平均超量 \(\bar{\imath}_W = S_W/\sigma(W)\)，选择差 \(S_W = \sigma^2(W)/\overline{W}\)，适应度标准差 \(\sigma(W)\)，平均适应度 \(\overline{W}\)。
formula-notes:formula_22.48b:zh.inThisChapter: 本节从一般性状的响应公式（22.14）出发，当性状为适应度本身时，通过22.48a代入得到此简化结果，为后续推导适应度方差与平均适应度的关系（22.48c-e）提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_22.48d:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the total response to selection (R_W) as the sum of three variance components: direct genetic variance σ²(A_d), covariance between direct and social breeding values σ(A_d, A_s) weighted by (n-1)(1+r), and social genetic variance σ²(A_s) weighted by r(n-1)², all divided by mean fitness W̄.
formula-notes:formula_22.48d:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on associative effects and inclusive fitness to show how relatedness (r) and group size (n) affect the response to selection, supporting the argument that negative covariance between direct and social effects can reverse the response when r=0.

formula-notes:formula_22.48c:en.plainMeaning: This formula expresses the response to selection (R_W) as the covariance between fitness and total additive genetic value divided by mean fitness, which equals the average excess of fitness (ī_W) scaled by the covariance ratio, and also equals the covariance between relative fitness (w) and total additive genetic value (A_T). Key symbols: R_W (response), σ(W, A_T) (covariance of fitness and total additive genetic value), σ(W) (standard deviation of fitness), ī_W (average excess of fitness), W̄ (mean fitness), w (relative fitness).
formula-notes:formula_22.48c:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on associative effects and inclusive fitness to connect Fisher's fundamental theorem with the response equation, showing how the change in mean fitness can be partitioned into components due to direct and associative effects, supporting the derivation of inclusive fitness theory.

formula-notes:formula_22.48c:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将群体平均适应度的变化率 R_W 表示为三个等价形式：一是通过选择强度 σ(W, A_T) 与平均适应度 σ(W) 的比值乘以平均剩余适应度 ī_W，二是直接等于 σ(W, A_T) 除以平均适应度 W̄，三是等于相对适应度 w 与加性遗传值 A_T 的协方差 σ(w, A_T)。
formula-notes:formula_22.48c:zh.inThisChapter: 在“关联效应、包容性适应度与费希尔定理”章节中，公式 22.48c 将之前推导的响应公式（22.14）与关联效应表达式（22.48b）结合，为后续讨论费希尔基本定理在非随机交配下的推广（如公式 22.48d 和 22.48e）提供了直接的计算形式。

formula-notes:formula_22.49a:en.plainMeaning: This formula decomposes the total response in mean fitness (R_W) into the sum of the response from changes in the mean of direct effects (R_W,d) and (n-1) times the response from changes in the mean of social effects (R_W,s), where n is group size.
formula-notes:formula_22.49a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to associative effects to show how total evolutionary change in fitness can be partitioned into direct and social components, supporting later derivations of selection gradients and inclusive fitness.

formula-notes:formula_22.48e:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the total response to selection (R_W) as a weighted sum of the additive genetic variance in total breeding value (σ²(A_T)) and the variance among direct and social effects (σ²(A_d), σ(A_d, A_s)), with weights determined by relatedness r and group size n.
formula-notes:formula_22.48e:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to associative effects to show how relatedness (r) modulates the contribution of direct vs. social genetic effects to evolutionary change, supporting the argument that kin selection can be understood via group selection or relatedness in interacting groups.

formula-notes:formula_22.48e:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将总选择响应 R_W 分解为两部分：第一部分 r σ²(A_T) 表示亲缘关系 r 带来的间接遗传方差贡献，第二部分 (1-r)[σ²(A_d)+(n-1)σ(A_d,A_s)] 表示非亲缘个体间直接与间接遗传效应的方差和协方差贡献。
formula-notes:formula_22.48e:zh.inThisChapter: 此公式出现在讨论群体选择与亲缘选择效应的章节，通过引入亲缘系数 r 将 Hamilton 规则与 Price 方程联系起来，为后续推导亲缘选择下的响应表达式奠定基础。

formula-notes:formula_22.48d:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算群体平均适合度变化率 R_W，它等于平均适合度 W̄ 的倒数乘以三项方差-协方差之和：直接育种值方差 σ²(A_d)、直接与间接育种值协方差 σ(A_d, A_s) 乘以 (n-1)(1+r)、以及间接育种值方差 σ²(A_s) 乘以 r(n-1)²。
formula-notes:formula_22.48d:zh.inThisChapter: 在本节中，该公式将适合度对直接和间接遗传效应的响应分解为方差组分，为后续讨论 r=0 时响应方向可能反转（若直接与间接育种值负相关足够强）以及社会效应如何影响进化提供定量基础。

formula-notes:formula_22.49a:zh.plainMeaning: 公式22.49a将总适应度响应R_W分解为直接效应均值变化引起的响应R_W,d与(n-1)倍社会效应均值变化引起的响应R_W,s之和，其中n是群体大小。
formula-notes:formula_22.49a:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在介绍关联效应（竞争、社会互动、群体和亲缘选择）的章节，用于量化群体中个体间相互作用对适应度演化的贡献，为后续推导间接遗传效应和群体选择响应提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_22.49b:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the direct response to selection on the direct genetic effect (R_W,d) as the sum of the additive genetic variance of the direct effect (σ²(A_d)) and r(n-1) times the covariance between direct and indirect effects (σ(A_d, A_s)), divided by mean fitness (W̄).
formula-notes:formula_22.49b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to associative effects to decompose the total response into direct and indirect components, supporting the derivation of selection responses under social interactions and relatedness.

formula-notes:formula_22.49b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算直接遗传效应（A_d）对相对适合度（R_{W,d}）的贡献，分子是A_d的遗传方差σ²(A_d)加上由亲缘关系r加权的A_d与间接遗传效应A_s的协方差σ(A_d,A_s)乘以(n-1)，分母是平均适合度W̄。
formula-notes:formula_22.49b:zh.inThisChapter: 在关联效应章节中，此公式将直接遗传效应响应分量（来自式22.15a）具体化为可观测的遗传参数，为后续分析亲缘选择下性状进化提供量化基础。

formula-notes:formula_22.49c:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算社会伙伴对个体适应度的间接响应分量 R_{W,s}，分子是直接遗传方差 σ²(A_s) 乘以 r(n-1) 加上直接与间接遗传协方差 σ(A_d, A_s)，再除以平均适应度 W̄。
formula-notes:formula_22.49c:zh.inThisChapter: 在介绍关联效应（竞争、社会互动、群体与亲缘选择）的章节中，公式22.49c与22.49b共同将广义选择方程（22.15a-22.15c）分解为直接和间接响应分量，为后续分析亲缘系数r如何影响社会演化奠定基础。

formula-notes:formula_22.49c:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the response to selection due to social effects (R_{W,s}) as the sum of the covariance between direct and social breeding values and r(n-1) times the variance of social breeding values, divided by mean fitness. Key symbols: σ(A_d, A_s) = covariance between direct and social breeding values, σ²(A_s) = variance of social breeding values, r = relatedness, n = group size, W̄ = mean fitness.
formula-notes:formula_22.49c:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to associative effects to decompose total response into direct and social components, supporting the later derivation of Hamilton's rule and kin selection models by showing how relatedness and group size affect the social component.

formula-notes:formula_22.50b:en.plainMeaning: This inequality is a generalized Hamilton's rule, where σ(A_d, A_s) is the covariance between direct and social breeding values, r is relatedness, n is group size, and σ²(A_s) is the variance in social breeding values. It specifies the condition for altruism to be favored by selection.
formula-notes:formula_22.50b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to associative effects to show how Hamilton's rule can be extended to include group size effects, contrasting with Bijma's dilution model (Equation 22.10a) where the variance is diluted.

formula-notes:formula_22.50a:zh.plainMeaning: 该不等式表示利他行为在个体选择下得以进化的条件：利他者承担的个体成本c乘以-1（即-c）加上利他行为带来的群体收益b乘以亲缘关系系数r必须大于0，等价于亲缘关系系数r大于成本收益比b/c。
formula-notes:formula_22.50a:zh.inThisChapter: 本章从群体遗传学角度推导利他行为的进化条件，该公式由方程22.49c直接导出，将群体选择中的收益b和成本c与亲缘系数r联系起来，为后续讨论亲缘选择理论（如Hamilton法则）奠定基础。

formula-notes:formula_22.50c:en.plainMeaning: This inequality is Hamilton's rule under Bijma's dilution model, where σ(A_d, A_s) is the covariance between direct and social genetic effects, r is relatedness, n is group size, d is the dilution fraction, and σ²(A_{s,2}) is the variance in social effects. It specifies the condition for altruism to evolve.
formula-notes:formula_22.50c:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to associative effects to show how group size influences the benefit term in Hamilton's rule when social effects dilute with group size, supporting the later analysis of how dilution (d < 1/2) makes altruism more likely in larger groups.

formula-notes:formula_22.50b:zh.plainMeaning: 该不等式判断社会行为是否被选择：左边第一项σ(A_d, A_s)是直接适应度效应（个体自身行为对其适应度的协方差），第二项r(n-1)σ²(A_s)是间接效应（通过亲缘关系r和群体大小n放大的社会行为方差），总和大于0时行为受正向选择。
formula-notes:formula_22.50b:zh.inThisChapter: 本节从个体选择与群体选择的对比引入，公式22.50b是Hamilton法则的推广形式，明确展示了利他行为在群体中的选择条件依赖于群体大小n，为后续与Bijma稀释模型（公式22.10a）的对比提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_22.50d:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算个体社会行为基因型值A_s与群体总适合度之和∑W_j之间的协方差，并简化为(-c+b)[1+(n-1)r]，其中c是成本、b是收益、n是群体大小、r是亲缘关系。
formula-notes:formula_22.50d:zh.inThisChapter: 本节推导群体选择下社会行为的响应，该协方差是选择差方程22.27c中的关键项，后续用于说明利他行为在b>c时即可进化，且亲缘关系r>0会增强进化条件。

formula-notes:formula_22.50d:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the covariance between an individual's social trait value (A_s) and the total fitness of its group (sum of W_j), which simplifies to (-c+b)[1+(n-1)r] under the assumptions that σ(A_d, A_s) = -c and σ²(A_s) = b. Key symbols: A_s = social trait, A_d = direct fitness effect, n = group size, r = relatedness, c = cost, b = benefit.
formula-notes:formula_22.50d:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on associative effects to quantify how group selection acts on social traits, showing that the covariance depends on relatedness (r) and the net benefit (b-c). This result supports the argument that altruism can evolve when b > c, and relatedness amplifies the response to group selection.

formula-notes:formula_22.51a:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the breeding value for inclusive fitness of individual i, A_incf,i, as the sum of its direct breeding value A_d_i and its social breeding value A_s_i multiplied by the sum of relatedness coefficients r_ij to all other group members, which under equal relatedness simplifies to r(n-1)A_s_i.
formula-notes:formula_22.51a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on associative effects and inclusive fitness to define the heritable component of inclusive fitness, which is then used in subsequent equations (22.51b and 22.51c) to derive the change in mean inclusive fitness and the response to selection.

formula-notes:formula_22.50c:zh.plainMeaning: 该不等式是汉密尔顿规则在Bijma稀释模型下的形式，左边第一项σ(A_d, A_s)是直接遗传效应与社会遗传效应的协方差（代表亲缘选择中的间接收益），第二项r(n-1)^{1-2d}σ^2(A_{s,2})是亲缘系数r乘以经组大小n和稀释参数d调整后的社会效应方差（代表社会互动的净收益），不等式大于0表示利他行为被选择。
formula-notes:formula_22.50c:zh.inThisChapter: 本节引入竞争、社会互动、群体选择和亲缘选择，该公式将汉密尔顿规则推广到社会效应随组大小稀释的情形，为后续讨论稀释参数d如何影响利他行为的进化条件（如d<1/2时收益随组大小增加）提供定量判据。

formula-notes:formula_22.51a:zh.plainMeaning: 公式 (22.51a) 将个体 i 的广义适合度育种值 A_{incf,i} 分解为直接育种值 A_{d_i} 与间接育种值 A_{s_i} 乘以所有其他个体与 i 的亲缘系数之和（在等亲缘假设下简化为 r(n-1)）之和。
formula-notes:formula_22.51a:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在“关联效应、广义适合度与费希尔定理”一节中，用于定义广义适合度的可遗传成分（育种值），为后续推导广义适合度对自然选择响应的表达式（如公式 22.51b 和 22.51c）奠定基础。

formula-notes:formula_22.51b:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the variance in breeding value for inclusive fitness (A_incf) as the sum of the variance in direct breeding value (A_d), twice the relatedness-weighted covariance between direct and social breeding values, and the squared relatedness-scaled variance in social breeding value (A_s).
formula-notes:formula_22.51b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on associative effects and inclusive fitness to decompose the genetic variance underlying inclusive fitness, supporting later arguments about how relatedness and social interactions affect evolutionary change via Fisher's theorem.

formula-notes:formula_22.51c:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the total breeding value for fitness (A_T_i) as the sum of the inclusive fitness breeding value (A_incf,i) and a term involving the social effect breeding value (A_s_i) scaled by (1-r)(n-1), where r is relatedness and n is group size.
formula-notes:formula_22.51c:en.inThisChapter: It appears in this section to show that the heritable component of inclusive fitness differs from the total breeding value for fitness, supporting the argument that inclusive fitness is not equivalent to total fitness in the context of Fisher's theorem.

formula-notes:formula_22.51b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算包容适合度育种值A_{incf}的方差σ²(A_{incf})，它等于直接育种值A_d的方差σ²(A_d)加上2r(n-1)倍的A_d与间接育种值A_s的协方差σ(A_d,A_s)，再加上r²(n-1)²倍的A_s的方差σ²(A_s)。
formula-notes:formula_22.51b:zh.inThisChapter: 本节通过将包容适合度育种值分解为直接和间接组分，推导其方差结构，为后续分析群体遗传方差变化及费希尔定理在包容适合度下的推广提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_22.52b:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the response in mean inclusive fitness (R_{W,incf}) as the covariance between fitness (W) and inclusive fitness (A_{incf}), scaled by mean fitness (overline{W}).
formula-notes:formula_22.52b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in this section to quantify how inclusive fitness changes in response to selection, supporting the derivation of the associative-effects version of Fisher's theorem.

formula-notes:formula_22.52a:en.plainMeaning: This formula decomposes the total change in mean individual fitness (R_W) into the change in mean inclusive fitness (R_W,incf) plus a residual term (1-r)(n-1)R_W,s, where r is relatedness, n is group size, and R_W,s is the change in mean social value.
formula-notes:formula_22.52a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on associative effects to show that the total response in fitness equals the change in inclusive fitness plus a residual, supporting the argument that inclusive fitness captures the component of selection explained by genetic relatedness among group members.

formula-notes:formula_22.51c:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将个体i的总育种值A_{T_i}分解为包容适合度育种值A_{incf,i}与一个修正项之和，修正项为(1-r)(n-1)A_{s_i}，其中r是亲缘系数，n是群体大小，A_{s_i}是社会环境育种值。
formula-notes:formula_22.51c:zh.inThisChapter: 本节比较包容适合度的可遗传成分与总育种值，公式(22.51c)通过对比公式(22.51a)和(22.3)得出，说明总育种值不等于包容适合度育种值，为后续讨论Fisher基本定理在包容适合度下的适用性做铺垫。

formula-notes:formula_22.52c:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the covariance between individual fitness (W) and inclusive fitness (A_incf), expanding it into components involving additive genetic variance for direct fitness (σ²(A_d)), covariance between direct and social genetic effects (σ(A_d, A_s)), and variance for social genetic effects (σ²(A_s)), weighted by relatedness r and group size n.
formula-notes:formula_22.52c:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on associative effects and inclusive fitness to derive the response in mean inclusive fitness (Equation 22.52b) and ultimately to connect to Fisher's theorem via the covariance formulation.

formula-notes:formula_22.52a:zh.plainMeaning: 公式将总适应度响应 R_W 分解为包容适应度响应 R_{W,incf} 加上一个残差项 (1-r)(n-1)R_{W,s}，其中 r 是群体内个体间的平均亲缘关系，n 是群体大小，R_{W,s} 是社会平均值的响应。
formula-notes:formula_22.52a:zh.inThisChapter: 在关联效应章节中，该公式用于展示总适应度变化如何被包容适应度变化和剩余社会效应所解释，为后续讨论费希尔定理在关联效应下的推广提供分解基础。

formula-notes:formula_22.52b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算平均广义适合度对时间的响应，即响应变量 R_{W,incf} 等于协方差 σ(W, A_{incf}) 除以平均适合度 W̄，其中 W 是个体适合度，A_{incf} 是广义适合度加性遗传成分。
formula-notes:formula_22.52b:zh.inThisChapter: 在讨论关联效应和广义适合度的章节中，该公式将费舍尔基本定理推广到包含广义适合度的情况，为后续推导广义适合度下的响应分解（如公式 22.52c-22.52f）提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_22.52d:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the response in mean inclusive fitness (R_W,incf) as the additive genetic variance in inclusive fitness (σ²(A_incf)) divided by mean fitness (W̄), showing that the change in mean inclusive fitness is proportional to its additive variance.
formula-notes:formula_22.52d:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on associative effects and inclusive fitness to demonstrate that, under the simple model, mean inclusive fitness is nondecreasing, analogous to Fisher's fundamental theorem of natural selection applied to inclusive fitness.

formula-notes:formula_22.52d:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算了平均广义适合度（inclusive fitness）的响应 R_W,incf，它等于广义适合度的加性方差 σ²(A_incf) 除以平均适合度 W̄。
formula-notes:formula_22.52d:zh.inThisChapter: 在本节中，该公式表明在简单模型下，平均广义适合度的变化率正比于其加性方差，从而推出平均广义适合度非减，为后续讨论费希尔定理在广义适合度下的推广提供关键桥梁。

formula-notes:formula_22.52c:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将个体适应度W与包含遗传效应A_incf的协方差σ(W, A_incf)展开为三个方差-协方差项之和：加性直接效应方差σ²(A_d)、加性直接与加性社会效应协方差σ(A_d, A_s)乘以2r(n-1)、以及加性社会效应方差σ²(A_s)乘以r²(n-1)²，其中r是亲缘系数，n是群体大小。
formula-notes:formula_22.52c:zh.inThisChapter: 在“关联效应、包容适合度与费希尔定理”这一节中，公式22.52c通过将协方差分解为可遗传组分的方差和协方差，为后续推导平均包容适合度的响应R_W,incf（公式22.52b）提供了具体的代数表达式，从而将自然选择对包容适合度的作用与遗传参数的统计关系联系起来。

formula-notes:formula_22.52e:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the difference between the total change in mean fitness (R_W) and the change due to inclusive fitness (R_W,incf), expressed as a function of relatedness r, group size n, mean fitness W̄, and covariances involving direct (A_d) and social (A_s) additive genetic components.
formula-notes:formula_22.52e:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on associative effects and inclusive fitness to quantify how the decline in mean fitness (despite increasing inclusive fitness) arises from a decline in residual social value, supporting the argument that Fisher's theorem applies to inclusive fitness rather than total fitness.

formula-notes:formula_22.52f:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the difference between the total response to selection (R_W) and the inclusive fitness response (R_W,incf) when relatedness r=0, showing it equals (n-1) times the covariance between direct genetic effects (A_d) and associative effects (A_s), divided by mean fitness (W̄).
formula-notes:formula_22.52f:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on associative effects and inclusive fitness to isolate the effect of covariance between direct and associative effects when relatedness is zero, supporting the argument that the sign of this covariance determines whether total response exceeds or falls short of inclusive fitness prediction.

formula-notes:formula_22.52e:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算个体适应度变化率 R_W 与包含性适应度变化率 R_W,incf 之差，等于 (1-r)(n-1)/W̄ 乘以 σ(A_d, A_s) 与 r(n-1)σ²(A_s) 之和，其中 r 是亲缘系数，n 是群体大小，W̄ 是平均适应度，σ(A_d, A_s) 是直接遗传效益 A_d 与社会遗传效益 A_s 的协方差，σ²(A_s) 是 A_s 的方差。
formula-notes:formula_22.52e:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在讨论个体适应度持续下降而平均包含性适应度却上升的矛盾时，通过将 R_W 与 R_W,incf 的差异分解为亲缘选择和群体结构效应，为后续解释社会价值下降导致适应度变化率差异提供定量依据。

formula-notes:formula_22.52f:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算当群体内个体间亲缘关系 r=0 时，总响应 R_W 与包含性适应度响应 R_W,incf 之差，等于 (n-1) 乘以直接效应 A_d 与联合效应 A_s 的协方差 σ(A_d, A_s) 除以平均适应度 W̄。
formula-notes:formula_22.52f:zh.inThisChapter: 在讨论联合效应与包含性适应度及费希尔定理的章节中，此公式用于展示当 r=0 时，总响应与包含性适应度响应的偏差完全由直接效应与联合效应的协方差决定，为后续分析亲缘关系 r 如何通过公式 22.52e 减小该残差响应提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_22.53a:en.plainMeaning: This formula expresses an individual's fitness (W_i) as the sum of its breeding value (BV_i) and a residual (e), where the breeding value is decomposed into a direct genetic effect (β_{i,d} A_{d_i}) and a social genetic effect (β_{i,s} A_{s_i}).
formula-notes:formula_22.53a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on associative effects and inclusive fitness to formally define how fitness depends on both direct and social breeding values, setting up the derivation of the total breeding value and the partitioning of selection response in subsequent equations (22.53b, 22.53c).

formula-notes:formula_22.53b:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the breeding value for individual fitness (BV_i) as the sum of a direct genetic effect (A_{d_i}) and an indirect genetic effect (A_{s_i}) weighted by the sum of relatedness coefficients (r_{ij}) with all other individuals j.
formula-notes:formula_22.53b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on associative effects and inclusive fitness to express how an individual's total genetic contribution to fitness includes both its own direct effect and the indirect effects on relatives, supporting the derivation of inclusive fitness and Fisher's theorem.

formula-notes:formula_22.53b:zh.plainMeaning: 公式(22.53b)计算个体i的育种值BV_i，它等于直接遗传效应A_{d_i}加上间接遗传效应A_{s_i}乘以所有其他个体j与i的遗传相关r_{ij}之和。
formula-notes:formula_22.53b:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在“关联效应、广义适合度与费希尔定理”一节，从公式(22.53a)推导而来，为后续简化到等亲缘关系情形（公式22.53c）提供中间步骤。

formula-notes:formula_22.53c:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the breeding value for indirect genetic effects (BV_i) as the sum of the direct breeding value (A_{d_i}) and the indirect breeding value (A_{s_i}) multiplied by the relatedness coefficient r and the number of group members excluding the focal individual (n-1).
formula-notes:formula_22.53c:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on associative effects and inclusive fitness to simplify the general expression (22.53b) under the assumption of equal relatedness among all group members, supporting the derivation of inclusive fitness effects and Fisher's theorem.

formula-notes:formula_22.53c:zh.plainMeaning: 公式(22.53c)计算个体i的育种值BV_i，它等于直接遗传效应育种值A_{d_i}加上r(n-1)倍的间接遗传效应育种值A_{s_i}，其中r是亲属间亲缘系数，n是群体大小。
formula-notes:formula_22.53c:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式是(22.53b)在亲属间亲缘系数相等时的特例，用于简化关联效应模型下的育种值表达，为后续讨论包容性适应度和费希尔定理提供可操作的形式。

formula-notes:formula_22.53a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将个体i的适应度Wi分解为育种值BVi（由直接遗传效应βi,d Ad_i和社会遗传效应βi,s As_i线性组合）加上残差e，其中Ad_i和As_i分别是个体i的直接和社会育种值，βi,d和βi,s是对应的回归系数。
formula-notes:formula_22.53a:zh.inThisChapter: 在本章关于关联效应和广义适合度的上下文中，该公式将个体适应度表达为直接和社会育种值的线性函数，为后续推导社会选择梯度（如公式22.53b）和广义适合度（如公式22.53c）提供了基础回归模型。

formula-notes:formula_22.55a:en.plainMeaning: This formula expresses the relative fitness w_i of a focal individual i as the sum of a baseline fitness w_0, a direct effect w_{d,i} from its own phenotype, and an indirect effect w_{s,j} from its neighbor j's phenotype.
formula-notes:formula_22.55a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the Hamilton's Rule section to decompose fitness into direct and indirect components, which is then used in Equation 22.55b to derive the condition for altruism via relatedness.

formula-notes:formula_22.54:en.plainMeaning: This formula decomposes the total change in a quantity G (e.g., a trait or gene frequency) into two components: the covariance between G and relative fitness w (selection effect) and the expected product of w and transmission bias δ_G (inheritance effect).
formula-notes:formula_22.54:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the derivation of Hamilton's rule to show how the Price equation can be used to separate selection from transmission bias, providing a general framework for analyzing social evolution.

formula-notes:formula_22.54:zh.plainMeaning: 公式 (22.54) 将群体中任意数量 G 的响应 ΔG 分解为两项之和：第一项 σ(G,w) 是 G 与相对适应度 w 的协方差，代表自然选择导致的直接变化；第二项 E[wδ_G] 是 w 加权的平均传递偏差，代表从亲代到子代过程中 G 值的系统性偏移。
formula-notes:formula_22.54:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在 Hamilton 法则的推导中，作为 Price 方程的一般形式，为后续将 G 具体化为“利他行为倾向”并代入 Hamilton 法则的协方差形式提供基础框架。

formula-notes:formula_22.55b:en.plainMeaning: This linear regression models individual i's fitness (w_i) as a function of its own phenotype (z_i) and its neighbor j's phenotype (z_j), with coefficients β_{w_d|z} (direct effect) and β_{w_s|z} (social effect), plus intercept a and residual e_i.
formula-notes:formula_22.55b:en.inThisChapter: It quantifies the direct and indirect fitness effects needed to derive Hamilton's rule (c - b r > 0) in the context of kin selection, supporting the argument that relatedness modulates social behavior evolution.

formula-notes:formula_22.55b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将个体i的适应度wi回归到其自身表型zi（直接效应β_{w_d|z}）和邻居j的表型zj（社会效应β_{w_s|z}）上，加上截距a和残差ei。
formula-notes:formula_22.55b:zh.inThisChapter: 在汉密尔顿法则章节中，该公式将适应度分解为直接和间接遗传效应，为后续推导包含亲缘系数的广义适应度回归方程（如22.55c）提供线性模型基础。

formula-notes:formula_22.55c:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the change in mean breeding value (ΔμA) as the covariance between fitness (wi) and breeding value (Ai), decomposed into additive genetic variances/covariances of direct and indirect genetic effects plus a residual term.
formula-notes:formula_22.55c:en.inThisChapter: It appears in Hamilton's Rule section to derive the condition for altruism evolution by linking Price's theorem to kin selection, supporting the argument that relatedness modulates selection on social traits.

formula-notes:formula_22.56b:en.plainMeaning: This inequality specifies the condition for the mean value of a social trait to increase: the direct fitness cost (β_{w_d|z}) plus the indirect fitness benefit (β_{w_s|z}) weighted by the relatedness coefficient (σ(z_j, A_i)/σ(z_i, A_i)) must be positive.
formula-notes:formula_22.56b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the Hamilton's Rule section to formalize the condition for altruistic trait evolution, supporting the argument that inclusive fitness effects determine trait change when fitness residuals are uncorrelated with the genetic value A_i.

formula-notes:formula_22.55c:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将育种值对适应度的协方差ΔμA（即性状响应）分解为直接遗传效应β_{w_d|z}乘以个体自身育种值与表型的协方差σ(z_i, A_i)、间接遗传效应β_{w_s|z}乘以伙伴育种值与个体表型的协方差σ(z_j, A_i)，以及残差协方差σ(e_i, A_i)之和。
formula-notes:formula_22.55c:zh.inThisChapter: 在Hamilton规则章节中，此公式通过Price方程将性状响应拆解为直接和间接遗传组分，为后续推导亲缘选择系数（如Hamilton规则中的r）奠定协方差分解基础。

formula-notes:formula_22.55a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将焦点个体 i 的相对适应度 w_i 分解为三个部分：基础适应度 w_0、个体 i 自身行为对其适应度的直接效应 w_{d,i}，以及邻居 j 的行为对 i 适应度的间接效应 w_{s,j}。
formula-notes:formula_22.55a:zh.inThisChapter: 在汉密尔顿法则的章节中，该公式作为直接适应度模型的起点，将适应度分解为直接和间接成分，为后续推导包含亲缘关系系数的汉密尔顿法则（如公式 22.55b 和 22.55c）提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_22.56a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算了平均育种值Δμ_A的变化，它等于直接选择梯度β_{w_d|z}乘以表型z_i与育种值A_i的协方差σ(z_i, A_i)，加上间接选择梯度β_{w_s|z}乘以社会伙伴表型z_j与焦点个体育种值A_i的协方差σ(z_j, A_i)。
formula-notes:formula_22.56a:zh.inThisChapter: 在Hamilton规则章节中，此公式将选择梯度与遗传协方差联系起来，为后续推导Hamilton规则（如公式22.56b）中亲缘关系系数r与成本-收益比的关系提供关键代数形式。

formula-notes:formula_22.56b:zh.plainMeaning: 该不等式表示，当直接效应β_{w_d|z}（成本c）加上间接效应β_{w_s|z}（收益b）乘以个体i与j的遗传协方差之比（广义亲缘关系）大于0时，性状均值增加。
formula-notes:formula_22.56b:zh.inThisChapter: 本章推导汉密尔顿法则，该式由方程22.56a除以σ(z_i,A_i)得到，将成本、收益和亲缘关系组合成选择条件，为后续说明亲缘选择如何促进利他行为提供定量判据。

formula-notes:formula_22.57a:en.plainMeaning: This formula expresses an individual's fitness (w_i) as a linear function of the actor's breeding value (A_i) and the recipient's breeding value (A_j), with partial regression coefficients β_{w_d|A} (direct effect) and β_{w_s|A} (indirect effect), plus an intercept a and residual e_i.
formula-notes:formula_22.57a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the derivation of Hamilton's rule to decompose fitness into direct and indirect genetic components, enabling the use of Price's equation to derive the condition for altruism (Δμ_A > 0) in terms of relatedness and cost-benefit ratios.

formula-notes:formula_22.56a:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the change in mean breeding value (Δμ_A) as the sum of two covariance terms: the direct effect of an individual's own breeding value (A_i) on its fitness, weighted by β_{w_d|z}, and the indirect effect of a social partner's breeding value (A_j) on the focal individual's fitness, weighted by β_{w_s|z}.
formula-notes:formula_22.56a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the Hamilton's Rule section to decompose the total evolutionary response into direct and indirect genetic components, supporting the derivation of Hamilton's rule by linking kin selection to genetic covariance.

formula-notes:formula_22.57a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将个体i的适应度w_i表示为截距a、自身育种值A_i的偏回归系数β_{w_d|A}、对方育种值A_j的偏回归系数β_{w_s|A}以及残差e_i的线性组合，其中β_{w_d|A}衡量直接遗传效应，β_{w_s|A}衡量间接（社会）遗传效应。
formula-notes:formula_22.57a:zh.inThisChapter: 本章推导Hamilton规则时，需要将适应度分解为直接和间接遗传效应的线性函数，以便利用Price方程计算育种值均值变化Δμ_A；此回归形式确保残差与预测变量不相关，为后续简化协方差项（如σ(e_i, A_i)=0）提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_22.57b:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the change in mean breeding value (Δμ_A) as the covariance between fitness (w_i) and breeding value (A_i), which equals the sum of the direct effect (β_{w_d|A}) times the variance of A_i and the indirect effect (β_{w_s|A}) times the covariance between A_j and A_i.
formula-notes:formula_22.57b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the derivation of Hamilton's rule to show how Price's equation decomposes selection into direct and indirect genetic components, supporting the condition for altruism to evolve.

formula-notes:formula_22.57b:zh.plainMeaning: 公式(22.57b)将个体适合度w_i与育种值A_i的协方差Δμ_A分解为直接遗传效应β_{w_d|A}乘以A_i的方差σ(A_i,A_i)加上社会遗传效应β_{w_s|A}乘以A_j与A_i的协方差σ(A_j,A_i)。
formula-notes:formula_22.57b:zh.inThisChapter: 在Hamilton法则章节中，该公式通过Price方程将适合度变化分解为直接和间接遗传效应，为后续推导Hamilton法则（rb>c）中亲缘关系系数r=σ(A_j,A_i)/σ(A_i,A_i)提供关键协方差表达式。

formula-notes:formula_22.58a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式表示，当直接适应度效应β_{w_d|A}加上间接适应度效应β_{w_s|A}乘以遗传协方差与方差之比σ(A_j,A_i)/σ(A_i,A_i)大于0时，自然选择会促进该社会行为。
formula-notes:formula_22.58a:zh.inThisChapter: 在Hamilton法则章节中，该公式是Queller对Hamilton法则的推广，通过引入遗传协方差与方差之比来量化亲缘关系，为后续讨论广义亲缘选择系数（公式22.58b）提供了基础。

formula-notes:formula_22.58b:en.plainMeaning: This inequality states that the sum of the direct cost (β_{w_d|A}) and the product of the benefit (β_{w_s|A}) and relatedness (β_{A_j|A_i}) must be positive for altruism to evolve.
formula-notes:formula_22.58b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in Hamilton's Rule section as a regression-based reformulation of the classic rule, supporting the argument that relatedness can be measured as a regression coefficient.

formula-notes:formula_22.58b:zh.plainMeaning: 该不等式表示直接选择梯度（成本β_{w_d|A}）加上间接选择梯度（收益β_{w_s|A}）乘以广义亲缘系数β_{A_j|A_i}必须大于零，即Hamilton规则成立的条件。
formula-notes:formula_22.58b:zh.inThisChapter: 在本节Hamilton规则中，该公式将Queller的精确结果简化为回归系数形式，为后续讨论亲缘选择如何促进利他行为提供了可检验的统计条件。

formula-notes:formula_22.58a:en.plainMeaning: This inequality expresses Queller's generalization of Hamilton's rule, where β_{w_d|A} is the direct fitness effect of an individual's own allele, β_{w_s|A} is the indirect fitness effect of a social partner's allele, and σ(A_j, A_i)/σ(A_i, A_i) is the regression coefficient of the partner's allele on the individual's allele (relatedness).
formula-notes:formula_22.58a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on Hamilton's rule to provide a regression-based formulation that accounts for non-additive genetic effects, supporting later arguments about the conditions for altruism to evolve under general genetic architectures.

formula-notes:formula_22.59a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将个体i的适合度w_i表示为自身表型值z_i的直接效应β_{w_d|z}与群体中其他n-1个个体表型值之和的间接（社会）效应β_{w_s|z}的线性回归，加上截距a和残差ε_i。
formula-notes:formula_22.59a:zh.inThisChapter: 在群体选择与亲缘选择章节中，此公式将适合度分解为直接效应和社会效应，为后续推导广义Hamilton规则（公式22.59b-c）提供回归基础，从而量化亲缘关系对间接效应的调节作用。

formula-notes:formula_22.60a:en.plainMeaning: This formula defines the ratio g of the partial regression of social fitness component on group phenotype (β_{w_s|z}) to the partial regression of direct fitness component on individual phenotype (β_{w_d|z}), quantifying the relative strength of group versus individual selection.
formula-notes:formula_22.60a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in this section to connect multilevel selection theory with kin selection models, and it supports the derivation of Hamilton's rule by showing that relatedness can be expressed as this ratio under certain conditions.

formula-notes:formula_22.60a:zh.plainMeaning: 公式 g = β_{w_s|z} / β_{w_d|z} 计算的是群体选择梯度 β_{w_s|z} 与个体选择梯度 β_{w_d|z} 的比值，其中 w_s 是群体适应度，w_d 是个体适应度，z 是性状值。
formula-notes:formula_22.60a:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在群体选择与亲缘选择关联的推导中，用于定义多水平选择连接的关键参数 g，为后续公式 22.60b 中展示群体选择与亲缘选择模型的等价性提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_22.59a:en.plainMeaning: This formula expresses an individual's fitness as a linear regression on its own phenotype (direct effect) and the sum of phenotypes of all other group members (indirect social effect), plus an intercept and residual. Key symbols: w_i (fitness of individual i), z_i (phenotype of i), Σ_{j≠i} z_j (sum of phenotypes of other group members), β_{w_d|z} (direct effect), β_{w_s|z} (indirect effect).
formula-notes:formula_22.59a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on group and kin selection to model how fitness depends on both the individual's own trait and the social environment, extending Equation 22.55b. This regression forms the basis for deriving the total evolutionary change (Equation 22.59b) and the condition for altruism (Equation 22.59c).

formula-notes:formula_22.59b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算选择响应R（即性状均值Δμ_A），它等于直接选择梯度β_{w_d|z}乘以个体自身表型z_i与其育种值A_i的协方差σ(z_i, A_i)，加上间接选择梯度β_{w_s|z}乘以所有其他个体j≠i的表型z_j与个体i育种值A_i的协方差之和。
formula-notes:formula_22.59b:zh.inThisChapter: 在本节中，该公式将群体选择响应分解为直接效应和间接（社会）效应，为后续推导Hamilton规则（成本-收益形式）提供定量基础，其中β_{w_d|z}对应成本c，β_{w_s|z}对应收益b。

formula-notes:formula_22.59c:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the response to selection (R) as the change in mean additive genetic value (ΔμA), equal to the additive genetic variance (σA²) multiplied by the sum of the direct fitness effect (βwd|z) and the indirect effect from n-1 group mates (r(n-1)βws|z).
formula-notes:formula_22.59c:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on group and kin selection to show how relatedness (r) and group size (n) amplify the contribution of indirect genetic effects to evolutionary change, supporting the argument that kin selection can be expressed as a form of group selection.

formula-notes:formula_22.59b:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the selection response R (change in mean breeding value Δμ_A) as the sum of a direct effect (β_{w_d|z} times the covariance between individual i's phenotype and breeding value) and an indirect effect (β_{w_s|z} times the sum over other individuals j of the covariance between j's phenotype and i's breeding value). Key symbols: β_{w_d|z} = cost (c), β_{w_s|z} = benefit (b), σ(z_i, A_i) = covariance of own phenotype and breeding value, σ(z_j, A_i) = covariance of others' phenotype and own breeding value.
formula-notes:formula_22.59b:en.inThisChapter: This formula appears in the section on group selection, kin selection, and associative effects to quantify the total response to selection when interactions among individuals occur. It supports the argument that selection can act on both direct and indirect genetic effects, leading to Hamilton's rule (c < b * relatedness) for the evolution of altruism.

formula-notes:formula_22.60b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将个体i的适应度wi表示为截距a加上对群体平均表型z的回归系数β_{w_d|z}乘以个体i的包含指数I_i（即自身表型z_i加上g倍的其他个体表型之和），再加上残差ε_i。
formula-notes:formula_22.60b:zh.inThisChapter: 在本节中，该公式通过引入包含指数I_i将群体选择（g=1）和个体选择（g=0）统一在一个框架下，为后续推导选择梯度或协方差公式提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_22.59c:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算响应变量R（即群体平均适应度的变化ΔμA）等于加性遗传方差σA²乘以两项之和：第一项β_{w_d|z}是直接社会效应（个体自身表型对自身适应度的偏回归系数），第二项r(n-1)β_{w_s|z}是间接社会效应（群体中其他n-1个个体对焦点个体适应度的影响）乘以亲缘关系r。
formula-notes:formula_22.59c:zh.inThisChapter: 在群体选择与亲缘选择章节中，该公式将广义的Price方程（22.59b）简化为所有配对亲缘关系相等（r_{ij}=r）的情形，为后续讨论亲缘系数如何放大间接遗传效应、驱动群体间分化提供直接代数形式。

formula-notes:formula_22.60b:en.plainMeaning: This formula expresses an individual's fitness w_i as a linear function of an index I_i, which combines the individual's own phenotype z_i and the sum of others' phenotypes weighted by a coefficient g. The key symbols are w_i (fitness), a (intercept), β_{w_d|z} (partial regression coefficient of fitness on direct genetic effect given phenotype), z_i (individual's phenotype), g (relatedness or group selection coefficient), and ε_i (residual).
formula-notes:formula_22.60b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in this section to formalize how fitness depends on both individual and group traits, linking to the index I_i from Equation 22.28a. This supports the argument that individual selection (g=0) and group selection (g=1) are special cases, and that kin selection can be captured by intermediate g values.

formula-notes:formula_22.61a:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the change in mean breeding value for trait A (ΔμA) as the product of the selection gradient β_{w_d|z}, the additive genetic variance σ_A^2, and a factor (1+(n-1)gr) that accounts for kin selection via relatedness r, group size n, and the expected response g from Equation 22.59c.
formula-notes:formula_22.61a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in this section to express the expected response under kin selection in terms of g, linking group selection and kin selection frameworks, and supports later arguments about the conditions under which altruism evolves.

formula-notes:formula_22.61b:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the response to selection (Δμ_A) as the product of heritability (h²) and the selection differential (S), using the Robertson-Price identity where σ(w_d, z_i) = S. Key symbols: Δμ_A (response), β_{w_d|z} (regression of fitness on trait), σ_A² (additive genetic variance), σ(w_d, z_i) (covariance of fitness and trait), σ_z² (phenotypic variance), S (selection differential), h² (heritability).
formula-notes:formula_22.61b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in this section to show that when either relatedness (r) or levels-of-selection (g) is zero, the general group selection response (Equation 22.61a) reduces to the standard breeder's equation, highlighting that both factors are necessary for a different response.

formula-notes:formula_22.61b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将群体平均性状值的响应Δμ_A表示为选择差S与遗传力h²的乘积，即经典育种者方程的形式。其中β_{w_d|z}是适合度对性状的回归系数，σ_A²是加性遗传方差，σ_z²是表型方差，h²=σ_A²/σ_z²是遗传力。
formula-notes:formula_22.61b:zh.inThisChapter: 在22.61a的基础上，通过设定亲缘关系r=0或选择层次g=0，公式简化为标准育种者方程，从而凸显了Bijma和Wade的核心论点：只有当亲缘关系和选择层次同时非零时，响应才会偏离经典形式。

formula-notes:formula_22.62a:en.plainMeaning: This formula expresses individual fitness w_i as a linear regression on the group mean phenotype z̄ and the within-group deviation Δz_i, with intercept a, partial regression coefficients β_w|z̄ and β_w|Δz, and residual e_i.
formula-notes:formula_22.62a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on group and kin selection to decompose fitness into components due to group mean and individual deviation, supporting the derivation of the Price equation and selection gradients in equations 22.62b–f.

formula-notes:formula_22.62b:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the response to selection (R) as the sum of two covariances: one between group mean phenotype (z̄) and individual breeding value (A_i), weighted by the partial regression of fitness on group mean (β_{w|z̄}), and one between individual deviation from group mean (Δz_i) and A_i, weighted by the partial regression of fitness on individual deviation (β_{w|Δz}).
formula-notes:formula_22.62b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in this section to decompose the total response to selection into between-group and within-group components, supporting the argument that group selection can be quantified via the covariance of group mean with breeding value, while kin selection operates through the covariance of individual deviation with breeding value.

formula-notes:formula_22.62a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将个体i的适应度w_i分解为截距a、群体均值z̄的线性效应β_{w|z̄}、个体偏离群体均值的偏差Δz_i的线性效应β_{w|Δz}以及残差e_i。
formula-notes:formula_22.62a:zh.inThisChapter: 本节通过该回归模型将群体选择和亲缘选择统一到同一框架中，为后续推导群体均值z̄的进化变化（如公式22.62b-22.62f）提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_22.61a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算群体选择下性状均值的变化 Δμ_A，它等于对群体内个体适合度 w_d 关于个体表型 z 的回归系数 β_{w_d|z} 乘以加性遗传方差 σ_A^2，再乘以因子 (1+(n-1)g r)，其中 n 是群体大小，g 是群体内遗传相关系数，r 是亲缘系数。
formula-notes:formula_22.61a:zh.inThisChapter: 在“群体选择、亲缘选择与关联效应”章节中，该公式将亲缘选择下的期望响应（公式 22.59c）用群体内遗传相关系数 g 和亲缘系数 r 表达，为后续推导群体选择与亲缘选择的等价性（如公式 22.61b）提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_22.62c:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the covariance between the group mean phenotype (z̄) and the additive genetic value (Ai) of individual i, showing it equals the among-group genetic variance (r_n σ_A^2). Key symbols: z̄ = group mean phenotype, Ai = additive genetic value of individual i, n = group size, r_n = relatedness coefficient within groups, σ_A^2 = additive genetic variance.
formula-notes:formula_22.62c:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to associative effects to decompose the total covariance into within- and among-group components, supporting the derivation of Hamilton's rule and the role of relatedness in social evolution.

formula-notes:formula_22.62c:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算个体平均表型值（群体均值）与个体育种值之间的协方差，通过将协方差分解为个体自身贡献和他人贡献，最终等于群体遗传方差乘以系数 r_n。
formula-notes:formula_22.62c:zh.inThisChapter: 本章讨论关联效应（如竞争、社会互作）对群体遗传结构的影响，该公式将群体均值与个体育种值的协方差表达为群体遗传方差与亲缘系数 r_n 的乘积，为后续推导选择响应和群体分化提供关键桥梁。

formula-notes:formula_22.62b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将响应R（即平均育种值Δμ_A）分解为两部分：第一部分是群体平均表型z̄的回归系数β_{w|z̄}乘以z̄与个体育种值A_i的协方差σ(z̄, A_i)；第二部分是个体偏差Δz_i的回归系数β_{w|Δz}乘以Δz_i与A_i的协方差σ(Δz_i, A_i)。
formula-notes:formula_22.62b:zh.inThisChapter: 在群体选择、亲缘选择和关联效应章节中，该公式从Price定理出发（公式22.62a），将适应度对育种值的协方差分解为群体平均效应和个体偏差效应，为后续推导群体选择与亲缘选择下的响应（如公式22.62c-22.62f）提供基础分解框架。

formula-notes:formula_22.62d:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算个体i的性状偏差Δz_i（即个体表型值z_i与群体均值z̄的差）与其育种值A_i之间的协方差，结果等于群体内遗传方差σ_A^2乘以(1 - r_n)，其中r_n是包含群体大小的亲缘系数。
formula-notes:formula_22.62d:zh.inThisChapter: 在多层次选择章节中，此公式与公式22.62c分别给出组内和组间遗传方差，为后续代入公式22.62b计算多水平选择响应Δμ_A提供关键分量。

formula-notes:formula_22.62d:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the covariance between an individual's breeding value A_i and its deviation from the group mean Δz_i = z_i - ẑ, which equals the within-group additive genetic variance σ_A² times (1 - r_n), where r_n is the relatedness coefficient adjusted for group size.
formula-notes:formula_22.62d:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to multilevel selection to quantify the within-group genetic variance component, which is then substituted into Equation 22.62b to derive the overall response to selection Δμ_A.

formula-notes:formula_22.62f:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the change in mean breeding value (Δμ_A) as the additive genetic variance (σ_A^2) times a weighted average of the within-group regression of fitness on group mean phenotype (β_{w|\overline{z}}) and the among-group regression of fitness on group deviation (β_{w|Δz}), with weights 1/n and 1-1/n respectively.
formula-notes:formula_22.62f:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to associative effects to show how, when relatedness r=0 (so r_n=1/n), the response to selection partitions into within-group and among-group components, supporting the later argument that relatedness shifts the balance between these components.

formula-notes:formula_22.62e:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the total expected response to multilevel selection (Δμ_A) as the sum of among-group and within-group components, where σ_A² is additive genetic variance, r_n is relatedness, β_{w|z̄} is the among-group selection gradient on group mean phenotype, and β_{w|Δz} is the within-group selection gradient on individual deviation from group mean.
formula-notes:formula_22.62e:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to associative effects and multilevel selection to formalize how total evolutionary change partitions into group and individual components, supporting later arguments about the conditions under which group selection can overcome within-group selection.

formula-notes:formula_22.62e:zh.plainMeaning: 公式22.62e计算多层级选择下的总响应Δμ_A，它是组间遗传方差σ_A^2乘以组间选择梯度β_{w|\overline{z}}的加权（权重为r_n）与组内选择梯度β_{w|Δz}的加权（权重为1-r_n）之和。
formula-notes:formula_22.62e:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在介绍竞争、社会互动、群体选择和亲缘选择的章节，它整合了组间和组内选择响应（来自公式22.62b、22.62c、22.62d），为后续讨论亲缘选择系数r_n如何影响进化结果（如公式22.62f）奠定基础。

formula-notes:formula_22.63c:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the response to selection for the direct genetic effect of an individual's own genes on its fitness, expressed as the covariance between direct fitness component and breeding value. It equals the regression coefficient of direct fitness on phenotype times the additive genetic variance of the direct effect.
formula-notes:formula_22.63c:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to associative effects to show that the direct contribution to response follows the standard breeder's equation, setting the baseline for later adding indirect genetic effects from social partners.

formula-notes:formula_22.63b:en.plainMeaning: This formula expresses the direct fitness effect of an individual (w_{d,i}) as the product of the direct selection gradient (β_{w_d|z}) and its direct breeding value (A_{d,i}), and the social fitness effect of a neighbor (w_{s,j}) as the product of the same gradient, the relatedness coefficient (g), and the neighbor's direct breeding value (A_{d,j}).
formula-notes:formula_22.63b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to associative effects to decompose total fitness into direct and social components, setting up the derivation of inclusive fitness and kin selection models in later sections.

formula-notes:formula_22.63a:en.plainMeaning: This formula expresses an individual's fitness as the sum of its own direct breeding value (weighted by β) plus the indirect effects of all other group members' breeding values (weighted by gβ), plus a residual. Key symbols: w_i (fitness of i), A_{d,i} (direct breeding value of i), A_{d,j} (direct breeding value of j), β_{w_d|z} (regression of direct fitness on breeding value), g (relatedness coefficient), n (group size), ε_i* (residual).
formula-notes:formula_22.63a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to associative effects to decompose fitness into direct and indirect (social) components, setting up the partition of selection into direct and indirect components that will be used in later derivations of Hamilton's rule and kin selection models.

formula-notes:formula_22.63a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将个体i的适合度w_i分解为自身育种值A_{d,i}的贡献β_{w_d|z}A_{d,i}（即w_{d,i}）与同群其他个体育种值A_{d,j}的贡献gβ_{w_d|z}∑A_{d,j}（即∑w_{s,j}）之和，再加上残差ε_i^*。
formula-notes:formula_22.63a:zh.inThisChapter: 此公式出现在关联效应章节的引言部分，通过将适合度回归中的非育种值项归入残差，将式(22.60b)转化为育种值线性组合的形式，为后续推导群体遗传参数（如式22.63b-d）提供基础表达式。

formula-notes:formula_22.62f:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算在无亲缘关系（r=0，即r_n=1/n）时，群体中个体性状均值的响应Δμ_A，等于加性遗传方差σ_A^2乘以两项的加权和：第一项是(1/n)乘以组平均性状对适应度的回归系数β_{w|z̄}，第二项是(1-1/n)乘以组内偏差对适应度的回归系数β_{w|Δz}。
formula-notes:formula_22.62f:zh.inThisChapter: 此公式是公式22.62e在r=0时的特例，用于说明当群体内无亲缘关系时，选择响应完全由组间和组内选择分量的加权平均决定，为后续讨论亲缘关系如何影响组间与组内选择的相对强度提供基准。

formula-notes:formula_22.63b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将个体i的直接适应度分量w_{d,i}表示为直接育种值A_{d,i}乘以直接选择梯度β_{w_d|z}，将个体j的关联适应度分量w_{s,j}表示为关联育种值A_{d,j}乘以直接选择梯度β_{w_d|z}再乘以关联系数g。
formula-notes:formula_22.63b:zh.inThisChapter: 在介绍关联效应（Associative Effects）的章节中，此公式将适应度分解为直接和关联两部分，为后续推导关联效应的育种值A_s以及扩展选择梯度公式（如22.63c和22.63d）提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_22.63c:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将直接遗传响应 R_{i,d} 表示为直接育种值 A_i 与直接适应度分量 w_{d,i} 的协方差，并进一步分解为直接育种值对直接适应度的回归系数 β_{w_d|z} 乘以直接育种值方差 σ^2(A_d)，即育种者方程的形式。
formula-notes:formula_22.63c:zh.inThisChapter: 在本节中，该公式从Price方程出发，将群体遗传响应分解为直接和关联两部分，其中直接部分（22.63c）对应经典育种者方程，为后续引入关联效应（如公式22.63d）和广义遗传力奠定基础。

formula-notes:formula_22.63d:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the genetic covariance between the fitness of individual j (w_s,j) and the breeding value of individual i (A_i), expressed as r times the additive genetic variance σ²(A_d) scaled by the product g β_{w_d|z}. Here, r is the relatedness coefficient, g is a scaling factor, β_{w_d|z} is the regression of fitness on phenotype, and σ²(A_d) is the additive genetic variance of the direct trait.
formula-notes:formula_22.63d:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to associative effects to quantify the indirect genetic contribution of a social partner j to the response to selection of individual i, extending the breeder's equation (22.63c) to include kin selection effects.

formula-notes:formula_22.63d:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算个体i与个体j之间的遗传协方差R_{i,j}，它等于社会伙伴j的适合度w_{s,j}与i的育种值A_i的协方差。通过代入关系，它被表示为遗传相关系数r、群体中直接遗传效应加性遗传方差σ^2(A_d)以及回归系数β_{w_d|z}的乘积。
formula-notes:formula_22.63d:zh.inThisChapter: 在介绍关联效应（社会互动、群体选择）的章节中，公式22.63d扩展了22.63c的育种者方程，将个体i的响应分解为自身直接效应（22.63c）和来自社会伙伴j的间接遗传效应（22.63d），为后续推导总响应（如公式22.64）奠定基础。

formula-notes:formula_22.64a:en.plainMeaning: This formula rewrites the linear predictor β_{w|z̄} z̄ + β_{w|Δz} (z_i - z̄) as a weighted sum of the focal individual's trait z_i and the sum of others' traits Σ_{j≠i} z_j, separating the effects of group mean and deviation.
formula-notes:formula_22.64a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to associative effects to decompose the multilevel selection model into individual and social partner contributions, supporting the derivation of inclusive fitness and kin selection coefficients in later equations.

formula-notes:formula_22.64a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将群体选择与亲缘选择模型中的线性项展开为个体自身表型值z_i与群体内其他个体表型值之和∑_{j≠i}z_j的线性组合，关键系数由回归系数β_{w|Δz}和β_{w|z̄}表示。
formula-notes:formula_22.64a:zh.inThisChapter: 本章通过此展开将多层级选择（公式22.62a）与亲缘选择（公式22.59a）的表达式统一为个体与群体效应的显式形式，为后续推导公式22.64b中个体适应度与群体平均适应度的关系奠定代数基础。

formula-notes:formula_22.64b:en.plainMeaning: This formula expresses the regression slopes of fitness on individual phenotype (β_{w_d|z}) and on group mean phenotype (β_{w_s|z}) as weighted combinations of the slopes on group mean (β_{w|\overline{z}}) and on deviation from group mean (β_{w|\Delta z}), with group size n.
formula-notes:formula_22.64b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to associative effects to show how individual and group-level selection gradients are derived from the contextual analysis framework (Equation 22.59a), supporting the decomposition of selection into within-group and between-group components.

formula-notes:formula_22.65b:en.plainMeaning: This formula expresses the partial regression coefficients of fitness on individual deviation (Δz) and group mean (z̄) in terms of direct (β_wd|z) and social (β_ws|z) effects. β_w|Δz = β_wd|z - β_ws|z and β_w|z̄ = β_wd|z + (n-1)β_ws|z.
formula-notes:formula_22.65b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to associative effects to decompose total fitness into within-group and between-group components, supporting the analysis of social selection and kin selection in structured populations.

formula-notes:formula_22.64b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将群体中个体（下标d）和群体均值（下标s）的适合度对性状的回归斜率，表示为群体平均性状（β_{w|\overline{z}}）和群体内偏差（β_{w|Δz}）回归斜率的线性组合，其中n为群体大小。
formula-notes:formula_22.64b:zh.inThisChapter: 在介绍关联效应（竞争、社会互动、群体和亲缘选择）的章节中，该公式用于连接个体水平与群体水平的适合度回归，为后续推导群体选择与个体选择的分解（如Price方程）提供代数基础。

formula-notes:formula_22.65b:zh.plainMeaning: 公式(22.65b)将个体对自身性状偏差Δz_i的回归斜率β_{w|Δz}定义为直接效应β_{w_d|z}减去社会效应β_{w_s|z}，而将个体对群体平均性状z̄的回归斜率β_{w|z̄}定义为直接效应加上(n-1)倍的社会效应。
formula-notes:formula_22.65b:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式从(22.65a)的分解中提取出两个独立的回归系数，为后续将选择梯度分解为直接和间接成分（如Hamilton规则）提供关键线性变换。

formula-notes:formula_22.65a:en.plainMeaning: This formula decomposes the total effect on fitness of an individual's own phenotype (z_i) and the summed phenotypes of its n-1 neighbors into two components: one proportional to the deviation Δz_i = z_i - z̄ and one proportional to the group mean z̄. Key symbols: β_{w_d|z} (direct effect of own phenotype), β_{w_s|z} (social effect of each neighbor's phenotype), n (group size), Δz_i (individual deviation from group mean), z̄ (group mean).
formula-notes:formula_22.65a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to associative effects to show how the individual fitness function can be re-expressed in terms of deviation from the group mean and the group mean itself, leading directly to the definitions of the selection gradients β_{w|Δz} and β_{w|z̄} in equation (22.65b), which are central to analyzing competition, social interactions, and kin selection.

formula-notes:formula_22.65a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将个体i的性状值z_i与其他n-1个个体性状值之和的线性组合，重新表达为个体i的偏差Δz_i（相对于群体均值）与群体均值z̄的线性组合，其中系数分别涉及直接效应β_{w_d|z}和间接效应β_{w_s|z}。
formula-notes:formula_22.65a:zh.inThisChapter: 本章讨论关联效应（竞争、社会互作、群体与亲缘选择），该公式通过代数变换将个体与群体水平的回归系数分离，为后续推导公式(22.65b)中Δz和z̄的回归系数提供直接基础。

formula-notes:formula_22.66:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将个体i的索引I_i展开为自身直接遗传效应A_d_i、自身间接遗传效应A_s_i、其他个体j的直接和间接遗传效应以及环境残差e_i的线性组合，其中g为群体内亲缘系数，n为群体大小。
formula-notes:formula_22.66:zh.inThisChapter: 在本节中，该公式用于展示当存在间接遗传效应（关联效应）时，索引I_i如何分解为个体自身效应和其他个体效应的加权和，为后续推导关联效应下的选择响应和遗传参数奠定基础。

formula-notes:formula_22.66:en.plainMeaning: This formula expresses the selection index I_i for individual i as a linear combination of its own breeding value (A_d_i) and associative effects (A_s_i), plus contributions from all other group members, with relatedness g weighting their phenotypes. It decomposes I_i into terms involving direct and associative genetic effects.
formula-notes:formula_22.66:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on group and kin selection to show how the index I, used for predicting response to selection, is partitioned when associative effects exist, supporting later derivations of selection gradients and evolutionary change under relatedness.

formula-notes:formula_22.67a:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the change in mean additive genetic value (R = Δμ_{A_T}) as the covariance between fitness (w_i) and additive genetic value (A_{T_i}), which simplifies to β_{w_d|z} times the covariance between the index I_i and A_{T_i}, assuming no covariance between the residual ε_i and A_{T_i}.
formula-notes:formula_22.67a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on group selection and kin selection to derive the response to selection when fitness depends on both direct and associative effects, supporting the decomposition of total evolutionary change into components due to direct and indirect genetic effects.

formula-notes:formula_22.67a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算响应R（即性状均值的变化Δμ_{A_T}）等于个体适合度w_i与性状值A_{T_i}的协方差σ(w_i, A_{T_i})，在假设残差ε_i与A_{T_i}不相关（σ(ε_i, A_{T_i})=0）且无传递偏差时，简化为β_{w_d|z}乘以指示变量I_i与A_{T_i}的协方差σ(I_i, A_{T_i})。
formula-notes:formula_22.67a:zh.inThisChapter: 本节讨论群体选择、亲缘选择和关联效应，该公式通过Price方程将响应分解为直接选择（β_{w_d|z}）和关联效应（σ(I_i, A_{T_i})），为后续推导群体选择与亲缘选择的关系（如公式22.67b-d）提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_22.67b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算了群体选择下的响应R，它等于对群体中个体适应度w_d关于群体均值z的回归系数β乘以括号内两项之和：第一项包含加性遗传方差σ²(A_T)乘以系数[g+r+(n-2)gr]，第二项包含直接遗传方差σ²(A_d)和直接-社会遗传协方差σ(A_d,A_s)乘以系数(1-g)(1-r)。
formula-notes:formula_22.67b:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式由方程22.67a代入方程22.29d得到，将群体选择响应分解为遗传方差和协方差的加权和，为后续推导方程22.67c和22.67d中不同遗传结构下的响应形式提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_22.67b:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the response to selection R as a function of genetic variances and covariances, where β is the selection gradient, g is relatedness, r is a correlation, n is group size, σ²(A_T) is the variance in total additive genetic value, σ²(A_d) is the variance in direct additive genetic value, and σ(A_d, A_s) is the covariance between direct and social additive genetic values.
formula-notes:formula_22.67b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in this section to decompose the response to selection into components due to kin selection (via relatedness g) and group selection (via the associative effects term), supporting the argument that both processes can be unified under a single framework.

formula-notes:formula_22.67c:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the total response R to selection when social effects are heritable but group members are unrelated (r=0). Key symbols: R = response to selection, β_{w_d|z} = selection gradient on direct fitness, g = group relatedness (here 0), σ²(A_T) = variance in total breeding value, σ²(A_d) = variance in direct breeding value, σ(A_d,A_s) = covariance between direct and social breeding values, n = group size.
formula-notes:formula_22.67c:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on group selection and kin selection to show how the response to selection simplifies when relatedness is zero, isolating the contributions of direct and social effects. This supports later arguments about the conditions under which social effects can drive evolution without relatedness.

formula-notes:formula_22.67d:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the total response to selection (R) as the sum of a direct genetic variance term and an associative covariance term, each weighted by the partial regression coefficient β_{w_d|z}. Here, σ²(A_d) is the additive genetic variance in direct effects, σ(A_d, A_s) is the genetic covariance between direct and associative effects, and n is group size.
formula-notes:formula_22.67d:en.inThisChapter: It appears in this section to show that even without kin or group selection (g = r = 0), associative effects alone can cause a response beyond the standard breeder's equation, supporting the argument that group-structured populations can evolve due to indirect genetic effects.

formula-notes:formula_22.68:en.plainMeaning: This formula decomposes individual fitness into direct (w_d,i) and associative (w_s,j) components, where A_d and A_s are direct and associative breeding values, g is relatedness, n is group size, and β_wd|z is the regression of direct fitness on phenotype z.
formula-notes:formula_22.68:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to associative effects to show how social interactions and relatedness modify fitness components, generalizing Equation 22.63b and setting up the analysis of group and kin selection.

formula-notes:formula_22.67d:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算在无亲缘选择和无群体选择（g=r=0）时，对性状z的响应R，它等于直接遗传效应方差σ²(A_d)乘以回归系数β_{w_d|z}，加上(n-1)倍直接与间接遗传效应协方差σ(A_d,A_s)乘以同一回归系数。
formula-notes:formula_22.67d:zh.inThisChapter: 此公式出现在群体选择与关联效应章节，从更一般的式22.67b简化而来，用于展示即使没有亲缘或群体选择，仅关联效应（间接遗传效应）的存在就足以使响应R偏离标准育种者方程，为后续讨论关联效应如何影响进化预测奠定基础。

formula-notes:formula_22.68:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将个体适应度的直接组分 w_{d,i} 和间接组分 w_{s,j} 分别表示为直接遗传效应 A_d 和间接遗传效应 A_s 的线性组合，其中 β_{w_d|z} 是适应度对直接效应的回归系数，g 是关联系数，n 是群体大小。
formula-notes:formula_22.68:zh.inThisChapter: 本章从群体遗传学角度分析关联效应（竞争、社会互作等），公式22.68将22.63b推广到包含间接遗传效应的情况，为后续推导群体平均适应度与遗传方差分量提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_22.67c:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算当群体成员无亲缘关系（r=0）时，对群体性状的响应R，它等于直接遗传效应（A_d）对群体性状的回归系数β乘以括号内两项之和：第一项是群体遗传方差σ²(A_T)乘以群体遗传方差占比g，第二项是(1-g)乘以直接遗传效应方差σ²(A_d)与(n-1)倍直接与间接遗传效应协方差σ(A_d,A_s)之和。
formula-notes:formula_22.67c:zh.inThisChapter: 此公式是式22.67b在r=0时的特例，用于展示当群体成员无亲缘关系时，群体选择响应仅由直接遗传效应方差和直接-间接协方差贡献，为后续讨论亲缘系数r对响应的影响（如式22.67d）提供对比基准。

formula-notes:formula_22.69a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将群体平均性状值的变化 Δμ_{A_T} 分解为直接适应度分量 w_{d,i} 与个体自身性状值 A_{T_i} 的协方差，加上所有其他个体 j≠i 的社会适应度分量 w_{s,j} 与焦点个体性状值 A_{T_i} 的协方差之和。
formula-notes:formula_22.69a:zh.inThisChapter: 在介绍关联效应（竞争、社会互动、群体和亲缘选择）的章节中，此公式从公式22.67a推广而来，将预测响应分解为直接和关联适应度分量，为后续引入亲缘关系系数（公式22.69b）和解释广义Hamilton规则奠定基础。

formula-notes:formula_22.69a:en.plainMeaning: This formula decomposes the total selection differential (Δμ_{A_T}) into a direct component (σ(w_{d,i}, A_{T_i})) and a sum of associative components (σ(w_{s,j}, A_{T_i}) for j≠i), where w_{d,i} is direct fitness, w_{s,j} is associative fitness of individual j on i, and A_{T_i} is the trait value of i.
formula-notes:formula_22.69a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to associative effects to show how relatedness can be incorporated into the predicted response (Equation 22.67a) by separating fitness into direct and social components, supporting later arguments about kin selection and indirect genetic effects.

formula-notes:formula_22.69b:en.plainMeaning: This formula expresses the covariance between an individual j's direct (or social) breeding value and the total breeding value of individual i as the product of the relatedness coefficient r_ij and the corresponding covariance for i itself.
formula-notes:formula_22.69b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to associative effects to show that when individuals are unrelated (r_ij=0), the covariances vanish, justifying the claim that σ(w_{s,j}, A_{T_i}) is zero for unrelated individuals.

formula-notes:formula_22.70a:en.plainMeaning: This formula expresses the direct fitness components for a donor (w_{d,i}) and a recipient (w_{s,j}) as the product of the associative effect coefficient β_{w_d|z} and the additive genetic values A_{d_i} and A_{s_j}, respectively, under the condition of no multilevel selection (g=0).
formula-notes:formula_22.70a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to associative effects to show how, when group selection is absent, the fitness of each individual is solely determined by its own associative genetic value, simplifying the general multilevel selection framework and setting the stage for discussing the role of relatedness in Equation 22.69b.

formula-notes:formula_22.70b:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the direct fitness effect (w_{d,i}) of an individual i as the product of the selection gradient β_{w_d|z} and the sum of its own breeding value (A_{d_i}) and the total social breeding value from n-1 group mates (g(n-1)A_{s_i}), where g is the relatedness coefficient.
formula-notes:formula_22.70b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on associative effects to show how selection response (from Equation 22.68) depends only on direct fitness when there are no relatives in the group, isolating the role of relatedness in social evolution.

formula-notes:formula_23.1a:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the inbreeding depression parameter B as minus twice the sum over n diallelic loci of the dominance coefficient d_i times the heterozygosity p_i(1-p_i).
formula-notes:formula_23.1a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on selection response under inbreeding to show that B depends on allele frequencies, and it supports the derivation of subsequent equations (23.1b–d) that track changes in B over generations.

formula-notes:formula_22.69b:zh.plainMeaning: 公式(22.69b)表明，个体j的两种育种值（直接育种值A_{d_j}和社会育种值A_{s_j}）与焦点个体i的总体育种值A_{T_i}之间的协方差，分别等于个体i对应的协方差乘以亲缘系数r_{ij}。
formula-notes:formula_22.69b:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在介绍关联效应（竞争、社会互动、群体和亲缘选择）的章节，用于将非焦点个体j的育种值协方差转化为焦点个体i的协方差，从而在后续推导中利用亲缘系数简化对群体遗传参数的计算。

formula-notes:formula_22.70a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将个体i的直接适应度分量w_{d,i}表示为关联选择梯度β_{w_d|z}乘以个体i的关联育种值A_{d_i}，将个体j的社会适应度分量w_{s,j}表示为同一梯度乘以个体j的社会育种值A_{s_j}。
formula-notes:formula_22.70a:zh.inThisChapter: 在无多层级选择（g=0）的特殊情形下，公式22.68简化为本式，说明此时直接和社会适应度分量仅由关联选择梯度和各自的育种值决定，为后续推导关联响应（公式22.69b）提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_23.1b:zh.plainMeaning: 这个公式计算的是所有位点所有等位基因纯合子的显性偏差δ_{kii}乘以该等位基因频率p_{ki}的加权和，即B值，它衡量了群体中纯合子显性偏差的累积效应。
formula-notes:formula_23.1b:zh.inThisChapter: 在近交下选择响应的章节中，B用于量化方向性显性（directional dominance）对群体均值的影响，为后续推导近交衰退或选择响应公式（如23.1c、23.1d）提供基础量。

formula-notes:formula_22.70c:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the response to selection (R) as the change in mean total breeding value (Δμ_{A_T}), equal to the product of the direct selection gradient (β_{w_d|z}) and the covariance between direct breeding values (A_d) and total breeding values (A_T). The covariance expands as the variance of direct breeding values (σ²(A_d)) plus (n-1) times the covariance between direct and social breeding values (σ(A_d, A_s)).
formula-notes:formula_22.70c:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on associative effects to show how the breeder's equation is modified when direct and social breeding values are correlated, supporting the argument that social interactions can alter the response to selection beyond the simple direct effect.

formula-notes:formula_23.1b:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the sum over all loci (k) and all alleles (i) of the product of the dominance deviation for homozygote i at locus k (δ_{kii}) and the frequency of that homozygote (p_{ki}). It represents the contribution of directional dominance to the change in mean under inbreeding.
formula-notes:formula_23.1b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on selection response under inbreeding to quantify the effect of directional dominance (average heterozygote closer to the larger homozygote) on the population mean, supporting later arguments about how inbreeding depression and selection interact.

formula-notes:formula_23.1a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算近交参数B，它是各基因座显性效应d_i乘以杂合子频率2p_i(1-p_i)的加权和（取负号），即B = -2∑ d_i p_i (1-p_i)。
formula-notes:formula_23.1a:zh.inThisChapter: 本章讨论近交下选择响应的基本问题，此公式表明B随等位基因频率变化，为后续推导近交衰退与显性方向性（d_i为正）的关系提供基础。
