formula-notes:formula_22.70b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算个体 i 的适应度分量 w_{d,i}，它等于对直接遗传效应（A_{d_i}）的回归系数 β_{w_d|z} 乘以直接遗传效应与间接遗传效应（A_{s_i}）乘以组内非自身个体数 (n-1) 和关联度 g 的加权和。
formula-notes:formula_22.70b:zh.inThisChapter: 在讨论群体内无亲属时，公式 22.68 中 w_{s,j} 对选择响应无贡献，因此公式 22.70b 简化了选择响应的决定因素，为后续推导仅由直接效应驱动的选择响应公式做铺垫。

formula-notes:formula_23.1c:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将经过t代选择后的总均值变化Δμ(t)分解为选择响应R(t)和近交衰退引起的均值变化ΔI_t两部分，其中ΔI_t通常为负值。
formula-notes:formula_23.1c:zh.inThisChapter: 在本节中，该公式用于区分近交衰退和选择对群体均值变化的贡献，为后续单独计算选择响应R(t)（如公式23.1d）提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_22.70c:zh.plainMeaning: 公式22.70c计算群体对性状T的响应R（即Δμ_{A_T}），它等于直接育种值A_d对个体适合度w_d的回归系数β_{w_d|z}乘以直接育种值A_d与总育种值A_T的协方差σ(A_{d_i}, A_{T_i})，其中该协方差展开为直接育种值方差σ²(A_d)加上(n-1)倍直接与间接育种值协方差σ(A_d, A_s)。
formula-notes:formula_22.70c:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在讨论关联效应中竞争、社会互作、群体与亲缘选择的章节，它展示了当直接与间接育种值相关时，响应R不再等于育种者方程中的简单形式，而是需要包含间接育种值通过协方差对响应的贡献，为后续理解群体选择响应提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_23.1c:en.plainMeaning: This formula decomposes the total change in population mean after t generations (Δμ(t) = μt - μ0) into the selection response R(t) and the change due to inbreeding depression ΔIt, where ΔIt is typically negative.
formula-notes:formula_23.1c:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on basic issues in selection response under inbreeding to separate the effects of selection from inbreeding depression, supporting the derivation of the corrected selection response R(t) in Equation 23.1d.

formula-notes:formula_23.1d:zh.plainMeaning: 公式(23.1d)将选择响应R(t)定义为总均值变化Δ_μ(t)减去近交衰退引起的均值变化ΔI_t，即R(t)=Δ_μ(t)-ΔI_t。
formula-notes:formula_23.1d:zh.inThisChapter: 在近交下选择响应的基本问题章节中，该公式从(23.1c)推导而来，用于分离选择效应和近交衰退效应，为后续讨论如何从观测数据中估计真实选择响应提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_23.2a:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the change in the inbreeding coefficient ΔI_t due to genetic drift, where B is the base inbreeding coefficient, f_t ≈ t/(2N_e) is the inbreeding coefficient at generation t, and N_e is the effective population size.
formula-notes:formula_23.2a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on selection response under inbreeding to quantify how inbreeding from drift reduces heterozygosity linearly over time, supporting later derivations of cumulative inbreeding effects on selection response.

formula-notes:formula_23.1d:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the response to selection R(t) as the total mean change Δμ(t) minus the inbreeding depression ΔI_t, where Δμ(t) is the change in population mean from generation 0 to t, and ΔI_t is the change due to inbreeding depression (typically negative).
formula-notes:formula_23.1d:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on selection response under inbreeding to isolate the genetic gain from the confounding effect of inbreeding depression, supporting later arguments that selection response can be estimated by correcting observed mean changes for inbreeding depression.

formula-notes:formula_23.2c:en.plainMeaning: This formula decomposes the phenotypic value y_i of individual i into the population mean μ, the additive genetic value A_i, a linear effect B of inbreeding coefficient f_i, and a residual e_i.
formula-notes:formula_23.2c:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on selection response under inbreeding to model how inbreeding depression (via B f_i) can be included as a cofactor when predicting response, supporting later arguments that adjust selection models for inbreeding effects.

formula-notes:formula_23.3:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the total expected selection response after T generations under inbreeding, where S_t is the selection differential, σ_G(T,t) is the genetic covariance between generation t and T, σ^2(z_t) is the phenotypic variance, and ī_t is the standardized selection intensity.
formula-notes:formula_23.3:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on basic issues to show how cumulative response is decomposed into contributions from each generation, accounting for reduced genetic variance due to inbreeding, and supports later arguments about the impact of inbreeding on long-term selection limits.

formula-notes:formula_23.2a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算近交导致的群体均值变化ΔI_t，它等于-B乘以近交系数f_t，其中B是基础群体中因显性偏差导致的均值降低量，f_t ≈ t/(2N_e)是第t代的近交系数。
formula-notes:formula_23.2a:zh.inThisChapter: 本章讨论近交下选择响应，公式(23.2a)将遗传漂变产生的近交f_t与均值下降ΔI_t直接关联，为后续推导近交导致的方差变化(23.2b)和长期选择响应(23.2c)提供线性近似基础。

formula-notes:formula_23.2b:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the expected total change in mean phenotype after t generations of selection with inbreeding, as the sum of selection response (R(t)) and inbreeding depression (ΔI_t). Key symbols: Δ_μ(t) = total response, t = generations, ī = selection intensity, h² = heritability, σ_z = phenotypic standard deviation, B = inbreeding depression rate, N_e = effective population size.
formula-notes:formula_23.2b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on selection response under inbreeding to show how inbreeding depression (B) reduces the net response from the breeder's equation. This supports later arguments about the trade-off between selection and inbreeding in conservation or breeding programs.

formula-notes:formula_23.2b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算近交下选择响应Δμ(t)，等于育种者方程响应R(t)加上近交衰退校正项ΔI_t，近似为t乘以选择强度ī、遗传力h²、表型标准差σz的乘积减去Bt/(2Ne)，其中B是近交衰退系数，Ne是有效群体大小。
formula-notes:formula_23.2b:zh.inThisChapter: 出现在讨论近交对选择响应影响的章节，公式(23.2b)将育种者方程(13.6b)扩展至包含近交衰退，为后续推导(23.2c)中平衡选择响应与近交衰退的条件铺垫。

formula-notes:formula_23.3:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算经过T代选择和近交后的总预期响应R(T)，等于各代选择差S_t乘以该代贡献的遗传标准差σ_G(T,t)除以该代表型方差σ²(z_t)的加权和，或等价地等于各代标准化选择强度ī_t乘以σ_G(T,t)除以表型标准差σ(z_t)的加权和。
formula-notes:formula_23.3:zh.inThisChapter: 此公式出现在讨论近交下选择响应的基本问题章节，它整合了各代选择对最终响应的贡献，为后续推导近交导致方差变化时的响应预测提供基础框架。

formula-notes:formula_23.2c:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将个体i的表型值yi分解为总体均值μ、加性遗传值Ai、近交衰退效应B fi（其中B是近交衰退系数，fi是个体i的近交系数）以及残差ei。
formula-notes:formula_23.2c:zh.inThisChapter: 本章讨论近交下的选择响应，此公式通过引入近交系数fi作为协变量，将近交衰退从表型值中分离出来，为后续推导近交群体中加性遗传方差和选择响应的变化提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_23.4:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the cumulative selection response R(T) over T generations as the sum of contributions from each generation t, where S_t is the selection differential and σ_G(T,t) is the genetic covariance between generation T and t, scaled by the phenotypic variance (σ_G(t,t)+σ_e^2). The second expression rewrites it using standardized selection intensity i̅_t.
formula-notes:formula_23.4:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on selection response under inbreeding to show how the response depends on genetic covariances across generations, which are affected by inbreeding. This formula supports later arguments about how inbreeding reduces long-term response by decreasing σ_G(T,t).

formula-notes:formula_23.4:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算在近交体系下，经过T代选择后的累积响应R(T)，等于各代选择差S_t乘以第t代与第T代遗传协方差与第t代表型方差之比的和，或等价地等于各代标准化选择强度ī_t乘以该比值再乘以第t代表型标准差的和。
formula-notes:formula_23.4:zh.inThisChapter: 本章讨论近交下的选择响应，公式(23.4)将响应表示为各代选择差与遗传协方差-表型方差比的加权和，为后续利用特定近交系统的协方差函数计算具体响应值提供直接表达式。

formula-notes:formula_23.5b:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the permanent response after two generations of selection followed by inbreeding to homozygosity, as the sum of contributions from each generation weighted by the selection intensity and the genetic covariance between the selected generation and the final inbred population.
formula-notes:formula_23.5b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on selection response under inbreeding to show how the total permanent response can be partitioned across multiple selection episodes, supporting later arguments about the diminishing returns of continued selection under inbreeding.

formula-notes:formula_23.5a:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the cumulative selection response after two generations of inbreeding and selection, where R(2) is the total response, ī₀ and ī₁ are selection intensities in generations 0 and 1, σ_G(2,0) and σ_G(2,1) are genetic covariances between generation 2 and generations 0 and 1, and σ(z₀) and σ(z₁) are phenotypic standard deviations in generations 0 and 1.
formula-notes:formula_23.5a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on selection response under inbreeding to show how response accumulates over generations when inbreeding reduces genetic variance, and it supports the derivation of Equation 23.5b by providing the two-generation expression that can be generalized.

formula-notes:formula_23.5b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算经过两代选择后继续近交至完全纯合时的永久响应，等于第一代选择强度乘以第一代遗传标准差与最终遗传标准差之比，加上第二代选择强度乘以第二代遗传标准差与最终遗传标准差之比。
formula-notes:formula_23.5b:zh.inThisChapter: 本章讨论近交下选择响应的基本问题，此公式用于量化两代选择后近交至纯合时的累积永久响应，为后续分析多代选择与近交交互作用提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_23.5a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算近交和选择两代后的总响应R(2)，它是第一代选择强度ī₀乘以第0代遗传标准差与第0代表型标准差之比σ_G(2,0)/σ(z₀)，加上第二代选择强度ī₁乘以第1代遗传标准差与第1代表型标准差之比σ_G(2,1)/σ(z₁)。
formula-notes:formula_23.5a:zh.inThisChapter: 在近交下选择响应的基本问题章节中，此公式将总响应分解为两代贡献之和，为后续推导更一般的多代响应公式（如23.5b）提供基础，并说明近交导致遗传方差变化如何影响响应累积。

formula-notes:formula_23.6b:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes twice the coefficient of coancestry (2Θ_xy) as a linear combination of identity coefficients Δ_xy,i, which quantify probabilities of specific allelic identity states between two individuals x and y.
formula-notes:formula_23.6b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on selection response under inbreeding to decompose the genotypic covariance (Equation 23.6a) into components due to additive, dominance, and epistatic effects, supporting the derivation of covariance under inbreeding.

formula-notes:formula_23.6a:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the genetic covariance σ_G(x,y) between individuals x and y under inbreeding, incorporating additive (σ_A^2), dominance (σ_D^2), additive-by-additive epistatic (σ_DI^2), additive-by-dominance epistatic (σ_ADI), and a term involving ι* (related to inbreeding depression). Key symbols: Θ_xy (coancestry), Δ_xy,7, Δ_xy,1, Δ_xy,3, Δ_xy,5, Δ_xy,2 (identity coefficients), f_x, f_y (inbreeding coefficients).
formula-notes:formula_23.6a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on selection response under inbreeding to extend the basic genetic covariance formula (Equation 11.13) to include epistatic components and inbreeding effects, supporting later analysis of how inbreeding alters genetic variance and response to selection.

formula-notes:formula_23.7:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the expected selection response R as the product of the regression coefficient of offspring y on the selection unit z̄ (the covariance divided by the variance of z̄) and the standardized selection differential ī.
formula-notes:formula_23.7:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to selection under inbreeding to extend the standard breeder's equation to cases where the selection unit or offspring may be inbred, supporting later derivations of response when inbreeding alters variances and covariances.

formula-notes:formula_23.7:zh.plainMeaning: 公式 (23.7) 计算选择响应 R，其中分子 σ(ẑ, y) 是选择单元均值 ẑ 与后代个体值 y 的协方差，分母 σ²(ẑ) 是选择单元方差，ẍ 是标准化选择强度。
formula-notes:formula_23.7:zh.inThisChapter: 本章讨论近交下的选择，该公式将经典选择响应公式（如式 21.3b）推广到近交情形，为后续推导近交对响应的影响提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_23.6a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算近交群体中个体x与y之间的遗传协方差σ_G(x,y)，它分解为加性方差σ_A^2、显性方差σ_D^2、显性×显性上位方差σ_DI^2、加性×显性上位协方差σ_ADI以及由近交产生的额外项ι^*的贡献，各分量权重由共祖系数Θ_xy和一系列联合近交系数Δ_xy,?决定。
formula-notes:formula_23.6a:zh.inThisChapter: 本章讨论近交下选择响应的基本问题，公式(23.6a)将无连锁、无上位的一般近交遗传协方差公式(11.13)扩展为包含显性×显性上位和加性×显性上位效应的形式，为后续推导近交群体的选择响应和方差变化提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_23.6b:zh.plainMeaning: 公式(23.6b)定义了系数2Θ_{xy}，它等于2Δ_{xy,1}、Δ_{xy,3}、Δ_{xy,5}、Δ_{xy,7}以及1/2Δ_{xy,8}之和，用于量化个体x和y之间在加性×加性上位方差σ_{AA}^2上的遗传协方差贡献。
formula-notes:formula_23.6b:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在近交下选择响应基本问题的章节中，作为(23.6a)中σ_{AA}^2项的系数，为后续推导近交群体中亲属间协方差和选择响应公式提供必要的遗传方差分量权重。

formula-notes:formula_23.8b:en.plainMeaning: This formula expresses the variance of the mean of a family of n sibs, σ²(ẑ), as the sum of the between-family genetic variance σG(sibs) and the within-family error variance σe², which combines common environmental variance σEc² and within-family genetic and environmental components.
formula-notes:formula_23.8b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to selection under inbreeding to decompose the phenotypic variance of family means into components that will be used to compare the impact of inbreeding on σG(sibs) and to derive selection response formulas later in the chapter.

formula-notes:formula_23.8a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将家系内n个同胞表型均值与亲本y的协方差分解为两部分：第一个同胞（用于选择）的协方差乘以1/n，加上其余n-1个同胞的协方差乘以(1-1/n)。
formula-notes:formula_23.8a:zh.inThisChapter: 本章讨论近交下的选择，此公式为后续推导同胞均值与亲本的协方差表达式（23.8b和23.8c）提供基础，通过区分被选同胞与其他同胞来量化近交对协方差的影响。

formula-notes:formula_23.8a:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the covariance between the family mean phenotype (over n sibs) and the breeding value of a relative y, as a weighted average of the covariance with the measured sib used as parent (z1) and the covariance with another sib (z2). Key symbols: σ(·,·) = covariance, z̄ = family mean, y = relative, n = number of measured sibs, z1 = value of sib used as parent, z2 = value of another sib.
formula-notes:formula_23.8a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to selection under inbreeding to show how the covariance with the family mean can be expressed in terms of covariances with individual sibs, which is then used to derive the selection response when only one sib is measured (Equation 23.8b) and when all sibs are measured (Equation 23.8c).

formula-notes:formula_23.8c:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将误差方差 σ_e² 分解为共同环境方差 σ_{E_c}² 加上家系内遗传方差 σ_{G_w}² 和特殊环境方差 σ_{E_s}² 之和除以家系内个体数 n，用于量化家系均值估计中的总误差。
formula-notes:formula_23.8c:zh.inThisChapter: 本章讨论近交下的选择，该公式出现在引入部分，将家系均值误差分解为共同环境效应和抽样误差，为后续推导近交家系选择响应提供误差项表达式。

formula-notes:formula_23.8c:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the total error variance (σ_e²) in a family selection experiment, combining the common environmental variance (σ_{E_c}²) with the within-family genetic variance (σ_{G_w}²) and specific environmental variance (σ_{E_s}²) divided by the number of individuals per family (n).
formula-notes:formula_23.8c:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to selection under inbreeding to quantify the error term when using family means, supporting later arguments about the impact of inbreeding on the accuracy of selection and the design of breeding programs.

formula-notes:formula_23.9a:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the genetic covariance among half-sibs when the common parent is inbred to degree f, expressed as a sum over additive (σ²_A) and epistatic (σ²_{AA}, …, σ²_{A^k}) variance components weighted by powers of (1+f)/4.
formula-notes:formula_23.9a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on family selection with inbreeding and random mating to quantify how inbreeding alters the covariance among half-sibs, which is essential for predicting response to selection and connects to Equation 23.9b for full-sibs.

formula-notes:formula_23.8b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将家系均值z̄的方差σ²(z̄)分解为家系间方差σ_b²和家系内方差σ_w²/n之和，进一步将σ_b²拆分为同胞间遗传协方差σ_G(sibs)和共同环境方差σ_Ec²，将σ_w²/n拆分为家系内遗传方差σ_Gw²和特殊环境方差σ_Es²除以n，最终合并为σ_G(sibs)与总环境方差σ_e²之和。
formula-notes:formula_23.8b:zh.inThisChapter: 本章旨在比较近交对σ_G(sibs)的影响，此公式将σ²(z̄)表达为σ_G(sibs)与σ_e²之和，从而为后续推导近交下选择响应公式（如23.8c）提供方差分解基础。

formula-notes:formula_23.9b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算全同胞家系间遗传方差 σ_G(FS)，它分解为加性方差 σ_A^2、显性方差 σ_D^2 和加性×加性上位方差 σ_AA^2 等分量，每个分量乘以一个由亲本近交系数 f1、f2 及其均值 f̄ 决定的系数。
formula-notes:formula_23.9b:zh.inThisChapter: 在本章“近交与随机交配下的家系选择”中，该公式用于量化近交对全同胞家系间遗传方差的影响，为后续比较不同家系类型（如半同胞）的选择响应提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_23.9a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算当共同亲本近交系数为 f 时，半同胞间的遗传协方差，其中 σ²_A 是加性遗传方差，σ²_{A^k} 是 k 阶上位方差，系数 (1+f)/4 反映了近交对半同胞协方差的影响。
formula-notes:formula_23.9a:zh.inThisChapter: 本章讨论近交与随机交配下的家系选择，此公式用于量化近交对半同胞遗传协方差的放大效应，为后续推导全同胞协方差（公式 23.9b）以及比较不同亲缘关系协方差提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_23.9b:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the genetic variance among full-sib families (σ_G(FS)) when parents are inbred, as a function of additive (σ_A²), dominance (σ_D²), and additive-by-additive epistatic (σ_AA²) variance components, weighted by the parents' inbreeding coefficients f₁ and f₂ and their average f̄.
formula-notes:formula_23.9b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on family selection with inbreeding and random mating to quantify how inbreeding alters the covariance among full sibs, which is essential for predicting response to family selection under non-random mating.

formula-notes:formula_23.10a:zh.plainMeaning: 公式(23.10a)计算个体x与其后代y（通过x的一个亲本R）之间的加性遗传协方差，其中f是近交系数，σ_A^2是加性遗传方差，系数(1+f)/4反映了亲本-后代关系中的共祖系数。
formula-notes:formula_23.10a:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在讨论近交和随机交配下的家系选择章节，为后续推导半同胞(23.10b)和全同胞(23.10c)协方差提供基础，并说明近交如何改变亲属间的遗传协方差。

formula-notes:formula_23.10a:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the genetic covariance between a measured individual x and its offspring y when the relationship R is that y is a child of x (i.e., parent-offspring). The covariance equals ((1+f)/4) times the additive genetic variance σ_A^2, where f is the inbreeding coefficient of the parents.
formula-notes:formula_23.10a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on family selection with inbreeding and random mating to quantify the parent-offspring covariance under inbreeding, which is needed to predict response to selection when parents are inbred. It supports later derivations for other relationships like half-sibs (23.10b) and full-sibs (23.10c).

formula-notes:formula_23.10b:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the genetic covariance between a measured individual x and an offspring y when the single parent (ℛ) of y is a half-sibling of x. It equals (1+f)/8 times the additive genetic variance σA², where f is the inbreeding coefficient.
formula-notes:formula_23.10b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on family selection with inbreeding and random mating to quantify the genetic resemblance between half-sib relatives under inbreeding, which is needed to predict response to selection when pedigrees include inbred individuals.

formula-notes:formula_23.10b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算当y的亲属R是x的半同胞（HS）时，x与y之间的加性遗传协方差，结果为(1+f)/8乘以加性遗传方差σ_A^2。
formula-notes:formula_23.10b:zh.inThisChapter: 在家族选择与近交随机交配的章节中，此公式与(23.10a)和(23.10c)共同给出不同亲属关系下的遗传协方差，为后续计算选择响应和预测遗传进展提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_23.10c:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the genetic covariance between an individual x and a relative y, where the relative y is a full-sibling of x (i.e., the reference individual R is a full-sib of x). It equals ((1+f)/4) times the additive genetic variance σ_A^2, where f is the inbreeding coefficient of the parents.
formula-notes:formula_23.10c:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on family selection with inbreeding and random mating to quantify the genetic covariance among full-sibs when parents are inbred, which is needed to predict response to family selection under inbreeding.

formula-notes:formula_23.11b:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the probabilities of identity-by-descent (IBD) for two alleles in a half-sib sire and dam family: Δ₃ = 1/16 is the probability both alleles are IBD (both from the same parent), and Δ₈ = 7/16 is the probability exactly one allele is IBD.
formula-notes:formula_23.11b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on family selection with inbreeding and random mating to quantify the genetic covariance among half-sibs, which is needed to predict response to selection under these mating structures.

formula-notes:formula_23.11b:zh.plainMeaning: 对于半同胞-全同胞（SDHS）家系，Δ₃ = 1/16 表示来自父本和母本的两个等位基因同时为IBD的概率，Δ₈ = 7/16 表示仅有一个等位基因为IBD的概率。
formula-notes:formula_23.11b:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式在章节中用于计算半同胞-全同胞家系中不同IBD状态的概率，为后续推导家系内个体间的共祖系数或亲缘关系提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_23.11a:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the probabilities Δ₃ and Δ₈ for full-sib mating (SDFS): Δ₃ = 1/8 is the probability that both alleles in a pair are identical by descent (IBD) from the same parent, and Δ₈ = 3/8 is the probability that neither allele is IBD. Key symbols: Δ₃ (probability of two alleles IBD from same parent), Δ₈ (probability of no IBD).
formula-notes:formula_23.11a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on family selection with inbreeding and random mating to quantify the coancestry and inbreeding coefficients for full-sib matings, which are needed to compute genetic covariances and selection responses in subsequent equations (23.11b–d).

formula-notes:formula_23.11c:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the genetic covariance between inbred (I) and outcrossed (O) full sibs in a sire-dam family selection design, expressed as a linear combination of the additive genetic variance (σ²_A) and the additive-by-dominance interaction variance (σ_ADI).
formula-notes:formula_23.11c:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on family selection with inbreeding and random mating to quantify the genetic relationship between inbred and outcrossed relatives, which is essential for predicting response to selection when some individuals are inbred.

formula-notes:formula_23.10c:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算当y的亲属R是x的全同胞（FS）时，x与y的遗传协方差σ_G，等于(1+f)/4乘以加性遗传方差σ_A^2，其中f是近交系数。
formula-notes:formula_23.10c:zh.inThisChapter: 本节讨论近交和随机交配下的家系选择，公式(23.10a-c)分别给出R为亲本、半同胞、全同胞时的遗传协方差，为后续计算家系内和家系间遗传方差及选择响应提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_23.11d:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the genetic covariance between inbred (I) and outcrossed (O) sibs in a half-sib sire and dam design, expressed as a linear combination of additive genetic variance (σ²_A) and covariance due to additive by dominance interaction (σ_ADI).
formula-notes:formula_23.11d:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on family selection with inbreeding and random mating to quantify the genetic relationship between inbred and outcrossed relatives, supporting the comparison of selection responses under different mating designs.

formula-notes:formula_23.11c:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算全同胞父本-母本设计中，近交个体（I）与远交个体（O）之间的遗传协方差，等于(5/16)加性遗传方差σ_A²加上(1/8)加性×显性互作方差σ_ADI。
formula-notes:formula_23.11c:zh.inThisChapter: 在设定a₁=Δ₂=Δ₅=Δ₇=0后，由式23.6a和23.6b代入得到，用于推导近交与远交同胞间协方差的具体表达式，为后续比较不同交配设计下的遗传方差分量提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_23.11a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算了在全同胞交配（SDFS）情况下，两个配子来自同一祖先且该祖先为纯合子的概率Δ₃=1/8，以及两个配子来自同一祖先且该祖先为杂合子的概率Δ₈=3/8。其中1/2是祖先为特定性别的概率，1/4和1-1/4分别是全同胞亲本传递相同等位基因的概率。
formula-notes:formula_23.11a:zh.inThisChapter: 在本节中，该公式用于推导全同胞交配时配子间的共祖系数和亲缘系数，为后续计算近交系数和方差分量（如公式23.11b-d）提供基础概率值。

formula-notes:formula_23.12:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the covariance σ(x,y) between an individual x in the selection unit and the offspring y of its selfed sib, as the sum of the additive genetic variance σ_A^2 and a term β that captures dominance effects. Here, p_i and q_i are allele frequencies, d_i is the dominance deviation, and a_i is the additive effect at locus i.
formula-notes:formula_23.12:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on family selection with inbreeding and random mating to quantify the genetic covariance between relatives under selfing, which is essential for predicting response to selection and designing breeding strategies.

formula-notes:formula_23.11d:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算半同胞父本和母本设计（SDHS）下，近交个体（I）与远交个体（O）之间的加性遗传协方差σ_G(I,O|SDHS)，其中σ_A^2为加性方差，σ_ADI为近交与远交的加性×显性互作方差分量，系数9/32和1/16分别反映该设计下两类方差的贡献比例。
formula-notes:formula_23.11d:zh.inThisChapter: 在“近交与随机交配下的家系选择”章节中，公式23.11d紧接全同胞设计公式23.11c，用于推导半同胞设计下近交与远交个体间的遗传协方差，为后续比较不同交配设计的选择响应提供关键协方差分量。

formula-notes:formula_23.12:zh.plainMeaning: 公式(23.12)计算选择单元中个体x与其自交同胞后代y之间的协方差，它等于加性遗传方差σ_A²加上一项β；β是各基因位点上由显性效应d_i和等位基因频率p_i、q_i构成的求和项，反映了非加性遗传方差对协方差的贡献。
formula-notes:formula_23.12:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在“近交与随机交配下的家系选择”章节，用于推导选择单元与后代间的遗传协方差，为后续计算选择响应或预测遗传进展提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_23.13a:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes Δ₃, the probability that two alleles sampled from different individuals within a family are identical by descent, given inbreeding coefficients fᵢ and fⱼ for generations i and j. It simplifies to 1 - ½(1/2ⁱ + 1/2ʲ).
formula-notes:formula_23.13a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on family selection with inbreeding and random mating to quantify the genetic covariance among relatives, supporting later derivations of selection response and variance components.

formula-notes:formula_23.13a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算Δ₃，它表示在近交和随机交配的家系选择中，两个个体（i和j）的共祖系数或基因一致性概率，其中f_i是第i个个体的近交系数，最终简化为1减去(1/2^{i+1} + 1/2^{j+1})。
formula-notes:formula_23.13a:zh.inThisChapter: 本章讨论近交和随机交配下的家系选择，Δ₃是推导遗传方差分量（如σ_A²和σ_ADI）所需的关键系数，为后续计算选择响应和方差组分提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_23.13c:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes twice the coefficient of coancestry (2Θxy) between two individuals in a selected line after i generations of full-sib mating, expressed as 1 minus 1/2^(i+1). Δ3 and Δ8 are probabilities of specific identity-by-descent modes.
formula-notes:formula_23.13c:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on family selection with inbreeding and random mating to show how the coancestry coefficient simplifies under full-sib mating, supporting later calculations of inbreeding depression or genetic variance in selected lines.

formula-notes:formula_23.14:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes twice the genetic covariance between a selected family mean (selection unit) and an offspring, accounting for additive genetic variance (σ²_A) and additive-by-dominance interaction variance (σ_ADI), with inbreeding coefficients i and j for the two parents.
formula-notes:formula_23.14:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on family selection with inbreeding and random mating to quantify the response to selection when families are inbred, supporting the derivation of selection response equations that incorporate inbreeding effects.

formula-notes:formula_23.13b:zh.plainMeaning: 公式(23.13b)计算的是在亲本i和j的共祖系数f_i已知时，个体8（即i和j的后代）的近交系数Δ₈，它等于(1-f_i)乘以2的-(j-i)次方，最终简化为2的-j次方。
formula-notes:formula_23.13b:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在“近交与随机交配下的家系选择”章节中，用于推导特定家系结构中个体的近交系数，为后续计算群体平均近交系数或选择响应提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_23.13b:en.plainMeaning: Δ₈ computes the probability that two alleles in a pair of individuals are identical by descent (IBD) given that the first individual is inbred (with inbreeding coefficient fᵢ) and the second is from a later generation j, assuming random mating after the initial inbreeding; it simplifies to 2⁻ʲ, showing that the IBD probability depends only on the later generation's index j.
formula-notes:formula_23.13b:en.inThisChapter: This formula appears in the section on family selection with inbreeding and random mating to quantify the reduction in IBD probability over generations, supporting the derivation of overall inbreeding coefficients and genetic variance components in structured populations.

formula-notes:formula_23.15:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the genetic variance among S_{i,j} families, where i and j are inbreeding generations of the two parents, in terms of additive (σ²_A), dominance (σ²_D), additive-by-additive (σ²_ADI), dominance-by-dominance (σ²_DI) variance components, and a term ι* related to inbreeding depression.
formula-notes:formula_23.15:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on family selection with inbreeding and random mating to quantify how genetic variance among families changes with different levels of parental inbreeding, supporting later arguments about optimal inbreeding levels for selection response.

formula-notes:formula_23.15:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算近交和随机交配方案中S_{i,j}家系间的遗传方差σ_G^2(S_{i,j})，它分解为加性方差σ_A^2、显性方差σ_D^2、加性×加性上位方差σ_ADI^2、显性×显性上位方差σ_DI^2以及近交增量ι*的线性组合，系数由近交代数i和随机交配代数j决定。
formula-notes:formula_23.15:zh.inThisChapter: 在“近交与随机交配下的家系选择”章节中，该公式用于量化不同近交-随机交配方案产生的家系间遗传变异，为后续比较不同选择策略的效率提供方差分量表达式。

formula-notes:formula_23.14:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算在S_{i,j}家系选择下，选择单元（亲本）与后代y之间的总协方差（即2σ_G(x,y)），它等于加性遗传方差σ_A^2乘以4θ_{x,y}加上加性×显性互作方差σ_ADI乘以2Δ_3；第二行代入θ_{x,y}=1-1/2^{i+1}和Δ_3=1-1/2^{i+1}-1/2^{j+1}后的展开形式。
formula-notes:formula_23.14:zh.inThisChapter: 本章讨论近交与随机交配下的家系选择，该公式将选择单元-后代协方差分解为加性和互作分量，为后续推导选择响应和遗传进展提供关键协方差表达式。

formula-notes:formula_23.13c:zh.plainMeaning: 公式左边2Θxy表示个体x和y之间的共祖系数（两倍），右边等于Δ3（x和y通过共同祖先i的配子同源概率）加上Δ8/2（x和y通过i的配子同源概率的一半），最终化简为1减去1/2的(i+1)次方。
formula-notes:formula_23.13c:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在“近交与随机交配下的家系选择”章节，用于计算特定近交结构下个体间的共祖系数，为后续推导家系内遗传方差和选择响应提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_23.16:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算对特定家系选择方案 S_{i,j} 进行一代选择后的响应 R_{S_{i,j}}，分子包含加性遗传方差 σ_A^2 和加性-显性互作协方差 σ_{ADI} 的加权组合，分母为表型标准差（遗传方差 σ_G^2 与环境方差 σ_e^2 之和的平方根），整体乘以选择强度 ī。
formula-notes:formula_23.16:zh.inThisChapter: 本章介绍近交下的选择，公式 23.16 将基础响应公式（23.7）与近交导致的方差分量变化（23.14、23.15）结合，为后续推导特定家系选择方案的响应提供通用表达式。

formula-notes:formula_23.17a:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the response to S1 family selection (R_{S_{0,1}}) as the product of selection intensity (ī) and the ratio of additive genetic variance plus half the additive-by-dominance interaction variance to the square root of the total phenotypic variance among S1 family means.
formula-notes:formula_23.17a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to selection under inbreeding to quantify the genetic gain from selecting among S1 families, and it supports later arguments (Eqs. 23.17b, 23.17c) by providing the baseline expression for response when inbreeding is first imposed.

formula-notes:formula_23.17a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算S1家系选择（对半同胞家系进行选择）的响应R_{S_{0,1}}，分子是加性遗传方差σ_A^2加上加性×显性互作方差的一半(1/2)σ_ADI，分母是表型方差平方根，包含加性、显性、互作及环境方差分量。
formula-notes:formula_23.17a:zh.inThisChapter: 本章讨论近交下的选择，此公式为S1家系选择响应提供定量表达式，后续将与其他选择方案（如S0,2、S2,1）的响应公式（23.17b、23.17c）对比，以评估不同近交程度对选择效率的影响。

formula-notes:formula_23.16:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the response to family selection (R) for a specific family structure S_{i,j}, where i and j denote the number of generations of selfing in the two parents. The numerator includes additive genetic variance (σ²_A) and additive-by-dominance interaction variance (σ_ADI), each scaled by factors involving 2^{-(i+1)} and 2^{-(j+1)}. The denominator is the square root of the total genotypic variance (σ²_G) plus environmental variance (σ²_e) for that family type. The term ī is the standardized selection intensity.
formula-notes:formula_23.16:en.inThisChapter: This formula appears in the introduction to selection under inbreeding to quantify the expected genetic gain from family selection when parents have undergone different numbers of selfing generations. It supports later arguments about optimizing the balance between inbreeding and selection response, and is used to derive specific cases such as full-sib or half-sib family selection.

formula-notes:formula_23.17b:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the expected response to S₂ family selection (i=1, j=2) as the product of the selection intensity (τ̄) and the ratio of the numerator (additive genetic variance plus covariance between additive and dominance effects under inbreeding) to the square root of the total phenotypic variance among S₂ family means, which includes components of genetic variance, inbreeding depression variance (ι*), and environmental variance.
formula-notes:formula_23.17b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to selection under inbreeding to quantify the response when selecting among S₂ families (full-sib families from selfing), supporting later comparisons with other selection methods and illustrating how inbreeding affects the components of response.

formula-notes:formula_23.17b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算S₁,₂家系选择（i=1, j=2）的响应R，分子是加性方差σA²与加性×显性上位方差σADI的线性组合，分母是总表型方差（包括加性、显性、上位、近交衰退ι*和误差方差σe²）的平方根，整体乘以选择强度τ̄。
formula-notes:formula_23.17b:zh.inThisChapter: 本章讨论近交下的选择，公式23.17b给出经典S₂家系选择的响应表达式，与23.17a（S₁家系）和23.17c（S₀,₂家系）对比，展示不同交配设计下遗传方差分量对选择响应的贡献差异。

formula-notes:formula_23.19a:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the ratio of response to selection under cyclic inbreeding (R_I) to response under mass selection (R_m), where symbols include generation times g_I and g_m, selection intensities ī_I and ī_m, genetic correlation r_f among inbred line members, inbreeding coefficient f, and heritability h².
formula-notes:formula_23.19a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in this section to quantify the efficiency of family selection with inbreeding relative to mass selection, supporting the argument that stringent conditions are needed for cyclic inbreeding to outperform mass selection.

formula-notes:formula_23.17c:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the response to bulk S₂ family selection (R_{S_{0,2}}) as the product of selection intensity (ī) and a ratio of genetic variance components (σ²_A and σ_ADI) over the square root of total phenotypic variance among S₂ family means, which includes additive, dominance, additive-by-dominance, dominance-by-dominance, and environmental variance.
formula-notes:formula_23.17c:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on selection under inbreeding to quantify the expected genetic gain from selecting among S₂ families (i=0, j=2), supporting the comparison of different inbreeding levels and selection methods in later arguments.

formula-notes:formula_23.19a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算循环近交选择响应（R_I）与群体选择响应（R_m）的比值，其中关键符号包括：近交选择强度（ī_I）、群体选择强度（ī_m）、近交世代间隔（g_I）、群体世代间隔（g_m）、近交系数（f）、近交系内遗传相关（r_f）以及遗传力（h²）。
formula-notes:formula_23.19a:zh.inThisChapter: 本章讨论近交与随机交配下的家系选择，此公式用于量化循环近交相对于群体选择的效率，为后续推导（如公式23.19b）提供基础，并说明近交策略在特定条件下可能优于群体选择。

formula-notes:formula_23.18:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the expected selection response R for a selected line derived from an F1 cross, where i and j denote the number of generations of selfing and selection, respectively. Key symbols: R = response, ī = standardized selection intensity, σ²_A = additive genetic variance, σ²_D = dominance variance, σ²_e = environmental variance, i = generations of selfing, j = generations of selection.
formula-notes:formula_23.18:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to selection under inbreeding to show how the response formula simplifies when starting from an F1 (p=q=0.5, no inbreeding disequilibrium). This supports later arguments about the impact of inbreeding on genetic variance components and selection response.

formula-notes:formula_23.17c:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算在近交背景下基于S0,2家系选择（即对未自交亲本产生的S2家系进行选择）的响应R，分子包含加性方差σA²和加性×显性上位方差σADI的加权和，分母为表型标准差（包含加性、显性、上位及环境方差分量）。
formula-notes:formula_23.17c:zh.inThisChapter: 本节介绍近交下的选择响应，公式(23.17c)与(23.17a,b)并列，展示不同自交代数（S1,2 vs S0,2）下响应表达式的差异，为后续比较不同选择方案的效果提供定量基础。

formula-notes:formula_23.19b:en.plainMeaning: This formula compares the response to family selection (R_I) relative to mass selection (R_m) as a function of the ratio of selection intensities (ī_m/ī_I) and the square root of 0.1875 divided by heritability (h²).
formula-notes:formula_23.19b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on family selection with inbreeding and random mating to quantify the efficiency of family selection under specific inbreeding (f=0.25) and relatedness (r_f=0.6) conditions, supporting the argument that family selection can outperform mass selection when heritability is low.

formula-notes:formula_23.18:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算在自交系杂交产生的F1群体中，对S_{i,j}家系进行选择时的预期响应R_{S_{i,j}}，其中分子为加性方差σ_A^2乘以选择强度ῑ和系数2(1-2^{-(i+1)})，分母为加性、显性和环境方差分量之和的平方根。
formula-notes:formula_23.18:zh.inThisChapter: 本章讨论近交下的选择，公式23.18是23.16在特定初始条件（F1群体，σ_DI^2=σ_ADI=0，p=q=1/2）下的简化形式，为后续推导近交对选择响应的影响提供具体表达式。

formula-notes:formula_23.20a:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the covariance between a parent from generation S_k and its offspring y, expressed as a weighted sum of the additive genetic variance σ_A^2 and the additive-by-dominance interaction variance σ_ADI, with weights depending on the inbreeding coefficient f_k = 1 - 2^{-k}.
formula-notes:formula_23.20a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on family selection with inbreeding and random mating to quantify the genetic covariance between relatives under inbreeding, which is essential for predicting response to selection and is used alongside Equations 23.20b and 23.20c for related covariances.

formula-notes:formula_23.20c:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the ratio of per-generation response under S_k family selection to that under standard mass selection, where R_{S_k} is response under S_k, R_m is response under mass selection, k is number of individuals per family, σ_A^2 is additive genetic variance, σ_e^2(m) is error variance for mass selection, and σ_e^2(S_k) is error variance for S_k selection.
formula-notes:formula_23.20c:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on family selection with inbreeding and random mating to quantify the efficiency of S_k selection relative to mass selection, supporting later arguments about optimal family size and the impact of inbreeding on selection response.

formula-notes:formula_23.20b:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the response to family selection per generation (R_{S_K}) when both parents are selected, incorporating the average selection intensity (ī), family size (k), additive genetic variance (σ²_A), additive-by-dominance interaction variance (σ_{ADI}), and the square root of the sum of genetic (σ²_g) and environmental (σ²_e) variances among S_k families.
formula-notes:formula_23.20b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on family selection with inbreeding and random mating to quantify the genetic gain under this specific breeding scheme, supporting later comparisons with other selection methods (e.g., Equations 23.20a and 23.20c).

formula-notes:formula_23.19b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算在近交家系选择（I）与随机交配群体选择（m）下的响应比 R_I/R_m，其中关键符号：R_I 和 R_m 分别为两种选择方案的响应，ī_m 和 ī_I 为选择强度，h² 为狭义遗传力，f=0.25 时系数 0.1875 来自 (1-f)/(4) 等推导。
formula-notes:formula_23.19b:zh.inThisChapter: 本章讨论近交与随机交配下的家系选择，此公式在 23.19a 基础上代入 f=0.25、r_f=0.6、g_I/g_m=1/2 得到，用于比较两种策略的效率，为后续选择方案决策提供定量依据。

formula-notes:formula_23.20c:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算的是S_k家系选择相对于标准个体选择（质量选择）每代响应之比。分子中的(2-2^{-k})/(k+1)是家系内选择强度校正因子，分母中的平方根项是两种选择方案下遗传方差与误差方差之比的调整。
formula-notes:formula_23.20c:zh.inThisChapter: 在本章“近交与随机交配下的家系选择”中，该公式用于量化当采用S_k（连续自交k代后随机交配）家系结构时，选择响应相对于标准质量选择的效率，为后续比较不同近交程度下的选择效果提供定量依据。

formula-notes:formula_23.21:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the parent-offspring covariance among fully inbred lines, denoted σ(z_p,z_o), which equals the total genotypic variance after inbreeding, σ̃_G². It is expressed as 2σ_A² (additive variance) + 2σ_ADI (additive-by-dominance interaction) + σ_DI² (dominance interaction variance).
formula-notes:formula_23.21:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on individual selection under pure selfing to show how the genetic variance components change from the outbred population to the inbred lines, supporting the prediction of response to selection in a selfing population.

formula-notes:formula_23.20a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算自交k代的亲本S_k与后代y之间的协方差，其中第一项(1/2)(2-2^{-k})σ_A^2是加性遗传方差贡献，第二项(1-2^{-k})σ_{ADI}是加性×显性互作方差贡献。
formula-notes:formula_23.20a:zh.inThisChapter: 在讨论近交与随机交配下的家系选择时，该公式用于量化亲本与后代间的遗传协方差，为后续推导选择响应和方差组分估计提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_23.22:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the expected response to selection (R) as the selection differential (S) multiplied by the heritability, where the heritability is the ratio of genetic variance (σ̃_G²) to total phenotypic variance (σ̃_G² + σ_e²).
formula-notes:formula_23.22:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on individual selection under pure selfing to show how the response depends on the genetic variance among inbred lines and the environmental variance, supporting the argument that selection efficiency is determined by heritability in this breeding system.

formula-notes:formula_23.22:zh.plainMeaning: 公式 (23.22) 计算选择响应 R，等于选择差 S 乘以遗传方差与表型方差的比值（即遗传力），其中遗传方差是自交系间遗传方差（包含加性、显性及上位性方差），σ_e^2 是环境方差。
formula-notes:formula_23.22:zh.inThisChapter: 在纯自交个体选择章节中，该公式用于预测对自交系进行一代选择后的平均表型变化，为后续讨论自交系选择效率及与杂合群体比较提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_23.21:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算完全自交系群体中亲本与子代之间的协方差，等于总遗传方差σ̃_G²，它由加性方差σ_A²的两倍、加性×加性上位方差σ_ADI的两倍以及加性×加性×加性上位方差σ_DI²组成。
formula-notes:formula_23.21:zh.inThisChapter: 在本节“纯自交下的个体选择”中，该公式用于量化自交导致遗传方差从随机交配群体的σ_A²+σ_D²转变为纯系群体总遗传方差σ̃_G²的过程，为后续推导自交系间选择响应提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_23.23:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the genetic covariance between a relative in generation T and its ancestor in generation t (t < T) under strict selfing, where f_t and f_T are inbreeding coefficients, σ²_A is additive variance, σ²_D is dominance variance, ι* is a function of inbreeding, σ_ADI is additive-by-dominance interaction variance, and σ²_DI is dominance-by-dominance interaction variance.
formula-notes:formula_23.23:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on family selection with inbreeding and random mating to quantify the genetic covariance across generations, which is essential for predicting response to selection and designing breeding schemes under inbreeding.

formula-notes:formula_23.20b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算在亲本均被选择且存在近交与随机交配时，对S_k家系进行选择的每代响应R_{S_K}。分子中(2-2^{-k})σ_A^2 + 2(1-2^{-k})σ_{ADI}表示加性方差σ_A^2和加性×显性互作方差σ_{ADI}的加权组合，分母为家系内表型方差σ_g^2(S_k)与误差方差σ_e^2(S_k)之和的平方根，乘以平均选择强度ī/(k+1)。
formula-notes:formula_23.20b:zh.inThisChapter: 本章讨论近交与随机交配下的家系选择，此公式（23.20b）与23.20a和23.20c共同构成对S_k家系选择响应的完整表达式，为后续比较不同交配设计（如全同胞、半同胞家系）的选择效率提供量化基础。

formula-notes:formula_23.23:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算严格自交下，第T代亲属与第t代祖先（t<T）之间的跨代遗传协方差σ_G(T,t)，其中f_t和f_T分别为第t代和第T代的近交系数，σ_A^2为加性方差，σ_D^2为显性方差，ι*为近交显性均值参数，σ_ADI为加性×显性×近交互作方差，σ_DI^2为显性×近交互作方差。
formula-notes:formula_23.23:zh.inThisChapter: 本章讨论近交与随机交配下的家系选择，该公式用于量化不同世代间遗传协方差，为后续推导表型方差σ^2(z_t)及选择响应提供关键协方差结构。

formula-notes:formula_23.24:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the cumulative response to selection R(T) over T generations of selfing, where S_t is the selection differential at generation t, σ_A^2 is the additive genetic variance, σ_e^2 is the environmental variance, and the term (2-2^{-t})σ_A^2 represents the additive genetic variance at generation t under complete additivity.
formula-notes:formula_23.24:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on individual selection under pure selfing to quantify the total response when selection is applied during inbreeding, supporting the derivation of the expected response under complete additivity as given by Brim and Cockerham (1961).

formula-notes:formula_23.27:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the genetic covariance between an individual in generation t and a completely inbred (F∞) line descended from it, expressed as a weighted sum of additive variance (σA²), additive-by-dominance interaction variance (σADI), and dominance variance (σDI²), with coefficients that depend on t.
formula-notes:formula_23.27:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on individual selection under pure selfing to show that for t > 5, this covariance approximates the permanent genetic variance σ̃G² (Equation 23.21), thereby demonstrating that additive variance contributes to permanent response while dominance and interaction variances contribute transiently.

formula-notes:formula_23.26:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the permanent response to T generations of selection, which is the cumulative sum over generations of the selection differential S_t (or standardized selection differential ī_t) weighted by the covariance between an individual in generation t and a completely inbred line (σ_G(∞,t)), divided by the phenotypic standard deviation (√(σ_G(t,t)+σ_e²)).
formula-notes:formula_23.26:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on individual selection under pure selfing to quantify the long-term genetic gain from selection when inbreeding is complete (f∞=1), supporting the argument that the response depends on the covariance with the inbred state and the phenotypic variance.

formula-notes:formula_23.24:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算在纯合自交过程中，经过T代选择后的总响应R(T)，其中每一代t的选择响应由选择差S_t乘以遗传方差占比（加性遗传方差(2-2^{-t})σ_A^2除以总表型方差）得到，并累加所有世代。
formula-notes:formula_23.24:zh.inThisChapter: 在“纯自交下的个体选择”章节中，该公式将之前推导的世代内加性遗传方差表达式(1+f_t)σ_A^2 = (2-2^{-t})σ_A^2代入响应公式(23.4)，从而得到自交过程中累积选择响应的具体形式，为后续讨论显性效应下的响应分解（瞬时应答与永久应答）提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_23.26:zh.plainMeaning: 公式计算经过T代选择后的永久响应，即完全近交（F∞）系与选择个体的遗传协方差σ_G(∞,t)加权和，其中权重为选择差S_t或标准化选择强度ī_t除以表型标准差。
formula-notes:formula_23.26:zh.inThisChapter: 在纯自交个体选择章节中，该公式将短期选择响应（每代选择差）与长期遗传协方差结合，为后续推导完全近交下的累积响应提供基础，并利用f∞=1简化协方差结构。

formula-notes:formula_23.27:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算在纯自交下，第t代个体与其完全近交（F∞）后代系之间的遗传协方差σ_G(∞,t)，它由加性方差σ_A^2、加性×显性互作方差σ_ADI和显性方差σ_DI^2的加权和组成，权重依赖于世代t。
formula-notes:formula_23.27:zh.inThisChapter: 在“纯自交下的个体选择”一节中，公式23.27利用f_∞=1的条件，从公式23.23推导而来，用于量化长期选择响应中遗传方差的贡献，并为后续说明加性方差驱动永久响应、而σ̃_D^2和ι*影响短期响应提供数学基础。

formula-notes:formula_23.25:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the expected total change in the mean phenotype after n generations, given that selection acted only during the first T generations (0 to T-1). It sums over those T generations the selection differential S_t (or standardized intensity ĩ_t) weighted by the genetic covariance σ_G(n,t) between generation n and t, scaled by the total phenotypic variance at generation t (σ_G(t,t)+σ_e²).
formula-notes:formula_23.25:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on individual selection under pure selfing to quantify the cumulative response to selection when the genetic variance changes over time due to inbreeding. This supports later arguments about how the long-term response depends on the transient dynamics of genetic variance and the timing of selection.

formula-notes:formula_23.28:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the total genotypic variance σ_G(T,t) after T generations of selfing, starting from generation t, as a weighted sum of additive (σ_A^2), dominance (σ_D^2), and epistatic (σ_{AA}^2, etc.) variance components, with coefficients involving c_t = 2 - 1/2^t and a factor 2^{-T} for dominance.
formula-notes:formula_23.28:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on individual selection under pure selfing to show how the genotypic variance changes with selfing generations, supporting later arguments about the efficiency of selection in selfing populations.

formula-notes:formula_23.25:zh.plainMeaning: 公式计算在自交群体中，经过T代选择后，第n代的期望总响应R(n|T)。它等于前T代每代的选择差S_t乘以遗传协方差σ_G(n,t)与表型方差(σ_G(t,t)+σ_e^2)之比，或等价地等于标准化选择强度ῑ_t乘以σ_G(n,t)与表型标准差之比。
formula-notes:formula_23.25:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在“纯自交下的个体选择”章节，用于量化自交导致的世代间遗传协方差对长期选择响应的影响，为后续讨论自交对响应衰减的作用提供数学基础。

formula-notes:formula_23.28:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算自交群体中第T代总遗传方差σ_G(T,t)的分解，其中c_t=2-1/2^t是自交系数，σ_A^2、σ_D^2、σ_AA^2等分别表示加性、显性和上位性方差分量，系数c_t的幂次和2^{-T}反映了自交导致的方差组分变化。
formula-notes:formula_23.28:zh.inThisChapter: 本章讨论纯自交下的个体选择，公式23.28从公式23.23推导而来，用于量化自交过程中遗传方差如何从初始分量（如σ_A^2）随世代T和自交代数t衰减或重组，为后续预测选择响应和设计育种方案提供数学基础。

formula-notes:formula_23.29:zh.plainMeaning: 公式23.29计算在纯自交群体中，从F2代开始进行T代个体选择后的总响应R(n|T)，其中n是自交代数，T是选择代数；关键符号：σ_A^2和σ_D^2分别是加性和显性遗传方差，σ_e^2是环境方差，ī_t是第t代的选择强度。
formula-notes:formula_23.29:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在“纯自交下的个体选择”一节，是公式23.25在自交群体（F2起始）下的简化形式，用于量化自交导致的遗传方差变化对选择响应的影响，为后续讨论自交对选择效率的影响提供定量基础。

formula-notes:formula_23.29:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the cumulative selection response R(n|T) after T generations of individual selection starting from F2, where n is the generation of selfing for variance components. Key symbols: R(n|T) = response after T cycles, i̅_t = standardized selection intensity in generation t, σ_A^2 = additive variance, σ_D^2 = dominance variance, σ_e^2 = environmental variance.
formula-notes:formula_23.29:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on individual selection under pure selfing to show how the response accumulates over generations, accounting for the changing genetic variance due to inbreeding. It supports the argument that early generations contribute more to response because of higher additive variance.

formula-notes:formula_23.30:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the additive genetic variance in generation t+1 after truncation selection under pure selfing, where σ_A^2(t) is the variance in generation t, σ_{A_o}^2(t) is the total additive variance in an unselected population after t generations of selfing, ī is the selection intensity, x_{[1-p]} is the truncation point, and σ_e^2 is the environmental variance.
formula-notes:formula_23.30:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on individual selection under pure selfing to model how selection reduces additive variance over generations, supporting the derivation of response to selection and long-term genetic gain in selfing populations.

formula-notes:formula_23.30:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算在自交群体中经过t代截断选择后，第t+1代加性遗传方差σ_A^2(t+1)的值。它由三部分构成：未选择群体中第t+1代与第t代总加性方差之差σ_{A_o}^2(t+1)-σ_{A_o}^2(t)，加上经选择强度校正后的当前代方差[1-ī(ī-x_{[1-p]})σ_A^2(t)/(σ_A^2(t)+σ_e^2)]σ_A^2(t)。
formula-notes:formula_23.30:zh.inThisChapter: 本节讨论纯系自交下的个体选择，公式(23.30)用于量化连续自交和选择共同作用下加性方差的动态变化，为后续推导选择响应或长期选择极限提供递推关系。

formula-notes:formula_23.31b:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the covariance between relatives in generations T and t under pure selfing in the absence of selection, expressed as a function of additive genetic variance σ_A^2 and dominance variance σ_D^2, with coefficients depending on the number of generations of selfing (t) and the generation gap (T).
formula-notes:formula_23.31b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on individual selection under pure selfing to provide the baseline covariance without selection, which is then used in Equation 23.31a to incorporate the effects of selection via the iterative reduction term.

formula-notes:formula_23.31c:en.plainMeaning: This formula gives the initial genetic variance at generation T under pure selfing with no selection, as the sum of additive variance and dominance variance halved each generation.
formula-notes:formula_23.31c:en.inThisChapter: It provides the starting point for iterating Equation 23.31a, which describes how genetic variance changes under selfing without selection, supporting the analysis of individual selection in pure selfing lines.

formula-notes:formula_23.31a:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the cross-generational genetic covariance σ_G(T,t) under pure selfing with selection, as the baseline covariance σ_{G_o}(T,t) minus a selection adjustment term involving the selection intensity ī, the truncation point x_{[1-p]}, and a sum over generations k of products of covariances divided by the sum of genetic variance and environmental variance σ_e^2.
formula-notes:formula_23.31a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on individual selection under pure selfing to show how selection reduces the genetic covariance between generations relative to the no-selection case, supporting later derivations of response to selection and prediction of genetic gain.

formula-notes:formula_23.31c:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算在无选择且完全自交的初始世代（T=0）时，遗传方差σ_G(T,0)等于加性方差σ_A^2加上2^{-T}倍显性方差σ_D^2，其中T=0使得2^{-T}=1，因此初始遗传方差为σ_A^2+σ_D^2。
formula-notes:formula_23.31c:zh.inThisChapter: 本章讨论纯自交下的个体选择，该公式作为迭代求解方程23.31a的初始条件，为后续推导自交代数增加时遗传方差的变化提供起点。

formula-notes:formula_23.31b:zh.plainMeaning: 公式(23.31b)计算在无选择条件下，自交群体中世代t和T个体间的遗传协方差σ_{G_o}(T,t)，它等于(2-2^{-t})乘以加性方差σ_A^2加上2^{-T}倍显性方差σ_D^2的和。
formula-notes:formula_23.31b:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在个体选择纯自交章节，作为有选择时协方差公式(23.31a)中σ_{G_o}(T,t)的表达式，为后续推导选择下的协方差提供无选择基准项。

formula-notes:formula_23.33:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the genetic variance σ_G among families in a pure-line cross under selfing, as a function of generations T, τ, t. Key symbols: σ_A^2 (additive variance), σ_D^2 (dominance variance), σ_AA^2 (additive-by-additive epistatic variance), f_t = 1 - 1/2^t (inbreeding coefficient).
formula-notes:formula_23.33:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on family selection under pure selfing to simplify the general expression (Equation 23.32) for the special case of a pure-line cross, supporting later arguments on selection response and variance components.

formula-notes:formula_23.31a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算在纯自交且存在选择的情况下，世代T与t之间的遗传协方差σ_G(T,t)，它等于无选择时的协方差σ_{G_o}(T,t)减去一个由选择强度(̄ı)、截断点x_{[1-p]}以及前t-1代协方差项构成的校正项。
formula-notes:formula_23.31a:zh.inThisChapter: 本章讨论纯自交下的个体选择，该公式用于量化选择对世代间遗传协方差的衰减作用，为后续推导选择响应和预测遗传进展提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_23.32:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the genetic covariance between relatives in generations T and τ (τ ≤ T) whose last common ancestor is in generation t (t ≤ τ), under pure selfing. Key symbols: σ²_A (additive variance), σ²_D (dominance variance), σ_ADI (additive-by-dominance interaction variance), σ²_DI (dominance-by-dominance interaction variance), ι* (inbreeding depression parameter), σ²_{A^k} (higher-order additive epistatic variances), and f_t, f_T, f_τ (inbreeding coefficients at generations t, T, τ).
formula-notes:formula_23.32:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on family selection under pure selfing to quantify the covariance between relatives needed for predicting response to selection. This formula supports later arguments by reducing to simpler cases (e.g., Equation 23.23 when τ = t) and by showing how inbreeding coefficients and epistatic terms affect selection accuracy.

formula-notes:formula_23.34a:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the total genetic variance among selection units at equilibrium (generation ∞) when remnant seed from generation t is used to form new lines, as a function of inbreeding coefficients f_t and f_τ, additive variance σ_A², additive-by-dominance interaction variance σ_ADI, dominance variance σ_DI², and higher-order additive epistatic variances σ_{A^k}².
formula-notes:formula_23.34a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on family selection under pure selfing to quantify the genetic variance among lines derived from remnant seed, which is essential for predicting response to selection and comparing selection strategies in selfing populations.

formula-notes:formula_23.32:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算在纯自交家系选择中，两个个体（分别处于世代T和τ）之间的遗传协方差σ_G，其中它们最近的共同祖先位于世代t。公式将协方差分解为加性方差σ_A²、显性方差σ_D²、加性×显性互作方差σ_ADI、显性×显性互作方差σ_DI²、近交衰退参数ι*以及高阶加性互作方差σ_{A^k}²的贡献，各分量权重由近交系数f_t、f_T、f_τ决定。
formula-notes:formula_23.32:zh.inThisChapter: 本章（纯自交家系选择）中，该公式用于量化不同世代个体间的遗传协方差，为后续推导选择响应和预测遗传进展提供基础。它从一般公式（11.15）引出，并当τ=t时简化为公式（23.23），从而连接了亲本与后代间的协方差。

formula-notes:formula_23.33:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算在纯系杂交（自交）下，以世代T、τ和t为参数的遗传方差σ_G，其中f_t=1-1/2^t，σ_A^2为加性方差，σ_D^2为显性方差，σ_AA^2为加性×加性上位方差。
formula-notes:formula_23.33:zh.inThisChapter: 本章讨论纯自交下的家系选择，公式23.33从23.32简化而来，通过代入纯系杂交条件（ι^*=σ_D^2, σ_DI^2=σ_ADI=0）得到，为后续推导选择响应或方差组分估计提供具体表达式。

formula-notes:formula_23.34b:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the total genotypic variance at generation infinity under pure selfing, as a weighted sum of additive and additive-by-additive epistatic variance components, where each component is scaled by powers of (1+f_t).
formula-notes:formula_23.34b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on family selection under pure selfing to show that, when dominance and dominance-related epistatic variances are zero, the permanent response depends only on additive and additive epistatic effects, supporting the use of this simplified variance expression in selection predictions.

formula-notes:formula_23.35a:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the total genetic variance in generation T under pure selfing, as a function of the inbreeding coefficient f_T, additive variance σ_A^2, dominance variance σ_D^2, additive-by-dominance interaction variance σ_ADI, dominance-by-dominance interaction variance σ_DI^2, and a composite term ι* involving higher-order epistasis.
formula-notes:formula_23.35a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on family selection under pure selfing to quantify how genetic variance components change with inbreeding, supporting later arguments about the efficiency of selection among selfed families.

formula-notes:formula_23.34b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算在纯系杂交后自交至完全纯合（∞代）时，永久遗传方差σ_G(∞,τ,t)由加性效应方差σ_A^2和各级加性×加性上位方差σ_{A^k}^2乘以系数(1+f_t)^k求和得到，其中f_t是近交系数。
formula-notes:formula_23.34b:zh.inThisChapter: 本章讨论纯自交下的家系选择，公式(23.34b)在(23.34a)基础上简化了非加性分量，为后续推导纯自交后代选择响应提供永久方差表达式。

formula-notes:formula_23.35b:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the total genetic variance across all lines in generation T under pure selfing, where σ_A^2 is additive variance, σ_D^2 is dominance variance, and f_T is the inbreeding coefficient at generation T.
formula-notes:formula_23.35b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on family selection under pure selfing to quantify the genetic variance available for selection among lines, supporting later arguments about selection response and the effect of inbreeding on variance components.

formula-notes:formula_23.37a:en.plainMeaning: This formula decomposes the total genetic covariance σ_G(T,t) into the sum of within-family covariance σ_Gw(T,t) and among-family covariance σ_Gb(T,t).
formula-notes:formula_23.37a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to selection under inbreeding to partition genetic variance into components that are affected differently by inbreeding, supporting later derivations of selection response under inbreeding.

formula-notes:formula_23.36b:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the genetic variance among F4 families derived from an F2 individual under pure selfing, where σ_A^2 and σ_D^2 are additive and dominance variances, and f_t and f_T are inbreeding coefficients at times t and T.
formula-notes:formula_23.36b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on family selection under pure selfing to quantify the genetic variance among families, which is essential for predicting response to selection and designing breeding strategies.

formula-notes:formula_23.34a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算在纯自交系选择中，当系谱中所有个体最终都来自世代t的同一祖先时，无限代后（∞）群体遗传方差σ_G(∞,τ,t)的组成，它分解为加性方差σ_A^2、加性×显性互作方差σ_ADI、显性×显性方差σ_DI^2以及各阶加性上位方差σ_{A^k}^2的加权和，权重依赖于近交系数f_t和f_τ。
formula-notes:formula_23.34a:zh.inThisChapter: 本章讨论纯自交下的家系选择，公式23.34a是23.32式的特例，用于量化当所有系谱最终共享同一祖先（如使用世代t的残余种子）时，无限代后遗传方差的持久结构，为后续比较不同选择策略的长期响应提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_23.35b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算在纯系自交T代后，整个群体（所有家系间）的遗传方差σ_G(T,T,T)，它等于加性方差σ_A^2乘以(1+f_T)加上显性方差σ_D^2乘以(1-f_T)(1+f_T)，其中f_T是T代的近交系数。
formula-notes:formula_23.35b:zh.inThisChapter: 本章讨论纯自交下的家系选择，此公式出现在推导群体遗传方差的分量中，为后续计算家系间选择响应或遗传力提供基础，它依赖于公式23.35a中家系内方差的表达式。

formula-notes:formula_23.36a:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the genetic variance at generation T among lines descending from a single individual at generation t, under pure selfing. Key symbols: σ²_A (additive), σ²_D (dominance), σ_ADI (additive-by-dominance interaction variance), σ²_DI (dominance-by-dominance interaction variance), ι* (homozygote dominance contribution), f_t and f_T (inbreeding coefficients at generations t and T).
formula-notes:formula_23.36a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on family selection under pure selfing to quantify the variance among lines derived from a common ancestor, which is essential for predicting response to selection and designing breeding schemes. This variance expression supports later arguments about the efficiency of family selection relative to individual selection.

formula-notes:formula_23.37b:en.plainMeaning: This formula defines the among-family genetic covariance in generation t, σ_{Gb}(T,t), as the genetic covariance between sibs from the same parent in generation t-1, σ_G(T,t,t-1).
formula-notes:formula_23.37b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to selection under inbreeding to relate the among-family variance component to the covariance across generations, which is used to partition genetic variance and predict response to selection under inbreeding.

formula-notes:formula_23.35a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算第T代自交群体的总遗传方差σ_G(T,T,T)，它由加性方差σ_A^2、显性方差σ_D^2、加性×显性互作方差σ_ADI、显性×显性互作方差σ_DI^2以及高阶互作项ι*组成，各项权重依赖于近交系数f_T。
formula-notes:formula_23.35a:zh.inThisChapter: 在本章“纯自交下的家系选择”中，该公式用于量化自交导致的遗传方差变化，为后续推导第T代家系间方差（公式23.35b）提供基础，从而评估自交对选择响应的影响。

formula-notes:formula_23.37a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将总遗传协方差σ_G(T,t)分解为家系内遗传协方差σ_{Gw}(T,t)与家系间遗传协方差σ_{Gb}(T,t)之和，其中T和t分别表示两个不同时间点或性状。
formula-notes:formula_23.37a:zh.inThisChapter: 本章讨论近交下的选择，该分解用于区分近交导致的遗传方差在家族内部和家族之间的分布，为后续推导近交对选择响应的影响（如公式23.37b和23.37c）提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_23.37b:zh.plainMeaning: 公式 (23.37b) 将世代 t 的家族间遗传方差 σ_{Gb}(T,t) 定义为世代 t 与 t-1 之间的遗传协方差 σ_G(T,t,t-1)，即同一亲本在 t-1 代产生的后代在 t 代时的遗传协方差。
formula-notes:formula_23.37b:zh.inThisChapter: 本章讨论近交下的选择，该公式出现在引入部分，用于建立家族间遗传方差与世代间遗传协方差的联系，为后续推导近交对遗传方差分量和选择响应的影响提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_23.36a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算在自交系选择中，从第t代单个个体出发的后代家系在第T代时的遗传方差σ_G(T,T,t)，它分解为加性方差σ_A^2、显性方差σ_D^2、加性×显性互作方差σ_ADI、显性×显性互作方差σ_DI^2以及上位性方差ι*的加权和，权重由近交系数f_t和f_T决定。
formula-notes:formula_23.36a:zh.inThisChapter: 本章讨论纯自交下的家系选择，该公式用于量化从第t代单个个体衍生出的家系在第T代时的遗传变异，为后续推导选择响应和比较不同选择策略提供方差分量表达式。

formula-notes:formula_23.38:en.plainMeaning: This formula expresses the covariance between two gene copies T and τ that share an ancestor in generation t from subpopulation k as the difference between the covariance for sharing an ancestor in generation t and that for sharing in generation k, for t > k.
formula-notes:formula_23.38:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to selection under inbreeding to decompose the total covariance into components from different ancestral generations, supporting later arguments about the effects of inbreeding on genetic variance and selection response.

formula-notes:formula_23.37c:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将家系内遗传协方差 σ_{Gw}(T,t) 定义为总遗传协方差 σ_G(T,t) 减去家系间遗传协方差 σ_{Gb}(T,t)，并进一步用两个不同时间点的总遗传协方差之差表示，即 σ_G(T,t,t) 与 σ_G(T,t,t-1) 的差。
formula-notes:formula_23.37c:zh.inThisChapter: 本章讨论近交下的选择，需要分解遗传方差为家系内和家系间组分。该公式提供了家系内遗传协方差的计算方式，为后续推导近交对选择响应的影响奠定基础。

formula-notes:formula_23.37c:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the within-family genetic covariance σ_{Gw}(T,t) as the difference between the total genetic covariance σ_G(T,t) and the between-family genetic covariance σ_{Gb}(T,t), which is equivalent to the difference between the genetic covariance of individuals with the same age (t,t) and that of individuals with ages differing by one year (t,t-1).
formula-notes:formula_23.37c:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on selection under inbreeding to decompose genetic variance into within- and between-family components, supporting later arguments about how inbreeding affects the response to selection by altering the partitioning of genetic variance.

formula-notes:formula_23.40a:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the permanent (fully inbred) genetic variance after one generation of selection on S_{t,t+1} families under pure selfing, as a function of the inbreeding coefficient f_t and additive, additive-by-dominance, dominance, and additive-by-additive variance components.
formula-notes:formula_23.40a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on family selection under pure selfing to quantify the long-term response from selecting on selfed families, supporting the comparison with selection on later-generation families (e.g., S_{t,t+2}) in Equation 23.40b.

formula-notes:formula_23.39:zh.plainMeaning: 公式 (23.39) 计算在世代 t 对亲本进行选择后，世代 T 的响应 R(T,τ,t)，它等于选择强度 ī 乘以遗传协方差 σ_G(T,τ,t) 与选择单位表型标准差（即 √[σ_G(τ,τ,t)+σ_e²]）的比值。
formula-notes:formula_23.39:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在“纯自交下的家系选择”一节，用于推导从 S_{t,τ} 家系（即亲本自交后代）中选择时的响应，为后续比较不同选择单位（如亲本 vs 后代）的效率提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_23.38:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将来自亚群k、共同祖先在t代的个体间协方差σ_G(T,τ,t,k)表示为两个协方差的差：σ_G(T,τ,t)（共同祖先在t代，不考虑亚群）减去σ_G(T,τ,k)（共同祖先在k代，不考虑亚群），其中t>k。
formula-notes:formula_23.38:zh.inThisChapter: 本章讨论近交下的选择，公式(23.38)用于分解不同世代和亚群来源的遗传协方差，为后续推导近交群体中亲属间协方差结构提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_23.40b:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the long-term genetic variance (σ_G) after selection based on S_{t,t+2} families (two generations after selfing), as a function of additive variance (σ_A^2), additive-by-dominance interaction variance (σ_ADI), dominance interaction variance (σ_DI^2), and additive-by-additive epistatic variance (σ_AA^2), all weighted by the inbreeding coefficient f_t.
formula-notes:formula_23.40b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on family selection under pure selfing to compare the long-term response of selecting on S_{t,t+1} vs. S_{t,t+2} families, showing that only the dominance-related terms (σ_ADI and σ_DI^2) differ between the two schemes.

formula-notes:formula_23.39:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the response to selection (R) when selecting among S_{t,τ} families, where the selection differential is scaled by the genetic covariance between selection unit and offspring generation (σ_G(T,τ,t)) divided by the square root of the total phenotypic variance of the selection unit (σ_G(τ,τ,t) + σ_e^2). Key symbols: R = response, ī = standardized selection differential, σ_G(T,τ,t) = genetic covariance between generation T and τ families from selection at t, σ_G(τ,τ,t) = genetic variance of S_{t,τ} families, σ_e^2 = error variance.
formula-notes:formula_23.39:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on family selection under pure selfing to quantify the expected genetic gain from selecting among S_{t,τ} families, supporting the argument that response depends on the covariance between the selection unit and the target generation relative to the selection unit's phenotypic variance.

formula-notes:formula_23.41a:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the covariance between the genotypic value of an individual in generation t+1 and the family mean (based on n members) from one generation of selfing, as a weighted average of the within-family covariance (σ_G(∞, t+1, t+1)) and the between-family covariance (σ_G(∞, t+1, t)).
formula-notes:formula_23.41a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on family selection under pure selfing to quantify the covariance needed for predicting response to selection when families of size n are scored, supporting the derivation of selection response formulas.

formula-notes:formula_23.40a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算在自交系选择中，基于S_{t,t+1}家系进行选择后，最终完全近交系（∞代）的永久遗传方差，其中σ_A^2为加性方差，σ_ADI为加性×显性互作方差，σ_DI^2为显性方差，σ_AA^2为加性×加性上位方差，f_t为t代的近交系数。
formula-notes:formula_23.40a:zh.inThisChapter: 本章讨论纯自交下的家系选择，公式23.40a给出了基于S_{t,t+1}家系（自交一代）选择后的永久响应，为后续与基于S_{t,t+2}家系（自交两代）的公式23.40b对比提供基础，以评估不同自交代数对选择效果的影响。

formula-notes:formula_23.40b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算基于S_{t,t+2}家系选择时，长期（∞世代）遗传方差σ_G(∞,t+2,t)，它由加性方差σ_A^2、加性×显性互作方差σ_ADI、显性方差σ_DI^2和加性×加性上位方差σ_AA^2组成，各分量乘以包含近交系数f_t的系数。
formula-notes:formula_23.40b:zh.inThisChapter: 在本章“纯自交下的家系选择”中，公式(23.40b)与(23.40a)对比，说明两种家系选择方案（基于S_{t,t+1}与S_{t,t+2}）的长期响应差异仅体现在显性相关项σ_ADI和σ_DI^2的系数上，为后续讨论不同家系结构对选择响应的影响提供定量依据。

formula-notes:formula_23.41b:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the covariance between the genotypic value of a family (based on two generations of selfing) and the phenotypic value of its members, used in family selection. Key symbols: n = number of individuals per family, σ_G(∞, t+2, t+2) = genotypic covariance among individuals from the same family after two generations of selfing, σ_G(∞, t+2, t+1) = covariance between an individual from generation t+2 and its parent from generation t+1, σ_G(∞, t+2, t) = covariance between an individual from generation t+2 and its grandparent from generation t.
formula-notes:formula_23.41b:en.inThisChapter: This formula appears in the section on family selection under pure selfing to provide the appropriate covariance when selection is based on two generations of selfing, supporting the derivation of selection response and comparison with simpler versions like Equation 23.40a.

formula-notes:formula_23.41a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算在纯自交一代后，基于包含n个家系成员的家族进行永久响应选择时，家系均值与个体育种值之间的协方差。其中σ_G(∞,t+1,t+1)是同一家系内个体间协方差，σ_G(∞,t+1,t)是不同家系个体间协方差，权重分别为1/n和(n-1)/n。
formula-notes:formula_23.41a:zh.inThisChapter: 本章讨论纯自交下的家族选择，该公式出现在推导家系选择响应时，为后续公式(23.41b)中计算选择响应提供协方差基础，并展示了家系大小n如何影响协方差结构。

formula-notes:formula_23.41b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算在自交两代（t+2）后，基于n个家系进行家系选择时，家系均值间的协方差。它由三项组成：第一项是家系内个体间遗传协方差（σ_G(∞,t+2,t+2)）除以n²，第二项是不同家系但同一年代的协方差（σ_G(∞,t+2,t+1)）乘以(n-1)/n²，第三项是不同家系且不同年代的协方差（σ_G(∞,t+2,t)）乘以(n-1)/n。
formula-notes:formula_23.41b:zh.inThisChapter: 本章讨论纯自交下的家系选择，公式23.41b是公式23.41a的简化版本（当某些项可忽略时），用于计算基于两代自交后家系均值的协方差，为后续推导选择响应或遗传增益提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_23.42a:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the remaining response in generation T from within-family selection performed in generation t, where r_w is the response, ī_t is the standardized selection differential, σ_Gw(T,t) is the within-family genetic covariance between generations T and t, σ_Gw(t,t) is the within-family genetic variance in generation t, and σ²_Ew is the within-family environmental variance.
formula-notes:formula_23.42a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on family selection under pure selfing to quantify how within-family selection response decays over generations due to rapid loss of genetic variation, and it supports the subsequent derivation of the total response by applying Equation 23.37c to express σ_Gw in terms of total genetic components.

formula-notes:formula_23.42b:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the within-family selection response r_w(T,t) as the product of the standardized selection intensity ī_t and the ratio of the between-generation genetic covariance difference to the square root of the within-family phenotypic variance (genetic variance within families plus environmental variance σ²_{E_w}).
formula-notes:formula_23.42b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on family selection under pure selfing to express the response when selection is based on within-family deviations, and it supports the derivation of the overall selection response by linking genetic covariances across generations to within-family variance components.

formula-notes:formula_23.42a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算在自交系选择中，第t代进行家系内选择对第T代（T≥t）的剩余响应r_w(T,t)，分子是选择强度ī_t乘以第t代家系内遗传协方差σ_Gw(T,t)，分母是第t代家系内表型标准差（遗传方差σ_Gw(t,t)加环境方差σ_Ew²的平方根）。
formula-notes:formula_23.42a:zh.inThisChapter: 本章讨论纯自交下的家系选择，公式(23.42a)给出了家系内选择响应随时间衰减的定量表达式，为后续利用(23.37c)将其转化为遗传方差分量形式（即公式23.42b-d）提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_23.42c:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the change in genotypic variance between two consecutive generations (t and t-1) under pure selfing, decomposed into additive (σ²_A), dominance (σ²_D), and additive-by-additive epistatic (σ²_{A^ℓ}) components, with coefficients depending on generation numbers t and T.
formula-notes:formula_23.42c:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on family selection under pure selfing to quantify the reduction in genetic variance due to inbreeding, which is essential for predicting the cumulative response to selection over multiple generations.

formula-notes:formula_23.42b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算在纯自交家系选择中，基于家系内个体表型值的响应 r_w(T,t)，它等于选择强度 ī_t 乘以家系内遗传标准差（σ_G(T,t,t) - σ_G(T,t,t-1)）除以家系内表型标准差（√[σ_G(t,t,t) - σ_G(t,t,t-1) + σ_{E_w}^2]）。
formula-notes:formula_23.42b:zh.inThisChapter: 此公式由公式23.42a通过代入公式23.37c（遗传协方差分解）推导而来，将家系内遗传方差表示为不同世代遗传协方差之差，为后续推导家系内选择响应（如公式23.42c、23.42d）提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_23.42c:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算纯系杂交后代中，经过t代自交和T代选择后，遗传方差分量σ_G(T,t,t)与σ_G(T,t,t-1)之差，其中σ_A^2为加性方差，σ_D^2为显性方差，σ_{A^ℓ}^2为ℓ阶加性×加性上位方差。
formula-notes:formula_23.42c:zh.inThisChapter: 在本章“纯系自交下的家系选择”中，该公式用于量化选择响应中遗传方差的衰减，为后续推导累积选择响应R(T|k)提供基础，特别是当忽略上位效应时，可简化响应表达式。

formula-notes:formula_23.42d:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the cumulative response R(T|k) after k generations of selection, measured at generation T > k, as the sum over t=1 to k of selection intensity ī_t times a ratio: the numerator is the additive genetic variance σ_A^2 scaled by 2^{-t} plus dominance variance σ_D^2 scaled by 2^{-T}, and the denominator is the square root of the sum of total genetic variance (σ_A^2+σ_D^2) scaled by 2^{-t} plus within-family environmental variance σ_{E_w}^2.
formula-notes:formula_23.42d:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on family selection under pure selfing to quantify the long-term response when selection is applied for k generations but response is measured later at generation T, supporting the argument that early selection captures additive variance while later dominance contributes little.

formula-notes:formula_23.42d:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算在纯自交家系选择中，经过k代选择后，在T代（T>k）时的累积响应R(T|k)。分子中，2^{-t}σ_A^2 + 2^{-T}σ_D^2表示第t代选择后加性方差和显性方差对响应贡献的加权和，分母是第t代表型方差（包括加性、显性和环境方差）的平方根，整体乘以第t代的选择强度ī_t并求和。
formula-notes:formula_23.42d:zh.inThisChapter: 在“纯自交下家系选择”章节中，该公式在忽略上位性（由23.42c推导）后，给出了多代选择累积响应的显式表达式，为后续比较不同选择策略或预测长期响应提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_23.43a:zh.plainMeaning: 该不等式表明，自交第t代后，表型方差σ_z^2至少为加性方差σ_A^2和显性方差σ_D^2之和的2^{-t}倍加上环境方差σ_{E_w}^2，且该下界不超过σ_z^2。
formula-notes:formula_23.43a:zh.inThisChapter: 在纯自交家系选择章节中，该公式用于量化自交导致遗传方差快速衰减，从而限制选择响应；它为后续推导永久响应上界（公式23.43b、23.43c）提供了方差分解基础。

formula-notes:formula_23.43c:en.plainMeaning: This inequality bounds the total permanent response R(∞|∞) under continued within-family selection, where the left side uses the additive genetic variance σ_A^2 and the environmental variance σ_{E_w}, and the right side uses the heritability h and the additive genetic standard deviation σ_A, with ī as the selection intensity.
formula-notes:formula_23.43c:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on family selection under pure selfing to show that the total response from continued within-family selection is at least twice the first-generation response, supporting the argument that such selection is highly effective over multiple generations.

formula-notes:formula_23.43a:en.plainMeaning: This inequality bounds the within-family environmental variance σ²_{E_w} between a lower limit (the left side) and an upper limit (the total phenotypic variance σ²_z). The left side shows that σ²_{E_w} is less than or equal to the sum of a decaying genetic component (2^{-t}(σ²_A + σ²_D)) plus σ²_{E_w} itself, which is a trivial statement; the key is that the right inequality gives σ²_{E_w} ≤ σ²_z.
formula-notes:formula_23.43a:en.inThisChapter: In the context of family selection under pure selfing, this inequality is used to bound the permanent response to selection as t → ∞, because the additive variance σ²_A decays by a factor 2^{-t} each generation. It supports the derivation of the upper bound for the cumulative response in Equation 23.43b.

formula-notes:formula_23.43b:en.plainMeaning: This inequality bounds the permanent response to selection under pure selfing by comparing the sum of selection responses across generations to two simpler sums: one using the within-family environmental standard deviation σ_{E_w} and one using the total phenotypic standard deviation σ_z. Key symbols: ī (selection intensity), σ_A^2 (additive genetic variance), σ_D^2 (dominance variance), σ_{E_w}^2 (within-family environmental variance), σ_z^2 (total phenotypic variance), t (generation index).
formula-notes:formula_23.43b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on family selection under pure selfing to derive the total permanent response R(∞|∞) by bounding the infinite sum of responses, using the inequality from Equation 23.43a. This supports the conclusion that the response converges to a finite value expressed in Equation 23.43c.

formula-notes:formula_23.44:en.plainMeaning: This formula defines an index I_{ij} for selecting individuals in selfing families, combining the family mean \(\overline{z}_{i.}\) weighted by coefficient b and the individual's own value z_{ij}.
formula-notes:formula_23.44:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on family selection under pure selfing to extend the family index concept from Chapter 21 to selfing populations, supporting later arguments on optimal weighting of family vs. individual information.

formula-notes:formula_23.43b:zh.plainMeaning: 该不等式链给出了永久响应（T→∞）的下界和上界：中间项是永久响应的精确表达式（选择强度 ī 乘以加性方差 σ_A² 乘以各世代响应权重 2^{-t} 除以各世代表型标准差），左边用 σ_{E_w} 代替了分母中的平方根（因为 σ_{E_w} 是分母的最小可能值），右边用 σ_z 代替（因为 σ_z 是分母的最大可能值），从而将中间项夹在两个等比级数之间。
formula-notes:formula_23.43b:zh.inThisChapter: 在纯自交家系选择章节中，公式(23.43b)利用(23.43a)对方差分量的不等式，将无限世代累积响应夹在两个收敛级数之间，从而为后续(23.43c)得出永久响应等于 ī σ_A² 提供关键推导步骤。

formula-notes:formula_23.44:zh.plainMeaning: 公式 I_{ij}=b\overline{z}_{i.}+z_{ij} 将个体 i 在家族 j 中的选择指数 I_{ij} 定义为家族均值 \overline{z}_{i.} 乘以权重 b 再加上个体观测值 z_{ij}。
formula-notes:formula_23.44:zh.inThisChapter: 在纯自交系家族选择章节中，该公式用于构建结合家族和个体信息的指数，为后续讨论如何通过调整权重 b 来优化选择响应提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_23.43c:zh.plainMeaning: 该不等式给出了在连续家系内选择下总永久响应 R(∞|∞) 的上下界：上界为平均选择强度 ī 乘以加性遗传方差 σ_A² 除以家系内环境标准差 σ_{E_w}，下界为 ī 乘以 h（h = σ_A/σ_P？但此处写为 hσ_A，可能 h 是 sqrt(heritability)？）再乘以 σ_A。
formula-notes:formula_23.43c:zh.inThisChapter: 在纯自交家系选择章节中，此公式用于量化长期选择响应，表明总响应至少是第一代响应（ī h σ_A/2）的两倍，从而强调家系内选择在自交物种中的累积效果。

formula-notes:formula_23.45:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the expected response in generation T of selfing, where R_y(T) is the response, ī is the selection intensity, σ(I_ij, y_T) is the covariance between the selection criterion I_ij and the trait value y_T in generation T, and σ(I_ij) is the standard deviation of I_ij.
formula-notes:formula_23.45:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on family selection under pure selfing to quantify the response after T generations of selfing, supporting the derivation of permanent response as T approaches infinity.

formula-notes:formula_23.45:zh.plainMeaning: 公式计算自交T代后的响应R_y(T)，等于选择强度乘以选择指标I_ij与自交T代目标性状y_T的协方差除以I_ij的标准差。
formula-notes:formula_23.45:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在纯自交下家系选择章节，通过修改广义育种者方程(13.10b)得到，用于预测自交T代后的响应，并为后续推导永久响应(T=∞)提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_23.46a:en.plainMeaning: This formula defines the variance between crosses, denoted σ²_c(T), as the genotypic variance σ_G(T,1,0) among F₂ populations derived from different crosses under pure selfing.
formula-notes:formula_23.46a:en.inThisChapter: It introduces a key variance component used to partition total genotypic variance into between-cross and within-cross components, simplifying the derivation of selection response formulas in family selection under selfing.

formula-notes:formula_23.46b:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the variance among lines within crosses, σ²_ℓ|c(T), as the difference between the total genetic variance among lines σ_G(T,1,1) and the variance between crosses σ_G(T,1,0).
formula-notes:formula_23.46b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on family selection under pure selfing to decompose total genetic variance into between-cross and within-cross components, which is essential for predicting selection response and designing breeding strategies.

formula-notes:formula_23.46a:zh.plainMeaning: 公式(23.46a)将σ_c²(T)定义为σ_G(T,1,0)，即不同F₂群体（杂交组合）之间的遗传方差，其中σ_G(T,1,0)中的参数(1,0)表示考虑所有自交世代T、一个自交世代（1）和零个重组世代（0）时的遗传方差分量。
formula-notes:formula_23.46a:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在“纯自交下的家系选择”章节中，用于定义杂交组合间的方差分量，为后续引入组合内家系间方差σ_{ℓ|c}²(T)（公式23.46b）以及简化选择响应推导提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_23.46b:zh.plainMeaning: 公式(23.46b)定义了杂交组合内家系间的方差，它等于总遗传方差σ_G(T,1,1)减去杂交组合间方差σ_G(T,1,0)，即从总方差中剔除组合间效应后剩余的、反映同一组合内不同家系偏离组合均值的变异。
formula-notes:formula_23.46b:zh.inThisChapter: 在纯自交系杂交的家族选择章节中，该公式将总遗传方差分解为组合间方差(23.46a)和组合内家系间方差两部分，为后续推导纯系杂交下这些方差的具体表达式（如σ_c^2和σ_ℓ|c^2的遗传组成）提供分解基础。

formula-notes:formula_23.47a:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the variance among pure-line crosses (σ_c²(T)) after T generations of selfing, expressed as a sum of additive (σ_A²), dominance (σ_D²) scaled by 2^{-(T+1)}, and higher-order epistatic components (σ_AA², …, σ_{A^k}²).
formula-notes:formula_23.47a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on family selection under pure selfing to quantify the genetic variation available for selection among crosses, and it supports the later argument that the variance among crosses decreases with selfing generations due to the decay of dominance variance.

formula-notes:formula_23.47b:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the variance among lines within crosses (σ²ℓ|c) after T generations of selfing, as a function of additive (σ²A), dominance (σ²D), and additive-by-additive epistatic (σ²AA, …, σ²A^k) variance components, with coefficients that increase with the order of epistasis.
formula-notes:formula_23.47b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on family selection under pure selfing to provide the within-cross variance component needed for the numerator of Equation 23.45, which evaluates the covariance between line performance and progeny mean for selection response.

formula-notes:formula_23.47a:zh.plainMeaning: 公式(23.47a)将纯系杂交后家系间方差 σ_c²(T) 分解为加性方差 σ_A²、显性方差 σ_D²（乘以系数 2^{-(T+1)}）、加性×加性上位方差 σ_AA² 以及更高阶加性上位方差 σ_{A^k}² 的线性组合，其中 T 表示自交代数。
formula-notes:formula_23.47a:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在“纯系自交下家系选择”一节，用于量化经过 T 代自交后杂交家系间的遗传方差组成，为后续推导家系内方差公式(23.47b)以及比较不同选择策略的效率提供方差分量基础。
