formula-notes:formula_28.28d:en.plainMeaning: This formula gives the equilibrium linkage disequilibrium (LD) between loci i and j, showing it is negative and proportional to the geometric mean of the genetic variances at each locus, divided by the recombination rate r_ij.
formula-notes:formula_28.28d:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to quantitative genetic variation maintenance to demonstrate that negative LD arises at equilibrium under stabilizing selection, independent of selection strength, supporting later arguments about the role of recombination and mutation-selection balance.

formula-notes:formula_28.28c:zh.plainMeaning: 公式(28.28c)给出了当i=j时，第i个突变位点对表型方差的贡献的平方(即C̃_i²)等于该位点的突变率μ_i、效应方差σ_{α_i}²以及总选择强度(V_s + σ̃_A²)的乘积，因此C̃_i是这些量的平方根。
formula-notes:formula_28.28c:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式从(28.28b)退化而来，用于计算单个突变位点维持的遗传方差，为后续推导多位点平衡方差(如公式28.28f)提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_28.28c:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the square of the critical mutation effect size (C̃_i) for a single locus i, where μ_i is the mutation rate, σ_α_i^2 is the variance of mutational effects, V_s is the variance of the stabilizing selection function, and σ̃_A^2 is the equilibrium additive genetic variance.
formula-notes:formula_28.28c:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to maintenance of quantitative genetic variation to derive the condition under which mutation-selection balance can maintain variation, specifically showing that C̃_i depends on the total effective strength of selection (V_s + σ̃_A^2).

formula-notes:formula_28.28a:en.plainMeaning: This recurrence equation computes the change in genetic covariance ΔC_{ij}(t+1) between traits i and j from one generation to the next, incorporating stabilizing selection (first term), recombination (second term), and mutation (third term). Key symbols: C_{ij}(t) is the covariance at time t, C_i(t) and C_j(t) are the genetic variances of traits i and j, V_s is the strength of stabilizing selection, σ_A^2(t) is the total additive genetic variance, r_{ij} is the recombination rate between loci affecting traits i and j, δ_{ij} is the Kronecker delta (1 if i=j, 0 otherwise), μ_i is the mutation rate for trait i, and σ_{α_i}^2 is the variance of mutational effects for trait i.
formula-notes:formula_28.28a:en.inThisChapter: This formula appears in the introduction to maintenance of quantitative genetic variation to derive the equilibrium conditions for genetic variances and covariances under mutation-selection-drift balance. It supports later arguments (e.g., Equation 28.28f) that solve for the equilibrium genetic covariance matrix.

formula-notes:formula_28.28d:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算了平衡状态下不同位点i和j之间的连锁不平衡系数C̃_ij，它等于负的根号下μ_i σ_{α_i}^2 μ_j σ_{m_j}^2除以重组率r_ij，表明平衡时LD为负。
formula-notes:formula_28.28d:zh.inThisChapter: 在本章关于数量遗传变异维持的背景下，该公式给出了多基因平衡下LD的显式解，为后续讨论LD与选择强度无关（如公式28.28f）以及负LD的普遍性提供了定量依据。

formula-notes:formula_28.28a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算遗传协方差C_{ij}在下一代的变化量ΔC_{ij}(t+1)，由三项组成：第一项是稳定性选择导致的协方差减少（与当前协方差C_i(t)C_j(t)成正比），第二项是重组导致的协方差衰减（与当前协方差C_{ij}(t)和重组率r_{ij}成正比），第三项是突变输入（仅当i=j时存在，与突变率μ_i和突变效应方差σ_{α_i}^2成正比）。
formula-notes:formula_28.28a:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在“数量遗传变异的维持”章节的引言部分，通过将选择、重组和突变过程整合到同一递推方程中，为后续推导平衡态协方差（如公式28.28f）和探讨变异维持条件奠定基础。

formula-notes:formula_28.28e:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the diagonal element C̃ᵢᵢ of the transformed genetic covariance matrix, representing the contribution of locus i to the equilibrium additive genetic variance, incorporating mutation (μᵢ, σ²_αᵢ), selection (Vₛ), and pleiotropic effects from other loci (j≠i) scaled by recombination rates rᵢⱼ.
formula-notes:formula_28.28e:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to maintenance of quantitative genetic variation to express C̃ᵢᵢ in terms of mutation and selection parameters, which is then used to derive the equilibrium additive variance σ̃²_A via the relation σ̃²_A = 2∑C̃ᵢ.

formula-notes:formula_28.28b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式是方程28.28a在平衡态（ΔC_{ij}=0）下的形式，它描述了在稳定选择下，遗传协方差C̃_{ij}与遗传方差σ̃_A^2、突变输入δ_{ij}μ_iσ_{α_i}^2之间的平衡关系：左侧第一项是选择对协方差的贡献（通过C̃_i和C̃_j的乘积除以总方差），第二项是重组对协方差的贡献（通过重组率r_{ij}乘以C̃_{ij}），右侧是突变对协方差的输入。
formula-notes:formula_28.28b:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在定量遗传变异维持的章节中，用于推导平衡时遗传协方差的结构。它从动态方程28.28a出发，通过设定ΔC_{ij}=0得到平衡条件，为后续求解C̃_{ij}（如公式28.28c-28.28f）提供基础方程。

formula-notes:formula_28.29a:en.plainMeaning: This formula defines the distribution of mutational effects f(α) as a function of effect size α, with σ_α^2 being the mutational-effects variance and sinh the hyperbolic sine function.
formula-notes:formula_28.29a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to maintenance of quantitative genetic variation to provide a closed-form solution for p(x) that enables analytical tractability, supporting later derivations of equilibrium distributions.

formula-notes:formula_28.28f:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the equilibrium additive genetic variance (σ̃_A²) under mutation-stabilizing selection balance, where Z is a sum over loci of the square root of the product of mutation rate (μ_i) and squared effect size (σ_α_i²), and V_s is the strength of stabilizing selection.
formula-notes:formula_28.28f:en.inThisChapter: It appears in this section to provide a closed-form expression for the equilibrium variance, supporting the argument that the variance depends on the square root of mutation rates and effect sizes, and linking to earlier equations (28.28a–e) in the derivation chain.

formula-notes:formula_28.28e:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算了第i个位点对加性遗传方差的贡献（即平衡时该位点的自协方差项C̃_ii），它等于第一项（包含选择强度V_s和总加性方差σ̃_A^2）加上第二项（对所有其他位点j≠i的求和，涉及突变率μ_j、突变效应方差σ_{m_j}^2和重组率r_{ij}）。
formula-notes:formula_28.28e:zh.inThisChapter: 此公式出现在定量遗传变异维持的章节，由式(28.25d)代入C̃_ij的表达式得到，用于将自协方差C̃_ii分解为直接选择效应和连锁效应两部分，为后续推导平衡加性方差σ̃_A^2（式28.28f）提供关键中间量。

formula-notes:formula_28.28f:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算平衡时加性遗传方差σ̃_A²，它等于2Z√(V_s+Z²)+2Z²，其中Z是各突变位点效应方差σ_{α_i}²与突变率μ_i乘积的平方根之和。
formula-notes:formula_28.28f:zh.inThisChapter: 在突变-稳定化选择平衡的章节中，该公式由加性方差等于2∑C̃_i（公式28.28e）推导而来，为后续分析多基因性状的遗传方差组成提供封闭解。

formula-notes:formula_28.29b:en.plainMeaning: This formula gives the equilibrium probability density p(x) of allelic effects, where x is the effect size, σα scales the distribution, β = 2σ̃²(a)/σα² is the ratio of mutational variance to per-locus variance, and Γ is the gamma function extended to complex arguments.
formula-notes:formula_28.29b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to maintenance of quantitative genetic variation to provide an exact solution for the equilibrium distribution of allelic effects, which is used to derive properties of the distribution and to compare it to a Gaussian approximation.

formula-notes:formula_28.29c:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the selection-mutation equilibrium variance in allelic effects at a haploid locus, denoted by \(\widetilde{\sigma}^{2}(a)\), as a function of the mutational variance \(\sigma_{\alpha}^{2}\), the mutation rate \(\mu\), and the strength of stabilizing selection \(V_s\).
formula-notes:formula_28.29c:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to maintenance of quantitative genetic variation to provide an explicit equilibrium solution under mutation-selection balance, supporting later arguments about the amount of genetic variance that can be maintained.

formula-notes:formula_28.29a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式定义了突变效应α的概率密度函数f(α)，其中α是突变效应大小，σ_α^2是突变效应方差，分母中的双曲正弦函数sinh使得分布具有特定的形状（如尖峰和重尾）。
formula-notes:formula_28.29a:zh.inThisChapter: 本章介绍数量遗传变异的维持机制，此公式作为突变效应分布的一个巧妙选择，使得后续可以推导出平衡时表型分布p(x)的闭式解（公式28.29b-28.29e），从而分析突变-选择平衡下的遗传方差。

formula-notes:formula_28.29b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算等位基因效应x的平衡分布p(x)，其中β=2σ̃²(a)/σ_α²是突变方差与选择方差的比值，σ_α是选择强度参数，Γ是复平面上的伽马函数。
formula-notes:formula_28.29b:zh.inThisChapter: 它出现在本章介绍数量遗传变异维持的背景下，作为方程28.21c的精确解，为后续讨论分布形状（接近高斯分布）和参数β的影响提供数学基础。

formula-notes:formula_28.29e:en.plainMeaning: This equation relates the equilibrium variance of allelic effects (σ̃²(a)) and its square (σ̃⁴(a)) to the variance of mutational effects (σ²_α), the strength of stabilizing selection (V_s), and the mutation rate (μ).
formula-notes:formula_28.29e:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to maintenance of quantitative genetic variation to derive the equilibrium solution under the house-of-cards approximation (HCA), showing how mutation-selection balance yields a finite genetic variance.

formula-notes:formula_28.29c:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算了单倍体位点上等位基因效应的选择-突变平衡方差 $\widetilde{\sigma}^{2}(a)$，它等于突变增量方差 $\sigma_{\alpha}^{2}$ 乘以一个因子，该因子依赖于突变率 $\mu$ 和选择强度 $V_s$。
formula-notes:formula_28.29c:zh.inThisChapter: 在本节中，该公式用于量化维持遗传变异的平衡水平，为后续讨论多基因性状的遗传方差和进化潜力提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_28.29d:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式表示在平衡状态下，由选择消除的变异（左边，包含等位基因效应的四阶累积量K̃₄和方差平方项）等于由新突变引入的变异（右边，μσ_α²）。
formula-notes:formula_28.29d:zh.inThisChapter: 出现在介绍维持数量遗传变异的章节，用于推导平衡时加性遗传方差，为后续讨论高斯假设（即忽略K̃₄）做铺垫。

formula-notes:formula_28.29d:en.plainMeaning: This equation expresses the balance between selection removing genetic variation (left side, involving the fourth cumulant and variance of allelic effects) and mutation introducing it (right side, involving mutation rate μ and additive genetic variance σα²). Key symbols: σ̃²(a) is the variance of allelic effects, K̃₄ is the fourth cumulant, Vₛ is the strength of stabilizing selection, μ is the mutation rate, and σα² is the additive genetic variance.
formula-notes:formula_28.29d:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to show the equilibrium condition for quantitative genetic variation under stabilizing selection and mutation, supporting later arguments about the Gaussian assumption and the maintenance of genetic variance.

formula-notes:formula_28.30a:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the equilibrium additive genetic variance under the stochastic house-of-cards (SHC) approximation, where n is the number of loci, μ is the mutation rate per locus, V_s is the variance of the Gaussian fitness function, N_e is the effective population size, and σ_α^2 is the variance of mutational effects.
formula-notes:formula_28.30a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on mutation-stabilizing selection balance with drift to provide an analytical approximation for the genetic variance when drift is strong relative to mutation, supporting later comparisons with the full stochastic model (Equations 28.30b–d).

formula-notes:formula_28.29e:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式通过将四阶累积量近似为σ_α^2 σ̃^2(a)，将高斯近似下的平衡条件（式28.29d）转化为一个关于等位基因效应平衡方差σ̃^2(a)的二次方程，其中σ_α^2是突变效应方差，V_s是选择方差，μ是突变率。
formula-notes:formula_28.29e:zh.inThisChapter: 在定量遗传变异维持的章节中，此式用于推导在House-of-Cards近似（HCA）下平衡方差σ̃^2(a)的显式解，从而比较不同近似（高斯vs HCA）对平衡方差预测的影响。

formula-notes:formula_28.30b:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the equilibrium additive genetic variance under mutation-stabilizing selection balance with drift (SHC) as the harmonic mean of the variance under house-of-cards mutation-selection balance (HC) and the neutral drift variance (N). Key symbols: σ̃²_A(SHC) is the combined variance, σ̃²_A(HC) is the selection-only variance, σ̃²_A(N) is the drift-only variance.
formula-notes:formula_28.30b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on mutation-stabilizing selection balance with drift to combine the pure selection and pure drift results into a single expression, supporting the analysis of selection- and drift-dominated domains in Equations 28.30c and 28.30d.

formula-notes:formula_28.30a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算在突变-稳定化选择平衡下，受遗传漂变影响时，加性遗传方差（σ̃_A²）的随机House-of-Cards近似值。其中n为性状数，μ为突变率，V_s为选择强度（环境方差），N_e为有效种群大小，σ_α²为突变效应方差。
formula-notes:formula_28.30a:zh.inThisChapter: 本节讨论突变、稳定化选择和遗传漂变共同作用下的平衡遗传方差。公式(28.30a)是SHC近似，为后续公式(28.30b)-(28.30d)提供基础，这些公式分别给出不同条件下的简化形式或数值结果。

formula-notes:formula_28.30b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算在突变-稳定化选择-漂变平衡下（SHC）的加性遗传方差，它是纯选择平衡方差（HC）与纯漂变中性方差（N）的调和平均的一半。
formula-notes:formula_28.30b:zh.inThisChapter: 此公式出现在讨论突变-稳定化选择平衡与遗传漂变共同作用的章节，它整合了纯选择（HC）和纯漂变（N）的结果，为后续划分选择主导和漂变主导的域（公式28.30c和28.30d）提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_28.30d:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the expected selection coefficient E(s_i) for a new mutation with effect α_i under the house-of-cards (HOC) model, where σ_{α_i}^2 is the variance of mutational effects and V_s is the variance of the fitness function.
formula-notes:formula_28.30d:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on mutation-stabilizing selection balance with drift to quantify the average strength of selection acting on new mutations, which is used to determine whether selection (|4N_e s| ≫ 1) or drift (|4N_e s| ≪ 1) dominates the dynamics.

formula-notes:formula_28.30c:en.plainMeaning: This formula gives the approximate equilibrium additive genetic variance under stabilizing selection, mutation, and drift (SHC model). It equals the neutral variance when Ne σα² ≪ Vs (drift-dominated) and equals the house-of-cards variance when Ne σα² ≫ Vs (selection-dominated).
formula-notes:formula_28.30c:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on mutation-stabilizing selection balance with drift to delineate the domains where drift or selection dominates, supporting the conclusion that the full SHC result (Equation 28.30a) reduces to these limiting cases.

formula-notes:formula_28.31:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the variance across replicate populations of the additive genetic variance under the SHC model, showing how it depends on the variance of mutational effects (σα²), effective population size (Ne), strength of stabilizing selection (Vs), and the expected additive genetic variance (σ̃A²(SHC)).
formula-notes:formula_28.31:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on mutation-stabilizing selection balance with drift to quantify the stochastic variation around the expected equilibrium, supporting later arguments about the predictability of the genetic variance in finite populations.

formula-notes:formula_28.30d:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算一个新突变（HOC模型下效应为α_i）的预期选择系数E(s_i)，等于突变效应平方的期望E(α_i^2)除以2倍遗传方差V_s，而E(α_i^2)就是突变效应的方差σ_{α_i}^2。
formula-notes:formula_28.30d:zh.inThisChapter: 在讨论突变-稳定化选择平衡并考虑遗传漂变时，公式(28.30d)给出了新突变选择系数的期望值，为后续判断选择与漂变谁占主导（|4N_e s|远大于或远小于1）提供了具体的s值表达式。

formula-notes:formula_28.30c:zh.plainMeaning: 该分段函数给出了在突变-稳定化选择平衡下，受漂移影响的加性遗传方差近似值：当Neσα²远小于Vs时，近似等于纯漂移结果σ̃_A²(N)；当Neσα²远大于Vs时，近似等于纯选择结果σ̃_A²(HC)。
formula-notes:formula_28.30c:zh.inThisChapter: 此公式由方程(28.30a)推导而来，明确了选择主导和漂移主导的边界条件，为后续讨论不同参数区域下的遗传方差行为提供了近似依据。

formula-notes:formula_28.32b:en.plainMeaning: This quadratic equation relates the equilibrium additive genetic variance (σ̃_A^2) under mutation-stabilizing selection-drift balance to the number of traits (n), strength of stabilizing selection (V_s), effective population size (N_e), and per-trait mutational variance (σ_m^2).
formula-notes:formula_28.32b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on mutation-stabilizing selection balance with drift, providing the intermediate step to derive the stochastic Gaussian result (28.32c) that accounts for drift's effect on the equilibrium variance.

formula-notes:formula_28.32a:en.plainMeaning: This formula gives the equilibrium genetic variance contributed by new mutation per generation (σ_m²) as the sum of a drift term (σ̃_A²/(2N_e)) and a selection term (σ̃_A⁴/(2nV_s)), where σ̃_A² is the equilibrium additive genetic variance, N_e is effective population size, n is number of loci, and V_s is the variance of the stabilizing selection fitness function.
formula-notes:formula_28.32a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on mutation-stabilizing selection balance with drift to incorporate the effect of finite population size on the maintenance of genetic variance, supporting the derivation of the equilibrium variance under the joint action of mutation, selection, and drift.

formula-notes:formula_28.32c:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the equilibrium additive genetic variance (σ̃_A²) under mutation-stabilizing selection balance with drift, where n is number of traits, V_s is strength of stabilizing selection, N_e is effective population size, and σ_m² is mutational variance per trait per generation.
formula-notes:formula_28.32c:en.inThisChapter: It appears in this section to provide the stochastic Gaussian solution for the balance when drift is included, supporting the argument that drift reduces the equilibrium genetic variance compared to the deterministic prediction.

formula-notes:formula_28.31:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算了在突变-稳定化选择平衡下，加性遗传方差（~σ_A^2(SHC)）的抽样方差σ^2[~σ_A^2(SHC)]，它等于括号内项（包含突变效应方差σ_α^2、有效群体大小N_e和选择强度V_s）乘以~σ_A^2(SHC)本身。
formula-notes:formula_28.31:zh.inThisChapter: 在讨论漂变对平衡方差的影响时，该公式给出了实际实现中方差围绕期望值的波动幅度，为后续理解有限群体中遗传方差的不确定性提供了定量描述。

formula-notes:formula_28.32a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算在突变-稳定化选择平衡下，由遗传漂变和选择共同维持的加性遗传方差 σ_m^2。关键符号：σ̃_A^2 是平衡时加性遗传方差，N_e 是有效群体大小，n 是性状数，V_s 是选择方差。
formula-notes:formula_28.32a:zh.inThisChapter: 出现在讨论漂变与突变-稳定化选择平衡的章节，用于量化漂变和选择对遗传方差维持的相对贡献，为后续近似简化（忽略 1/N_e 项）和与公式 28.32b、28.32c 的比较提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_28.33a:en.plainMeaning: This equation gives the equilibrium haploid single-locus genetic variance (σ̃²(a)) under mutation-stabilizing selection balance with genetic drift, where μ is mutation rate, σα² is mutational variance, Vs is strength of stabilizing selection, and Ne is effective population size.
formula-notes:formula_28.33a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on mutation-stabilizing selection balance with drift to incorporate the effect of finite population size (drift term -σ̃²(a)/Ne) into the deterministic HG approximation (Equation 28.29d), setting up the derivation of the multi-locus equilibrium variance in Equation 28.33b.

formula-notes:formula_28.32c:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算在遗传漂变影响下，平衡时加性遗传方差（σ̃_A²）的近似值，它等于根号下（(nV_s/(2N_e))² + 2nσ_m²V_s）减去 (nV_s/(2N_e))，其中 n 是位点数，V_s 是选择强度，N_e 是有效群体大小，σ_m² 是每代每配子突变方差。
formula-notes:formula_28.32c:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式是二次方程 (28.32b) 的解，出现在突变-稳定化选择平衡章节中考虑漂变的情形，用于给出在有限群体中遗传方差平衡值的显式近似表达式，为后续讨论漂变与选择、突变的相互作用提供定量基础。

formula-notes:formula_28.32b:zh.plainMeaning: 该二次方程将平衡时加性遗传方差（\(\widetilde{\sigma}_{A}^{2}\)）的平方与有效群体大小（\(N_e\)）、选择强度（\(V_s\)）、突变方差（\(\sigma_m^2\)）及性状维度（\(n\)）联系起来，用于求解随机高斯模型下的平衡方差。
formula-notes:formula_28.32b:zh.inThisChapter: 在本节“突变-稳定化选择平衡：漂变”中，该方程由前文考虑遗传漂变和选择共同作用的动态方程推导而来，其解（28.32c）给出了漂变存在时平衡加性遗传方差的近似表达式，为后续比较不同进化力下的方差预测奠定基础。

formula-notes:formula_28.33b:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the equilibrium additive genetic variance per locus under mutation-stabilizing selection balance with drift, where σ̃²(a) is the per-locus variance, n is the number of loci, σα² is the mutational variance per locus, γ = σα²/(2Vs) scales the strength of stabilizing selection relative to mutation, Ne is the effective population size, and μ is the mutation rate.
formula-notes:formula_28.33b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on mutation-stabilizing selection balance with drift to provide a stochastic extension of the deterministic House-of-Gauss approximation, supporting the argument that drift reduces the equilibrium genetic variance below the deterministic prediction.

formula-notes:formula_28.33a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式描述了在漂变存在时，单倍体单基因座遗传方差 $\widetilde{\sigma}^{2}(a)$ 的平衡条件：左侧是稳定化选择对遗传方差的影响（通过 $\widetilde{\sigma}^{4}(a)$ 和 $\widetilde{\sigma}^{2}(a)$ 项），右侧是突变输入 $\mu\sigma_{\alpha}^{2}$ 减去漂变导致的方差损失 $\widetilde{\sigma}^{2}(a)/N_{e}$。
formula-notes:formula_28.33a:zh.inThisChapter: 在章节“突变-稳定化选择平衡：漂变”中，此公式将确定性方程（28.29d）扩展为包含遗传漂变效应，为后续推导多基因座平衡方差（如公式28.33b）和连锁平衡下的总方差 $\widetilde{\sigma}^{2}(A)$ 提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_28.33b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算在漂变-突变-稳定化选择平衡下，每个等效位点对加性遗传方差的贡献，其中关键符号包括：n为等效位点数，σ_α^2为突变效应方差，γ=σ_α^2/(2V_s)衡量选择强度，N_e为有效群体大小，μ为突变率。
formula-notes:formula_28.33b:zh.inThisChapter: 本节推导漂变、突变与稳定化选择共同作用下的平衡遗传方差，公式28.33b是对方程28.33a的显式解，为后续讨论随机House-of-Gauss近似下遗传方差与位点数的关系提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_28.34b:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the expected substitution rate λ at loci under stabilizing selection, where μ is the mutation rate, σ_m^2 is the mutational variance, N_e is the effective population size, and V_s is the variance of the fitness function. It shows that λ equals μ when selection is weak (effective neutrality) and decreases as μ√(V_s/(σ_m^2 N_e)) when selection is strong.
formula-notes:formula_28.34b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on mutation-stabilizing selection balance with drift to quantify how drift and selection jointly affect substitution rates, and it supports the derivation of the expected nucleotide diversity in formula 28.34c.

formula-notes:formula_28.34b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算在稳定化选择下，受漂变影响的位点上的期望替代率λ，它等于突变率μ除以一个依赖于有效群体大小N_e、突变方差σ_m^2和选择强度V_s的因子。
formula-notes:formula_28.34b:zh.inThisChapter: 本节讨论突变-稳定化选择平衡中漂变的作用，此公式给出了替代率λ的近似表达式，为后续推导有效中性条件和强约束下的行为提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_28.35a:en.plainMeaning: This formula defines the (j,ℓ) entry of the additive genetic variance-covariance matrix V_a as the covariance σ(a_j, a_ℓ) between the effects of an allele on trait j and trait ℓ, for k traits influenced by pleiotropic mutations.
formula-notes:formula_28.35a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on mutation-stabilizing selection balance with pleiotropy to extend the single-trait model to multiple traits, providing the covariance structure needed for the subsequent derivation of the equilibrium genetic covariance matrix in Equation 28.35b.

formula-notes:formula_28.34c:en.plainMeaning: This formula adjusts the population mutation rate parameter θ to θs by dividing by a factor that accounts for the variance of mutational effects (σ²_m) and effective population size (N_e) relative to the variance of selection coefficients (V_s), thereby incorporating the effect of drift on the mutation-selection balance.
formula-notes:formula_28.34c:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on mutation-stabilizing selection balance with drift to provide a corrected version of θ that improves the fit of the observed heterozygosity (H̃_o) under weak selection or low variance of mutational effects, supporting the argument that drift can alter the expected genetic diversity at equilibrium.

formula-notes:formula_28.35b:en.plainMeaning: This formula defines the (j,ℓ) entry of the pleiotropic mutation matrix V_m as the covariance σ(α_j, α_ℓ) between mutational increments to traits j and ℓ, for j,ℓ = 1,…,k.
formula-notes:formula_28.35b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the mutation–stabilizing selection balance section to extend the single-trait mutational variance σ_α^2 to a full covariance matrix for pleiotropic traits, supporting the analysis of how pleiotropy affects the genetic variance maintained under selection.

formula-notes:formula_28.34c:zh.plainMeaning: 公式(28.34c)将有效群体大小修正后的突变参数θ调整为θ_s，其中θ是原始突变参数，σ_m^2是突变效应方差，N_e是有效群体大小，V_s是选择方差，分母根号项反映了漂变与选择对θ的削弱作用。
formula-notes:formula_28.34c:zh.inThisChapter: 在本节“突变-稳定化选择平衡：漂变”中，该公式用于修正观察到的杂合度H̃_o，说明在强选择或高突变效应方差下，需用θ_s替代θ以更准确拟合数据，为后续讨论漂变与选择共同作用下的平衡条件提供量化工具。

formula-notes:formula_28.35b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式定义了多效突变矩阵 V_m 的第 j 行第 ℓ 列元素为突变对性状 j 和 ℓ 的增量 α_j 与 α_ℓ 之间的协方差 σ(α_j, α_ℓ)，其中 k 是性状总数。
formula-notes:formula_28.35b:zh.inThisChapter: 在讨论多效性突变-稳定化选择平衡的章节中，此公式将单性状的突变效应方差 σ_α^2 推广为多性状的突变协方差矩阵 V_m，为后续推导多性状下遗传方差-协方差矩阵的平衡结构提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_28.36b:en.plainMeaning: This formula approximates the fitness function W(z) for weak selection as a quadratic form centered at the optimum θ, where V_{jℓ} is the (j,ℓ) element of the inverse of the covariance matrix V_ω.
formula-notes:formula_28.36b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on mutation-stabilizing selection balance with pleiotropy to linearize the fitness surface near the optimum, enabling later analysis of the equilibrium genetic variance under weak selection.

formula-notes:formula_28.35a:zh.plainMeaning: 公式 (28.35a) 定义矩阵 V_a 的第 j 行第 ℓ 列元素为等位基因对性状 j 和 ℓ 的效应之间的协方差 σ(a_j, a_ℓ)，其中 j 和 ℓ 从 1 到 k（k 为受多效突变影响的性状总数）。
formula-notes:formula_28.35a:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在“突变-稳定化选择平衡：多效性”一节，用于将单基因座等位效应从单性状方差推广到多性状协方差矩阵，为后续推导多性状下遗传方差-协方差矩阵的平衡结构（如公式 28.35b）奠定基础。

formula-notes:formula_28.36a:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the fitness W(z) of an individual with trait vector z as a multivariate Gaussian function centered at the optimum θ, with covariance matrix V_ω determining the strength of stabilizing selection on each trait and their correlations.
formula-notes:formula_28.36a:en.inThisChapter: It extends the univariate selection model (Equation 28.3b) to multiple traits, enabling analysis of mutation-stabilizing selection balance under pleiotropy, and serves as the basis for subsequent expansions (Equations 28.36b–28.36e) that approximate the selection gradient and genetic variance dynamics.

formula-notes:formula_28.36a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算多性状个体适应度W(z)，其中z是k个性状值的向量，θ是最优值向量，Vω是描述选择强度的正定矩阵，指数中的二次型衡量z与θ的偏离程度。
formula-notes:formula_28.36a:zh.inThisChapter: 本节将单性状稳定化选择（公式28.3b）推广到多性状（多效性）情形，公式28.36a是后续推导平衡方差（28.36b-e）的基础，其中Vω矩阵刻画了选择协方差结构。

formula-notes:formula_28.36c:zh.plainMeaning: 公式(28.36c)将选择协方差矩阵V_s定义为环境协方差矩阵V_ω与遗传协方差矩阵V_E之和，用于计算多变量高斯适应度函数中的二次型。
formula-notes:formula_28.36c:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在“突变-稳定化选择平衡：多效性”一节，是单变量公式(28.3f)的多变量扩展，为后续使用弱选择近似V_ω+V_z≈V_s铺垫，从而简化平衡分析。

formula-notes:formula_28.36d:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the change in the phenotypic covariance matrix ΔV_z due to stabilizing selection, where V_z is the phenotypic covariance matrix, V_ω is the matrix of selection widths, and V_s = V_ω + V_z is the matrix of total phenotypic variance plus selection. The approximation replaces V_ω + V_z with V_s.
formula-notes:formula_28.36d:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on mutation-stabilizing selection balance with pleiotropy to extend the univariate result (Equation 28.3g) to multivariate traits, supporting later analysis of how pleiotropic mutation maintains genetic variance under stabilizing selection.

formula-notes:formula_28.36c:en.plainMeaning: This formula defines the total phenotypic covariance matrix V_s as the sum of the within-individual environmental covariance matrix V_ω and the among-individual environmental covariance matrix V_E, connecting the multivariate fitness function to the combined environmental variance.
formula-notes:formula_28.36c:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on mutation-stabilizing selection balance with pleiotropy to extend the univariate balance equation to multiple traits, and it supports the subsequent weak-selection approximation V_ω + V_z ≈ V_s used in deriving the equilibrium genetic covariance.

formula-notes:formula_28.36e:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the change in the additive genetic covariance matrix (ΔV_a)_s due to stabilizing selection, where V_a is the genetic covariance matrix and V_s is the selection covariance matrix. The approximation V_a(V_s+V_a)^{-1}V_a ≈ V_a V_s^{-1} V_a holds when V_a is small relative to V_s.
formula-notes:formula_28.36e:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on mutation-stabilizing selection balance with pleiotropy to describe how selection alters genetic covariances, supporting later derivations of equilibrium V_a under mutation-selection balance.

formula-notes:formula_28.36b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将弱选择下的适应度函数 W(z) 近似为 1 减去一个二次型，其中 (z_j - θ_j) 是第 j 个性状偏离最优值的偏差，V_{jℓ} 是逆方差-协方差矩阵 V_ω^{-1} 的第 jℓ 个元素，从而量化了多性状偏离最优值的联合选择代价。
formula-notes:formula_28.36b:zh.inThisChapter: 在本节“突变-稳定化选择平衡：多效性”中，该公式从指数形式的适应度函数（公式 28.36a）通过弱选择近似展开得到，为后续推导平衡时性状均值和方差（如公式 28.36c–e）提供了线性化的二次选择梯度。

formula-notes:formula_28.36d:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算在突变-稳定化选择平衡下，由于选择导致的多性状表型协方差矩阵ΔVz的变化量。关键符号：Vz是表型协方差矩阵，Vω是选择表面的曲率矩阵（高斯适应度景观的方差-协方差矩阵），Vs是选择强度矩阵（近似为Vω+Vz）。
formula-notes:formula_28.36d:zh.inThisChapter: 出现在“突变-稳定化选择平衡：多效性”一节，作为单性状方差变化公式(28.3g)的多变量推广，为后续推导平衡时Vz与突变协方差矩阵的关系（如公式28.36e）提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_28.36e:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算在多元正态假设下，经过选择后等位基因效应协方差矩阵的变化量 (ΔVa)s，它等于 -Va (Vs + Va)^{-1} Va，其中 Va 是选择前的协方差矩阵，Vs 是选择梯度矩阵（与适应度曲率有关）。近似形式 -Va Vs^{-1} Va 在 Vs 远大于 Va 时成立。
formula-notes:formula_28.36e:zh.inThisChapter: 本章讨论突变-稳定化选择平衡与多效性，公式(28.36e)是推导平衡协方差矩阵的关键步骤，它给出了选择对遗传协方差矩阵的压缩效应，为后续求解平衡时 Va 与突变协方差矩阵的关系提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_28.37a:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the total change in the additive genetic covariance matrix ΔV_a as the sum of the change due to selection (ΔV_a)_s and the input from mutation at locus i, μ_i V_m, where μ_i is the mutation rate at the ith locus and V_m is the mutational covariance matrix.
formula-notes:formula_28.37a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on mutation-stabilizing selection balance under pleiotropy to decompose the evolutionary forces acting on genetic variance, and it supports the derivation of equilibrium conditions (e.g., Equation 28.37b) by setting ΔV_a = 0.

formula-notes:formula_28.37b:en.plainMeaning: This equation states that at mutation-selection balance, the product of the additive genetic covariance matrix, the inverse of the selection covariance matrix, and the additive genetic covariance matrix equals the per-locus mutation rate times the mutational covariance matrix.
formula-notes:formula_28.37b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on pleiotropy to formalize the balance condition, leading to the solution (28.37c) that expresses the equilibrium genetic covariance matrix in terms of selection and mutation parameters.

formula-notes:formula_28.37a:zh.plainMeaning: 公式 (28.37a) 将加性遗传方差矩阵 ΔV_a 的变化分解为两部分：选择引起的部分 (ΔV_a)_s 和突变输入部分 μ_i V_m，其中 μ_i 是第 i 位点的突变率，V_m 是突变协方差矩阵（多变量版本的 σ_α^2）。
formula-notes:formula_28.37a:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在“突变-稳定化选择平衡：多效性”一节，用于建立选择与突变共同作用下加性遗传方差的变化方程，并设其为零以求解平衡条件，为后续推导平衡时的方差分量（如公式 28.37b、28.37c）提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_28.37b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式表示在突变-稳定化选择平衡下，选择对加性遗传方差-协方差矩阵的消除（左端）等于新突变输入的速率（右端），其中左端是加性遗传协方差矩阵的估计量乘以选择梯度矩阵的逆再乘以该估计量，右端是每代每性状的突变输入率乘以突变协方差矩阵。
formula-notes:formula_28.37b:zh.inThisChapter: 在本节关于多效性导致的突变-稳定化选择平衡中，该公式是平衡条件方程，直接由公式(28.36e)推导而来，为后续求解平衡时的加性遗传协方差矩阵（公式28.37c）提供基础方程。

formula-notes:formula_28.37c:en.plainMeaning: This formula gives the additive genetic covariance matrix at mutation-selection balance, expressed as a function of the stabilizing selection matrix V_s, the mutational covariance matrix V_m, and the mutation rate μ_i. The square root and matrix products ensure the solution satisfies the balance condition.
formula-notes:formula_28.37c:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on pleiotropy to provide an explicit solution for the equilibrium genetic covariance matrix under stabilizing selection and mutation, supporting the analysis of how pleiotropic mutations affect the maintenance of genetic variation.

formula-notes:formula_28.38a:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the equilibrium genetic variance contributed by locus i to trait j under mutation-selection balance, as the square root of the product of the mutation rate μ_i, the variance of mutational effects σ_{α_{j,i}}^2, and the standing variance V_{s,j} of trait j due to selection.
formula-notes:formula_28.38a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the pleiotropy section to extend the single-trait Kimura result (Equation 28.22d) to a multi-trait context, showing that each locus contributes independently to trait variance when there is no pleiotropic covariance.

formula-notes:formula_28.38a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算在突变-稳定化选择平衡下，位点 i 上影响性状 j 的等位基因效应方差（即遗传方差）的近似值，等于突变率 μ_i、新突变效应方差 σ_{α_{j,i}}² 和性状 j 的选择方差 V_{s,j} 的乘积的平方根。
formula-notes:formula_28.38a:zh.inThisChapter: 在本章“突变-稳定化选择平衡：多效性”中，该公式将单性状的 Kimura 结果（公式 28.22d）推广到多效性情景，为后续推导多性状平衡方差（如公式 28.38b）奠定基础。

formula-notes:formula_28.38b:zh.plainMeaning: 该不等式表示，对于每个位点 i 和每个性状 k，突变效应均值 μ_i 必须远大于突变效应方差 σ_{α_{k,i}}^2 与选择强度 V_{s,k} 的比值，这是多元高斯近似成立的条件。
formula-notes:formula_28.38b:zh.inThisChapter: 本章讨论突变-稳定化选择平衡，该条件用于判断多元高斯近似是否合理，为后续推导平衡方差和协方差矩阵提供前提。

formula-notes:formula_28.38b:en.plainMeaning: This inequality states that the per-locus mutation rate μ_i must be much larger than the ratio of the variance of mutational effects on trait k at locus i (σ²_{α_{k,i}}) to the strength of stabilizing selection on trait k (V_{s,k}). It ensures that the multivariate Gaussian approximation for the distribution of breeding values is valid.
formula-notes:formula_28.38b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on mutation-stabilizing selection balance with pleiotropy to specify the condition under which the Gaussian approximation (used to derive equilibrium variances) holds, and to warn that violation invalidates subsequent analytical results.

formula-notes:formula_28.39a:en.plainMeaning: This formula defines the phenotypic variance components for two traits: V_{s,i} is the sum of genetic variance (ω_i^2) and environmental variance (σ_{E_i}^2) for trait i, and C_s is the phenotypic covariance, combining environmental covariance (ρ_e σ_{E1} σ_{E2}) and genetic covariance (ρ_ω ω_1 ω_2).
formula-notes:formula_28.39a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the pleiotropy section to decompose the total phenotypic covariance matrix V_s into genetic and environmental components, supporting the derivation of the equilibrium genetic covariance (formula 28.39b) under mutation-stabilizing selection balance.

formula-notes:formula_28.37c:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式给出了在突变-稳定化选择平衡下加性遗传协方差矩阵的近似解，其中关键符号：\(\tilde{\mathbf{V}}_a\) 是平衡加性遗传协方差矩阵，\(\mathbf{V}_s\) 是稳定化选择协方差矩阵，\(\mu_i\) 是每代每性状的突变率，\(\mathbf{V}_m\) 是突变协方差矩阵。公式通过矩阵平方根运算将 \(\mathbf{V}_s\) 和 \(\mathbf{V}_m\) 组合起来计算 \(\tilde{\mathbf{V}}_a\)。
formula-notes:formula_28.37c:zh.inThisChapter: 此公式是对方程 (28.37b) 的解，出现在讨论多效性下突变与稳定化选择平衡的章节中。它展示了当 \(\mathbf{V}_s\) 和 \(\mathbf{V}_m\) 为对角矩阵时，如何从选择强度和突变输入直接得到平衡遗传协方差，为后续分析多性状平衡结构提供具体表达式。

formula-notes:formula_28.39b:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the correlation coefficient ρ_s between the two traits in the genetic covariance matrix V_s, as the ratio of the covariance C_s to the geometric mean of the variances. It decomposes ρ_s into contributions from the environmental correlation ρ_e weighted by environmental standard deviations and the mutational correlation ρ_ω weighted by mutational effect sizes.
formula-notes:formula_28.39b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on mutation-stabilizing selection balance with pleiotropy to express the genetic covariance matrix V_s in terms of its correlation structure, which is needed to analyze how pleiotropy and correlated mutations affect the maintenance of genetic variation under stabilizing selection.

formula-notes:formula_28.40:zh.plainMeaning: 该不等式表示，对于第i个位点，突变效应μ_i必须远小于两个性状的方差分量乘积与选择强度乘积之比的平方根，这是双变量HCA近似成立的条件。
formula-notes:formula_28.40:zh.inThisChapter: 本章讨论突变-稳定化选择平衡及多效性，该公式扩展了单变量HCA条件（公式28.17）到双变量情形，说明即使单个位点不满足单变量条件，双变量条件仍可能成立，为后续推导平衡等位基因频率提供更宽松的近似前提。

formula-notes:formula_28.39a:zh.plainMeaning: 公式28.39a定义了多性状稳定化选择下性状i的表型方差V_{s,i}（等于遗传方差ω_i^2加上环境方差σ_{E_i}^2）以及两性状间的表型协方差C_s（等于环境协方差ρ_e σ_{E1} σ_{E2}加上遗传协方差ρ_ω ω_1 ω_2）。
formula-notes:formula_28.39a:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在“突变-稳定化选择平衡：多效性”一节，用于构建表型方差-协方差矩阵V_s，为后续推导平衡时遗传方差与协方差（如公式28.39b）提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_28.41a:en.plainMeaning: This formula approximates the equilibrium additive genetic variance in trait 1 contributed by locus i under bivariate mutation-selection balance, where μ_i is the mutation rate at locus i, V_{s,1} is the strength of stabilizing selection on trait 1, and β_i is a ratio that scales the effect of pleiotropy on trait 2 relative to trait 1.
formula-notes:formula_28.41a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on pleiotropy to extend the univariate HCA condition (Equation 28.17) to a bivariate context, showing that the equilibrium variance can be maintained even when individual loci do not satisfy the univariate condition, and it supports the derivation of the bivariate HCA condition (Equation 28.41b).

formula-notes:formula_28.39b:zh.plainMeaning: 公式 (28.39b) 定义了稳定化选择协方差矩阵中非对角线元素对应的相关系数 ρ_s，它等于协方差 C_s 除以两个方差 V_{s,1} 和 V_{s,2} 乘积的平方根，并进一步展开为环境效应相关系数 ρ_e 与环境方差 σ_{E1}σ_{E2} 的乘积加上突变效应相关系数 ρ_ω 与突变效应方差 ω_1ω_2 的乘积，再除以 V_{s,1}V_{s,2} 的平方根。
formula-notes:formula_28.39b:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在讨论突变-稳定化选择平衡与多效性的章节中，用于将稳定化选择下的遗传方差-协方差矩阵 V_s 的非对角线元素标准化为相关系数，从而为后续分析多效性如何影响性状间的遗传相关提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_28.41a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算在双变量HCA条件下，性状1在第i个位点上的平衡加性遗传方差，近似等于4μ_i V_{s,1}除以(1+β_i)，其中β_i是衡量两个性状效应方差与选择强度比值的平方根。
formula-notes:formula_28.41a:zh.inThisChapter: 本章讨论突变-稳定化选择平衡，公式(28.41a)扩展了单变量HCA条件(28.17)到双变量情形，为后续推导多性状平衡方差及遗传协方差(如公式28.41b)提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_28.40:en.plainMeaning: This inequality gives the condition for the House-of-Cards approximation (HCA) to be valid for a pleiotropic locus i affecting two uncorrelated traits: the mutation rate μ_i must be much smaller than the square root of the product of the per-locus variances of mutational effects on the two traits (σ²_{α1,i} and σ²_{α2,i}) divided by the product of the strengths of stabilizing selection on the two traits (V_{s,1} and V_{s,2}).
formula-notes:formula_28.40:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on mutation-stabilizing selection balance with pleiotropy to extend the univariate HCA condition (Equation 28.17) to multiple traits, showing that the bivariate condition is more lenient and can be satisfied even when the univariate condition is not, supporting the argument that pleiotropy facilitates the HCA approximation.

formula-notes:formula_28.41b:en.plainMeaning: This formula defines β_i^2 as the ratio of the average selection coefficients for two traits due to a mutation at locus i, where σ_{α_{1,i}}^2 and σ_{α_{2,i}}^2 are the mutational variances for traits 1 and 2, and V_{s,1} and V_{s,2} are the strengths of stabilizing selection on each trait.
formula-notes:formula_28.41b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on mutation-stabilizing selection balance with pleiotropy to quantify the relative selective effect of a mutation on two traits, supporting later arguments about the distribution of mutational effects and the maintenance of genetic variance.

formula-notes:formula_28.41b:zh.plainMeaning: 公式28.41b计算了位点i上两个性状的突变平均选择系数之比，分子是性状2的平均选择系数E[s_{2,i}]，分母是性状1的平均选择系数E[s_{1,i}]，其中E[s_{2,i}] = σ_{α2,i}^2/(2V_{s,2})，E[s_{1,i}] = σ_{α1,i}^2/(2V_{s,1})。
formula-notes:formula_28.41b:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在多效性下突变-稳定化选择平衡的章节中，用于量化单个位点突变对两个性状的相对选择强度，为后续推导多效性维持遗传变异的条件提供关键比值。

formula-notes:formula_28.42:zh.plainMeaning: 公式(28.42)计算在五位点模型（A0,0和Ai,j）下，第i个性状的加性遗传方差近似值，其中μi是第i个性状的新突变率，Vs,1是稳定化选择强度，βi是第i个性状与总适合度的相关系数。
formula-notes:formula_28.42:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在讨论多效性下突变-稳定化选择平衡的章节，与连续等位基因模型的结果(28.41a)对比，说明遗传细节（如等位基因数目）在多效性下会影响平衡方差。

formula-notes:formula_28.42:en.plainMeaning: This formula approximates the equilibrium genetic variance contributed by mutations at a pleiotropic locus affecting trait i, where μ_i is the mutation rate for that trait, V_s,1 is the strength of stabilizing selection on trait 1, and β_i is the ratio of pleiotropic effects.
formula-notes:formula_28.42:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on mutation-stabilizing selection balance under pleiotropy to show that the equilibrium variance depends on the number of alleles, contrasting with the continuum-of-alleles model (Equation 28.41a) and supporting the conclusion that genetic details matter under pleiotropy.

formula-notes:formula_28.43a:en.plainMeaning: This formula approximates the selection coefficient s_i against a new mutation at locus i, where α is the vector of pleiotropic effects on k traits and V_s^{-1} is the inverse of the additive genetic covariance matrix for fitness components.
formula-notes:formula_28.43a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on mutation-stabilizing selection balance with pleiotropy to quantify the initial selective disadvantage of a mutation affecting multiple traits, and it supports later derivations (e.g., Equations 28.43b and 28.43c) that extend the balance to equilibrium mutation load.

formula-notes:formula_28.43a:zh.plainMeaning: 公式(28.43a)计算新突变在i位点的选择系数s_i，它等于突变效应向量α的转置乘以稳定化选择协方差矩阵的逆V_s^{-1}再乘以α，然后除以2。
formula-notes:formula_28.43a:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在“突变-稳定化选择平衡：多效性”一节，用于量化多效突变在稳定化选择下的初始选择系数，为后续推导平衡时的遗传方差（如公式28.43b和28.43c）提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_28.43b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将第i个突变的选择系数s_i近似为k个性状上效应平方α_{j,i}^2除以2倍选择方差V_{s,j}之和，并进一步将期望E[s_i]表示为各性状期望E[s_{j,i}]之和。
formula-notes:formula_28.43b:zh.inThisChapter: 作为多变量平衡方程（28.4c的推广），在V_s为对角矩阵（不相关选择）时简化得到此式，为后续讨论多性状突变-选择平衡下平均选择系数的可加性提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_28.43c:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the expected selection coefficient E[s_i] for a mutation affecting trait i, summing over pairs of traits j and ℓ the product of the inverse genetic covariance matrix element V_{j,ℓ} and the covariance σ(α_{k,i}, α_{ℓ i}) of mutational effects on traits j and ℓ.
formula-notes:formula_28.43c:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on mutation-stabilizing selection balance with pleiotropy to derive the expected strength of stabilizing selection against a mutation, supporting later analysis of how pleiotropy affects the mutation load and the equilibrium genetic variance.

formula-notes:formula_28.43b:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the selection coefficient s_i of a new mutation affecting k traits, as the sum over traits of α_{j,i}^2/(2V_{s,j}), where α_{j,i} is the effect on trait j and V_{s,j} is the strength of stabilizing selection on trait j. The expectation E[s_i] equals the sum of the expected contributions from each trait, E[s_{j,i}].
formula-notes:formula_28.43b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on mutation-stabilizing selection balance with pleiotropy to extend the univariate result (Equation 28.4c) to multiple traits, showing that the total selection coefficient is additive across traits when selection is uncorrelated, which supports later derivations of the equilibrium genetic variance.

formula-notes:formula_28.44a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算一个受突变-选择平衡维持的位点对加性遗传方差的贡献。关键符号：α为等位基因效应，p̃为平衡频率（≈μ/s），μ为突变率，s为选择系数。
formula-notes:formula_28.44a:zh.inThisChapter: 本章讨论多效有害等位基因如何维持遗传变异，此公式给出单个位点的方差贡献，为后续推导多位点总贡献（如2μE[α²/s]）提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_28.44a:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the contribution to additive-genetic variance from a single locus under mutation-selection balance, where α is the additive effect, p̃ ≈ μ/s is the equilibrium allele frequency, μ is the mutation rate, and s is the selection coefficient.
formula-notes:formula_28.44a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in this section to show how pleiotropic deleterious alleles maintain genetic variation, and it supports the derivation of the expected variance contribution 2μE[α²/s] used in later arguments about the distribution of mutational effects.

formula-notes:formula_28.43c:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算选择系数 s_i 的期望值，近似等于对 V_{j,ℓ} 与性状 α_{k,i} 和 α_{ℓ,i} 的协方差 σ(α_{k,i}, α_{ℓ,i}) 的乘积进行双重求和。
formula-notes:formula_28.43c:zh.inThisChapter: 在讨论突变-稳定化选择平衡及多效性时，该公式通过取期望将确定性二次型（28.43a）转化为随机环境下的平均效应，为后续分析平衡时选择系数的分布提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_28.44b:en.plainMeaning: This formula approximates the expected value of the ratio α²/s, where α is the pleiotropic effect on a trait and s is the selection coefficient. It expresses the expectation in terms of the variance of α (σ²_α), the mean selection coefficient (s̄), and the variances and covariance of α² and s.
formula-notes:formula_28.44b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on maintenance of variation by pleiotropic deleterious alleles to quantify how the ratio of squared effect to selection coefficient behaves on average, supporting the argument that pleiotropic effects can maintain genetic variance despite purifying selection.

formula-notes:formula_28.45a:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the additive genetic variance contributed by n loci under mutation-selection balance, where each locus has mutation rate μ, selection coefficient s, and effect variance σ²_α. The key symbols are: n (number of loci), μ (mutation rate per locus), σ²_α (variance of additive effects), s (selection coefficient), and k̄ (average number of new mutations per diploid per generation).
formula-notes:formula_28.45a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in this section to show how pleiotropic deleterious alleles can maintain additive genetic variance, supporting the argument that the equilibrium variance equals the product of the average number of new mutations per generation (k̄) and the variance of mutational effects (σ²_α).

formula-notes:formula_28.45b:zh.plainMeaning: 公式(28.45b)将平衡时加性遗传方差(˜σ²_A)表示为每代由突变引入的方差(σ²_m)与选择系数(s)之比，即σ²_m除以s。
formula-notes:formula_28.45b:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在讨论多效有害等位基因维持遗传变异的章节中，它从(28.45a)推导而来，将平衡方差表达为突变输入与选择清除速率的比值，为后续理解突变-选择平衡下的遗传变异维持提供了简洁的定量关系。

formula-notes:formula_28.45b:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the equilibrium additive genetic variance contributed by a locus under mutation-selection balance, where σ̃_A² is the equilibrium variance, σ_m² is the mutational variance introduced per generation, and s is the selection coefficient against deleterious alleles.
formula-notes:formula_28.45b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in this section to show how pleiotropic deleterious alleles can maintain genetic variation, supporting the argument that mutation-selection balance can account for observed levels of additive variance when selection is weak.

formula-notes:formula_28.45a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算由多效有害等位基因维持的加性遗传方差，等于位点数n乘以每个位点平均杂合度效应E[α²]与有害等位基因平均频率p̃的乘积的两倍，最终简化为每个配子每代有害突变数k̄乘以突变效应方差σ_α²。
formula-notes:formula_28.45a:zh.inThisChapter: 本章讨论多效有害等位基因如何维持遗传变异，此公式通过将多位点贡献求和（基于公式28.44a），将加性方差表达为突变输入与选择清除的平衡结果，为后续推导突变-选择平衡下的方差组分提供关键桥梁。

formula-notes:formula_28.44b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式近似计算比值 α²/s 的期望，其中 α 是突变对性状的效应（均值为0，方差为 σ_α²），s 是选择系数（均值为 s̄）。它用 α² 的方差 σ²(α²)、s 的方差 σ²(s) 以及 α² 与 s 的协方差 σ(α²,s) 对一阶近似 σ_α²/s̄ 进行修正。
formula-notes:formula_28.44b:zh.inThisChapter: 在本章“多效有害等位基因维持变异”中，该公式用于量化有害突变（s>0）对数量性状遗传方差（由 α² 贡献）的期望贡献，修正了直接取比值期望的偏差，为后续推导平衡时遗传方差与突变输入的关系提供精确近似。

formula-notes:formula_28.46a:en.plainMeaning: This formula approximates the equilibrium genetic variance V̂_s as the negative reciprocal of the regression coefficient γ_{w,z²} of relative fitness on squared deviation from the mean, or equivalently as the ratio of the variance of z² to twice the covariance between w and z².
formula-notes:formula_28.46a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on maintenance of variation by pleiotropic deleterious alleles to provide an explicit expression for the equilibrium variance under mutation-selection balance, supporting the argument that pleiotropy can maintain substantial genetic variation.

formula-notes:formula_28.46a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将遗传方差维持量V̂_s近似为相对适应度对平方偏差z²的回归系数γ_{w,z²}的负倒数，等价于z²的方差σ²(z²)除以两倍的w与z²的协方差σ(w,z²)。
formula-notes:formula_28.46a:zh.inThisChapter: 在本节“多效有害等位基因维持变异”中，该公式用于量化有害等位基因通过多效性维持遗传变异的强度，为后续推导V̂_s的具体表达式（如公式28.46b-e）提供起点。

formula-notes:formula_28.46b:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the apparent strength of stabilizing selection (V̂_s) as a function of the variance of mutational effects (σ²_α), the scaled kurtosis of trait mutational effects (κ₄), the mean pleiotropic effect (k̄), and the selection coefficient (s). The symbols are: σ²_α = variance of mutational effects on the trait, κ₄ = scaled kurtosis, k̄ = mean pleiotropic effect, s = selection coefficient, n = number of traits, μ = mutation rate, σ²_m = mutational variance.
formula-notes:formula_28.46b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in this section to quantify how pleiotropic deleterious alleles can maintain genetic variation by generating an apparent stabilizing selection that is weaker than the true selection. This result supports the argument that mutation-selection balance with pleiotropy can account for observed levels of genetic variance.

formula-notes:formula_28.46c:en.plainMeaning: This formula approximates the equilibrium genetic variance contributed by a pleiotropic deleterious allele as the product of the variance of mutational effects on the trait (σα²) and the average number of mutations per genome (k̄) divided by the selection coefficient s, which equals the mutational variance σm² divided by s², and also equals the standing additive genetic variance σ̃A² divided by s.
formula-notes:formula_28.46c:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on maintenance of variation by pleiotropic deleterious alleles to show how the equilibrium variance can be expressed in terms of observable quantities (mutational variance, selection coefficient) and to connect with the earlier Equation 28.46b under the assumption that k̄ is large relative to κ₄.

formula-notes:formula_28.46d:en.plainMeaning: This formula expresses the ratio of the additive genetic variance (σ̃_A²) to the equilibrium genetic variance (V̂_s) as a function of mutation rate (nμ), selection coefficient (s), and kurtosis (κ₄) and average heterozygosity (k̄). It simplifies to 4nμ/(3κ₄+2k̄) and then to 4nμ/(3κ₄+4nμ/s).
formula-notes:formula_28.46d:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on maintenance of variation by pleiotropic deleterious alleles to show how the ratio depends on mutation and selection parameters, supporting the conclusion that σ̃_A² is less than 4V̂_s nμ.

formula-notes:formula_28.46b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算了表观稳定化选择强度 \(\widehat{V}_s\)，它等于突变效应方差 \(\sigma_\alpha^2\) 乘以 \(3\kappa_4+2\overline{k}\) 再除以 \(2s\)，其中 \(\kappa_4\) 是突变效应峰度（公式 28.18c），\(\overline{k}\) 是每个位点的平均突变率，\(s\) 是选择系数。公式右侧展开为两项：第一项与峰度相关，第二项与突变输入方差 \(\sigma_m^2\) 相关。
formula-notes:formula_28.46b:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在讨论多效有害等位基因维持遗传变异的章节中，由公式 28.46a 中的方差和协方差项推导而来，用于量化看似稳定化选择但实际上由突变-选择平衡产生的表观选择强度，为后续分析 \(\widehat{V}_s\) 与真实选择强度 \(V_s\) 的关系（公式 28.46c-e）提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_28.46c:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式给出了平衡时加性遗传方差V̂s的三种等价表达式：等于σα²乘以平均杂合度k̄再除以选择系数s，也等于突变输入方差σm²除以s²，还等于突变杂合度贡献的方差σ̃A²除以s。
formula-notes:formula_28.46c:zh.inThisChapter: 在讨论多效有害等位基因维持遗传变异的章节中，此公式由式(28.46b)在k̄远大于κ4时近似得到，为后续推导平衡方差与突变-选择平衡的关系提供简洁表达式。

formula-notes:formula_28.47a:en.plainMeaning: This formula gives the ratio of equilibrium additive genetic variance (σ̃_A²) to apparent stabilizing selection strength (V̂_s) under three scenarios: 4nμ for HCA, 4nμ/(3κ₄) for deleterious pleiotropy with small mean number of mutant alleles (k̄ ≪ 1), and s for deleterious pleiotropy with large k̄ (k̄ ≫ 1).
formula-notes:formula_28.47a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on maintenance of variation by pleiotropic deleterious alleles to contrast the predictions of the HCA and pleiotropy models, supporting the argument that the ratio differs qualitatively between models and depends on the mean number of mutant alleles.

formula-notes:formula_28.46e:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the equilibrium additive genetic variance (σ̃_A²) under a pleiotropic mutation model with constant selection coefficient s, showing it is less than 4V̂_s n μ (the product of apparent stabilizing selection variance, mutation rate, and population size). Key symbols: σ̃_A² = additive genetic variance, V̂_s = apparent strength of stabilizing selection, n = number of traits, μ = mutation rate, κ₄ = kurtosis of mutational effects, k̄ = average number of pleiotropic traits affected.
formula-notes:formula_28.46e:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on maintenance of variation by pleiotropic deleterious alleles to demonstrate that the constant-s pleiotropy model predicts less additive genetic variation than the Gaussian stabilizing selection model, supporting the argument that pleiotropy can account for observed levels of variation.

formula-notes:formula_28.46d:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将加性遗传方差与平衡选择维持的变异比例联系起来，通过代入公式28.45b和28.46b，消去σ_α^2和s，最终得到仅由突变率μ、有效等位基因数n、四阶累积量κ_4和平均杂合度k̄（或nμ/s）表达的简洁形式。
formula-notes:formula_28.46d:zh.inThisChapter: 在本节中，该公式用于推导多效有害等位基因维持遗传变异的平衡条件，并引出后续不等式（28.46e），说明加性方差的上界为4V̂_s nμ。

formula-notes:formula_28.47a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式给出了平衡时加性遗传方差（σ̃_A²）与表观稳定化选择强度（V̂_s）之比，在HCA模型下等于4nμ，在有害多效性模型下当平均突变效应k̄远小于1时等于4nμ/(3κ₄)，当k̄远大于1时等于s。
formula-notes:formula_28.47a:zh.inThisChapter: 本节比较不同多效性模型维持遗传变异的机制，该公式直接对比HCA模型（公式28.12b）和有害多效性模型（公式28.45b）的平衡方差与选择强度比值，为后续讨论模型区分（公式28.47b-c）提供定量依据。

formula-notes:formula_28.46e:zh.plainMeaning: 公式 (28.46e) 计算在稳态下由多效有害等位基因维持的加性遗传方差 (σ̃_A²)，它等于 4V̂_s n μ 除以 (3κ₄ + 2k̄)，并小于 4V̂_s n μ，其中 V̂_s 是表型方差，n 是位点数，μ 是突变率，κ₄ 是峰度，k̄ 是平均突变效应。
formula-notes:formula_28.46e:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在“通过多效有害等位基因维持变异”一节，由 (28.46d) 重排得到，用于比较在恒定选择系数模型下维持的加性方差与突变-选择平衡下的方差，并利用 κ₄ ≥ 1 得出 σ̃_A² 的上界，为后续讨论变异维持量提供定量约束。

formula-notes:formula_28.47b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将遗传方差估计量V̂_s与加性遗传方差σ̃_A^2的比值表示为峰度κ₄、突变率μ、有效群体大小n、选择系数s的函数，并推导出该比值不小于1/s，即σ̃_A^2/σ_m^2。
formula-notes:formula_28.47b:zh.inThisChapter: 在本节中，该公式用于展示V̂_s与σ̃_A^2之间存在的约束关系，为后续讨论遗传方差维持的平衡条件提供数学基础。

formula-notes:formula_28.47b:en.plainMeaning: This formula expresses the ratio of the standing variance (V̂_s) to the additive genetic variance (σ̃_A^2) in terms of kurtosis κ_4, population size n, mutation rate μ, and selection coefficient s, showing that this ratio is at least 1/s, which equals the ratio σ̃_A^2/σ_m^2.
formula-notes:formula_28.47b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to illustrate a constraint on the relationship between V̂_s and σ̃_A^2, supporting later arguments about the maintenance of quantitative genetic variation under mutation-selection balance.

formula-notes:formula_28.48a:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the total selection coefficient s_T against a mutant allele as the sum of its constant pleiotropic deleterious effect s_p and the deleterious effect from direct stabilizing selection s_d, where s_d = α²/(2V_s) with α being the phenotypic effect and V_s the variance of the stabilizing selection function.
formula-notes:formula_28.48a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in this section to quantify how pleiotropic deleterious alleles can maintain genetic variation despite stabilizing selection, supporting the argument that the total selective disadvantage is the sum of two components.

formula-notes:formula_28.47c:en.plainMeaning: This inequality gives a necessary condition for mutation-selection balance to maintain genetic variance: the standardized stabilizing selection variance (V̂s / σE²) must be at least the square of the heritability ratio times the ratio of environmental to mutational variance. Key symbols: V̂s (variance of stabilizing selection), σE² (environmental variance), h̃² (heritability), σm² (mutational variance).
formula-notes:formula_28.47c:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to show how the condition for maintenance of quantitative genetic variation depends on heritability and mutational input, supporting the argument that mutation-selection balance can explain observed heritabilities only if selection is weak or mutation rates are high.

formula-notes:formula_28.48a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将突变对总适合度的影响 s_T 近似为两部分之和：恒定的多效有害效应 s_p 与直接稳定化选择产生的有害效应 s_d，其中 s_d = α²/(2V_s)。
formula-notes:formula_28.48a:zh.inThisChapter: 在本节中，该公式用于量化多效有害等位基因在稳定化选择下维持遗传变异的条件，为后续推导平衡频率（如公式 28.48b-d）提供总选择系数表达式。

formula-notes:formula_28.48c:en.plainMeaning: This formula approximates the additive genetic variance (σ̃_A²) as a function of the mutational variance (σ_m²), the average selection coefficient (s_p), the variance of mutational effects (σ_α²), and the variance of the stabilizing selection (V_s).
formula-notes:formula_28.48c:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on maintenance of variation by pleiotropic deleterious alleles to provide a simplified expression for the equilibrium additive genetic variance, supporting the argument that pleiotropy can maintain genetic variation despite stabilizing selection.

formula-notes:formula_28.48b:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the equilibrium additive genetic variance (σ̃_A²) maintained by mutation-selection balance, where σ_m² is the mutational variance, s_T is the total selection coefficient against a pleiotropic allele, decomposed into direct selection (s_p) and apparent stabilizing selection (α²/(2V_s)).
formula-notes:formula_28.48b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on maintenance of variation by pleiotropic deleterious alleles to show how pleiotropy can generate stabilizing selection and maintain genetic variance, supporting the argument that mutation-selection balance can explain observed levels of additive variance.

formula-notes:formula_28.47c:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式给出了维持遗传变异所需的最小稳定化选择方差（V̂s）与环境方差（σE²）之比的下界，其中关键符号包括：V̂s为稳定化选择方差，σE²为环境方差，h̃²为狭义遗传力，σm²为突变方差。
formula-notes:formula_28.47c:zh.inThisChapter: 此公式由28.47b式代入σA² = [h²/(1-h²)]σE²推导而来，用于在遗传力已知时评估突变-选择平衡能否维持遗传变异，为后续讨论遗传力与选择强度的关系提供定量判据。

formula-notes:formula_28.48b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算平衡时加性遗传方差（σ̃_A²）近似等于每代突变引入的方差（σ_m²）除以总选择系数（s_T），其中s_T由稳定化选择（s_p）和杂合子劣势（α²/(2V_s)）两部分组成。
formula-notes:formula_28.48b:zh.inThisChapter: 本章讨论多效有害等位基因维持遗传变异，此公式将平衡方差表达为突变输入与选择清除的比值，为后续比较不同选择分量（s_p vs α²/(2V_s)）的相对贡献提供定量基础。

formula-notes:formula_28.48d:en.plainMeaning: This inequality shows that the equilibrium additive genetic variance (σ̃_A²) for a focal trait under pleiotropic mutation and stabilizing selection is less than the pure pleiotropy variance (σ_m²/s_p), because the denominator includes an additional term α²/(2V_s) representing stabilizing selection strength.
formula-notes:formula_28.48d:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on maintenance of variation by pleiotropic deleterious alleles to demonstrate that even weak stabilizing selection reduces the equilibrium variance below the pure pleiotropy prediction, supporting the argument that pleiotropy alone cannot fully explain observed genetic variation.

formula-notes:formula_28.48c:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算在平衡状态下，由多效有害等位基因维持的加性遗传方差（~σ_A^2）的近似值。分子σ_m^2是每代每配子的突变方差，分母s_p是平均纯合选择系数，σ_α^2/(2V_s)项代表杂合效应方差对维持方差的贡献，其中V_s是稳定化选择方差。
formula-notes:formula_28.48c:zh.inThisChapter: 本节讨论多效有害等位基因如何维持遗传变异。公式28.48c通过将s_d替换为其平均值（公式28.30d），简化了公式28.48a或28.48b，为后续推导平衡方差（如公式28.48d）提供了更易处理的表达式。

formula-notes:formula_28.49:zh.plainMeaning: 公式(28.49)表示表观稳定化选择强度(widehat{V}_s^{-1})等于由多效有害效应单独诱导的稳定化选择强度(widehat{V}_{s,p}^{-1})与真实稳定化选择强度(V_s^{-1})之和，即两者倒数相加。
formula-notes:formula_28.49:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在讨论多效有害等位基因维持遗传变异的章节中，用于说明表观稳定化选择强度(widehat{V}_s)总是小于或等于真实稳定化选择强度(V_s)，从而解释为何实际观测到的稳定化选择可能比真实选择更强。

formula-notes:formula_28.48d:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式表示在同时存在多效性有害突变和真实稳定化选择时，焦点性状的平衡加性遗传方差（~σ_A^2）近似等于突变方差（σ_m^2）除以选择系数（s_p）与稳定化选择强度（α^2/(2V_s)）之和，且该值小于纯多效性模型下的方差（σ_m^2/s_p）。
formula-notes:formula_28.48d:zh.inThisChapter: 本节讨论多效性有害等位基因如何维持遗传变异，公式(28.48d)通过引入稳定化选择项（α^2/(2V_s)）修正了纯多效性模型(28.48a)的预测，表明真实稳定化选择会降低平衡方差，为后续比较不同选择模型下的变异维持提供了定量依据。

formula-notes:formula_28.50a:en.plainMeaning: This formula relates the observed strength of apparent stabilizing selection (widehat{V}_s) to the true stabilizing selection (V_s), incorporating the additive genetic variance (tilde{sigma}_A^4), mutational variance (sigma_m^2), and the pleiotropic covariance (sigma_p(w,z^2)).
formula-notes:formula_28.50a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to show how pleiotropic effects can bias estimates of stabilizing selection, setting up the derivation of corrected estimates in subsequent equations (28.50b–f).

formula-notes:formula_28.49:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the apparent strength of stabilizing selection (1/widehat{V}_s) as the sum of the induced strength from deleterious pleiotropic effects (1/widehat{V}_{s,p}) and the real stabilizing selection strength (1/V_s). Key symbols: widehat{V}_s (apparent variance), widehat{V}_{s,p} (pleiotropic-induced variance), V_s (real stabilizing variance).
formula-notes:formula_28.49:en.inThisChapter: It appears in this section to show how deleterious pleiotropic alleles can maintain genetic variation by making stabilizing selection appear stronger than it actually is, supporting the argument that apparent stabilizing selection (widehat{V}_s) is less than or equal to real stabilizing selection (V_s).

formula-notes:formula_28.50b:zh.plainMeaning: 该不等式表明，多效性相对适应度与性状平方偏差的协方差（记为V̂_s）的下界是V̂_s^*，上界是V_s（即性状平方偏差的方差）。
formula-notes:formula_28.50b:zh.inThisChapter: 在定量遗传变异维持的章节中，该公式用于界定多效性对遗传变异贡献的协方差范围，为后续推导V̂_s的精确表达式（如公式28.50c-28.50f）提供边界条件。

formula-notes:formula_28.50b:en.plainMeaning: This inequality bounds the estimated pleiotropic variance in stabilizing selection (V̂_s) between a lower bound V̂_s^* and an upper bound V_s, where V_s is the total variance in fitness due to stabilizing selection.
formula-notes:formula_28.50b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to show that the estimated strength of stabilizing selection from pleiotropy is constrained, supporting later arguments about the maintenance of genetic variation.

formula-notes:formula_28.50a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将观测到的表观稳定化选择强度 $\widehat{V}_{s}$ 与真实的稳定化选择强度 $V_s$ 联系起来，其中 $\widetilde{\sigma}_A^4/V_s$ 表示遗传方差与真实选择强度的比值，$\sigma_m^2$ 是突变方差，$\sigma_p(w,z^2)$ 是多效性效应引起的相对适应度与性状平方偏差的协方差。
formula-notes:formula_28.50a:zh.inThisChapter: 在本章关于数量遗传变异维持的引言中，该公式用于说明观测到的表观稳定化选择强度 $\widehat{V}_s$ 如何被真实选择、突变方差和多效性效应共同影响，为后续推导（如公式28.50b-28.50f）中分离这些因素提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_28.50c:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the lower bound of apparent stabilizing selection strength (V_s^*), where stronger selection corresponds to smaller V_s. Key symbols: V_s is the strength of apparent selection (larger V_s = weaker selection), σ̃_A^4 is the square of the additive genetic variance for the trait, σ_m^2 is the mutational variance.
formula-notes:formula_28.50c:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to maintenance of quantitative genetic variation to show the strongest possible apparent selection under the joint-effects model, supporting later arguments about the limits of mutation-selection balance when pleiotropic effects dominate.

formula-notes:formula_28.50c:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算在联合效应模型下，当多效性选择效应占主导时，表观选择强度V_s的下界估计值Ŷ_s*。其中，σ̃_A^4是加性遗传方差的平方，V_s是上界表观选择强度，σ_m^2是多效性效应方差。
formula-notes:formula_28.50c:zh.inThisChapter: 此公式出现在讨论数量遗传变异维持的章节，用于界定表观选择强度的范围。它从公式28.50a的上界V_s出发，通过引入多效性方差σ_m^2，推导出下界，为后续分析多效性与稳定化选择的相对重要性提供定量边界。

formula-notes:formula_28.50d:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式在低界条件下（s_T ≈ s_p）将平衡加性遗传方差估计值 V̂_s^* 表达为 σ̃_A^2 / s_p 与 V_s s_p 的函数，其中 σ̃_A^2 ≈ σ_m^2 / s_p 是突变-选择平衡下的加性遗传方差，s_p 是有效选择系数，V_s 是选择强度参数。
formula-notes:formula_28.50d:zh.inThisChapter: 本节介绍数量遗传变异维持机制，公式28.50d通过简化28.50c得到，为后续讨论多效性主导时平衡方差的具体形式（28.50e）提供中间步骤。

formula-notes:formula_28.50d:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the equilibrium genetic variance V̂s* under pleiotropic mutation-selection balance when the effective selection coefficient s_T ≈ s_p. Key symbols: σ_m² (mutational variance), s_p (pleiotropic selection coefficient), V_s (variance of selection coefficients), and σ̃_A² (approximate additive genetic variance from Equation 20.45b).
formula-notes:formula_28.50d:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to show how the equilibrium variance simplifies when pleiotropy dominates, supporting later arguments about the maintenance of quantitative genetic variation under different mutation-selection regimes.

formula-notes:formula_28.50e:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the apparent stabilizing selection under the joint-effects model, denoted as V̂_s^*, as a function of the pure pleiotropy apparent stabilizing selection V̂_{s,p} and the true stabilizing selection V_s. It shows that V̂_s^* is always smaller (stronger) than V̂_{s,p}.
formula-notes:formula_28.50e:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to maintenance of quantitative genetic variation to derive the minimum possible apparent stabilizing selection under the joint-effects model, supporting later arguments about the relative contributions of pleiotropy and direct selection.

formula-notes:formula_28.50e:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算在联合效应模型下，表观稳定化选择的最小（最强）估计值 \(\widehat{V}_{s}^{*}\)，它是纯多效性下的表观稳定化选择 \(\widehat{V}_{s,p}\) 与真实稳定化选择 \(V_s\) 的调和平均形式。
formula-notes:formula_28.50e:zh.inThisChapter: 本节引入联合效应模型，该公式表明表观稳定化选择的最小值由纯多效性分量 \(\widehat{V}_{s,p}\) 和真实选择 \(V_s\) 共同决定，为后续推导 \(\widehat{V}_{s}^{*}\) 与 \(V_s\) 的关系以及比较不同模型提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_28.51:zh.plainMeaning: 公式(28.51)计算平衡时加性遗传方差(σ̃_A²)等于总突变输入方差(σ_m²)乘以各突变类别的比例(π_i)除以总选择系数(s_{T,i})的加权和，等价于σ_m²除以s_T的加权调和平均数(¯s_T)_H。
formula-notes:formula_28.51:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在“数量遗传变异的维持”章节引言中，将公式(28.48b)中的s_T替换为加权调和平均数，以处理多类突变对平衡方差的影响，为后续推导更一般的平衡条件做铺垫。

formula-notes:formula_28.51:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the equilibrium additive genetic variance (σ̃_A²) contributed by multiple mutation classes, where σ_m² is the total mutational variance, π_i is the fraction of σ_m² from class i, and s_{T,i} is the total selection coefficient for that class. The harmonic mean (s̄_T)_H of the s_{T,i} values, weighted by π_i, replaces the single s_T from Equation 28.48b.
formula-notes:formula_28.51:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to maintenance of quantitative genetic variation to extend the single-class result (Equation 28.48b) to multiple mutation classes, showing that the effective selection coefficient is the weighted harmonic mean, which is smaller than the arithmetic mean and thus increases the predicted variance, supporting the argument that mutation-selection balance can maintain substantial genetic variation.

formula-notes:formula_28.50f:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the ratio of the estimated segregational variance under the pure pleiotropy model (V̂_{s,p}) to the observed segregational variance (V_s). The ratio is approximated as σ_m²/(V_s s_p²) and is greater than 1, indicating that the pure pleiotropy model overestimates V_s. Key symbols: V̂_{s,p} = estimated segregational variance under pure pleiotropy; V_s = observed segregational variance; σ̃_A² = additive genetic variance under pure pleiotropy; s_p = strength of stabilizing selection; σ_m² = mutational variance.
formula-notes:formula_28.50f:en.inThisChapter: This formula appears in the introduction to maintenance of quantitative genetic variation to show that under the pure pleiotropy model, the estimated segregational variance exceeds the observed value, implying that the apparent strength of stabilizing selection is twice as strong. It supports the argument that the pure pleiotropy model cannot account for observed levels of genetic variation, motivating alternative models.

formula-notes:formula_28.50f:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算纯多效模型下估计的稳定化选择方差与真实稳定化选择方差之比。分子是估计的稳定化选择方差（由加性遗传方差估计值除以选择强度得到），分母是真实稳定化选择方差，比值近似等于突变方差除以真实稳定化选择方差与选择强度平方的乘积，且大于1。
formula-notes:formula_28.50f:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在讨论维持数量遗传变异的章节，用于说明在纯多效模型下，估计的稳定化选择方差会高估真实值，从而为后续讨论选择强度被低估（即表观稳定化选择强度是真实的两倍）提供定量依据。

formula-notes:formula_28.52a:en.plainMeaning: This formula approximates the total selection coefficient s_T as the sum of the direct stabilizing selection coefficient s_p and a term involving the kurtosis κ₄ of mutational effects and the average squared dominance coefficient ṡ_d, which equals σ_α²/(2V_s).
formula-notes:formula_28.52a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to maintenance of quantitative genetic variation to show how the equilibrium additive variance (Equation 28.45b) is modified when stabilizing selection is weak, supporting the result that variance approaches the lower bound of Equation 28.50c.

formula-notes:formula_28.52a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将总选择系数 s_T 近似为稳定化选择系数 s_p 加上由突变效应峰度 κ₄ 加权的平均定向选择系数 3κ₄·s̄_d，其中 s̄_d = σ_α²/(2V_s) 表示突变效应方差 σ_α² 与表型方差 V_s 的比值。
formula-notes:formula_28.52a:zh.inThisChapter: 在本节中，该公式用于推导平衡加性遗传方差的下界，结合 Zhang and Hill (2002) 的结果，将总选择强度分解为稳定化选择和定向选择两部分，为后续计算平衡方差提供关键近似。

formula-notes:formula_28.52b:en.plainMeaning: This formula approximates the total average selection coefficient (s_T) as the sum of the average direct selection coefficient (s_d) and the geometric mean of s_d and the average pleiotropic selection coefficient (s_p).
formula-notes:formula_28.52b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to maintenance of quantitative genetic variation to show that when mutation effects (α) and selection coefficients (s) vary independently, the average direct selection (s_d) dominates s_T, contrasting with earlier additive assumptions.

formula-notes:formula_28.52c:en.plainMeaning: This formula approximates the additive genetic variance (σ̃_A²) as the product of two square roots, each involving the mutational variance (σ_m²) and either the average strength of stabilizing selection on the pleiotropic trait (s̄_p) or on the direct trait (s̄_d).
formula-notes:formula_28.52c:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to maintenance of quantitative genetic variation to show how the equilibrium genetic variance depends on the geometric mean of selection strengths, supporting the argument that pleiotropy can maintain variation when selection on the direct trait is weak.

formula-notes:formula_28.52b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式近似表示总选择系数 s_T 等于直接选择系数的均值 s_d 加上 s_d 与上位选择系数均值 s_p 的几何平均，即 s_T 主要由 s_d 驱动，但受 s_p 的平方根项修正。
formula-notes:formula_28.52b:zh.inThisChapter: 本节讨论数量遗传变异维持机制，公式(28.52b)来自Zhang和Hill(2002)的模型，表明当α和s独立变化时，直接选择是主要驱动力，与Kondrashov和Turelli(1992)的结论不同，为后续比较不同模型假设提供定量依据。

formula-notes:formula_28.52d:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算平衡加性遗传方差 $\widetilde{\sigma}_{A}^{2}$ 的近似值，它是 $4n\mu V_{s}$（来自 HCA 模型）与 $\sigma_{m}^{2}/\overline{s}_{p}$（来自纯多效模型）的几何平均的平方根。
formula-notes:formula_28.52d:zh.inThisChapter: 出现在“数量遗传变异的维持”章节的引言部分，用于整合 HCA 模型和纯多效模型的结果，为后续讨论两种模型下的遗传方差平衡值提供统一表达式。

formula-notes:formula_28.52c:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将平衡时加性遗传方差 (˜σ²_A) 近似表示为两个因子的乘积，每个因子都是突变输入 (σ²_m) 与一种选择强度 (¯s_p 或 ¯s_d) 之比的平方根，其中 ¯s_p 和 ¯s_d 分别代表稳定化选择和定向选择的平均强度。
formula-notes:formula_28.52c:zh.inThisChapter: 在讨论数量遗传变异维持的章节中，此公式由式 (28.45b) 在 ¯s_d ≪ ¯s_p 条件下推导而来，用于简化平衡方差表达式，并为后续比较不同选择模式下的遗传方差提供直观形式。

formula-notes:formula_29.1a:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the mean fitness over the first episode of selection, where W1(r) is the fitness of individual r and n is the number of individuals.
formula-notes:formula_29.1a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on episodes of selection to define the average fitness used to track frequency changes, supporting later derivations of selection differentials.

formula-notes:formula_28.52d:en.plainMeaning: This formula approximates the equilibrium additive genetic variance (σ̃_A²) as the geometric mean of the house-of-cards approximation (HCA) and pure pleiotropy predictions, where n is the number of loci, μ is the mutation rate, V_s is the strength of stabilizing selection, σ_m² is the mutational variance, and s̄_p is the average selection coefficient against a homozygous mutant under pleiotropy.
formula-notes:formula_28.52d:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to maintenance of quantitative genetic variation to show that the joint effect of pleiotropy and mutation-selection balance yields an intermediate prediction, reconciling the HCA and pure pleiotropy models as noted by Zhang and Hill (2002).

formula-notes:formula_29.1a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算第一个选择时段内所有个体的平均适应度，即对每个个体 r 的适应度 W₁(r) 求和后除以个体总数 n。
formula-notes:formula_29.1a:zh.inThisChapter: 此处定义平均适应度，为后续将平均适应度归一化为 1（即 w̄ⱼ = 1）以及推导公式 29.1b 和 29.1c 中相对适应度与频率变化做准备。

formula-notes:formula_28.53a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将加性遗传方差与突变方差的比值（左端）表示为有效群体大小Ne和选择强度s的函数（右端），其中关键替换是σ_α^2/(2V_s)=s来自公式28.30d。
formula-notes:formula_28.53a:zh.inThisChapter: 本节评估模型拟合数据的能力，该公式将随机房顶模型下的加性遗传方差（公式28.30a）转化为仅含Ne和s的简洁形式，为后续推导持久时间（公式28.53b）提供直接代入项。

formula-notes:formula_28.53b:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the ratio of the additive genetic variance (σ̃_A²) to the phenotypic variance (σ_m²) under stabilizing selection, showing it equals 2N_e/(1+2N_e s) and approximates 2N_e when N_e s ≪ 1 or 1/s when N_e s ≫ 1. Key symbols: N_e = effective population size, s = selection strength parameter.
formula-notes:formula_28.53b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section evaluating model fit to data, providing a simplified expression for the genetic variance ratio that depends on N_e and s, which is used to compare theoretical predictions with observed variance patterns.

formula-notes:formula_28.53a:en.plainMeaning: This formula expresses the ratio of the additive genetic variance under stabilizing selection (tilde{sigma}_A^2) to the mutational variance (sigma_m^2) as a function of effective population size N_e and selection strength s. The key symbols are N_e (effective population size) and s (selection coefficient, defined as sigma_alpha^2/(2V_s)).
formula-notes:formula_28.53a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section assessing model fit, where it simplifies the persistence time expression using the stochastic house-of-cards approximation (Equation 28.30a) and the relation s = sigma_alpha^2/(2V_s) (Equation 28.30d), leading to the compact form 2N_e/(1+2N_e s) used in subsequent analysis (e.g., Equation 28.53b).

formula-notes:formula_28.53b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算了群体中观察到的加性遗传方差（σ̃_A²）相对于中性期望突变方差（σ_m²）的比值，它等于2N_e除以(1+2N_e s)，其中N_e是有效群体大小，s是选择系数。当N_e s远小于1时，比值近似为2N_e；当N_e s远大于1时，比值近似为1/s。
formula-notes:formula_28.53b:zh.inThisChapter: 本节评估模型与数据的拟合程度，该公式通过量化选择对遗传方差的影响，为比较中性模型与选择模型提供了理论预测，并展示了在弱选择（N_e s≪1）和强选择（N_e s≫1）下的极限行为。

formula-notes:formula_29.1b:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the mean fitness for the second episode of selection, where W2(r) is the fitness of individual r in the second episode, w1(r) is its fitness in the first episode, and n is the population size.
formula-notes:formula_29.1b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on episodes of selection to show how fitness from the first episode weights the calculation of mean fitness for the second episode, supporting the argument that selection episodes are sequential and fitnesses compound.

formula-notes:formula_29.1b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算第二轮选择（第二集）的平均适应度，它是每个个体在第二轮中的适应度 W2(r) 乘以其在第一轮后的适应度加权频率 w1(r)/n 的求和。
formula-notes:formula_29.1b:zh.inThisChapter: 在介绍多轮选择（选择集）的背景下，该公式承接第一轮后的频率更新，为后续推导第三轮平均适应度（公式29.1c）以及整体平均适应度与选择强度之间的关系提供中间步骤。

formula-notes:formula_29.1c:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the mean fitness after the j-th episode of selection, where W_j(r) is the fitness of type r in episode j, and the product of previous w's accounts for cumulative survival through earlier episodes, averaged over n types.
formula-notes:formula_29.1c:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on episodes of selection to extend the single-episode mean fitness formula (29.1a) to multiple sequential episodes, supporting later arguments about how selection accumulates over time.

formula-notes:formula_29.1c:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算第j个选择事件的平均适应度，它是通过将第j个事件中类型r的适应度W_j(r)乘以之前所有事件中类型r的适应度w_{j-1}(r), w_{j-2}(r), ..., w_1(r)以及初始频率1/n，再对所有r求和得到的。
formula-notes:formula_29.1c:zh.inThisChapter: 本章讨论多阶段选择，公式(29.1c)将公式(29.1a)和(29.1b)推广到一般情况，为后续推导多阶段选择后的总体平均适应度或基因频率变化提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_29.2b:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the fitness-weighted mean of a character z after the jth episode of selection, where z(r) is the character value of individual r and p_j(r) is its fitness weight (relative contribution) in that episode.
formula-notes:formula_29.2b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in this section to define how to calculate moments (like the mean) after each selection episode, which is essential for analyzing how selection changes the distribution of a character across multiple episodes.

formula-notes:formula_29.2a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算个体 r 经过 j 轮选择后的适应度加权频率 p_j(r)，等于初始频率 1/n 乘以各轮相对适应度 w_i(r) 的连乘积，且所有个体频率之和为 1。
formula-notes:formula_29.2a:zh.inThisChapter: 本节引入多轮选择场景，公式 29.2a 定义了选择后频率的递推关系，为后续推导平均适应度（公式 29.2b）和选择强度（公式 29.2c）提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_29.2b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算经过第j次选择事件后，个体r的性状值z(r)以该个体在第j次选择事件后的适应度权重p_j(r)为权重的加权平均值，即适应度加权后的性状均值。
formula-notes:formula_29.2b:zh.inThisChapter: 在介绍多轮选择（episodes of selection）的章节中，此公式用于定义每一轮选择后的性状均值，为后续计算选择前后均值变化（选择差）以及方差变化提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_29.2a:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the fitness-weighted frequency of individual r after j episodes of selection, where p_j(r) is the product of the initial frequency (1/n) and the cumulative product of relative fitnesses w_i(r) across episodes, and the sum over all r equals 1.
formula-notes:formula_29.2a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in this section to formalize how frequencies change under sequential selection episodes, supporting the derivation of the total relative fitness and the subsequent formulas (29.2b, 29.2c) that connect fitness components to population-level changes.

formula-notes:formula_29.2c:zh.plainMeaning: 公式(29.2c)计算第j个选择事件中个体适应度z的样本方差，其中z(r)是个体r的适应度值，p_j(r)是第j个事件中个体r被选中的概率，而z̄_j是公式(29.2b)给出的样本均值。
formula-notes:formula_29.2c:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在讨论选择事件与适应度分配的章节，用于量化适应度在事件中的变异程度，为后续将适应度分布与标准分布（如伯努利分布）联系起来提供方差计算工具。

formula-notes:formula_29.2c:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the sample variance of a character z across individuals in episode j, using the probability p_j(r) of each individual r. Key symbols: Var(z_j) is the variance, n is sample size, z(r) is character value, p_j(r) is probability, and overline{z}_j is the mean from equation 29.2b.
formula-notes:formula_29.2c:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on episodes of selection to quantify the spread of fitness-related traits, supporting later arguments that fitness distributions (e.g., Bernoulli) can be characterized by their variance.

formula-notes:formula_29.3a:en.plainMeaning: The Leslie matrix L organizes age-structured population dynamics: the first row contains age-specific fecundities b_x, and the subdiagonal contains survival probabilities ℓ_x, projecting the population vector from one time step to the next.
formula-notes:formula_29.3a:en.inThisChapter: This matrix formalizes the life cycle in a constant environment, providing the foundation for deriving the Euler–Lotka equation (29.3b–d) that links fitness to age-specific schedules.

formula-notes:formula_29.3b:en.plainMeaning: This matrix, L_ind, describes the age-structured life cycle of an individual that last reproduced at age m, with first-row entries f_x = b_x/2 (half the offspring produced at age x) and subdiagonal ones representing survival to the next age class.
formula-notes:formula_29.3b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on episodes of selection to model an individual's contribution to population growth, supporting later arguments that decompose fitness into age-specific components and connect to the Euler-Lotka equation.

formula-notes:formula_29.3b:zh.plainMeaning: 该矩阵L_ind是一个m×m的Leslie矩阵，第一行包含个体在各年龄x的生育力f_x（即b_x/2），次对角线元素为1，其余为0，用于描述一个最后在年龄m繁殖的个体的年龄结构动态。
formula-notes:formula_29.3b:zh.inThisChapter: 本节从种群水平的Leslie矩阵（公式29.3a）转向个体水平，公式29.3b定义了个体Leslie矩阵，为后续推导个体适应度（如公式29.3c、29.3d）提供基础，从而将选择作用与个体繁殖成功联系起来。

formula-notes:formula_29.3c:en.plainMeaning: This equation computes the individual growth rate λ_ind as the largest eigenvalue of the individual projection matrix L_ind by solving the modified Euler-Lotka equation, where f_i are age-specific fecundities and λ_ind is the unknown growth rate.
formula-notes:formula_29.3c:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on episodes of selection to derive the individual growth rate, which is used to assign fitness to individuals and support the argument that fitness can be decomposed into contributions from different life stages.

formula-notes:formula_29.3d:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes an unbiased estimator of the relative fitness w(j) for individual j as a weighted sum of its fecundities f_i(j) at ages i=1 to k, discounted by the population growth rate λ raised to the power -i.
formula-notes:formula_29.3d:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on episodes of selection and fitness assignment to provide a method for estimating relative fitness when the mean population growth rate λ is known, supporting later arguments about unbiased fitness estimation.

formula-notes:formula_29.3c:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式通过将各年龄段的生育力 f_i 乘以个体增长率 λ_ind 的负 i 次方并求和等于 1，来求解个体增长率 λ_ind（即 Leslie 矩阵 L_ind 的最大特征值）。
formula-notes:formula_29.3c:zh.inThisChapter: 在讨论选择事件与适合度分配的章节中，该公式用于从个体水平的 Leslie 矩阵推导出个体的增长率 λ_ind，为后续比较不同个体的适合度（增长率）提供计算基础。

formula-notes:formula_29.3a:zh.plainMeaning: 该矩阵L（Leslie矩阵）的第一行b1,b2,…,bk表示各年龄段的生育力（每个个体产生的后代数），次对角线ℓ1,ℓ2,…,ℓ_{k-1}表示各年龄段的存活率（从年龄x存活到x+1的概率），其余元素为0。它连接了年龄结构向量n(t)与n(t+1)，即n(t+1)=L n(t)。
formula-notes:formula_29.3a:zh.inThisChapter: 在本章“选择时段与适合度分配”中，该矩阵用于将年龄结构种群动态线性化，从而通过特征值（尤其是最大特征值λ）定义适合度，并为后续推导稳定年龄分布（公式29.3b）和特征方程（公式29.3c、29.3d）提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_29.3d:zh.plainMeaning: 公式 (29.3d) 计算个体 j 的相对适应度 w(j)，它是将个体 j 在各年龄 i 的半数繁殖力 f_i(j) 乘以种群增长率 λ 的负 i 次方后求和。
formula-notes:formula_29.3d:zh.inThisChapter: 本节讨论选择事件与适应度分配，该公式在已知 λ 时提供无偏的相对适应度估计，为后续比较不同个体的适应度差异奠定基础。

formula-notes:formula_29.4a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算Leslie矩阵元素L_ij的敏感性s_ij，即L_ij的微小变化如何影响总增长率λ，具体等于左特征向量v_i与右特征向量w_j的乘积除以v和w的点积。
