formula-notes:formula_29.4a:zh.inThisChapter: 本节讨论选择事件与适合度分配，该公式用于量化Leslie矩阵元素对种群增长率的影响，为后续推导敏感性分解（如公式29.4b-d）提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_29.4a:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the sensitivity of the dominant eigenvalue λ of a Leslie matrix L to a small change in matrix element L_ij, expressed as the product of the i-th left eigenvector component v_i and the j-th right eigenvector component w_j divided by the dot product v^T w.
formula-notes:formula_29.4a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on episodes of selection and fitness assignment to quantify how changes in demographic rates (matrix entries) affect population growth rate, supporting later arguments about selection gradients and evolutionary dynamics.

formula-notes:formula_29.4b:zh.plainMeaning: 弹性 e_{ij} 衡量矩阵元素 L_{ij} 的微小比例变化引起种群增长率 λ 的比例变化，等于 L_{ij} 除以 λ 再乘以敏感性 s_{ij}。
formula-notes:formula_29.4b:zh.inThisChapter: 本节通过弹性将敏感性与比例变化联系起来，为后续比较不同生命阶段对 λ 的相对贡献（如公式 29.4c 和 29.4d）提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_29.4b:en.plainMeaning: The elasticity e_ij measures the proportional change in λ (population growth rate) per proportional change in the matrix element L_ij (transition or fecundity rate), and equals L_ij/λ times the sensitivity s_ij.
formula-notes:formula_29.4b:en.inThisChapter: This formula appears in the section on episodes of selection to quantify how relative changes in life-history transitions affect fitness, supporting later arguments about the decomposition of selection gradients into elasticities.

formula-notes:formula_29.4c:en.plainMeaning: This formula defines the elasticity e_ij as the proportional change in population growth rate λ per proportional change in a life-history transition L_ij, equivalently expressed as the derivative of ln(λ) with respect to ln(L_ij).
formula-notes:formula_29.4c:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on episodes of selection to quantify the sensitivity of fitness (λ) to changes in vital rates, supporting later arguments about how selection acts on different life-history components.

formula-notes:formula_29.4d:en.plainMeaning: This formula shows that the population growth rate λ equals the sum over all matrix elements L_{ij} of the product of each element and its sensitivity s_{ij}, because elasticities e_{ij} sum to 1 and e_{ij} = (L_{ij}/λ) s_{ij}.
formula-notes:formula_29.4d:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on episodes of selection to demonstrate that elasticities provide a link between trait impacts on fitness components and the effect of those components on λ, supporting later arguments about selection gradients.

formula-notes:formula_29.5a:en.plainMeaning: This formula defines the opportunity for selection I as the variance in relative fitness, which equals the variance in absolute fitness σ²_W divided by the square of mean absolute fitness W̄².
formula-notes:formula_29.5a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to quantify the maximum possible strength of selection on any trait, providing a baseline measure that later arguments (e.g., Equation 29.5b) use to relate selection differentials to fitness variance.

formula-notes:formula_29.5b:en.plainMeaning: This formula estimates the index of total selection (I) as the variance in relative fitness (w), using the sample mean of squared relative fitness (overline{w^2}) and sample size n.
formula-notes:formula_29.5b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to quantify the total opportunity for selection, supporting later arguments that partition selection into components like viability and fecundity.

formula-notes:formula_29.5a:zh.plainMeaning: 这个公式定义了选择机会 I，它等于相对适应度 w 的方差 σ²_w，也等于绝对适应度 W 的方差 σ²_W 除以平均适应度 W̄ 的平方。
formula-notes:formula_29.5a:zh.inThisChapter: 在介绍单变量选择的章节中，该公式引入了一个无需对选择性状或性质做假设的度量，为后续推导相对适应度方差与选择强度之间的关系（如公式 29.5b）提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_29.4c:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将弹性 e_{ij} 定义为种群增长率 λ 的相对变化与生命表参数 L_{ij} 的相对变化之比，等价于 ln(λ) 对 ln(L_{ij}) 的导数。
formula-notes:formula_29.4c:zh.inThisChapter: 在“选择事件与适合度分配”这一节中，该公式将弹性从比例变化形式转换为对数导数形式，为后续推导弹性与敏感性的关系（如公式 29.4d）以及分析不同生命阶段对适合度的影响提供数学工具。

formula-notes:formula_29.4d:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式通过将弹性 e_ij 定义为 (L_ij/λ) * s_ij，并利用所有弹性之和为1的性质，将种群增长率 λ 表示为矩阵元素 L_ij 与敏感度 s_ij 乘积之和。
formula-notes:formula_29.4d:zh.inThisChapter: 本节引入弹性概念后，此公式展示了弹性与敏感度的关系，并为后续讨论性状对适合度组分的影响如何传递到增长率（van Tienderen 2000）提供代数基础。

formula-notes:formula_29.5b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式用样本数据估计适应度方差 I，其中 n 为样本大小，w 为相对适应度，w² 为 w 的平方的样本均值，通过 n/(n-1) 校正偏差。
formula-notes:formula_29.5b:zh.inThisChapter: 本章引入总选择指数 I 来量化选择强度，此公式提供 I 的无偏估计，为后续分析选择对群体遗传结构的影响奠定基础。

formula-notes:formula_29.6a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算性状z与适应度w之间的相关系数绝对值，等于协方差绝对值除以z的标准差与w的标准差之积，也等于选择差S的绝对值除以z的标准差与I的平方根之积，且该值不超过1。
formula-notes:formula_29.6a:zh.inThisChapter: 此处利用相关系数绝对值≤1的性质，将选择差S与选择梯度I联系起来，为后续推导|ī|≤√I（公式29.6b）提供直接依据。

formula-notes:formula_29.6a:en.plainMeaning: This formula expresses the absolute value of the correlation coefficient between trait z and fitness w as the absolute covariance divided by the product of standard deviations, which equals the absolute selection differential S divided by the product of the trait standard deviation and the square root of the opportunity for selection I, and is bounded by 1.
formula-notes:formula_29.6a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to univariate selection to derive the upper bound on the standardized selection differential (|ī| ≤ √I) via the inequality |ρ| ≤ 1, linking selection intensity to the opportunity for selection.

formula-notes:formula_29.6b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式表明，标准化选择梯度（即平均超额）的绝对值不超过选择强度I的平方根，其中I是方差标准化的选择强度。
formula-notes:formula_29.6b:zh.inThisChapter: 它由相关系数绝对值≤1的约束（公式29.6a）直接推导得出，为后续讨论选择梯度的上界以及标准化选择强度的测量提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_29.6b:en.plainMeaning: This inequality states that the absolute value of the mean standardized selection differential (|\bar{\imath}|) is bounded above by the square root of the variance in relative fitness (I).
formula-notes:formula_29.6b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to univariate selection to establish a fundamental constraint on the strength of selection, supporting later derivations of selection limits and the relationship between selection differential and fitness variance.

formula-notes:formula_29.7a:en.plainMeaning: This formula defines the variance in relative fitness of the jth fitness component, I_j, as the variance of w_j, which equals E(w_j^2) - 1 because the mean of w_j is 1.
formula-notes:formula_29.7a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in this section to quantify the opportunity for selection on a specific fitness component, supporting later decomposition of total opportunity for selection into components via Equation 29.7b.

formula-notes:formula_29.6c:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将标准化选择梯度（$\bar{\imath}$）的绝对值表示为性状与相对适应度之间的相关系数（$|\rho(z,w)|$）与选择强度（$\sqrt{I}$）的乘积，即选择梯度受限于性状-适应度相关性和选择强度的共同作用。
formula-notes:formula_29.6c:zh.inThisChapter: 在本节中，该公式用于说明$I$作为$\bar{\imath}$上界的有效性依赖于性状与适应度的相关性，为后续讨论单变量选择测量中相关性的重要性提供定量依据。

formula-notes:formula_29.6c:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the absolute value of the mean standardized selection differential |̄ı| as the product of the absolute correlation |ρ(z,w)| between the character z and relative fitness w, and the square root of the opportunity for selection I. Key symbols: ̄ı (mean standardized selection differential), ρ(z,w) (correlation), I (opportunity for selection).
formula-notes:formula_29.6c:en.inThisChapter: It appears in this section to show that the bound of ̄ı by √I (from Equation 29.6b) is tightened by the correlation ρ(z,w), supporting the argument that I alone is a useful bound only when the character is strongly correlated with fitness.

formula-notes:formula_29.7b:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the sample variance of relative fitness for the jth fitness component, using the fitness-weighted frequency p_{j-1}(r) to account for selection up to episode j-1. Key symbols: w_j(r) is relative fitness of individual r in episode j, p_{j-1}(r) is the frequency after j-1 episodes, n is sample size.
formula-notes:formula_29.7b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on variance in individual fitness to provide an unbiased estimator for I_j (Equation 29.7a), supporting the partition of total selection intensity I across multiple episodes of selection as discussed by Arnold and Wade.

formula-notes:formula_29.7a:zh.plainMeaning: 公式 I_j = σ²(w_j) = E(w_j²) - 1 定义了第 j 个适应度组分的相对适应度 w_j 的方差，其中 E(w_j²) 是 w_j 的二阶矩，减 1 是因为 w_j 的期望为 1。
formula-notes:formula_29.7a:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在“个体适应度方差”一节，为后续将总选择梯度 I 分解为各组分贡献（如公式 29.7b）提供基础，通过定义组分方差来量化各生活史阶段的选择强度。

formula-notes:formula_29.8:en.plainMeaning: This formula partitions the total opportunity for selection (I) into contributions from each of k episodes of selection (I_j) plus a remainder term R that captures covariances among fitness components across episodes.
formula-notes:formula_29.8:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on variance in individual fitness to show how the total selection intensity can be decomposed into episodic components, supporting later analyses of how selection acts at different life stages.

formula-notes:formula_29.8:zh.plainMeaning: 公式(29.8)将总选择强度I分解为k个选择时段各自的选择强度I_j之和加上一个剩余项R，其中I_j是第j个时段的贡献，R代表各适应度分量之间的协方差总和。
formula-notes:formula_29.8:zh.inThisChapter: 本章讨论个体适应度方差的分割，该公式出现在“个体适应度方差”一节，为后续分析多时段选择下总选择强度的组成提供分解框架，并引出剩余项R作为后续讨论的重点。

formula-notes:formula_29.9a:en.plainMeaning: This equation relates the variance in family size after selection (σ₂²) to the variance before selection (σ₁²), given mean family sizes sμ and μ, where s is survival probability and μ is mean offspring number before selection.
formula-notes:formula_29.9a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on variance in individual fitness to derive the relationship between the indices of variation I₂ and I₁, leading to Equation 29.9b which simplifies the comparison of fitness variation before and after selection.

formula-notes:formula_29.7b:zh.plainMeaning: 公式 (29.7b) 计算第 j 个适应度分量相对适应度 w_j 的样本方差的无偏估计，其中 w_j^2 的样本均值减去 1 后乘以 n/(n-1) 得到方差估计，求和项 ∑ w_j^2(r) p_{j-1}(r) 表示用第 j-1 轮选择后的适应度加权频率 p_{j-1}(r) 对 w_j^2 加权平均。
formula-notes:formula_29.7b:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在“个体适应度方差”一节，用于将理论方差 I_j = E(w_j^2)-1 (29.7a) 转化为实际可计算的样本估计量，为后续将总选择强度 I 分解为各分量贡献（如 Arnold 和 Wade 的分解）提供统计基础。

formula-notes:formula_29.9a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将选择后（经过生存筛选）的家族大小方差 σ₂² 与选择前的方差 σ₁² 联系起来，其中 μ 是选择前的平均家族大小，s 是随机个体的生存概率，因此 sμ 是选择后的平均家族大小。
formula-notes:formula_29.9a:zh.inThisChapter: 在本节“个体适合度的方差”中，该公式用于推导选择前后方差与均值的关系，为后续得到 I₂ - 1/(sμ) = I₁ - 1/μ 以及进一步讨论方差分量提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_29.9b:zh.plainMeaning: 公式将总选择机会 I₂ 表示为初始选择机会 I₁ 加上一个修正项 (1/s - 1)/μ，其中 s 是存活率，μ 是平均后代数，修正项量化了随机后代死亡对选择机会的贡献。
formula-notes:formula_29.9b:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在讨论个体适合度方差来源的章节中，用于分离随机后代死亡率对选择机会的影响，为后续比较不同生命阶段的选择强度提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_29.9b:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the opportunity for selection (I₂) when only random offspring mortality contributes, as a function of the initial opportunity (I₁), the survival probability (s), and the mean number of offspring (μ).
formula-notes:formula_29.9b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on variance in individual fitness to isolate the effect of random mortality on the opportunity for selection, supporting the argument that such mortality inflates I₂ relative to I₁.

formula-notes:formula_29.10:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the standardized variance in fitness (I) for a binomial distribution, where p is the mean copulatory success. For small p, I approximates 1/p.
formula-notes:formula_29.10:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on variance in individual fitness to show how the opportunity for selection (I) increases dramatically when mean fitness is low, supporting arguments about strong selection in rare mating events.

formula-notes:formula_29.11a:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the opportunity for sexual selection (I_s) as the variance in mating success (σ²(MS)) divided by the square of the mean mating success (MS̄²), quantifying the standardized variance in number of mates per male (or female).
formula-notes:formula_29.11a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on measuring sexual selection to provide a quantitative index of the potential for sexual selection, supporting later arguments that link variance in mating success to the strength of selection.

formula-notes:formula_29.12:en.plainMeaning: This formula models the relationship between reproductive success (RS) and mating success (MS) for a given sex s, where β_ss is the regression slope (sexual selection gradient) indicating how much RS changes per unit increase in MS, and e_s is the residual error.
formula-notes:formula_29.12:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on measuring sexual selection to quantify the opportunity for sexual selection by regressing RS on MS, supporting later arguments about the strength of sexual selection across sexes and species.

formula-notes:formula_29.11b:en.plainMeaning: Morisita's index Iδ quantifies the degree of non-randomness in mating success distribution, where N is the number of individuals and mi is the number of mates for individual i. It adjusts the variance in mating success by the variance expected under random mating.
formula-notes:formula_29.11b:en.inThisChapter: This formula appears in the section on measuring sexual selection to provide a metric that accounts for the variance in mating success relative to random expectations, supporting later comparisons of mating system skew.

formula-notes:formula_29.10:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算个体适应度的方差与均值平方之比（即变异系数平方），当平均交配成功概率p很小时，该比值近似等于1/p。
formula-notes:formula_29.10:zh.inThisChapter: 本章讨论个体适应度方差对选择强度的影响，此公式将二项分布方差p(1-p)代入I的定义，并给出p≪1时的简化形式，为后续分析低平均适应度下选择潜力的放大效应提供数学依据。

formula-notes:formula_29.11c:en.plainMeaning: Q computes the standardized variance in mating success, adjusting the observed variance (σ²_m) by the mean (μ_m) and scaling by the maximum possible variance (Nμ²_m - μ_m). Key symbols: μ_m = mean number of mates, σ²_m = variance in number of mates, N = population size.
formula-notes:formula_29.11c:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on measuring sexual selection to provide an alternative index (Green's index) that normalizes the variance in mating success relative to its theoretical maximum, supporting comparisons of the opportunity for selection across populations or species.

formula-notes:formula_29.11b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算Morisita指数I_δ，其中N是总个体数，m_i是第i个个体的配偶数，通过调整配偶数的方差来量化交配成功的不均匀程度。
formula-notes:formula_29.11b:zh.inThisChapter: 在本节“测量性选择”中，该公式用于衡量交配成功率的变异，作为性选择强度的指标，为后续比较不同种群或条件下的性选择强度提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_29.11c:zh.plainMeaning: Q 计算的是实际交配成功方差（σ_m²）与随机交配期望方差（μ_m）的差值，除以最大可能方差（Nμ_m² - μ_m），从而将观测方差标准化到0到1之间。
formula-notes:formula_29.11c:zh.inThisChapter: 本节讨论性选择强度的测量，Q 作为 Green 的资源垄断指数，调整了交配成功方差相对于最大可能值的比例，为后续比较不同群体或物种的性选择强度提供标准化指标。

formula-notes:formula_29.11a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算雄性交配成功机会的标准化方差，其中分子σ²(MS)是雄性交配成功次数（每个雄性获得的配偶数）的方差，分母是平均交配成功次数的平方，比值Iₛ量化了性选择的潜在强度。
formula-notes:formula_29.11a:zh.inThisChapter: 本节讨论性选择的测量，该公式将交配成功变异转化为无量纲指标，为后续比较不同种群或性别的选择潜力（如公式29.11b和29.11c）提供标准化基础。

formula-notes:formula_29.12:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式通过将总繁殖成功（RS_s）对交配成功（MS_s）进行线性回归，用回归系数β_ss量化性选择梯度，即每个额外配偶带来的繁殖成功增量。
formula-notes:formula_29.12:zh.inThisChapter: 此处用于建立性选择潜力的定量指标，为后续比较不同性别间性选择强度以及解释性二态演化提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_29.13a:en.plainMeaning: This formula expresses male reproductive success (RS_m) as a linear function of his own mating success (MS_m) and his partner's mating success (MS_f), with coefficients β_mm and β_mf representing the Bateman gradients for male and female components, plus an error term e_m.
formula-notes:formula_29.13a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on measuring sexual selection to extend Bateman's principle to simultaneous hermaphrodites, allowing estimation of sex-specific selection gradients from individual reproductive success data, and supports later arguments about the strength and direction of sexual selection in hermaphrodites.

formula-notes:formula_29.13a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将雄性个体的生殖成功（RS_m）表示为常数项加上雄性自身交配成功率（MS_m）的效应（β_mm）、雌性交配成功率（MS_f）的效应（β_mf）以及残差（e_m）的线性组合，用于量化性选择中雄性的Bateman梯度。
formula-notes:formula_29.13a:zh.inThisChapter: 在“测量性选择”章节中，该公式引入广义Bateman梯度，通过区分自身与异性的交配成功率对生殖成功的影响，为后续分析性选择强度（如β_mm）和性冲突（如β_mf）提供基础，并与公式(29.13b)共同构成雌雄对称的分析框架。

formula-notes:formula_29.14b:en.plainMeaning: This inequality states that the absolute value of the mean standardized selection differential (|ī|) is at most the Jones index (I_J), which quantifies the opportunity for sexual selection.
formula-notes:formula_29.14b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on measuring sexual selection to provide an upper bound on the change in a trait due to sexual selection, supporting the argument that I_J is a meaningful measure of selection's potential.

formula-notes:formula_29.13b:zh.plainMeaning: 公式(29.13b)将雌性生殖成功(RS_f)建模为常数项、雌性自身交配成功率(MS_f)的效应(β_ff)、雄性交配成功率(MS_m)的交叉效应(β_fm)以及残差(e_f)的线性组合。
formula-notes:formula_29.13b:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式与(29.13a)共同构成广义Bateman梯度，用于量化雌性生殖成功如何受自身及雄性交配成功率的影响，为后续比较两性选择强度差异提供回归框架。

formula-notes:formula_29.14a:en.plainMeaning: The Jones Index (I_J) quantifies the potential for sexual selection by multiplying the standardized selection gradient (β_ss) with the square root of the standardized variance in mating success (I_s).
formula-notes:formula_29.14a:en.inThisChapter: This formula appears in the section on measuring sexual selection to provide a composite metric that combines both the strength of selection (β_ss) and the opportunity for selection (I_s), supporting later comparisons of sexual selection across species or contexts.

formula-notes:formula_29.13c:en.plainMeaning: This formula models the reproductive success (RS) from selfing events (s_e) as a linear function of male mating success (MS_m) and female mating success (MS_f), with coefficients β_s_e_m and β_s_e_f representing the selection gradients for selfing.
formula-notes:formula_29.13c:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on measuring sexual selection to extend the Bateman gradient framework to hermaphrodites capable of self-fertilization, supporting the analysis of how selfing affects the relationship between mating success and reproductive success.

formula-notes:formula_29.13b:en.plainMeaning: This formula models female reproductive success (RS_f) as a linear function of her own mating success (MS_f) and her mate's mating success (MS_m), with coefficients β_ff and β_fm representing the Bateman gradients for female and male gametes, respectively.
formula-notes:formula_29.13b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on measuring sexual selection to quantify how female fitness depends on both her own and her partner's mating success, supporting the analysis of sex-specific selection gradients and potential sexual conflict.

formula-notes:formula_29.14c:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the standardized strength of sexual selection on a specific trait, where m' is the covariance between the standardized trait value z_sd and the mating success ms.
formula-notes:formula_29.14c:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on measuring sexual selection to provide a standardized metric (analogous to i-bar) that quantifies how strongly a trait is associated with mating success, supporting later comparisons across traits or studies.

formula-notes:formula_29.14b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式表明，性选择引起的任何性状的平均变化（|ī|）不会超过性选择强度指数 I_J，即性选择对性状变化的影响存在一个由 I_J 给定的上限。
formula-notes:formula_29.14b:zh.inThisChapter: 在“测量性选择”这一节中，该公式紧接公式 29.14a 的上界推导，利用与公式 29.6b 相同的逻辑，为后续公式 29.14c 和 29.14d 中进一步分解 I_J 或建立更具体的界限提供了基础。

formula-notes:formula_29.14a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算琼斯指数 I_J，它等于 Bateman 梯度 β_ss 乘以机会指数 I_s 的平方根，用于量化性选择的综合潜力。
formula-notes:formula_29.14a:zh.inThisChapter: 在“测量性选择”一节中，该公式将 Bateman 梯度（选择强度）与机会指数（交配机会变异）结合为一个复合指标，为后续比较不同物种或性别的性选择强度提供统一度量。

formula-notes:formula_29.14c:zh.plainMeaning: 公式 m' = σ(z_sd, ms) 计算的是标准化后的性选择强度，其中 z_sd 是标准化后的性状值（均值为0，方差为1），ms 是雄性交配成功率的相对值（均值为1），σ 表示协方差。
formula-notes:formula_29.14c:zh.inThisChapter: 在“测量性选择”一节中，该公式作为 Jones (2009) 定义的标准化性选择强度指标，是公式 29.14a 中 ī = σ(z_sd, w) 的类比，将适应度 w 替换为雄性交配成功率 ms，用于量化特定性状上的性选择强度，为后续比较不同性状或物种的性选择强度提供标准化度量。

formula-notes:formula_29.13c:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将自交事件（s_e）的繁殖成功（RS_{s_e}）建模为雄性投入（MS_m）和雌性投入（MS_f）的线性函数，其中β_{s_e m}和β_{s_e f}分别是MS_m和MS_f对RS_{s_e}的偏回归斜率（选择梯度），e_{s_e}为残差。
formula-notes:formula_29.13c:zh.inThisChapter: 在测量性选择的章节中，公式29.13c与29.13a（雄性繁殖成功）和29.13b（雌性繁殖成功）并列，共同构成对雌雄同体生物中三种繁殖途径（雄性功能、雌性功能、自交）的选择梯度系统，为后续分析自交如何影响性选择强度提供定量框架。

formula-notes:formula_29.14d:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the standardized strength of selection on a trait (τ̄) as the product of the Bateman gradient (βₛₛ) and the standardized strength of sexual selection (m′).
formula-notes:formula_29.14d:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on measuring sexual selection to provide a concise expression linking the Bateman gradient to selection intensity, supporting the Jones equation derived from Equation 6.10.

formula-notes:formula_29.15b:en.plainMeaning: This formula estimates the total difference between the cumulative distribution functions of a trait before and after selection, using ordered phenotypes z_i and their relative fitnesses w_j. The sum accumulates the absolute weighted differences between consecutive phenotypes.
formula-notes:formula_29.15b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on describing phenotypic selection to provide an empirical estimator for the theoretical metric d defined in Equation 29.15a, supporting later analyses of selection's effect on trait distributions.

formula-notes:formula_29.15a:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the total difference between the cumulative distribution functions of a trait before (F(z)) and after (F*(z)) selection, integrated over all trait values z. F(z) is the cumulative distribution of the trait before selection, defined as the integral of the probability density p(x) from -∞ to z.
formula-notes:formula_29.15a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in this section to introduce a metric (d) that quantifies the overall strength and nature of selection based on the entire phenotypic distribution, supporting later arguments about how selection changes the shape of the distribution beyond just moments.

formula-notes:formula_29.14d:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将标准化选择强度（τ̄）定义为Bateman梯度（β_ss）与标准化性选择强度（m′）的乘积，其中β_ss衡量交配成功率对繁殖成功的影响，m′衡量性状对交配成功率的影响。
formula-notes:formula_29.14d:zh.inThisChapter: 在“测量性选择”章节中，此公式整合了Bateman梯度（β_ss）和标准化性选择强度（m′），为后续通过Jones方程量化性选择对性状的总选择强度提供直接计算关系。

formula-notes:formula_29.15c:en.plainMeaning: This formula states that the distance d equals the absolute value of the mean standardized selection differential (ī). It connects the DSD (d) to the magnitude of directional selection.
formula-notes:formula_29.15c:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on describing phenotypic selection to show a property of the DSD under strictly directional selection, supporting later arguments about selection gradients and response to selection.

formula-notes:formula_29.15b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式通过将排序后的表型值区间长度 (z_{i+1}-z_{i}) 乘以该区间之前所有个体相对适应度偏差的累积绝对值来估计选择前后累积分布函数的总差异 d。
formula-notes:formula_29.15b:zh.inThisChapter: 在描述表型选择变化的章节中，公式(29.15b)给出了公式(29.15a)中理论量 d 的经验估计方法，为后续讨论选择强度度量（如公式29.15c-29.15e）提供实证基础。

formula-notes:formula_29.15a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算选择前后性状累积分布函数F(z)和F*(z)之差的绝对值在整个z轴上的积分，得到一个标量d，用于量化选择导致的整个分布形状的变化。
formula-notes:formula_29.15a:zh.inThisChapter: 在描述表型选择的章节中，该公式引入了一个基于累积分布函数差异的选择强度度量d，为后续讨论其经验估计（公式29.15b）及与其他度量（如公式29.15c-e）的关系提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_29.15d:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the nondirectional selection fraction d_N by subtracting the absolute value of the mean standardized selection differential |ī| from the total selection intensity d, isolating the residual selection after removing the strictly directional component.
formula-notes:formula_29.15d:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on changes in phenotypic moments to quantify how much selection remains nondirectional after accounting for directional selection, supporting later arguments about the decomposition of selection into directional and nondirectional parts.

formula-notes:formula_29.15c:zh.plainMeaning: 在严格定向选择（即适应度函数W(z)是z的单调函数）下，DSD（方向选择差）d等于选择梯度绝对值|ī|，其中ī是选择梯度（公式29.15a中定义的平均标准化选择梯度）。
formula-notes:formula_29.15c:zh.inThisChapter: 本节讨论表型选择描述中表型矩的变化，公式29.15c是DSD在定向选择下的一个特例，它简化了d与选择梯度ī的关系，为后续推导DSD的其他性质（如公式29.15d和29.15e）提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_29.15e:zh.plainMeaning: 该不等式表明，对于方差标准化的性状，方向选择差异度（DSD）d 不超过相对适应度方差 I 的平方根，即 d 的上界由 I 决定。
formula-notes:formula_29.15e:zh.inThisChapter: 本节讨论表型选择的描述，该公式将 DSD 与选择机会（公式 29.6b）联系起来，说明选择机会对 DSD 的约束，为后续理解选择强度提供边界。

formula-notes:formula_29.15e:en.plainMeaning: This inequality states that the directional selection differential d (for a variance-standardized trait) is bounded by the square root of the variance in relative fitness I, linking the magnitude of directional selection to the opportunity for selection.
formula-notes:formula_29.15e:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the discussion of the directional selection differential (DSD) to show that the bound from the opportunity for selection (Equation 29.6b) also applies to d, reinforcing the connection between phenotypic selection and fitness variation.

formula-notes:formula_29.15d:zh.plainMeaning: 公式 d_N = d - |i̅| 计算非定向选择分数，其中 d 是方差标准化后的选择差（即选择强度），|i̅| 是定向选择强度的绝对值，d_N 表示去除严格定向成分后剩余的残差选择量。
formula-notes:formula_29.15d:zh.inThisChapter: 本节讨论表型选择描述中的矩变化，该公式用于量化非定向选择分量，为后续分析选择如何改变表型分布的形状（如方差）提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_29.17:en.plainMeaning: This formula defines C as the covariance between relative fitness w and the squared deviation of trait value z from its mean μ, measuring how fitness varies with trait variance.
formula-notes:formula_29.17:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on changes in phenotypic moments to quantify the effect of selection on phenotypic variance, supporting later arguments about how selection alters trait distributions beyond the mean.

formula-notes:formula_9.23a:en.plainMeaning: This formula defines a summary statistic g as a linear combination of the unfolded site-frequency spectrum components ζ_i, where c_i are user-defined weights and n is the sample size.
formula-notes:formula_9.23a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in this section to introduce a general class of test statistics based on the site-frequency spectrum, which later supports deriving their expectations (Equation 9.23b) and variances for neutrality tests.

formula-notes:formula_22.50a:en.plainMeaning: This inequality states that altruism evolves when the relatedness coefficient r times the benefit b exceeds the cost c, i.e., r > c/b.
formula-notes:formula_22.50a:en.inThisChapter: It formalizes Hamilton's rule in the context of group selection, showing how kin selection can favor altruism despite individual costs.

formula-notes:formula_29.16b:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the stabilizing selection differential C, which measures the change in phenotypic variance due to selection after removing the effect of directional selection. σ²_z* is the phenotypic variance after selection, σ²_z is the variance before selection, and S² is the squared selection differential (directional selection effect).
formula-notes:formula_29.16b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on describing phenotypic selection to provide a corrected measure of variance change that isolates stabilizing selection from directional selection, supporting later arguments about distinguishing selection modes.

formula-notes:formula_29.18b:en.plainMeaning: This inequality bounds the absolute value of the covariance C between fitness and phenotype by the square root of the product of the selection intensity I and the excess kurtosis (μ₄,z − σ_z⁴) of the phenotype distribution.
formula-notes:formula_29.18b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on changes in phenotypic moments to quantify the maximum possible covariance given selection intensity and kurtosis, supporting later arguments about the limits of selection response.

formula-notes:formula_20.24c:en.plainMeaning: This formula expresses the variance of the predicted breeding value (σ²(â)) as the product of the squared accuracy (ρ²) and the additive genetic variance (σ²(A)).
formula-notes:formula_20.24c:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on applying mixed models to natural populations to show how the accuracy of prediction directly determines the reduction in variance of predicted values relative to true genetic variance, supporting later arguments about selection response and prediction reliability.

formula-notes:formula_29.16a:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the change in phenotypic variance after selection, where σ²_z* is the variance after selection, σ²_z is the variance before selection, σ[w, (z-μ_z)²] is the covariance between relative fitness and squared deviation from the mean, and S² is the squared selection differential.
formula-notes:formula_29.16a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on changes in phenotypic moments to decompose the change in variance into a component due to nonlinear selection (the covariance term) and a reduction due to directional selection (S²), supporting later arguments about how selection alters trait variance.

formula-notes:formula_29.18a:en.plainMeaning: This inequality bounds the squared covariance between relative fitness w and squared deviation (z-μ)^2 by the product of the variance in fitness and the variance of squared deviations, which equals the selection intensity I times the excess kurtosis (μ₄,z - σ_z⁴).
formula-notes:formula_29.18a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on changes in phenotypic moments to derive an upper bound on the change in phenotypic variance due to selection, supporting the argument that selection on variance is limited by the fourth moment of the trait distribution.

formula-notes:formula_14.17a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将潜在变量z通过指数函数映射到均值λ，确保λ为正数，从而作为泊松分布的期望值。
formula-notes:formula_14.17a:zh.inThisChapter: 本章讨论均值短期变化，此公式用于将线性预测值z（来自公式14.14a）转换为非负的泊松均值λ，为后续截断和阈值选择提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_29.17:zh.plainMeaning: 公式 C = σ[w, (z-μ)²] 计算相对适应度 w 与性状值偏离均值平方 (z-μ)² 之间的协方差，衡量选择如何改变性状方差。
formula-notes:formula_29.17:zh.inThisChapter: 本节推导选择对性状方差的影响，此公式类比选择差 S 的协方差定义，为后续推导方差变化量 Δσ² 提供关键中间量。

formula-notes:formula_18.30a:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the variance of the cumulative response to selection in generation t under pure drift, where σ²[R_C(t)] is the variance, h² is heritability, σ_z² is phenotypic variance, f_t is the inbreeding coefficient, B_0 and B_t are constants from the covariance structure, and A is the rate of increase of f_t per generation (f_t ≈ tA).
formula-notes:formula_18.30a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on control populations and experimental designs to quantify the uncertainty in response to selection over time, supporting later arguments about the precision of selection experiments and the design of controls.

formula-notes:formula_29.18a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将选择梯度C的平方上界表示为选择方差σ_w^2与表型方差σ^2[(z-μ)^2]的乘积，后者等于I乘以四阶中心矩μ_{4,z}与方差平方σ_z^4之差。
formula-notes:formula_29.18a:zh.inThisChapter: 在描述表型选择对表型矩变化的章节中，该公式由相关系数平方≤1推导而来，为后续通过不等式约束C的取值、进而分析选择强度提供理论界限。

formula-notes:formula_29.16a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算选择后表型方差（σ_{z^{*}}^2）与选择前表型方差（σ_z^2）之差，等于相对适合度w与表型值距均值平方(z-μ_z)^2的协方差减去选择差S的平方。
formula-notes:formula_29.16a:zh.inThisChapter: 在本节中，该公式用于分解选择对表型方差的影响，表明严格定向选择（S≠0）也会降低方差，为后续推导选择差与方差变化的关系（如公式29.16b）提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_29.16b:zh.plainMeaning: 公式 C = σ_{z*}^2 - σ_z^2 + S^2 计算的是稳定化选择差分 C，其中 σ_{z*}^2 是选择后表型方差，σ_z^2 是选择前方差，S^2 是定向选择导致的方差减少量（来自公式 29.16a）。
formula-notes:formula_29.16b:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在讨论表型选择如何改变方差的部分，通过减去定向选择对方差的影响（S^2），得到纯粹由稳定化选择引起的方差变化，为后续区分定向选择和稳定化选择对表型分布的作用提供校正指标。

formula-notes:formula_21.8b:zh.plainMeaning: 这个公式将个体观测值 \(z_{ij}\) 与家系均值 \(\mu_i\) 之差的方差 \(\sigma_w^2\) 分解为家系内遗传方差 \(\sigma_{Gw}^2\) 和环境方差 \(\sigma_{Es}^2\) 之和，即家系内表型方差由遗传和环境两部分组成。
formula-notes:formula_21.8b:zh.inThisChapter: 在推导家系内方差分量时，公式 (21.8b) 将 \(\sigma_w^2\) 分解为遗传和环境组分，为后续计算家系内遗传方差 \(\sigma_{Gw}^2\)（如公式 21.11b 和 21.26b）以及理解单周期响应中的方差结构提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_29.18b:zh.plainMeaning: 该不等式给出了方向性选择梯度C的上界，它由选择强度I、表型分布的四阶中心矩μ₄,z与方差平方σ_z⁴的差值的平方根决定。
formula-notes:formula_29.18b:zh.inThisChapter: 在描述表型选择如何改变表型矩的章节中，此公式将C的幅度限制为I和分布峰度的函数，为后续讨论选择梯度的可能范围以及与其他矩（如方差变化）的关系提供约束。

formula-notes:formula_22.37e:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the covariance between an individual's additive genetic effect for the shared group trait (A_{s_i}) and the sum of all other group members' total genetic effects (∑_{j≠i} z_j), expressed in terms of additive genetic variances and covariances of the direct (A_d) and social (A_s) traits, with relatedness r and group size n.
formula-notes:formula_22.37e:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on incorporating both individual and group information to derive the covariance structure needed for the total breeding value and the selection gradient, supporting the calculation of response to selection in socially interacting groups.

formula-notes:formula_22.12b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算在组内个体间遗传相关均为r时，总育种值A_T与表型z的协方差σ(z, A_T)。它由直接育种值方差σ²(A_d)、直接与间接育种值协方差σ(A_d, A_s)乘以(n-1)(1+r)、以及间接育种值方差σ²(A_s)乘以r(n-1)²三部分组成。
formula-notes:formula_22.12b:zh.inThisChapter: 本章讨论存在关联效应（associative effects）时的选择，公式(22.12b)是(22.12a)在组内所有个体间亲缘系数均为r时的特例，为后续推导(22.12d)和(22.12e)中基于亲缘关系的选择响应公式提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_23.36b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算自交T代时，基于t代自交系（f_t）和T代自交系（f_T）的遗传方差σ_G(T,T,t)，它等于加性方差σ_A^2乘以(1+f_t)加上显性方差σ_D^2乘以(1-f_T)^2/(1-f_t)*(1+f_t)。
formula-notes:formula_23.36b:zh.inThisChapter: 在纯系自交的家族选择章节中，该公式由一般公式(23.36a)简化而来，用于描述F_4家族（T=2, t=0）的遗传方差，为后续评估选择响应和最优选择策略提供方差分量表达式。

formula-notes:formula_29.18c:en.plainMeaning: This inequality bounds the absolute standardized selection differential |C|/σ_z^2 by the square root of twice the standardized variance of fitness (I), under the assumption that the trait z is normally distributed.
formula-notes:formula_29.18c:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on describing phenotypic selection via changes in phenotypic moments, specifically to show that the change in mean (C) relative to variance is limited by the strength of selection (I), supporting later arguments about constraints on evolutionary responses.

formula-notes:formula_29.20a:en.plainMeaning: This formula expresses the logarithmic derivative of mean fitness with respect to the population mean phenotype, showing that the relative change in mean fitness equals the absolute change divided by the mean fitness itself.
formula-notes:formula_29.20a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on describing phenotypic selection to relate the selection differential to the gradient of mean fitness, supporting later derivations of evolutionary change in phenotypic moments.

formula-notes:formula_18.28:zh.plainMeaning: 公式(18.28)计算了单向选择加对照设计中的响应R_C(t)，即选择群体在t代的表型均值与对照群体均值之差，它等于两个群体的遗传值之差加上环境误差之差。
formula-notes:formula_18.28:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在讨论选择实验设计的章节，用于将表型响应分解为遗传响应和环境偏差，为后续估计遗传增益和检验选择效果提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_29.18c:zh.plainMeaning: 该不等式将标准化协方差（|C|/σ_z^2）的上界与选择强度（√(2I)）联系起来，其中C是协方差，σ_z^2是表型方差，I是选择梯度。
formula-notes:formula_29.18c:zh.inThisChapter: 在推导表型矩变化时，利用正态分布的四阶矩性质（μ_4,z=3σ_z^4）简化不等式，得到该上界，为后续讨论选择强度对协方差变化的限制提供定量约束。

formula-notes:formula_29.20b:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the average directional selection gradient, which is the expected value (over the phenotypic distribution p(z)) of the slope of the individual fitness surface w(z) with respect to phenotype z.
formula-notes:formula_29.20b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on describing phenotypic selection to define the average slope of the fitness surface, supporting later arguments about how selection changes phenotypic moments (e.g., mean and variance).

formula-notes:formula_29.19:zh.plainMeaning: 公式 (29.19) 定义了二次选择梯度 γ，它等于相对适应度 w 与 (z-μ)² 的协方差 C 除以表型方差 σz⁴，用于量化选择对表型方差（即分布宽度）的影响。
formula-notes:formula_29.19:zh.inThisChapter: 在描述表型选择如何改变表型矩的章节中，γ 作为 β 的二次类比出现，为后续推导选择引起的方差变化（如 Δσ²）提供关键参数，并引出多元形式的 γ 矩阵以处理表型相关。

formula-notes:formula_29.19:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the quadratic selection gradient γ, which measures the strength of stabilizing or disruptive selection on a trait. Here, σ[w, (z-μ)²] is the covariance between relative fitness w and the squared deviation of trait value z from its mean μ, and σ_z⁴ is the square of the phenotypic variance.
formula-notes:formula_29.19:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on changes in phenotypic moments to quantify how selection alters the variance (and higher moments) of a trait distribution, complementing the directional selection gradient β introduced earlier.

formula-notes:formula_29.20c:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the average curvature of the individual fitness surface, where w(z) is individual fitness as a function of phenotype z, p(z) is the phenotype distribution, and the expectation E_z is taken over that distribution.
formula-notes:formula_29.20c:en.inThisChapter: It appears in this section to define the average quadratic selection gradient, which together with the linear gradient (Equation 29.20b) describes how the mean and variance of a normally distributed phenotype change under selection.

formula-notes:formula_29.20a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将平均适应度对群体均值μz的偏导数转换为对数平均适应度的偏导数，即用平均适应度W̅的偏导数除以W̅本身。
formula-notes:formula_29.20a:zh.inThisChapter: 在本章描述表型选择对群体均值变化的影响时，该公式为后续推导选择梯度（如公式29.20b、29.20c）提供了对数线性化的基础，便于分析相对适应度变化。

formula-notes:formula_29.22b:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the change in phenotypic variance due to the jth episode of selection, where C_j is the change in variance, σ_j^2 and σ_{j-1}^2 are the variances after and before the episode, and S_j is the selection differential (change in mean from Equation 29.22a).
formula-notes:formula_29.22b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on describing phenotypic selection to quantify how selection alters variance, supporting later arguments about cumulative selection effects across multiple episodes.

formula-notes:formula_29.21:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the expected change in phenotypic variance (Δσ_z²) after one generation of selection under the infinitesimal model, expressed in terms of heritability (h⁴), additive genetic variance (σ_A⁴), phenotypic variance (σ_z⁴), and selection differentials (C, S²) or selection gradients (γ, β²).
formula-notes:formula_29.21:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on changes in phenotypic moments to show how selection alters variance, supporting later arguments that variance change depends on both stabilizing/disruptive selection (γ) and directional selection (β²).

formula-notes:formula_29.20b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算个体适应度曲面相对于表型值z的偏导数的期望，即平均方向选择梯度，其中∂w(z)/∂z是个体适应度曲面的斜率，p(z)是表型分布的概率密度，积分或期望E_z[·]是对当前种群的表型分布进行的。
formula-notes:formula_29.20b:zh.inThisChapter: 在本节描述表型选择如何改变表型矩的上下文中，该公式作为平均方向选择梯度的定义出现，为后续推导表型均值的变化（如公式29.20c）提供基础，并与基于个体适应度曲面的其他梯度（如二次选择梯度）形成对比。

formula-notes:formula_29.22a:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the selection differential S_j for the jth episode of selection as the change in mean phenotype from before (μ_{j-1}) to after (μ_j) that episode.
formula-notes:formula_29.22a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on describing phenotypic selection to quantify the effect of a single episode on the mean, and it is used together with C_j (Eq. 29.22b) to track changes in variance across multiple episodes.

formula-notes:formula_29.22b:zh.plainMeaning: 公式(29.22b)计算第j次选择事件后的表型方差变化量C_j，它等于选择后方差σ_j²减去选择前方差σ_{j-1}²，再加上选择前后均值差S_j的平方。
formula-notes:formula_29.22b:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在描述表型选择如何改变表型矩的章节中，与(29.22a)的均值变化S_j对应，共同刻画单次选择对表型分布前两阶矩的影响，为后续推导多阶段选择累积效应提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_29.20c:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算个体适应度曲面二阶导数（曲率）关于表型分布p(z)的期望，即平均二次选择梯度E_z[∂²w(z)/∂z²]，量化选择对表型方差和协方差的平均非线性作用。
formula-notes:formula_29.20c:zh.inThisChapter: 在描述表型选择如何改变表型矩的章节中，该公式与29.20a（平均梯度）和29.20b（选择梯度β）并列，为后续推导表型分布变化方程（如Lande方程）提供曲率项，解释选择如何影响表型方差。

formula-notes:formula_29.22a:zh.plainMeaning: 公式 S_j = μ_j - μ_{j-1} 计算第 j 次选择事件前后群体平均表型值的变化，其中 μ_j 是选择后的均值，μ_{j-1} 是选择前的均值。
formula-notes:formula_29.22a:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在描述表型选择对均值影响的章节，为后续定义选择对表型方差的影响（公式 29.22b）以及更复杂的协方差变化（公式 29.22c-29.22e）提供基础度量。

formula-notes:formula_29.21:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算表型方差在单代选择后的期望变化量Δσ_z²，它等于加性遗传方差σ_A⁴除以2σ_z⁴再乘以(C - S²)，其中C是协方差项，S是选择差，或者等价地表示为σ_A⁴/2乘以(γ - β²)，其中γ是方差选择梯度，β是方向选择梯度。
formula-notes:formula_29.21:zh.inThisChapter: 本章讨论表型选择的描述，公式(29.21)将方差变化分解为方差选择(γ)和方向选择(β²)的贡献，为后续在正态性假设下简化选择响应分析提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_29.22c:en.plainMeaning: This formula defines the selection differential S_j and the selection intensity C_j for the j-th episode of selection: S_j is the covariance between relative fitness w_j and phenotype z, and C_j is the covariance between w_j and the squared deviation of z from the mean before selection μ_{j-1}.
formula-notes:formula_29.22c:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on describing phenotypic selection to quantify how each episode of selection changes the mean and variance of the phenotype, supporting the decomposition of total selection into components across episodes.

formula-notes:formula_29.23a:en.plainMeaning: This formula defines the linear selection gradient β_j and quadratic selection gradient γ_j for the jth episode of selection, where S_j is the selection differential, C_j is the selection covariance, and σ_{j-1}^2 is the phenotypic variance before that episode.
formula-notes:formula_29.23a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in this section to show how selection gradients are standardized by the phenotypic variance before each episode, enabling the calculation of changes in phenotypic moments across multiple episodes of selection.

formula-notes:formula_29.22e:en.plainMeaning: This formula decomposes the total change in phenotypic variance plus squared mean shift (C_T) into a sum of per-step variance changes (C_j) plus a correction term (S_T^2 minus sum of squared per-step mean shifts). Key symbols: C_T = total change in variance plus squared mean shift; σ_k^2, σ_0^2 = final and initial variances; S_T = total mean shift; C_j = change in variance at step j; S_j = mean shift at step j.
formula-notes:formula_29.22e:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on describing phenotypic selection via changes in phenotypic moments, showing that the total change in variance (including the squared mean shift) can be partitioned additively across selection episodes, supporting later analyses of how selection alters the phenotypic distribution.

formula-notes:formula_29.22c:zh.plainMeaning: 公式定义第j个选择事件的选择微分Sj为相对适应度wj与表型值z的协方差，选择微分Cj为wj与(z-μ_{j-1})²的协方差，其中μ_{j-1}是选择前的平均表型。
formula-notes:formula_29.22c:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式将选择微分分解到每个选择事件，为后续推导多事件选择下表型矩的变化（如公式29.22d和29.22e）提供基础，并衔接公式29.18c对选择微分界限的约束。

formula-notes:formula_29.22d:en.plainMeaning: This formula expresses the total selection differential S_T (the change in mean phenotype from episode 0 to episode k) as the sum of the selection differentials S_j from each individual episode j, showing that the total change in mean is additive across episodes.
formula-notes:formula_29.22d:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on describing phenotypic selection to show how the total change in mean phenotype can be partitioned into additive contributions from each selection episode, supporting later arguments about the decomposition of total selection into components.

formula-notes:formula_29.22d:zh.plainMeaning: 公式29.22d表示总选择差S_T等于最终均值μ_k减去初始均值μ_0，也等于各时段选择差S_j（即μ_i - μ_{i-1}）的累加和，其中j从1到k。
formula-notes:formula_29.22d:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在讨论表型选择描述中，说明总选择差可以分解为各时段选择差的加和，为后续推导总协方差C_T的分解（公式29.22e）提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_29.23b:en.plainMeaning: This formula expresses the total standardized selection gradient β_T as a weighted sum of the per-episode gradients β_j, where each weight a_j is the ratio of the trait variance at the start of episode j (σ_{j-1}^2) to the initial variance σ_0^2.
formula-notes:formula_29.23b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in this section to show how the overall selection gradient across multiple episodes depends on both the per-episode gradients and the changes in trait variance, supporting the later argument that variance dynamics can amplify or attenuate selection (Equation 29.23c).

formula-notes:formula_29.22e:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将总方差变化量 C_T（即表型方差从第0代到第k代的变化加上选择差平方 S_T^2）分解为各代方差变化量 C_j 之和，再减去一个由各代选择差平方和与总选择差平方之间的差异构成的修正项。
formula-notes:formula_29.22e:zh.inThisChapter: 在本节中，公式(29.22e)与(29.22d)共同将总选择微分（均值和方差的变化）分解为各代贡献之和，为后续推导选择响应和方差变化的可加性提供数学基础。

formula-notes:formula_29.23a:zh.plainMeaning: 公式定义了第j轮选择的方向梯度β_j和曲率梯度γ_j：β_j等于选择差S_j除以前一轮表型方差σ_{j-1}^2，γ_j等于选择微分C_j除以前一轮表型方差的平方σ_{j-1}^4。
formula-notes:formula_29.23a:zh.inThisChapter: 由于多轮选择中表型方差会变化，不能直接使用单轮公式；这里通过标准化S_j和C_j得到β_j和γ_j，为后续推导多轮选择后表型均值与方差的变化（如公式29.23b和29.23c）提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_29.23c:en.plainMeaning: This formula partitions the total nonlinear selection gradient γ into a weighted sum of within-episode nonlinear gradients γ_j (each weighted by a_j^2) plus a term that captures the difference between the squared total selection differential S_T^2 and the sum of squared episode-specific differentials S_j^2, scaled by 1/σ_0^4.
formula-notes:formula_29.23c:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on partitioning phenotypic selection across multiple episodes, extending the partition of the linear gradient to the nonlinear case, and supports later arguments about how covariance among episodes contributes to total nonlinear selection.

formula-notes:formula_29.24a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算方向选择差分估计量 Ŝⱼ 的抽样方差，等于第 j 期样本方差 σⱼ² 除以该期样本量 nⱼ，加上第 j-1 期样本方差 σⱼ₋₁² 除以该期样本量 nⱼ₋₁。
formula-notes:formula_29.24a:zh.inThisChapter: 本章描述表型选择的变化，该公式为后续使用 delta 方法推导选择梯度 C 的近似方差（公式 29.24b 和 29.24c）提供基础方差表达式。

formula-notes:formula_29.24a:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the sampling variance of the estimated directional selection differential (Ŝⱼ) as the sum of the variances of the means before and after selection, each divided by its respective sample size. Key symbols: σ²(Ŝⱼ) = variance of the estimated differential, σⱼ² = phenotypic variance after episode j, nⱼ = sample size after episode j, σⱼ₋₁² = variance before episode j, nⱼ₋₁ = sample size before episode j.
formula-notes:formula_29.24a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on describing phenotypic selection to quantify the uncertainty in estimates of selection differentials, supporting later arguments that use the delta method to derive large-sample variances for selection gradients (e.g., Equation 29.24b and 29.24c).

formula-notes:formula_29.24b:en.plainMeaning: This formula approximates the large-sample variance of the estimated covariance between phenotype and relative fitness, \(\widehat{C}_j\), as a function of the variance of the estimated selection differential \(\widehat{S}_j\), the selection differential \(S_j\), and the third and fourth central moments (\(\mu_3\), \(\mu_4\)) and variances (\(\sigma^2\)) of the phenotype before and after selection, with sample sizes \(n_j\) and \(n_{j-1}\).
formula-notes:formula_29.24b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on changes in phenotypic moments to provide a variance estimate for the covariance measure \(\widehat{C}_j\), enabling statistical inference (e.g., confidence intervals) for selection analysis, and it supports later simplifications under normality (Equation 29.24c).

formula-notes:formula_29.23c:zh.plainMeaning: 公式(29.23c)将总非线性选择梯度γ分解为各时段非线性梯度γ_j的加权和（权重为各时段选择强度平方a_j^2），再加上一项由总选择差分S_T与各时段选择差分S_j平方差除以σ_0^4构成的修正项，反映时段间选择方向不一致导致的额外非线性效应。
formula-notes:formula_29.23c:zh.inThisChapter: 本节在划分选择梯度β的基础上，进一步划分非线性梯度γ，为后续分析多时段选择下总选择如何由各时段贡献组合提供完整框架，并引出γ可能因时段间选择方向冲突而增大的关键特征。

formula-notes:formula_29.23b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将总选择梯度β_T表示为各时段选择梯度β_j的加权和，权重a_j是第j-1时段末的性状方差σ_{j-1}^2与初始方差σ_0^2之比。
formula-notes:formula_29.23b:zh.inThisChapter: 在描述表型选择对表型矩变化的章节中，公式29.23b通过分解总选择梯度，为后续推导总选择梯度与各时段方差变化的关系（如公式29.23c）提供了基础。

formula-notes:formula_29.24b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式给出了选择微分Ĉ_j的近似大样本方差，它由四项组成：第一项是4倍S_j平方乘以Ŝ_j的方差，第二项是8倍S_j乘以两个偏度项（μ₃,j/n_j + μ₃,j-1/n_{j-1}），第三和第四项分别是j和j-1期的峰度项（μ₄,j - σ_j⁴）/n_j和（μ₄,j-1 - σ_{j-1}⁴）/n_{j-1}。
formula-notes:formula_29.24b:zh.inThisChapter: 在推导了Ĉ_j的估计量后，本节需要给出其抽样方差以进行统计推断；该公式为后续在正态假设下简化（公式29.24c）以及构建置信区间提供了基础。

formula-notes:formula_29.25a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将相对适应度 w 分解为线性预测部分 a + βz 和残差 e，其中 β 是 w 对 z 的最小二乘回归斜率，a 是截距。
formula-notes:formula_29.25a:zh.inThisChapter: 在本节描述表型选择的个体适应度曲面中，该公式建立了相对适应度与表型值 z 之间的线性回归模型，为后续推导最佳线性预测器以及进一步分析选择梯度 β 的几何意义（如公式 29.25b-29.25e）提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_29.25a:en.plainMeaning: This formula expresses relative fitness w as a linear function of a phenotypic trait z, where a is the intercept, β is the selection gradient (slope), and e is the residual. It represents the least-squares linear regression of w on z.
formula-notes:formula_29.25a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on individual fitness surfaces to define the best linear predictor of relative fitness, which is used to quantify directional selection and to partition fitness into predicted and residual components, supporting later derivations of selection differentials and gradients.

formula-notes:formula_29.25b:en.plainMeaning: This formula expresses relative fitness w as a linear function of the deviation of the phenotype z from its mean μz, with slope β and residual e. The predicted relative fitness for a given z is ŵ(z) = 1 + β(z - μz).
formula-notes:formula_29.25b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on individual fitness surfaces to provide a simple linear regression model for describing phenotypic selection, supporting later arguments about estimating selection gradients and testing for nonlinear selection.

formula-notes:formula_29.26a:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the coefficient of determination (r²) for the linear regression of fitness w on trait z, expressing it as the squared covariance of z and w divided by the product of their variances, or equivalently as the squared regression slope times the variance of z divided by mean fitness (Î).
formula-notes:formula_29.26a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on individual fitness surfaces to quantify how much of the variance in fitness is explained by a linear relationship with the trait, supporting later arguments about the strength of selection and the interpretation of standardized regression coefficients.

formula-notes:formula_29.25d:en.plainMeaning: This formula states that the selection differential for a standardized trait (S_sd) equals the selection intensity (ī_z) of the trait on the original scale. The symbol ī_z represents the mean of the standardized trait after selection, i.e., the selection intensity.
formula-notes:formula_29.25d:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on individual fitness surfaces to show how standardization simplifies the relationship between selection differential and intensity, enabling easy comparison across traits with different variances.

formula-notes:formula_29.25c:en.plainMeaning: This formula models relative fitness (w) as a linear function of the standardized trait value (z_sd), where β_sd is the selection gradient representing the expected change in fitness per standard deviation change in the trait, and e is the residual error.
formula-notes:formula_29.25c:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on individual fitness surfaces to provide a standardized version of the Lande-Arnold regression, allowing direct comparison of selection gradients across traits with different variances, and supports later arguments about the strength of selection in standard deviation units.

formula-notes:formula_29.24c:en.plainMeaning: This formula approximates the sampling variance of the estimated selection differential Ĉ_j, assuming normally distributed phenotypes. It depends on the squared selection differential S_j^2, the variance of Ŝ_j, and the phenotypic variances σ_j^4 and σ_{j-1}^4 with sample sizes n_j and n_{j-1}.
formula-notes:formula_29.24c:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on describing phenotypic selection via changes in phenotypic moments, providing a practical approximation for the variance of the estimated selection differential when phenotypes are normal, which is used to assess the precision of selection estimates.

formula-notes:formula_29.25d:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式表明，标准化后的性状的选择微分 S_sd 等于该性状在原始尺度上的选择强度 ī_z。
formula-notes:formula_29.25d:zh.inThisChapter: 在讨论个体适合度曲面时，标准化使不同性状的选择强度可直接比较，此公式将标准化后的选择微分与原始选择强度联系起来，为后续比较不同性状的选择强度提供简便方法。

formula-notes:formula_29.25b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将相对适应度 w 表示为截距 1 加上线性项 β(z - μ_z) 与残差 e 之和，其中 β 是选择梯度，z 是表型值，μ_z 是表型均值。
formula-notes:formula_29.25b:zh.inThisChapter: 在本节中，该公式通过将回归线中心化（使截距为 1），为后续推导适应度预测值 ŵ(z) 和估计选择梯度 β 提供基础，并引出后续关于二次项（如公式 29.25c）的扩展。

formula-notes:formula_29.25c:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将相对适应度 w 表示为标准化性状值 z_sd 的线性函数，其中 β_sd 是标准化选择梯度，表示性状每变化一个标准差时适应度的预期变化，e 为残差。
formula-notes:formula_29.25c:zh.inThisChapter: 在介绍个体适应度曲面时，该公式将 Lande-Arnold 回归标准化，使得选择梯度 β_sd 具有标准差的量纲，便于比较不同尺度性状的选择强度，并为后续讨论非线性选择（如公式 29.25d）提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_29.26a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算线性回归中表型性状z解释的个体适合度w的方差比例，即决定系数r²。分子是z与w的协方差平方，分母是z的方差乘以w的方差；等价于回归系数β̂的平方乘以z的方差再除以适合度方差Î。
formula-notes:formula_29.26a:zh.inThisChapter: 本章讨论表型选择的描述，该公式将决定系数与回归系数β̂和适合度方差Î联系起来，为后续标准化回归（公式29.26b）和选择梯度解释提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_29.26b:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the squared correlation between standardized breeding value (z_sd) and fitness (w) as the square of the standardized selection gradient (β̂_sd) divided by the opportunity for selection (Î).
formula-notes:formula_29.26b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on individual fitness surfaces to show how the standardized selection gradient relates to the strength of selection on breeding values, supporting later arguments about the predictability of evolutionary change.

formula-notes:formula_29.26b:zh.plainMeaning: 公式 (29.26b) 计算标准化回归中表型性状 z 与相对适合度 w 之间决定系数的估计值，等于标准化回归系数 β̂_sd 的平方除以机会主义指数 Î。
formula-notes:formula_29.26b:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在个体适合度曲面章节，由 (29.26a) 在标准化回归下简化而来，为后续 (29.26c) 中比较不同性状的选择强度提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_29.26c:en.plainMeaning: This formula expresses the opportunity for selection (I) on a focal trait as the product of the selection gradient (β̂) and the selection differential (S), showing how directional selection accounts for variance in relative fitness.
formula-notes:formula_29.26c:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on individual fitness surfaces to quantify the contribution of directional selection on a trait to the total variance in relative fitness, supporting the decomposition of selection into components.

formula-notes:formula_29.24c:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式在假设表型正态分布（μ₃=0, μ₄=3σ⁴）下，给出了选择微分Ĉ_j的抽样方差近似表达式，它等于4倍选择差S_j的方差乘以S_j²，再加上前后两代表型方差σ_j⁴和σ_{j-1}⁴分别除以各自样本量n_j和n_{j-1}后乘以2。
formula-notes:formula_29.24c:zh.inThisChapter: 本节推导表型选择下各统计量的抽样方差，公式(29.24c)是(29.24a)在正态假设下的简化形式，为后续评估选择微分估计的精度提供可直接计算的近似公式。

formula-notes:formula_29.25e:en.plainMeaning: This formula expresses the selection gradient β (the slope of fitness on trait z) in terms of the standardized selection gradient β_sd and the trait standard deviation σ_z, showing that β = β_sd / σ_z. Key symbols: β (selection gradient), σ(z,w) (covariance of trait and fitness), σ_z^2 (trait variance), z_sd (standardized trait), β_sd (selection gradient on standardized trait).
formula-notes:formula_29.25e:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on describing phenotypic selection to connect the unstandardized selection gradient β to the standardized version β_sd, facilitating comparison across traits with different variances. This supports later arguments about the fraction of variance in fitness explained by linear regression (via Equation 3.17).

formula-notes:formula_29.25e:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将表型选择梯度β（基于原始性状z）与标准化选择梯度β_sd（基于标准化性状z_sd = z/σ_z）联系起来：β等于β_sd除以性状标准差σ_z，即β = β_sd / σ_z。
formula-notes:formula_29.25e:zh.inThisChapter: 在本节描述表型选择的个体适应度曲面中，该公式展示了如何从标准化回归系数β_sd（对应标准化性状）转换回原始尺度上的选择梯度β，为后续比较不同性状选择强度或与遗传方差结合提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_29.27a:en.plainMeaning: This quadratic regression models individual fitness (w) as a function of a trait (z), including a linear term (b₁) and a quadratic term (b₂) centered at the trait mean (μ_z), plus an error (e).
formula-notes:formula_29.27a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on individual fitness surfaces to capture curvature (stabilizing or disruptive selection), and it supports deriving the mean fitness constraint (Equation 29.27b) and selection gradients (Equations 29.27c, 29.27d).

formula-notes:formula_29.27a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式通过二次回归将个体相对适应度 w 表示为性状 z 的线性项 b₁z 和二次项 b₂(z-μz)² 之和，其中 a 是截距，e 是残差，用于检测稳定化或歧化选择导致的适应度曲面弯曲。
formula-notes:formula_29.27a:zh.inThisChapter: 本节介绍如何用二次回归描述个体适应度曲面，公式(29.27a)是基础模型，后续公式(29.27b-d)通过该回归的期望和协方差推导选择梯度与非线性选择系数。

formula-notes:formula_29.26c:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将选择梯度估计值 $\widehat{\beta}$ 与选择差 $S$ 的乘积等于相对适合度方差中被方向选择解释的部分 $\widehat{Ir}_{z,w}^2$，其中 $\widehat{\beta} = \sigma(z,w)/\sigma^2(z)$，$S = \sigma(z,w)$。
formula-notes:formula_29.26c:zh.inThisChapter: 在本节中，该公式整合了之前定义的 $\widehat{\beta}$ 和 $S$，说明方向选择对性状方差贡献的度量 $\widehat{Ir}_{z,w}^2$ 可简化为 $\widehat{\beta}S$，为后续理解选择强度与适合度方差的关系提供直接表达式。

formula-notes:formula_29.27b:en.plainMeaning: This formula expresses relative fitness w as a quadratic function of the standardized trait value (z - μz), with linear coefficient b1, quadratic coefficient b2, and an error term e, after centering and scaling by the mean μz and variance σz².
formula-notes:formula_29.27b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on individual fitness surfaces to provide a quadratic approximation of the fitness function, which allows estimation of directional (b1) and stabilizing/disruptive (b2) selection gradients from empirical data.

formula-notes:formula_29.27d:en.plainMeaning: This formula expresses relative fitness (w) as a quadratic function of a standardized trait (z_sd), including a linear term (b_sd,1 * z_sd) and a quadratic term (b_sd,2 * z_sd^2), plus an intercept (a) and an error term (e).
formula-notes:formula_29.27d:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on individual fitness surfaces to provide a practical regression equation for estimating stabilizing/disruptive selection (via b_sd,2) and directional selection (via b_sd,1) from standardized trait data.

formula-notes:formula_29.27c:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes relative fitness (w) as a quadratic function of the standardized trait z_sd, with linear coefficient b_sd,1 and quadratic coefficient b_sd,2, plus residual e; the intercept is fixed at 1 due to standardization (mean fitness = 1).
formula-notes:formula_29.27c:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on individual fitness surfaces to provide a trait-standardized version of the quadratic regression (Equation 29.27a), enabling direct interpretation of selection coefficients on a common scale and supporting later analyses of nonlinear selection gradients.

formula-notes:formula_29.28a:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the partial regression coefficients b1 and b2 for a quadratic regression of relative fitness w on a standardized trait z, where x1 = z and x2 = (z - μz)^2. It expresses b1 and b2 in terms of the selection differential S, the covariance C between z and w, the variance σz^2, the third central moment μ3,z, and the fourth central moment μ4,z.
formula-notes:formula_29.28a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on describing phenotypic selection via individual fitness surfaces, specifically to derive the coefficients of a quadratic approximation of the fitness surface. These coefficients (b1 and b2) are later used to interpret directional and stabilizing/disruptive selection, respectively.

formula-notes:formula_29.29c:en.plainMeaning: This formula models fitness (w) as a quadratic function of a mean-centered trait (z) with no linear term, where a is the intercept, b is the quadratic coefficient (related to γ), and e is the residual error.
formula-notes:formula_29.29c:en.inThisChapter: It appears here to provide a less-biased estimator of the quadratic selection gradient γ by omitting the linear term, supporting the estimation of stabilizing or disruptive selection on the fitness surface.

formula-notes:formula_29.27d:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将标准化后的相对适合度 w 表示为截距 a、线性项 b_sd,1 * z_sd 和二次项 b_sd,2 * z_sd^2 之和再加上残差 e，其中 z_sd 是标准化后的性状值。
formula-notes:formula_29.27d:zh.inThisChapter: 本节介绍个体适合度曲面，公式(29.27d)是(29.27c)的另一种写法，将二次项展开以便直接使用 z_sd^2 进行回归分析，为后续估计选择梯度（线性系数）和选择曲率（二次系数）提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_29.29a:en.plainMeaning: This formula expresses relative fitness (w) as a quadratic regression on the phenotypic trait z, where β is the directional selection gradient and γ is the quadratic (nonlinear) selection gradient, with e as the residual. The terms involve the deviation of z from its mean μz and the variance σz².
formula-notes:formula_29.29a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on individual fitness surfaces to provide the univariate Lande–Arnold regression, which is the foundation for estimating linear and nonlinear selection gradients from data, and it supports later arguments about selection analysis and standardized forms (e.g., Equation 29.29b).

formula-notes:formula_29.29d:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the slope b of the regression of relative fitness w on squared trait value z², expressed as the covariance C between z² and w divided by the variance of z², which equals C over the fourth central moment minus the square of the variance.
formula-notes:formula_29.29d:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on individual fitness surfaces to provide an explicit expression for the quadratic regression coefficient, which is used to quantify nonlinear (stabilizing or disruptive) selection on the trait.

formula-notes:formula_29.27c:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将相对适应度 w 表示为标准化性状 z_sd 的线性项和二次项（z_sd^2 - 1）的函数，其中 b_sd,1 是线性选择梯度，b_sd,2 是二次选择梯度，e 是残差。
formula-notes:formula_29.27c:zh.inThisChapter: 在描述表型选择的个体适应度曲面章节中，此公式通过标准化性状（均值为0，方差为1）简化了二次回归模型，为后续估计选择梯度和检验非线性选择（如稳定化或歧化选择）提供了基础。

formula-notes:formula_29.29b:en.plainMeaning: This formula models individual fitness (w) as a quadratic function of a standardized trait value (z_sd), where β_sd is the linear selection gradient and γ_sd is the quadratic (nonlinear) selection gradient, plus an intercept a and residual e.
formula-notes:formula_29.29b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on individual fitness surfaces to describe how fitness varies with phenotype, supporting the estimation of nonlinear selection (γ_sd) and the construction of fitness surfaces in later analyses.

formula-notes:formula_29.27b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将相对适应度 w 表示为性状 z 偏离均值 μ_z 的线性项 b₁(z-μ_z) 和二次项 b₂[(z-μ_z)²-σ_z²] 之和，再加上残差 e，其中 σ_z² 是性状方差，用于校正二次项的期望。
formula-notes:formula_29.27b:zh.inThisChapter: 在描述表型选择的个体适应度曲面章节中，该公式通过重新参数化二次回归模型（方程29.26b），使线性系数 b₁ 直接表示方向性选择梯度，二次系数 b₂ 表示非线性选择梯度（如稳定或歧化选择），为后续估计选择梯度（如方程29.27c,d）提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_29.29a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将个体相对适合度 w 表示为性状值 z 的二次回归：线性项系数 β 是选择梯度，二次项系数 γ/2 衡量非线性选择（如稳定或 disruptive 选择），其中 μ_z 和 σ_z^2 分别是性状的均值和方差，e 是残差。
formula-notes:formula_29.29a:zh.inThisChapter: 本节构建个体适合度曲面，该公式是 Lande-Arnold 回归的单变量版本，将选择梯度 β 和二次选择系数 γ 直接与回归系数联系起来，为后续估计选择强度和分析选择形式提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_29.29c:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式通过二次回归 w = a + b z^2 + e 拟合适应度 w 与性状 z 的关系，其中 b 是二次项系数，用于估计非线性选择梯度 γ，且已通过将性状均值平移至零去除了线性项。
formula-notes:formula_29.29c:zh.inThisChapter: 本节介绍个体适应度曲面，公式(29.29c)是文献中估计 γ 的标准方法，通过省略线性项减少偏差，并为后续推导 b 的协方差表达式(29.29d)提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_29.29b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将相对适应度 w 表示为标准化性状 z_sd 的二次回归：β_sd 是线性选择梯度，γ_sd 是非线性选择梯度（二次项系数的一半），e 是残差。
formula-notes:formula_29.29b:zh.inThisChapter: 在描述表型选择的个体适应度曲面章节中，公式(29.29b)是公式(29.29a)的标准化版本，通过标准化性状使回归系数直接对应选择梯度，为后续估计线性与非线性选择强度提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_29.29d:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算了二次回归模型（式29.29c）中斜率b的值，它等于性状平方z²与相对适合度w的协方差C除以z²的方差（即四阶中心矩μ₄,z减去σ_z⁴）。
formula-notes:formula_29.29d:zh.inThisChapter: 在本节描述表型选择的个体适合度曲面中，该公式将二次回归的斜率b与性状分布的高阶矩（四阶矩）联系起来，为后续推导二次选择梯度γ（如式29.29e）提供了具体的代数表达式。

formula-notes:formula_29.29f:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes an improved estimate of the quadratic gradient γ̂ by adjusting the sample estimate b̂ with the sample kurtosis κ̂₄, where γ̂ = b̂(κ̂₄ + 2).
formula-notes:formula_29.29f:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on individual fitness surfaces to correct bias in the quadratic gradient estimate when the trait distribution has non-zero kurtosis, supporting the argument that kurtosis can affect selection gradient estimates.

formula-notes:formula_29.29e:zh.plainMeaning: 公式将标准化梯度差b表示为C除以σ^4乘以(κ₄+2)，或者等价地表示为γ除以(κ₄+2)，其中C是协方差矩阵，σ是标准差，κ₄是超值峰度，γ是标准化梯度差向量。
formula-notes:formula_29.29e:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在个体适应度曲面章节中，用于将标准化梯度差b与协方差矩阵C和峰度κ₄联系起来，为后续推导b与γ的关系以及理解选择梯度提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_29.29e:en.plainMeaning: This formula expresses the quadratic selection gradient b as the ratio of the curvature C (or γ) to σ^4 times (κ₄+2), where κ₄ is scaled kurtosis, σ is standard deviation, and γ is the quadratic selection differential.
formula-notes:formula_29.29e:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on individual fitness surfaces to relate the curvature of the fitness surface (b) to the fourth moment of the trait distribution, supporting later arguments about how non-normal kurtosis affects the interpretation of quadratic selection gradients.

formula-notes:formula_29.28a:zh.plainMeaning: 公式 (29.28a) 给出了二次回归模型 w = a + b1 x1 + b2 x2 + e 中偏回归系数 b1 和 b2 的表达式，其中 x1 = z（性状值），x2 = |z-μz|²（偏离均值的平方），w 是适应度。b1 和 b2 分别用性状的方差 σz²、三阶中心矩 μ3,z、四阶中心矩 μ4,z、选择差 S 和协方差 C 表示。
formula-notes:formula_29.28a:zh.inThisChapter: 本章讨论表型选择描述，通过二次回归拟合个体适应度曲面。公式 (29.28a) 将偏回归系数转化为性状矩的形式，为后续推导选择梯度（如 β1 = b1）和稳定化/歧化选择参数（如 γ = 2b2）提供具体表达式。

formula-notes:formula_29.30a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算了二次函数 w(z) 对表型值 z 的一阶和二阶导数：一阶导数为 b₁ + 2b₂(z - μ_z)，二阶导数为常数 2b₂。
formula-notes:formula_29.30a:zh.inThisChapter: 在描述表型选择的个体适应度曲面章节中，该公式通过对二次适应度函数求导，为后续推导选择微分和平均适应度变化提供梯度信息。

formula-notes:formula_29.30b:en.plainMeaning: This formula gives the first and second derivatives of the fitness function w(z) evaluated at the population mean phenotype μz, showing that the linear coefficient b1 equals the slope and the quadratic coefficient b2 equals half the curvature.
formula-notes:formula_29.30b:en.inThisChapter: It appears here to connect the parameters of the quadratic approximation (29.30a) to the directional and quadratic selection differentials derived later, enabling the decomposition of selection into linear and nonlinear components.

formula-notes:formula_29.30a:en.plainMeaning: This formula gives the first and second derivatives of the quadratic fitness function w(z) with respect to the phenotype z. The first derivative is b1 + 2b2(z - μz) and the second derivative is 2b2, where b1 and b2 are coefficients and μz is the mean phenotype.
formula-notes:formula_29.30a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on individual fitness surfaces to show how the gradient and curvature of the quadratic fitness function are expressed simply in terms of b1 and b2, supporting later derivations of selection differentials and gradients.

formula-notes:formula_29.29f:zh.plainMeaning: 公式将二次选择梯度γ的估计量γ̂表示为回归系数b̂乘以（峰度κ̂₄加2），用于修正非正态分布（峰度非零）时b̂对γ的偏差。
formula-notes:formula_29.29f:zh.inThisChapter: 本节讨论个体适合度曲面中二次选择梯度的估计，此前公式29.29a-e推导了正态假设下b̂与γ的关系，此公式引入峰度修正，为后续说明偏度和峰度引起的偏差程度提供更准确的估计量。

formula-notes:formula_29.30c:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算二次适应度曲面（公式29.20b）在整个表型分布上的平均方向选择梯度，即对z求偏导后取期望，最终结果等于线性系数b₁。
formula-notes:formula_29.30c:zh.inThisChapter: 本节通过此公式证明平均方向选择梯度等于二次曲面中的线性系数b₁，为后续推导平均非线性选择梯度（如公式29.30e）和解释选择梯度与曲面参数的关系奠定基础。

formula-notes:formula_29.30g:en.plainMeaning: This formula states that the partial derivative of mean fitness (W̄) with respect to the population mean phenotype (μ) equals the linear selection gradient b₁, which quantifies directional selection.
formula-notes:formula_29.30g:en.inThisChapter: It is derived from the quadratic fitness function (29.30f) to show that b₁ directly measures how mean fitness changes with μ, supporting the interpretation of b₁ as the directional selection coefficient in individual fitness surfaces.

formula-notes:formula_29.30c:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the average directional selection gradient across the entire distribution of z, showing that it equals b1, the linear coefficient of the quadratic fitness surface. Key symbols: Ez (expectation over z), ∂w(z)/∂z (fitness gradient), b1 (linear term), b2 (quadratic term), μz (mean of z).
formula-notes:formula_29.30c:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on describing phenotypic selection to demonstrate that the average selection gradient simplifies to b1, supporting the interpretation that b1 represents the average directional selection gradient across the population.

formula-notes:formula_29.30f:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the mean fitness (overline{W}) as the expected value of a quadratic fitness function of trait z, where a is the baseline fitness, b1 is the linear coefficient, b2 is the quadratic coefficient, μ is the mean of z, and σ² is the variance of z.
formula-notes:formula_29.30f:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on individual fitness surfaces to show how mean fitness depends on both the mean and variance of the trait distribution, supporting later derivations of selection gradients (e.g., ∂overline{W}/∂μ = b1).

formula-notes:formula_29.30e:en.plainMeaning: This formula expands the expected first derivative of fitness with respect to phenotype (∫(∂w/∂z)p(z)dz) as a Taylor series around the mean phenotype μz, showing it equals the slope at the mean plus higher-order corrections involving odd derivatives and the phenotypic variance σz².
formula-notes:formula_29.30e:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on describing phenotypic selection via individual fitness surfaces to show how the directional selection differential (from Equation 29.20b) depends not only on the slope at the mean but also on nonlinearities in the fitness surface, supporting the argument that selection gradients can be biased when fitness is nonlinear.

formula-notes:formula_29.30f:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算平均适应度W̄，它是二次适应度函数a + b₁z + b₂(z-μ)²在表型z分布上的期望，结果等于a + b₁μ + b₂σ²₂，其中μ是z的均值，σ²₂是z的方差。
formula-notes:formula_29.30f:zh.inThisChapter: 在描述表型选择的个体适应度曲面章节中，该公式将二次适应度函数的参数（a, b₁, b₂）与表型分布的矩（μ, σ²₂）联系起来，为后续推导平均适应度对均值的偏导∂W̄/∂μ = b₁（公式29.30g）提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_29.30g:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式表示平均适应度W̄对性状均值μ的偏导数等于二次回归系数b₁，即b₁衡量了均值变化对平均适应度的线性影响。
formula-notes:formula_29.30g:zh.inThisChapter: 在推导出二次适应度函数下平均适应度的表达式(29.30f)后，通过求偏导得到(29.30g)，为后续分析选择梯度（即均值变化引起的适应度变化）提供直接公式。

formula-notes:formula_29.31b:en.plainMeaning: This formula estimates the variance of the jackknife estimator of β (a selection gradient) using the pseudo-values φ_i and their mean φ̄, where φ_i = nβ̂ - (n-1)β̂_i.
formula-notes:formula_29.31b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on individual fitness surfaces to provide a variance estimate for the jackknife resampling method, supporting inference about the stability of the estimated selection gradient.

formula-notes:formula_29.31a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算刀切估计量 $\widehat{\beta}_{jack}$，它是所有伪值 $\phi_i$ 的均值 $\overline{\phi}$，其中每个伪值 $\phi_i = n\widehat{\beta} - (n-1)\widehat{\beta}_{i}$ 由全样本估计 $\widehat{\beta}$ 和删去第 $i$ 个个体后的估计 $\widehat{\beta}_{i}$ 构造。
formula-notes:formula_29.31a:zh.inThisChapter: 在本节描述表型选择的个体适应度曲面中，该公式提供了刀切法估计选择梯度 $\beta$ 的方法，用于减少偏差，并为后续公式 (29.31b) 计算刀切估计量的近似方差提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_29.32a:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the correlation ρ between a trait and relative fitness, expressed as the ratio of the selection differential S to the product of standard deviations σ_z and σ_w, or equivalently as the ratio of the mean standardized selection intensity ī to the square root of the opportunity for selection I.
formula-notes:formula_29.32a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on individual fitness surfaces to quantify the strength of the linear relationship between trait and fitness, supporting the interpretation of the selection gradient β and connecting to the opportunity for selection I and selection intensity ī.

formula-notes:formula_29.31a:en.plainMeaning: The jackknife estimator β̂_jack is the average of n pseudovalues φ_i, each computed as n times the full-sample estimate β̂ minus (n-1) times the leave-one-out estimate β̂_i. This formula provides a bias-reduced estimate of the selection gradient.
formula-notes:formula_29.31a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on describing phenotypic selection to provide a robust estimate of the selection gradient that corrects for the bias inherent in the ordinary least-squares estimate, supporting later inference of the variance of the jackknife estimator via equation 29.31b.

formula-notes:formula_29.31b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算刀切法估计量 β̂_jack 的近似方差，等于 (n(n-1))⁻¹ 乘以所有伪值 φ_i 与均值 φ̄ 的离差平方和。
formula-notes:formula_29.31b:zh.inThisChapter: 在介绍刀切法估计量 β̂_jack（公式 29.31a）后，本公式给出其方差估计，用于评估估计的精度，为后续推断或比较不同选择梯度提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_29.30b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算了适应度函数 w(z) 在种群均值 μ_z 处的一阶和二阶导数，分别等于 b₁ 和 2b₂，其中 b₁ 和 b₂ 是二次回归模型（公式 29.30a）中的系数。
formula-notes:formula_29.30b:zh.inThisChapter: 在本节中，该公式将二次回归系数 b₁ 和 b₂ 与适应度曲面的局部斜率（方向选择梯度）和曲率（非线性选择）联系起来，为后续推导选择梯度 β 和非线性选择梯度 γ（公式 29.30c–g）提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_29.32a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算性状值与相对适应度之间的相关系数ρ，等于性状与适应度的协方差σ(z,w)除以两者标准差σ_z和σ_w的乘积，也等于选择差S除以σ_zσ_w，或选择强度ī除以机会选择I的平方根。
formula-notes:formula_29.32a:zh.inThisChapter: 在本节描述表型选择的个体适应度曲面中，该公式将回归分析中的选择梯度β与相关系数ρ联系起来，为后续通过ρ衡量选择强度与机会选择的关系（如公式29.32b-d）提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_29.32b:en.plainMeaning: This formula expresses the phenotypic correlation ρ between relative fitness w and a trait z in terms of the selection differential S, the trait standard deviation σ_z, and the fitness standard deviation σ_w, and shows that ρ equals the unstandardized selection gradient β times σ_z/σ_w, or the standardized gradient β_sd divided by σ_w.
formula-notes:formula_29.32b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on individual fitness surfaces to connect the correlation measure ρ with the directional selection gradients β and β_sd, facilitating interpretation of selection strength and power analysis in later sections.

formula-notes:formula_29.32c:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes an adjusted sample correlation r' between fitness w and trait z, correcting for sample variances relative to population variances. Key symbols: Var(w) and Var(z) are sample variances, σ_w^2 and σ_z^2 are population variances, r is the sample correlation.
formula-notes:formula_29.32c:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on individual fitness surfaces to provide a corrected correlation measure that accounts for sampling variability, supporting later arguments about the distribution of r' under normality (e.g., scaling to a t-distribution).

formula-notes:formula_29.32d:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将样本相关系数 r' 与总体相关系数 ρ 的差异标准化后，乘以 √(n-1) 并除以 √(1-ρ²)，所得统计量服从自由度为 n-1 的 t 分布。
formula-notes:formula_29.32d:zh.inThisChapter: 在本章关于表型选择与个体适合度曲面的上下文中，该公式用于在假设适合度残差正态的条件下，对样本相关系数 r' 进行假设检验或构建置信区间，从而推断总体相关系数 ρ。

formula-notes:formula_29.32b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将选择差S与选择强度ρ联系起来，通过非标准化选择梯度β或标准化选择梯度β_sd表示：ρ = S/(σ_z σ_w) = β (σ_z/σ_w) = β_sd/σ_w，其中σ_z是表型标准差，σ_w是相对适合度标准差。
formula-notes:formula_29.32b:zh.inThisChapter: 在本节中，公式29.32b展示了如何从选择差S推导出选择强度ρ，并连接了非标准化和标准化选择梯度，为后续讨论检测选择梯度的统计功效（依赖于ρ和样本量）提供了基础。

formula-notes:formula_29.32d:en.plainMeaning: This formula shows that a transformed version of the sample correlation r' (between fitness and phenotype) follows a Student's t distribution with n-1 degrees of freedom, where ρ is the population correlation and n is sample size.
formula-notes:formula_29.32d:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on describing phenotypic selection to provide a significance test for the correlation between fitness and phenotype, supporting inference about selection gradients.

formula-notes:formula_29.33a:en.plainMeaning: This formula converts the variance-standardized selection gradient β into a mean-standardized gradient β_μ by multiplying β by the trait mean μ. β_μ measures the change in relative fitness per proportional change in the trait.
formula-notes:formula_29.33a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the discussion of alternative standardization methods for selection gradients, supporting the argument that mean-standardization is superior to variance-standardization for comparing selection across traits or populations.

formula-notes:formula_29.32c:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将样本相关系数 r 调整为 r'，通过乘以两个平方根因子：第一个是样本方差 Var(w) 与总体方差 σ_w² 之比的开方，第二个是总体方差 σ_z² 与样本方差 Var(z) 之比的开方，从而校正样本与总体方差的差异。
formula-notes:formula_29.32c:zh.inThisChapter: 在描述表型选择的个体适应度曲面章节中，该公式用于定义调整后的样本相关系数，以便在假设适应度残差正态时，使 r' 服从学生 t 分布，从而进行统计推断。

formula-notes:formula_29.33a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将均值标准化后的选择梯度 β_μ 定义为总体均值 μ 乘以原始选择梯度 β，即通过乘以均值来调整选择梯度的尺度。
formula-notes:formula_29.33a:zh.inThisChapter: 本节讨论表型选择的描述方法，公式(29.33a)引入均值标准化作为方差标准化的替代方案，为后续公式(29.33b)-(29.33f)中不同标准化方法的选择梯度转换提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_29.30e:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将∫(∂w/∂z)p(z)dz（即选择梯度β的期望值）展开为在均值μz处的斜率加上包含σz²、σz⁴等偶数阶中心矩的高阶修正项，表明当性状分布非退化时，期望斜率不等于均值处的斜率。
formula-notes:formula_29.30e:zh.inThisChapter: 本章通过泰勒展开将个体适应度曲面上的局部导数与群体平均选择梯度联系起来，此公式为后续推导选择梯度β与非线性选择γ的精确表达式（如公式29.30f、29.30g）提供基础，说明分布方差σz²如何导致期望斜率偏离局部斜率。

formula-notes:formula_29.33d:en.plainMeaning: This formula expresses the proportional response to selection (R/μ_z) as the product of evolvability I_A (additive genetic variance scaled by squared mean) and the mean-standardized selection gradient β_u, connecting genetic variation and selection to trait evolution on a proportional scale.
formula-notes:formula_29.33d:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on individual fitness surfaces to show how mean-standardized gradients (β_u) can be used to compute the proportional selection response, supporting the argument that evolvability I_A quantifies the potential for proportional change.

formula-notes:formula_29.33b:en.plainMeaning: This formula relates the mean-standardized selection gradient β_μ and the variance-standardized selection gradient β_sd through the common standardized gradient β, where μ is the trait mean and σ is the trait standard deviation.
formula-notes:formula_29.33b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on individual fitness surfaces to show how to convert between different standardizations of selection gradients, supporting later comparisons across traits with different means and variances.

formula-notes:formula_29.33b:zh.plainMeaning: 此公式建立了均值标准化选择梯度β_μ、方差标准化选择梯度β_sd与原始选择梯度β之间的换算关系：β_μ/μ = β = β_sd/σ，因此β_μ = (μ/σ)β_sd且β_sd = (σ/μ)β_μ。
formula-notes:formula_29.33b:zh.inThisChapter: 在描述表型选择的个体适应度曲面章节中，该公式将不同标准化方式下的选择梯度联系起来，为后续比较不同性状或不同研究中的选择强度提供统一的转换基础。

formula-notes:formula_29.33c:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算当性状z等于绝对适合度W时，选择梯度β等于绝对适合度均值W̄的倒数。关键符号：β是选择梯度，σ(z,w)是性状z与相对适合度w的协方差，σ_z^2是性状方差，W̄是平均绝对适合度。
formula-notes:formula_29.33c:zh.inThisChapter: 本节推导了当性状为绝对适合度本身时选择梯度的简化形式，为后续证明均值标准化梯度β_μ=1以及比例选择响应R/μ_z的表达式提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_29.33c:en.plainMeaning: When the trait z equals absolute fitness W, the selection gradient β simplifies to 1/mean absolute fitness (1/\overline{W}), because the covariance σ(W,w) reduces to \overline{W}σ²(w) and the variance σ²(W) to \overline{W}²σ²(w).
formula-notes:formula_29.33c:en.inThisChapter: This derivation shows that for absolute fitness itself, the selection gradient is simply the inverse of mean absolute fitness, which is then used to compute the mean-standardized gradient β_μ = 1, linking to proportional selection response.

formula-notes:formula_29.33e:en.plainMeaning: This formula defines the elasticity of mean fitness with respect to the mean trait, β_u, as the proportional change in mean fitness per proportional change in the mean trait μ, which equals the derivative of ln(mean fitness) with respect to ln(μ).
