formula-notes:formula_29.33e:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on individual fitness surfaces to provide a scale-independent measure of selection on the mean trait, supporting later arguments about comparing selection across traits with different units.

formula-notes:formula_29.34b:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the fitness W of an individual with phenotype z as an exponential function of z, where a is a baseline fitness and b determines the strength and direction of selection.
formula-notes:formula_29.34b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in this section to model strictly directional selection, contrasting with quadratic fitness functions, and serves as a building block for the more general function (29.34c) that also captures stabilizing or disruptive selection.

formula-notes:formula_29.33d:zh.plainMeaning: 公式(29.33d)将性状对相对适应度的选择梯度β转化为均值标准化后的选择响应R/μ_z，等于加性遗传方差σ_A^2除以均值μ_z再乘以β，也等于均值标准化遗传方差I_A乘以均值标准化选择梯度β_μ。
formula-notes:formula_29.33d:zh.inThisChapter: 在本节描述表型选择（个体适应度曲面）的背景下，该公式将选择梯度与进化响应联系起来，为后续讨论均值标准化选择梯度β_μ和进化能力I_A提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_29.33f:en.plainMeaning: This formula expresses the elasticity of population growth rate λ with respect to a trait μ as the sum over k fitness components of the product of the elasticity of λ with respect to component Wi (ei) and the elasticity of Wi with respect to μ (βμ,i).
formula-notes:formula_29.33f:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on individual fitness surfaces to decompose the total selection gradient on a trait into contributions from different fitness components, supporting later analyses of how traits affect population growth through multiple pathways.

formula-notes:formula_29.33e:zh.plainMeaning: 公式(29.33e)将选择梯度β_u定义为性状μ的弹性（即平均适应度W̄对μ的弹性），它等于平均适应度的对数对性状对数的偏导数，表示性状每增加1%时平均适应度增加的百分比。
formula-notes:formula_29.33e:zh.inThisChapter: 在描述表型选择的个体适应度曲面章节中，该公式将选择梯度β（来自公式29.20a）转化为弹性形式β_u，便于比较不同尺度性状的选择强度，并为后续推导标准化选择梯度（如公式29.33f）提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_29.34a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式定义了一个高斯型适应度函数，其中W(z)表示表型值z的适应度，a是最大适应度（当z=θ时），θ是最优表型，ω控制选择强度（ω越小选择越强）。
formula-notes:formula_29.34a:zh.inThisChapter: 本节从二次适应度函数转向其他参数形式，此高斯函数作为第一个替代模型引入，为后续推导选择响应（如公式29.34b和29.34c）提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_29.34a:en.plainMeaning: This formula defines a Gaussian (bell-shaped) fitness function W(z) where a is the maximum fitness, θ is the optimal phenotype, and ω controls the width (strength of stabilizing selection).
formula-notes:formula_29.34a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on non-quadratic fitness functions to introduce an alternative parametric form that can be used to model stabilizing selection, and it supports later derivations of selection gradients and evolutionary dynamics (e.g., Equation 29.34c).

formula-notes:formula_29.33f:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将种群增长率λ对性状μ的弹性（∂lnλ/∂lnμ）分解为各生活史组分Wi的弹性ei与性状对Wi的弹性βμ,i的乘积之和，即总弹性等于各组分贡献的加和。
formula-notes:formula_29.33f:zh.inThisChapter: 在个体适合度曲面章节中，此公式将总选择梯度（λ对μ的弹性）拆解为各生活史组分（如存活、繁殖）的弹性ei与性状对组分的选择梯度βμ,i的乘积，为后续分析性状通过不同生活史路径影响整体适合度提供了分解工具。

formula-notes:formula_29.34b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式定义了一个指数形式的适应度函数 W(z)，其中 a 是基础适应度（当性状值 z=0 时的适应度），b 是选择梯度（控制适应度随 z 变化的速率），exp(bz) 表示适应度随 z 呈指数增长或衰减。
formula-notes:formula_29.34b:zh.inThisChapter: 在讨论远离二次型适应度函数的章节中，此公式作为严格定向选择的模型出现，为后续引入更一般的二次指数函数（公式 29.34c）提供基础，后者能同时处理定向、稳定化或破坏性选择。

formula-notes:formula_29.34c:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the fitness W(z) of an individual with phenotype z, where c scales the overall fitness, a shifts the exponential, b determines directional selection, and c (the same symbol) determines stabilizing (c<0) or disruptive (c>0) selection.
formula-notes:formula_29.34c:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on describing phenotypic selection to model both directional and stabilizing/disruptive selection, supporting later arguments about how selection changes phenotypic moments (mean and variance) when the trait is normally distributed.

formula-notes:formula_29.35a:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the Janzen-Stein selection gradient β_JS as the expected value (over the distribution p(z)) of the derivative of the fitness function w(z) with respect to the trait z, approximated by the sample average of ∂w/∂z at observed trait values z_i.
formula-notes:formula_29.35a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in this section to provide a method for estimating selection gradients without assuming a quadratic fitness function, supporting the later argument that the gradient can be approximated directly from data using the sample mean of fitness derivatives.

formula-notes:formula_29.35b:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the Janzen-Stein quadratic gradient γ_JS, which is the average curvature of the individual fitness surface, as the integral of the second derivative of fitness w(z) with respect to trait z weighted by the trait distribution p(z), approximated by the sample mean of second derivatives at observed trait values z_i.
formula-notes:formula_29.35b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on non-quadratic fitness functions to extend the curvature measure beyond quadratic approximations, supporting later arguments about how nonlinear selection can be quantified using empirical data.

formula-notes:formula_29.35c:en.plainMeaning: This formula approximates the first derivative of the fitness function w(z) with respect to trait z at point z_i using a central difference quotient, where δ is a small step size.
formula-notes:formula_29.35c:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on non-quadratic fitness functions to provide a numerical method for computing the partial derivatives needed in Equations 29.35a and 29.35b, enabling analysis of evolutionary dynamics when analytical derivatives are unavailable.

formula-notes:formula_29.34c:zh.plainMeaning: 公式 W(z)=c·exp(a+bz+cz²) 将个体适应度 W 表示为表型值 z 的二次指数函数，其中 a、b、c 为参数，c 为缩放因子，b 控制方向选择，c 控制稳定化或破坏化选择。
formula-notes:formula_29.34c:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在描述表型选择的章节，作为比线性指数函数 (29.34b) 更一般的模型，用于同时刻画方向选择与稳定化/破坏化选择，并为后续推导选择前后表型分布的变化提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_29.35a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式定义了Janzen-Stein选择梯度β_JS，它等于适应度函数w(z)对性状z的偏导数的总体期望（用p(z)加权），并通过样本均值近似计算，即用n个观测值处的偏导数的平均值来估计。
formula-notes:formula_29.35a:zh.inThisChapter: 本节讨论当适应度函数不是二次型时如何计算选择梯度，此公式通过直接对一般适应度曲面求导并取期望，为后续在非二次情形下估计选择梯度提供了实用方法，并引出后续的平滑技术（如公式29.35b-d）。

formula-notes:formula_29.35d:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the selection gradient β_MS as the derivative of log mean fitness with respect to the population mean phenotype μ_z, where mean fitness W̄ is the average of individual fitnesses W(z_i) over n individuals.
formula-notes:formula_29.35d:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on non-quadratic fitness functions to provide a numerical method for calculating the selection gradient when the fitness function is not quadratic, supporting the use of numerical differentiation in place of analytical derivatives.

formula-notes:formula_29.35b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算Janzen-Stein梯度γ_JS，即个体适应度曲面的平均曲率，通过将二阶导数∂²w(z)/∂z²对表型分布p(z)积分，并用样本均值近似。
formula-notes:formula_29.35b:zh.inThisChapter: 在脱离二次适应度函数的章节中，该公式将二次函数下的曲率度量推广到一般形式，为后续使用非参数方法估计梯度提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_29.35c:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式用中心差分近似计算适应度函数 w(z) 在点 z_i 处的一阶导数，其中 δ 是一个很小的步长，近似值等于 (w(z_i+δ/2) - w(z_i-δ/2)) / δ。
formula-notes:formula_29.35c:zh.inThisChapter: 本节讨论非二次适应度函数，无法直接解析求导，因此引入数值差分公式（29.35c）和（29.35d）来近似计算方程（29.35a）和（29.35b）中所需的偏导数，为后续数值求解进化动态做准备。

formula-notes:formula_29.36a:en.plainMeaning: This logistic regression formula computes the probability of survival (fitness component W) given a continuous trait value z, using parameters a (intercept) and b (slope).
formula-notes:formula_29.36a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in this section to model realistic, nonlinear relationships between a trait and survival probability, supporting later arguments about selection gradients and fitness surfaces.

formula-notes:formula_29.36a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将个体适应度W(z)（即生存概率p(z)）建模为个体表型值z的logistic函数，其中a控制截距，b控制斜率，输出值在0到1之间。
formula-notes:formula_29.36a:zh.inThisChapter: 本章引入更现实的适应度组分分布模型，logistic回归用于将离散的生存/繁殖数据与连续表型值关联，为后续推导选择梯度（如公式29.36b）和进化动态提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_29.37:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the probability of survival given a phenotypic value z, using a double exponential (Gumbel) distribution. W(z) is survival probability, z is the phenotype, and a and b are parameters (b typically negative for directional selection).
formula-notes:formula_29.37:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on realistic fitness models to illustrate a survival analysis approach for viability data, supporting later arguments about nonlinear selection gradients and the interpretation of fitness components.

formula-notes:formula_29.38b:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the survival probability W(z,t) for an individual with phenotype z up to time t, where λ is a baseline hazard rate and b measures the effect of phenotype on mortality risk.
formula-notes:formula_29.38b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to show how individual fitness (survival) depends on phenotype when risk is age-independent but phenotype-dependent, setting up the derivation of selection gradients in later sections.

formula-notes:formula_29.36b:en.plainMeaning: The logit function transforms a probability p(z) into a linear function of the predictor variable(s): for univariate case, logit[p(z)] = a + b z; for multivariate case, logit[p(z)] = a + b^T z, where a is intercept, b is slope, and z are predictors.
formula-notes:formula_29.36b:en.inThisChapter: This formula appears in the section on realistic fitness models to link a binary fitness component (e.g., survival) to continuous traits via logistic regression, supporting later arguments about how selection acts on traits when fitness is modeled as a probability.

formula-notes:formula_29.35d:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式定义了选择梯度β_MS，它等于平均适应度对性状均值的对数导数，即平均适应度相对变化率与性状均值变化之比；其中平均适应度W¯是样本中n个个体适应度W(z_i)的算术平均。
formula-notes:formula_29.35d:zh.inThisChapter: 在“离开二次型适应度函数”一节中，当适应度函数非二次型时，经典选择梯度公式不再适用，此公式提供了一种数值计算选择梯度的替代方法，为后续讨论非二次型适应度下的进化动态奠定基础。

formula-notes:formula_29.38a:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the probability of survival to age t for an individual with phenotype z, assuming a baseline hazard that increases with t via a monotonic function g(t) and a proportional hazard effect bz. Key symbols: W(z,t) = survival probability, g(t) = baseline hazard function, a = scaling parameter, b = effect of phenotype z on hazard.
formula-notes:formula_29.38a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on more realistic fitness models to incorporate age-dependent mortality and phenotypic effects, supporting later derivations of lifetime fitness and selection gradients in equations 29.38b and 29.38c.

formula-notes:formula_29.36b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将概率p(z)通过logit变换（即对数几率）与线性预测器a+bz（单变量）或a+∑b_i z_i（多变量）联系起来，其中a是截距，b或b_i是回归系数，z或z_i是自变量。
formula-notes:formula_29.36b:zh.inThisChapter: 本章讨论适应度组分的更现实模型，此公式出现在logistic回归的背景下，用于将生存概率p(z)建模为性状z的线性函数，为后续推导选择梯度或适应度函数的形式提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_29.38c:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the probability of survival to stage j given trait value z, using a proportional-hazards model where h_j is the baseline hazard at stage j and b is the selection gradient on z.
formula-notes:formula_29.38c:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to show how survival probability depends on a trait via an exponential link, supporting later arguments about measuring univariate selection gradients.

formula-notes:formula_29.38c:zh.plainMeaning: 公式 (29.38c) 计算给定性状值 z 和阶段 j 时的生存概率，它等于 exp(-exp[h_j + b z])，其中 h_j 是阶段 j 的基线风险对数，b 是选择梯度。
formula-notes:formula_29.38c:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式将比例风险模型引入个体适应度度量，为后续推导选择梯度 b 与生存概率的关系以及量化单变量选择提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_29.39a:en.plainMeaning: This formula gives the probability of observing exactly j offspring (or j mates, etc.) given a trait value z, assuming a Poisson distribution with mean θ(z). Key symbols: W = number of offspring, j = specific count, z = trait value, θ(z) = mean fitness as a function of z.
formula-notes:formula_29.39a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to univariate selection to model fitness as a Poisson random variable, linking trait z to mean fitness via a log-linear model (Eq. 29.39b) and enabling later derivation of selection gradients.

formula-notes:formula_29.37:zh.plainMeaning: 公式 (29.37) 表示表型值 z 对应的个体存活概率 W(z)，其中 a 和 b 是拟合参数，指数嵌套指数构成双指数函数（Gompertz 型）。
formula-notes:formula_29.37:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在“适应度组分分布的现实模型”一节，用于替代简单线性或逻辑斯蒂模型，为后续分析环境或遗传因素对存活概率的非线性影响提供更灵活的生存分析框架。

formula-notes:formula_29.38b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算表型为z的个体在时间t内的生存概率W(z,t)，其中λ是基线风险率，b是选择梯度，指数项exp(bz)表示表型z对风险的乘性影响。
formula-notes:formula_29.38b:zh.inThisChapter: 在介绍单变量选择测度的章节中，此公式将年龄无关的指数分布风险（公式29.38a）扩展为依赖于表型z的风险，为后续推导选择微分和适应度梯度（如公式29.38c）提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_29.39b:en.plainMeaning: This formula models the log of the mean fitness component θ(z) as a linear function of the trait z, with intercept a and slope b. It connects the unconstrained linear predictor a + bz to the nonnegative mean of a Poisson distribution.
formula-notes:formula_29.39b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to univariate selection to show how a log-linear link function maps a linear model onto the allowable range of Poisson means, setting up the framework for analyzing fitness as a function of a single trait.

formula-notes:formula_29.40a:en.plainMeaning: This formula gives the probability of observing exactly j successes before r failures in a sequence of independent Bernoulli trials with success probability p. Key symbols: y (number of successes), r (number of failures), p (success probability).
formula-notes:formula_29.40a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to individual fitness and univariate selection to model the distribution of offspring counts (fitness) when overdispersion is present, supporting later arguments about using the negative binomial as an alternative to the Poisson for fitness data.

formula-notes:formula_29.38a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算给定年龄t和表型z的个体存活概率W(z,t)，它等于exp(-exp[ag(t)+bz])，其中g(t)是随年龄单调非减的函数，a和b是参数，z是表型值。
formula-notes:formula_29.38a:zh.inThisChapter: 本节引入更现实的适合度组分模型，公式(29.38a)通过双指数形式将存活概率与年龄依赖的风险ag(t)和表型特异风险bz联系起来，为后续推导年龄特异性选择梯度(29.38b)和表型分布动态(29.38c)提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_29.39c:en.plainMeaning: This log-linear model expresses the natural logarithm of the fitness function θ(z) as a linear combination of traits z_i, with intercept a and coefficients b_i, or equivalently as a + b^T z in vector form.
formula-notes:formula_29.39c:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to univariate selection to show how a linear predictor can be mapped to positive fitness values (via exponentiation), suitable for Poisson-distributed fitness data, and it sets up the framework for modeling directional selection and later extensions to quadratic terms for stabilizing or disruptive selection.

formula-notes:formula_29.40b:en.plainMeaning: This formula gives the mean (μ_y) and variance (σ_y²) of a negative-binomial random variable y ~ NB(r, p), and shows that the variance-to-mean ratio σ_y²/μ_y = 1/(1-p) > 1, indicating overdispersion.
formula-notes:formula_29.40b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to illustrate that the negative-binomial distribution can model overdispersed fitness data, supporting later arguments for using it instead of Poisson when variance exceeds the mean.

formula-notes:formula_29.40a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算在成功概率为p的独立试验中，恰好发生j次成功之前已发生r次失败的概率，其中(j+r-1)!/(j!(r-1)!)是组合数，p^j(1-p)^r是成功和失败的概率乘积。
formula-notes:formula_29.40a:zh.inThisChapter: 本节引入负二项分布作为个体适合度的候选模型，为后续推导适合度测量的选择梯度（如公式29.40b）提供概率基础。

formula-notes:formula_29.39a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式表示给定性状值z时，个体产生j个后代（或配偶等）的概率服从参数为θ(z)的泊松分布，其中θ(z)是z的函数。
formula-notes:formula_29.39a:zh.inThisChapter: 本章引入泊松分布来建模离散适应度组分（如后代数），为后续通过log-linear模型（公式29.39b）将θ(z)与性状z关联起来提供基础，从而将选择分析转化为广义线性模型问题。

formula-notes:formula_29.39b:zh.plainMeaning: 公式 ln[θ(z)] = a + b z 将线性预测值 a + b z 映射到泊松分布均值 θ(z) 的对数，其中 a 是截距，b 是斜率，z 是自变量。
formula-notes:formula_29.39b:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在介绍单变量选择中个体适合度测量的章节，用于将性状 z 与泊松分布均值 θ(z) 关联，为后续推导适合度分量（如公式 29.39a）和选择梯度（如公式 29.39c）提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_29.39c:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将适应度函数θ(z)取对数后表示为线性组合a + bᵀz，其中a是截距，b是选择梯度向量，z是性状向量，从而将无约束线性模型映射到Poisson均值允许的正数范围(0,∞)。
formula-notes:formula_29.39c:zh.inThisChapter: 本章介绍单变量选择度量，此公式将线性模型扩展到多性状情形，为后续引入二次项（如b₁z + b₂z²）以建模凸或凹选择提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_29.40b:zh.plainMeaning: 公式(29.40b)给出了负二项分布NB(r,p)的均值μ_y = pr/(1-p)和方差σ_y^2 = pr/(1-p)^2，并由此推导出方差与均值之比σ_y^2/μ_y = 1/(1-p) > 1，说明方差可以大于均值。
formula-notes:formula_29.40b:zh.inThisChapter: 本章介绍个体适应度的单变量选择测量，负二项分布因其方差可超过均值（过度分散）的特性，被用作泊松分布的替代，以处理实际数据中常见的过度分散现象，为后续选择分析提供更灵活的分布模型。

formula-notes:formula_29.41b:en.plainMeaning: This formula gives the probability that the number of offspring (j) equals a specific positive integer, given a trait-dependent mean θ(z), under a zero-truncated Poisson distribution. The key symbols are j (offspring count), θ(z) (trait-specific mean), and the denominator 1−e^{−θ(z)} corrects for the absence of zero counts.
formula-notes:formula_29.41b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to individual fitness measurement to model fitness components (e.g., offspring number) that are strictly positive, supporting later arguments about selection gradients when zero counts are impossible or unobserved.

formula-notes:formula_29.41a:en.plainMeaning: This formula gives the probability of observing exactly j offspring (j ≥ 1) given trait value z, after removing the possibility of zero offspring, by renormalizing the original counting distribution φ(j|z) by 1 − φ(0|z).
formula-notes:formula_29.41a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to individual fitness and selection measurement to define a zero-truncated distribution, which is needed to model fitness components (like number of mates or offspring) that cannot be zero, and it directly leads to the zero-truncated Poisson (29.41b) and other truncated distributions used in later selection analyses.

formula-notes:formula_29.43:en.plainMeaning: This formula models a performance surface, where h is the predicted performance, a is the intercept, b_i are linear coefficients for traits z_i, c_jk are quadratic coefficients for trait interactions, and ε is error.
formula-notes:formula_29.43:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on experimental manipulation to show how performance surfaces can be estimated from regression, supporting the argument that manipulation is needed to infer causation from such correlational models.

formula-notes:formula_29.44:en.plainMeaning: This formula models the selection gradient β as a linear function of multiple environmental and biotic factors f_i, with coefficients b_i and an error term ε.
formula-notes:formula_29.44:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on experimental manipulation to show how selection can be decomposed into sensitivities to specific factors, supporting the argument that manipulation of these factors can reveal causal mechanisms of selection.

formula-notes:formula_29.41a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算给定z条件下，计数变量W取非零值j（j≥1）的条件概率，等于原始计数分布φ(j|z)除以1减去φ(0|z)，即排除零观测后的重新归一化。
formula-notes:formula_29.41a:zh.inThisChapter: 本节引入零截断分布以处理个体适应度测量中零值（如无后代）被排除的情形，为后续推导零截断泊松等具体分布（如公式29.41b、29.41c）提供一般形式。

formula-notes:formula_29.41c:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算在给定z的条件下，个体状态W等于j（j≥k）的条件概率，分子是原始概率φ(j|z)，分母是1减去前k个状态（0到k-1）的概率之和，从而将分布截断为只考虑第k个及之后的状态。
formula-notes:formula_29.41c:zh.inThisChapter: 本章引入k截断分布以处理选择文献中忽略前k个状态的情况，该公式为后续推导截断后的选择微分或适应度度量提供概率基础。

formula-notes:formula_30.1a:en.plainMeaning: This inequality bounds the absolute value of the selection differential S_i (scaled by the phenotypic standard deviation σ_{z_i}) by the square root of the opportunity for selection I (the variance in relative fitness).
formula-notes:formula_30.1a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on multivariate selection to show that the strength of selection on any single trait is limited by the total opportunity for selection, supporting later arguments about constraints on evolutionary response.

formula-notes:formula_29.41c:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the conditional probability that the number of offspring W equals j (for j ≥ k), given phenotype z, after truncating the first k states (0 to k-1). The numerator φ(j|z) is the probability mass from the untruncated distribution, and the denominator normalizes by the total probability of all states j ≥ k.
formula-notes:formula_29.41c:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to univariate selection to model individual fitness when zero or low offspring counts are ignored, supporting later arguments about selection gradients under truncated distributions (e.g., Shaw et al. 2008).

formula-notes:formula_29.42:en.plainMeaning: This formula defines a zero-inflated distribution for offspring count W given covariate z, where with probability 1-q(z) the count is forced to zero, and otherwise follows a base counting distribution φ(j|z) (with an extra zero from φ(0|z) added to the zero-inflated part).
formula-notes:formula_29.42:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to univariate selection to model excess zeros in fitness data, supporting later arguments about how zero-inflation affects selection gradient estimation.

formula-notes:formula_30.1a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式表明，第i个性状的选择微分绝对值除以该性状的标准差，不超过选择机会I的平方根，即性状响应受限于选择强度。
formula-notes:formula_30.1a:zh.inThisChapter: 本章讨论多变量表型选择，该公式由方程29.6b推导而来，为后续比较不同性状的选择强度提供上界，并引出公式30.1b中关于标准化选择梯度的类似约束。

formula-notes:formula_29.44:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将选择梯度β（即性状与适应度的回归系数）分解为多个环境或生物因子f_i的线性组合，其中b_i是各因子的偏回归系数，ε为残差。
formula-notes:formula_29.44:zh.inThisChapter: 在本节中，该公式用于将选择梯度分解为对特定环境与生物因子的敏感性，从而将G×E（基因型×环境互作）分解为可解释的组分，为后续讨论实验操纵的重要性提供量化基础。

formula-notes:formula_29.41b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算在给定性状值z对应的平均后代数θ(z)的条件下，零截断泊松分布中后代数W=j（j≥1）的条件概率。分子是标准泊松概率θ(z)^j e^{-θ(z)}/j!，分母是1减去零概率e^{-θ(z)}，确保概率之和为1。
formula-notes:formula_29.41b:zh.inThisChapter: 本节引入零截断分布以处理适应度度量中零值（如无后代）被排除的情况，公式(29.41b)作为零截断泊松的具体形式，为后续将θ(z)建模为对数线性模型（公式29.39b,c）提供概率基础，并推广到k截断分布。

formula-notes:formula_29.43:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式通过线性项（b_i z_i）和二次项（c_jk z_j z_k）将表现值 h 与多个性状 z_i 联系起来，其中 a 为截距，ε 为误差项。
formula-notes:formula_29.43:zh.inThisChapter: 此处引入二次回归以构建性能曲面（performance surface），用于描述性状与表现之间的非线性关系，为后续讨论实验操纵如何影响性状-表现关联提供数学框架。

formula-notes:formula_30.1b:en.plainMeaning: This inequality states that the absolute value of the standardized selection differential (or selection intensity) on trait i, denoted |ı̄_i|, cannot exceed the standard deviation of relative fitness σ_w. It connects the strength of selection on a single trait to the overall opportunity for selection.
formula-notes:formula_30.1b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on multivariate selection to show that the selection intensity on any individual trait is bounded by the total variance in relative fitness, reinforcing that selection on a single trait is limited by the overall opportunity for selection (I). This supports later arguments about constraints on trait evolution.

formula-notes:formula_30.1b:zh.plainMeaning: 公式(30.1b)表明，性状i的选择微分绝对值|ī_i|不超过相对适应度的标准差σ_w，即选择强度受限于适应度变异的大小。
formula-notes:formula_30.1b:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式与(30.1a)共同构成对选择微分S_i的约束，说明即使多变量选择下，每个性状的选择响应也受总选择机会I（即σ_w^2）的限制，为后续推导选择梯度β_i奠定基础。

formula-notes:formula_30.2a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将选择差向量 S（即性状 z 与适应度 w 的协方差向量）左乘 P⁻¹ 后得到偏回归系数向量 β，其中 P 是性状的方差-协方差矩阵。
formula-notes:formula_30.2a:zh.inThisChapter: 本节推导多变量选择下的梯度，公式 (30.2a) 将选择差 S 转化为偏回归系数 β，为后续 (30.2b) 将 β 与选择梯度 ∇lnw̄ 联系起来做铺垫。

formula-notes:formula_30.2b:en.plainMeaning: This formula expresses relative fitness w(z) as a linear function of deviations of phenotypic traits z from their means μ, with coefficients β (partial regression slopes) and an error term e. The vector β is the gradient of selection.
formula-notes:formula_30.2b:en.inThisChapter: It appears here to define the linear approximation of the fitness surface around the mean phenotype, which is used to derive selection differentials and gradients in multivariate selection analysis.

formula-notes:formula_30.2a:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the vector of partial regression coefficients (β) for the linear regression of relative fitness (w) on phenotypic values (z), by multiplying the inverse of the phenotypic variance-covariance matrix (P⁻¹) with the vector of covariances between traits and fitness (S).
formula-notes:formula_30.2a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in this section to derive the selection gradient (β) from the phenotypic covariance structure, supporting the later argument that β represents the direction of multivariate selection in the Lande equation.

formula-notes:formula_29.42:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式定义了给定z时W的条件概率分布：当j=0时，概率由两部分组成——1-q(z)是零膨胀的额外点质量，加上q(z)乘以基础计数分布φ(0|z)；当j≥1时，概率为q(z)乘以φ(j|z)。
formula-notes:formula_29.42:zh.inThisChapter: 本节引入零膨胀分布来处理个体适应度数据中过多的零值，公式(29.42)将零膨胀机制与基础计数分布φ(j|z)结合，为后续推导选择梯度或适应度函数提供概率模型基础。

formula-notes:formula_30.4a:en.plainMeaning: This formula standardizes a phenotypic trait value z_i by subtracting its population mean μ_i and dividing by its standard deviation σ_i, producing a dimensionless variable z_{sd,i} with mean 0 and variance 1.
formula-notes:formula_30.4a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on selection on multivariate phenotypes to define standardized variables used in fitness regressions, enabling comparison of selection gradients across traits with different scales.

formula-notes:formula_30.4c:en.plainMeaning: This diagonal matrix D contains the standard deviations σ_i of each trait on its diagonal, used to standardize multivariate trait vectors by scaling each trait by its standard deviation.
formula-notes:formula_30.4c:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on selection on multivariate phenotypes to define the standardization matrix D, which is used in Equation 30.4b to transform traits into standardized units, facilitating analysis of selection gradients.

formula-notes:formula_30.4b:en.plainMeaning: This formula standardizes a multivariate vector z by subtracting the mean vector μ and then scaling each component by the inverse of its standard deviation (from diagonal matrix D), yielding z_sd with unit variance per trait.
formula-notes:formula_30.4b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on selection differentials and gradients to provide a standardized scale for multivariate traits, enabling later derivation of selection gradients (β) that are independent of trait variances.

formula-notes:formula_30.2b:zh.plainMeaning: 公式(30.2b)将相对适应度w(z)表示为1加上回归系数向量β与表型偏差(z-μ)的点积再加上残差e，其中β来自(30.2a)的多元回归。
formula-notes:formula_30.2b:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在多元表型选择章节，用于将适应度与表型值之间的线性回归关系显式写出，为后续推导选择梯度（如β作为选择梯度）提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_30.4a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将原始性状值 $z_i$ 减去其均值 $\mu_i$ 后除以标准差 $\sigma_i$，得到标准化变量 $z_{sd,i}$，使其均值为0、方差为1。
formula-notes:formula_30.4a:zh.inThisChapter: 本章讨论多变量表型选择，标准化变量用于后续计算选择梯度等回归系数，使不同尺度的性状可比较，并为公式30.4b和30.4c的推导提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_30.3:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the directional selection differential S_i for trait i as the sum of direct selection (β_i P_ii) and indirect contributions from selection on correlated traits (∑_{j≠i} β_j P_ij). Key symbols: S_i (selection differential for trait i), β_j (selection gradient for trait j), P_ij (phenotypic covariance between traits i and j).
formula-notes:formula_30.3:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on multivariate selection to decompose S_i into direct and indirect components, supporting the argument that S = Pβ conflates direct and correlated selection, which is later used to motivate the need for the selection gradient β to isolate direct selection.

formula-notes:formula_30.4b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式通过对角矩阵 D（其对角线元素为标准差 σ_i）将原始多元向量 z 减去均值向量 μ 后，逐分量除以标准差，得到标准化向量 z_sd。
formula-notes:formula_30.4b:zh.inThisChapter: 在多元表型选择章节中，此公式将原始表型值标准化为均值为0、方差为1的尺度，为后续计算选择梯度（如公式30.4c）和选择微分提供统一量纲的基础。

formula-notes:formula_30.4c:zh.plainMeaning: 公式(30.4c)定义了一个对角矩阵D，其对角线元素是各性状的标准差σ₁, σ₂, …, σₙ，用于将原始变量z标准化为z_sd。
formula-notes:formula_30.4c:zh.inThisChapter: 该矩阵出现在标准化变换z_sd = D⁻¹(z - μ)中，为后续讨论多变量表型的选择梯度和微分提供统一的尺度，使得不同量纲的性状可以比较。

formula-notes:formula_30.3:zh.plainMeaning: 公式(30.3)将性状i的选择微分Si分解为两部分：直接选择效应βi乘以性状i的方差Pii，以及由于性状i与其他性状j的表型协方差Pij带来的间接选择贡献（βj乘以Pij，j≠i）。
formula-notes:formula_30.3:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在讨论多变量表型选择时，说明选择微分S与选择梯度β的关系S=Pβ，并强调S_i会混入间接选择效应，为后续区分直接与间接选择、理解相关选择响应奠定基础。

formula-notes:formula_30.5a:zh.plainMeaning: 公式 (30.5a) 将选择梯度 β 定义为对数平均适应度 ln W̄(μ) 关于均值向量 μ 的梯度，并等价于平均适应度 W̄(μ) 的梯度乘以 W̄ 的倒数。关键符号：β 是选择梯度向量，μ 是表型均值向量，W̄ 是平均适应度。
formula-notes:formula_30.5a:zh.inThisChapter: 本节推导多元表型下选择梯度的表达式，公式 (30.5a) 给出了 β 与平均适应度景观 W̄(μ) 的关系，为后续 (30.5b) 将 β 与个体适应度曲面 w(z) 的梯度联系起来提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_30.5a:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the selection gradient β as the gradient of log mean fitness with respect to the mean phenotype vector μ, equivalently as the inverse of mean fitness times the gradient of mean fitness. Key symbols: β (selection gradient), μ (mean phenotype vector), W̄ (mean population fitness), ∇μ (gradient with respect to μ).
formula-notes:formula_30.5a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on multivariate selection to define β as the directional force on the mean, linking the mean fitness landscape to evolutionary change. It supports later arguments (e.g., Equation 30.5b) that connect β to the selection differential and the genetic covariance matrix.

formula-notes:formula_30.6:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the selection gradient β as the expected value (over the multivariate normal distribution of phenotypes z) of the gradient of individual relative fitness w(z) with respect to z. The key symbols are β (selection gradient), E_Z (expectation over Z), ∇_Z (gradient operator), w(z) (individual relative fitness), and φ(z) (multivariate normal probability density function).
formula-notes:formula_30.6:en.inThisChapter: It appears in this section to define the selection gradient for multivariate phenotypes under a multivariate normal distribution, supporting the derivation of the multivariate breeder's equation and the relationship between selection and the fitness surface.

formula-notes:formula_30.5b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将选择梯度 β 分解为两项之和：第一项是平均适应度 ln(平均适应度) 对群体均值 μ 的梯度，第二项是个体适应度函数 w(z) 对 μ 的梯度在表型分布 φ(z) 上的积分。
formula-notes:formula_30.5b:zh.inThisChapter: 在讨论多变量表型选择时，当个体适应度依赖于群体均值（频率依赖选择）时，公式(30.5a)中的简单梯度不再成立，此公式给出了修正后的选择梯度表达式，为后续推导频率依赖下的响应奠定了基础。

formula-notes:formula_30.7a:en.plainMeaning: This formula defines each element C_{ij} of the matrix C as the covariance between relative fitness w and the product of deviations (z_i - μ_i)(z_j - μ_j), capturing how quadratic deviations co-vary with fitness.
formula-notes:formula_30.7a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on selection differentials and gradients to define the matrix C, which is then used to derive the change in the covariance matrix (P* - P) and the selection gradient (β) in subsequent equations (30.7b, 30.7c).

formula-notes:formula_30.7b:en.plainMeaning: This formula expresses the covariance matrix between relative fitness and the outer product of phenotypic deviations from the mean, showing it equals the change in phenotypic covariance matrix (P* - P) plus the outer product of the selection differential vector S.
formula-notes:formula_30.7b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on multivariate selection to decompose the selection gradient into linear and quadratic components, supporting the derivation of the selection gradient and the interpretation of nonlinear selection.

formula-notes:formula_30.5b:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the selection gradient β as the sum of the gradient of log mean fitness with respect to the population mean vector μ and the expected gradient of individual fitness w(z) with respect to μ, integrated over the phenotype distribution φ(z). Key symbols: β (selection gradient), μ (population mean vector), W̄ (mean fitness), w(z) (individual fitness), φ(z) (phenotype density).
formula-notes:formula_30.5b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on multivariate selection to account for frequency-dependent selection where individual fitness depends on the population mean. It supports the argument that the selection gradient includes both direct effects on mean fitness and indirect effects via changes in the fitness function itself.

formula-notes:formula_30.8a:en.plainMeaning: This formula defines the phenotypic variance-covariance matrix P as the expected outer product of the deviation of the multivariate phenotype vector z from its mean μ, computed by integrating over the probability density p(z).
formula-notes:formula_30.8a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on selection on multivariate phenotypes to formally define P, which is then used in deriving selection differentials and gradients (e.g., Equation 30.7b) and in subsequent expressions for the selected covariance matrix P*.

formula-notes:formula_30.7c:zh.plainMeaning: 公式(30.7c)计算选择后表型协方差矩阵的变化量P_{ij}^{*}-P_{ij}，它等于负的选择梯度S_i与S_j的乘积。
formula-notes:formula_30.7c:zh.inThisChapter: 在C=0（二次偏差与适应度协方差为零）的特殊情况下，由(30.7b)简化得到此式，为后续讨论无二次协方差时的选择响应提供直接表达式。

formula-notes:formula_30.7a:zh.plainMeaning: 公式 (30.7a) 定义了矩阵 C 的第 i 行第 j 列元素 C_{ij}，它是相对适应度 w 与二次偏差乘积 (z_i - μ_i)(z_j - μ_j) 之间的协方差，其中 z_i 和 z_j 是表型值，μ_i 和 μ_j 是群体均值。
formula-notes:formula_30.7a:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在“多变量表型选择：微分与梯度”章节中，用于构建选择微分矩阵 C，为后续推导选择梯度 β = P^{-1} S 以及二次选择响应提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_30.6:zh.plainMeaning: 公式(30.6)将选择梯度β定义为个体相对适应度w(z)的梯度∇_Z[w(z)]在表型z的多元正态分布φ(z)上的期望，即对∇_Z[w(z)]按φ(z)加权积分。
formula-notes:formula_30.6:zh.inThisChapter: 在多元表型选择章节中，该公式将选择梯度β从单变量推广到多变量，并利用多元正态分布假设，为后续通过分部积分推导β与协方差矩阵的关系（如公式30.7）提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_30.7c:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the change in the phenotypic covariance matrix P due to selection, specifically the change in the (i,j) element, as the negative product of the selection differentials S_i and S_j, assuming no quadratic selection (C=0).
formula-notes:formula_30.7c:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on selection differentials and gradients to show that under purely directional selection (no stabilizing or disruptive selection), the covariance matrix shrinks by an amount proportional to the product of the selection differentials, supporting the argument that directional selection reduces genetic variance.

formula-notes:formula_30.8c:en.plainMeaning: This formula expands the outer product of the deviation of z from the post-selection mean μ* into four terms involving the pre-selection mean μ and the selection differential vector S. Key symbols: z (phenotype vector), μ (pre-selection mean), μ* (post-selection mean), S (selection differential).
formula-notes:formula_30.8c:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the derivation of the change in the covariance matrix due to selection, supporting the calculation of the gradient of mean fitness with respect to the mean phenotype.

formula-notes:formula_30.7b:zh.plainMeaning: 公式30.7b将选择前后表型协方差矩阵之差加上选择梯度平方项，与二次偏差和相对适应度的协方差矩阵C联系起来，其中C的元素是σ[w, (z_i-μ_i)(z_j-μ_j)]。
formula-notes:formula_30.7b:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在讨论多变量表型选择的章节，用于将选择前后的表型协方差矩阵变化与二次选择梯度联系起来，为后续推导选择微分和梯度提供关键关系。

formula-notes:formula_30.8b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算选择后（繁殖前）表型向量z*的协方差矩阵P*，其中μ*是选择后均值，p*(z)是选择后分布，积分表示对选择后分布求期望。
formula-notes:formula_30.8b:zh.inThisChapter: 在多元表型选择的章节中，公式(30.8b)定义了选择后的表型协方差矩阵P*，为后续推导选择响应（如公式30.8c和30.8d）提供基础，连接了选择前后协方差结构的变化。

formula-notes:formula_30.8b:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the phenotypic covariance matrix after selection (but before reproduction), denoted P*, as the expected outer product of the deviation of the selected trait vector z* from its post-selection mean μ*. The symbols are: z* (selected trait vector), μ* (post-selection mean vector), p*(z) (post-selection probability density), and the integral is over all z.
formula-notes:formula_30.8b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on selection on multivariate phenotypes to define the change in the phenotypic covariance matrix due to selection, which is needed to derive the selection differential S and the gradient of mean fitness, supporting the multivariate breeder's equation and the fundamental theorem of natural selection.

formula-notes:formula_30.8d:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the phenotypic covariance matrix after selection, P*, as the expected outer product of the deviation vector (z - μ) weighted by the fitness function w(z), minus the outer product of the selection differential vector S with itself.
formula-notes:formula_30.8d:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on multivariate selection to derive the change in phenotypic covariance due to selection, supporting later arguments about the gradient of mean fitness and the secondary theorem of selection.

formula-notes:formula_30.8a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式定义了多变量性状的方差-协方差矩阵 P，它等于随机向量 z 与其均值 μ 的偏差的外积的期望，也等于该外积乘以概率密度 p(z) 在全空间上的积分。
formula-notes:formula_30.8a:zh.inThisChapter: 在讨论多变量表型选择（微分与梯度）的章节中，此公式为后续推导选择前后方差-协方差矩阵的变化（如 P*）提供了基础定义，并直接用于连接前面的公式 30.7b。

formula-notes:formula_30.9a:en.plainMeaning: This inequality bounds the squared selection differential for trait pair (i,j) by the product of the variance in fitness (I) and the variance of the product of centered trait values, using the Cauchy-Schwarz inequality for covariances.
formula-notes:formula_30.9a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on multivariate selection to show that the magnitude of the selection differential C_{ij} is constrained by the opportunity for selection I and the trait variability, supporting later derivations of selection gradients and response predictions.

formula-notes:formula_30.8d:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将选择后的表型协方差矩阵 P* 表示为加权外积的期望减去选择差向量 S 与其转置的乘积，其中 w(z) 是选择权重函数，z 是表型向量，μ 是总体均值。
formula-notes:formula_30.8d:zh.inThisChapter: 在本节中，该公式用于推导选择前后协方差矩阵的变化（P* - P），为后续计算选择梯度（β）和选择微分（s）提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_30.8c:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将选择后个体表型值向量与选择后均值向量之差的叉积展开为四项之和：选择前偏差的叉积、两个交叉项（分别涉及选择微分向量S）以及S自身的叉积，从而将选择后的二阶矩与选择前的二阶矩和选择微分联系起来。
formula-notes:formula_30.8c:zh.inThisChapter: 本章推导多变量表型选择下的响应公式，此展开用于计算选择后协方差矩阵（公式30.8d），进而通过Price方程得到选择响应（公式30.9）。

formula-notes:formula_30.10:en.plainMeaning: This formula bounds the absolute ratio of the genetic covariance C_{ij} to the phenotypic covariance P_{ij} by the square root of the selection intensity I times the square root of 1 plus the inverse square of the phenotypic correlation ρ_{ij}.
formula-notes:formula_30.10:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on multivariate selection to provide a tighter bound on the genetic differential when phenotypes are Gaussian, supporting the derivation of selection gradients and constraints on correlated trait evolution.

formula-notes:formula_30.9a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式利用协方差不等式将选择微分C_{ij}的平方上界表示为机会选择强度I与(z_i-μ_i)(z_j-μ_j)方差的乘积，其中I=σ²(w)是相对适合度的方差。
formula-notes:formula_30.9a:zh.inThisChapter: 此处通过不等式约束C_{ij}的范围，为后续推导选择梯度（如公式30.9b）提供理论基础，说明选择微分受限于机会选择强度与性状组合的变异。

formula-notes:formula_30.9b:en.plainMeaning: This formula gives the variance of the product of two centered phenotypic traits (z_i - μ_i)(z_j - μ_j) under bivariate normality, expressed in terms of phenotypic covariances P_ij and variances P_ii, P_jj, or equivalently using the phenotypic correlation ρ_ij.
formula-notes:formula_30.9b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on selection differentials and gradients to quantify the sampling variance of the product of deviations, which is needed to bound the ratio C_ij/P_ij in the subsequent inequality for Gaussian phenotypes.

formula-notes:formula_30.11a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将相对适应度 w(z) 表示为表型向量 z 的二次函数：线性部分由选择梯度 b_j 加权，二次部分由 γ_jk 矩阵描述表型偏离均值后的非线性选择效应。
formula-notes:formula_30.11a:zh.inThisChapter: 在本节中，该公式用于量化多变量表型上的选择曲面，为后续通过回归去除间接选择效应、推导选择梯度与二次选择矩阵提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_30.11b:en.plainMeaning: This formula expresses relative fitness w(z) as a quadratic function of the multivariate phenotype vector z, where a is baseline fitness, b is the gradient vector, μ is the mean phenotype, and γ is the matrix of quadratic selection coefficients.
formula-notes:formula_30.11b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on selection on multivariate phenotypes to provide a compact matrix representation of the quadratic fitness function (30.11a), which is used later to derive selection differentials and gradients via the multivariate breeder's equation.

formula-notes:formula_30.10:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式给出了选择梯度分量 C_{ij} 与表型协方差 P_{ij} 之比的绝对值上界，该上界由遗传变异度量 I 和表型相关系数 ρ_{ij} 决定。
formula-notes:formula_30.10:zh.inThisChapter: 本节推导多变量表型选择下的约束，公式 (30.10) 将单变量情形 (29.18c) 推广到多变量，为后续讨论多性状选择极限提供定量界限。

formula-notes:formula_30.12:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the matrix γ of quadratic selection gradients, which quantifies nonlinear selection (e.g., stabilizing, disruptive) on multivariate traits. γ is obtained by pre- and post-multiplying the covariance matrix C between relative fitness w and the outer product of trait deviations (z−μ) by the inverse of the phenotypic covariance matrix P⁻¹.
formula-notes:formula_30.12:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on multivariate selection to extend the univariate quadratic selection gradient to multiple traits, supporting later analyses of nonlinear selection surfaces and the estimation of selection on trait combinations.

formula-notes:formula_30.11a:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the relative fitness w(z) as a quadratic function of the multivariate phenotype z, including linear terms (b_j z_j) and quadratic terms (γ_jk (z_j-μ_j)(z_k-μ_k)) that capture stabilizing/disruptive selection and correlational selection.
formula-notes:formula_30.11a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on selection on multivariate phenotypes to model nonlinear selection gradients, supporting the derivation of the quadratic selection differential and the interpretation of the γ matrix as the curvature of the fitness surface.

formula-notes:formula_30.12:zh.plainMeaning: 公式(30.12)计算二次偏回归系数矩阵γ，它等于表型方差-协方差矩阵P的逆乘以协方差矩阵C（C是适应度w与二次型(z-μ)(z-μ)^T的协方差矩阵）再乘以P的逆。
formula-notes:formula_30.12:zh.inThisChapter: 在本节关于多变量表型选择中，该公式用于量化选择梯度的二次项（非线性选择），为后续分析选择曲率和稳定/歧化选择提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_30.13b:en.plainMeaning: This formula expresses the expected fitness w(z) as a quadratic function of the standardized trait vector z_sd, including a linear term with coefficient vector β_sd and a quadratic term with matrix γ_sd, plus an intercept a.
formula-notes:formula_30.13b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on selection differentials and gradients to provide a compact quadratic approximation of the fitness surface after standardization, which is used to analyze nonlinear selection on multivariate phenotypes.

formula-notes:formula_30.11b:zh.plainMeaning: 公式(30.11b)将(30.11a)的求和形式改写为向量-矩阵形式，其中b是选择梯度向量，γ是二次选择曲率矩阵，μ是表型均值向量，z是表型值向量，计算相对适应度w(z)作为z的二次函数。
formula-notes:formula_30.11b:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在多元表型选择章节，将(30.11a)的标量求和紧凑表达为向量形式，便于后续利用梯度算子推导选择微分和选择梯度，为理解多元选择下的适应度地形曲率铺垫。

formula-notes:formula_30.15a:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the average curvature of the individual fitness surface, where γ is the mean Hessian matrix of the fitness function w(z) weighted by the phenotype distribution φ(z).
formula-notes:formula_30.15a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on selection on multivariate phenotypes to quantify the curvature of the fitness surface, which is used later to analyze the dynamics of the mean phenotype and the genetic covariance matrix.

formula-notes:formula_30.14:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the within-generation change in phenotypic covariance between traits i and j (C_ij) as a double sum over all pairs of traits k and l of the quadratic selection gradient γ_kl multiplied by the phenotypic covariances P_ik and P_lj.
formula-notes:formula_30.14:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on selection on multivariate phenotypes to show how quadratic selection on correlated traits alters phenotypic covariances, supporting later arguments about indirect selection effects and the decomposition of the selection gradient.

formula-notes:formula_30.13a:en.plainMeaning: This formula expresses the expected fitness w(z) as a quadratic function of the multivariate phenotype vector z, including a linear term βᵀz and a quadratic term involving the matrix γ, which captures stabilizing/disruptive selection and correlational selection. Key symbols: w(z) = fitness, a = intercept, β = vector of linear selection gradients, z = phenotype vector, μ = mean phenotype, γ = matrix of quadratic selection gradients.
formula-notes:formula_30.13a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on selection on multivariate phenotypes to extend the linear selection gradient (β) to include nonlinear selection (γ), supporting the estimation of the full quadratic selection surface and the analysis of selection differentials and gradients in multivariate normal distributions.

formula-notes:formula_30.13a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将个体适应度 w(z) 表示为性状向量 z 的二次函数：线性项 βᵀz 捕捉方向选择，二次项 (1/2)(z-μ)ᵀγ(z-μ) 捕捉非线性选择（如稳定或 disruptive 选择），其中 γ 是二次选择梯度矩阵，μ 是性状均值向量。
formula-notes:formula_30.13a:zh.inThisChapter: 在多元表型选择章节中，此公式将 Lande-Arnold 回归推广到二次项，用于估计非线性选择梯度 γ，并为后续标准化（公式 30.4b）和简化形式（公式 30.13b）提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_30.15b:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the Hessian matrix of the log mean fitness with respect to the mean phenotype vector μ, showing it equals the curvature matrix γ minus the outer product of the selection gradient β with itself.
formula-notes:formula_30.15b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on multivariate selection to describe the curvature of the mean fitness landscape, supporting later arguments about the shape of adaptive landscapes and the dynamics of multivariate evolution.

formula-notes:formula_30.14:zh.plainMeaning: 公式 (30.14) 计算了性状 i 和 j 之间表型协方差的代内变化 C_{ij}，它等于对所有 k 和 l 求和，其中 γ_{kl} 是二次选择梯度，P_{ik} 和 P_{ℓj} 是表型协方差矩阵 P 的元素。
formula-notes:formula_30.14:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在讨论多变量表型选择的章节，它通过矩阵运算 C = PγP 将二次选择梯度 γ 与表型协方差 P 结合，为后续推导选择如何改变性状间的协方差结构提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_30.15a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算个体适应度曲面在群体表型分布上的平均曲率，其中H_Z[w(z)]是适应度函数w(z)关于表型向量z的Hessian矩阵（二阶偏导矩阵），φ(z)是群体中表型z的概率密度，积分得到平均Hessian矩阵γ。
formula-notes:formula_30.15a:zh.inThisChapter: 本节讨论多变量表型选择中的微分与梯度，该公式将个体适应度曲面的局部曲率（Hessian）通过群体分布加权平均，为后续推导平均适应度景观的梯度（如公式30.15b）提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_30.13b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将标准化后的性状向量 z_sd 与适应度 w(z) 联系起来：a 是截距，β_sd 是线性梯度向量，γ_sd 是二次梯度矩阵，通过二次项捕捉非线性选择。
formula-notes:formula_30.13b:zh.inThisChapter: 在多元表型选择章节中，公式30.13b是30.13a在标准化变量下的紧凑形式，为后续推导选择梯度（如β_sd和γ_sd）以及分析多元选择下的响应奠定基础。

formula-notes:formula_30.16:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the additive-genetic covariance matrix after selection (G*) from the original matrix G, using the selection gradient β and the quadratic selection gradient γ. The term (γ - ββᵀ) adjusts G for the effects of directional and stabilizing/correlational selection.
formula-notes:formula_30.16:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on selection on multivariate phenotypes to show how selection directly alters the genetic covariance structure, supporting later arguments about evolutionary change in multiple traits.

formula-notes:formula_30.16:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算选择后（繁殖前）的加性遗传协方差矩阵 G*，其中 G 是选择前的加性遗传协方差矩阵，γ 是二次选择梯度矩阵，β 是线性选择梯度向量，ββᵀ 是 β 的外积。
formula-notes:formula_30.16:zh.inThisChapter: 本章讨论多变量表型选择下的响应，该公式用于量化选择如何改变遗传协方差结构，为后续推导选择响应和遗传参数变化提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_30.15b:zh.plainMeaning: 公式 (30.15b) 计算了平均适应度对数 ln(平均适应度) 关于多变量均值向量 μ 的 Hessian 矩阵（即曲率矩阵），它等于 γ 减去 β 与其自身转置的乘积。其中 γ 是适应度曲率矩阵，β 是选择梯度向量。
formula-notes:formula_30.15b:zh.inThisChapter: 在讨论多变量表型选择时，该公式出现在频率无关适应度且表型服从多元正态分布的假设下，用于描述平均适应度景观的曲率，为后续分析稳定选择或进化动态提供曲率信息。

formula-notes:formula_30.17b:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the within-generation change in phenotypic variance of trait i, where δ[σ²(z_i)] is the change, γ_ii is the quadratic selection differential, P_ii is the phenotypic variance, and S_i is the directional selection differential.
formula-notes:formula_30.17b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on selection on multivariate phenotypes to decompose the change in variance into components due to quadratic selection (γ_ii) and directional selection (S_i), supporting later arguments about how selection alters trait variances within a generation.

formula-notes:formula_30.17c:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the within-generation change in additive genetic variance for trait i, δ[σ²(A_i)], as the product of (γ_ii - β_i²) and σ⁴(A_i), where γ_ii is the quadratic selection gradient, β_i is the directional selection gradient, and σ²(A_i) is the additive genetic variance.
formula-notes:formula_30.17c:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on multivariate selection to show how selection alters genetic variance components, supporting later arguments about the evolution of genetic architecture under multivariate selection.

formula-notes:formula_30.17a:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the change in phenotypic variance of trait i after selection, expressed as the difference between the variance after selection (σ²(zᵢ*)) and before selection (σ²(zᵢ)) plus the squared selection differential (Sᵢ²), which equals the quadratic selection differential γᵢᵢ times the squared phenotypic variance σ⁴(zᵢ).
formula-notes:formula_30.17a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on multivariate selection to quantify how selection alters the variance of a single trait, supporting later arguments about the components of phenotypic change and the role of nonlinear selection (γᵢᵢ).

formula-notes:formula_30.18a:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the covariance between two traits i and j after selection (C_ij) as twice the correlational selection gradient (γ_ij) times the phenotypic variances (P_ii, P_jj), assuming zero initial genetic and phenotypic correlations. Key symbols: C_ij = covariance after selection, γ_ij = correlational selection gradient, P_ii, P_jj = phenotypic variances.
formula-notes:formula_30.18a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on multivariate selection to quantify how correlational selection (γ_ij ≠ 0) generates a within-generation covariance between traits, supporting the derivation of the change in phenotypic covariance (δ[σ(z_i,z_j)]) in Equation 30.18b.

formula-notes:formula_30.17b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算性状i的表型方差在世代内的变化δ[σ²(z_i)]，等于二次选择差分γ_ii乘以表型方差平方P_ii²减去选择差分平方S_i²。
formula-notes:formula_30.17b:zh.inThisChapter: 在多元表型选择章节中，该公式与30.17a和30.17c共同描述选择对表型方差的影响，为后续推导选择梯度与方差变化的关系提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_30.18a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算在相关选择（γ_{ij}≠0）且初始遗传和表型相关为零时，性状i和j的协方差C_{ij}，它等于选择后与选择前的表型协方差之差加上选择差之积，并简化为2γ_{ij}P_{ii}P_{jj}。
formula-notes:formula_30.18a:zh.inThisChapter: 本节讨论多变量表型选择中的微分与梯度，该公式展示了相关选择如何直接改变性状间的协方差，为后续推导世代内协方差变化（公式30.18b）和长期进化响应提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_30.17c:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算在世代内（无遗传相关时）加性遗传方差σ²(A_i)的变化量δ[σ²(A_i)]，它等于(γ_{ii} - β_i²)乘以σ⁴(A_i)，其中γ_{ii}是二次选择梯度（凸度），β_i是方向选择梯度。
formula-notes:formula_30.17c:zh.inThisChapter: 本章讨论多变量表型选择，公式30.17c由公式30.16推导而来，说明选择如何改变加性方差，为后续分析选择对遗传方差的影响（如凸选择增加方差、凹和方向选择减少方差）提供定量基础。

formula-notes:formula_30.18c:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the within-generation change in the genetic covariance between traits i and j, δ[σ(A_i, A_j)], as a function of the quadratic selection gradient γ_ij, the directional selection gradients β_i and β_j, and the additive genetic variances σ²(A_i) and σ²(A_j).
formula-notes:formula_30.18c:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on selection on multivariate phenotypes to show how selection can alter genetic covariances even without initial genetic correlations, supporting the argument that correlational selection (γ_ij) can increase covariance when traits are selected in opposite directions.

formula-notes:formula_30.18b:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the within-generation change in phenotypic covariance δ[σ(z_i, z_j)] between traits i and j, expressed as the difference between the product of the selection gradient γ_ij and the genetic variances P_ii and P_jj (scaled by 2) and the product of the selection differentials S_i and S_j.
formula-notes:formula_30.18b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on multivariate selection to quantify how selection alters the covariance between traits within a generation, supporting later arguments about the response to selection via the multivariate breeder's equation.

formula-notes:formula_30.19:en.plainMeaning: This formula expresses the fitness w as a quadratic function of multiple phenotypic traits z_i, with linear coefficients b_i and quadratic coefficients γ_ij, written in matrix form as a + b^T z + (1/2) z^T γ z.
formula-notes:formula_30.19:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on multidimensional quadratic fitness regressions to generalize the univariate quadratic regression to multiple traits, providing the foundation for analyzing stabilizing selection and correlational selection in higher dimensions.

formula-notes:formula_30.18c:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算选择一代内遗传协方差的变化量δ[σ(A_i, A_j)]，它等于(2γ_{ij} - β_i β_j)乘以两个性状的加性遗传方差σ²(A_i)和σ²(A_j)的乘积。其中γ_{ij}是二次项选择梯度，β_i和β_j是线性选择梯度。
formula-notes:formula_30.18c:zh.inThisChapter: 本章讨论多变量表型选择，公式(30.18c)从(30.16)推导而来，用于量化选择如何改变性状间的遗传协方差，为后续分析选择对遗传相关的影响提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_30.20a:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the gradient (directional slope) of the quadratic fitness surface w(z) with respect to the trait vector z. The gradient equals the sum of a constant vector b and a linear term γz, where γ is a scalar curvature parameter.
formula-notes:formula_30.20a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on multidimensional quadratic fitness regressions to express the gradient of the best-fitting quadratic surface, which is then used in subsequent arguments about evolutionary dynamics and equilibrium points.

formula-notes:formula_30.18b:zh.plainMeaning: 公式(30.18b)计算了表型协方差σ(z_i,z_j)在一代选择中的变化δ[σ(z_i,z_j)]，它等于由选择梯度γ_ij和加性遗传方差P_ii、P_jj决定的项2γ_ij P_ii P_jj减去选择差S_i与S_j的乘积。
formula-notes:formula_30.18b:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在讨论多变量表型选择的章节，紧接公式(30.18a)之后，将协方差的变化分解为选择梯度驱动的部分和选择差乘积的修正，为后续推导选择响应和遗传协方差变化提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_30.17a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将性状i的选择方差C_{ii}（即选择前后方差变化加上选择差平方）表示为二次项系数γ_{ii}乘以表型方差平方P_{ii}^2，其中P_{ii}=σ^2(z_i)。
formula-notes:formula_30.17a:zh.inThisChapter: 在讨论多变量表型选择时，本节先忽略遗传相关，通过此公式建立单性状选择方差与二次项系数γ_{ii}的直接关系，为后续推导多性状选择响应（如公式30.17b、30.17c）提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_30.19:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将适应度 w(z) 表示为性状向量 z 的二次函数：常数项 a、线性项 bᵀz（b 为梯度向量）和二次项 ½ zᵀγ z（γ 为对称矩阵，刻画性状间的非线性相互作用与选择曲率）。
formula-notes:formula_30.19:zh.inThisChapter: 本节引入多维二次适应度回归的一般形式，为后续分析多元性状的进化动态（如 Lande 方程）提供基础，其中 γ 矩阵将直接关联到选择梯度与遗传协方差矩阵的乘积。

formula-notes:formula_30.21b:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the expected individual fitness w0 at the stationary point z0, where a is the intercept, b is the gradient vector, and z0 is the stationary point from Equation 30.21a.
formula-notes:formula_30.21b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on multidimensional quadratic fitness regressions to provide the fitness value at the unique stationary point, supporting later analysis of local maxima or minima via the Hessian matrix γ.

formula-notes:formula_30.20b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算平均个体适应度梯度，将梯度 ∇_Z[w(z)] 的积分分解为 b 乘以 p(z) 的积分加上 γ 乘以 z p(z) 的积分，并利用 p(z) 积分为 1、z p(z) 积分为零（均值 μ=0）化简为 b。
formula-notes:formula_30.20b:zh.inThisChapter: 在本节多维二次适应度回归中，公式(30.20b)承接(30.20a)的二次适应度函数，证明平均梯度等于线性系数 b，与分布无关，为后续推导选择梯度等于 b 奠定基础。

formula-notes:formula_30.20a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算了二次适应度曲面 w(z) 在点 z 处的梯度向量，其中 b 是线性系数向量，γ 是二次曲率标量，z 是性状向量。
formula-notes:formula_30.20a:zh.inThisChapter: 本章从二次适应度回归出发探索几何性质，该梯度公式为后续分析适应度曲面的方向导数、最陡爬坡路径以及平衡点条件提供了基础。

formula-notes:formula_30.20b:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the average gradient of individual fitness across the phenotype distribution, showing it equals the linear coefficient vector b when the fitness function is quadratic and phenotypes are centered (mean μ=0). Key symbols: ∇_Z[w(z)] is the gradient of individual fitness w with respect to phenotype vector z; p(z) is the phenotype distribution; b is the linear coefficient vector; γ is the quadratic coefficient.
formula-notes:formula_30.20b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on multidimensional quadratic fitness regressions to demonstrate that under a quadratic fitness surface, the average gradient simplifies to b, independent of the phenotype distribution. This supports later arguments about selection gradients and evolutionary dynamics.

formula-notes:formula_30.9b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算了双变量正态分布下乘积偏差 $(z_i-\mu_i)(z_j-\mu_j)$ 的方差，等于表型协方差 $P_{ij}$ 的平方加上表型方差 $P_{ii}$ 与 $P_{jj}$ 的乘积，也可表示为 $P_{ij}^2(1+\rho_{ij}^{-2})$，其中 $\rho_{ij}=P_{ij}/\sqrt{P_{ii}P_{jj}}$ 是表型相关系数。
formula-notes:formula_30.9b:zh.inThisChapter: 本节推导多元选择下的选择梯度，公式 (30.9b) 为后续不等式 $|C_{ij}/P_{ij}|\le\sqrt{I}\sqrt{1+\rho_{ij}^{-2}}$ 提供方差表达式，从而将遗传协方差 $C_{ij}$ 与表型参数关联起来。

formula-notes:formula_30.21a:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the stationary point (candidate extremum) of a quadratic fitness surface by solving γ z₀ = -b for z₀, where γ is the matrix of quadratic coefficients and b is the vector of linear coefficients.
formula-notes:formula_30.21a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in this section to find the unique point where the gradient of the quadratic fitness regression is zero, which is then used to derive the expected fitness at that point via Equation 30.19 and to support subsequent analysis of evolutionary equilibria.

formula-notes:formula_30.21b:zh.plainMeaning: 公式 (30.21b) 将平衡点处的期望个体适应度 w₀ 表示为截距 a 加上二次项的一半，其中 b 是梯度向量，z₀ 是平衡点。
formula-notes:formula_30.21b:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在多维二次适应度回归章节中，用于计算二次曲面上驻点（由 (30.21a) 给出）处的适应度值，为后续分析适应度景观的局部性质（如 Hessian 矩阵）提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_30.21a:zh.plainMeaning: 公式 (30.21a) 通过求解梯度为零的条件 γ z₀ = -b，得到二次曲面的唯一驻点 z₀ = -γ⁻¹ b，其中 γ 是二次系数矩阵，b 是一次系数向量。
formula-notes:formula_30.21a:zh.inThisChapter: 本章讨论多维二次适应度回归，该公式给出了适应度曲面的驻点表达式，为后续计算该点的适应度值（公式 30.21b）以及判断极值性质提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_30.22:en.plainMeaning: This equation states that the matrix U is orthogonal (or unitary in real case), meaning its transpose is its inverse, and the product of U and its transpose yields the identity matrix I. U is a square matrix whose columns are orthonormal vectors.
formula-notes:formula_30.22:en.inThisChapter: In the context of multidimensional quadratic fitness regressions, this property ensures that the transformation U applied to the coordinate system preserves distances and angles, simplifying the analysis of fitness landscapes by diagonalizing the quadratic form.

formula-notes:formula_30.24a:en.plainMeaning: This formula represents a diagonal matrix A whose diagonal entries are the eigenvalues λ₁, λ₂, …, λₙ, and all off-diagonal entries are zero. It shows that when A is expressed in the basis of its eigenvectors, it becomes a diagonal matrix of eigenvalues.
formula-notes:formula_30.24a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on multidimensional quadratic fitness regressions to show that the symmetric matrix A can be diagonalized by an orthogonal transformation, simplifying the analysis of quadratic forms in fitness landscapes.

formula-notes:formula_30.23:zh.plainMeaning: 公式(30.23)将对称矩阵A分解为特征向量矩阵U、特征值对角矩阵Λ和U的转置的乘积，即A通过正交变换对角化。
formula-notes:formula_30.23:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在多维二次适应度回归章节，用于将方差-协方差矩阵等对称矩阵对角化，为后续推导适应度景观的二次型表达式和特征值分析提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_30.22:zh.plainMeaning: 这个公式表示矩阵U是正交矩阵（或酉矩阵），其转置等于其逆，因此U的转置与U相乘（无论顺序）都得到单位矩阵I。
formula-notes:formula_30.22:zh.inThisChapter: 在本节多维二次适应度回归中，该公式用于确保U的列向量构成标准正交基，从而简化后续对二次型矩阵的对角化或坐标变换推导。

formula-notes:formula_30.24a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将矩阵A表示为以特征值λ1,λ2,…,λn为对角元素的对角矩阵，即A经过正交变换后化为对角形，其中λi是A的第i个特征值。
formula-notes:formula_30.24a:zh.inThisChapter: 在本节多维二次适应度回归中，该公式用于将二次型矩阵A对角化，从而简化适应度景观的分析，为后续利用特征向量矩阵U（公式30.24b）进行坐标变换和讨论适应度曲率做准备。

formula-notes:formula_30.24b:en.plainMeaning: This formula defines the matrix U whose columns are the eigenvectors e1, e2, ..., en of the matrix G (or a related matrix), used to diagonalize it via UᵀGU = diag(λ1, λ2, ..., λn).
formula-notes:formula_30.24b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on multidimensional quadratic fitness regressions to provide the orthogonal transformation that diagonalizes the quadratic form, enabling analysis of fitness surfaces in terms of independent axes (eigenvectors).

formula-notes:formula_30.23:en.plainMeaning: This formula expresses the diagonalization of a symmetric matrix A, where U is an orthonormal matrix (U⁻¹ = Uᵀ) and Λ is a diagonal matrix containing the eigenvalues λᵢ. It decomposes A into a product of eigenvectors, eigenvalues, and transposed eigenvectors.
formula-notes:formula_30.23:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on multidimensional quadratic fitness regressions to diagonalize the quadratic form, simplifying the analysis of fitness surfaces by rotating to principal axes. This supports later arguments about selection gradients and evolutionary dynamics.

formula-notes:formula_30.25:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式通过左乘U^T、右乘U，将对称矩阵A对角化为特征值矩阵Λ，其中U是正交矩阵（U^T U = I），Λ的对角元是A的特征值。
formula-notes:formula_30.25:zh.inThisChapter: 在本节多维二次适应度回归中，此公式用于将二次型矩阵A对角化，从而将原坐标系下的二次型变换到主轴坐标系，简化后续对适应度景观的分析。

formula-notes:formula_30.25:en.plainMeaning: This formula shows that multiplying the matrix A on the left by U^T and on the right by U diagonalizes A, yielding the diagonal matrix Λ of eigenvalues. U is an orthogonal (unitary) matrix, Λ is diagonal, and the simplification relies on U^T U = I.
formula-notes:formula_30.25:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on multidimensional quadratic fitness regressions to demonstrate how to transform the quadratic form into a coordinate system where the fitness surface is aligned with the principal axes, simplifying analysis of selection gradients and curvatures.

formula-notes:formula_30.24b:zh.plainMeaning: 公式(30.24b)定义矩阵U，其列向量是标准正交基e1, e2, ..., en，用于将向量从标准基坐标变换到由这些基向量张成的空间。
formula-notes:formula_30.24b:zh.inThisChapter: 在多元二次适应度回归章节中，该公式与对角矩阵(30.24a)共同构成特征分解，为后续简化二次型或分析适应度景观的几何性质提供坐标变换工具。

formula-notes:formula_30.27:en.plainMeaning: This formula expresses the quadratic fitness function w(z) in the B canonical form, where y are transformed coordinates aligned with the eigenvectors of the Hessian matrix, and λ_i are the eigenvalues. The sum shows that the quadratic part is a weighted sum of squares of the transformed variables.
formula-notes:formula_30.27:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on multidimensional quadratic fitness regressions to present the simplest diagonalized form after removing linear terms via rotation and translation, supporting later analysis of the fitness landscape's curvature and stationary points.

formula-notes:formula_30.29:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将多元函数 f(z) 近似表示为 k 个投影方向 a_i 上的单变量函数 f_i 之和，其中 x_i = a_i^T z 是 z 在方向 a_i 上的投影。
formula-notes:formula_30.29:zh.inThisChapter: 在多元半参数适应曲面估计章节中，该公式引入投影寻踪回归（PPR）的核心思想，为后续通过迭代拟合投影方向与岭函数来估计高维曲面提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_30.29:en.plainMeaning: This formula expresses a multivariate function f(z) as a sum of k univariate ridge functions, each acting on a linear projection a_i^T z of the input vector z, where x_i = a_i^T z are the projected coordinates.
formula-notes:formula_30.29:en.inThisChapter: It introduces the projection pursuit regression (PPR) model for estimating fitness surfaces, providing a flexible semiparametric approach that reduces dimensionality by modeling f(z) through additive nonlinear functions of linear combinations of predictors.

formula-notes:formula_30.27:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式表示经过变量变换 y = U^T(z - z0) 后，二次适应度函数 w(z) 被简化为常数项 w0 加上二次型 (1/2) y^T Λ y，其中 Λ 是对角矩阵，λ_i 是其特征值，y_i 是变换后的坐标。
formula-notes:formula_30.27:zh.inThisChapter: 本节推导多维二次适应度回归的规范形式，公式(30.27)通过正交变换消去线性项，得到B规范形式，为后续分析适应度曲面的形状和稳定性提供简化表达式。

formula-notes:formula_30.28:en.plainMeaning: This formula defines a confidence region for the stationary point of a quadratic response surface: the inequality describes an ellipsoid in the space of the canonical variable z, where d_z = b + γz is the vector of first-order coefficients at z, V is the estimated covariance matrix of b, and the right-hand side is the critical value from the F distribution.
formula-notes:formula_30.28:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on multidimensional quadratic fitness regressions to provide a simultaneous confidence volume for the location of the optimum, which is essential for interpreting the fitted surface and testing hypotheses about the stationary point.

formula-notes:formula_30.31:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the squared multiple correlation coefficient ρ² between fitness and a set of traits, where β_sd is the vector of standardized selection gradients, s is the vector of selection differentials, and I is the opportunity for selection.
formula-notes:formula_30.31:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on selection strength and pattern to quantify the overall trait-fitness association when multiple correlated traits are considered, supporting later arguments about power calculations in natural populations.

formula-notes:formula_30.26:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将二次适应度函数 w(z) 通过正交变换 z = U y 对角化，消去交叉项，最终表示为常数 a、线性项 ∑θ_i y_i 与纯二次项 (1/2)∑λ_i y_i^2 之和，其中 θ_i 是 b 在 U 基下的分量，λ_i 是 γ 的特征值。
formula-notes:formula_30.26:zh.inThisChapter: 本节讨论多维二次适应度回归，公式 (30.26) 通过正交对角化简化了二次型，为后续分析适应度景观的几何性质（如鞍点、峰谷）以及选择梯度提供简洁表达式。

formula-notes:formula_30.30b:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the selection gradient for trait i, β_MS,i, as the proportional change in mean fitness (W̄) with respect to the mean of trait i (z̄_i), where W̄ is the sample average of individual fitnesses W(z_j) over n data vectors.
formula-notes:formula_30.30b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the multivariate semiparametric fitness surface estimation section to provide a nonparametric estimator of the selection gradient that does not assume a specific distribution, supporting later comparisons with parametric gradients like the Lande-Arnold β.

formula-notes:formula_30.33a:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the extended selection gradient η_i for trait i as the sum of its direct effect (β_{pa,i}) and indirect effects via other traits j (β_{pa,j} multiplied by Φ_{ij}, the total causal impact of i on j).
formula-notes:formula_30.33a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on path analysis and fitness estimation to decompose selection into direct and indirect components, supporting later arguments about how correlated traits affect evolutionary response.

formula-notes:formula_30.26:en.plainMeaning: This formula expresses the quadratic fitness function w(z) in terms of rotated coordinates y = U^T z, eliminating cross-product terms. The key symbols are: a (constant), b (linear coefficient vector), U (orthonormal rotation matrix), γ (symmetric matrix of quadratic coefficients), A = U^T γ U (diagonalized matrix with eigenvalues λ_i), θ_i = (U^T b)_i (linear coefficients in rotated coordinates), and y_i (rotated trait values).
formula-notes:formula_30.26:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on multidimensional quadratic fitness regressions to show that by rotating the trait space using the eigenvectors of γ, the quadratic form becomes a sum of independent squared terms, simplifying the analysis of selection gradients and the connection to the selection differential.

formula-notes:formula_30.33b:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the total effect matrix Φ as the inverse of (I - B), where I is the identity matrix and B is the matrix of direct path coefficients with zeros on the diagonal.
formula-notes:formula_30.33b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the path analysis section to derive total effects from direct effects, supporting the calculation of selection gradients via Equation 30.33c.

formula-notes:formula_30.32:en.plainMeaning: This formula estimates the standardized distance of a population mean (z̄) from an optimum (θ) in units of phenotypic standard deviation (σ), approximated by the absolute ratio of the standardized linear selection differential (β_sd) to the negative standardized quadratic selection differential (γ_sd).
formula-notes:formula_30.32:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on selection strength and pattern to provide a method for inferring how far a population is from its adaptive optimum using estimated selection gradients, supporting later arguments about the prevalence of directional versus stabilizing selection in natural populations.

formula-notes:formula_30.32:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式用标准化选择梯度（β_sd）和非线性选择系数（γ_sd）的比值绝对值，来近似估计种群均值（z̄）与最优表型（θ）之间的距离（以表型标准差σ为单位）。
formula-notes:formula_30.32:zh.inThisChapter: 本节旨在检验自然种群是否处于最优状态，该公式提供了利用选择梯度估计种群偏离最优程度的方法，为后续判断种群是否接近适应峰提供定量依据。

formula-notes:formula_30.31:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算多性状情况下性状-适合度相关性的平方 ρ²，其中 βₛᵈ 是标准化选择梯度的列向量，s 是性状间的协方差矩阵（或相关矩阵），I 是适合度方差（或标准化后的总方差），分子 βₛᵈᵀ s 表示标准化选择梯度与性状协方差的加权内积。
formula-notes:formula_30.31:zh.inThisChapter: 本节讨论自然种群中选择强度与模式的量化，公式(30.31)将单性状的性状-适合度相关性推广到多性状情形，为后续进行统计功效分析（如检测选择信号所需样本量）提供核心参数 ρ。

formula-notes:formula_30.33a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算第 i 个性状对适应度的总选择梯度 η_i，它等于该性状对适应度的直接路径系数 β_{pa,i}（乘以1），加上所有其他性状 j（j≠i）通过因果路径 Φ_{ij} 传递的间接效应之和（β_{pa,j} Φ_{ij}）。
formula-notes:formula_30.33a:zh.inThisChapter: 本节通过路径分析将选择梯度分解为直接和间接成分，此公式是扩展梯度定义的核心，为后续推导总选择梯度与遗传协方差的关系（如公式30.33b、30.33c）奠定基础。

formula-notes:formula_30.28:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式定义了二次型 d_z^T V^{-1} d_z 的上界，其中 d_z = b + γ z 是响应面在点 z 处的梯度向量，V 是梯度估计的协方差矩阵，k 是因子个数，F_{1-α,k,n-p} 是 F 分布的临界值。它给出了响应面驻点（即最优解）的 100(1-α)% 置信区域，即所有满足该不等式的 z 向量构成一个椭球。
formula-notes:formula_30.28:zh.inThisChapter: 本章讨论多元二次拟合回归（响应面分析），公式 (30.28) 用于构造驻点的置信域，是响应面分析中推断最优操作条件的关键工具。它基于 Box 和 Hunter (1954) 的结果，将梯度向量的二次型与 F 分布临界值比较，从而得到驻点的联合置信区域。

formula-notes:formula_30.30b:zh.plainMeaning: 公式 (30.30b) 定义了第 i 个性状的多变量半参数选择梯度 β_{MS,i}，它等于平均适应度 \(\overline{W}\) 对第 i 个性状均值 \(\overline{z}_i\) 的偏导数除以 \(\overline{W}\)，其中 \(\overline{W}\) 是 n 个数据向量适应度的算术平均。
formula-notes:formula_30.30b:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在多变量半参数适应度曲面估计章节，用于在非参数框架下计算选择梯度，为后续基于数据直接估计选择强度提供基础，并推广了第 29 章中单变量或参数化的梯度表达式。

formula-notes:formula_30.33c:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the vector of total selection differentials η as the product of the matrix of total effects Φ (which is (I-B)^{-1}) and the vector of partial selection gradients β_pa. Φ captures both direct and indirect paths in the path diagram, and β_pa contains the direct selection gradients.
formula-notes:formula_30.33c:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on path analysis and fitness estimation to show how total selection differentials are derived from partial selection gradients using the total effects matrix, supporting the decomposition of selection into direct and indirect components.

formula-notes:formula_30.33b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算路径系数矩阵Φ，其中I是单位矩阵，B是因果连接矩阵（B_{ii}=0且B_{ij}表示从j到i的直接因果效应），(I-B)^{-1}是矩阵求逆，Φ的每个元素Φ_{ij}表示从j到i的总因果效应（包括直接和间接路径）。
formula-notes:formula_30.33b:zh.inThisChapter: 本章通过路径分析估计适应度，公式(30.33b)从(30.33a)的η = Bη + β_{pa}推导而来，用于将η表示为β_{pa}的线性函数，为后续(30.33c)中η = Φβ_{pa}提供基础，从而将适应度向量与选择梯度联系起来。

formula-notes:formula_30.33c:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将总选择梯度向量 η 表示为路径系数矩阵 Φ 与直接选择梯度向量 βₚₐ 的乘积，其中 Φ 由 (I-B)⁻¹ 给出，因此 η = (I-B)⁻¹ βₚₐ。
formula-notes:formula_30.33c:zh.inThisChapter: 在路径分析与适应度估计章节中，该公式用于从直接选择梯度 βₚₐ 和路径系数矩阵 B 推导出总选择梯度 η，为后续分析性状间的间接选择效应提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_30.34:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the elasticity of population growth rate λ with respect to a parameter μ as the sum over fitness components Wi of the product of the elasticity of λ with respect to Wi (ei) and the mean-standardized gradient of Wi with respect to μ (βμ,i).
formula-notes:formula_30.34:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on path analysis and fitness estimation to decompose the effect of a parameter on λ into contributions via different fitness components, supporting later arguments about how selection gradients on traits can be partitioned into components acting through different vital rates.

formula-notes:formula_30.35a:en.plainMeaning: This formula expresses the fitness w_i of a focal individual i as a linear function of its own trait value z_i and the sum of trait values of all other individuals in the group (∑_{i≠j} z_j), with coefficients β1 and β2, plus an error term e_i. The constant 1 represents baseline fitness.
formula-notes:formula_30.35a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the 'LEVELS OF SELECTION' section to model how neighbor interactions (non-additive social effects) influence individual fitness, supporting the argument that selection can act on groups or social partners rather than solely on individuals.

formula-notes:formula_30.35a:zh.plainMeaning: 公式 (30.35a) 将焦点个体 i 的适应度 w_i 表示为自身性状值 z_i 的线性效应 (β₁) 加上所有邻居性状值之和 (∑_{i≠j} z_j) 的线性效应 (β₂)，再加上残差 e_i。
formula-notes:formula_30.35a:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在“选择层次”一节，用于建模邻居互作对适应度的影响，为后续推导群体选择与个体选择的分解（如公式 30.35b）提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_30.34:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将总体增长率λ对平均环境μ的对数灵敏度分解为各生活史组分Wi的弹性ei与组分对μ的对数斜率βμ,i的乘积之和，即总弹性等于各组分弹性与组分对μ的敏感度的加权和。
formula-notes:formula_30.34:zh.inThisChapter: 在路径分析与适合度估计章节中，此公式用于量化环境变化通过影响不同生活史组分（如存活率、繁殖率）进而传递到种群增长率λ的累积效应，为后续构建适合度梯度或分析环境协方差奠定基础。

formula-notes:formula_30.35b:en.plainMeaning: This formula expresses individual fitness w_i as a linear function of own phenotype z_i and the sum of neighbors' phenotypes (n\overline{z} - z_i), with coefficients β₁ and β₂, plus an error term e_i. The second line rewrites it separating the effects of z_i and the group mean \overline{z}.
formula-notes:formula_30.35b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the Levels of Selection section to decompose fitness into within-group (β₁) and between-group (β₂) components, supporting the derivation of Hamilton's rule or multilevel selection conditions.

formula-notes:formula_30.37a:en.plainMeaning: This formula expresses the mean fitness of group i (w̄_i) as a linear function of the group's mean trait value (z̄_i), with slope β and residual e_i, where the intercept is fixed at 1.
formula-notes:formula_30.37a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the Levels of Selection section to define the group-level regression that partitions selection into within- and among-group components, supporting the derivation of the contextual analysis (Equation 30.37b).

formula-notes:formula_30.36:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将总选择差分解为组内协方差的期望（第一项）和组间协方差（第二项），其中 w_ij 和 z_ij 是个体适应度和表型，而 w̄_i 和 z̄_i 是组均值。
formula-notes:formula_30.36:zh.inThisChapter: 在“选择层次”章节中，此公式用于量化个体选择与群体选择对总进化变化的相对贡献，为后续讨论多水平选择理论奠定基础。

formula-notes:formula_30.37b:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the slope β of a univariate regression of group mean fitness w̄_i on group mean trait z̄_i, where σ(z̄_i, w̄_i) is the covariance between group means and σ²(z̄_i) is the variance of group mean trait.
formula-notes:formula_30.37b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the Levels of Selection section to quantify the effect of group-level trait variation on group fitness, supporting the argument that selection can act at multiple levels by decomposing total evolutionary change into within- and between-group components.

formula-notes:formula_30.36:en.plainMeaning: This formula decomposes the total covariance between phenotype and fitness across all individuals into the average within-group covariance plus the between-group covariance of group means. Symbols: σ(z,w) is total covariance, E_i[σ(w_ij,z_ij)] is average within-group covariance, σ(z̄_i,w̄_i) is between-group covariance of group means.
formula-notes:formula_30.36:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on levels of selection to partition selection into within-group and between-group components, supporting the argument that group selection can occur when between-group covariance is nonzero.

formula-notes:formula_30.37a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将第 i 组的平均适应度 w̄_i 表示为 1（基线适应度）加上组平均性状值 z̄_i 乘以回归系数 β，再加上残差 e_i，刻画了组平均适应度与组平均性状之间的线性关系。
formula-notes:formula_30.37a:zh.inThisChapter: 本节讨论选择层次，此公式作为单性状组间回归的基础模型，为后续引入组内回归（公式 30.37b）并比较组间与组内选择强度提供起点。

formula-notes:formula_30.37b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算回归斜率β，等于群体平均性状值z̄_i与群体平均适应度w̄_i之间的协方差除以z̄_i的方差。
formula-notes:formula_30.37b:zh.inThisChapter: 在“选择层次”章节中，此公式将群体层次的回归斜率表达为协方差与方差之比，为后续推导多层级选择中的Price方程或群体间选择强度提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_30.38b:en.plainMeaning: This formula expresses individual fitness w_ij as a linear function of the within-group deviation (z_ij - z̄_i) with slope β₁* and the group mean z̄_i with slope β₂*, plus an error e_ij. β₁* measures selection within groups, β₂* measures selection between groups.
formula-notes:formula_30.38b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the Levels of Selection section to decompose total selection into within-group and between-group components, supporting the argument that group selection can occur when β₂* ≠ β₁*.

formula-notes:formula_30.35b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将个体适应度 w_i 表示为自身性状值 z_i 的线性函数（系数 β₁−β₂）与群体平均性状值 n·z̄ 的线性函数（系数 β₂）之和，再加上误差项 e_i。
formula-notes:formula_30.35b:zh.inThisChapter: 在本节“选择层次”中，该公式将群体选择模型（公式 30.35a）重新参数化为个体性状和群体平均性状的线性组合，为后续推导多层级选择下的协方差公式（如 Price 方程）奠定基础。

formula-notes:formula_30.38a:en.plainMeaning: This regression predicts individual fitness w_ij as a linear function of the individual's own trait value z_ij and the group mean trait value \overline{z}_i, with coefficients β1 and β2, plus an error term e_ij.
formula-notes:formula_30.38a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the Levels of Selection section to show how contextual analysis can unify different models of group selection, and it supports the derivation of the Price equation decomposition in Equation 30.38b and the condition for group selection in Equation 30.38c.

formula-notes:formula_30.38a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将个体适应度 w_{ij} 分解为三部分：1 是基线适应度，β₁z_{ij} 是个体自身性状值 z_{ij} 的线性贡献（直接效应），β₂z̄_i 是所在群体平均性状值 z̄_i 的线性贡献（群体背景效应），e_{ij} 是残差。
formula-notes:formula_30.38a:zh.inThisChapter: 本节讨论不同层次选择（硬选择、软选择、严格群体选择）的统一建模，该公式作为情境分析回归的基本形式，将个体适应度拆分为个体效应和群体效应，为后续推导选择梯度（如公式 30.38b、30.38c）提供线性框架。

formula-notes:formula_30.39a:en.plainMeaning: This formula expresses individual fitness w_ij as a baseline of 1 plus a within-group selection term β(z_ij - z̄_i) plus an error e_ij, where β is the selection gradient, z_ij is the individual's trait value, and z̄_i is the group mean.
formula-notes:formula_30.39a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the 'Levels of Selection' section to model soft selection where fitness depends only on within-group deviations, setting up the derivation of the Price equation components in Equation 30.39b.

formula-notes:formula_30.38b:zh.plainMeaning: 公式(30.38b)将个体适应度w_ij分解为三部分：常数1、个体内偏差(z_ij - z̄_i)的回归项β1*乘以该偏差、群体均值z̄_i的回归项β2*乘以该均值，再加上残差e_ij。
formula-notes:formula_30.38b:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在“选择层次”一节，用于将回归模型(30.38a)重写为组内偏差和组均值的形式，从而区分个体水平选择（β1*）和群体水平选择（β2*），为后续推导Price方程的多层次分解（如公式30.38c）做铺垫。

formula-notes:formula_30.38c:en.plainMeaning: This formula expresses individual fitness w_ij as a linear function of the individual's own trait value z_ij, the group mean trait value \bar{z}_i, and an error term e_ij, with coefficients β1* and (β2* - β1*).
formula-notes:formula_30.38c:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the Levels of Selection section to show how the regression coefficients from two different models (Equations 30.38a and 30.38b) are related, specifically that β1 = β1* and β2 = β2* - β1*, which is used to connect the models and clarify the partitioning of selection into within- and between-group components.

formula-notes:formula_30.38c:zh.plainMeaning: 公式(30.38c)将个体适应度 w_{ij} 表示为个体表型值 z_{ij} 和群体平均表型值 \overline{z}_i 的线性函数，其中系数 β₁* 和 β₂* 来自公式(30.38b)，而 β₂* - β₁* 对应公式(30.38a)中的 β₂。
formula-notes:formula_30.38c:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在“选择层次”一节，用于连接两个不同回归模型（个体模型与群体模型）的系数，为后续推导多层级选择下的协方差分解（如Price方程）提供代数基础。

formula-notes:formula_30.39b:en.plainMeaning: This formula expresses an individual's fitness as a function only of the group mean phenotype, with a regression coefficient β and residual e_ij, indicating strict group selection where individual deviations do not affect fitness.
formula-notes:formula_30.39b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the 'Levels of Selection' section to contrast with individual selection models, supporting the argument that when group selection is strict, the individual-level regression coefficient β1 in Equation 30.38a is zero.
