formula-notes:formula_30.39b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将个体适应度 \(w_{ij}\) 表示为仅依赖于其所在群体均值 \(\overline{z}_i\) 的线性函数，其中 \( eta\) 是群体均值对适应度的回归斜率，\(e_{ij}\) 是残差。
formula-notes:formula_30.39b:zh.inThisChapter: 在讨论严格群体选择时，此公式通过设定个体适应度完全由群体均值决定（即忽略个体表型的影响），为后续比较个体选择模型（公式30.38a）与群体选择模型提供基础，并引出对回归系数 \( eta_1=0\) 的约束。

formula-notes:formula_30.40a:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the relative fitness of a male offspring as a linear function of the mother's trait value in the previous generation (maternal care, z_m) and the offspring's own trait value (z_o), with coefficients b_m and b_o measuring selection strengths, plus an intercept α and error ε.
formula-notes:formula_30.40a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the 'Levels of Selection' section to illustrate maternal selection, where a male's fitness depends on both his own phenotype and his mother's phenotype, supporting the argument that selection can act across generations and not just on the individual.

formula-notes:formula_30.40b:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the fitness of a female individual as a function of her own trait value (with direct cost b_d), the trait value of her mate (b_m), and the trait value of her offspring (b_o), plus an intercept and error term.
formula-notes:formula_30.40b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on levels of selection to model how a female's fitness is affected by her own trait (including a direct cost) and by traits expressed in her mate and offspring, supporting the analysis of multilevel selection.

formula-notes:formula_30.40a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算雄性后代相对适应度 w_{(t)}[male] 为截距 α_{(t)} 加上母亲上一代母性照顾 z_{m(t-1)} 的效应 b_m 和后代自身性状 z_{o(t)} 的效应 b_o，再加残差 ε_{(t)}。
formula-notes:formula_30.40a:zh.inThisChapter: 在“选择层次”章节中，此公式引入母性选择（maternal selection）的概念，说明雄性后代的适应度不仅受自身性状影响，还受母亲上一代母性照顾的影响，为后续推导雌性后代适应度公式（30.40b）及两性动态方程（30.40c, 30.40d）奠定基础。

formula-notes:formula_30.39a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将个体i在群体j中的适应度w_{ij}表示为常数1加上个体表型值z_{ij}偏离其所在群体均值\overline{z}_{i}的线性函数，其中β是选择梯度，e_{ij}是残差。
formula-notes:formula_30.39a:zh.inThisChapter: 在软选择（soft selection）的章节中，该公式刻画了适应度仅依赖于个体相对于其所在群体的偏差（如家系内选择），为后续推导群体间和群体内选择分量（如公式30.39b）提供了基础回归形式。

formula-notes:formula_30.40d:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the total selection differential on male offspring (S_m(off)) as a weighted average of three components: the additive genetic covariance between male parent and offspring (b_m σ²(A_m)/2), the dominance variance in males (b_d σ²(z_m)/2), and the covariance between male additive genetic value and female phenotype (b_o σ(A_m, A_o)).
formula-notes:formula_30.40d:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the 'Levels of Selection' section to decompose the total selection differential into additive, dominance, and cross-sex components, supporting the argument that selection on males can be partitioned into within-sex and between-sex effects.

formula-notes:formula_30.40c:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the selection differential on a maternal trait z_m(t) via offspring fitness, decomposed into three components: direct maternal effect (b_m), sex-specific maternal effect (δ_f b_d), and paternal effect (b_o), each weighted by the covariance between the respective trait and z_m(t).
formula-notes:formula_30.40c:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the 'Levels of Selection' section to partition the total selection differential into contributions from different genetic and environmental pathways, supporting the later argument that selection on maternal traits can be expressed as a weighted average over sexes (Equation 13.5).

formula-notes:formula_30.40b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算雌性个体在时间t的适合度w_(t)[female]，它由截距α_(t)、雄性上一代性状z_m(t-1)的间接效应b_m、雌性自身当前性状z_m(t)的直接成本b_d、其他个体性状z_o(t)的效应b_o以及残差ε_(t)线性组合而成。
formula-notes:formula_30.40b:zh.inThisChapter: 在“选择层次”章节中，该公式引入雌性直接成本b_d，扩展了之前的适合度模型，为后续讨论性冲突和选择层次间的权衡提供定量基础。

formula-notes:formula_30.41b:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the fitness component due to selection on the maternal trait at time t-1, where w_{m(t-1)} is the maternal fitness, α_{m(t-1)} is the baseline fitness, b_d is the direct effect of the maternal trait z_{m(t-1)} on her own fitness, and ε_{(t-1)} is the residual.
formula-notes:formula_30.41b:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the Levels of Selection section to decompose total fitness into components from offspring survival and maternal trait selection, supporting the argument that selection can act at different levels (offspring vs. maternal) and that total fitness is the sum of these components.

formula-notes:formula_30.41a:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the fitness component w_{o(t)} (offspring survival at time t) as a linear function of the mother's trait z_{m(t-1)} (with slope b_m) and the offspring's own trait z_{o(t)} (with slope b_o), plus an intercept α_{o(t)} and an error term ε_{(t)}.
formula-notes:formula_30.41a:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the 'LEVELS OF SELECTION' section to decompose total maternal fitness into two episodes: offspring survival and maternal trait selection, supporting the argument that selection can act at both the offspring and maternal levels simultaneously.

formula-notes:formula_30.40c:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将母亲对子代性状的协方差 S_m(off) 分解为三项：母亲自身性状 z_{m(t-1)} 与子代性状 z_{m(t)} 的协方差乘以 b_m、子代自身性状 z_{m(t)} 与其自身的协方差乘以 δ_f b_d、以及父亲性状 z_{o(t)} 与子代性状 z_{m(t)} 的协方差乘以 b_o。
formula-notes:formula_30.40c:zh.inThisChapter: 在本章“选择层次”中，该公式用于量化母亲通过直接遗传（b_m）、性别依赖的母性效应（δ_f b_d）和父性效应（b_o）对子代性状的贡献，为后续推导总选择微分（如公式30.40d）提供分解基础。

formula-notes:formula_30.41a:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将后代存活适应度 $w_{o(t)}$ 分解为截距 $\alpha_{o(t)}$、母体性状 $z_{m(t-1)}$ 的加性效应 $b_m z_{m(t-1)}$、后代性状 $z_{o(t)}$ 的加性效应 $b_o z_{o(t)}$ 以及残差 $\epsilon_{(t)}$。
formula-notes:formula_30.41a:zh.inThisChapter: 在本节“选择层次”中，该公式用于刻画母体总适应度中来自后代存活的部分，与公式(30.41b)共同构成母体总适应度 $w_{o(t)}+w_{m(t-1)}$，为后续推导跨世代选择响应（如公式30.41d）提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_30.42:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the difference in the selection differential on maternal trait between mothers and offspring, expressed in terms of genetic variance components and covariance between maternal and offspring additive genetic values.
formula-notes:formula_30.42:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the Levels of Selection section to quantify how selection on a maternal trait differs between generations, supporting the argument that indirect genetic effects can alter evolutionary dynamics across levels.

formula-notes:formula_30.41b:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式表示母亲在时间t-1的适合度w_{m(t-1)}由截距α_{m(t-1)}、直接选择效应b_d乘以母亲性状z_{m(t-1)}以及残差ε_{(t-1)}组成，反映了母亲性状对自身适合度的直接影响。
formula-notes:formula_30.41b:zh.inThisChapter: 在“选择层次”章节中，此公式与公式30.41a共同分解母亲总适合度，为后续推导总适合度表达式（公式30.41c）以及分析直接选择与间接选择（母性效应）的贡献提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_30.41d:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算母体性状的选择微分 S_m(mother)，即母体性状 z_m 与母体适合度 w_o(t) + w_m(t-1) 的协方差，展开为 (b_m + b_d)σ²(z_m) 与 b_o 乘以母体与子代性状协方差项之和的一半。
formula-notes:formula_30.41d:zh.inThisChapter: 在本节“选择层次”中，公式 (30.41d) 将母体性状的选择微分分解为母体直接效应 (b_m + b_d)σ²(z_m) 和母体通过子代性状的间接选择 b_o σ(z_o, z_m)，为后续比较母体与子代层次的选择强度、理解多层级选择冲突提供定量基础。

formula-notes:formula_30.40d:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算雄性后代选择微分 Sm(off)，它等于雄性繁殖成功 bm 与雄性后代性状 zm(t) 和父亲性状 zm(t-1) 的协方差 σ(zm(t-1), zm(t)) 之和，加上雌性繁殖成功 bd 的一半与 zm(t) 方差的乘积，再加上其他个体繁殖成功 bo 与 zm(t) 和 zo(t) 的协方差。第二行将第一行的协方差用加性遗传方差 σ²(Am) 和加性遗传协方差 σ(Am, Ao) 表示。
formula-notes:formula_30.40d:zh.inThisChapter: 本章讨论选择层次（LEVELS OF SELECTION），该公式将个体选择（bm、bd、bo）与遗传传递（σ²(Am)、σ(Am, Ao)）联系起来，为后续推导多层级选择下的响应方程提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_A1.1:zh.plainMeaning: 这个公式表示，在给定当前状态 $x_t = x$ 的条件下，增量 $\delta_x = x_{t+\delta_t} - x_t$ 的条件期望近似等于漂移函数 $m(x)$ 乘以时间增量 $\delta_t$，忽略高阶小项 $o(\delta_t)$。
formula-notes:formula_A1.1:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在附录引言中，用于定义扩散过程的漂移条件，为后续定义漂移函数 $m(x)$ 和扩散函数 $v(x)$ 提供基础，并引出扩散过程的随机微分方程表示。

formula-notes:formula_A1.1:en.plainMeaning: This formula defines the conditional expected infinitesimal change (drift) of a diffusion process: the expected change in x over a small time interval δt, given current value x, is approximately m(x)δt, with error of order smaller than δt.
formula-notes:formula_A1.1:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the Appendix introduction to formally define the drift function m(x) of a diffusion process, which is essential for later derivations of stochastic calculus and the Fokker-Planck equation.

formula-notes:formula_30.41d:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the selection differential on the maternal trait, S_m(mother), as the covariance between total fitness (offspring fitness w_o(t) plus maternal fitness w_m(t-1)) and the maternal trait z_m(t-1). It decomposes into terms involving additive genetic variances and covariances, with b_m, b_d, b_o as selection gradients and σ²(z_m) as phenotypic variance of the maternal trait.
formula-notes:formula_30.41d:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the 'LEVELS OF SELECTION' section to quantify how selection on a maternal trait arises from both direct fitness effects on the mother and indirect effects through offspring fitness, supporting the argument that selection can act at multiple levels (individual and kin).

formula-notes:formula_A1.3:zh.plainMeaning: 这个公式表示，当k≥3时，增量δ_x的k阶矩是δ_t的高阶无穷小，即随着δ_t→0，这些矩比δ_t更快地趋于0。
formula-notes:formula_A1.3:zh.inThisChapter: 在附录引言中，该条件与一阶矩和二阶矩的条件共同定义了扩散过程，确保高阶矩在极限下可忽略，从而简化后续对扩散过程性质的推导。

formula-notes:formula_A1.4:zh.plainMeaning: 公式定义了扩散过程的无穷小均值 m(x)，它表示在给定当前状态 x_t = x 的条件下，过程在极短时间 δ_t 内的条件期望变化率，即瞬时漂移。
formula-notes:formula_A1.4:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在扩散理论基础部分，为后续定义扩散过程的随机微分方程（SDE）和推导 Kolmogorov 方程提供关键的漂移项系数。

formula-notes:formula_30.42:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算母亲选择梯度（S_m(mother)）与子代选择梯度（S_m(off)）之差，等于母亲加性遗传方差项（b_m/2乘以σ²(z_m)与σ²(A_m)之差）减去母子加性遗传协方差项（3/4 b_o乘以σ(A_m, A_o)）。
formula-notes:formula_30.42:zh.inThisChapter: 在“选择层次”章节中，该公式通过比较母亲和子代的选择梯度，量化了母亲与子代间遗传协方差对进化响应的抵消作用，为后续推导多层次选择下的总响应方程提供关键分解。

formula-notes:formula_A1.2:en.plainMeaning: This formula defines the conditional variance of the increment δ_x given the current state x_t = x, showing that it is proportional to the time increment δ_t plus higher-order terms. Here, v(x) is the instantaneous variance (diffusion coefficient) and o(δ_t) represents terms that become negligible relative to δ_t as δ_t → 0.
formula-notes:formula_A1.2:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the Appendix to formally characterize a diffusion process by specifying the second moment (variance) condition, which together with the drift condition defines the infinitesimal parameters needed for later derivations of stochastic calculus and option pricing models.

formula-notes:formula_A1.3:en.plainMeaning: This formula states that for k ≥ 3, the k-th absolute moment of the increment δ_x is of smaller order than δ_t, meaning it vanishes faster than δ_t as δ_t → 0. δ_x is the change in x_t over a small time interval δ_t.
formula-notes:formula_A1.3:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to define a diffusion process by specifying that higher-order moments (k≥3) are negligible relative to δ_t, which together with the first two moments (drift and diffusion) characterizes the process and supports the derivation of stochastic calculus results later.

formula-notes:formula_A1.2:zh.plainMeaning: 这个公式表示，在给定当前状态 $x_t = x$ 的条件下，增量 $\delta_x$ 的条件方差近似等于 $v(x)\delta_t$，加上一个比 $\delta_t$ 更高阶的小量 $o(\delta_t)$。其中 $v(x)$ 是扩散过程的瞬时方差率（扩散系数），$\delta_t$ 是时间间隔。
formula-notes:formula_A1.2:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在附录引言中，用于定义扩散过程的条件二阶矩性质，与前面的一阶矩条件 $E(\delta_x \mid x_t=x)=m(x)\delta_t+o(\delta_t)$ 一起，构成了扩散过程的完整局部特征，为后续推导扩散过程的转移密度和随机微分方程奠定基础。

formula-notes:formula_A1.5:zh.plainMeaning: 公式定义了扩散过程的无穷小方差 v(x)，它等于在给定当前状态 x_t=x 的条件下，未来极短时间 δ_t 内状态变化量 (x_{t+δ_t} - x_t) 平方的条件期望除以 δ_t 的极限。
formula-notes:formula_A1.5:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式与无穷小均值 m(x) 共同构成扩散过程的局部特征，为后续推导 Kolmogorov 向前/向后方程（Fokker-Planck 方程）提供基础，其中 v(x) 控制扩散项的强度。

formula-notes:formula_A1.5:en.plainMeaning: This formula defines the infinitesimal variance v(x) as the limit of the conditional expected squared displacement per unit time, given the process starts at x. Key symbols: v(x) is the infinitesimal variance, δ_t is a small time increment, x_t is the state at time t, and E[·|x_t=x] is the conditional expectation given x_t=x.
formula-notes:formula_A1.5:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the foundations of diffusion theory to formally define the infinitesimal variance, which together with the infinitesimal mean characterizes the local behavior of a diffusion process and is essential for deriving the Kolmogorov forward and backward equations later.

formula-notes:formula_A1.4:en.plainMeaning: This formula defines the infinitesimal mean m(x) as the limit of the expected change in the process x_t over a small time interval δ_t, divided by δ_t, given that x_t = x. Key symbols: m(x) (infinitesimal mean), δ_t (small time increment), x_t (process value at time t), E(·|x_t=x) (conditional expectation).
formula-notes:formula_A1.4:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the foundations of diffusion theory to formally define the drift coefficient m(x), which together with the infinitesimal variance v(x) characterizes the stochastic differential equation of the diffusion process, supporting later derivations of transition densities and sample path properties.

formula-notes:formula_A1.8:en.plainMeaning: This formula is the Taylor expansion of f(x-a) around x, expressing the shifted function value in terms of f(x) and its derivatives up to third order, with a remainder o(a^3). Key symbols: f (function), x (variable), a (shift), ∂/∂x (partial derivative).
formula-notes:formula_A1.8:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the derivation of the diffusion equation from the Chapman-Kolmogorov equation, where the expansion of the transition probability density in small time steps leads to the Fokker-Planck equation.

formula-notes:formula_A1.6:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将解 φ(x,t,p) 表示为关于时间 t 的指数衰减模式之和，其中 λ_i 是特征值，f_i(x,p) 是相应的特征函数，系数由初始条件确定。
formula-notes:formula_A1.6:zh.inThisChapter: 在本章中，该公式展示了如何通过分离变量法将偏微分方程的解展开为特征函数级数，为后续推导 Kolmogorov 前向方程（KFE）的级数解形式提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_A1.6:en.plainMeaning: This formula expresses the solution φ(x,t,p) as a sum over eigenfunctions f_i(x,p) multiplied by exponentially decaying factors e^{-λ_i t}, where λ_i are eigenvalues. It connects the time evolution of the probability density to its spatial and parameter dependence via an eigenfunction expansion.
formula-notes:formula_A1.6:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the foundations of diffusion theory to show how the Kolmogorov forward equation (KFE) can be solved by separation of variables, leading to a spectral representation that supports later analysis of asymptotic behavior and closed-form solutions.

formula-notes:formula_A1.7:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将t+δt时刻在x处的概率密度φ(x,t+δt,p)表示为所有可能的上一时刻位置x-δx处的概率密度φ(x-δx,t,p)乘以从x-δx出发在δt内移动δx的概率φ(δx,x-δx,δt)的积分，即全概率公式的连续形式。
formula-notes:formula_A1.7:zh.inThisChapter: 此公式是扩散方程推导的起点，通过将概率分布的时间演化表达为跳跃过程的积分，为后续利用扩散近似（矩条件）展开积分并得到福克-普朗克方程（公式A1.6）提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_A1.7:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the probability distribution at position x and time t+δt as the integral over all possible jumps δx of the probability of being at x-δx at time t times the jump probability φ(δx, x-δx, δt). Key symbols: φ(x,t,p) is the probability distribution, δt is a small time step, δx is the jump size, and φ(δx, x-δx, δt) is the jump probability given starting point x-δx.
formula-notes:formula_A1.7:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the derivation of the diffusion equation (Equation A1.6) by expressing the time evolution of the distribution as a convolution with jump probabilities, which is then expanded using Taylor series and the diffusion-approximation assumptions (A1.1a–A1.1c) to obtain the Fokker-Planck equation.

formula-notes:formula_A1.8:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将函数在点 x-a 处的值 f(x-a) 展开为在点 x 处的泰勒级数，包含一阶、二阶、三阶导数项及高阶无穷小 o(a³)，其中 a 是小位移，∂f/∂x 等是偏导数。
formula-notes:formula_A1.8:zh.inThisChapter: 在扩散理论基础章节中，该泰勒展开用于将 Chapman-Kolmogorov 方程中的转移概率密度展开为关于时间和空间步长的级数，从而推导出扩散方程（Fokker-Planck 方程）。

formula-notes:formula_A1.9:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将函数 φ(x-δ_x, t) φ(δ_x, x-δ_x, δ_t) 在点 (x, t) 附近展开为 φ(x, t) φ(δ_x, x, δ_t) 及其对 x 的各阶偏导数的泰勒级数，其中 δ_x 是小位移，δ_t 是小时间间隔。
formula-notes:formula_A1.9:zh.inThisChapter: 在扩散理论基础章节中，此展开用于将积分方程中的被积函数近似为多项式，以便后续推导扩散方程（如 Fokker-Planck 方程）的微分形式。

formula-notes:formula_A1.10:en.plainMeaning: This formula expands the integral of φ(x-δx,t)ϕ(δx,x-δx,δt) around x using a Taylor series up to third order in δx, connecting the shifted integrand to derivatives of φ and ϕ at the original point x.
formula-notes:formula_A1.10:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the derivation of the diffusion equation from a master equation, where the expansion is truncated to second order to obtain the Fokker-Planck equation after integrating over δx.

formula-notes:formula_A1.13:en.plainMeaning: This formula states that the integral of the transition probability density φ(δ_x, x, δ_t) over all possible displacement sizes δ_x equals 1, ensuring that φ is a normalized probability distribution.
formula-notes:formula_A1.13:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the derivation of the diffusion equation to normalize the probability distribution of particle displacements, allowing the expansion of integrals that lead to the Fokker-Planck equation.

formula-notes:formula_A1.9:en.plainMeaning: This formula expands the product φ(x-δ_x,t) φ(δ_x, x-δ_x, δ_t) as a Taylor series in δ_x around x, showing how the shifted product relates to the product at (x,t) and its spatial derivatives up to third order, plus a remainder o(δ_x³). Key symbols: φ (probability density), φ (transition probability), δ_x (spatial step), δ_t (time step).
formula-notes:formula_A1.9:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the derivation of the diffusion equation from the Chapman-Kolmogorov equation, providing the Taylor expansion needed to evaluate the integral over δ_x and obtain the differential form of the master equation, which later leads to the Fokker-Planck equation.

formula-notes:formula_A1.13:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式表示，给定起始位置 x 和时间间隔 δ_t 后，位移 δ_x 的概率密度函数 φ(δ_x, x, δ_t) 对 δ_x 的积分为 1，即总概率归一化。
formula-notes:formula_A1.13:zh.inThisChapter: 此处利用概率密度归一化性质，将积分结果设为 1，从而在后续推导中消去对 δ_x 的积分，简化扩散方程的推导过程。

formula-notes:formula_A1.10:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将积分中的被积函数 φ(x-δx, t) 在点 (x, t) 处对 δx 进行泰勒展开至三阶，从而将原积分近似为四个积分项之和，其中 φ 和 φ 的偏导数均在 (x, t) 处取值。
formula-notes:formula_A1.10:zh.inThisChapter: 在扩散理论基础章节中，此展开用于将主方程中的跳跃积分转化为关于空间导数的微分形式，为后续推导扩散方程（Fokker-Planck 方程）提供关键近似步骤。

formula-notes:formula_A1.11:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将卷积积分展开为两项：第一项是φ(x,t)乘以跃迁概率密度φ对δ_x的积分（即总概率1），第二项是-∂/∂x[φ(x,t)乘以δ_x的期望值]，从而将非局部的积分关系转化为局部的微分形式。
formula-notes:formula_A1.11:zh.inThisChapter: 在扩散理论基础中，此公式用于从主方程（积分形式）推导出福克-普朗克方程（微分形式），通过忽略高阶项并利用概率密度性质，将空间非局部的跃迁过程近似为局部的扩散过程。

formula-notes:formula_A1.15:en.plainMeaning: This formula expresses the integral of δx² times the joint probability density φ(δx, x, δt) as the sum of the variance σ²(δx) and the square of the mean E(δx) of δx, connecting the second moment to variance and mean.
formula-notes:formula_A1.15:en.inThisChapter: It appears here to derive the infinitesimal variance and drift coefficients of the diffusion process, supporting the transition from discrete random walks to continuous diffusion equations.

formula-notes:formula_A1.11:en.plainMeaning: This formula expresses the integral of the product of the probability density φ at a shifted position and the transition probability φ over small displacements δ_x, relating it to the density at the original position and a spatial derivative term. Key symbols: φ(x,t) is the probability density at position x and time t; φ(δ_x, x, δ_t) is the transition probability for a displacement δ_x over time δ_t starting from x.
formula-notes:formula_A1.11:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the derivation of the diffusion equation from a master equation, showing how the probability density evolves due to small random displacements. This step supports the later argument that the integral of the transition probability times displacement yields the drift term in the Fokker-Planck equation.

formula-notes:formula_A1.12:en.plainMeaning: This formula expresses the second and third order spatial derivative terms in the Kramers-Moyal expansion of the master equation, where φ(x,t) is the probability density, δx is the jump size, and φ(δx, x, δt) is the conditional jump probability density.
formula-notes:formula_A1.12:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the derivation of the diffusion equation from a random walk, showing that truncating the expansion at second order yields the Fokker-Planck equation, while the third order term is neglected under the assumption of small jumps.

formula-notes:formula_A1.18:en.plainMeaning: This formula defines the partial derivative of φ with respect to time t as the limit of the difference quotient, showing the instantaneous rate of change of φ at a fixed position x.
formula-notes:formula_A1.18:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the derivation of the diffusion equation, establishing the time derivative term that will be balanced with spatial derivatives to form the governing PDE.

formula-notes:formula_A1.16:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the expected squared displacement over a small time interval, showing it equals the infinitesimal variance v(x) times δt plus higher-order terms. Key symbols: δx (displacement), δt (time step), φ (transition probability density), v(x) (infinitesimal variance), m(x) (infinitesimal mean).
formula-notes:formula_A1.16:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the derivation of the diffusion equation to show that the second moment of displacement is dominated by the variance term, supporting the transition from discrete random walk to continuous diffusion process.

formula-notes:formula_A1.15:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将位移平方的积分（即二阶矩）分解为方差 σ²(δx) 与均值平方 [E(δx)]² 之和，其中 δx 是位移变量，φ 是概率密度函数。
formula-notes:formula_A1.15:zh.inThisChapter: 在扩散理论基础中，该公式用于将扩散假设（A1.1a 和 A1.1b）代入后简化二阶矩表达式，为后续推导扩散方程中的漂移和扩散系数做准备。

formula-notes:formula_A1.14:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式表示对位移δ_x乘以条件概率密度φ(δ_x, x, δ_t)的积分等于给定初始位置x_t=x时位移δ_x的条件期望，该期望近似等于漂移函数m(x)乘以时间增量δ_t加上高阶无穷小o(δ_t)。
formula-notes:formula_A1.14:zh.inThisChapter: 在扩散理论基础章节中，该公式用于从随机游走的局部矩条件推导漂移函数m(x)的表达式，为后续建立扩散过程的无穷小均值和方差参数化奠定基础。

formula-notes:formula_A1.14:en.plainMeaning: This formula defines the conditional expectation of the displacement δx given the starting position x, showing that it equals the drift m(x) times the time increment δt plus a term of smaller order. The symbols are: δx (displacement), x (position), δt (time increment), φ (probability density of δx given x and δt), E (expectation), m(x) (drift function), and o(δt) (terms that go to zero faster than δt).
formula-notes:formula_A1.14:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the foundations of diffusion theory to derive the drift coefficient from the infinitesimal mean of the displacement, which is essential for linking the stochastic process to the Fokker-Planck equation and later for establishing the diffusion equation.

formula-notes:formula_A1.17:en.plainMeaning: This formula expresses the probability density φ at time t+δt in terms of its value at time t, accounting for drift m(x) and diffusion v(x) via a Taylor expansion up to second order, with higher-order terms absorbed into o(δt).
formula-notes:formula_A1.17:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the derivation of the diffusion (Fokker-Planck) equation, showing how the density evolves over a small time increment, which is then used to obtain the continuous-time PDE by taking the limit δt → 0.

formula-notes:formula_A1.12:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式表示对概率密度函数 φ(δ_x, x, δ_t) 与 φ(x,t) 乘积的积分进行泰勒展开后，保留到三阶项的结果，其中二阶项系数为 1/2，三阶项系数为 -1/6，分别对应空间二阶和三阶偏导数。
formula-notes:formula_A1.12:zh.inThisChapter: 在扩散理论基础章节中，该公式用于推导扩散方程，通过忽略高阶项（o(δ_x³)）并利用跳跃矩的定义，将积分形式的跳跃过程转化为偏微分方程，为后续建立扩散系数与跳跃矩的关系做铺垫。

formula-notes:formula_A1.19:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式表明，当时间增量δt趋于0时，包含δt和更高阶无穷小o(δt)的项对空间导数的贡献退化为仅保留δt线性项，最终极限等于m(x)φ(x,t)对x的偏导数。
formula-notes:formula_A1.19:zh.inThisChapter: 此处出现在扩散理论基础的推导中，用于简化方程A1.9中的高阶无穷小项，从而得到扩散方程的标准形式，为后续建立Fokker-Planck方程提供关键步骤。

formula-notes:formula_A1.17:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将 t+δt 时刻的概率密度 φ(x,t+δt) 展开为 t 时刻的 φ(x,t) 减去一阶空间导数项（包含漂移 m(x)δt）加上二阶空间导数项（包含扩散 v(x)δt），其中 o(δt) 表示高阶小量。
formula-notes:formula_A1.17:zh.inThisChapter: 在扩散理论基础中，此公式由 Chapman-Kolmogorov 方程结合扩散假设（高阶矩可忽略）推导得出，为后续得到 Fokker-Planck 方程（即扩散方程）提供关键中间步骤。

formula-notes:formula_A1.16:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算了扩散过程在短时间δt内位移平方的期望值，其中v(x)是漂移率，m(x)是扩散率，结果仅保留到δt的一阶项，表明二阶矩的贡献被吸收到o(δt)中。
formula-notes:formula_A1.16:zh.inThisChapter: 在扩散理论基础中，该公式用于推导扩散过程的二阶矩性质，为后续建立福克-普朗克方程或随机微分方程的矩条件提供关键步骤。

formula-notes:formula_A1.22:en.plainMeaning: This equation states that at equilibrium, the probability density function φ(x,t,p) does not change with time; its partial derivative with respect to t is zero.
formula-notes:formula_A1.22:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the foundations of diffusion theory to define the equilibrium condition, which is used later to derive the stationary solution of the diffusion equation.

formula-notes:formula_A1.22:zh.plainMeaning: 这个公式表示概率密度函数 φ(x,t,p) 对时间 t 的偏导数为零，即 φ 不随时间变化，对应平衡状态。
formula-notes:formula_A1.22:zh.inThisChapter: 在本章扩散理论基础中，该公式用于定义平衡态条件，为后续推导扩散方程或稳态解提供前提。

formula-notes:formula_A1.20:en.plainMeaning: This formula shows that the limit of a scaled second spatial derivative of a product involving a small time increment δ_t equals the second derivative of v(x) times φ(x,t). Key symbols: δ_t (time increment), v(x) (drift coefficient), φ(x,t) (probability density).
formula-notes:formula_A1.20:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the derivation of the diffusion equation to simplify terms involving o(δ_t) and to connect the discrete-time jump process to the continuous-time Fokker-Planck equation.

formula-notes:formula_A1.21:en.plainMeaning: This is the Kolmogorov forward equation (Fokker-Planck equation) describing the time evolution of the probability density φ(x,t) for a diffusion process with drift m(x) and diffusion coefficient v(x).
formula-notes:formula_A1.21:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the foundations of diffusion theory to formalize how probability density changes over time due to deterministic drift and random diffusion, supporting later derivations of stationary distributions and boundary conditions.

formula-notes:formula_A1.20:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式表明，当时间间隔δt趋近于0时，包含o(δt)高阶无穷小的项在除以δt并取极限后消失，最终将v(x)φ(x,t)对x的二阶偏导数从极限符号中提取出来。
formula-notes:formula_A1.20:zh.inThisChapter: 在扩散理论的推导中，该公式用于简化方程A1.9中的最后两项，从而得到扩散方程的标准形式，为后续建立Fokker-Planck方程奠定基础。

formula-notes:formula_A1.19:en.plainMeaning: This formula shows that in the limit as the time increment δt goes to zero, the derivative of the term involving the drift m(x) and probability density φ(x,t) simplifies to the partial derivative of m(x)φ(x,t) with respect to x, because the higher-order term o(δt) vanishes. Key symbols: δt (time increment), m(x) (drift coefficient), φ(x,t) (probability density).
formula-notes:formula_A1.19:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the derivation of the Fokker-Planck equation from the master equation, specifically to simplify the drift contribution in the continuum limit, supporting the final diffusion equation for the probability density.

formula-notes:formula_A1.18:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式表示当时间增量δt趋近于0时，函数φ(x,t)在时间方向上的差商极限等于其对时间的偏导数，即定义了偏导数∂φ/∂t。
formula-notes:formula_A1.18:zh.inThisChapter: 在扩散理论基础章节中，该公式用于将离散时间步的差分方程转化为连续时间的偏微分方程，为后续推导扩散方程（如Fick第二定律）提供数学基础。

formula-notes:formula_A1.25:en.plainMeaning: This formula expresses the stationary distribution φ(x) as a constant C divided by the product of the infinitesimal variance v(x) and the scale function G(x).
formula-notes:formula_A1.25:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the derivation of the stationary distribution for a diffusion process, supporting later analysis of long-term behavior and ergodicity.

formula-notes:formula_A1.23:en.plainMeaning: This equation expresses a balance between the second derivative of the product of velocity v(x) and concentration φ(x) and the first derivative of the product of mobility m(x) and concentration φ(x), relating diffusion and drift processes.
formula-notes:formula_A1.23:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the derivation of the diffusion equation to show that under certain conditions (Eq. A1.10a), the Fokker-Planck equation simplifies to a first-order differential equation, linking the diffusion flux to the drift term.

formula-notes:formula_A1.23:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式表示，当某条件满足时，函数 v(x) 与 φ(x) 乘积的二阶导数的一半等于 m(x) 与 φ(x) 乘积的一阶导数，其中 v(x) 和 m(x) 是扩散系数和漂移系数，φ(x) 是概率密度或势函数。
formula-notes:formula_A1.23:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在扩散理论基础的推导中，用于从更一般的福克-普朗克方程简化得到一阶微分方程，为后续求解稳态分布或势函数提供关键步骤。

formula-notes:formula_A1.25:zh.plainMeaning: 公式 φ(x) = C / [v(x) G(x)] 给出了扩散过程的平稳分布密度 φ(x)，其中 v(x) 是扩散系数，G(x) 是尺度函数，C 是归一化常数。
formula-notes:formula_A1.25:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在扩散理论基础章节，用于从尺度函数和扩散系数直接构造平稳分布，为后续计算扩散过程的长期行为或首达时间等量提供关键表达式。

formula-notes:formula_A1.24:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式表示对函数 v(x) 与 φ(x) 的乘积求 x 的偏导数，结果等于 2m(x)φ(x)，其中 v(x) 是漂移系数，m(x) 是扩散系数，φ(x) 是概率密度。
formula-notes:formula_A1.24:zh.inThisChapter: 在扩散理论基础章节中，该公式由连续性方程和通量表达式推导而来，用于建立稳态下概率流与扩散系数之间的关系，为后续求解扩散方程或福克-普朗克方程提供简化条件。

formula-notes:formula_A1.24:en.plainMeaning: This formula expresses the derivative of the product of the diffusion coefficient v(x) and the probability density φ(x) with respect to position x, equating it to twice the product of the drift coefficient m(x) and φ(x). It connects the spatial variation of the probability flux to the drift term.
formula-notes:formula_A1.24:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the derivation of the steady-state solution of the Fokker-Planck equation, showing that under certain conditions (Equation A1.10a), the probability current becomes constant, leading to a simple differential equation that can be integrated to find φ(x).

formula-notes:formula_A1.26:zh.plainMeaning: 该方程描述函数 φ(x,t,p) 随时间 t 的变化率，等于扩散系数 v(p) 乘以 φ 对 p 的二阶偏导的一半，加上漂移系数 m(p) 乘以 φ 对 p 的一阶偏导。
formula-notes:formula_A1.26:zh.inThisChapter: 在扩散理论基础章节中，KBE 与 KFE 互补，用于从当前时间向后分析过程，为后续计算固定概率、固定时间等量提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_A1.21:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式是Kolmogorov前向方程（Fokker-Planck方程）的一种形式，它描述了概率密度函数φ(x,t)随时间的变化率等于漂移项（一阶导数项）和扩散项（二阶导数项）的贡献，其中m(x)是漂移系数，v(x)是扩散系数。
formula-notes:formula_A1.21:zh.inThisChapter: 在本章中，该公式从扩散过程的连续极限推导而来，为后续分析随机过程的概率分布演化提供了基础方程，并用于连接微观随机运动与宏观扩散行为。

formula-notes:formula_A1.26:en.plainMeaning: This is the Kolmogorov backward equation (KBE) for the diffusion process, describing how the probability density φ(x,t,p) evolves backward in time with respect to the initial frequency p, where v(p) is the variance and m(p) is the mean rate of change per unit time.
formula-notes:formula_A1.26:en.inThisChapter: It appears in this section to provide a simpler method for computing fixation probabilities and times when no equilibrium exists, supporting later derivations of these quantities using boundary conditions.

formula-notes:formula_A1.27:en.plainMeaning: This equation sets the sum of the drift term (m(p) times the first derivative of u) and the diffusion term (half v(p) times the second derivative of u) to zero, describing the stationary probability of fixation u(p) as a function of initial allele frequency p.
formula-notes:formula_A1.27:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the diffusion applications section to derive the ultimate fixation probability u(p) when boundaries are absorbing, supporting later arguments about fixation probabilities under selection and drift.

formula-notes:formula_A1.27:zh.plainMeaning: 该方程表示固定概率 u(p) 关于初始等位基因频率 p 的漂移项 m(p) 乘以一阶导数与扩散项 1/2 v(p) 乘以二阶导数之和为零，即 u(p) 满足的稳态扩散方程。
formula-notes:formula_A1.27:zh.inThisChapter: 在扩散应用章节中，当边界吸收时无平稳分布，转而关注固定概率。该方程由 Kolmogorov 向后方程在时间趋于无穷时导出，为后续求解 u(p) 的显式表达式提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_A1.28:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the probability u(p) that a diffusion process starting at p reaches a boundary b before a, where G(x) is a function related to the diffusion's infinitesimal variance and mean (defined in Equation A1.12).
formula-notes:formula_A1.28:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on diffusion applications in population genetics to provide a general solution for fixation probabilities, supporting later arguments about allele frequency trajectories under selection and drift.

formula-notes:formula_A1.29:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the probability that a diffusion process starting at p hits boundary b before boundary a, where G(x) is a function related to the diffusion's scale measure.
formula-notes:formula_A1.29:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on diffusion applications in population genetics to provide a general expression for fixation probabilities, supporting later arguments on allele frequency dynamics.

formula-notes:formula_A1.28:zh.plainMeaning: 公式 u(p) 表示扩散过程从初始值 p 出发，在到达边界 b 之前先到达边界 a 的概率，其中分子是 G(x) 从 0 到 p 的积分，分母是 G(x) 从 0 到 1 的积分，G(x) 由方程 A1.12 定义。
formula-notes:formula_A1.28:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在群体遗传学扩散应用的章节中，用于计算等位基因频率在固定（边界 b=1）或丢失（边界 a=0）之前的概率，为后续推导固定概率和平均时间等量提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_A1.31:en.plainMeaning: This formula defines the expected total time that a diffusion process starting at p spends in the vicinity of x before absorption, where φ(x,t,p) is the probability density of being at x at time t given start at p.
formula-notes:formula_A1.31:en.inThisChapter: It appears here to provide a key quantity for analyzing absorption times and fixation probabilities in population genetics, supporting later derivations of expected sojourn times and related quantities.

formula-notes:formula_A1.29:zh.plainMeaning: 公式 u_{b,a}(p) 计算从初始状态 p 出发，在扩散过程中先到达边界 b 而非边界 a 的概率，其中分子是 G(x) 从 a 到 p 的积分，分母是 G(x) 从 a 到 b 的积分。
formula-notes:formula_A1.29:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在种群遗传学扩散应用的章节，用于给出扩散过程在给定初始点 p 时，到达两个边界 a 和 b 的相对概率，为后续分析固定概率或首次到达时间等量提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_A1.30:zh.plainMeaning: 公式计算扩散过程在区间 (a,b) 内停留的期望总时间，其中 φ(x,t,p) 是给定起始频率 p 时 t 时刻过程位于 x 的概率密度，先对 x 在 (a,b) 上积分得到 t 时刻在区间内的概率，再对时间 t 从 0 到无穷积分。
formula-notes:formula_A1.30:zh.inThisChapter: 本节讨论扩散过程在区间内的逗留时间，该公式为后续计算固定时间（吸收边界逗留时间）提供一般框架，通过特化 a,b 为边界值即可导出固定时间。

formula-notes:formula_A1.30:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the expected total time (sojourn time) that a diffusion process starting at frequency p spends in the interval [a, b], by integrating over time the probability that the process is in that interval at each time t.
formula-notes:formula_A1.30:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on diffusion applications in population genetics to quantify the expected time a allele frequency spends in a given range, which is used to study sojourn times and fixation times in genetic models.

formula-notes:formula_A1.31:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式定义函数 h(x,p) 为从初始频率 p 出发的扩散过程，在吸收前停留在频率 x 附近的总期望时间，通过对时间 t 从 0 到无穷积分 φ(x,t,p) 得到，其中 φ(x,t,p) 是 t 时刻过程位于 x 的概率密度。
formula-notes:formula_A1.31:zh.inThisChapter: 在本章中，该公式用于将扩散过程的解（如方程 A1.21）转化为期望占据时间，从而为后续计算固定概率、平均固定时间等种群遗传学量提供基础工具。

formula-notes:formula_A1.32:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式定义了一个平均时间量 \(\bar t_{a,b}\)，它等于函数 \(h(x,p)\) 从 \(a\) 到 \(b\) 的积分，其中 \(x\) 是积分变量，\(p\) 是参数。
formula-notes:formula_A1.32:zh.inThisChapter: 在本章扩散过程应用于群体遗传学的背景下，该公式用于计算等位基因频率从 \(a\) 到 \(b\) 的平均时间，为后续推导固定时间或吸收时间提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_A1.32:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the mean sojourn time (expected time) that a population spends with allele frequency between a and b, given the diffusion coefficient h(x,p) which depends on current frequency x and initial frequency p.
formula-notes:formula_A1.32:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the diffusion applications section to provide a key expression for expected sojourn times, which later supports calculations of fixation probabilities and expected times under selection and drift.

formula-notes:formula_A1.33:en.plainMeaning: This formula defines the Green's function h(x,p) for diffusion processes, where u(p) is the fixation probability, v(x) is the variance, and G(x) is the scale function. It gives the expected sojourn time density at frequency x starting from initial frequency p, with separate expressions for x < p and x > p.
formula-notes:formula_A1.33:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on diffusion applications in population genetics to provide a fundamental tool for solving problems involving expected times and probabilities. The Green's function will be used later to compute quantities such as expected fixation times and allele frequency spectra.

formula-notes:formula_A1.34:en.plainMeaning: This formula defines a modified Green's function h1(x,p) for the conditional process where allele A fixes, by scaling the original Green's function h(x,p) by the ratio of the fixation probabilities u(x) and u(p).
formula-notes:formula_A1.34:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on diffusion applications in population genetics to derive the expected time to fixation t̄F, supporting the analysis of conditional processes that lead only to fixation.

formula-notes:formula_A1.35:en.plainMeaning: This formula gives the conditional expected time until allele A is fixed, given initial frequency p and current frequency x, by adjusting the unconditional expected time h(x,p) with the fixation probability ratio u(x)/u(p).
formula-notes:formula_A1.35:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the diffusion applications section to derive conditional expectations for fixation times, supporting later calculations of expected times to fixation or loss under selection and drift.

formula-notes:formula_A1.36:zh.plainMeaning: 公式将平均等待时间（固定或丢失）表示为固定概率加权的固定平均时间与丢失概率加权的丢失平均时间之和，其中u(p)是固定概率，1-u(p)是丢失概率。
formula-notes:formula_A1.36:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在扩散应用章节，用于将总平均等待时间分解为固定和丢失两种路径的加权平均，为后续计算条件等待时间或比较不同路径提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_A1.33:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式定义了Green函数h(x,p)，它表示在扩散过程中，从初始频率p出发，在固定前访问频率x的期望时间密度。对于a<x<p，h由左侧积分项计算；对于p<x<b，由右侧积分项计算，其中u(p)是固定概率，v(x)和G(x)分别与扩散过程的漂移和扩散系数相关。
formula-notes:formula_A1.33:zh.inThisChapter: 在本章中，Green函数h(x,p)被引入作为求解种群遗传学中各种扩散问题（如固定时间、杂合度等）的核心工具。它通过将问题转化为积分方程，为后续推导期望固定时间等量提供了统一的解析框架。

formula-notes:formula_A1.34:zh.plainMeaning: 公式 h1(x,p)=h(x,p) * u(x)/u(p) 定义了条件过程的修正格林函数，其中 h(x,p) 是原始格林函数，u(x) 和 u(p) 分别是固定概率在状态 x 和初始频率 p 处的值，通过乘以 u(x)/u(p) 将原始过程限制为仅导致固定的样本路径。
formula-notes:formula_A1.34:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在群体遗传学扩散应用的章节中，用于推导条件过程（如仅导致固定）的期望时间，为后续计算固定等位基因A的期望时间 t̄_F 提供修正的格林函数。

formula-notes:formula_A1.35:zh.plainMeaning: 公式 h0(x,p)=h(x,p)*(1-u(x))/(1-u(p)) 计算在等位基因 A 最终丢失的条件下，扩散过程从初始频率 p 到频率 x 的转移密度，其中 h(x,p) 是无条件转移密度，u(x) 和 u(p) 分别是固定概率。
formula-notes:formula_A1.35:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在讨论扩散过程在群体遗传学中的应用时，用于推导条件期望时间，如等位基因丢失的期望时间 t̄_L，通过替换 h(x,p) 得到条件转移密度。

formula-notes:formula_A1.36:en.plainMeaning: This formula expresses the overall expected time to either loss or fixation, \(\bar{t}(p)\), as a weighted average of the expected time to fixation \(\bar{t}_F(p)\) and the expected time to loss \(\bar{t}_L(p)\), with weights given by the probability of fixation \(u(p)\) and the probability of loss \(1-u(p)\), respectively.
formula-notes:formula_A1.36:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on diffusion applications in population genetics to decompose the total expected sojourn time into contributions from the fixation and loss pathways, supporting later analyses of allele dynamics under selection and drift.

formula-notes:formula_A1.37:en.plainMeaning: The formula defines the function h0(x,p) as a piecewise expression for the expected conditional fixation time, where x is the current frequency of allele A, p is the initial frequency, and Ne is the effective population size.
formula-notes:formula_A1.37:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the Appendix to provide the explicit form of h0(x,p) used in Equations A1.23a and A1.23b for computing conditional fixation times, supporting the derivation of expected times to loss and fixation.

formula-notes:formula_A1.37:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式给出了条件平均固定时间 h₀(x,p) 的表达式，其中 x 为初始频率，p 为平衡频率，Nₑ 为有效种群大小；当 0
formula-notes:formula_A1.37:zh.inThisChapter: 在附录中，该公式由方程 A1.22b 积分得到，用于计算条件固定时间，为后续推导条件固定时间（如公式 A1.38 和 A1.39）提供具体表达式。

formula-notes:formula_A1.39:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the expected conditional fixation time \(\bar{t}_{L}(p)\) for a mutant allele starting at frequency \(p\) to become fixed, given that fixation occurs. Key symbols: \(N_e\) = effective population size, \(p\) = initial frequency.
formula-notes:formula_A1.39:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the appendix to derive the conditional fixation time from the diffusion approximation, supporting later arguments on the time scale of fixation under selection and drift.

formula-notes:formula_A1.38:en.plainMeaning: This formula defines the function h1(x,p) as (x/p) times h(x,p), giving a piecewise expression for the conditional expected sojourn time in state x given initial frequency p, where Ne is effective population size, p is initial frequency, and x is current frequency.
formula-notes:formula_A1.38:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the Appendix to provide the integrand for computing conditional fixation times via Equations A1.23a and A1.23b, supporting the derivation of expected times to loss and fixation.

formula-notes:formula_A1.38:zh.plainMeaning: 公式 h1(x,p) 表示从初始频率 x 出发，在固定概率 h(x,p) 的基础上乘以 x/p，从而得到条件于最终丢失（即等位基因频率降至 0）的固定时间计算中所需的量。其中 Ne 为有效群体大小，p 为初始频率，x 为当前频率。
formula-notes:formula_A1.38:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在附录中，用于推导条件固定时间（条件于丢失或固定）。它通过将 h(x,p) 乘以 x/p 来调整路径权重，为后续积分得到条件丢失时间提供被积函数。

formula-notes:formula_A1.40:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算在Moran过程中，给定突变初始频率p时，突变最终被固定（而非丢失）的条件平均时间t̄_F(p)。关键符号：N_e为有效种群大小，p为初始突变频率，积分结果包含对数项-ln(1-p)。
formula-notes:formula_A1.40:zh.inThisChapter: 此处通过积分公式A1.22b得到条件固定时间，为后续比较固定与丢失时间、分析选择压力对固定时间的影响提供具体表达式。

formula-notes:formula_A1.42:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式给出了中性等位基因频率p=1/(2N)时，(1-p)/p和p/(1-p)的近似值：前者约等于1/p=2N，后者约等于p=1/(2N)。
formula-notes:formula_A1.42:zh.inThisChapter: 在附录引言中，该公式用于简化中性等位基因单拷贝引入时的概率表达式，为后续推导固定概率或扩散近似提供简洁形式。

formula-notes:formula_A1.39:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算在Moran过程中，给定初始突变频率p时，突变等位基因最终丢失的平均时间t̄_L(p)。关键符号：N_e为有效种群大小，p为初始频率，积分结果简化为-4N_e [p/(1-p)] ln(p)。
formula-notes:formula_A1.39:zh.inThisChapter: 此公式出现在附录推导中，用于给出条件固定时间的显式表达式，为后续分析突变固定或丢失的时间尺度提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_A1.40:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the expected conditional fixation time \(\bar{t}_F(p)\) for a mutant starting at frequency \(p\), given that it ultimately fixes. It integrates the function \(h_1(x,p)\) over \(x\) from 0 to 1, resulting in an expression involving effective population size \(N_e\), initial frequency \(p\), and a logarithmic term.
formula-notes:formula_A1.40:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the Appendix to derive the conditional fixation time from the general diffusion equation (A1.22b), supporting the analysis of fixation dynamics under selection and drift.

formula-notes:formula_A1.41:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the average fixation time of a neutral allele in a population of effective size Ne, given initial frequency p. It is the weighted average of fixation times conditional on fixation (t_F) and loss (t_L), and simplifies to -4Ne[(1-p)ln(1-p)+p ln(p)].
formula-notes:formula_A1.41:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the appendix to derive the unconditional mean fixation time from conditional times, serving as a consistency check with earlier results (Equation A1.24) and confirming the expression for the unconditional time t.

formula-notes:formula_A1.43:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将中性等位基因的初始频率 p=1/(2N) 代入对数近似，得到 ln(1-p) ≈ -p = -1/(2N) 以及 ln(p) = -ln(2N)，从而将概率的对数表达为种群大小 N 的简单函数。
formula-notes:formula_A1.43:zh.inThisChapter: 在附录引言中，此公式用于简化中性等位基因固定概率的对数形式，为后续推导固定时间或扩散近似中的关键表达式提供代数基础。

formula-notes:formula_A1.42:en.plainMeaning: This formula approximates the fixation probability ratio for a neutral allele: (1-p)/p ≈ 1/p = 2N and p/(1-p) ≈ p = 1/(2N), where p is the initial frequency and N is the population size.
formula-notes:formula_A1.42:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the appendix to derive simplified expressions for the fixation probability of a neutral mutation, supporting later arguments about allele frequency dynamics under neutrality.

formula-notes:formula_A1.41:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算平均固定时间 \(\bar{t}\)，它是条件固定时间 \(\bar{t}_{F}(p)\) 和条件丢失时间 \(\bar{t}_{L}(p)\) 以固定概率 \(u(p)\) 为权重的加权平均，最终简化为 \(-4N_e[(1-p)\ln(1-p)+p\ln p]\)，其中 \(p\) 为初始频率，\(N_e\) 为有效群体大小。
formula-notes:formula_A1.41:zh.inThisChapter: 此处作为附录引言，通过将加权平均公式与无条件固定时间表达式（公式 A1.25）对比，验证 Kimura 和 Ohta 结果的内部一致性，并为后续推导提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_A1.43:en.plainMeaning: This formula approximates the natural logarithm of (1-p) as -p = -1/(2N) and the logarithm of p as -ln(2N), where p = 1/(2N) is the initial frequency of a neutral allele in a diploid population of size N.
formula-notes:formula_A1.43:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the Appendix to derive convenient approximations for the fixation probability of a neutral allele, supporting later calculations of allele frequency dynamics under drift.

formula-notes:formula_A1.44:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算平均固定时间 t̄，它等于 -4Nₑ 乘以熵项 [(1-p)ln(1-p) + p ln(p)]，然后利用 p=1/(2N) 近似展开，最终得到 t̄ ≈ (2Nₑ/N) ln(2N)，其中 Nₑ 是有效种群大小，N 是实际种群大小。
formula-notes:formula_A1.44:zh.inThisChapter: 在附录引言中，该公式从方程 A1.25 简化而来，用于给出中性等位基因在有限种群中固定时间的近似表达式，为后续讨论有效种群大小与固定时间的关系提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_A1.45:en.plainMeaning: This formula gives the expected time to loss of a neutral allele in a population, where \(\bar{t}_{L}\) is the mean time to loss, \(N_e\) is the effective population size, \(p\) is the initial frequency, and \(N\) is the census population size. The approximation holds for small \(p\).
formula-notes:formula_A1.45:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the appendix introduction to provide a key result for coalescent theory, supporting later derivations of expected coalescence times and the relationship between effective and census population sizes.

formula-notes:formula_A1.47:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式定义了沿着扩散过程样本路径对函数 f(x_t) 从时间 0 到无穷的积分 I_f(p)，其中 x_t 是区间 (0,1) 内的随机变量，p 是初始值。
formula-notes:formula_A1.47:zh.inThisChapter: 在群体遗传学的扩散应用中，该积分用于计算沿样本路径的期望值，为后续推导更复杂函数（如固定概率、驻留时间）的期望奠定基础。

formula-notes:formula_A1.44:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the expected coalescence time (in generations) for a sample of two alleles under a model with selection, where p is the frequency of the favored allele. The symbols are: t̄ (mean coalescence time), Nₑ (effective population size), N (census population size), and p (allele frequency).
formula-notes:formula_A1.44:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the Appendix Introduction to show how the general coalescent time formula simplifies under the assumption of strong selection and large population size, supporting later derivations of coalescent times under selection.

formula-notes:formula_A1.46:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算在特定近似下（p=1/(2N)）的固定时间t_F，其中N_e为有效群体大小，p为等位基因频率，结果简化为4N_e。
formula-notes:formula_A1.46:zh.inThisChapter: 出现在附录引言中，用于推导固定时间的近似表达式，为后续章节中基于扩散近似的固定时间公式提供简化形式。

formula-notes:formula_A1.47:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the total integral over all time of a function f of the diffusion process x_t, representing the cumulative effect of f along a sample path.
formula-notes:formula_A1.47:en.inThisChapter: It appears here to generalize the concept of sojourn times to arbitrary functions, enabling the calculation of more complex expected values in population genetics models.

formula-notes:formula_A1.45:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式给出了在选择性清除（selective sweep）后，等位基因频率从初始频率p上升到接近1所需的平均时间（以世代为单位），其中Ne为有效种群大小，N为实际种群大小，p为初始频率。
formula-notes:formula_A1.45:zh.inThisChapter: 在附录引言中，该公式用于量化选择性清除过程中有利突变固定所需的时间尺度，为后续推导其他种群遗传学量（如连锁不平衡衰减）提供时间基准。

formula-notes:formula_A1.46:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the average fixation time of a neutral allele in a diploid population, where N_e is the effective population size, p is the initial allele frequency, and N is the census population size. The approximation uses p = 1/(2N) for a new mutation.
formula-notes:formula_A1.46:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the Appendix to derive the classic result that the average fixation time for a neutral mutation is 4N_e generations, supporting later discussions on molecular evolution and coalescent theory.

formula-notes:formula_A1.48:zh.plainMeaning: 这个公式计算的是随机积分 I_f(p) 的期望值，其中 f(x) 是被积函数，φ(x,t,p) 是给定起始频率 p 时，t 时刻等位基因频率 x 的概率密度函数。
formula-notes:formula_A1.48:zh.inThisChapter: 在群体遗传学的扩散应用中，该公式用于将随机过程的期望转化为确定性积分，为后续推导固定概率、平均时间等量奠定基础。

formula-notes:formula_A1.50:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式定义了布朗运动（维纳过程）的无穷小均值为常数 a，无穷小方差为常数 b，即漂移参数和扩散参数。
formula-notes:formula_A1.50:zh.inThisChapter: 在定量遗传学应用中，该公式为后续推导布朗运动下 x_t 的分布（均值为 x_0+at，方差为 bt）提供了基础，并说明无平衡解的原因。

formula-notes:formula_A1.49:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the expected value of the integral of a function f(x) with respect to the Green's function h(x,p), where p is the initial frequency and x is the frequency variable.
formula-notes:formula_A1.49:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the context of solving diffusion equations in population genetics, allowing the expectation of functionals of the allele frequency to be expressed without solving for the transition density directly.

formula-notes:formula_A1.49:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式表示在给定初始频率p时，函数f(x)的期望值E[If(p)]等于f(x)与h(x,p)的乘积在[0,1]上的积分，其中h(x,p)是扩散过程的格林函数。
formula-notes:formula_A1.49:zh.inThisChapter: 此处利用格林函数h(x,p)将期望值表示为积分形式，从而避免直接求解复杂的时变概率密度φ(x,t,p)，为后续计算固定时间或固定频率的期望值提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_A1.50:en.plainMeaning: This formula defines the constant infinitesimal mean m(x)=a and constant infinitesimal variance v(x)=b for a Brownian motion (Wiener process), where a is the drift parameter and b is the diffusion coefficient.
formula-notes:formula_A1.50:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the quantitative genetics section to model the continuous diffusion of a quantitative trait under random genetic drift and selection, supporting the result that the trait distribution becomes normal with mean x0+at and variance bt.

formula-notes:formula_A1.52:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式给出了Ornstein-Uhlenbeck过程的漂移系数m(x) = -ax和扩散系数v(x) = b，其中a > 0控制回复力强度，b > 0控制随机波动幅度。
formula-notes:formula_A1.52:zh.inThisChapter: 在定量遗传学应用中，该公式定义了具有线性回复力的扩散过程，为后续推导x_t的条件正态分布（均值与方差随时间变化）提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_A1.48:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the expected value of the integral I_f(p) = ∫_0^∞ f(x_t) dt, where x_t is a diffusion process starting at p. The expectation is expressed as a double integral over time t and space x of f(x) times the transition density φ(x,t,p).
formula-notes:formula_A1.48:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on diffusion applications in population genetics to derive the expected value of a function of the sample path, which is used later to compute quantities like fixation probabilities or expected allele frequency trajectories.

formula-notes:formula_A1.51:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式表示在布朗运动（维纳过程）中，时刻t的位置x_t服从均值为x_0+at、方差为bt的正态分布，其中a是漂移参数，b是扩散系数。
formula-notes:formula_A1.51:zh.inThisChapter: 在数量遗传学应用章节中，该公式用于描述等位基因频率在随机遗传漂变和选择作用下的概率分布，为后续推导有限种群中基因频率的扩散近似奠定基础。

formula-notes:formula_A1.52:en.plainMeaning: The formula defines the infinitesimal mean m(x) = -a x (linear restoring force toward zero) and infinitesimal variance v(x) = b (constant) for the Ornstein-Uhlenbeck process, where a and b are positive constants and x is the state variable.
formula-notes:formula_A1.52:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on quantitative genetics to introduce the Ornstein-Uhlenbeck process as a model for traits under stabilizing selection, supporting later derivation of the normal distribution with time-dependent mean and variance.

formula-notes:formula_A1.53:en.plainMeaning: This formula gives the mean (μ_t) and variance (σ_t^2) of the Ornstein-Uhlenbeck process at time t, starting from x_0, with parameters a (strength of restoring force) and b (diffusion coefficient).
formula-notes:formula_A1.53:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the quantitative genetics section to model trait evolution under stabilizing selection, where the mean decays exponentially to an optimum and variance approaches a stationary value, supporting later arguments about equilibrium genetic variance.

formula-notes:formula_A1.51:en.plainMeaning: This formula states that the position x_t at time t follows a normal distribution with mean x_0 + a t and variance b t, where a is the drift rate and b is the diffusion coefficient.
formula-notes:formula_A1.51:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on quantitative genetics to model the evolution of a quantitative trait under Brownian motion, providing the basis for phylogenetic comparative methods that assume traits evolve via random drift with a constant rate.

formula-notes:formula_A2.2:en.plainMeaning: This formula expresses the joint probability of x and θ as the product of the conditional probability of x given θ and the marginal probability of θ.
formula-notes:formula_A2.2:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to Bayes' theorem to derive the posterior distribution, which is the core of Bayesian inference.

formula-notes:formula_A2.1:en.plainMeaning: Bayes' theorem computes the posterior probability of θ given x as the joint probability of x and θ divided by the marginal probability of x.
formula-notes:formula_A2.1:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the Appendix introduction to establish the fundamental formula of Bayesian inference, which is used throughout the book to update beliefs about θ after observing data x.

formula-notes:formula_A2.3:en.plainMeaning: Bayes' theorem computes the posterior probability Pr(θ|x) of parameter θ given data x, as the normalized product of the likelihood Pr(x|θ) and the prior Pr(θ) divided by the marginal likelihood Pr(x).
formula-notes:formula_A2.3:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the Appendix Introduction to state the fundamental formula for Bayesian inference, which underpins all subsequent derivations and applications in the chapter.

formula-notes:formula_A1.54:zh.plainMeaning: 公式 μ_t = θ + (x_0 - θ)e^{-at} 描述了在定向力 m(x) = -a(x - θ) 作用下，群体均值 μ_t 随时间 t 从初始值 x_0 指数衰减到平衡值 θ 的过程，其中 a 是恢复力强度。
formula-notes:formula_A1.54:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在定量遗传学应用中，用于展示当选择或突变等力使群体均值趋向最优值 θ 时，均值随时间变化的确定性轨迹，为后续讨论平稳分布（均值为 θ，方差为 b/(2a)）提供动态基础。

formula-notes:formula_A1.53:zh.plainMeaning: 公式给出了Ornstein-Uhlenbeck过程中，给定初始值x₀时，t时刻状态xₜ的均值μₜ和方差σₜ²。均值以指数衰减方式趋向0，方差从0开始逐渐趋近于b/(2a)。
formula-notes:formula_A1.53:zh.inThisChapter: 在定量遗传学应用中，该公式描述了受选择或稳定化选择影响下性状均值和方差的动态变化，为后续推导平衡方差和响应选择等结论提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_A2.1:zh.plainMeaning: 这个公式是贝叶斯定理，它通过条件概率将后验概率 Pr(θ|x) 表示为联合概率 Pr(x,θ) 与边际概率 Pr(x) 的比值，从而将关于 θ 的推断从观测数据 x 中更新。
formula-notes:formula_A2.1:zh.inThisChapter: 在附录引言中，该公式从条件概率定义出发，为后续推导贝叶斯统计中通过先验和似然计算后验的完整形式（如公式 A2.2）奠定基础。

formula-notes:formula_A2.3:zh.plainMeaning: 这个公式（贝叶斯定理）计算在观察到数据 x 后，参数 θ 的后验概率 Pr(θ|x)，它等于似然 Pr(x|θ) 乘以先验 Pr(θ) 再除以边缘概率 Pr(x)。
formula-notes:formula_A2.3:zh.inThisChapter: 出现在附录引言中，作为贝叶斯统计的核心公式，为后续推导后验分布、进行贝叶斯推断提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_A1.54:en.plainMeaning: This formula gives the mean trait value μ_t at time t, starting from initial value x_0, under a restoring force pulling toward θ with strength a. The mean decays exponentially from x_0 to θ.
formula-notes:formula_A1.54:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the quantitative genetics section to model the deterministic dynamics of the mean under stabilizing selection, supporting later derivation of the stationary normal distribution with mean θ and variance b/(2a).

formula-notes:formula_A2.2:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将联合概率 Pr(x,θ) 分解为条件概率 Pr(x|θ) 与边缘概率 Pr(θ) 的乘积，其中 x 是观测数据，θ 是参数。
formula-notes:formula_A2.2:zh.inThisChapter: 在附录贝叶斯统计基础中，该公式从条件概率定义出发，为后续推导贝叶斯定理（公式 A2.3）提供关键步骤，即通过联合概率的两种分解建立后验概率表达式。

formula-notes:formula_A2.4:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算在观测到数据 x 后，参数 θ 取第 j 个值的后验概率 Pr(θ_j | x)，等于似然 Pr(x | θ_j) 乘以先验 Pr(θ_j) 再除以所有可能 θ_i 下似然与先验乘积之和（即边际概率 Pr(x)）。
formula-notes:formula_A2.4:zh.inThisChapter: 作为附录的贝叶斯定理离散形式，它展示了如何从先验概率和似然函数更新得到后验概率，为后续章节中连续参数空间的贝叶斯推断提供基础框架。

formula-notes:formula_A2.4:en.plainMeaning: Bayes' theorem computes the posterior probability of a parameter value θⱼ given observed data x, using the likelihood Pr(x|θⱼ) and prior Pr(θⱼ), normalized by the marginal probability Pr(x) (summed over all k possible θ values).
formula-notes:formula_A2.4:en.inThisChapter: This formula introduces the discrete form of Bayes' theorem in the appendix, providing the foundational tool for updating beliefs about θ based on data, which supports later Bayesian inference arguments in the chapter.

formula-notes:formula_A2.5:en.plainMeaning: Bayes' theorem for continuous multivariate variables: the posterior density p(Θ|x) equals the likelihood p(x|Θ) times the prior p(Θ) divided by the marginal likelihood p(x) (the integral of the joint density over Θ).
formula-notes:formula_A2.5:en.inThisChapter: It extends Bayes' theorem to continuous parameter vectors, forming the foundation for Bayesian inference in the appendix and later chapters.

formula-notes:formula_A2.6:en.plainMeaning: Bayes' theorem expresses the posterior distribution p(Θ|x) as proportional to the likelihood p(x|Θ) times the prior p(Θ), normalized by the marginal likelihood p(x).
formula-notes:formula_A2.6:en.inThisChapter: This formula introduces the core Bayesian update rule, enabling the transition from likelihood-based inference to posterior inference, which is foundational for the Bayesian analyses developed later in the appendix.

formula-notes:formula_A2.7:en.plainMeaning: This formula expresses the posterior distribution as proportional to the product of the likelihood and the prior, where the normalizing constant ensures the posterior integrates to 1. Key symbols: p(Θ) is the prior, p(x|Θ) is the likelihood, and the constant is 1/p(x).
formula-notes:formula_A2.7:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the Appendix Introduction to formally state Bayes' theorem for parameter inference, supporting the transition from likelihood-based methods to Bayesian analysis in later sections.

formula-notes:formula_A2.6:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式是贝叶斯定理，将后验分布 p(Θ|x) 表示为似然函数 p(x|Θ) 与先验分布 p(Θ) 的乘积除以边缘似然 p(x)，其中 p(x) 是归一化常数。
formula-notes:formula_A2.6:zh.inThisChapter: 此处从似然过渡到贝叶斯分析，公式展示了如何通过先验和似然得到后验，为后续将后验写作正比于似然乘先验（省略归一化常数）做铺垫。

formula-notes:formula_A2.7:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式表示后验分布正比于似然函数 p(x|Θ) 与先验分布 p(Θ) 的乘积，其中归一化常数 1/p(x) 确保后验积分为 1。
formula-notes:formula_A2.7:zh.inThisChapter: 在附录引言中，此公式从贝叶斯定理出发，将后验分布表达为似然与先验的乘积（忽略归一化常数），为后续推导具体的后验分布形式（如公式 A2.8）提供简洁的表达式。

formula-notes:formula_A2.9:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式表示后验分布 p(Θ|x) 正比于似然函数 ℓ(Θ|x) 与先验分布 p(Θ) 的乘积，其中 Θ 是参数向量，x 是观测数据。
formula-notes:formula_A2.9:zh.inThisChapter: 此处从贝叶斯定理出发，忽略归一化常数 p(x)，将后验简化为似然与先验的乘积形式，为后续贝叶斯推断（如最大后验估计）提供基础表达式。

formula-notes:formula_A2.8:en.plainMeaning: The formula states that the posterior distribution is proportional to the product of the likelihood function and the prior distribution, up to a normalizing constant. Key symbols: likelihood (ℓ(Θ|x) or p(x|Θ)), prior (p(Θ)), and constant (1/p(x)).
formula-notes:formula_A2.8:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the Appendix introduction to show how Bayes' theorem simplifies to a proportional relationship, setting up the foundation for Bayesian inference used in later chapters.

formula-notes:formula_A2.5:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式是贝叶斯定理的连续多变量版本，计算在给定数据x后参数向量Θ的后验概率密度p(Θ|x)，等于似然p(x|Θ)乘先验p(Θ)再除以边际似然p(x)（即分母对Θ的积分）。
formula-notes:formula_A2.5:zh.inThisChapter: 在附录引言中，该公式将离散贝叶斯定理推广到连续多变量情形，为后续章节中使用先验和似然推导后验分布提供基础工具。

formula-notes:formula_A2.8:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式表示后验分布正比于似然函数与先验分布的乘积，其中“constant”是归一化常数（即证据的倒数），确保后验积分为1。
formula-notes:formula_A2.8:zh.inThisChapter: 在附录引言中，此公式用于从似然函数过渡到贝叶斯分析，展示后验分布如何通过结合先验与数据（似然）得到，为后续贝叶斯推断奠定基础。

formula-notes:formula_A2.9:en.plainMeaning: The posterior distribution of parameters Θ given data x is proportional to the product of the likelihood ℓ(Θ|x) and the prior p(Θ).
formula-notes:formula_A2.9:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the Appendix introduction to show how Bayes' theorem yields the posterior, which is the foundation for Bayesian inference used throughout the book.

formula-notes:formula_A2.10:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the marginal likelihood (or evidence) \(p(\mathbf{x})\) by integrating the product of the likelihood \(p(\mathbf{x} \mid  oldsymbol{\Theta})\) and the prior \(p( oldsymbol{\Theta})\) over all possible parameter values \( oldsymbol{\Theta}\).
formula-notes:formula_A2.10:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the Appendix Introduction to define the normalizing constant needed for Bayes' theorem, enabling the transition from likelihood to posterior distribution in Bayesian analysis.

formula-notes:formula_A2.10:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算边际似然（证据）p(x)，通过对参数Θ的联合分布p(x|Θ)p(Θ)积分得到，其中p(Θ)是先验分布，p(x|Θ)是似然函数。
formula-notes:formula_A2.10:zh.inThisChapter: 它出现在附录引言中，用于从似然过渡到贝叶斯分析，为后续推导后验分布p(Θ|x)∝p(x|Θ)p(Θ)提供归一化常数p(x)。

formula-notes:formula_A2.12:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the marginal posterior distribution of the variance σ² by integrating the joint posterior distribution p(μ, σ² | x) over the mean μ, thereby removing μ as a nuisance parameter.
formula-notes:formula_A2.12:en.inThisChapter: It appears in this section to illustrate the Bayesian method of handling nuisance parameters by marginalization, supporting the argument that Bayesian analysis fully accounts for uncertainty from nuisance parameters when making inferences about parameters of interest.

formula-notes:formula_A2.13:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the marginal posterior distribution of the parameters of interest Θ₁ by integrating the joint posterior p(Θ₁, Θₙᵤ | y) over the nuisance parameters Θₙᵤ.
formula-notes:formula_A2.13:en.inThisChapter: It appears in this section to show how to eliminate nuisance parameters via marginalization, supporting later Bayesian inference focused solely on Θ₁.

formula-notes:formula_A2.11:en.plainMeaning: This formula expresses the log posterior as the sum of the log likelihood and log prior plus a constant, showing how the posterior combines prior information and data evidence.
formula-notes:formula_A2.11:en.inThisChapter: It appears here to demonstrate that the posterior's dependence on the prior reflects data informativeness, supporting the argument that a flat likelihood leads to strong prior influence while a peaked likelihood makes the prior negligible.

formula-notes:formula_A2.11:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将后验概率的对数分解为似然函数的对数、先验概率的对数以及一个常数项之和，其中后验概率正比于似然乘以先验。
formula-notes:formula_A2.11:zh.inThisChapter: 在此附录引言中，该公式用于展示对数变换后后验与先验、似然的关系，从而便于后续讨论先验对后验的影响程度，以及数据信息量（似然曲面曲率）的评估。

formula-notes:formula_A2.15:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算后验分布下参数θ的条件期望，即用后验概率密度p(θ|x)对θ加权积分，得到θ的贝叶斯估计量。
formula-notes:formula_A2.15:zh.inThisChapter: 在附录引言中，此公式给出贝叶斯点估计的常用方法，为后续推导具体模型下的后验期望奠定基础。

formula-notes:formula_A2.12:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式表示方差σ²的后验分布等于对联合后验分布p(μ,σ²|x)关于均值μ积分得到的边缘后验分布，其中μ被视为 nuisance parameter。
formula-notes:formula_A2.12:zh.inThisChapter: 本节介绍贝叶斯分析中处理 nuisance parameters 的方法，该公式展示了如何通过积分将 nuisance parameter μ 边缘化，从而得到仅关注参数σ²的后验分布，为后续推导方差的后验推断提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_A2.15:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the posterior mean of the parameter vector θ given observed data x, where E[θ|x] is the expectation of θ under the posterior distribution p(θ|x).
formula-notes:formula_A2.15:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the Appendix Introduction to define the Bayesian estimator as the posterior mean, which is a common point estimate used in later chapters for inference and decision-making.

formula-notes:formula_A2.13:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式通过对联合后验分布 p(Θ₁, Θₙᵤ | y) 中的 nuisance 参数 Θₙᵤ 积分，得到参数 Θ₁ 的边缘后验分布 p(Θ₁ | y)。
formula-notes:formula_A2.13:zh.inThisChapter: 在从似然到贝叶斯分析的章节中，该公式展示了如何通过积分消除 nuisance 参数，从而聚焦于感兴趣的参数 Θ₁ 的后验推断，为后续推导边缘后验的解析或数值计算奠定基础。

formula-notes:formula_A2.14:en.plainMeaning: This formula defines the Bayesian point estimator known as the maximum a posteriori (MAP) estimator, which selects the value of θ that maximizes the posterior distribution p(θ|x).
formula-notes:formula_A2.14:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to illustrate a Bayesian alternative to classical maximum likelihood estimation, supporting later arguments for using posterior modes as point estimates.

formula-notes:formula_A2.14:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算后验分布 p(θ|x) 取最大值时对应的参数 θ，即后验众数（MAP 估计），其中 θ 是未知参数，x 是观测数据。
formula-notes:formula_A2.14:zh.inThisChapter: 在附录介绍中，该公式承接经典统计学的点估计思路，给出贝叶斯框架下的一种点估计方法——后验众数估计，为后续比较不同贝叶斯估计量（如后验均值、中位数）提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_A2.17:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式表示后验分布 p(θ|x) 在区间 (L_{α/2}, H_{α/2}) 上的积分等于 1-α，即该区间覆盖了后验分布的 1-α 概率质量。
formula-notes:formula_A2.17:zh.inThisChapter: 在本节中，该公式用于定义后验置信区间（可信区间），说明如何从后验分布中构造区间估计，为后续讨论区间选择（如最高后验密度区间）提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_A2.19:en.plainMeaning: This formula defines the posterior probabilities p0 and p1 that the parameter θ belongs to the null hypothesis set Θ0 or the alternative hypothesis set Θ1, respectively, given the observed data x.
formula-notes:formula_A2.19:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on summarizing the posterior distribution to formalize Bayesian hypothesis testing, showing how prior probabilities are updated to posterior probabilities, which are then used to compute posterior odds for comparing hypotheses.

formula-notes:formula_A2.18:en.plainMeaning: These formulas compute the posterior probability that the parameter θ exceeds a threshold θ₀, or lies between θ₀ and θ₁, by integrating the posterior density p(θ|x) over the specified interval.
formula-notes:formula_A2.18:en.inThisChapter: They appear in the section on summarizing the posterior distribution to show how Bayesian inference directly provides probabilistic statements about θ, analogous to frequentist p-values but based on the posterior distribution.

formula-notes:formula_A2.17:en.plainMeaning: This formula defines a Bayesian credible interval: the posterior probability that the parameter θ lies between L_α/2 and H_α/2 equals 1-α, where L_α/2 and H_α/2 are the lower and upper quantiles of the posterior distribution p(θ|x).
formula-notes:formula_A2.17:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on summarizing the posterior distribution to show how to construct a credible interval directly from the posterior, providing a Bayesian analog to frequentist confidence intervals.

formula-notes:formula_A2.16:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式表示后验分布的中位数估计量 \(\widehat{\theta}\) 将后验概率密度函数从负无穷到正无穷的积分等分为两部分，每部分面积均为 1/2，即 \(\theta\) 大于或小于 \(\widehat{\theta}\) 的后验概率各为 0.5。
formula-notes:formula_A2.16:zh.inThisChapter: 在附录引言中，此公式用于定义后验中位数作为点估计量，强调其相对于后验均值对异常值更稳健，并为后续讨论不同点估计（如均值、众数）的性质提供对比基础。

formula-notes:formula_A2.20:en.plainMeaning: This formula defines the prior probabilities π0 and π1 that the parameter θ lies in the null hypothesis set Θ0 or the alternative hypothesis set Θ1, respectively.
formula-notes:formula_A2.20:en.inThisChapter: It appears here to formalize how prior beliefs about hypotheses are quantified, which is then used to compute prior odds and compare with posterior odds in Bayesian hypothesis testing.

formula-notes:formula_A2.18:zh.plainMeaning: 第一个公式计算后验分布中参数θ大于某个阈值θ₀的概率，即对后验密度从θ₀到无穷积分；第二个公式计算θ落在区间(θ₀, θ₁)内的概率，即对后验密度从θ₀到θ₁积分。
formula-notes:formula_A2.18:zh.inThisChapter: 本节讨论如何总结后验分布，这两个公式直接给出了贝叶斯框架下进行假设检验和区间估计的概率计算方式，替代了频率学派p值的作用。

formula-notes:formula_A2.16:en.plainMeaning: This formula states that the posterior median \(\widehat{\theta}\) splits the posterior distribution into two equal halves, each with probability 0.5. The integrals from \(\widehat{\theta}\) to \(+\infty\) and from \(-\infty\) to \(\widehat{\theta}\) both equal 1/2.
formula-notes:formula_A2.16:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the Appendix introduction to define the posterior median as a robust point estimator, supporting later arguments that the median is less sensitive to outliers than the mean.

formula-notes:formula_A2.19:zh.plainMeaning: 这个公式定义了在给定观测数据 x 后，参数 θ 属于零假设集合 Θ₀ 的后验概率 p₀，以及属于备择假设集合 Θ₁ 的后验概率 p₁。
formula-notes:formula_A2.19:zh.inThisChapter: 本节介绍贝叶斯假设检验，公式 A2.19 给出了后验概率的定义，为后续计算后验优势比 p₀/p₁ 以及比较先验优势比 π₀/π₁ 提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_A2.20:zh.plainMeaning: 公式定义了先验概率 π₀ 和 π₁，分别表示参数 θ 属于零假设集合 Θ₀ 和备择假设集合 Θ₁ 的先验概率。
formula-notes:formula_A2.20:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在贝叶斯假设检验的引入部分，用于定义先验概率，为后续计算先验优势比 π₀/π₁ 以及比较先验与后验优势比提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_A2.21:en.plainMeaning: The Bayes factor B0 is the ratio of posterior odds (p0/p1) to prior odds (π0/π1), equivalently (p0 π1)/(p1 π0), quantifying evidence for H0 vs H1.
formula-notes:formula_A2.21:en.inThisChapter: This formula appears in the section summarizing the posterior distribution to show how prior odds are updated to posterior odds via the Bayes factor, supporting Bayesian inference.

formula-notes:formula_A2.21:zh.plainMeaning: 公式A2.21计算的是贝叶斯因子B0，它等于后验几率(p0/p1)除以先验几率(π0/π1)，即(p0π1)/(p1π0)，用于量化数据支持H0相对于H1的证据强度。
formula-notes:formula_A2.21:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在总结后验分布部分，基于公式A2.20定义的先验概率π0和π1，将后验几率与先验几率联系起来，为后续通过贝叶斯因子进行假设检验比较提供核心计算工具。

formula-notes:formula_A2.22:zh.plainMeaning: 公式A2.22计算了贝叶斯因子B0，它等于先验优势比π0/(1-π0)与后验优势比p0/(1-p0)的比值，其中π0是H0的先验概率，p0是H0的后验概率。
formula-notes:formula_A2.22:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在“总结后验分布”一节中，用于将贝叶斯因子表达为先验优势比与后验优势比的比值，从而更直观地展示数据如何更新对H0的信念。

formula-notes:formula_A2.23:en.plainMeaning: This formula expresses that the posterior probability of a simple hypothesis (θ_i) is proportional to its prior probability π_i times the likelihood p(x|θ_i). For i=0,1, it connects prior beliefs and data to posterior probabilities.
formula-notes:formula_A2.23:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on summarizing the posterior distribution to show how posterior probabilities are computed for simple hypotheses, supporting later arguments about Bayesian hypothesis testing and model comparison.

formula-notes:formula_A2.25:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the Bayes factor B0, which is the ratio of the likelihood of the data x under the null hypothesis (θ0) to the likelihood under the alternative hypothesis (θ1).
formula-notes:formula_A2.25:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on summarizing the posterior distribution to show how the Bayes factor simplifies to a likelihood ratio, supporting model comparison and hypothesis testing.

formula-notes:formula_A2.23:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式表示在简单假设检验中，后验概率 p_i 正比于先验概率 π_i 乘以似然 p(x|θ_i)，即后验概率与先验和似然的乘积成正比。
formula-notes:formula_A2.23:zh.inThisChapter: 它出现在“总结后验分布”一节，用于将后验概率与先验和似然联系起来，为后续计算后验概率的具体值或进行模型比较提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_A2.24:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the posterior odds (p0/p1) as the product of the prior odds (π0/π1) and the likelihood ratio p(x|θ0)/p(x|θ1), connecting prior beliefs and data evidence.
formula-notes:formula_A2.24:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on summarizing the posterior to show how the Bayes factor simplifies to a likelihood ratio, supporting the argument that posterior inference depends only on the data through the likelihood.

formula-notes:formula_A2.25:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算贝叶斯因子 B0，它是零假设下数据 x 的似然 p(x|θ0) 与备择假设下似然 p(x|θ1) 的比值，用于比较两个假设的相对证据强度。
formula-notes:formula_A2.25:zh.inThisChapter: 在本节中，该公式将后验概率的贝叶斯因子简化为似然比，为后续通过似然比进行假设检验和模型选择提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_A2.24:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将后验几率（p0/p1）表示为先验几率（π0/π1）乘以似然比 p(x|θ0)/p(x|θ1)，即先验几率乘以数据对两个假设的支持程度之比。
formula-notes:formula_A2.24:zh.inThisChapter: 在本节中，该公式用于展示贝叶斯因子（原假设的贝叶斯因子）简化为似然比，从而将后验信念更新与先验信念和数据的似然性直接联系起来，为后续推导贝叶斯因子与后验分布的关系提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_A2.26:en.plainMeaning: This formula defines the prior distribution of θ conditioned on hypothesis Hi (i=0,1) by renormalizing the overall prior p(θ) over Θi, dividing by the prior probability πi = P(θ ∈ Θi) so that the conditional distribution integrates to 1.
formula-notes:formula_A2.26:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the discussion of composite hypotheses to define the conditional priors needed for computing the Bayes factor via weighted likelihoods, supporting the derivation of the Bayes factor as a ratio of integrals over Θ0 and Θ1.

formula-notes:formula_A2.27:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the posterior probability that θ lies in a composite hypothesis region Θ_i, given data x. It expresses p_i as the integral of the posterior density over Θ_i, then rewrites it using Bayes' theorem and the prior π_i times the likelihood weighted by the conditional prior p_i(θ).
formula-notes:formula_A2.27:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on summarizing the posterior distribution to handle composite hypotheses, supporting the derivation of the Bayes factor as a ratio of weighted likelihoods for hypothesis testing.

formula-notes:formula_A2.27:zh.plainMeaning: 这个公式计算了在给定数据 x 后，参数 θ 落在子集 Θ_i 中的后验概率 p_i，它等于先验概率 π_i 乘以在 Θ_i 上对似然函数 p(x|θ) 按条件先验 p_i(θ) 积分的加权平均。
formula-notes:formula_A2.27:zh.inThisChapter: 本节讨论复合假设的后验概率，公式 A2.27 将后验概率分解为先验概率与加权似然积分的乘积，为后续定义贝叶斯因子（即两个加权似然积分之比）提供了直接基础。

formula-notes:formula_A2.29:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式表示参数θ在区间[a,b]上服从均匀分布，其概率密度函数为常数1/(b-a)，即在该区间内每个θ值被赋予相同的先验概率。
formula-notes:formula_A2.29:zh.inThisChapter: 本节讨论先验选择，该公式给出了无信息先验（平坦先验）的数学形式，为后续在无先验信息时使用均匀先验进行贝叶斯推断提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_A2.29:en.plainMeaning: This formula defines a uniform (flat) prior distribution for a parameter θ, assigning equal probability density 1/(b-a) to all values in the interval [a, b]. The symbols are: θ (parameter), a (lower bound), b (upper bound).
formula-notes:formula_A2.29:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on prior choice to illustrate the simplest uninformative prior, which is used when no strong prior information is available, and later serves as a baseline for comparing informative priors or for deriving posterior distributions.

formula-notes:formula_A2.30:en.plainMeaning: This formula expresses the posterior distribution p(θ|x) as proportional to the likelihood ℓ(θ|x) when a flat (uniform) prior is used, with C being a normalizing constant.
formula-notes:formula_A2.30:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on choosing a prior to illustrate that a flat prior yields a posterior directly proportional to the likelihood, linking Bayesian inference to frequentist results and justifying the use of likelihood-based methods.

formula-notes:formula_A2.30:zh.plainMeaning: 这个公式表示在给定数据 x 的条件下，参数 θ 的后验分布 p(θ|x) 等于常数 C 乘以似然函数 ℓ(θ|x)，其中 C 是归一化常数。
formula-notes:formula_A2.30:zh.inThisChapter: 在本节“先验的选择”中，该公式通过假设平坦先验（无信息先验）将后验与似然直接联系起来，为后续推导贝叶斯推断与频率学派统计结果的一致性奠定基础。

formula-notes:formula_A2.32:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式表示 Jeffreys 先验分布 p(θ) 与 Fisher 信息量 I(θ|x) 的平方根成正比，其中 θ 是参数，x 是观测数据。
formula-notes:formula_A2.32:zh.inThisChapter: 在“先验选择”章节中，该公式给出了基于数据信息量的无信息先验构造方法，为后续推导 Jeffreys 先验的具体形式提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_A2.26:zh.plainMeaning: 公式 p_i(θ) = p(θ) / π_i 定义了在给定假设 H_i (i=0,1) 下参数 θ 的条件先验密度，其中 p(θ) 是无条件先验密度，π_i = P(θ ∈ Θ_i) 是假设 H_i 的先验概率，除以 π_i 使得条件密度积分为1。
formula-notes:formula_A2.26:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在“总结后验分布”章节，用于处理复合假设时，将无条件先验 p(θ) 转化为条件先验 p_i(θ)，以便后续通过贝叶斯定理计算后验概率和贝叶斯因子，为推导公式 A2.12 后的贝叶斯因子表达式做铺垫。

formula-notes:formula_A2.31:en.plainMeaning: The Fisher information I(θ|x) is the expected negative second derivative of the log-likelihood, measuring the curvature of the likelihood function and thus the amount of information the data provides about θ.
formula-notes:formula_A2.31:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on prior choice because Jeffreys prior is defined as proportional to the square root of the Fisher information, making it invariant under reparameterization and thus a noninformative prior.

formula-notes:formula_A2.28:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算复合假设检验中的贝叶斯因子 B₀，它是零假设与备择假设的加权似然比：分子是数据 x 在零假设参数空间 Θ₀ 上对先验 p₀(θ) 的积分，分母是数据 x 在备择假设参数空间 Θ₁ 上对先验 p₁(θ) 的积分。
formula-notes:formula_A2.28:zh.inThisChapter: 本节讨论复合假设的后验汇总，此公式将简单假设的贝叶斯因子（公式 A2.20）推广到复合情形，通过加权似然比量化数据支持零假设相对于备择假设的证据强度，为后续贝叶斯假设检验决策提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_A2.28:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the Bayes factor B0 for composite hypotheses as the ratio of the marginal likelihoods under H0 and H1, where each marginal likelihood integrates the likelihood p(x|θ) over the parameter space Θi weighted by the prior pi(θ) normalized by the prior probability πi of the hypothesis.
formula-notes:formula_A2.28:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on summarizing the posterior distribution to extend Bayes factor calculation from simple to composite hypotheses, supporting later arguments about model comparison when parameters are unknown.

formula-notes:formula_A2.34:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式表示无信息先验分布 p(Θ) 与 Fisher 信息矩阵 I(θ|x) 的行列式的平方根成正比，即 Jeffreys 先验。
formula-notes:formula_A2.34:zh.inThisChapter: 在“先验选择”章节中，该公式给出了 Jeffreys 先验的具体形式，为后续在无信息先验下进行贝叶斯推断提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_A2.33:en.plainMeaning: The Fisher information matrix I(Θ|x) has entries that are the negative expected value of the second partial derivative of the log-likelihood with respect to parameters θ_i and θ_j, measuring the curvature of the log-likelihood.
formula-notes:formula_A2.33:en.inThisChapter: This formula defines the Fisher information matrix used in the Jeffreys prior, which is proportional to the square root of the determinant of I, to construct a noninformative prior that is invariant under reparameterization.

formula-notes:formula_A2.32:en.plainMeaning: This formula defines the Jeffreys prior, where the prior density p(θ) is proportional to the square root of the Fisher information I(θ|x).
formula-notes:formula_A2.32:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on prior choice to introduce a non-informative prior that is invariant under reparameterization, supporting later Bayesian inference with objective priors.

formula-notes:formula_A2.31:zh.plainMeaning: 这个公式定义了Fisher信息量 I(θ|x)，它是负的对数似然函数 ln ℓ(θ|x) 关于参数 θ 的二阶偏导数的期望，衡量了似然函数在参数真值处的曲率（即数据对参数的信息量）。
formula-notes:formula_A2.31:zh.inThisChapter: 在本章“先验的选择”中，该公式引出Jeffreys先验（正比于Fisher信息量的平方根），为后续构造无信息先验提供基础，确保先验在参数变换下具有不变性。

formula-notes:formula_A2.34:en.plainMeaning: The Jeffreys prior for parameters Θ is proportional to the square root of the determinant of the Fisher information matrix I(θ|x), which measures the expected curvature of the log-likelihood.
formula-notes:formula_A2.34:en.inThisChapter: This formula appears in the section on prior choice to introduce a non-informative prior that is invariant under reparameterization, supporting later Bayesian inference where the prior is derived from the data's information structure.

formula-notes:formula_A2.35:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式给出了第 i 个观测值 x_i 在给定均值 μ 和方差 σ² 下的正态分布似然函数，即单个数据点出现的概率密度。
formula-notes:formula_A2.35:zh.inThisChapter: 在本附录引言中，它作为正态分布似然函数的基础形式，为后续推导贝叶斯分析中的后验分布以及定量遗传学中的常见假设提供起点。

formula-notes:formula_A2.35:en.plainMeaning: This formula gives the likelihood of observing a single data point x_i given parameters μ (mean) and σ² (variance) under a normal distribution.
formula-notes:formula_A2.35:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the appendix introduction to define the likelihood function for normal data, which is foundational for Bayesian analysis and later used in quantitative genetics models.

formula-notes:formula_A2.33:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式定义了Fisher信息矩阵I(Θ|x)的第(i,j)个元素，即对观测数据x的期望下，对数似然函数lnℓ(Θ|x)关于参数θ_i和θ_j的二阶偏导数的负值。
formula-notes:formula_A2.33:zh.inThisChapter: 在本节关于先验分布选择的讨论中，该公式用于计算Fisher信息矩阵，为后续基于Jeffreys先验（正比于det(I)^(1/2)）的构造提供基础，从而确保先验在参数变换下具有不变性。

formula-notes:formula_A2.36:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the likelihood function ℓ(μ|x) for n independent data points x_i given mean μ and known variance σ², using the product of normal densities.
formula-notes:formula_A2.36:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the Appendix Introduction to define the full likelihood under independence, which is then used to derive the maximum likelihood estimator for μ.

formula-notes:formula_A2.38:en.plainMeaning: This is the probability density function of a Gaussian prior for the unknown mean μ, with hyperparameters μ₀ (prior mean) and σ₀² (prior variance).
formula-notes:formula_A2.38:en.inThisChapter: It appears here to specify the prior distribution needed for Bayesian inference of μ under known variance, which will be combined with the likelihood to derive the posterior distribution.

formula-notes:formula_A2.39:en.plainMeaning: This formula expresses the posterior distribution of unknown parameters Θ₂ given data x and known parameters Θ₁ as the product of a function f (constant in Θ₂) and a function g that captures the dependence on Θ₂.
formula-notes:formula_A2.39:en.inThisChapter: It appears here to justify ignoring multiplicative factors constant in the unknown parameters when deriving the posterior, simplifying calculations under normality assumptions.
