formula-notes:formula_A2.40:en.plainMeaning: This formula expresses that the posterior distribution of unknown parameters Θ₂ given data x and known parameters Θ₁ is proportional to the function g(x, Θ₁, Θ₂), ignoring constants that do not depend on Θ₂.
formula-notes:formula_A2.40:en.inThisChapter: It appears here to simplify posterior calculations under normality by discarding terms constant in Θ₂, enabling derivation of the posterior distribution in closed form.

formula-notes:formula_A2.37:en.plainMeaning: This is the likelihood function for n independent and identically distributed normal observations with mean μ and variance σ², expressed in terms of the sample mean x̄ and sum of squares of the data.
formula-notes:formula_A2.37:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the appendix introduction to derive the maximum likelihood estimators for μ and σ², supporting later arguments on estimation and inference.

formula-notes:formula_A2.36:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式在假设数据独立同分布且方差已知的条件下，计算样本均值μ的似然函数，即给定μ时观测到所有数据点x_i的联合概率密度；关键符号：μ为均值参数，σ²为已知方差，x_i为第i个观测值。
formula-notes:formula_A2.36:zh.inThisChapter: 出现在附录引言中，承接公式A2.35对单个观测的似然定义，通过独立乘积得到n个数据点的完整似然，为后续推导μ的极大似然估计或贝叶斯后验分布提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_A2.37:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式表示在独立同分布假设下，n个数据点的联合似然函数，其中关键符号包括样本均值x̄、总体均值μ和方差σ²，通过指数项中的平方和与样本均值的关系展开。
formula-notes:formula_A2.37:zh.inThisChapter: 此公式出现在附录中，用于展示如何将独立观测的似然函数从乘积形式转化为指数形式，为后续推导最大似然估计或贝叶斯后验分布提供代数基础。

formula-notes:formula_A2.39:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将未知参数Θ2的后验分布p(Θ2|x,Θ1)分解为与Θ2无关的因子f(x,Θ1)和与Θ2有关的因子g(x,Θ1,Θ2)的乘积，其中f(x,Θ1)在Θ2的后验推断中可视为常数。
formula-notes:formula_A2.39:zh.inThisChapter: 在本节正态性假设下，该分解用于简化后验分布的计算：通过忽略与Θ2无关的常数因子f(x,Θ1)，仅需关注g(x,Θ1,Θ2)部分，从而将后验密度与先验和似然中Θ2相关的部分对应起来。

formula-notes:formula_A2.41:en.plainMeaning: This formula expresses the posterior density of μ (given data x) as proportional to the product of the likelihood and prior, combining the prior N(μ₀, σ₀²) and the normal likelihood with known variance σ², resulting in a quadratic exponent in μ.
formula-notes:formula_A2.41:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on posterior distributions under normality to derive the conjugate normal-normal posterior, supporting the argument that the posterior is also normal with updated mean and variance.

formula-notes:formula_A2.38:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式是高斯先验分布的概率密度函数，它描述了未知均值 μ 服从均值为 μ₀、方差为 σ₀² 的正态分布，其中 μ₀ 和 σ₀² 是先验超参数。
formula-notes:formula_A2.38:zh.inThisChapter: 在已知方差 σ² 的假设下，本节需要为 μ 指定先验分布，该公式给出了高斯先验的具体形式，为后续推导 μ 的后验分布（即高斯分布共轭性）提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_A2.42:en.plainMeaning: This formula gives the posterior density of the mean μ given data x, up to a proportionality constant, by combining a normal prior (with mean μ0 and variance σ0²) and a normal likelihood (with known variance σ² and sample mean x̄).
formula-notes:formula_A2.42:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the derivation of the posterior distribution under normality, showing how the prior and likelihood combine to yield a normal posterior, which is then simplified to the standard conjugate form.

formula-notes:formula_A2.44:en.plainMeaning: This formula gives the posterior variance σ*² and posterior mean μ* for a normal distribution with known variance σ², when the prior is normal with mean μ₀ and variance σ₀², and n observations have sample mean x̄.
formula-notes:formula_A2.44:en.inThisChapter: It appears here to show how the posterior distribution of μ is derived by completing the square in the exponential, supporting later Bayesian inference under normality.

formula-notes:formula_A2.43:zh.plainMeaning: 该等式将指数项中关于μ的二次型整理成完全平方形式，其中σ*²和μ*分别表示后验方差和后验均值。
formula-notes:formula_A2.43:zh.inThisChapter: 在本节正态假设下，通过配方将先验与似然结合，为后续直接写出后验分布的正态形式（均值μ*、方差σ*²）做准备。

formula-notes:formula_A2.42:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式表示在给定数据x下，均值μ的后验分布正比于指数函数，指数中包含μ的二次项和一次项，其中σ₀²和μ₀是μ的先验方差和均值，σ²是已知的数据方差，n是样本量，x̄是样本均值。
formula-notes:formula_A2.42:zh.inThisChapter: 此公式出现在推导正态分布下均值后验分布的过程中，通过合并指数中的μ项，为后续整理成高斯分布的标准形式（即配方）做准备，从而得到后验均值和方差的具体表达式。

formula-notes:formula_A2.40:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式表示在给定数据x和已知参数Θ1的条件下，未知参数Θ2的后验密度正比于函数g(x, Θ1, Θ2)，其中g是联合密度中与Θ2相关的部分，而分母中与Θ2无关的常数因子f(x, Θ1)被省略。
formula-notes:formula_A2.40:zh.inThisChapter: 在本节正态性假设下的后验分布推导中，该公式用于简化计算：通过忽略与未知参数Θ2无关的常数项，将后验密度表示为正比于一个更简单的函数g，从而便于后续利用共轭先验（如公式A2.19）得到具体的后验分布形式。

formula-notes:formula_A2.41:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式表示在正态分布假设下，给定数据x后均值μ的后验密度正比于似然函数ℓ(μ|x)与先验密度p(μ)的乘积，展开后指数部分合并了先验（含μ₀,σ₀²）和似然（含σ², n, x̄）的二次项，用于推导μ的后验分布形式。
formula-notes:formula_A2.41:zh.inThisChapter: 本节在正态性假设下推导后验分布，该公式通过忽略常数项将后验核简化为μ的二次型指数形式，为后续得到μ的后验正态分布（均值与方差表达式）做代数铺垫。

formula-notes:formula_A2.43:en.plainMeaning: This formula simplifies the exponent of the posterior distribution for μ by rewriting the quadratic form in μ as a perfect square, where σ₀² is the prior variance, σ² is the data variance, n is sample size, x̄ is sample mean, μ₀ is prior mean, and μ₊ and σ₊² are the posterior mean and variance.
formula-notes:formula_A2.43:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the derivation of the normal posterior for μ under conjugate priors, showing that the posterior is normal with mean μ₊ and variance σ₊², which is the key result of this section.

formula-notes:formula_A2.46:en.plainMeaning: This formula shows that the posterior distribution of μ given data x is proportional to a normal density with mean μ* and variance σ*², where μ* and σ*² are defined from the prior and likelihood.
formula-notes:formula_A2.46:en.inThisChapter: It appears here to derive the posterior under normality, supporting the result that the posterior is normal with updated parameters, which is used for Bayesian inference in later sections.

formula-notes:formula_A2.46:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式表示在给定观测数据x的条件下，参数μ的后验密度正比于一个指数函数，指数中的二次项表明μ服从均值为μ*、方差为σ*²的正态分布。
formula-notes:formula_A2.46:zh.inThisChapter: 本节在正态性假设下推导后验分布，该公式直接给出μ的后验密度核，为后续证明后验分布为正态分布（均值为μ*、方差为σ*²）提供关键表达式。

formula-notes:formula_A2.47:en.plainMeaning: This formula states that the posterior distribution of the mean μ, given the data x and known variance σ², is normal with mean μ₊ and variance σ₊².
formula-notes:formula_A2.47:en.inThisChapter: It appears here to show that under a normal likelihood with a conjugate prior, the posterior for μ is also normal, enabling closed-form Bayesian updating.

formula-notes:formula_A2.45:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式表示在给定数据x的条件下，均值μ的后验密度正比于指数函数，其中指数由二次项(μ-μ*)²/(2σ*²)和一个与x、μ₀、σ²、σ₀²有关的函数f组成，μ*和σ*²分别是后验均值和方差。
formula-notes:formula_A2.45:zh.inThisChapter: 本节通过配方法将后验分布化简为高斯形式，该公式是推导后验分布显式表达式（即μ|x服从N(μ*,σ*²)）的关键步骤，为后续贝叶斯推断提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_A2.47:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式表示在给定观测数据 x 和方差 σ² 的条件下，均值 μ 的后验分布服从均值为 μ₊、方差为 σ₊² 的正态分布。其中 μ₊ 是后验均值，σ₊² 是后验方差。
formula-notes:formula_A2.47:zh.inThisChapter: 此公式出现在正态假设下后验分布推导的结论处，它直接给出了 μ 的后验分布形式，为后续进行贝叶斯推断（如区间估计或假设检验）提供了明确的分布基础。

formula-notes:formula_A2.44:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式给出了在正态分布假设下，已知方差σ²时，均值μ的后验分布方差σ₊²和后验均值μ₊。σ₊²是先验方差σ₀²与样本方差σ²/n的调和平均（倒数之和的倒数），μ₊则是先验均值μ₀与样本均值x̄的加权平均，权重分别为各自方差的倒数。
formula-notes:formula_A2.44:zh.inThisChapter: 本节推导正态分布下均值μ的后验分布，该公式直接来自对似然函数与先验分布乘积的指数项配方，是后续进行贝叶斯推断（如后验区间估计、假设检验）的基础。

formula-notes:formula_A2.49:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式给出了指数分布的概率密度函数，其中β是速率参数，x是等待时间，表示在给定速率β下，等待时间x的概率密度为βe^{-βx}。
formula-notes:formula_A2.49:zh.inThisChapter: 本节在正态性假设下讨论后验分布，此处引入指数分布是为了引出伽马分布，为后续推导伽马分布作为共轭先验或似然函数做准备。

formula-notes:formula_A2.49:en.plainMeaning: This is the probability density function (pdf) of the exponential distribution, where x is the waiting time and β is the rate parameter (inverse of mean waiting time).
formula-notes:formula_A2.49:en.inThisChapter: It introduces the exponential distribution as a special case of the gamma distribution, which is used later as a prior for the precision (inverse variance) in normal models.

formula-notes:formula_A2.45:en.plainMeaning: This formula gives the posterior density of the mean μ given data x, up to a normalizing constant, after completing the square in the exponent. The key symbols are μ (parameter), μ₀ (prior mean), σ² (data variance), σ₀² (prior variance), μ₊ and σ₊² (posterior mean and variance), and f(·) collects terms not involving μ.
formula-notes:formula_A2.45:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the derivation of the normal posterior distribution, showing that the posterior is proportional to a normal density, which is then normalized to obtain the exact posterior distribution used for inference.

formula-notes:formula_A2.48:zh.plainMeaning: 公式计算后验均值 μ_* 是先验均值 μ₀ 与样本均值 x̄ 的加权平均，权重分别为 σ_*²/σ₀² 和 σ_*²/(σ²/n)，其中 σ_*² 是后验方差。
formula-notes:formula_A2.48:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在正态假设下后验分布推导的末尾，用于定量比较先验与数据对后验均值的影响，为后续讨论先验扩散（σ₀²→∞）或样本量增大（n→∞）时后验均值趋近于样本均值提供代数依据。

formula-notes:formula_A2.50:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式表示给定率参数β时，指数分布的概率密度函数，其中λ=1/β是尺度参数（平均等待时间），x是等待时间。
formula-notes:formula_A2.50:zh.inThisChapter: 此处通过指数分布引出伽马分布，为后续在正态性假设下推导后验分布提供先验分布的基础。

formula-notes:formula_A2.48:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the posterior mean μ* as a weighted average of the prior mean μ₀ and the sample mean x̄, with weights proportional to the prior precision (1/σ₀²) and data precision (n/σ²), respectively.
formula-notes:formula_A2.48:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on posterior distributions under normality to show how the posterior mean combines prior and data information, and supports the argument that with a diffuse prior or large n, the posterior mean converges to the sample mean.

formula-notes:formula_A2.51:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式定义了Erlang分布的概率密度函数，其中k是形状参数（正整数），β是速率参数，x是随机变量，表示k个独立同分布指数随机变量之和。
formula-notes:formula_A2.51:zh.inThisChapter: 在本章中，该公式用于描述在正态性假设下，后验分布可能涉及的先验分布形式，为后续推导共轭先验或后验分布的具体表达式提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_A2.50:en.plainMeaning: This formula gives the probability density function of an exponential distribution parameterized by the scale parameter λ (mean waiting time), where x ≥ 0 is the waiting time and β = 1/λ is the rate.
formula-notes:formula_A2.50:en.inThisChapter: It introduces the exponential distribution as a special case of the gamma distribution, which will be used as a prior for the precision (inverse variance) in normal models, motivating the gamma prior's form.

formula-notes:formula_A2.52:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式定义了形状参数为α、速率参数为β的伽马分布的概率密度函数，其中x>0，Γ(α)是伽马函数，用于归一化。
formula-notes:formula_A2.52:zh.inThisChapter: 在本章关于正态性假设下后验分布的讨论中，伽马分布常作为共轭先验出现在精度参数（方差的倒数）的后验推导中，为后续计算后验均值和方差提供解析形式。

formula-notes:formula_A2.51:en.plainMeaning: This formula gives the probability density function of the Erlang distribution, which models the sum of k independent exponential random variables with rate β. The symbols are: x (random variable), k (shape parameter, integer), β (rate parameter).
formula-notes:formula_A2.51:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on posterior distributions under normality assumptions to illustrate a conjugate prior for the precision parameter in a normal model, supporting later arguments about Bayesian inference for normal variance.

formula-notes:formula_A2.52:en.plainMeaning: This is the probability density function of the gamma distribution with shape parameter α and rate parameter β, giving the density at x > 0.
formula-notes:formula_A2.52:en.inThisChapter: It appears here because the gamma distribution is used as a conjugate prior for the precision (inverse variance) in normal models, enabling closed-form posterior updates in Bayesian inference.

formula-notes:formula_A2.53:en.plainMeaning: This formula defines the kernel of a Gamma distribution for x, with shape parameter α and rate parameter β, omitting the normalizing constant Γ(α)/β^α.
formula-notes:formula_A2.53:en.inThisChapter: It appears here because the Gamma distribution is used as a conjugate prior for the precision (inverse variance) in normal models, enabling closed-form posterior updates in later derivations.

formula-notes:formula_A2.53:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式表示给定参数α和β时，随机变量x的概率密度函数正比于x^(α-1)乘以e^(-βx)，其中α>0是形状参数，β>0是速率参数。
formula-notes:formula_A2.53:zh.inThisChapter: 在本章中，该公式作为Gamma分布的非归一化形式出现，用于在正态性假设下推导后验分布，特别是当先验分布为Gamma分布时，后验分布仍为Gamma分布，从而简化计算。

formula-notes:formula_A2.54:en.plainMeaning: This formula gives the probability density function of a Gamma distribution parameterized by shape α and scale λ, where x > 0, α > 0, λ > 0, and Γ(α) is the gamma function.
formula-notes:formula_A2.54:en.inThisChapter: It appears here because the Gamma distribution is used as a conjugate prior for the precision (inverse variance) of a normal distribution when the mean is known, and this scale parameterization is common in software like R.

formula-notes:formula_A2.57:en.plainMeaning: This formula expresses the shape parameter α and rate parameter β of a gamma distribution in terms of the mean μ_x and variance σ_x^2 of the distribution.
formula-notes:formula_A2.57:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on posterior distributions under normality to allow reparameterization of the gamma prior/posterior from (α, β) to (μ_x, σ_x^2), facilitating interpretation and computation.

formula-notes:formula_A2.54:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式给出了Gamma分布的概率密度函数，其中参数α是形状参数，λ是尺度参数，x是随机变量，Γ(α)是Gamma函数，用于归一化。
formula-notes:formula_A2.54:zh.inThisChapter: 在本章中，该公式用于定义Gamma分布作为共轭先验或后验分布的形式，为后续推导正态分布下方差的后验分布提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_A2.56:en.plainMeaning: This formula gives the mean (μ_x) and variance (σ_x^2) of a gamma distribution in terms of shape α and rate β, or equivalently shape α and scale λ=1/β: μ_x = α/β = αλ, σ_x^2 = α/β^2 = αλ^2.
formula-notes:formula_A2.56:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on posterior distributions under normality to allow reparameterization of the gamma prior/posterior in terms of its mean and variance, facilitating interpretation and comparison with normal distributions.

formula-notes:formula_A2.55:en.plainMeaning: This formula gives the probability density function of a gamma distribution parameterized by shape α and scale λ, up to a proportionality constant. The variable x is the random variable, α controls the shape, and λ scales the distribution.
formula-notes:formula_A2.55:en.inThisChapter: It appears here to define the gamma distribution in scale parameterization, which is used as a prior or posterior for precision parameters in normal models, supporting later derivations of conjugate posteriors.

formula-notes:formula_A2.57:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将伽马分布的形状参数α和速率参数β用均值μ_x和方差σ_x²表示：α = μ_x²/σ_x²，β = μ_x/σ_x²。
formula-notes:formula_A2.57:zh.inThisChapter: 在正态性假设下，后验分布常为伽马分布，此公式允许通过后验均值和方差直接确定伽马参数，为后续数值计算或软件实现提供参数化转换。

formula-notes:formula_A2.58:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式定义了伽马函数 Γ(α)，它是通过对 y^(α-1) e^{-y} 从 0 到 ∞ 积分得到的，用于归一化伽马分布的概率密度函数。
formula-notes:formula_A2.58:zh.inThisChapter: 在本章中，伽马函数用于定义伽马分布（公式 A2.17）的归一化常数，从而为后续在正态性假设下推导后验分布（如逆伽马分布）提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_A2.56:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式给出了伽马分布（参数化形式为形状参数α和速率参数β或尺度参数λ=1/β）的均值μ_x和方差σ_x^2，分别等于α/β和α/β²，或者等价地αλ和αλ²。
formula-notes:formula_A2.56:zh.inThisChapter: 在本章关于正态性假设下后验分布的讨论中，该公式用于将伽马分布重新参数化为均值与方差的形式，以便后续推导中能够根据后验矩直接识别出伽马分布的具体参数。

formula-notes:formula_A2.55:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式表示给定形状参数α和尺度参数λ时，随机变量x的概率密度函数正比于x^(α-1)乘以e^(-x/λ)，其中x>0。
formula-notes:formula_A2.55:zh.inThisChapter: 在本章正态性假设下的后验分布中，该公式用于定义伽马分布的尺度参数化形式，为后续推导后验分布（如正态分布精度参数的共轭先验）提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_A2.59:en.plainMeaning: This formula defines the gamma function's recurrence relation and key values: Γ(α+1)=αΓ(α), Γ(1)=1, and Γ(1/2)=√π. The gamma function generalizes factorials to positive real numbers.
formula-notes:formula_A2.59:en.inThisChapter: It appears here because the chi-square distribution (a special case of the gamma) is used for posterior inference under normality, and these identities simplify the normalizing constants and moments in posterior calculations.

formula-notes:formula_A2.58:en.plainMeaning: The gamma function Γ(α) is defined as the integral from 0 to ∞ of y^(α-1) e^{-y} dy for α > 0; it generalizes the factorial to real numbers and serves as the normalizing constant of the gamma distribution.
formula-notes:formula_A2.58:en.inThisChapter: This definition appears in the appendix to support the derivation of posterior distributions under normality, where the gamma distribution is used as a conjugate prior for the precision (inverse variance) parameter.

formula-notes:formula_A2.60:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式给出了自由度为 n 的卡方分布的概率密度函数，其中 x 是卡方随机变量的取值，n 是自由度，Γ(n/2) 是伽马函数。
formula-notes:formula_A2.60:zh.inThisChapter: 在正态性假设下的后验分布章节中，该公式用于描述正态分布方差的后验分布（逆卡方分布）的核，为后续推导后验均值和区间估计提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_A2.60:en.plainMeaning: This formula gives the probability density function (PDF) of a chi-square random variable x with n degrees of freedom, where Γ is the gamma function and x > 0.
formula-notes:formula_A2.60:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on posterior distributions under normality to describe the distribution of sums of squared normal residuals, which is used later to derive posterior distributions for variance parameters.

formula-notes:formula_A2.59:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式给出了伽马函数的递推关系：Γ(α+1)=αΓ(α)，以及两个特殊值Γ(1)=1和Γ(1/2)=√π。其中α是任意正数，Γ(α)是伽马函数。
formula-notes:formula_A2.59:zh.inThisChapter: 在本章正态假设下的后验分布中，伽马函数用于定义卡方分布和伽马分布。这些递推关系帮助简化涉及伽马函数的积分和密度表达式，为后续推导卡方分布的后验或边际分布做准备。

formula-notes:formula_A2.62:en.plainMeaning: This is the probability density function of the inverse-gamma distribution with shape α and scale β, giving the density of x > 0. The symbols are: α (shape), β (scale), Γ(α) (gamma function).
formula-notes:formula_A2.62:en.inThisChapter: It appears here because the inverse-gamma distribution serves as a conjugate prior for the variance in Gaussian likelihoods, enabling closed-form posterior updates in later derivations.

formula-notes:formula_A2.61:en.plainMeaning: This formula gives the probability density function of a chi-square distribution with n degrees of freedom, up to a proportionality constant; x is the random variable and n is the degrees of freedom.
formula-notes:formula_A2.61:en.inThisChapter: It appears here because the chi-square distribution arises as the posterior distribution for the variance parameter under normal likelihood with conjugate priors, supporting later inference on variance.

formula-notes:formula_A2.61:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式表示自由度为 n 的卡方分布的概率密度函数（未归一化形式），其中 x 是卡方随机变量，n 是自由度，指数 n/2-1 来自伽马分布的形状参数 α=n/2，指数 -x/2 来自尺度参数 β=1/2。
formula-notes:formula_A2.61:zh.inThisChapter: 在本章正态性假设下的后验分布中，卡方分布用于描述正态样本方差的后验分布或与方差相关的统计量，该公式为后续推导后验分布的具体形式提供密度函数基础。

formula-notes:formula_A2.63:zh.plainMeaning: 对于逆伽马分布，当形状参数α>1时，均值μ_x等于β/(α-1)；当α>2时，方差σ_x^2等于β^2/[(α-1)^2(α-2)]，其中β为尺度参数。
formula-notes:formula_A2.63:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在正态性假设下后验分布的讨论中，用于给出逆伽马分布（作为方差的后验分布）的均值和方差，为后续计算后验期望和区间估计提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_A2.63:en.plainMeaning: This formula gives the mean (μ_x) and variance (σ_x²) of a Pareto distribution with parameters α (shape) and β (scale), provided α > 1 for the mean and α > 2 for the variance.
formula-notes:formula_A2.63:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the appendix on posterior distributions under normality to characterize the marginal posterior distribution of a variance parameter when using a conjugate prior, supporting the derivation of posterior moments and inference.

formula-notes:formula_A2.62:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式给出了逆伽马分布的概率密度函数，其中α和β分别为形状参数和尺度参数，x为随机变量，Γ(α)是伽马函数。它描述了当随机变量x服从逆伽马分布时，其概率密度随x的变化关系。
formula-notes:formula_A2.62:zh.inThisChapter: 本节讨论正态假设下的后验分布，逆伽马分布作为正态似然中未知方差（或精度）的共轭先验出现。该公式为后续推导方差的后验分布提供了具体的密度形式，使得后验更新可以通过参数α和β的简单加法完成。

formula-notes:formula_A2.64:en.plainMeaning: This formula defines the inverse gamma distribution's probability density function up to a constant, where x > 0, α > 0 is the shape parameter, and β > 0 is the scale parameter. It shows that p(x|α,β) is proportional to x^{-(α+1)} e^{-β/x}.
formula-notes:formula_A2.64:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on posterior distributions under normality to describe the posterior distribution of the variance parameter when using a conjugate inverse gamma prior, supporting later derivations of marginal distributions and predictive densities.

formula-notes:formula_A2.64:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式表示给定参数α和β时，随机变量x服从逆伽马分布的概率密度函数（正比于），其中α控制形状（尾部厚度），β控制尺度（峰值位置）。
formula-notes:formula_A2.64:zh.inThisChapter: 在本章正态性假设下，逆伽马分布常作为正态分布方差（或精度）的共轭先验，此处公式A2.64为后续推导后验分布（如正态方差的后验）提供逆伽马分布的密度形式。

formula-notes:formula_A2.66:en.plainMeaning: This formula gives the mean and variance of an inverse chi-square distribution with n degrees of freedom, where μ_x = 1/(n-2) and σ_x² = 2/[(n-2)²(n-4)], valid for n > 4.
formula-notes:formula_A2.66:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on posterior distributions under normality to provide moments of the inverse chi-square distribution, which is used as a conjugate prior or posterior for variance parameters in normal models.

formula-notes:formula_A2.65:en.plainMeaning: This formula gives the probability density function of an inverse chi-square random variable x with n degrees of freedom, where x = 1/y and y ~ χ²_n. Key symbols: n = degrees of freedom, x = inverse chi-square variable, Γ = gamma function.
formula-notes:formula_A2.65:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on posterior distributions under normality to define the inverse chi-square distribution, which is used as a conjugate prior or posterior for variance parameters in normal models, supporting later derivations of posterior distributions for σ².

formula-notes:formula_A2.65:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式给出了自由度为 n 的逆卡方分布的概率密度函数，其中 x = 1/y，y 服从卡方分布 χ²_n。关键符号：n 为自由度，Γ(n/2) 为伽马函数，x 为逆卡方随机变量。
formula-notes:formula_A2.65:zh.inThisChapter: 本节在正态性假设下推导后验分布，逆卡方分布作为逆伽马的特例，用于描述方差参数的后验分布，为后续贝叶斯推断中方差的后验更新提供解析形式。

formula-notes:formula_A2.66:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式给出了逆卡方分布 χ_n^{-2} 的均值 μ_x = 1/(n-2) 和方差 σ_x^2 = 2/[(n-2)^2 (n-4)]，其中 n 是自由度参数。
formula-notes:formula_A2.66:zh.inThisChapter: 在正态假设下的后验分布章节中，该公式用于描述精度参数（方差倒数）的后验分布（逆卡方分布）的矩，为后续推导后验均值和后验方差提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_A2.68:en.plainMeaning: This formula shows that if a random variable x follows a scaled inverse chi-square distribution with parameters n and σ₀², then σ₀² times x follows a standard inverse chi-square distribution with n degrees of freedom.
formula-notes:formula_A2.68:en.inThisChapter: It appears here to demonstrate the scaling property of the inverse chi-square distribution, which is used to simplify posterior derivations for the variance under normal models.

formula-notes:formula_A2.67:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式表示在正态性假设下，给定数据 n 时参数 x 的后验分布正比于 x^{-(n/2+1)} e^{-σ₀²/(2x)}，其中 x 是方差参数，σ₀² 是尺度参数，n 是自由度。
formula-notes:formula_A2.67:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在介绍尺度逆卡方分布的部分，用于将标准逆卡方分布中的指数项 1/(2x) 替换为 σ₀²/(2x)，从而得到后验分布的形式，为后续贝叶斯分析中方差参数的推断提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_A2.70:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the sample variance S² as the average squared deviation of observations x_i from the known mean μ, where n is the sample size.
formula-notes:formula_A2.70:en.inThisChapter: It appears here because the likelihood for normal data with known mean depends on the sum of squared deviations, making S² a sufficient statistic for the unknown variance σ², which is used to derive the posterior distribution of σ².

formula-notes:formula_A2.69:en.plainMeaning: This formula gives the likelihood function for the variance σ² given data x and known mean μ, proportional to (σ²)^{-n/2} times exp(-nS²/(2σ²)), where n is sample size and S² is sample variance (or sum of squared deviations divided by n).
formula-notes:formula_A2.69:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on posterior distributions under normality to derive the posterior for σ² when μ is known, supporting later Bayesian inference for normal variance with conjugate inverse-gamma priors.

formula-notes:formula_A2.67:en.plainMeaning: This formula gives the posterior density of the variance x (or σ²) under a normal model with a scaled inverse chi-square prior, proportional to x^{-(n/2+1)} e^{-σ₀²/(2x)}, where n is the degrees of freedom and σ₀² is the scale parameter.
formula-notes:formula_A2.67:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on posterior distributions under normality to show that the posterior of the variance is also a scaled inverse chi-square, supporting later Bayesian inference for normal data.

formula-notes:formula_A2.70:zh.plainMeaning: 公式 S² = (1/n) Σ(x_i - μ)² 计算的是已知总体均值 μ 时，样本观测值 x_i 与 μ 的偏差平方的平均值，即样本方差（分母为 n 而非 n-1）。
formula-notes:formula_A2.70:zh.inThisChapter: 在本节中，该公式用于定义已知均值 μ 下方差 σ² 的充分统计量，为后续推导方差的后验分布（如逆伽马分布）提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_A2.68:zh.plainMeaning: 公式表明，如果随机变量 x 服从参数为 (n, σ₀²) 的缩放逆卡方分布，那么 σ₀² 乘以 x 就服从自由度为 n 的标准逆卡方分布。这里 x 是缩放逆卡方变量，σ₀² 是缩放参数。
formula-notes:formula_A2.68:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在介绍缩放逆卡方分布的部分，用于说明 σ₀² 作为缩放因子的作用，为后续在贝叶斯分析中利用该分布作为正态分布方差的共轭先验做铺垫。

formula-notes:formula_A2.71:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式表示在给定数据x和均值μ的条件下，方差σ²的后验分布正比于一个逆卡方分布，其中形状参数为(n+ν₀)/2，尺度参数为(nS²+σ₀²)/(n+ν₀)。
formula-notes:formula_A2.71:zh.inThisChapter: 此处通过将似然函数（正比于逆卡方分布）与逆卡方先验相乘，推导出后验仍为逆卡方分布，从而为后续共轭先验下的贝叶斯更新提供具体形式。

formula-notes:formula_A2.69:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式是在均值μ已知、方差σ²未知的正态分布假设下，基于观测数据x和已知μ，σ²的似然函数（忽略常数因子）的表达式，其中n为样本量，S²为样本方差。
formula-notes:formula_A2.69:zh.inThisChapter: 在本章中，该公式用于推导在正态分布假设下、均值已知时方差的后验分布，为后续计算后验期望或进行贝叶斯推断提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_A2.71:en.plainMeaning: This formula shows the posterior density of the variance σ² given data x and known mean μ, proportional to the product of a normal likelihood and a scaled inverse χ² prior, resulting in a scaled inverse χ² posterior with updated parameters n+ν₀ and (nS²+σ₀²)/(n+ν₀).
formula-notes:formula_A2.71:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on posterior distributions under normality to derive the conjugate posterior for the variance when the mean is known, supporting later Bayesian inference for normal models.

formula-notes:formula_A2.72:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式说明，当方差σ²的先验分布是参数为ν₀和σ₀²的缩放逆卡方分布时，给定数据x和均值μ后，σ²的后验分布也是缩放逆卡方分布，其参数更新为νₙ = n + ν₀和σₙ² = nS² + σ₀²。
formula-notes:formula_A2.72:zh.inThisChapter: 在本章正态性假设下，该公式展示了共轭先验（缩放逆卡方）如何导致后验分布保持相同形式，从而简化贝叶斯更新，并为后续推导μ的后验分布（如公式A2.73）提供方差部分的解析形式。

formula-notes:formula_A2.73:en.plainMeaning: This formula expresses the t-statistic with n-1 degrees of freedom as the ratio of a standard normal variable U to the square root of a chi-squared variable divided by its degrees of freedom, where U = (x̄ - μ)/(σ/√n) and χ²_{n-1} = (n-1)Var(x)/σ².
formula-notes:formula_A2.73:en.inThisChapter: It appears here to derive the Student's t distribution from the normal and chi-squared distributions, which is essential for Bayesian inference on μ when σ² is unknown, leading to the posterior distribution of μ being t-distributed.

formula-notes:formula_A2.72:en.plainMeaning: This formula shows that when the prior for variance σ² follows a scaled inverse chi-squared distribution with ν₀ degrees of freedom and scale σ₀², the posterior for σ² given data x and mean μ also follows a scaled inverse chi-squared distribution, with updated parameters νₙ = n + ν₀ and σₙ² = nS² + σ₀².
formula-notes:formula_A2.72:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on posterior distributions under normality to demonstrate conjugacy: the scaled inverse chi-squared prior leads to a posterior of the same family, enabling closed-form updates for Bayesian inference about the variance.

formula-notes:formula_A2.76:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式给出了非中心t分布（位置参数μ，尺度参数σ，自由度ν）的期望为μ，方差为σ²·ν/(ν-2)，前提是ν>2。
formula-notes:formula_A2.76:zh.inThisChapter: 在正态性假设下推导后验分布时，该公式用于计算后验预测分布的均值和方差，为后续的区间估计和假设检验提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_A2.74:en.plainMeaning: This formula defines a t-distributed random variable t_ν as a standard normal variable U divided by the square root of a chi-square variable χ_ν^2 divided by its degrees of freedom ν.
formula-notes:formula_A2.74:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on posterior distributions under normality to show that the posterior distribution of the mean (after integrating out variance) follows a t-distribution, which is used for inference about the mean.

formula-notes:formula_A2.74:zh.plainMeaning: 公式将t_ν定义为标准正态变量U除以自由度为ν的卡方变量除以ν的平方根，即t_ν = U / sqrt(χ_ν^2 / ν)，用于构造t分布。
formula-notes:formula_A2.74:zh.inThisChapter: 在本节正态性假设下，该公式用于定义t统计量，为后续推导均值或回归系数的后验分布（如正态-逆伽马先验下的后验）提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_A2.73:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将t统计量表示为标准正态变量U与卡方变量χ²_{n-1}的比值，其中U = (x̄ - μ)/(σ/√n)，χ²_{n-1} = (n-1)Var(x)/σ²，从而将t分布与正态和卡方分布联系起来。
formula-notes:formula_A2.73:zh.inThisChapter: 在本节中，该公式用于推导在正态假设下，当方差未知时，样本均值经标准化后服从t分布，为后续贝叶斯分析中后验分布的推导（如使用t分布作为先验或似然）提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_A2.75:zh.plainMeaning: 公式 t_ν(μ,σ)=μ+σ·t_ν 通过位置参数 μ 和尺度参数 σ 将标准 t 分布 t_ν 转换为一般 t 分布，其中 t_ν 是自由度为 ν 的标准 t 随机变量。
formula-notes:formula_A2.75:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在正态性假设下的后验分布章节，用于将标准 t 分布扩展为具有位置和尺度的一般形式，以便后续在正态分布均值或方差的共轭先验下推导后验分布时，能够用 t 分布表示后验边缘分布。

formula-notes:formula_A2.76:en.plainMeaning: This formula gives the mean and variance of a scaled and shifted t-distribution with ν degrees of freedom, location μ, and scale σ. The mean is μ, and the variance is σ² * ν/(ν-2) for ν>2.
formula-notes:formula_A2.76:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on posterior distributions under normality to provide the moments of the marginal posterior distribution of a normal mean when the variance is unknown, supporting later inference on μ.

formula-notes:formula_A2.78:en.plainMeaning: This formula expresses the joint prior distribution for the mean μ and variance σ² as the product of the conditional prior for μ given σ² and the marginal prior for σ², using the chain rule of probability.
formula-notes:formula_A2.78:en.inThisChapter: It appears here to set up the joint prior structure needed for deriving the posterior distribution under normality, enabling subsequent factorization and conjugate updating.

formula-notes:formula_A2.78:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将联合先验分布 p(μ,σ²) 分解为条件先验 p(μ|σ²) 与边缘先验 p(σ²) 的乘积，其中 μ 的先验依赖于方差 σ²。
formula-notes:formula_A2.78:zh.inThisChapter: 在本节中，该分解用于构建正态分布下未知均值和方差的联合后验分布，为后续通过共轭先验推导后验解析形式奠定基础。

formula-notes:formula_A2.77:en.plainMeaning: This formula gives the probability density function of a Student's t-distribution with ν degrees of freedom, location μ, and scale σ. The symbols are: x (random variable), ν (degrees of freedom), μ (location), σ (scale), and Γ (gamma function).
formula-notes:formula_A2.77:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on posterior distributions under normality assumptions to model heavy-tailed data or robust inference, supporting later arguments about Bayesian analysis with non-normal priors or likelihoods.

formula-notes:formula_A2.79:en.plainMeaning: This formula specifies the joint prior distribution for the variance σ² and the mean μ in a normal model: σ² follows a scaled inverse chi-square distribution with ν₀ degrees of freedom and scale σ₀², and conditional on σ², μ follows a normal distribution with mean μ₀ and variance σ²/κ₀.
formula-notes:formula_A2.79:en.inThisChapter: It appears in this section to define the conjugate prior for the normal model with unknown mean and variance, which is then used to derive the posterior distributions in closed form.

formula-notes:formula_A2.77:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式给出了学生t分布的概率密度函数，其中μ控制位置，σ控制尺度，ν控制峰度（ν越小尾部越厚），x是随机变量。
formula-notes:formula_A2.77:zh.inThisChapter: 在正态性假设下，为了处理未知方差或厚尾数据，引入学生t分布作为后验分布或稳健替代，该公式为后续贝叶斯推断提供了具体的似然函数形式。

formula-notes:formula_A2.75:en.plainMeaning: This formula expresses a non-standardized t-distributed random variable with location parameter μ and scale parameter σ as a linear transformation of a standard t-distributed random variable t_ν with ν degrees of freedom.
formula-notes:formula_A2.75:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on posterior distributions under normality to show how the posterior distribution of the mean, given a normal likelihood and a conjugate prior, follows a scaled and shifted t-distribution, which is used for inference about μ.

formula-notes:formula_A2.79:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式表示方差σ²服从参数为ν₀和σ₀²的缩放逆卡方分布，而给定方差σ²后，均值μ服从均值为μ₀、方差为σ²/κ₀的正态分布。
formula-notes:formula_A2.79:zh.inThisChapter: 此处将方差和均值的先验分布以条件形式写出，为后续推导联合后验分布提供基础，并引出共轭先验的具体形式。

formula-notes:formula_A2.80:en.plainMeaning: This formula gives the joint posterior distribution for variance and mean under a normal model: the variance follows a scaled inverse chi-squared distribution with ν_n degrees of freedom and scale σ_n², and the mean follows a t-distribution with ν_n degrees of freedom, location μ_n, and scale σ_n²/κ_n.
formula-notes:formula_A2.80:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on posterior distributions under normality to show the closed-form conjugate posterior when using a normal-inverse-chi-squared prior, supporting later Bayesian inference and prediction.

formula-notes:formula_A2.82:zh.plainMeaning: 公式A2.82给出了在正态假设下，给定数据后均值μ的后验均值μ_n，它是先验均值μ_0和样本均值x̄的加权平均，权重分别由先验精度参数κ_0和样本量n决定。
formula-notes:formula_A2.82:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在后验分布推导中，用于明确后验均值的具体表达式，为后续将后验分布表示为t分布并进一步进行推断提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_A2.83:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the posterior variance σ_n² of a normal distribution with unknown mean and known variance, combining prior information (ν₀, σ₀², κ₀, μ₀) with observed data (x_i, n, κ_n).
formula-notes:formula_A2.83:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on posterior distributions under normality to derive the marginal posterior distribution of the mean, which is a t-distribution used for inference.

formula-notes:formula_A2.81:zh.plainMeaning: 公式定义了后验分布的自由度 ν_n 和缩放参数 κ_n，它们分别等于先验自由度 ν_0 和先验缩放参数 κ_0 加上样本量 n，用于更新 t 分布中的参数。
formula-notes:formula_A2.81:zh.inThisChapter: 在正态性假设下推导后验分布时，该公式给出了从先验到后验的自由度和缩放参数的更新规则，为后续得到边缘后验 t 分布的具体形式提供参数表达式。

formula-notes:formula_A2.80:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式给出了在给定数据 x 的条件下，方差 σ² 服从逆卡方分布 χ^{-2}(ν_n, σ_n²)，而均值 μ 服从 t 分布 t_{ν_n}(μ_n, σ_n²/κ_n)，其中 ν_n、σ_n²、μ_n、κ_n 是后验参数。
formula-notes:formula_A2.80:zh.inThisChapter: 在本章中，该公式总结了在正态性假设下，共轭先验（逆卡方-正态）的后验分布形式，为后续进行贝叶斯推断（如区间估计、假设检验）提供了具体的分布表达式。

formula-notes:formula_A2.81:en.plainMeaning: The formula defines the posterior degrees of freedom ν_n and posterior scaling parameter κ_n as the prior values ν_0 and κ_0 increased by the sample size n, connecting the prior hyperparameters to their posterior counterparts.
formula-notes:formula_A2.81:en.inThisChapter: It appears in this section to specify how the hyperparameters of the t-distribution for μ are updated after observing data, supporting the derivation of the marginal posterior distribution of μ.

formula-notes:formula_A2.86:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式定义了狄利克雷分布的超参数α₀等于各分量参数α_i之和，同时要求每个α_i>0，且概率向量x_i满足和为1且介于0和1之间。
formula-notes:formula_A2.86:zh.inThisChapter: 在共轭先验章节中，此公式为狄利克雷分布作为多项分布共轭先验的归一化条件，确保分布有效并为后续后验参数更新提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_A2.88:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式定义了Beta分布的概率密度函数，其中x是[0,1]上的随机变量，α和β是形状参数，Γ是伽马函数，用于归一化使得总概率为1。
formula-notes:formula_A2.88:zh.inThisChapter: 本节介绍共轭先验，Beta分布作为二项分布（k=2的Dirichlet分布）的共轭先验出现，为后续推导后验分布和贝叶斯推断提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_A2.85:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式是Dirichlet分布的概率密度函数，计算给定参数α₁,…,αₖ时随机向量(x₁,…,xₖ)的联合密度，其中xᵢ∈(0,1)且∑xᵢ=1，α₀=∑αᵢ，Γ是伽马函数。
formula-notes:formula_A2.85:zh.inThisChapter: 出现在共轭先验章节，作为多项分布似然的共轭先验分布，为后续推导后验分布（Dirichlet分布）提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_A2.84:en.plainMeaning: This formula gives the probability of observing a specific count vector (n₁,…,nₖ) from n independent trials, each with k possible outcomes having probabilities p₁,…,pₖ. The multinomial coefficient n!/(n₁!…nₖ!) counts the number of ways to assign the trials to categories.
formula-notes:formula_A2.84:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the conjugate priors section because the multinomial likelihood is the natural extension of the binomial for multiple categories, and its conjugate prior is the Dirichlet distribution, which is introduced next to form a conjugate Bayesian model.

formula-notes:formula_A2.87:en.plainMeaning: The formulas give the mean, variance, and covariance of a Dirichlet distribution with concentration parameters α_i and total α_0 = Σ α_i, where x_i are the random probability variables.
formula-notes:formula_A2.87:en.inThisChapter: They appear in the Conjugate Priors section to characterize the Dirichlet distribution as the conjugate prior for the multinomial likelihood, supporting later Bayesian inference for categorical data.

formula-notes:formula_A2.84:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算在n次独立试验中，每个试验有k种可能结果，且第i种结果概率为p_i时，恰好观察到n_1次结果1、n_2次结果2、…、n_k次结果k的概率。其中n!/(n_1!...n_k!)是多项式系数，p_i^{n_i}是各结果概率的乘积。
formula-notes:formula_A2.84:zh.inThisChapter: 本节介绍共轭先验，该公式作为多项分布的概率质量函数，是二项分布向多类别情形的推广，为后续推导狄利克雷分布作为其共轭先验提供似然函数形式。

formula-notes:formula_A2.85:en.plainMeaning: This is the probability density function of the Dirichlet distribution, which gives the joint density of a probability vector (x1,...,xk) given concentration parameters (α1,...,αk). Γ is the gamma function, and α0 = Σ αi.
formula-notes:formula_A2.85:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the Conjugate Priors section because the Dirichlet distribution is the conjugate prior for the multinomial likelihood, enabling closed-form posterior updates in Bayesian inference.

formula-notes:formula_A2.82:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the posterior mean μ_n of a normal distribution with known variance, given a normal prior with mean μ_0 and variance σ²/κ₀, and data with sample mean x̄ and sample size n. The symbols are: μ_n (posterior mean), μ_0 (prior mean), κ₀ (prior precision multiplier), κ_n = κ₀ + n (posterior precision multiplier), x̄ (sample mean), n (sample size).
formula-notes:formula_A2.82:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on posterior distributions under normality to derive the closed-form posterior mean when σ² is known, supporting later arguments for Bayesian updating and the connection to t-distributions when σ² is unknown.

formula-notes:formula_A2.83:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算在给定数据后，正态分布模型中方差的边缘后验分布参数σ_n²，它由先验方差σ₀²、样本离差平方和∑(x_i - x̄)²以及先验均值μ₀与样本均值x̄的偏差平方项加权求和得到，其中ν_n是后验自由度。
formula-notes:formula_A2.83:zh.inThisChapter: 本节推导正态分布下共轭先验的后验分布，该公式给出方差σ²的边缘后验分布中的尺度参数，为后续得到t分布形式的后验均值表达式提供关键组成部分。

formula-notes:formula_A2.86:en.plainMeaning: This formula defines the Dirichlet concentration parameter α₀ as the sum of the individual αᵢ (all positive), and states that the probability vector x has components summing to 1 with each between 0 and 1.
formula-notes:formula_A2.86:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the Conjugate Priors section to define the Dirichlet distribution's normalizing constant and parameter constraints, supporting the derivation of the posterior Dirichlet parameters from multinomial data.

formula-notes:formula_A2.89:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式给出了Beta分布的均值μ和方差σ²，其中α和β是Beta分布的两个形状参数。均值μ等于α除以α+β，方差σ²等于αβ除以(α+β)²(α+β-1)。
formula-notes:formula_A2.89:zh.inThisChapter: 在共轭先验章节中，Beta分布作为二项分布（k=2的Dirichlet分布特例）的共轭先验出现，该公式提供了其均值和方差的显式表达式，为后续推导后验分布及进行贝叶斯推断奠定基础。

formula-notes:formula_A2.88:en.plainMeaning: This is the probability density function (pdf) of the beta distribution, parameterized by α and β, which gives the probability of x (0 ≤ x ≤ 1). The Gamma function Γ ensures normalization.
formula-notes:formula_A2.88:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the Conjugate Priors section as the conjugate prior for the Bernoulli/binomial likelihood (k=2 Dirichlet), enabling closed-form posterior updates. Its flexibility (flat, unimodal, U-, L-shaped) supports later arguments on prior selection and posterior analysis.

formula-notes:formula_A2.89:en.plainMeaning: This formula gives the mean μ and variance σ² of a beta distribution in terms of its shape parameters α and β.
formula-notes:formula_A2.89:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on conjugate priors to show how the beta distribution's moments depend on α and β, supporting the later argument that the beta is a flexible conjugate prior for binomial likelihoods.

formula-notes:formula_A2.87:zh.plainMeaning: 公式给出了狄利克雷分布的三个关键矩：均值 μ_{x_i} 等于 α_i 除以 α_0；方差 σ²(x_i) 等于 α_i(α_0-α_i) 除以 α_0²(α_0+1)；协方差 σ(x_i,x_j) 等于 -α_i α_j 除以 α_0²(α_0+1)。
formula-notes:formula_A2.87:zh.inThisChapter: 在共轭先验章节中，狄利克雷分布作为多项分布的共轭先验出现，这些矩公式用于描述后验分布（即参数 x_i 的分布）的集中趋势和不确定性，为后续贝叶斯推断中计算后验期望和方差提供解析表达式。

formula-notes:formula_A3.1:zh.plainMeaning: 这个公式表示函数 h(x) 在区间 [a, b] 上的定积分，即曲线下的面积。
formula-notes:formula_A3.1:zh.inThisChapter: 它出现在附录引言中，作为蒙特卡洛方法要近似计算的目标，为后续引入随机数生成近似积分做铺垫。

formula-notes:formula_A2.91:en.plainMeaning: This is the probability density function of the Wishart distribution for a random matrix W given a scale matrix V, with n degrees of freedom and dimension k. Key symbols: W (random matrix), V (scale matrix), n (degrees of freedom), k (dimension), tr (trace), Γ (gamma function).
formula-notes:formula_A2.91:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the Conjugate Priors section because the Wishart distribution is the conjugate prior for the precision matrix of a multivariate normal distribution, and this formula provides the explicit density needed for Bayesian updating and posterior derivation.

formula-notes:formula_A2.90:zh.plainMeaning: 公式计算样本协方差矩阵W，它是n个独立同分布的多维零均值正态向量x_i的外积之和，服从自由度为n、尺度矩阵为V的Wishart分布。
formula-notes:formula_A2.90:zh.inThisChapter: 本节介绍共轭先验，Wishart分布作为多元正态分布协方差矩阵的共轭先验出现，此公式定义了Wishart随机矩阵，为后续推导后验分布提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_A2.90:en.plainMeaning: This formula defines the sample sum-of-squares matrix W as the sum of outer products of n independent zero-mean multivariate normal vectors, which follows a Wishart distribution with n degrees of freedom and scale matrix V.
formula-notes:formula_A2.90:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on conjugate priors to establish that the Wishart distribution is the conjugate prior for the precision matrix of a multivariate normal, supporting later derivations of posterior distributions.

formula-notes:formula_A2.91:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式给出了给定尺度矩阵V时，随机矩阵W服从Wishart分布的概率密度函数，其中n是自由度，k是矩阵维数，tr[V^{-1}W]是矩阵V^{-1}W的迹（对角线元素之和）。
formula-notes:formula_A2.91:zh.inThisChapter: 在共轭先验章节中，Wishart分布作为多元正态分布协方差矩阵的共轭先验出现，该公式用于定义Wishart分布的密度，为后续推导后验分布提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_A3.1:en.plainMeaning: This is the definite integral of a function h(x) from a to b, representing the area under the curve. The symbols a and b are the integration limits, and h(x) is the integrand.
formula-notes:formula_A3.1:en.inThisChapter: It appears here to introduce the problem that Monte Carlo methods solve: approximating complex integrals that are difficult to compute analytically. This motivates the need for random sampling techniques discussed later.

formula-notes:formula_A3.3:en.plainMeaning: This formula expresses an integral as the expectation of f(x) under the probability density p(x), and approximates it by the sample average of f(x_i) from n samples drawn from p(x).
formula-notes:formula_A3.3:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the Appendix Introduction to introduce Monte Carlo integration, which is used later to approximate intractable integrals in Bayesian inference or other probabilistic models.

formula-notes:formula_A3.2:en.plainMeaning: This formula expresses the integral of h(x) over [a,b] as the expectation of f(x) with respect to the probability density p(x), where h(x) = f(x)p(x).
formula-notes:formula_A3.2:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the appendix to introduce the Monte Carlo integration concept, showing that an integral can be approximated by averaging f(x) over samples drawn from p(x).

formula-notes:formula_A3.4:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the Monte Carlo estimate of the integral I(y) = ∫ f(y|x) p(x) dx, where x_i are random draws from p(x) and f(y|x_i) is evaluated at each draw, then averaged over n samples.
formula-notes:formula_A3.4:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the Appendix Introduction to illustrate Monte Carlo integration for approximating posterior distributions in Bayesian analysis, supporting the later discussion of Monte Carlo standard error and its dependence on sample size.

formula-notes:formula_A3.4:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式通过从密度 p(x) 抽取的样本 x_i 计算 f(y|x_i) 的样本均值，来近似积分 I(y) = ∫ f(y|x) p(x) dx，即用蒙特卡洛积分估计后验分布。
formula-notes:formula_A3.4:zh.inThisChapter: 在附录引言中，此公式展示了如何用蒙特卡洛方法近似贝叶斯分析中的后验积分，为后续推导蒙特卡洛标准误差（公式 A3.1e）提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_A2.92:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式给出了逆Wishart分布的概率密度函数，其中随机矩阵W服从逆Wishart分布，参数为自由度n和正定尺度矩阵V。公式中的|W|和|V|分别表示矩阵W和V的行列式，tr[VW^{-1}]表示矩阵V与W^{-1}乘积的迹，Γ是伽马函数。
formula-notes:formula_A2.92:zh.inThisChapter: 本节介绍共轭先验，逆Wishart分布作为Wishart分布的逆，常用于多元正态分布协方差矩阵的共轭先验。该公式为后续推导后验分布提供了逆Wishart分布的具体形式。

formula-notes:formula_A3.3:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将积分 ∫_a^b h(x)dx 表示为函数 f(x) 关于概率密度 p(x) 的期望 E_{p(x)}[f(x)]，并用蒙特卡洛方法近似为样本均值 (1/n)∑_{i=1}^n f(x_i)，其中 x_i 从 p(x) 中独立采样。
formula-notes:formula_A3.3:zh.inThisChapter: 在附录引言中，该公式引出蒙特卡洛积分的基本思想：通过分解被积函数并利用随机采样来近似积分，为后续章节中更复杂的采样方法（如重要性采样）奠定基础。

formula-notes:formula_A2.92:en.plainMeaning: This formula gives the probability density of an inverse-Wishart distributed random matrix W, parameterized by degrees of freedom n and scale matrix V. Key symbols: W (random matrix), V (scale matrix), n (degrees of freedom), k (dimension), tr (trace), Γ (gamma function).
formula-notes:formula_A2.92:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on conjugate priors to provide the density of the inverse-Wishart distribution, which is the conjugate prior for the covariance matrix of a multivariate normal distribution. This density supports later Bayesian inference by enabling closed-form posterior updates.

formula-notes:formula_A3.2:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将积分 ∫ h(x) dx 表示为函数 f(x) 关于概率密度 p(x) 的期望 E[f(x)]，其中 h(x) 被分解为 f(x) 与 p(x) 的乘积。
formula-notes:formula_A3.2:zh.inThisChapter: 在附录引言中，该公式为后续蒙特卡洛积分方法提供理论基础，说明通过从 p(x) 采样可近似计算积分值。

formula-notes:formula_A3.6:en.plainMeaning: This formula expresses the integral of f(x)q(x) as an expectation under distribution p(x) by multiplying by the importance weight q(x)/p(x). Key symbols: f(x) is the integrand, q(x) is the target distribution, p(x) is the proposal distribution.
formula-notes:formula_A3.6:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the Monte Carlo Integration section to introduce importance sampling, allowing estimation of expectations under q(x) using samples from p(x) when direct sampling from q(x) is difficult.

formula-notes:formula_A3.6:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将关于分布 q(x) 的期望 ∫ f(x)q(x)dx 转化为关于分布 p(x) 的期望 E_{p(x)}[f(x) q(x)/p(x)]，其中 q(x)/p(x) 是重要性权重。
formula-notes:formula_A3.6:zh.inThisChapter: 在蒙特卡洛积分章节中，此公式引出重要性采样方法：当无法直接从 q(x) 采样时，可通过从易采样的 p(x) 采样并加权来估计原积分，为后续推导重要性采样估计量及其方差性质做铺垫。

formula-notes:formula_A3.5:zh.plainMeaning: 这个公式计算的是蒙特卡洛积分估计量 $\widehat{I}(y)$ 的平方标准误，其中 $\frac{1}{n-1}\sum_{i=1}^{n}(f(y|x_i)-\widehat{I}(y))^2$ 是样本方差 $\sigma^2$ 的估计，再除以 $n$ 得到标准误的平方。
formula-notes:formula_A3.5:zh.inThisChapter: 在附录介绍中，该公式用于量化蒙特卡洛积分近似 $\widehat{I}(y)$ 的不确定性，为后续讨论标准误随 $\sqrt{n}$ 衰减（如公式 A3.1e）提供具体表达式。

formula-notes:formula_A3.7:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式用从分布 p(x) 抽取的样本 x_i 的加权平均来近似积分 ∫ f(x) q(x) dx，权重为 q(x_i)/p(x_i)。
formula-notes:formula_A3.7:zh.inThisChapter: 在蒙特卡洛积分章节中，该公式引出重要性采样方法：通过从易抽样的 p(x) 中采样并加权，来估计难以直接积分的期望，为后续计算条件密度 J(y) 的近似提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_A3.7:en.plainMeaning: This formula approximates the integral of f(x)q(x) by averaging f(x_i) weighted by the ratio q(x_i)/p(x_i), where x_i are samples drawn from distribution p(x).
formula-notes:formula_A3.7:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the Monte Carlo Integration section to introduce importance sampling, which allows efficient estimation of integrals like marginal densities J(y) by sampling from a convenient proposal distribution p(x).

formula-notes:formula_A3.5:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the squared Monte Carlo standard error of the estimate \(\widehat{I}(y)\), where \(\widehat{I}(y)\) approximates the integral \(I(y) = \int f(y \mid x) p(x) \, dx\). The inner term estimates the sampling variance \(\sigma^2\) from \(n\) draws \(x_i\) from \(p(x)\).
formula-notes:formula_A3.5:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the Appendix Introduction to quantify the uncertainty of Monte Carlo integration, supporting the claim that the standard error scales as \(\sigma/\sqrt{n}\) and that precision improves with sample size.

formula-notes:formula_A3.8:en.plainMeaning: This formula approximates the integral J(y) = ∫ f(y|x) q(x) dx by averaging f(y|x_i) weighted by the ratio q(x_i)/p(x_i), where x_i are sampled from p(x).
formula-notes:formula_A3.8:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the Monte Carlo Integration section to introduce importance sampling, allowing estimation of integrals under q(x) using samples from a different distribution p(x).

formula-notes:formula_A3.8:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式用从分布 p(x) 抽取的样本 x_i 的加权平均来近似积分 J(y) = ∫ f(y|x) q(x) dx，其中权重为 q(x_i)/p(x_i)。
formula-notes:formula_A3.8:zh.inThisChapter: 在蒙特卡洛积分章节中，该公式引出重要性采样方法：通过从易抽样的 p(x) 中抽取样本，并乘以重要性权重来校正分布差异，从而高效估计目标积分。

formula-notes:formula_A3.9:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式通过重要性采样估计归一化常数 C 的倒数：C^{-1} = ∫ q(x) dx，近似为样本权重 w_i = q(x_i)/p(x_i) 的平均值，其中 p(x) 是提议分布。
formula-notes:formula_A3.9:zh.inThisChapter: 在蒙特卡洛积分章节中，此公式解决 q(x) 未归一化时积分常数未知的问题，为后续使用重要性采样估计后验期望或归一化常数提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_A3.9:en.plainMeaning: This formula estimates the normalizing constant C⁻¹ = ∫ q(x) dx using importance sampling, where w_i = q(x_i)/p(x_i) are importance weights and p(x) is a proposal distribution.
formula-notes:formula_A3.9:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the Monte Carlo Integration section to show how to handle an unnormalized posterior q(x) by sampling from a convenient p(x) and averaging the weights, supporting later arguments on variance reduction and computational efficiency.

formula-notes:formula_A3.13:zh.plainMeaning: 这个公式定义了马尔可夫链的转移概率 P(i,j)，表示在时刻 t 处于状态 s_i 的条件下，下一时刻 t+1 转移到状态 s_j 的概率。
formula-notes:formula_A3.13:zh.inThisChapter: 在附录引言中，该公式用于正式定义马尔可夫链的转移概率（或转移核），为后续讨论马尔可夫链的性质和依赖关系提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_A3.11:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the variance of the importance sampling estimator Î, where w_i are importance weights, f(x_i) are function evaluations, and Î is the estimate of the integral.
formula-notes:formula_A3.11:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the Monte Carlo Integration section to quantify the variance reduction achieved by a good importance sampling distribution p(x), supporting the argument that a judicious choice of p(x) leads to a more accurate integral estimate.

formula-notes:formula_A3.14:en.plainMeaning: This formula defines πⱼ(t) as the probability that the Markov chain is in state sⱼ at time t, where Xₜ is the state at time t.
formula-notes:formula_A3.14:en.inThisChapter: It introduces the notation for state probabilities used throughout the appendix, forming the basis for the Chapman-Kolmogorov equation and subsequent analysis of chain evolution.

formula-notes:formula_A3.13:en.plainMeaning: This formula defines the transition probability from state s_i to state s_j in one step, denoted P(i,j) or P(i→j), which is the conditional probability that X_{t+1}=s_j given X_t=s_i.
formula-notes:formula_A3.13:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the Appendix introduction to formalize the Markov property, establishing the fundamental building block for defining a Markov chain and its transition kernel, which is used throughout the appendix to analyze chain behavior.

formula-notes:formula_A3.12:en.plainMeaning: This formula defines the Markov property: the probability of transitioning to state s_j at time t+1 depends only on the current state s_i at time t, not on the entire history (s_k,...,s_i).
formula-notes:formula_A3.12:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the appendix introduction to establish the fundamental assumption of Markov chains, which is necessary for explaining the Metropolis-Hastings algorithm and Gibbs sampler later.

formula-notes:formula_A3.10:en.plainMeaning: This formula approximates the integral of f(x) times an unnormalized density q(x) (with normalizing constant C) using importance sampling with proposal p(x). The weighted average of f(x_i) with weights w_i = q(x_i)/p(x_i) estimates the integral, and the denominator normalizes the weights.
formula-notes:formula_A3.10:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the Monte Carlo Integration section to show how importance sampling handles unnormalized densities (e.g., posterior distributions with unknown constants). The formula supports the argument that choosing p(x) proportional to f(x)q(x) reduces variance, even when q(x) is not a proper probability distribution.

formula-notes:formula_A3.10:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式表示用重要性采样近似积分 C∫f(x)q(x)dx：从提议分布 p(x) 采样，计算加权平均 ∑ w_i f(x_i) / ∑ w_i，其中权重 w_i = q(x_i)/p(x_i)，C 是归一化常数（若 q 未归一化）。
formula-notes:formula_A3.10:zh.inThisChapter: 本节介绍重要性采样，旨在通过选择 p(x) 降低蒙特卡洛方差；该公式给出当 q 的归一化常数未知时，如何用加权平均估计积分，为后续讨论最优 p 和方差减小铺垫。

formula-notes:formula_A3.14:zh.plainMeaning: 公式 π_j(t) = Pr(X_t = s_j) 定义了在时间 t 时马尔可夫链处于状态 s_j 的概率，其中 X_t 表示链在时刻 t 的状态。
formula-notes:formula_A3.14:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式引入状态概率的符号 π_j(t)，为后续使用 Chapman-Kolmogorov 方程推导状态概率的递推关系以及定义概率行向量 π(t) 提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_A3.11:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算重要性采样估计量 \(\widehat{I}\) 的方差，其中 \(w_i = f(x_i)q(x_i)/p(x_i)\) 是重要性权重，\(\widehat{I} = \sum w_i f(x_i) / \sum w_i\) 是加权平均估计。方差衡量了估计量围绕真实积分 \(I\) 的波动程度。
formula-notes:formula_A3.11:zh.inThisChapter: 在蒙特卡洛积分章节中，此公式用于量化重要性采样方法的精度，说明通过选择恰当的提议分布 \(p(x)\) 可以减小方差，从而为后续讨论最优提议分布 \(p(x) \propto f(x)q(x)\) 提供理论依据。

formula-notes:formula_A3.16:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the next state probability distribution vector π(t+1) by multiplying the current distribution π(t) with the transition matrix P, where π(t) is a row vector of state probabilities and P contains transition probabilities P(i→j).
formula-notes:formula_A3.16:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the Appendix Introduction to compactly express the Chapman-Kolmogorov equations in matrix form, supporting later derivations of Markov chain properties and stationary distributions.

formula-notes:formula_A3.12:zh.plainMeaning: 这个公式表示，在给定当前状态 X_t = s_i 的条件下，下一时刻状态 X_{t+1} = s_j 的概率与更早的历史状态 X_0, ..., X_{t-1} 无关，即马尔可夫性质：未来只依赖于现在，不依赖于过去。
formula-notes:formula_A3.12:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在附录介绍部分，用于正式定义马尔可夫链的核心性质——无记忆性，为后续介绍 Metropolis-Hastings 和 Gibbs 采样这两种 MCMC 方法提供理论基础。

formula-notes:formula_A3.16:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式表示在时刻t+1的分布向量π(t+1)等于时刻t的分布向量π(t)右乘转移概率矩阵P，即通过一步转移更新状态分布。
formula-notes:formula_A3.16:zh.inThisChapter: 此处将Chapman-Kolmogorov方程写成矩阵形式，为后续利用矩阵幂计算多步转移概率（如π(t)=π(0)P^t）提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_A3.17:en.plainMeaning: This formula shows that the state distribution vector at time t, π(t), is obtained by multiplying the previous distribution π(t-1) by the transition matrix P, and by induction, π(t) = π(0) P^t.
formula-notes:formula_A3.17:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the appendix introduction to establish the recursive relationship for Markov chain state distributions, supporting later derivations of limiting distributions or stationary distributions.

formula-notes:formula_A3.17:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式表示时刻t的状态分布向量π(t)等于前一时刻分布π(t-1)右乘转移矩阵P，通过迭代得到π(t)=π(0)P^t，即初始分布经t步转移后的分布。
formula-notes:formula_A3.17:zh.inThisChapter: 在附录引言中，此公式用于展示马尔可夫链中状态分布随时间的递推关系，为后续讨论平稳分布和极限行为提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_A3.18:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算初始分布 π(0) 经过 t 步转移后的概率分布 π(t)，其中 P 是转移概率矩阵，P^t 表示矩阵的 t 次幂。
formula-notes:formula_A3.18:zh.inThisChapter: 出现在附录引言中，为后续推导马尔可夫链的平稳分布和收敛性质提供基础表达式。

formula-notes:formula_A3.15:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the probability distribution over states at time t+1 by summing over all possible previous states i, multiplying the transition probability from i to j by the probability of being in state i at time t. Key symbols: π_j(t+1) (probability of state j at time t+1), P(i→j) (transition probability from i to j), π_i(t) (probability of state i at time t).
formula-notes:formula_A3.15:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the appendix introduction to define the fundamental update rule for Markov chain probabilities, which is used later to derive properties like stationarity and convergence.

formula-notes:formula_A3.15:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式通过全概率公式将 t+1 时刻处于状态 s_j 的概率 π_j(t+1) 表示为 t 时刻所有可能状态 s_i 的概率 π_i(t) 乘以从 s_i 转移到 s_j 的概率 P(i→j) 的求和。
formula-notes:formula_A3.15:zh.inThisChapter: 在附录引言中，该公式引出状态概率的递推关系，为后续定义转移矩阵和推导 Chapman-Kolmogorov 方程提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_A3.18:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the probability distribution over states at time t, given the initial distribution π(0) and the t-step transition matrix P^t.
formula-notes:formula_A3.18:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the appendix introduction to formalize how the Markov chain evolves over discrete time steps, supporting later arguments about convergence and stationary distributions.

formula-notes:formula_A3.19:zh.plainMeaning: 这个公式定义了n步转移概率p_{ij}^{(n)}，表示从状态s_i出发经过n步后到达状态s_j的条件概率。
formula-notes:formula_A3.19:zh.inThisChapter: 在附录引言中，该公式为后续讨论马尔可夫链的n步转移概率矩阵和Chapman-Kolmogorov方程提供基础定义。

formula-notes:formula_A3.20:en.plainMeaning: This formula defines the stationary distribution π* of a Markov chain as a probability vector that remains unchanged after applying the transition matrix P, i.e., π* is a left eigenvector of P with eigenvalue 1.
formula-notes:formula_A3.20:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to establish the key property of stationary distributions, which is used later to analyze long-run behavior and convergence of Markov chains.

formula-notes:formula_A3.19:en.plainMeaning: This formula defines the n-step transition probability, which gives the probability that a Markov chain will be in state s_j after n steps, given that it started in state s_i at time t.
formula-notes:formula_A3.19:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the appendix introduction to formally define the n-step transition probability, which is fundamental for analyzing the long-term behavior and convergence properties of Markov chains later in the chapter.

formula-notes:formula_A3.20:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式表示平稳分布 π* 是概率转移矩阵 P 的左特征向量，即经过一步转移后状态分布保持不变。
formula-notes:formula_A3.20:zh.inThisChapter: 在附录引言中，该公式定义了马尔可夫链平稳分布的核心条件，为后续推导平稳分布的存在性、唯一性及收敛性提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_A3.22:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式表明，若细致平衡条件成立，则平稳分布π*满足π* = π*P，即π*是转移矩阵P的左特征向量（特征值1），具体地，第j个分量(π*P)_j等于π_j*。
formula-notes:formula_A3.22:zh.inThisChapter: 在附录介绍中，该公式用于证明细致平衡条件（公式A3.10）是平稳分布存在的充分条件，为后续讨论可逆马尔可夫链和细致平衡的应用（如MCMC）提供理论基础。

formula-notes:formula_A3.24:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the probability distribution π_t(y) at time t as the integral of the previous distribution π_{t-1}(x) multiplied by the transition kernel P(x,y) over all states x.
formula-notes:formula_A3.24:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the appendix introduction to define the continuous version of the Chapman-Kolmogorov equation, which is fundamental for Markov chain Monte Carlo methods and later arguments about convergence.

formula-notes:formula_A3.23:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式表示对于固定的 x，概率核 P(x, y) 关于 y 的积分等于 1，即 P(x, ·) 是一个概率密度函数。
formula-notes:formula_A3.23:zh.inThisChapter: 在附录引言中，此式作为概率核必须满足的归一化条件，为后续将离散状态马尔可夫链推广到连续状态马尔可夫过程奠定基础。

formula-notes:formula_A3.21:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式（细致平衡方程）表示在平稳分布π*下，从状态j转移到状态i的概率流P(j→i)π_j*等于从状态i转移到状态j的概率流P(i→j)π_i*，即正反向概率流相等。
formula-notes:formula_A3.21:zh.inThisChapter: 在附录引言中，该公式作为马尔可夫链存在唯一平稳分布的充分条件被引入，并用于推导平稳分布满足π* = π*P（即平稳分布方程），为后续讨论可逆马尔可夫链和MCMC方法奠定基础。

formula-notes:formula_A3.26:zh.plainMeaning: 这个公式计算候选点θ*与当前点θ_{t-1}的密度比值α，其中p(θ)是目标分布，f(θ)是未归一化的密度函数，两者比值相等。
formula-notes:formula_A3.26:zh.inThisChapter: 在附录介绍中，该公式用于定义Metropolis-Hastings算法中的接受概率，为后续推导接受-拒绝步骤提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_A3.24:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将 t 时刻的分布 π_t(y) 表示为 t-1 时刻的分布 π_{t-1}(x) 与转移核 P(x,y) 的乘积的积分，即通过前一时刻的状态分布和转移概率密度计算当前时刻的状态分布。
formula-notes:formula_A3.24:zh.inThisChapter: 作为连续状态空间下 Chapman-Kolmogorov 方程的推广，它为后续推导马尔可夫链的平稳分布和收敛性质提供了基础工具。

formula-notes:formula_A3.22:en.plainMeaning: This formula shows that if the detailed balance condition holds, then the stationary distribution π* satisfies π* = π*P, meaning π* is invariant under the transition matrix. The key symbols are π* (stationary distribution) and P (transition matrix).
formula-notes:formula_A3.22:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the appendix introduction to demonstrate that detailed balance (reversibility) is a sufficient condition for a stationary distribution, supporting the later argument that reversible Markov chains have a unique stationary distribution.

formula-notes:formula_A3.23:en.plainMeaning: This formula states that for each fixed x, the integral of the probability kernel P(x,y) over all y equals 1, ensuring that P(x,·) is a probability density function. Here, x is the current state and y is the next state.
formula-notes:formula_A3.23:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the appendix introduction to define the normalization condition for a probability kernel, which is essential for generalizing discrete-state Markov chains to continuous-state Markov processes.

formula-notes:formula_A3.28:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the acceptance probability α for a proposed move from θ_{t-1} to θ* in the Metropolis-Hastings algorithm, where f is the target density and q is the proposal density.
formula-notes:formula_A3.28:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the appendix introduction to define the generalized Metropolis-Hastings acceptance rule, which is the foundation for the MCMC methods discussed later.

formula-notes:formula_A3.27:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the acceptance probability α for moving from the current state θ_{t-1} to a proposed state θ* in Metropolis sampling, where f is the target density (up to a constant).
formula-notes:formula_A3.27:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to define the core acceptance rule of the Metropolis algorithm, which is essential for constructing the Markov chain that will later be shown to converge to the target distribution p(θ).

formula-notes:formula_A3.21:en.plainMeaning: This equation expresses detailed balance: at equilibrium, the probability flux from state j to state i equals the flux from i to j, where P(j→i) is the transition probability, and π*_j and π*_i are the stationary probabilities of states j and i.
formula-notes:formula_A3.21:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the Appendix Introduction to define the reversibility condition for Markov chains, which is a sufficient condition for a unique stationary distribution and supports later arguments about equilibrium properties.

formula-notes:formula_A3.25:en.plainMeaning: This formula defines the stationary distribution π* of a continuous Markov chain, where π*(y) is the probability density at state y, obtained by integrating the product of the density at x and the transition kernel P(x,y) over all x.
formula-notes:formula_A3.25:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the appendix introduction to establish the equilibrium condition for Markov chains, which is foundational for later arguments about convergence and sampling methods.

formula-notes:formula_A3.26:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the acceptance ratio α for a Metropolis-Hastings step, comparing the posterior density (or unnormalized target f) at the candidate point θ* to that at the current point θ_{t-1}.
formula-notes:formula_A3.26:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the appendix introduction to define the core acceptance probability used in MCMC algorithms, supporting later arguments about how candidate draws are accepted or rejected to sample from the target distribution.

formula-notes:formula_A3.25:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式表示平稳分布π*满足：对于任意状态y，π*(y)等于对所有x的π*(x)乘以转移概率P(x,y)的积分，即平稳分布是转移核的不动点。
formula-notes:formula_A3.25:zh.inThisChapter: 在附录引言中，该公式定义了马尔可夫链达到平衡时平稳分布必须满足的条件，为后续推导MCMC方法（如Metropolis-Hastings算法）中构造满足细致平衡的转移核提供理论基础。

formula-notes:formula_A3.27:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算接受候选值θ*的概率α，取f(θ*)/f(θ_{t-1})与1中的较小值，其中f(θ)是目标分布（未归一化）的密度函数。
formula-notes:formula_A3.27:zh.inThisChapter: 在附录介绍Metropolis采样时，该公式定义了从当前状态θ_{t-1}转移到候选状态θ*的接受概率，是构建马尔可夫链转移核的核心，为后续证明链的平稳分布等于目标分布p(θ)做铺垫。

formula-notes:formula_A3.29:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式定义了一个概率密度函数 f(x)，其中 x 的幂次为 -2.5，并乘以指数项 exp(-2/x)，用于描述某个随机变量的分布。
formula-notes:formula_A3.29:zh.inThisChapter: 在附录引言中，此公式作为 Metropolis 算法模拟的目标分布出现，为后续实现算法并生成该分布的样本提供具体的密度函数形式。

formula-notes:formula_A3.28:zh.plainMeaning: 这个公式计算接受候选点θ*的概率α，它等于目标密度比f(θ*)/f(θ_{t-1})与提议分布比q(θ*,θ_{t-1})/q(θ_{t-1},θ*)的乘积与1之间的最小值。
formula-notes:formula_A3.28:zh.inThisChapter: 在附录介绍中，该公式推广了Metropolis算法，允许使用非对称提议分布q，通过调整接受概率来保持细致平衡条件，为后续MCMC算法的实现提供理论基础。

formula-notes:formula_A3.29:en.plainMeaning: This formula defines the target probability density function f(x) for a simulation, where x is a positive random variable; it combines a power-law decay (x^{-2.5}) with an exponential decay (exp[-2/x]).
formula-notes:formula_A3.29:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the Appendix Introduction to specify the distribution to be sampled via the Metropolis algorithm, supporting the subsequent demonstration of the algorithm's implementation and convergence.

formula-notes:formula_A3.30:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算接受概率α，即新参数θ*的似然值f(θ*)与当前参数θ_{t-1}的似然值f(θ_{t-1})的比值，再与1取最小值。具体代入数值后得到α=0.0007。
formula-notes:formula_A3.30:zh.inThisChapter: 在附录引言中，此公式用于展示Metropolis-Hastings算法中接受概率的具体计算示例，为后续理解MCMC采样步骤提供数值基础。

formula-notes:formula_A3.32:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式定义了在模拟退火中第 t 步的温度 T(t)，它从初始温度 T₀ 开始，经过 n 步后降至最终温度 T_f，中间按几何级数衰减。
formula-notes:formula_A3.32:zh.inThisChapter: 在 Metropolis-Hastings 算法章节中，此公式用于实现退火调度，通过逐步降低温度来控制接受概率，从而在搜索后期收敛到全局最优。

formula-notes:formula_A3.31:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the acceptance probability α_SA for a proposed move in simulated annealing, where f(θ*) is the density at the proposed state, f(θ_{t-1}) at the current state, and T(t) is the temperature at iteration t. It equals the Metropolis acceptance probability α raised to the power 1/T(t).
formula-notes:formula_A3.31:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the Metropolis-Hastings algorithm section to show how simulated annealing modifies the acceptance rule by introducing a temperature schedule T(t) that controls the probability of accepting downhill moves, supporting the later argument that decreasing temperature gradually focuses the chain on high-density regions.

formula-notes:formula_A3.32:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the temperature T(t) at step t in simulated annealing, starting from T0 and cooling geometrically to Tf over n steps. T0 is initial temperature, Tf is final temperature, n is total steps, and t is current step.
formula-notes:formula_A3.32:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the Metropolis-Hastings algorithm section to define a geometric cooling schedule for simulated annealing, supporting the gradual reduction of temperature to balance exploration and exploitation.

formula-notes:formula_A3.30:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the acceptance probability α in a Metropolis-Hastings algorithm, comparing the likelihood of a proposed parameter θ* to the current parameter θ_{t-1} using a specific likelihood function (here, a gamma-like density with shape 2.5 and scale 39.82). The symbols are: α (acceptance probability), f(θ) (likelihood function), θ* (proposed value), θ_{t-1} (current value).
formula-notes:formula_A3.30:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the Appendix Introduction to illustrate a numerical example of the acceptance probability calculation, supporting the explanation of how the MCMC algorithm accepts or rejects proposals based on the ratio of likelihoods.

formula-notes:formula_A3.33:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the temperature T(t) at iteration t, starting from T0 and cooling geometrically to Tf by iteration n, then holding constant at Tf. Key symbols: T0 (initial temperature), Tf (final temperature), n (total cooling iterations), t (current iteration).
formula-notes:formula_A3.33:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the Metropolis-Hastings algorithm section to define a cooling schedule for simulated annealing, ensuring the temperature decreases to Tf by time n and remains constant thereafter, which supports convergence to a low-energy state.

formula-notes:formula_A3.34:en.plainMeaning: This formula defines the temperature T(t) at step t of a simulated annealing schedule, where T0 is the initial temperature and n is the total number of steps, ensuring T(t) does not fall below 1.
formula-notes:formula_A3.34:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the Metropolis-Hastings section to specify a cooling schedule that ends at T=1, enabling the algorithm to transition from simulated annealing to standard Metropolis sampling by step n.

formula-notes:formula_A3.31:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式定义了模拟退火中接受新状态的概率 α_SA，它等于 Metropolis-Hastings 接受概率 α 的 1/T(t) 次幂（或 1 中的较小值），其中 T(t) 是冷却调度中的温度参数。
formula-notes:formula_A3.31:zh.inThisChapter: 在本节中，该公式将 Metropolis-Hastings 算法扩展为模拟退火，通过温度 T(t) 控制接受下坡移动的概率，从而在初始阶段探索整个空间，随后逐渐降低接受概率以收敛到全局最大值。

formula-notes:formula_A3.35:en.plainMeaning: This formula expresses the new proposed value y as the sum of the current value x and a random perturbation z, which is the defining update rule for a random-walk Metropolis-Hastings chain.
formula-notes:formula_A3.35:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the discussion of proposal distribution choices to illustrate the random-walk approach, which is contrasted with independent chain sampling later in the section.

formula-notes:formula_A3.37:en.plainMeaning: This formula defines a first-order autoregressive process (AR(1)), where θ_t is the current value, μ is the mean, α is the autoregressive coefficient (|α|<1), and ε is white noise. It connects θ_t to its previous value θ_{t-1}.
formula-notes:formula_A3.37:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the Metropolis-Hastings chapter to model the correlation structure of MCMC samples, supporting the argument that the standard error of the sample mean depends on autocorrelation, which is used to estimate required sample size.

formula-notes:formula_A3.35:zh.plainMeaning: 公式 y = x + z 表示新候选值 y 由当前值 x 加上一个随机扰动 z 得到，其中 z 来自某个对称或非对称的提议分布。
formula-notes:formula_A3.35:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在讨论随机游走提议分布的段落中，为后续推导 Metropolis-Hastings 接受概率中提议分布比值的计算提供基础，因为随机游走中 z 的分布决定了 y 给定 x 的条件概率。

formula-notes:formula_A3.37:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式定义了一个一阶自回归过程 AR(1)，其中当前值 θ_t 由长期均值 μ、上一期值 θ_{t-1} 与 μ 的偏差乘以自回归系数 α，再加上白噪声 ε 得到。
formula-notes:formula_A3.37:zh.inThisChapter: 此处引入 AR(1) 模型是为了量化 MCMC 样本的自相关性，从而估计所需样本量；后续将利用 α 计算自相关系数 ρ_k = α^k，并推导样本均值标准误。

formula-notes:formula_A3.36:en.plainMeaning: This formula estimates the autocorrelation at lag k for a sequence θ₁,…,θₙ, measuring the linear dependence between values k steps apart. The numerator is the sample covariance between θₜ and θₜ₊ₖ, and the denominator is the sample variance of θₜ.
formula-notes:formula_A3.36:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the Metropolis-Hastings section to quantify the correlation between MCMC samples, which is used later to assess mixing quality and to compute effective sample size for Monte Carlo standard errors.

formula-notes:formula_A3.38:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the standard error of the sample mean for a stationary first-order autoregressive process, where σ is the standard deviation of the white noise, n is the sample size, and ρ is the lag-1 autocorrelation (α).
formula-notes:formula_A3.38:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the Metropolis-Hastings algorithm section to quantify the Monte Carlo standard error of the sample mean from correlated MCMC samples, supporting the need for longer runs when autocorrelation is high.

formula-notes:formula_A3.39:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the Monte Carlo estimate of the expectation of a function h(θ) under the target distribution, using the sample mean of h evaluated at each MCMC draw θ_i.
formula-notes:formula_A3.39:en.inThisChapter: It appears here to show how to estimate quantities of interest (e.g., mean, variance) from a burned-in MCMC sample, and it sets up the subsequent discussion of the sampling variance of such estimates.

formula-notes:formula_A3.36:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算滞后k阶自相关系数ρ̂_k，分子是θ_t与θ_{t+k}的样本协方差（减去均值θ̅），分母是θ_t的样本方差，用于量化MCMC序列中相隔k步的样本之间的线性相关性。
formula-notes:formula_A3.36:zh.inThisChapter: 在Metropolis-Hastings算法章节中，该公式用于评估MCMC链的混合效率：若ρ̂_k随k增大衰减缓慢，说明链存在强自相关，需要更长的迭代或调整提议分布以减少相关性。

formula-notes:formula_A3.38:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算在AR(1)过程下样本均值θ̄的标准误，其中σ是白噪声的标准差，n是样本量，ρ是一阶自相关系数。
formula-notes:formula_A3.38:zh.inThisChapter: 本章讨论MCMC算法，此公式用于说明当MCMC样本存在自相关时，有效样本量比独立样本小，从而需要更大的样本量才能达到给定精度。

formula-notes:formula_A3.34:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式定义了在模拟退火中第 t 步的温度 T(t)，它取 T0 的 (1 - t/n) 次幂与 1 中的较大值，其中 T0 是初始温度，n 是总步数，t 是当前步数。
formula-notes:formula_A3.34:zh.inThisChapter: 本节介绍 Metropolis-Hastings 算法，该公式用于实现从初始高温 T0 逐渐冷却到 T=1 的退火过程，确保在 n 步后温度降至 1 并保持，从而过渡到 Metropolis 采样。

formula-notes:formula_A3.39:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算目标分布函数 h(θ) 的蒙特卡洛估计，即对 MCMC 采样序列 (θ₁,…,θₙ) 中每个样本的函数值求平均，其中 θᵢ 是经过 burn-in 后的第 i 个样本。
formula-notes:formula_A3.39:zh.inThisChapter: 在 Metropolis-Hastings 算法章节中，该公式用于说明如何利用 MCMC 生成的样本序列来估计目标分布的期望、方差等统计量，为后续讨论估计量的抽样方差和收敛性提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_A3.40:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算了多个独立MCMC链的估计值 $\widehat{h}_j$ 之间的样本方差，除以 $c-1$ 得到无偏估计，其中 $\widehat{h^*}$ 是 $c$ 个链估计值的均值，用于量化估计量 $\widehat{h}$ 的蒙特卡洛方差。
formula-notes:formula_A3.40:zh.inThisChapter: 在Metropolis-Hastings算法章节中，此公式用于评估链的收敛性和估计精度，通过多条链的链间方差来估计单链估计量的方差，为后续诊断工具（如Gelman-Rubin统计量）提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_A3.40:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the sample variance of the Monte Carlo estimates from c independent chains, where \(\widehat{h}_j\) is the estimate from chain j and \(\widehat{h^*}\) is the average of these estimates.
formula-notes:formula_A3.40:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the Metropolis-Hastings algorithm section to provide a method for assessing Monte Carlo error by using multiple chains, supporting the evaluation of convergence and precision of the estimates.

formula-notes:formula_A3.33:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式定义了一个分段退火温度调度：在时间 t ≤ n 时，温度从初始值 T₀ 按指数衰减到 T_f；当 t > n 后，温度恒定为 T_f。关键符号：T(t) 是时刻 t 的温度，T₀ 是初始温度，T_f 是最终温度，n 是降温阶段的总步数。
formula-notes:formula_A3.33:zh.inThisChapter: 在 Metropolis-Hastings 算法的模拟退火实现中，该公式提供了具体的温度下降方案，确保算法在有限步数内降温至 T_f 并保持恒温，从而平衡探索与利用，为后续证明算法收敛到全局最优提供温度调度依据。

formula-notes:formula_A3.41:en.plainMeaning: This formula estimates the lag-k autocovariance of the sequence h(θ_i) from a single MCMC chain, where h(θ_i) are the sampled values, ĥ is their sample mean, and n is the chain length.
formula-notes:formula_A3.41:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the Metropolis-Hastings section to quantify the correlation between chain samples, which is later used to compute the effective sample size or to adjust Monte Carlo standard errors for dependent samples.

formula-notes:formula_A3.41:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算序列 h(θ_i) 的滞后 k 自协方差估计值，其中 h(θ_i) 是 MCMC 样本的函数值，widehat{h} 是样本均值，n 是链长，k 是滞后阶数。
formula-notes:formula_A3.41:zh.inThisChapter: 在 Metropolis-Hastings 算法章节中，该公式用于量化 MCMC 样本的自相关性，为后续计算有效样本量（ESS）和调整链长以降低估计方差提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_A3.42:en.plainMeaning: This formula estimates the variance of the Monte Carlo estimator \(\widehat{h}\) as a function of the sample size \(n\) and the estimated autocovariances \(\widehat{\gamma}(i)\) up to lag \(2\delta+1\), where \(\delta\) is a truncation point.
formula-notes:formula_A3.42:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the Metropolis-Hastings section to quantify the Monte Carlo error of the estimator \(\widehat{h}\) based on correlated MCMC samples, supporting the assessment of simulation accuracy.

formula-notes:formula_A3.43:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算有效样本量 $\widehat{n}$，它是链的样本方差 $\widehat{\gamma}(0)$ 与估计量 $\widehat{h}$ 的方差 $\operatorname{Var}(\widehat{h})$ 之比，用于量化自相关对样本信息量的影响。
formula-notes:formula_A3.43:zh.inThisChapter: 在 Metropolis-Hastings 算法章节中，该公式用于评估 MCMC 样本的有效性，为后续讨论链的收敛性和估计精度提供度量标准。

formula-notes:formula_A3.43:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the effective sample size (ESS) of a Markov chain, where \(\widehat{n}\) is the effective number of independent samples, \(\widehat{\gamma}(0)\) is the sample variance of the chain (assuming no autocorrelation), and \(\operatorname{Var}(\widehat{h})\) is the estimated variance of the sample mean accounting for autocorrelation.
formula-notes:formula_A3.43:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the Metropolis-Hastings algorithm section to quantify the loss of efficiency due to autocorrelation in the chain, supporting the argument that the effective sample size is smaller than the actual number of iterations when autocorrelation is present.

formula-notes:formula_A3.44:zh.plainMeaning: 公式计算的是链间方差B，其中n是每条链的长度，m是链数，θ̄_i.是第i条链的均值，θ̄_..是所有链的总均值，B衡量各链均值与总均值的平方偏差的加权平均。
formula-notes:formula_A3.44:zh.inThisChapter: 在收敛诊断章节中，B用于与链内方差W对比，构造Gelman-Rubin统计量R̂，以判断多条链是否混合充分、收敛到同一分布。

formula-notes:formula_A3.45:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the within-chain variance W, which is the average over m chains of the variance of the chain means around each chain's own mean. Here, θ̄_{ij} is the j-th estimate in chain i, θ̄_{i.} is the mean of chain i, m is the number of chains, and n is the chain length.
formula-notes:formula_A3.45:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the convergence diagnostics section to define the within-chain variance component needed for the ANOVA-based Gelman-Rubin statistic, which compares between-chain and within-chain variances to assess MCMC convergence.

formula-notes:formula_A3.46:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算后验方差的组合估计，其中W是链内方差均值，B是链间方差，n是每条链的样本量，通过加权平均得到方差估计σ²的估计值。
formula-notes:formula_A3.46:zh.inThisChapter: 在收敛诊断章节中，该公式用于评估MCMC链是否收敛，通过比较链内和链间方差来诊断混合效果，为后续Gelman-Rubin统计量提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_A3.46:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes a weighted average of the within-chain variance W and between-chain variance B to estimate the marginal posterior variance σ², with weights (n-1)/n and 1/n respectively.
formula-notes:formula_A3.46:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the convergence diagnostics section to provide a pooled variance estimate that is used in the calculation of the potential scale reduction factor R̂, which assesses whether multiple chains have converged to the same distribution.

formula-notes:formula_A3.44:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the among-chain variance B, which measures the squared deviation of each chain's mean from the overall grand mean, scaled by n/(m-1). Here, n is the chain length, m is the number of chains, θ̄ᵢ. is the mean of chain i, and θ̄.. is the grand mean over all chains.
formula-notes:formula_A3.44:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the convergence diagnostics section to quantify between-chain variability, which is compared to within-chain variance to assess whether multiple chains have mixed (i.e., converged to the same distribution). This supports the Gelman-Rubin diagnostic for monitoring MCMC convergence.

formula-notes:formula_A3.42:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算估计量 \(\widehat{h}\) 的方差，其中 \(\widehat{\gamma}(0)\) 是滞后0的样本自协方差（即样本方差），\(\widehat{\gamma}(i)\) 是滞后 \(i\) 的样本自协方差，求和项考虑了从滞后1到滞后 \(2\delta+1\) 的自相关贡献，\(n\) 是样本量。
formula-notes:formula_A3.42:zh.inThisChapter: 在Metropolis-Hastings算法章节中，该公式用于估计基于MCMC样本的蒙特卡洛方差，它利用了自协方差函数 \(\widehat{\gamma}\)（来自公式A3.41）来修正因自相关导致的方差低估，为后续构造置信区间或诊断收敛性提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_A3.49:en.plainMeaning: This notation indicates that the next sample x_i is drawn from the conditional distribution p(x | y = y_{i-1}), where y_{i-1} is the previous sample of y.
formula-notes:formula_A3.49:en.inThisChapter: It formalizes the first step of the Gibbs sampling iteration for a bivariate distribution, establishing the alternating conditional sampling scheme used to generate a Markov chain that converges to the joint distribution.

formula-notes:formula_A3.48:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算潜在尺度缩减因子R，其中n是链内样本数，m是链数，λ₁是矩阵W⁻¹B/n的最大特征值，R接近1表示链收敛。
formula-notes:formula_A3.48:zh.inThisChapter: 在收敛诊断章节中，该公式用于量化多变量MCMC链的混合程度，为后续判断链是否达到平稳分布提供数值依据。

formula-notes:formula_A3.47:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the potential scale reduction factor (PSRF) R, where \(\widehat{\sigma^{2}}\) is an estimate of the marginal posterior variance, W is the within-chain variance, B is the between-chain variance, and n is the number of iterations per chain. R compares the pooled variance estimate to the within-chain variance, with values near 1 indicating convergence.
formula-notes:formula_A3.47:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the convergence diagnostics section to provide a scalar measure for monitoring MCMC convergence; the plot of R over time is used to assess whether chains have mixed sufficiently, supporting the practical diagnosis of convergence in Bayesian analyses.

formula-notes:formula_A3.47:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算潜在尺度缩减因子R，其中W是链内方差，B是链间方差，σ̂²是目标方差估计，n是链长。R衡量链间方差相对于总方差的比例，接近1表示收敛。
formula-notes:formula_A3.47:zh.inThisChapter: 在收敛诊断章节中，该公式用于定义PSRF，通过比较链内和链间方差来评估MCMC是否收敛，为后续讨论R的轨迹图和多变量版本提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_A3.48:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the multivariate potential scale reduction factor (PSRF) for MCMC convergence, where n is the number of chains, m is the number of iterations per chain, and λ₁ is the leading eigenvalue of W⁻¹B/n (with W and B being within- and among-chain covariance matrices).
