formula-notes:formula_A3.48:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the Convergence Diagnostics section to provide a multivariate extension of the univariate PSRF, allowing assessment of convergence for multiple parameters simultaneously, as recommended by Brooks and Gelman (1998).

formula-notes:formula_A3.50:en.plainMeaning: This notation indicates that each observed value y_i is drawn from the conditional distribution of y given that x equals x_i.
formula-notes:formula_A3.50:en.inThisChapter: It formalizes the sampling step in the Gibbs sampler where, after drawing x_i from p(x|y=y_i), the next y is drawn from p(y|x=x_i).

formula-notes:formula_A3.45:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算的是组内方差（within-chain variance）的估计量，其中 \(\overline{\theta}_{ij}\) 是第 \(i\) 条链第 \(j\) 个样本的参数值，\(\overline{\theta}_{i.}\) 是第 \(i\) 条链的样本均值，\(m\) 是链数，\(n\) 是每条链的样本数。公式先对每条链内各样本与链均值的离差平方求和，再除以 \(n-1\) 得到链内方差，最后取所有链的平均。
formula-notes:formula_A3.45:zh.inThisChapter: 在收敛诊断章节中，该公式用于计算链内方差 \(W\)，与链间方差 \(B\) 共同构成方差比 \(\hat{R}\)，通过比较两者大小判断MCMC链是否收敛到目标分布。

formula-notes:formula_A3.49:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式表示从给定 y 等于上一轮采样值 y_{i-1} 的条件分布 p(x|y=y_{i-1}) 中抽取当前 x_i 的样本，即 Gibbs 采样中交替更新 x 的步骤。
formula-notes:formula_A3.49:zh.inThisChapter: 此处出现在附录介绍 Gibbs 采样器的流程中，紧接在从 p(x|y=y_0) 抽取 x_0 之后，用于说明后续迭代中如何利用上一轮的 y 值来更新 x，从而构建马尔可夫链。

formula-notes:formula_A3.50:zh.plainMeaning: 公式表示第 i 次迭代中，给定当前 x 的取值 x_i，从条件分布 p(y|x=x_i) 中抽取 y_i。
formula-notes:formula_A3.50:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在 Gibbs 采样器的迭代步骤描述中，说明如何从条件分布 p(y|x) 抽取 y 的新值，与之前从 p(x|y) 抽取 x 的步骤交替进行，从而构造马尔可夫链。

formula-notes:formula_A3.51:en.plainMeaning: This formula defines how to sample the k-th variable θ_i^{(k)} during the i-th iteration of Gibbs sampling, conditional on the most recent values of all other variables: the first k-1 variables from the current i-th iteration and the remaining variables from the previous (i-1)-th iteration.
formula-notes:formula_A3.51:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the appendix introduction to formally describe the Gibbs sampling update step for multiple variables, supporting the later argument that the sampler converges to the target joint distribution.

formula-notes:formula_A3.52:en.plainMeaning: This formula specifies that the new value w_i is drawn from the conditional distribution of w given the previous values of x, y, and z (x_{i-1}, y_{i-1}, z_{i-1}). It represents one step in a Gibbs sampling update for the variable w.
formula-notes:formula_A3.52:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the Appendix Introduction to illustrate how a Gibbs sampler iteratively updates each variable in a multi-variable system, supporting the explanation of the sampling algorithm used in the main text.

formula-notes:formula_A3.52:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式表示从给定前一步状态 $(x_{i-1}, y_{i-1}, z_{i-1})$ 的条件分布中抽取 $w_i$，即 $w$ 的第 $i$ 个样本依赖于其他三个变量的前一个样本值。
formula-notes:formula_A3.52:zh.inThisChapter: 在附录介绍中，此公式展示吉布斯采样如何依次更新每个变量：通过从条件分布中采样，利用最新状态逐步逼近联合分布。

formula-notes:formula_A3.51:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式表示在第 i 次迭代中，第 k 个变量 θ_i^{(k)} 从条件分布中抽取，该条件分布以当前迭代中已更新的前 k-1 个变量（θ_i^{(1)} 到 θ_i^{(k-1)}）以及上一次迭代中尚未更新的后 n-k 个变量（θ_{i-1}^{(k+1)} 到 θ_{i-1}^{(n)}）为条件。
formula-notes:formula_A3.51:zh.inThisChapter: 在附录介绍中，此公式展示了吉布斯采样在多变量情况下的具体实现步骤，即逐个变量地从其满条件分布中采样，并立即使用最新值，为后续推导采样算法的收敛性和有效性奠定基础。

formula-notes:formula_A3.55:en.plainMeaning: This formula defines the conditional distribution of variable z given the current values of w, x, and y, which is used to sample a new value for z in a Gibbs sampling step.
formula-notes:formula_A3.55:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the appendix introduction to illustrate how a Gibbs sampler updates one variable at a time by sampling from its full conditional distribution, supporting the explanation of the sampling algorithm.

formula-notes:formula_A3.53:en.plainMeaning: This formula defines the conditional distribution for sampling the variable x_i given the current values of w_i, y_{i-1}, and z_{i-1} in a Gibbs sampling step.
formula-notes:formula_A3.53:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the appendix introduction to illustrate how a Gibbs sampler updates each variable in turn using the most recent values of the other variables, supporting the description of the sampling algorithm.

formula-notes:formula_A3.54:en.plainMeaning: This formula states that the observed variable y_i is drawn from a conditional distribution p(y | w=w_i, x=x_i, z=z_{i-1}), where w_i is the current sample of w, x_i is the current sample of x, and z_{i-1} is the previous sample of z.
formula-notes:formula_A3.54:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the appendix introduction to illustrate the structure of a Gibbs sampling update for a four-variable system, showing how each variable is sampled conditioned on the most recent values of the others, which supports the sequential sampling scheme described in the chapter.

formula-notes:formula_A3.53:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式表示在给定当前参数w取值为w_i、上一时刻的y为y_{i-1}、上一时刻的z为z_{i-1}的条件下，从条件分布p(x|w=w_i, y=y_{i-1}, z=z_{i-1})中抽取x_i。
formula-notes:formula_A3.53:zh.inThisChapter: 在附录的Gibbs采样器介绍中，此公式展示了四变量(w,x,y,z)情况下如何依次从x的条件分布采样，为后续完整采样步骤提供具体示例。

formula-notes:formula_A3.56:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the Monte Carlo estimate of the expectation E[f(θ)] as the sample average of f evaluated at m draws θ_i from the Gibbs sampler.
formula-notes:formula_A3.56:en.inThisChapter: It appears here to show how posterior expectations are approximated from the Gibbs output, supporting inference after convergence.

formula-notes:formula_A3.55:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式表示在给定 w=w_i, x=x_i, y=y_i 的条件下，从条件分布 p(z | w=w_i, x=x_i, y=y_i) 中抽取 z_i 样本。
formula-notes:formula_A3.55:zh.inThisChapter: 在附录引言中，该公式用于说明吉布斯采样器如何依次对每个变量进行条件采样，为后续推导完整采样步骤提供具体示例。

formula-notes:formula_A3.54:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式表示在给定当前参数 w_i、当前输入 x_i 以及前一步状态 z_{i-1} 的条件下，观测值 y_i 服从某个概率分布 p，即 y_i 的生成过程依赖于 w_i、x_i 和 z_{i-1}。
formula-notes:formula_A3.54:zh.inThisChapter: 在附录的吉布斯采样器示例中，该公式定义了 y_i 的条件分布，用于后续从该分布中采样 y_i，从而完成对四变量 (w,x,y,z) 的联合分布的迭代采样步骤。

formula-notes:formula_A3.58:en.plainMeaning: This formula expresses the marginal density p(x) as the expectation over y of the conditional density p(x|y), i.e., the average of p(x|y) with respect to the distribution of y.
formula-notes:formula_A3.58:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the Gibbs sampler section to justify estimating the marginal density by averaging conditional densities from the Gibbs sequence, which is more efficient than using a histogram.

formula-notes:formula_A3.57:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the Monte Carlo estimate of the expected value of a function f of n variables (θ^(1),...,θ^(n)), as the average of f evaluated at m samples (θ_i^(1),...,θ_i^(n)).
formula-notes:formula_A3.57:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the Gibbs Sampler section to show how to approximate expectations of functions of multiple parameters using samples from the Gibbs sampler, supporting the convergence argument that the estimate approaches the true expectation as m→∞.

formula-notes:formula_A3.57:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式用m个样本的平均值来近似计算函数f在n个变量θ^(1)到θ^(n)上的期望，其中每个样本点(θ_i^(1),...,θ_i^(n))来自联合分布。
formula-notes:formula_A3.57:zh.inThisChapter: 在Gibbs采样器章节中，该公式用于说明如何通过Gibbs采样得到的样本进行蒙特卡洛积分估计，为后续证明估计的收敛性提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_A3.58:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将边际密度 p(x) 表示为条件密度 p(x|y) 关于 y 的期望，即通过对 y 积分（或求期望）来从联合分布中消去 y，得到 x 的边际分布。
formula-notes:formula_A3.58:zh.inThisChapter: 在吉布斯采样器章节中，该公式为后续使用条件密度的平均值（而非经验直方图）来估计边际密度提供了理论依据，从而更高效地利用采样信息。

formula-notes:formula_A3.56:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式用样本均值近似期望：将m个Gibbs采样得到的θ值代入函数f，取算术平均，作为E[f(θ)]的蒙特卡洛估计。
formula-notes:formula_A3.56:zh.inThisChapter: 在Gibbs采样器章节中，该公式说明如何利用采样序列（经burn-in后）计算边缘分布的任何特征（如均值、方差），为后续基于模拟的贝叶斯推断提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_A4.2:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算 Stouffer 综合 Z 分数 Z_s，它是 k 个独立检验的 Z 分数 Z_i 之和除以 sqrt(k)，使得 Z_s 服从标准正态分布 N(0,1)。
formula-notes:formula_A4.2:zh.inThisChapter: 在附录介绍中，该公式用于定义 Stouffer 方法的核心统计量，以便后续通过 Z_s 计算综合 p 值，作为 Fisher 方法的替代方案。

formula-notes:formula_A4.1:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the chi-square test statistic X² from the geometric mean of p-values (p̄_G) and the number of tests k, showing how Fisher's method gives more weight to smaller p-values via the negative log transformation.
formula-notes:formula_A4.1:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the Appendix to illustrate the differential weighting of p-values in Fisher's method, motivating the introduction of the Z-score method which treats complementary p-values symmetrically.

formula-notes:formula_A3.59:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes a Monte Carlo estimate of the marginal density of x by averaging the conditional density p(x|y=y_i) over m Gibbs samples y_i. The hat denotes an estimator, p_m(x) is the estimated marginal density, m is the number of samples, and p(x|y=y_i) is the conditional density of x given the i-th sample of y.
formula-notes:formula_A3.59:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the Gibbs Sampler section to provide an efficient method for estimating the marginal density of x, avoiding the inefficiency of using an empirical histogram. This estimator supports later arguments about using conditional densities to improve inference from Gibbs samples.

formula-notes:formula_A3.59:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式通过取所有采样点 y_i 对应的条件密度 p(x|y=y_i) 的算术平均，来估计 x 的边缘密度 p(x)。其中 m 是 Gibbs 采样迭代次数，y_i 是第 i 次迭代中 y 的采样值。
formula-notes:formula_A3.59:zh.inThisChapter: 在 Gibbs 采样器章节中，该公式用于从条件密度样本中重建边缘密度，避免了仅用直方图估计的低效性，并为后续基于 Rao-Blackwell 定理的方差缩减方法提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_A4.2:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the combined Z-score (Z_s) from k independent Z-scores (Z_i) by summing them and dividing by the square root of k, yielding a standard normal variable under the null hypothesis.
formula-notes:formula_A4.2:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the introduction to Stouffer's method to show how individual Z-scores are aggregated into a single test statistic with unit variance, which is then used to compute an overall p-value for combining multiple tests.

formula-notes:formula_A4.1:zh.plainMeaning: 公式 X² = -2k ln( p̄_G ) 将 Fisher 方法的检验统计量 X² 表示为单个 p 值的几何均值 p̄_G 的对数函数，其中 k 是独立检验的个数，p̄_G 是各 p 值的几何均值。
formula-notes:formula_A4.1:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在附录引言中，旨在揭示 Fisher 方法对较小 p 值赋予更大权重的特性，从而引出 Z 分数方法作为替代方案，为后续推导 Z 分数方法提供动机。

formula-notes:formula_A4.3:zh.plainMeaning: 公式 p = Pr(U > Z_s) 表示在标准正态分布 U 下，随机变量大于 Z_s 的概率，即 Stouffer 方法合并检验的总体 p 值。
formula-notes:formula_A4.3:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在附录介绍中，承接 Z_s 的定义（由各 p_i 转换的 Z_i 求和缩放得到），说明如何利用 Z_s 服从标准正态分布的性质计算合并后的 p 值，为后续 Stouffer 方法的实际应用提供计算依据。

formula-notes:formula_A4.3:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the overall p-value p as the probability that a standard normal variable U exceeds the observed combined Z-score Z_s, where Z_s is the sum of individual Z-scores (transformed from p-values) scaled to unit variance.
formula-notes:formula_A4.3:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the Appendix Introduction to define the final p-value for Stouffer's method, supporting the argument that combining Z-scores yields a valid overall test under the null hypothesis.

formula-notes:formula_A4.5:zh.plainMeaning: 公式 π = 1 - (1 - α)^n 计算在 n 次独立检验中至少发生一次第一类错误（假阳性）的概率，其中 α 是单次检验的显著性水平。
formula-notes:formula_A4.5:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在 Bonferroni 校正及其扩展的章节中，用于说明多重比较时整体错误率随检验次数增加而上升，从而引出 Bonferroni 校正的必要性。

formula-notes:formula_A4.5:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the familywise error rate π, the probability of at least one Type-I error across n independent hypothesis tests, each conducted at significance level α.
formula-notes:formula_A4.5:en.inThisChapter: It appears here to derive the Bonferroni correction, showing that the uncorrected familywise error rate grows with n, motivating the need for adjusted significance thresholds.

formula-notes:formula_A4.7:en.plainMeaning: This formula defines the per-comparison significance level α as π divided by the number of comparisons n, where π is the familywise error rate and n is the number of tests.
formula-notes:formula_A4.7:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the context of the Dunn-Šidák correction to derive the Bonferroni method via approximation, supporting the discussion of multiple comparison adjustments.

formula-notes:formula_A4.4:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算加权Z统计量Z_w，分子是各独立检验的Z分数Z_i与权重w_i的加权和，分母是权重平方和的平方根，使得Z_w服从标准正态分布。
formula-notes:formula_A4.4:zh.inThisChapter: 在附录引言中，该公式展示了如何通过加权Z分数方法合并不同检验的p值，为后续讨论权重选择（如自由度或标准误倒数）以及比较加权方法与等权重方法（Z_s）提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_A4.6:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the per-test significance level α needed to maintain an overall family-wise error rate π across n independent tests, using the Šidák correction. π is the desired FWER, n is the number of tests, and α is the adjusted threshold for each individual test.
formula-notes:formula_A4.6:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on Bonferroni corrections and extensions to derive the Šidák correction, which is a less conservative alternative to Bonferroni when tests are independent, supporting the discussion of multiple comparison adjustments.

formula-notes:formula_A4.6:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算单次检验的显著性水平 α，使得在 n 次独立检验后，整体犯第一类错误的概率不超过 π。其中 π 是期望的全局错误率，n 是检验次数。
formula-notes:formula_A4.6:zh.inThisChapter: 在 Bonferroni 校正部分，该公式用于推导当希望控制全局错误率时，每次检验应采用的调整后 α 值，为后续多重比较方法提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_A4.9:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式表示相关系数矩阵C的特征值λ_i的平均值等于1，因为所有特征值之和等于矩阵的迹（即n），除以n后得到1。
formula-notes:formula_A4.9:zh.inThisChapter: 在讨论Bonferroni校正及其扩展的章节中，该公式用于说明相关系数矩阵的特征值平均为1，为后续推导多重检验中依赖结构对校正方法的影响提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_A4.4:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes a weighted combined Z-score \(Z_w\) from \(k\) independent Z-scores \(Z_i\) with weights \(w_i\), where the weighted sum is normalized by the square root of the sum of squared weights so that \(Z_w\) follows a standard normal distribution \(N(0,1)\).
formula-notes:formula_A4.4:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the Appendix Introduction to extend the unweighted Z-score method (Equation A4.2a) to allow differential weighting of p-values, supporting later arguments that the weighted Z-score method outperforms other meta-analytic approaches when sample sizes vary.

formula-notes:formula_A4.7:zh.plainMeaning: 公式 α = π/n 定义了一个调整后的显著性水平 α，其中 π 是期望的族系错误率（FWER），n 是比较次数，通过将 π 除以 n 来对每次检验进行校正。
formula-notes:formula_A4.7:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在介绍 Bonferroni 校正及其扩展的章节中，用于说明 Dunn-Šidák 方法如何通过近似 (1 - α)^n ≈ 1 - nα 导出 Bonferroni 校正，为后续讨论多重比较的保守性提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_A4.8:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算 Hommel 方法中的临界索引 k*，它是在所有 j=1,...,i 中，使得不等式 p(n-i+j) > π * (j/i) 成立的最大 i 值。其中 p(n-i+j) 是第 (n-i+j) 小的 p 值，π 是预设的显著性水平，n 是假设总数。
formula-notes:formula_A4.8:zh.inThisChapter: 在本节关于 Bonferroni 校正及其扩展的讨论中，该公式定义了 Hommel 方法的关键步骤，用于确定拒绝假设的阈值 π/k*，从而在控制 FWER 的同时提高检验功效。

formula-notes:formula_A4.8:en.plainMeaning: This formula defines the integer k* as the maximum i such that for all j from 1 to i, the j-th smallest p-value p(n-i+j) is less than or equal to π * j / i. Here, p(n-i+j) denotes the (n-i+j)-th order statistic of the p-values, π is a constant (often the significance level α), and i and j are indices.
formula-notes:formula_A4.8:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on Bonferroni corrections and extensions to define the critical value for Hommel's method, which is a more powerful multiple testing procedure that controls the family-wise error rate. This formula supports the rejection rule that follows.

formula-notes:formula_A4.9:en.plainMeaning: This formula shows that the average of the eigenvalues λ_i of an n×n correlation matrix C equals 1, because the sum of eigenvalues equals the trace (n) and dividing by n gives 1.
formula-notes:formula_A4.9:en.inThisChapter: It establishes that the mean eigenvalue of a correlation matrix is 1, which is used later in Bonferroni corrections to quantify effective number of tests or adjust for non-independence among variables.

formula-notes:formula_A4.10:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式利用特征值λ_i的方差σ²(λ)来调整原始检验次数n，计算有效独立检验数n_e,Cheverud，其中σ²(λ)度量特征值与1的偏离程度。
formula-notes:formula_A4.10:zh.inThisChapter: 在Bonferroni校正及其扩展的章节中，该公式基于特征结构观察（如公式A4.9中的λ_i），为后续推导更准确的校正方法提供有效检验数的具体计算方式。

formula-notes:formula_A4.12:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算在n次独立检验中恰好出现j次假阳性（即错误拒绝原假设）的概率，其中每次检验的假阳性概率为α，关键符号j表示假阳性次数，n为检验总数。
formula-notes:formula_A4.12:zh.inThisChapter: 在本节中，该公式用于描述所有原假设为真时假阳性数量的分布，为后续推导多重检验中至少出现一次假阳性的概率（如家族wise错误率）提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_A4.11:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将每个特征值 λ_i 拆分为整数部分（代表完全相关的测试，计为1个独立测试）和小数部分（代表部分相关），从而计算有效独立测试数 n_e。
formula-notes:formula_A4.11:zh.inThisChapter: 在Bonferroni校正扩展中，Li和Ji提出此公式以改进Cheverud方法，避免高估n_e，从而在中等相关测试中保持统计功效。

formula-notes:formula_A4.12:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the probability of exactly j false positives (Type I errors) when performing n independent hypothesis tests, each with significance level α, assuming all null hypotheses are true. The symbols are: n (number of tests), j (number of false positives), α (Type I error rate per test).
formula-notes:formula_A4.12:en.inThisChapter: It appears in this section to derive the binomial distribution of false positives under the global null, which is then used to test whether the observed number of significant tests exceeds the expected number under the null hypothesis.

formula-notes:formula_A4.13:en.plainMeaning: This formula gives the approximate probability of observing exactly j false positives when performing n independent tests each at significance level α, using the Poisson distribution with mean nα.
formula-notes:formula_A4.13:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on detecting an excess of significant tests to provide a simple approximation for the distribution of false positives, which is then used to assess whether the observed number of significant results exceeds what is expected by chance.

formula-notes:formula_A4.10:en.plainMeaning: Cheverud's effective number of independent tests n_e,Cheverud adjusts the nominal number of tests n downward based on the variance σ²(λ) of the eigenvalues λ_i of the correlation matrix, where λ_i are scaled to have mean 1.
formula-notes:formula_A4.10:en.inThisChapter: This formula appears in the section on Bonferroni corrections and their extensions to provide a less conservative multiple testing correction that accounts for correlation among tests, supporting the argument that the effective number of tests can be estimated from the eigenvalue distribution.

formula-notes:formula_A4.13:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式用泊松分布近似计算在n次独立检验中恰好出现j个假阳性结果的概率，其中nα是假阳性数的期望值。
formula-notes:formula_A4.13:zh.inThisChapter: 在本节中，该公式用于量化多重检验中假阳性数量的分布，为后续判断观测到的显著检验数是否超出随机期望提供概率依据。

formula-notes:formula_A4.14:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式表示在0到1之间，均匀分布的概率密度函数恒等于1，即φ_u(p)=1。
formula-notes:formula_A4.14:zh.inThisChapter: 此处引入均匀分布的密度函数，是为了后续利用p值直方图中部的高度来估计零假设比例n0，因为零假设下的p值服从均匀分布。

formula-notes:formula_A4.11:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the effective number of independent tests (n_e) by summing the integer parts of eigenvalues (each eigenvalue >=1 contributes 1) plus the fractional remainders of all eigenvalues (including those <1). Key symbols: n_{e,Li-Ji} = effective number of independent tests, λ_i = eigenvalue of the correlation matrix, N = number of tests.
formula-notes:formula_A4.11:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on Bonferroni corrections and extensions to improve upon Cheverud's method by accounting for partially correlated tests, supporting a more accurate correction for multiple testing that preserves power.

formula-notes:formula_A4.14:en.plainMeaning: This formula states that the probability density function (pdf) of a uniform distribution on (0,1) is constant and equal to 1 for all p in [0,1]. The symbol φ_u(p) denotes the pdf of the uniform distribution.
formula-notes:formula_A4.14:en.inThisChapter: It appears here to justify that under the null hypothesis, p-values are uniformly distributed on (0,1), which is the basis for using the flat middle region of the p-value histogram to estimate the number of true null hypotheses n0.

formula-notes:formula_A4.16:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算在区间 (a,b) 内 p 值的经验密度估计，即落在该区间内的 p 值个数除以区间长度 (b-a)，得到单位区间上的平均频数。
formula-notes:formula_A4.16:zh.inThisChapter: 本节旨在检测显著检验的过量个数，该公式用于估计零假设下 p 值的均匀分布密度，为后续比较实际观测密度与理论均匀密度提供基准。

formula-notes:formula_A4.16:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the estimated density of p-values in the interval (a,b) by dividing the count of p-values falling in that interval by the interval width (b-a). The symbol n̂₀(a,b) denotes the estimated density, and p(i) values are the observed p-values.
formula-notes:formula_A4.16:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on detecting an excess of significant tests to provide a nonparametric estimate of the p-value density under the null hypothesis, which is later used to compare with the expected uniform density for identifying an excess of small p-values.

formula-notes:formula_A4.15:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算在零假设为真的 n0 个检验中，p 值落在区间 [a, b] 内的期望个数：由于零假设下 p 值服从均匀分布 U(0,1)，其密度函数 φ_u(p)=1，因此期望个数等于 n0 乘以区间长度 (b-a)。
formula-notes:formula_A4.15:zh.inThisChapter: 本节旨在检测显著检验的过量个数，该公式为后续比较实际落入区间 [a,b] 的 p 值个数与零假设下的期望个数提供基准，从而判断是否存在过量显著结果。

formula-notes:formula_A4.15:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the expected number of p-values from truly null tests that fall in the interval [a, b], which equals n₀ times the length (b−a) because the p-values are uniformly distributed on [0,1] under the null.
formula-notes:formula_A4.15:en.inThisChapter: It appears here to derive the expected count of null p-values in any interval, which is then used to detect an excess of significant tests by comparing observed counts to this null expectation.

formula-notes:formula_A4.17:en.plainMeaning: This formula estimates the proportion of true null hypotheses, π₀, by computing the density of p-values in an interval (a,b) relative to the uniform density under the null. Key symbols: π̂₀(a,b) is the estimate, n is total tests, a and b define the interval.
formula-notes:formula_A4.17:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on detecting an excess of significant tests to provide a practical estimate of π₀ from the p-value distribution, supporting later arguments about false discovery rate control and multiple testing adjustments.

formula-notes:formula_A4.21:en.plainMeaning: This formula gives the likelihood of a single p-value under a mixture model: with probability (1-π₀) it follows a Beta(a,b) distribution (alternative hypothesis), and with probability π₀ it follows a uniform distribution (null hypothesis).
formula-notes:formula_A4.21:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on detecting an excess of significant tests to model the distribution of p-values under a mixture of null and alternative hypotheses, enabling estimation of π₀ (proportion of true nulls) via maximum likelihood.

formula-notes:formula_A4.20:en.plainMeaning: This formula gives the probability density of a p-value under the alternative hypothesis, modeled as a beta distribution with parameters a and b. The symbols are: Γ the gamma function, p the p-value, and a, b shape parameters.
formula-notes:formula_A4.20:en.inThisChapter: It appears here to model the distribution of p-values from true alternative hypotheses, enabling estimation of π₀ via mixture modeling in the context of detecting an excess of significant tests.

formula-notes:formula_A4.17:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式用落入区间 (a,b) 内的 p 值个数除以 n(b-a) 来估计零假设为真的比例 π₀，其中 n 是总检验数，b-a 是区间长度，相当于将 p 值在区间内的频率除以区间宽度得到密度估计。
formula-notes:formula_A4.17:zh.inThisChapter: 本章旨在检测显著检验的过量个数，需要估计零假设为真的比例 π₀；此公式提供了基于 p 值直方图的一种非参数估计方法，为后续比较观测与期望的 p 值分布、判断是否存在过量显著结果奠定基础。

formula-notes:formula_A4.20:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式是Beta分布的概率密度函数，用于建模备择假设下p值的分布φ_A(p)，其中a和b是形状参数，p是p值，Γ是伽马函数。
formula-notes:formula_A4.20:zh.inThisChapter: 在本节中，该公式用于描述备择假设下p值的分布，以便将p值分布分解为均匀分布（零假设）和Beta分布（备择假设）的混合，从而估计零假设比例π_0。

formula-notes:formula_A4.18:en.plainMeaning: This formula estimates the proportion π₀ of true null hypotheses by counting p-values greater than a threshold λ, assuming most such p-values come from the null uniform distribution. The numerator counts p-values > λ, and the denominator adjusts for the expected fraction (1-λ) of uniform null p-values above λ.
formula-notes:formula_A4.18:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on detecting an excess of significant tests to provide a data-driven estimate of π₀, which is then used to compute the q-value (formula A4.11) for controlling the false discovery rate.

formula-notes:formula_A4.19:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算在给定阈值λ下，p值大于λ的个数除以(1-λ)，再乘以总假设数n，得到估计的零假设下p值个数。关键符号：n为总假设数，λ为可调参数，Number of p(i) values > λ为观测中大于λ的p值个数。
formula-notes:formula_A4.19:zh.inThisChapter: 本节旨在检测是否存在过多显著检验，该公式用于估计零假设下p值的期望个数，为后续计算FDR或比较观测与期望提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_A4.19:en.plainMeaning: This formula estimates the number of true null hypotheses, \(\widehat{n}_0(\lambda)\), as the total number of tests \(n\) times the estimated null proportion \(\widehat{\pi}_0(\lambda)\), which is computed as the count of p-values exceeding \(\lambda\) divided by \(1-\lambda\).
formula-notes:formula_A4.19:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on detecting an excess of significant tests to provide a plug-in estimate of the number of null hypotheses, which is then used to compute the false discovery rate or related quantities for a given threshold \(\lambda\).

formula-notes:formula_A4.18:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算在p值大于λ的观测中，期望来自原假设的比例，通过“p值大于λ的个数”除以“n(1-λ)”来估计原假设为真的比例π₀。其中，n是总假设数，λ是调优参数，1-λ是p值在(λ,1]上的均匀概率。
formula-notes:formula_A4.18:zh.inThisChapter: 本节旨在检测显著检验的过量数目，该公式利用p值在λ附近的均匀性来估计原假设比例π₀，为后续基于π₀估计计算q值（FDR的估计）提供关键输入。

formula-notes:formula_A4.21:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式表示单个p值的似然函数ℓ(p)，它是两种成分的混合：以概率(1-π₀)来自Beta分布φ_A(p)（参数a,b），以概率π₀来自均匀分布φ_u(p)=1。
formula-notes:formula_A4.21:zh.inThisChapter: 在本节中，该公式用于构建p值的混合模型，以便通过最大化总似然来估计参数a、b和π₀，从而检测显著检验的过量数目。

formula-notes:formula_A4.22:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式表示在独立检验假设下，所有p值的联合似然函数等于每个p值似然函数的乘积，其中ℓ(p_i)是单个p值的似然函数。
formula-notes:formula_A4.22:zh.inThisChapter: 此处用于构建基于p值分布的总体似然函数，为后续通过最大化似然估计参数π₀、a和b提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_A4.22:en.plainMeaning: The formula computes the total likelihood over n independent p-values as the product of individual likelihoods ℓ(p_i) for each p-value, where ℓ(p) is the likelihood for a single p-value parameterized by π₀, a, and b.
formula-notes:formula_A4.22:en.inThisChapter: It appears in this section to combine the likelihood contributions from all independent tests into a joint likelihood function, which is then maximized to obtain ML estimates of π₀, a, and b for detecting an excess of significant tests.

formula-notes:formula_A4.24:en.plainMeaning: The false-positive rate (FPR) is defined as the probability that a hypothesis is deemed significant given that it is truly null, which equals the significance level α.
formula-notes:formula_A4.24:en.inThisChapter: This formula clarifies the definition of FPR in contrast to FDR, supporting the argument that FPR conditions on the null hypothesis while FDR conditions on significance.

formula-notes:formula_A4.23:en.plainMeaning: The formula defines the false-discovery rate (FDR) as the probability that a hypothesis deemed significant is actually null, denoted by δ. It conditions on the test being significant.
formula-notes:formula_A4.23:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the Appendix introduction to contrast FDR with the false-positive rate, supporting the argument that FDR conditions on significance rather than on the null hypothesis.

formula-notes:formula_A4.24:zh.plainMeaning: 公式 A4.24 定义假阳性率 FPR 为在原假设为真的条件下，该假设被判定为显著的概率，即显著性水平 α。
formula-notes:formula_A4.24:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在附录引言中，用于区分假阳性率（FPR）与错误发现率（FDR）：FPR 条件于原假设为真，而 FDR 条件于检验被判定为显著，为后续推导多重比较中的错误率概念奠定基础。

formula-notes:formula_A4.23:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将FDR定义为在检验被判定为显著的条件下该检验的原假设为真的概率，即δ。其中“i is truly null”表示第i个检验的原假设为真，“i is deemed significant”表示该检验被判定为显著。
formula-notes:formula_A4.23:zh.inThisChapter: 本节通过对比FDR与假阳性率的条件概率定义，阐明两者的本质区别：FDR以“判定显著”为条件，而假阳性率以“原假设为真”为条件。这为后续引入多重检验中控制FDR的方法（如Benjamini-Hochberg过程）提供了概率解释基础。

formula-notes:formula_A4.25:en.plainMeaning: The posterior error rate (PER) is the probability that a test is a false positive given that it is significant (S=n=1). Here, F=1 indicates a false positive, and S=n=1 indicates a significant result.
formula-notes:formula_A4.25:en.inThisChapter: This formula appears in the FDR section to connect FDR to Morton's PER, showing that FDR can be interpreted as the expected proportion of false positives among significant tests, which is analogous to PER.

formula-notes:formula_A4.25:zh.plainMeaning: PER 表示在单个检验被判定为显著（S=1）的条件下，该检验实际上为假阳性（F=1）的条件概率，即 Pr(F=1 | S=n=1)。
formula-notes:formula_A4.25:zh.inThisChapter: 本节将 PER 作为 FDR 的密切关联概念引入，为后续推导 FDR 与 PER 的关系（如公式 A4.26）提供基础，并说明 FDR 是 PER 在多重检验下的推广。

formula-notes:formula_A4.27:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the expected number of false positives as the product of the Type I error rate α and the proportion π₀ of true null hypotheses, where π₀ = n₀/n.
formula-notes:formula_A4.27:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the FDR section to derive the numerator of the FDR (Equation A4.13), showing how false positives depend on both the significance level and the prevalence of null hypotheses.

formula-notes:formula_A4.26:en.plainMeaning: The PER (Proportion of false positives among significant tests) equals the probability that a significant test is a false positive, computed as the product of the false-positive probability under the null and the prior null probability, divided by the marginal probability of significance.
formula-notes:formula_A4.26:en.inThisChapter: This formula appears in the FDR section to quantify the screening paradox: even with low α, the PER can be high because it conditions on significance rather than on the null, and it depends on α, β, and π0, motivating FDR control.

formula-notes:formula_A4.29:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the positive error rate (PER) as the proportion of true positives among all positive test results, given the significance level α, power (1-β), and prior probability π₀ of the null hypothesis being true.
formula-notes:formula_A4.29:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the FDR section to derive the false-discovery rate from the positive error rate, supporting the argument that controlling FDR requires adjusting for the prior probability of null hypotheses.

formula-notes:formula_A4.28:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算单个随机检验被判定为显著（S=n=1）的概率，等于原假设为真且发生第一类错误（απ₀）加上备择假设为真且避免第二类错误（(1-β)(1-π₀)）的概率之和。
formula-notes:formula_A4.28:zh.inThisChapter: 在本章FDR的上下文中，该公式用于推导式A4.13的分母，即所有检验中被判定为显著的比例，为后续计算FDR（假发现率）提供基础概率表达式。

formula-notes:formula_A4.31:zh.plainMeaning: 这个公式将FDR控制中的阈值α表示为γ/(1-γ)乘以1/n，并近似为γ/n，其中γ是期望的FDR水平，n是假设检验总数。
formula-notes:formula_A4.31:zh.inThisChapter: 它出现在FDR章节中，用于展示在完全功效且只有一个备择假设的特殊情况下，FDR控制阈值如何简化为Bonferroni校正，从而建立FDR与FWER之间的联系。

formula-notes:formula_A4.26:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算在检验结果为显著（S=n=1）的条件下，该检验为假阳性（F=1）的概率，即PER。分子是假阳性概率（Pr(false positive | null true)）乘以原假设为真的先验概率Pr(null)，分母是检验结果为显著的边际概率Pr(S=n=1)。
formula-notes:formula_A4.26:zh.inThisChapter: 本节通过PER公式揭示筛选悖论：即使控制单检验的α=0.05，PER可能远高于5%，因为PER条件于检验显著，而显著结果中假阳性比例受π0、α、β共同影响。该公式为后续推导FDR（如公式A4.27）奠定基础，说明多重检验中需调整错误率定义。

formula-notes:formula_A4.31:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the significance threshold α for multiple testing when there is complete power (β=0) and only one true alternative hypothesis among n tests (π₀ = n/(n+1)). It shows that α simplifies to γ/n, which is the Bonferroni correction.
formula-notes:formula_A4.31:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the FDR section to illustrate that under specific ideal conditions (complete power and a single true alternative), the FDR-based threshold reduces to the classic Bonferroni correction, linking FDR to traditional multiple testing methods.

formula-notes:formula_A4.28:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the probability that a single randomly chosen hypothesis test is declared significant, denoted Pr(S=n=1). It combines the probability of a true null hypothesis (π₀) times the Type-I error rate (α) plus the probability of a true alternative (1-π₀) times the power (1-β).
formula-notes:formula_A4.28:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the FDR chapter to derive the denominator of the false-discovery rate (Equation A4.13), which is the expected proportion of significant tests. This probability is needed to compute FDR as a function of α, β, and π₀.

formula-notes:formula_A4.30:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the significance threshold α needed to achieve a desired expected proportion of false positives among rejected hypotheses (PER = γ), given the prior probability π₀ that a null hypothesis is true and the desired power (1-β).
formula-notes:formula_A4.30:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the FDR chapter to show how to set α for a target PER, linking power, prior probability, and the false-positive rate in multiple testing contexts.

formula-notes:formula_A4.27:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算在零假设为真的条件下被错误拒绝的期望比例（即假阳性数量）与总假设数之比，其中左侧是假阳性概率乘以零假设比例，右侧是显著性水平α与零假设比例π₀的乘积。
formula-notes:formula_A4.27:zh.inThisChapter: 此处为推导FDR的分子部分，通过将假阳性数表示为α·π₀·m（m为总假设数），为后续计算FDR=E[V/R]中分子E[V]提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_A4.32:en.plainMeaning: This inequality bounds the false-discovery rate (FDR) for the kth hypothesis, where np(k)/k is the estimated proportion of false discoveries among the k rejected hypotheses, and δ_k is the FDR threshold.
formula-notes:formula_A4.32:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on FDR to derive the Benjamini-Hochberg procedure, showing that rejecting hypotheses with p-values ≤ p(k) controls the FDR at level δ_k.

formula-notes:formula_A4.29:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算了在多重假设检验中，当拒绝原假设时，该拒绝为错误发现（即原假设实际为真）的后验概率PER。其中α是显著性水平（第一类错误概率），β是第二类错误概率，π0是先验的原假设为真的比例。
formula-notes:formula_A4.29:zh.inThisChapter: 在本章FDR（错误发现率）的上下文中，该公式将PER表达为α、β和π0的函数，为后续推导FDR的估计量（如Benjamini-Hochberg过程）提供了基础，并展示了如何通过控制α和β来间接控制PER。

formula-notes:formula_A4.33:en.plainMeaning: This inequality gives a threshold for rejecting a hypothesis: reject if the p-value p(k) is at most δ times k/n, where k is the rank of the p-value (sorted ascending), n is the total number of hypotheses, and δ is the desired false-discovery rate.
formula-notes:formula_A4.33:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the FDR chapter to define the Benjamini-Hochberg procedure, which controls the expected proportion of false discoveries among rejected hypotheses at level δ.

formula-notes:formula_A4.32:zh.plainMeaning: 该不等式表示，当所有n个假设均为零假设时，错误发现的比例np(k)/k不超过δ_k，其中p(k)是第k小的p值，δ_k是第k个假设的错误发现率。
formula-notes:formula_A4.32:zh.inThisChapter: 此处通过假设所有假设均为零，推导出FDR的原始估计量np(k)/k，并以此作为δ_k的上界，为后续Benjamini-Hochberg过程控制FDR提供理论基础。

formula-notes:formula_A4.30:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将显著性水平α与期望的PER值γ、先验概率π₀和统计功效1-β联系起来，用于计算在给定γ下应采用的α阈值。
formula-notes:formula_A4.30:zh.inThisChapter: 在本节FDR讨论中，该公式由方程A4.15a重排得到，用于指导如何设定α以控制PER（错误发现比例），为后续FDR方法中的阈值选择提供理论依据。

formula-notes:formula_A4.33:zh.plainMeaning: 该不等式给出了在控制整体FDR为δ时，单个p值p(k)需要满足的上界：p(k)必须不超过δ乘以k/n，其中k是排序后的序号，n是总假设数。
formula-notes:formula_A4.33:zh.inThisChapter: 此公式是Benjamini-Hochberg步骤的核心阈值，用于在给定FDR水平δ下确定哪些假设被拒绝，从而在多重检验中控制错误发现率。

formula-notes:formula_A4.34:en.plainMeaning: This formula estimates the number of false discoveries at threshold k, where \(\widehat{n}_0\) is the estimated number of true null hypotheses, \(p(k)\) is the proportion of p-values less than or equal to k, and \(k\) is the p-value threshold.
formula-notes:formula_A4.34:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the FDR section to provide a more accurate estimate of false discoveries by using \(\widehat{n}_0\) instead of n, supporting the argument that the Benjamini-Hochberg procedure is conservative when \(n_0 < n\).

formula-notes:formula_A4.34:zh.plainMeaning: 公式 A4.34 计算第 k 个排序 p 值对应的 FDR 估计值，其中分子是估计的零假设下被拒绝的期望个数（估计的零假设总数 n̂₀ 乘以 p(k)），分母是排序位置 k。
formula-notes:formula_A4.34:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在 Benjamini-Hochberg 方法推广部分，用 n̂₀ 替换 n 以修正原始 FDR 估计的保守性，为后续自适应 FDR 控制方法提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_A4.35:en.plainMeaning: This formula approximates the expected false discovery rate (FDR) for a given p-value threshold τ as the ratio of the expected number of false positives F(τ) to the expected number of significant tests S(τ), using a first-order Taylor expansion.
formula-notes:formula_A4.35:en.inThisChapter: It appears here to derive a simple estimator of the expected FDR as a function of τ, enabling optimal threshold selection to control FDR while maintaining power in large-scale multiple testing.

formula-notes:formula_A4.35:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式表示FDR的期望E[FDR(τ)]近似等于F(τ)的期望除以S(τ)的期望，其中F(τ)是p值≤τ的无效假设个数，S(τ)是p值≤τ的总假设个数。
formula-notes:formula_A4.35:zh.inThisChapter: 本节旨在通过期望FDR作为阈值τ的函数来优化τ，该近似简化了计算，为后续推导FDR的估计量（如Storey的q值）提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_A4.36:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式表示在原假设为真时，p值小于等于某个阈值τ的概率等于τ，因为原假设下p值服从均匀分布U(0,1)，其概率密度函数φ_u(p)=1，积分从0到τ得到τ。
formula-notes:formula_A4.36:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式用于估计F(τ)的期望E[F(τ)]，即错误拒绝原假设的个数，为后续推导FDR的估计量（如Benjamini-Hochberg过程）提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_A4.38:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the expected false-discovery rate (FDR) for a given threshold τ, where n₀ is the number of true null hypotheses, τ is the p-value threshold, and S(τ) is the number of discoveries (p-values ≤ τ).
formula-notes:formula_A4.38:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the FDR section to derive an estimator for FDR, supporting the Benjamini-Hochberg procedure by showing how to control the expected proportion of false discoveries.

formula-notes:formula_A4.36:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the probability that a p-value under the null hypothesis is ≤ τ, which equals τ because p-values under the null are uniformly distributed on (0,1). Here, φ_u(p) is the uniform density (equal to 1 on [0,1]), and τ is a threshold.
formula-notes:formula_A4.36:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the FDR chapter to justify that the expected number of false positives E[F(τ)] equals n₀τ, which is used to derive the Benjamini-Hochberg procedure for controlling FDR.

formula-notes:formula_A4.38:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算在阈值τ下，期望的假发现率（FDR）等于零假设成立的特征数n0乘以τ，除以在τ下被判定为显著的特征数S(τ)。
formula-notes:formula_A4.38:zh.inThisChapter: 在本节中，该公式用于定义FDR的期望形式，为后续推导FDR的控制方法（如Benjamini-Hochberg过程）提供理论基础。

formula-notes:formula_A4.39:en.plainMeaning: This formula estimates the false-discovery rate (FDR) at threshold τ, where n₀ is the estimated number of true null hypotheses, S(τ) is the number of p-values ≤ τ, and λ is a tuning parameter used to estimate n₀ via the Storey-Tibshirani estimator.
formula-notes:formula_A4.39:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the FDR section to provide a practical estimate of FDR using the Storey-Tibshirani estimator for n₀, supporting the argument that the estimate should be stable over a reasonable range of λ values.

formula-notes:formula_A4.37:en.plainMeaning: This formula estimates the expected number of false positives E[F(τ)] as the product of the number of truly null tests n₀ and the probability that a null p-value is ≤ τ, which under the uniform null distribution approximates n₀·τ.
formula-notes:formula_A4.37:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the FDR section to derive an estimator for the expected number of false rejections, which is then used to estimate the false-discovery rate FDR(τ) = E[F(τ)]/E[R(τ)].

formula-notes:formula_A4.37:zh.plainMeaning: 这个公式计算在阈值τ下被错误拒绝的零假设个数E[F(τ)]，它等于真实零假设总数n₀乘以单个零假设p值小于τ的概率Pr(p≤τ|null hypothesis)，并近似为n₀·τ，因为零假设下p值服从均匀分布。
formula-notes:formula_A4.37:zh.inThisChapter: 在本节FDR估计中，该公式用于建立错误发现数F(τ)的期望表达式，为后续通过观测数据估计n₀并进而估计FDR（如公式A4.38）提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_A4.42:en.plainMeaning: The q-value estimate for a test with p-value p(i) is the minimum estimated FDR over all thresholds τ ≥ p(i).
formula-notes:formula_A4.42:en.inThisChapter: It appears here to define the q-value as a per-test FDR measure, supporting the goal of assigning an FDR to individual tests within a family.

formula-notes:formula_A4.41:en.plainMeaning: This formula defines the cumulative distribution functions (cdfs) for p-values under the null (uniform, φ_U) and alternative (φ_A) hypotheses, showing that the null cdf equals x (identity) while the alternative cdf is the integral of its density.
formula-notes:formula_A4.41:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the FDR chapter to provide the cumulative probabilities needed to compute the false-discovery rate as a function of the significance threshold τ, supporting the mixture-model estimation of FDR.

formula-notes:formula_A4.42:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将某个检验的q值估计量定义为，在所有阈值τ≥该检验的p值p(i)中，使估计的FDR值最小的那个阈值对应的FDR估计值。
formula-notes:formula_A4.42:zh.inThisChapter: 本节引入q值概念以评估单个检验的FDR，该公式通过最小化FDR估计来定义q值估计量，为后续使用q值进行多重检验筛选提供理论基础。

formula-notes:formula_A4.40:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the false-discovery rate (FDR) at threshold τ as the ratio of expected null p-values ≤ τ (π₀τ) to total expected p-values ≤ τ (π₀τ + (1-π₀)cdf_A(τ)), where π₀ is the null proportion, cdf_U(τ)=τ is the uniform null CDF, and cdf_A(τ) is the alternative CDF.
formula-notes:formula_A4.40:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the FDR section to provide a direct parametric estimate of FDR under the mixture model, supporting later arguments about controlling FDR via threshold selection and comparing with other error measures.

formula-notes:formula_A4.43:en.plainMeaning: This formula defines the effect size estimate T_i as the sample mean of observations in study i, and the within-study variance s_i^2 as the sample variance of those observations. T_i and s_i^2 are the key symbols.
formula-notes:formula_A4.43:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the Formal Meta-Analysis section to establish the basic data structure for each study, which is then used to compute study weights and the overall pooled estimate in a fixed-effects or random-effects meta-analysis.

formula-notes:formula_A4.39:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式估计在阈值τ下的错误发现率（FDR），其中n0用Storey-Tibshirani估计量（基于λ）替代，S(τ)是p值小于等于τ的个数，τ/S(τ)是原始FDR估计（公式A4.21）中n0=1时的形式，乘以n0的估计量得到最终估计。
formula-notes:formula_A4.39:zh.inThisChapter: 出现在FDR章节，用于将理论FDR公式（A4.21）转化为实际可计算的估计量，通过引入Storey-Tibshirani估计量（A4.9b）处理n0未知的问题，为后续讨论λ选择及估计稳定性提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_A4.41:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式定义了两个累积分布函数：cdf_U(x) 是零假设下均匀分布 φ_U(p) 从 0 到 x 的积分，结果为 x（因为均匀分布密度为 1）；cdf_A(x) 是备择假设下 p 值分布 φ_A(p) 的积分。
formula-notes:formula_A4.41:zh.inThisChapter: 本章通过混合模型设定（公式 A4.10）推导 FDR，需要利用零假设和备择假设下 p 值的累积分布来计算给定阈值 τ 下真阳性与所有显著检验的比例，该公式为后续 FDR 估计提供基础分布函数。

formula-notes:formula_A4.44:zh.plainMeaning: 公式 T_i = \overline{z}_{i,t} - \overline{z}_{i,c} 计算第 i 个研究中处理组均值与对照组均值的差值，其中 \overline{z}_{i,t} 是处理组均值，\overline{z}_{i,c} 是对照组均值。
formula-notes:formula_A4.44:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在正式元分析章节，用于定义两独立组比较的效应量（均值差），为后续合并效应量、计算方差和进行异质性检验提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_A4.43:zh.plainMeaning: 公式定义第 i 个研究的效应量 T_i 等于该研究的样本均值 \(\overline{z}_i\)，同时给出其样本方差 s_i^2 的计算公式，即组内离差平方和除以自由度 n_i-1。
formula-notes:formula_A4.43:zh.inThisChapter: 在形式元分析章节中，该公式为后续合并效应量（如固定效应或随机效应模型）提供了每个研究的基本统计量（均值和方差），是构建元分析加权平均的基础。

formula-notes:formula_A4.40:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算在显著性阈值τ下，所有被判定为显著的检验中，实际为真的零假设所占的比例（即错误发现率FDR）。其中π0为零假设为真的比例，cdf_U(τ)为零假设下p值的累积分布（均匀分布时等于τ），cdf_A(τ)为备择假设下p值的累积分布。
formula-notes:formula_A4.40:zh.inThisChapter: 本节引入FDR作为多重检验中控制错误发现率的指标，该公式基于混合模型（如公式A4.10）推导，将FDR表示为π0、τ和备择分布累积分布函数的函数，为后续估计实际FDR值提供理论依据。

formula-notes:formula_A4.44:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the raw effect size for study i as the difference between the mean outcome in the treatment group (z̄_{i,t}) and the mean outcome in the control group (z̄_{i,c}).
formula-notes:formula_A4.44:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the Formal Meta-Analysis section to define the basic effect size metric for two-group comparisons, which will later be used to combine effect sizes across studies or to compute standardized measures.

formula-notes:formula_A4.45:zh.plainMeaning: 公式 D_i = T_i / s_{i,p} 计算第 i 个研究的标准化效应量 D_i，其中 T_i 是原始效应量（如均值差），s_{i,p} 是合并标准误。
formula-notes:formula_A4.45:zh.inThisChapter: 本章讨论元分析中效应量的标准化，该公式给出一种标准化形式，为后续比较不同研究的效应量或推导 Cohen's d 统计量提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_A4.45:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes a standardized effect size D_i for study i by dividing the test statistic T_i by the pooled standard error s_{i,p}, yielding a unitless measure of effect magnitude.
formula-notes:formula_A4.45:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the Formal Meta-Analysis section to define one version of a standardized effect size (like Cohen's d), which is later used to combine or compare effect sizes across studies.

formula-notes:formula_A4.46:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the pooled standard deviation for study i by combining the variances of the treatment and control groups, weighted by their respective degrees of freedom. Key symbols: n_{i,t} and n_{i,c} are sample sizes, s_{i,t}^2 and s_{i,c}^2 are variances, and s_{i,p} is the pooled standard deviation.
formula-notes:formula_A4.46:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on formal meta-analysis to define one specific standardization of the effect size (Cohen's d), which is used to combine effect sizes across studies in a meta-analysis.

formula-notes:formula_A4.48:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the corrected (unbiased) Hedge's g effect size by multiplying the biased g_i by a correction factor that depends on the sample sizes of the control (n_{i,c}) and treatment (n_{i,t}) groups.
formula-notes:formula_A4.48:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the Formal Meta-Analysis section to provide an unbiased estimate of the standardized mean difference, which is essential for accurate meta-analytic pooling and inference.

formula-notes:formula_A4.46:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算第 i 个研究的合并标准差 s_{i,p}^2，它是对照组（c）和实验组（t）的样本方差 s_{i,c}^2 和 s_{i,t}^2 按各自自由度（n-1）加权平均的结果。
formula-notes:formula_A4.46:zh.inThisChapter: 在正式元分析章节中，此公式用于定义 Cohen's d 统计量中的分母（合并标准差），为后续计算标准化效应量及其方差提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_A4.48:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式是对Hedge's g统计量g_i进行小样本偏差校正，乘以一个与实验组和对照组样本量n_{i,c}和n_{i,t}相关的校正因子，得到无偏效应量估计。
formula-notes:formula_A4.48:zh.inThisChapter: 在正式元分析章节中，该公式出现在介绍Hedge's g及其偏差校正之后，为后续使用校正后的效应量进行元分析计算提供无偏估计量。

formula-notes:formula_A4.47:en.plainMeaning: Hedge's g computes the standardized mean difference between treatment and control groups, where g_i is the difference in means divided by the pooled standard deviation s_{i,p}. The pooled variance s_{i,p}^2 is a weighted average of the sample variances, using degrees-of-freedom weights.
formula-notes:formula_A4.47:en.inThisChapter: This formula appears in the Formal Meta-Analysis section to define the effect size measure used for combining studies. It supports later arguments about bias correction and meta-analytic inference by providing an unbiased estimate of the standardized effect.

formula-notes:formula_A4.49:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将原始相关系数 r_i 校正为无偏估计 r_i^*，其中 n_i 是第 i 个研究的样本量，校正项依赖于 r_i 和 n_i。
formula-notes:formula_A4.49:zh.inThisChapter: 在元分析中，相关系数作为效应量时存在小样本偏倚，此公式提供简单校正，为后续合并效应量（如加权平均）提供无偏输入。

formula-notes:formula_A4.49:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes an unbiased estimate of the true correlation coefficient (ρ) by correcting the bias in the sample correlation r_i using a function of r_i and sample size n_i.
formula-notes:formula_A4.49:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the meta-analysis section to provide an unbiased effect size (r_i*) for each study, which is then used in subsequent analyses to combine correlations across studies.

formula-notes:formula_A4.47:zh.plainMeaning: 公式计算 Hedge's g 效应量，即处理组均值与对照组均值之差除以合并标准差 s_{i,p}；其中 s_{i,p}^2 是两组方差的加权平均（权重为各自自由度），用于估计共同总体方差。
formula-notes:formula_A4.47:zh.inThisChapter: 在正式元分析章节中，该公式提供了一种标准化的效应量度量，使得不同研究的结果可以合并；后续常对小样本偏差进行校正（如公式 A4.28a 的偏倚修正）。

formula-notes:formula_A4.50:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将相关系数 r_i 通过 Fisher z 变换转换为 z_{i,r}，其中 s_i^2 是变换后 z 值的近似方差，分母为 n_i - 3。
formula-notes:formula_A4.50:zh.inThisChapter: 在正式元分析章节中，此变换用于使相关系数满足正态性假设，以便后续进行固定效应或随机效应模型的合并与推断。

formula-notes:formula_A4.52:en.plainMeaning: This formula represents the observed effect size in study i as the sum of the common true effect θ and a residual error e_i, where the error variance equals the within-study variance s_i^2.
formula-notes:formula_A4.52:en.inThisChapter: It formalizes the fixed-effects assumption that all studies estimate the same θ, setting up the GLS estimation of the overall effect in meta-analysis.

formula-notes:formula_A4.50:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the Fisher z-transformation of a correlation coefficient r_i, yielding z_{i,r} with an approximately normal distribution, and its variance s_i^2 = 1/(n_i - 3).
formula-notes:formula_A4.50:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the Formal Meta-Analysis section to transform correlation coefficients so that they can be combined using standard meta-analytic methods that assume normality and known variances.

formula-notes:formula_A4.51:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将 Fisher z 变换后的值 z_r 逆变换回相关系数 r，其中 e 是自然常数，z_r 是经过 Fisher 变换的样本相关系数。
formula-notes:formula_A4.51:zh.inThisChapter: 在正式元分析章节中，此公式用于将基于 z 的估计结果（如合并效应量）转换回原始相关系数 ρ 的推断，从而完成从变换到原始尺度的回代。

formula-notes:formula_A4.53:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算固定效应元分析中共同效应θ的加权平均估计值，其中权重w_i为各研究效应估计量方差s_i^2的倒数，即精度越高（方差越小）的研究权重越大。
formula-notes:formula_A4.53:zh.inThisChapter: 在固定效应元分析章节中，该公式由广义最小二乘法（GLS）推导得出，用于合并k个独立但异方差的研究效应估计，为后续讨论异质性检验和随机效应模型提供基准估计量。

formula-notes:formula_A4.54:en.plainMeaning: The formula computes the squared standard error of the meta-analytic mean, where s_T^2 is the variance of the overall estimate and w_i are the weights (typically inverse variances) for each of the k studies.
formula-notes:formula_A4.54:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the Formal Meta-Analysis section to quantify the precision of the combined effect estimate, supporting the calculation of confidence intervals and hypothesis tests for the global mean.

formula-notes:formula_A4.54:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算元分析中全局估计值T̅的方差s_T²，等于所有研究权重w_i之和的倒数，其中权重w_i通常为各研究效应量方差的倒数（即精度）。
formula-notes:formula_A4.54:zh.inThisChapter: 在正式元分析章节中，此公式用于量化合并效应量的不确定性，为后续计算置信区间和假设检验提供标准误的基础。

formula-notes:formula_A4.53:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the weighted average effect size (θ̄) across k studies under a fixed-effects model, where each study i is weighted by the inverse of its variance (w_i = 1/s_i²), giving more precise studies greater influence.
formula-notes:formula_A4.53:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the Formal Meta-Analysis section to provide the GLS-based estimator of the common effect θ, which is the central result for combining studies under the fixed-effects assumption.

formula-notes:formula_A4.52:zh.plainMeaning: 公式 T_i = θ + e_i 表示第 i 个研究的观察效应量 T_i 等于共同的真实效应量 θ 加上一个残差 e_i，其中残差 e_i 的方差为 s_i^2（即各研究内方差）。
formula-notes:formula_A4.52:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式出现在固定效应元分析（共同效应模型）的设定中，为后续使用广义最小二乘法（GLS）估计共同效应 θ 提供了线性模型基础，并引出残差异方差性（heteroscedastic）的假设。

formula-notes:formula_A4.51:en.plainMeaning: This formula converts Fisher's z-transformed correlation coefficient back to the original correlation scale, where r is the correlation estimate and z_r is its Fisher z-transform.
formula-notes:formula_A4.51:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the meta-analysis section to allow back-transformation of summary effect estimates from the z-scale (used for analysis) to the correlation scale for interpretation.

formula-notes:formula_A4.55:zh.plainMeaning: 这个公式计算的是在假设每个研究内个体观测方差相同（均为σ²）且每个研究样本量均为n时，k个研究的样本均值（T̄）的方差，等于σ²除以nk。
formula-notes:formula_A4.55:zh.inThisChapter: 出现在形式元分析章节，用于推导当各研究方差相等且样本量相同时，合并均值的方差表达式，为后续讨论固定效应模型下合并估计的精度和假设检验提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_A4.55:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the variance of the overall mean effect size \(\overline{T}\) across \(k\) studies, each with \(n\) observations, assuming equal within-study variance \(\sigma^2\). The variance is \(\sigma^2/(nk)\).
formula-notes:formula_A4.55:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the formal meta-analysis section to provide a simple expression for the variance of the combined estimate under homogeneity, supporting the derivation of confidence intervals and hypothesis tests for the overall effect.

formula-notes:formula_A4.56:zh.plainMeaning: Q统计量是各研究效应估计值T_i与总体均值\overline{T}的偏差平方除以各自方差s_i^2后求和，衡量研究间异质性。
formula-notes:formula_A4.56:zh.inThisChapter: 该公式用于Cochran Q检验，检验各研究效应是否相等（共同效应假设），其分布为卡方分布，为后续异质性判断和随机效应模型选择提供依据。

formula-notes:formula_A4.56:en.plainMeaning: Cochran's Q statistic measures the weighted sum of squared deviations of each study's treatment effect estimate T_i from the overall mean effect T̄, using the inverse of each study's variance s_i^2 as weights. It tests whether the variability across studies exceeds what would be expected by chance under a common effect.
formula-notes:formula_A4.56:en.inThisChapter: This formula appears in the Formal Meta-Analysis section to provide a statistical test (Cochran's Q) for heterogeneity among study effects, which is essential for deciding whether to proceed with a fixed-effect model or to consider random-effects methods.

formula-notes:formula_A4.57:en.plainMeaning: This formula models the effect size T_i as a linear function of an overall mean θ, a sum of moderator variables M_ij weighted by coefficients b_j, and a residual error e_i.
formula-notes:formula_A4.57:en.inThisChapter: It appears here to extend the basic meta-analytic model by allowing moderator variables to explain heterogeneity, supporting the argument that a significant Q may be due to subgroup differences rather than random variation.

formula-notes:formula_A4.60:en.plainMeaning: This formula estimates the between-study variance σ_u² using the heterogeneity statistic Q and sums of inverse variances S_j, where s_i is the standard error of study i.
formula-notes:formula_A4.60:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the random-effects meta-analysis section to quantify the variance among true effects θ_i, supporting inference about the dispersion of treatment effects across studies.

formula-notes:formula_A4.58:en.plainMeaning: This formula represents the observed effect size T_i as the sum of the grand mean μ, a random study-specific deviation u_i, and a sampling error e_i. It is the random-effects meta-analysis model where u_i ~ N(0, σ_u^2) and e_i ~ N(0, σ_i^2).
formula-notes:formula_A4.58:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the Formal Meta-Analysis section to introduce the random-effects model, which accounts for between-study variability. This model supports later estimation of the variance σ_u^2 among true effects and the overall mean μ.

formula-notes:formula_A4.57:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将第 i 个研究的效应量 T_i 分解为总体均值 θ、m 个调节变量 M_{ij} 的线性组合（系数 b_j）以及随机误差 e_i，用于建模研究间异质性。
formula-notes:formula_A4.57:zh.inThisChapter: 在正式元分析章节中，该公式扩展了基础模型，通过引入调节变量回归来解释显著的 Q 统计量，为后续检验调节效应和探索异质性来源提供统计框架。

formula-notes:formula_A4.59:en.plainMeaning: This formula defines the weight w_i for study i in a random-effects meta-analysis, computed as the reciprocal of the sum of the within-study variance s_i^2 and the estimated between-study variance \(\widehat{\sigma}_{u}^{2}\).
formula-notes:formula_A4.59:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the Formal Meta-Analysis section to specify how studies are weighted when estimating the overall mean μ under the random-effects model, accounting for both sampling error and true effect heterogeneity.

formula-notes:formula_A4.58:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将第 i 个研究的观测效应 T_i 分解为总体均值 μ、该研究的随机偏移 u_i 和抽样误差 e_i，其中 u_i 反映研究间效应变异，e_i 反映研究内抽样误差。
formula-notes:formula_A4.58:zh.inThisChapter: 在随机效应元分析章节中，该公式正式引入研究间方差 σ_u^2，为后续估计总体均值 μ 和研究间方差 σ_u^2 以及进行异质性检验提供基础模型。

formula-notes:formula_A4.59:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式定义了随机效应元分析中第 i 个研究的权重 w_i，等于该研究内方差 s_i^2 与研究间方差估计值 σ̂_u^2 之和的倒数。
formula-notes:formula_A4.59:zh.inThisChapter: 在随机效应元分析中，由于效应量 θ_i 存在真实异质性 σ_u^2，权重需同时纳入研究内方差 s_i^2 和研究间方差 σ̂_u^2，以正确估计总体均值 μ 及其标准误。

formula-notes:formula_A4.60:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算随机效应方差分量σ_u^2的估计量，其中Q是异质性检验统计量，k是研究个数，S_j是各研究标准误s_i的-2j次幂之和。
formula-notes:formula_A4.60:zh.inThisChapter: 在随机效应元分析中，该公式用于从Q统计量中剥离出研究内方差，从而估计研究间方差σ_u^2，为后续计算总体均值μ的加权估计提供方差分量。

formula-notes:formula_A4.61:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算随机效应元分析中总体均值估计量 T̄ 的方差，它等于个体观测误差方差 σ² 除以总样本数 nk，再加上研究间方差 σ_u² 除以研究个数 k。
formula-notes:formula_A4.61:zh.inThisChapter: 此处出现在正式元分析章节，用于对比固定效应与随机效应模型：固定效应下方差仅依赖总样本数 nk，而随机效应下研究个数 k 同样重要，为后续讨论研究数量对估计精度的影响做铺垫。

formula-notes:formula_A4.62:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将第 i 个研究的观测效应量 T_i 分解为：总体均值 μ、m 个调节变量（moderator）的线性组合（b_j 为第 j 个调节变量的效应，M_ij 为第 i 个研究中该调节变量的取值）、研究间随机效应 u_i 以及抽样误差 e_i。
formula-notes:formula_A4.62:zh.inThisChapter: 在“正式元分析”章节中，该公式引入混合效应元分析模型，通过调节变量（如性别、性状类型）解释效应量的系统变异，为后续比较不同类别间选择强度差异提供统计框架。

formula-notes:formula_A4.62:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the observed effect size T_i as the sum of a grand mean μ, the linear contribution from m moderator variables (each with effect b_j and value M_{ij}), a random study-level effect u_i, and sampling error e_i.
formula-notes:formula_A4.62:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the Formal Meta-Analysis section to extend the basic random-effects model to a mixed model that accounts for categorical differences (e.g., between sexes or trait types) via moderator variables, supporting later tests of heterogeneity among subgroups.

formula-notes:formula_A4.63:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将观察到的效应量向量 y 分解为固定效应部分（M b）、随机效应部分（u）和抽样误差部分（e），其中 M 是调节变量设计矩阵，b 是固定效应系数向量，u 是研究间随机效应向量，e 是研究内抽样误差向量。
formula-notes:formula_A4.63:zh.inThisChapter: 在本节中，该公式引入混合效应元分析模型，通过调节变量 M 解释不同类别（如性别、性状类型）间平均效应量的差异，为后续讨论固定效应与随机效应的联合估计以及模型比较提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_A4.63:en.plainMeaning: This formula represents a mixed-effects meta-analysis model where the observed effect size vector y is decomposed into fixed effects (M b), random study effects (u), and sampling error (e). M is the design matrix for moderators, b is the vector of moderator coefficients, u is the vector of random effects, and e is the vector of residuals.
formula-notes:formula_A4.63:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on formal meta-analysis to extend the basic random-effects model by incorporating moderator variables, allowing the grand mean to vary across categories (e.g., male vs. female). This supports later arguments about testing whether selection strength differs among trait types.

formula-notes:formula_A4.61:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the variance of the overall mean estimate \(\overline{T}\) in a random-effects meta-analysis, where \(\sigma^2\) is the within-study variance per observation, \(\sigma_u^2\) is the between-study variance, \(n\) is the sample size per study, and \(k\) is the number of studies.
formula-notes:formula_A4.61:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the Formal Meta-Analysis section to contrast with the fixed-effects variance (Equation A4.30d), showing that under random effects the number of studies \(k\) matters separately from total observations \(nk\), which is crucial for understanding why increasing \(k\) reduces variance more effectively than increasing \(n\).

formula-notes:formula_A4.64:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将每个研究的效应量估计值 \(T_i\) 减去所有研究的均值 \(\overline{T}\) 得到 \(y_i\)，然后对 \(y_i\) 与标准误 \(s_i\) 进行线性回归，其中 \(a\) 是截距、\(b\) 是斜率、\(e\) 是残差。
formula-notes:formula_A4.64:zh.inThisChapter: 在“正式元分析”章节中，该回归用于检验漏斗图不对称性：若截距 \(a\) 显著不为零，则提示存在发表偏倚或小样本效应，为后续的敏感性分析或偏倚校正提供统计依据。

formula-notes:formula_A4.66:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算随机效应模型中观测效应绝对值期望E[|T|]与真实效应绝对值期望E[|θ|]的相对偏差，其中σ_e^2是抽样方差，σ_u^2是真实效应方差。
formula-notes:formula_A4.66:zh.inThisChapter: 在正式元分析章节中，该公式用于说明抽样误差σ_e^2会膨胀观测效应绝对值的期望，从而为后续讨论如何校正这种偏差提供理论依据。

formula-notes:formula_A4.65:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算了随机效应中真实效应绝对值 |θ| 的期望等于 σ_u 乘以 √(2/π)，而观测效应绝对值 |T| 的期望等于 √(σ_u² + σ_e²) 乘以 √(2/π)。关键符号：σ_u 是真实效应标准差，σ_e 是抽样误差标准差。
formula-notes:formula_A4.65:zh.inThisChapter: 出现在“正式元分析”章节，说明当关注效应绝对值而非均值时，观测效应 |T| 的期望因包含抽样误差 σ_e 而大于真实效应 |θ| 的期望，为后续推导元分析中绝对值效应的偏倚校正提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_A4.64:en.plainMeaning: This formula defines the Egger regression test, where the dependent variable y_i is the study estimate T_i centered by the overall mean T̄, and it is regressed on the standard error s_i to test for funnel asymmetry (publication bias).
formula-notes:formula_A4.64:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the Formal Meta-Analysis section to provide a quantitative test for publication bias, supporting the argument that funnel asymmetry can be formally assessed beyond visual inspection.

formula-notes:formula_A5.1:zh.plainMeaning: 这个公式定义了向量 x 的欧几里得范数（长度），它等于各分量平方和的平方根，也等于 x 与其自身内积的平方根。
formula-notes:formula_A5.1:zh.inThisChapter: 在本节中，该公式为后续讨论向量间的距离、夹角以及矩阵的范数提供了基础度量工具。

formula-notes:formula_A4.65:en.plainMeaning: This formula gives the expected absolute value of the true effect |θ| as σ_u√(2/π) and the expected absolute value of the observed effect |T| as √(σ_u²+σ_e²)·√(2/π), where σ_u² is the between-study variance and σ_e² is the sampling error variance.
formula-notes:formula_A4.65:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the random-effects meta-analysis section to show that while the mean estimate is unbiased, the absolute magnitude is inflated by sampling error, supporting the need to correct for attenuation when interest lies in |θ|.

formula-notes:formula_A5.1:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the Euclidean norm (length) of a vector x in ℝⁿ as the square root of the sum of squares of its components, equivalently the square root of the dot product of x with itself.
formula-notes:formula_A5.1:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the geometry section to define the fundamental concept of vector length, which is essential for later discussions of distance, orthogonality, and matrix norms.

formula-notes:formula_A4.66:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the proportional bias in the expected absolute effect size when using the observed absolute effect |T| instead of the true absolute effect |θ|, where σ_e^2 is sampling error variance and σ_u^2 is true effect variance.
formula-notes:formula_A4.66:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the random-effects meta-analysis section to quantify how sampling error inflates the expected absolute effect size, supporting the argument that naive estimates of |θ| are biased upward and require correction.

formula-notes:formula_A5.2:zh.plainMeaning: 这个公式计算向量 x 和 y 之间欧几里得距离的平方，等于各分量差平方和，也等于差向量的内积。
formula-notes:formula_A5.2:zh.inThisChapter: 在向量与矩阵几何章节中，它定义了向量间距离的度量，为后续讨论向量范数、正交性和最小二乘问题提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_A5.4:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式通过计算向量 x 与 y 的点积除以它们模长的乘积，再取反余弦，得到两个向量之间的夹角 θ。
formula-notes:formula_A5.4:zh.inThisChapter: 本节讨论向量与矩阵的几何意义，此公式将点积与夹角联系起来，为后续理解向量正交性、投影以及矩阵分解等概念提供几何基础。

formula-notes:formula_A5.3:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the cosine of the angle θ between two n-dimensional vectors x and y using their dot product and magnitudes. The numerator is the dot product (xᵀy or yᵀx), and the denominator is the product of their Euclidean norms.
formula-notes:formula_A5.3:en.inThisChapter: It appears in this section to quantify the geometric relationship (angle) between vectors, which is essential for defining orthogonality and orthonormality, and later supports arguments about vector projections and linear independence.

formula-notes:formula_A5.2:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the squared Euclidean distance between two vectors x and y, where ||·|| denotes the Euclidean norm, x_i and y_i are components, and the expression equals the dot product of the difference vector with itself.
formula-notes:formula_A5.2:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on vector geometry to define distance and norm properties, supporting later arguments on vector differences and orthogonality.

formula-notes:formula_A5.3:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式通过向量点积与模长的比值计算两个n维向量x和y之间夹角θ的余弦值，其中分子xᵀy（或yᵀx）是点积，分母||x||·||y||是模长乘积。
formula-notes:formula_A5.3:zh.inThisChapter: 本节讨论向量几何，该公式将向量夹角与点积、模长联系起来，为后续定义正交性（θ=90°时点积为零）以及正交基、正交矩阵等概念提供定量基础。

formula-notes:formula_A5.4:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the angle θ between two vectors x and y using the arccosine of the normalized dot product. The symbols are: θ (angle), x and y (vectors), ||·|| (Euclidean norm), and yᵀx (dot product).
formula-notes:formula_A5.4:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the geometry section to define the angle between vectors, which is fundamental for understanding orthogonality, projections, and later concepts like the Cauchy-Schwarz inequality and matrix factorizations.

formula-notes:formula_A5.6:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the vector projection of x onto y, where x^T y is the dot product and cos(θ)||x|| is the signed length of the projection; the result is a scalar multiple of y.
formula-notes:formula_A5.6:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the geometry section to illustrate how dot products relate to projection lengths, supporting later arguments about orthogonality and basis decomposition.

formula-notes:formula_A5.7:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the magnitude of the projection of vector x onto vector y, showing it equals |cos(θ)| times the magnitude of x, and is always ≤ ||x||. Key symbols: Proj(x on y) is the projection vector, θ is the angle between x and y, ||·|| denotes magnitude.
formula-notes:formula_A5.7:en.inThisChapter: It appears in this section to quantify the length of the projection vector, supporting the geometric interpretation that projection can reverse direction when cos(θ) is negative, and that its length never exceeds that of x.

formula-notes:formula_A5.7:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算向量 x 在 y 上的投影向量的长度，等于 |cos(θ)| 乘以 x 的范数，且该长度不超过 x 的范数。
formula-notes:formula_A5.7:zh.inThisChapter: 本节讨论向量与矩阵的几何性质，该公式通过投影长度与夹角余弦的关系，为后续推导投影矩阵及正交分解提供长度约束条件。

formula-notes:formula_A5.5:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the projection vector of vector x onto vector y, which is a vector in the direction of y with magnitude equal to the component of x along y. Key symbols: x, y (vectors), θ (angle between x and y), ||x||, ||y|| (norms).
formula-notes:formula_A5.5:en.inThisChapter: It appears in this section to define the geometric concept of projection, which is used later to decompose vectors and to derive orthogonal projections in linear algebra and least squares problems.

formula-notes:formula_A5.6:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算向量 x 在单位向量 y 上的投影向量，其中 xᵀy 是点积（标量），表示投影长度，乘以 y 得到方向与 y 相同的投影向量；cos(θ)||x|| 是点积的几何解释，θ 是 x 与 y 的夹角。
formula-notes:formula_A5.6:zh.inThisChapter: 本节讨论向量与矩阵的几何意义，此公式将投影运算表示为点积与向量 y 的乘积，为后续推导投影矩阵、正交分解等概念提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_A5.5:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式计算向量 x 在向量 y 上的投影向量，结果是一个与 y 同方向的向量，其长度等于 x 在 y 方向上的分量大小。关键符号：xᵀy 是点积，||y||² 是 y 的模长的平方，θ 是 x 与 y 的夹角。
formula-notes:formula_A5.5:zh.inThisChapter: 本节通过几何直观引入投影概念，该公式将投影表示为点积与模长的比值乘以 y，为后续讨论正交性、最小二乘等奠定基础。

formula-notes:formula_A5.8:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将任意n维向量x表示为在相互正交的向量y_i上的投影之和，即x等于各投影向量的线性叠加。
formula-notes:formula_A5.8:zh.inThisChapter: 本节讨论向量与矩阵的几何性质，该公式展示了正交基下向量的分解形式，为后续引入正交变换、最小二乘等概念提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_A5.9:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式表示向量 u_i 与 u_j 的内积：当 i=j 时内积为 1，否则为 0，即这些向量是单位长度且相互正交的。
formula-notes:formula_A5.9:zh.inThisChapter: 此公式定义了正交矩阵中列向量的标准正交性质，为后续利用正交矩阵实现旋转和缩放分解提供基础条件。

formula-notes:formula_A5.12:en.plainMeaning: This formula shows that the inner product of two transformed vectors y1 and y2 equals the inner product of the original vectors x1 and x2 when the transformation matrix U is orthonormal (U^T U = I).
formula-notes:formula_A5.12:en.inThisChapter: It appears in this section to demonstrate that orthonormal matrices preserve inner products, supporting the geometric interpretation that such transformations are rigid rotations of the coordinate system.

formula-notes:formula_A5.10:en.plainMeaning: This formula states that a unitary matrix U multiplied by its transpose (or vice versa) yields the identity matrix I, meaning U is orthogonal and its inverse equals its transpose.
formula-notes:formula_A5.10:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on vector/matrix geometry to define unitary matrices, which are essential for preserving lengths and angles in transformations, supporting later arguments on orthogonal diagonalization and least squares.

formula-notes:formula_A5.9:en.plainMeaning: This formula defines the orthonormality condition for a set of vectors: the dot product of any two distinct vectors is 0 (orthogonal), and the dot product of a vector with itself is 1 (unit length). The symbols u_i and u_j are column vectors from the matrix U.
formula-notes:formula_A5.9:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on geometry of vectors and matrices to establish the definition of an orthonormal matrix, which is essential for later decompositions like the singular value decomposition (SVD) that separate rotation and scaling.

formula-notes:formula_A5.8:en.plainMeaning: This formula expresses any n-dimensional vector x as the sum of its projections onto a set of mutually orthogonal vectors y_i, where Proj(x on y_i) is the projection of x onto y_i.
formula-notes:formula_A5.8:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the geometry section to show that orthogonal vectors form a basis for the vector space, supporting later arguments about decomposition and coordinate representation.

formula-notes:formula_A5.10:zh.plainMeaning: 这个公式表示矩阵U是正交矩阵（实矩阵情形）或酉矩阵（复矩阵情形），即U的转置（或共轭转置）与U相乘等于单位矩阵I，因此U的逆矩阵就是其转置。
formula-notes:formula_A5.10:zh.inThisChapter: 在向量与矩阵几何的章节中，该公式定义了正交（酉）矩阵的核心性质，为后续讨论向量正交变换、坐标旋转以及简化矩阵运算（如求逆）提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_A5.12:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式说明，经过正交矩阵U变换后的向量y1和y2的内积等于原始向量x1和x2的内积，因为U^T U = I，所以内积保持不变。
formula-notes:formula_A5.12:zh.inThisChapter: 在本节中，该公式用于证明正交矩阵保持内积，从而说明坐标变换是刚性旋转，为后续讨论正交变换的几何意义提供代数依据。

formula-notes:formula_A5.11:en.plainMeaning: This formula states that for a unitary matrix U, its transpose equals its inverse, meaning U^T U = I, where each column of U is orthonormal.
formula-notes:formula_A5.11:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the geometry section to highlight that unitary matrices preserve lengths and angles, supporting later arguments about orthogonal transformations and simplifications in linear algebra.

formula-notes:formula_A5.11:zh.plainMeaning: 这个公式表示对于酉矩阵（列向量单位长度且彼此正交的实矩阵），其转置等于其逆矩阵，即 U^T 与 U^{-1} 是同一个矩阵。
formula-notes:formula_A5.11:zh.inThisChapter: 在“向量与矩阵的几何”章节中，该公式直接由酉矩阵的定义推导而来，为后续利用正交变换简化计算（如坐标旋转、最小二乘）提供关键性质：求逆只需转置。

formula-notes:formula_A5.13:en.plainMeaning: This formula shows that the cosine of the angle between two vectors y1 and y2 equals the cosine of the angle between their pre-images x1 and x2 under an orthonormal transformation, where y_i = Q x_i with Q orthonormal. The cosine is computed as the normalized dot product.
formula-notes:formula_A5.13:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on geometry of vectors to demonstrate that orthonormal matrices preserve angles between vectors, supporting the argument that such transformations are rigid rotations/reflections.

formula-notes:formula_A5.13:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式表明，经过正交矩阵变换后，向量y1和y2之间的夹角余弦等于原始向量x1和x2之间的夹角余弦，即正交变换保持向量间的夹角不变。公式中y1和y2是变换后的向量，x1和x2是原始向量，分子是内积，分母是范数的乘积。
formula-notes:formula_A5.13:zh.inThisChapter: 本节讨论向量和矩阵的几何性质，该公式紧接正交矩阵保持向量长度不变的结论，进一步证明正交变换也保持向量间的夹角，为后续理解正交矩阵的保角性质提供关键推导。

formula-notes:formula_A5.14:en.plainMeaning: This equation defines eigenvalues λ and eigenvectors y of a square matrix A, where multiplying A by y yields a scalar multiple of y.
formula-notes:formula_A5.14:en.inThisChapter: It formalizes the geometric concept that eigenvectors are directions unchanged (except scaling) by A, supporting later arguments that eigenvectors reveal the inherent axes of the transformation.

formula-notes:formula_A5.14:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式表示对于方阵A，存在非零向量y和标量λ，使得A与y的乘积等于λ乘以y，即向量y经过A变换后方向不变（或反向），仅被缩放λ倍。
formula-notes:formula_A5.14:zh.inThisChapter: 本节引入特征值和特征向量的概念，该公式是定义特征方程的基础，后续将用于描述矩阵变换的固有轴和几何性质。

formula-notes:formula_A5.16:en.plainMeaning: The trace of a square matrix A, denoted tr(A), is the sum of its diagonal entries A_ii from i=1 to n.
formula-notes:formula_A5.16:en.inThisChapter: It appears here because the trace is the sum of principal minors of order 1 (S_1), linking eigenvalues to matrix invariants in the geometry of vectors and matrices.

formula-notes:formula_A5.17:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式表明，矩阵A的迹（tr(A)）等于其所有特征值λ_i之和，而矩阵A的行列式（|A|）等于其所有特征值λ_i之积。
formula-notes:formula_A5.17:zh.inThisChapter: 本节通过特征值将迹和行列式联系起来，为后续讨论协方差矩阵的总变异（迹）和奇异性（行列式为零）提供代数基础。

formula-notes:formula_A5.16:zh.plainMeaning: 公式 tr(A) = Σ A_ii 定义矩阵 A 的迹为对角线元素之和，即从第 1 行第 1 列加到第 n 行第 n 列的所有 A_ii 相加。
formula-notes:formula_A5.16:zh.inThisChapter: 本节讨论主余子式与特征值的关系，此处通过 S₁ 引出迹，为后续利用迹与行列式判断特征值符号（如正定矩阵）作铺垫。

formula-notes:formula_A5.15:en.plainMeaning: This is the characteristic equation of an n×n matrix A, expanded as a polynomial in (-λ) with coefficients S_i (sums of principal minors of order i). Solving it yields the eigenvalues λ.
formula-notes:formula_A5.15:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on eigenvalues to show that the characteristic equation is a polynomial of degree n, setting up the need to solve it for eigenvalues, which is central to matrix geometry and diagonalization.

formula-notes:formula_A5.15:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将特征多项式展开为关于(-λ)的n次多项式，其中S_i是A的所有i阶主子式之和，从而将特征值问题转化为求解该多项式的根。
formula-notes:formula_A5.15:zh.inThisChapter: 本节通过Laplace展开将特征方程|A-λI|=0化为多项式形式，为后续讨论特征值的代数性质（如迹、行列式与系数关系）以及数值求解奠定基础。

formula-notes:formula_A5.18:en.plainMeaning: This formula expresses a symmetric matrix A as a sum of rank-1 matrices, each formed by an eigenvalue λ_i and its corresponding orthonormal eigenvector e_i, representing the spectral decomposition of A.
formula-notes:formula_A5.18:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on geometry of vectors and matrices to show how a symmetric matrix can be decomposed into orthogonal projections onto its eigenvector directions, supporting later arguments about matrix diagonalization and principal component analysis.

formula-notes:formula_A5.17:en.plainMeaning: This formula expresses the trace (sum of diagonal entries) and determinant of a matrix A in terms of its eigenvalues λ_i: trace equals the sum of eigenvalues, determinant equals the product of eigenvalues.
formula-notes:formula_A5.17:en.inThisChapter: It appears in this section to connect matrix invariants (trace, determinant) to eigenvalues, supporting later arguments that the trace of a covariance matrix measures total variation and that a zero eigenvalue indicates singularity.

formula-notes:formula_A5.21:zh.plainMeaning: 这个公式表示标准基向量之间的内积：当 i=j 时内积为 1，否则为 0，即这些向量是单位正交的。
formula-notes:formula_A5.21:zh.inThisChapter: 在附录引言中，该公式用于定义标准正交基的性质，为后续构造对称矩阵的正交特征向量集提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_A5.18:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将对称矩阵A分解为特征值λ_i与对应单位特征向量e_i的外积的加权和，即A等于所有特征值乘以各自特征向量的自外积（e_i e_i^T）之和。
formula-notes:formula_A5.18:zh.inThisChapter: 本节通过正交特征向量基将矩阵表示为谱分解形式，为后续讨论矩阵的几何意义（如拉伸方向与幅度）以及简化二次型计算提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_A5.21:en.plainMeaning: This formula defines the orthonormality condition for eigenvectors: the dot product of two eigenvectors e_i and e_j is 1 if they are the same (i=j) and 0 otherwise (i≠j).
formula-notes:formula_A5.21:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the Appendix Introduction to establish the fundamental property of orthonormal eigenvectors, which is used later to simplify expressions involving symmetric matrices and to support spectral decomposition.

formula-notes:formula_A5.19:en.plainMeaning: This formula expresses the matrix-vector product Ax as a weighted sum of projections of x onto the orthonormal eigenvectors e_i, with weights equal to the eigenvalues λ_i. The symbols are: A (symmetric matrix), x (vector), λ_i (eigenvalues), e_i (orthonormal eigenvectors).
formula-notes:formula_A5.19:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the section on the geometry of vectors and matrices to illustrate the spectral decomposition of a symmetric matrix, showing how A acts by scaling components along eigen-directions. This supports later arguments about diagonalization and the geometric interpretation of linear transformations.

formula-notes:formula_A5.20:en.plainMeaning: This formula expresses the matrix-vector product Ax as the norm of x times a weighted sum of eigenvectors e_i, where each weight is the eigenvalue λ_i multiplied by the cosine of the angle between x and e_i.
formula-notes:formula_A5.20:en.inThisChapter: It appears in this section to illustrate how a matrix acts geometrically: multiplying a vector projects it onto the eigenvector directions, scaling each projection by the corresponding eigenvalue, thereby supporting the interpretation of a matrix as defining a projection space.

formula-notes:formula_A5.22:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式表示对称矩阵A可以通过正交矩阵U对角化为对角矩阵Λ，其中U的列是A的单位特征向量，Λ的对角元素是A的特征值。
formula-notes:formula_A5.22:zh.inThisChapter: 在附录介绍中，该公式展示了对称矩阵的特征分解形式，为后续推导矩阵函数或简化计算提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_A5.22:en.plainMeaning: This formula represents the eigendecomposition of a symmetric matrix A, where U is an orthonormal matrix of eigenvectors and Λ is a diagonal matrix of eigenvalues, showing that A can be reconstructed from its eigenvectors and eigenvalues.
formula-notes:formula_A5.22:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the Appendix Introduction to establish the spectral decomposition, which is used later to derive properties of covariance matrices or to simplify matrix operations in the main text.

formula-notes:formula_A5.23:en.plainMeaning: This formula defines a diagonal matrix A whose diagonal entries are the eigenvalues λ₁, λ₂, …, λₙ of a matrix, with all off-diagonal entries zero.
formula-notes:formula_A5.23:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the appendix introduction to define the diagonal eigenvalue matrix used in the eigendecomposition A = UΛUᵀ, supporting later spectral analysis.

formula-notes:formula_A5.19:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将对称矩阵A与向量x的乘积分解为各特征值λ_i乘以x在对应特征向量e_i上的投影（即(e_i^T x) e_i）的线性组合，其中每个投影分量被其对应的特征值缩放。
formula-notes:formula_A5.19:zh.inThisChapter: 在本节“向量与矩阵的几何意义”中，该公式展示了对称矩阵的谱分解如何将矩阵乘法解释为沿特征向量方向对输入向量进行缩放投影，为后续理解主成分分析（PCA）等降维方法的几何基础做铺垫。

formula-notes:formula_A5.20:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将矩阵A与向量x的乘积分解为：x的范数乘以各特征向量方向上的投影分量（由x与特征向量ei夹角的余弦给出）再乘以对应特征值λi的加权和。
formula-notes:formula_A5.20:zh.inThisChapter: 在本节中，该公式用于几何化解释矩阵乘法：矩阵A作用于向量x相当于将x投影到特征向量张成的空间上，并按特征值缩放后求和，为后续理解矩阵的谱分解和主成分分析奠定基础。

formula-notes:formula_A5.23:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式定义了一个对角矩阵 A，其对角线元素为 λ₁, λ₂, …, λₙ，其余位置均为 0，用于表示矩阵的特征值。
formula-notes:formula_A5.23:zh.inThisChapter: 在附录引言中，此公式给出特征值分解中 Λ 的具体形式，为后续推导 A = UΛUᵀ 及正交对角化提供基础。

formula-notes:formula_A5.24:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式将矩阵U表示为列向量e1, e2, ..., en的拼接，其中每个ei是矩阵A的第i个单位特征向量。
formula-notes:formula_A5.24:zh.inThisChapter: 在附录引言中，此公式用于定义正交矩阵U的结构，为后续推导特征分解A = UΛU^T提供基础，其中Λ是对角矩阵。

formula-notes:formula_A5.24:en.plainMeaning: This formula defines the matrix U whose columns are the unit eigenvectors e_i of A, forming an orthonormal basis. U is orthogonal, so its inverse equals its transpose.
formula-notes:formula_A5.24:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the appendix introduction to set up the eigendecomposition A = UΛU^T, which is used later for matrix diagonalization and spectral analysis.

formula-notes:formula_A5.26:zh.plainMeaning: 该公式表示对称矩阵A的逆矩阵可以通过其特征向量矩阵U和特征值对角矩阵Λ的逆来构造：A⁻¹ = U Λ⁻¹ Uᵀ。
formula-notes:formula_A5.26:zh.inThisChapter: 在附录引言中，此公式用于展示如何利用特征分解（公式A5.23）直接计算矩阵的逆，为后续推导涉及矩阵求逆的表达式提供基础工具。

formula-notes:formula_A5.25:en.plainMeaning: This formula expresses the matrix A as a sum of rank-1 matrices, each equal to the outer product of eigenvector e_i with itself, scaled by eigenvalue λ_i. U is the eigenvector matrix, Λ_i is a diagonal matrix with λ_i at the i-th position and zeros elsewhere.
formula-notes:formula_A5.25:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the appendix introduction to derive the spectral decomposition (eigendecomposition) of A, showing how A can be reconstructed from its eigenvalues and eigenvectors, which is fundamental for later arguments involving matrix diagonalization and principal component analysis.

formula-notes:formula_A5.26:en.plainMeaning: This formula computes the inverse of a symmetric matrix A by decomposing it into its eigenvectors U and eigenvalues Λ, then inverting the eigenvalues. U is the orthogonal matrix of eigenvectors, Λ is the diagonal matrix of eigenvalues, and Λ^{-1} has reciprocals of eigenvalues.
formula-notes:formula_A5.26:en.inThisChapter: It appears in the appendix introduction to provide a key linear algebra identity used for deriving or simplifying expressions in later sections, such as inverting covariance matrices or solving normal equations.

formula-notes:formula_A5.25:zh.plainMeaning: 这个公式将矩阵A分解为n个秩1矩阵λ_i e_i e_i^T的和，其中U是正交矩阵，Λ_i是对角矩阵（只有第i个对角元为λ_i，其余为零），e_i是第i个特征向量。
formula-notes:formula_A5.25:zh.inThisChapter: 在附录介绍中，该公式展示了谱分解的另一种推导形式，从A = U(∑Λ_i)U^T出发，利用U的正交性和Λ_i的结构，最终得到A = ∑λ_i e_i e_i^T，为后续理解特征分解的几何意义（旋转和缩放）提供代数基础。
